TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_TATARU_000_000: Good news, ! We've had a stroke of luck in our search for that beacon!
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_TATARU_000_001: Apparently, our colleagues have stumbled across a hidden path leading down into the hollows around the base of the Crystal Tower.
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_TATARU_000_002: ...A path I doubt we'd ever have found had the Ironworks and the Sons not added their numbers to the party.
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_TATARU_000_003: Thanks to them, we have eager eyes aplenty down there, checking under rocks and peering into every nook and cranny. Still, it sounds like there's a lot of ground to cover...
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_A1_000_005: Then we'd better go and give them a hand!
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_A2_000_006: ...Sounds like tedious work. But not as tedious as waiting around, I suppose.
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_TATARU_000_008: The sooner we find this beacon, the sooner you can travel to wherever it is this mysterious voice is coming from.
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_TATARU_000_009: Exactly! So I was thinking we should go and lend a hand. The sooner we find this beacon, the sooner you can travel to wherever it is this mysterious voice is coming from.
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_TATARU_000_010: And the sooner we can work out how to help our friends.
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_TATARU_000_011: We have to find a way to wake them up─and before the Empire comes calling again! Meaning we have no time to lose!
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_TATARU_000_012: There's a boat in north Silvertear waiting to ferry people to the site, so let's be on our way!
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_COINACHBOATMAN_000_: Heading to the survey site, ? It's on the eastern shore of the lake, and the swiftest way to get there is by boat.
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_Q2_000_021: Take the boat to the survey site?
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_HOARYBOULDER_000_03: ! The search continues, but I have no doubt we shall find this beacon of yours!
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_COULTENET_000_035: The air here weighs heavily upon me. 'Tis little wonder, I suppose, when standing in the shadow of such an imposing structure.
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_AENOR_000_040: The Archons need our help! Next to that, even matters of the heart don't seem to matter!
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_CLEMENCE_000_045: I've detected no slavering beasts in the vicinity...my sister excepted.
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_GARLONDMAN03279_000: The Ironworks is out in force! Master Garlond's orders!
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_COINACHINVESTIGATOR: That towering edifice is the outer wall of the Crystal Tower's foundation─the Labyrinth of the Ancients to be precise.
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_Q3_000_060: Continue with the main scenario quest?
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_GARLONDMAN03279_000: I've been keeping that device you uncovered safe and sound. Did you need to use it again...?
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_Q4_000_066: Touch the beacon and travel to the First?
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_COINACHINVESTIGATOR: Seeing as we've set up a site here anyway, we decided to conduct a thorough investigation of the tower's base.
TEXT_LUCKMA101_03279_MYSTERYVOICE_000_07: And here we are. Welcome, my friend, to the Crystarium.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_GARLONDMAN03279_100: I've been keeping that device you uncovered safe and sound. Did you need to use it again...?
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_Q0_100_000: Touch the beacon and travel to the First?
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MYSTERYVOICE_000_00: Now, a full and frank discussion in the privacy of my study would seem to be in order...
...But I think our conversation would be more meaningful were you first to gain a firmer grasp of the situation here.
To that end, I would like you to visit a few of the Crystarium's civic leaders, and glean something of this world and its predicament.
As you can see, this path will take you directly to the aetheryte─a convenience with which I am sure you are only too familiar.
Being the rightful object of my summoning spell, you should in theory be able to reach all the way back along your aetheric trail and find a connection in the Source, believe it or not.
I strongly suggest you complete this attunement before venturing any further.

After you have done so, walk up the steps next to the aetheryte and head out to the left to arrive in the Crystalline Mean. This is where you'll find our collective of crafters and gatherers, as well as their spokeswoman, Katliss─one of the people I should like you to meet.

Another is Moren. To reach him and his “Cabinet of Curiosity,” you'll want to avoid the aforementioned steps, take the exit on the left, and simply continue straight along and down until you come to the large doors at the end of the path.

The third and final person I should like you to meet is Bragi, our man in charge of trade and distribution. He is to be found in the markets, which you can access from the opposite side of the aetheryte plaza.
In seeking out each of my colleagues, you will visit the major districts of the city, and hopefully gain a feel for the place. I trust my directions were simple enough?
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_A1_000_012: To the right and down the where now...?
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MYSTERYVOICE_000_01: Hah, very good. I concede, the layout of the Crystarium owes more to historic necessity than planning, but I'm sure you'll learn its twists and turns before long.
My apologies. I forget how confusing the Crystarium can be for newcomers. Not to worry! I'm sure you'll soon become accustomed to its twists and turns.
...In all honesty, the true challenge may be in finding the right way to approach its citizens.
As you discovered during your encounter with the captain, the people of this world are unaware of the existence of other stars, and will struggle to accept the truth of your origin.

That being the case, when they ask whence you hail─as they inevitably will─I suggest you claim to share a homeland with the Crystal Exarch. There is an unspoken rule here about peering too deeply into that particular mystery.
When you've finished making the rounds, pray meet me in the large courtyard at the center of town. Until then.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MYSTERYVOICE_000_02: The attunement worked as hoped, I trust? Any trouble finding my three colleagues?

Remember: starting from the aetheryte, go up the steps and to the north to find the Crystalline Mean, where Katliss awaits, or forgo the steps and take the north passage to reach the Cabinet of Curiosity, and Moren.
Exiting to the south of the aetheryte plaza, meanwhile, will bring you to the markets, overseen by Bragi. The order in which you visit them is entirely up to you, of course.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_SYSTEM_000_030: By focusing your senses, you detect the flow of vastly distant currents of aether. Your connection to these energies is faint but stable, and should allow teleportation to aetherytes in the Source.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_KATLISS_000_040: Rare to see a place so well stocked with goods, isn't it? But not here.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_KATLISS_000_041: I'm going to guess you're new to our fair city?
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_KATLISS_000_042: Well, for what it's worth, you've chosen a fine sanctuary. The Exarch can throw up a barrier if the sin eaters come knocking, so it's a damn sight safer in here than it is out there.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_KATLISS_000_043: Safer and more civilized, too─thanks to us in the Mean. We work together to procure materials and resources, and craft the goods which make city life possible. This is the place to visit if you need a coat mended or a kettle forged!
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_KATLISS_000_044: Just don't go thinking it'll all be handed to you on a plate like those Eulmoran layabouts. Here in the Crystarium, we work for a living.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_KATLISS_000_045: Though I see you're no stranger to honest labor. You don't have that whiff of indolence about you like some folk I've met. Still, I can't quite pin down your profession... Where is it you're from?
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_KATLISS_000_046: ...One of the Exarch's countrymen, you say? ...I see.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_KATLISS_000_047: Well then, I'll work twice as hard to make you feel welcome! Our city wouldn't even exist if it weren't for him, and any friend of his is a friend of ours!
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_KATLISS_000_048: It's really quite incredible when you think about it. They say his grand magicks summoned the Crystal Tower into existence─pulled the entire thing out of thin air.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_KATLISS_000_049: It wasn't long before droves of refugees began congregating around its base, desperate for shelter after losing their homes to the Flood...
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_KATLISS_000_050: And that's how the Crystarium began. At the Exarch's invitation, buildings started going up, and with the help of some curious relics brought forth from the tower, the place gradually expanded into the thriving metropolis you see today.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_KATLISS_000_051: The city's stood here for decades now, yet the eldest among us swear the Exarch looks exactly the same as he did back then...
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_KATLISS_000_052: He is indeed a man of many mysteries. But for all his secrecy, he has never yet let us down.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_KATLISS_000_053: So if he─and you─wish to remain silent about your shared homeland, then the folk here will respect your wish for privacy.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_KATLISS_000_054: ...I am, however, more than a little curious to see any crafting talent you might be hiding! If you've aught to contribute on that front, be sure to come back and visit once you've had a chance to settle in.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_KATLISS_000_055: Just ask for Katliss, and I'll find you a niche here in the Crystalline Mean. You can help us keep the cogs of the city greased and turning!
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_SYSTEM_000_056: Your exchange with Katliss has taught you about “Life in the Crystarium.”
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_KATLISS_000_060: Feel free to look around the workshops, but try not to distract the artisans. If they fall behind in their quotas, then everyone suffers for it.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MOREN_000_070: Er, e-excuse me, ! Are you recently come to the city, perchance? I'm quite familiar with our civic roles, you see, and...well... Ahem!
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MOREN_000_071: Wh-What I mean to ask is, have you brought any books with you!? A rumpled scroll, even? A scrap of scribbled-on parchment...?
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MOREN_000_072: ...My apologies. Literature is something of an obsession of mine. As well as a profession.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MOREN_000_073: Librarian Moren, at your service. And this humble collection is known as the Cabinet of Curiosity.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MOREN_000_074: As your powers of perception have likely informed you, my colleagues and I are responsible for curating all manner of tomes, documents, and other vehicles for the written word.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MOREN_000_075: As horrific as the loss of life and land wrought by the Flood unquestionably was, the damage to recorded knowledge was no less catastrophic. We few do all we can to preserve what wisdom survived.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MOREN_000_076: But tell me, what brings you to the Cabinet today? Looking for any title in particular? Mayhap a spot of academic research!?
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MOREN_000_077: Oho! So you've an interest in modern history? Splendid! A thorough review of recent events can often yield novel perspectives, I quite agree!
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MOREN_000_078: If you would prefer something visual to accompany the account, then I think I have an illustrated history book for children somewhere... Just a moment, and I'll fetch it for you.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MOREN_000_079: And here we are. Would you like to pull up a chair? Make yourself more comfortable? ...Ahem, on with the lesson, then.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MOREN_000_080: A hundred years ago─or near enough not to matter─villains known as the Warriors of Light slew the Shadowkeeper, the steward of Darkness.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MOREN_000_081: In the wake of this tainted deed, Light began to pour into the world as if from unseen cracks. It pooled and swelled without cease, until the day an enormous, blinding wave rose up and swept across our star.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MOREN_000_082:
We called this calamity the “Flood of Light.”
Everything it touched was leeched of life and vigor, leaving naught behind but a luminous wasteland.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MOREN_000_083: Yet just when it seemed that all would be lost, a savior appeared before us...
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MOREN_000_084: The Oracle of Light. She stood 'twixt us and approaching doom, and by her power did she stay the Flood. Thus was Norvrandt, and Norvrandt alone, spared the fate of erasure.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MOREN_000_085: Tragedy would, however, arrive in another form. From the blasted emptiness descended horrors of strange and terrible aspect to bedevil the few folk who survived.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MOREN_000_086: These “sin eaters” were Light incarnate, and their fulgent presence stole the night from Norvrandt's sky.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MOREN_000_087: Even now, they circle the remaining bastions of civilization, ever on the hunt for us, ever hungering for our flesh...
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MOREN_000_088:
...And thus did the world become what it is.
Should you ever wish to hear the tale again, I would be glad to retell it for you.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MOREN_000_089: O-Or if you would rather I speak of other matters, that too would be my pleasure! I should be glad of the company!
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_SYSTEM_000_090: Your exchange with Moren has taught you about “The Flood of Light.”
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_BRAGI_000_100: New to the city, friend? The spinning head and wide eyes give you away.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_BRAGI_000_101: Welcome. My name is Bragi, and I'm the master of these markets. They gave the district another, official title, but I'm not in the habit of using it. Too florid by half...
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_BRAGI_000_102: In any case, our merchants stock a range of equipment for , so finding something in your size shouldn't be a problem.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_BRAGI_000_103: In any case, our merchants stock a wide range of equipment, so we should have something in your size. Forgive my asking, but you are a dwarf, yes? We don't get many of your lot coming down from the mountain these days.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_BRAGI_000_108: Hm? Must be a dialect I'm not familiar with.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_BRAGI_000_109: Let's see if we can straighten this out. See those two in front of us? The shorter one is a Hume.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_BRAGI_000_110: And the taller one is an elf.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_BRAGI_000_112: ...whilst the one with the horns is a Drahn.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_BRAGI_000_113: And then you have the large, scaly chaps with long tails and a knack for raising livestock. Those would be the Zun.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_BRAGI_000_114: ...Which is apparently not the name you know them by. Now I'm curious to know which far-flung region you hail from...
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_BRAGI_000_115: ...Which is apparently not what you call them. Do the dwarves have different names for all the peoples of the world? Or did you pick up the common tongue in some other far-flung region...?
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_BRAGI_000_116: Ah, the same as the Exarch, eh? Well, that explains it.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_BRAGI_000_117: You don't get much further-flung than that. We've had a few of your lot pass through in recent years, and despite their obvious learning, they floundered over the simplest things.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_BRAGI_000_118: But not to worry! Should you find yourself confused by the local language or customs, I'll be here to answer your questions.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_SYSTEM_000_119: Your exchange with Bragi has taught you about “The Peoples of the First.”
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_BRAGI_000_120: I didn't point them out earlier, but I'm sure you'll spot  Mystel, or another Ronso like  sooner rather than later. Even Viis like  aren't that unusual in this city.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_BRAGI_000_121: Aye, the Crystarium's long been a sanctuary for all manner of refugees─except maybe the dwarves.  lot prefer to keep themselves to themselves, in my experience.
TEXT_LUCKMA102_03280_MYSTERYVOICE_000_13: Well, how did you fare? Did my colleagues help you form a clearer picture of this world and its people?
Yes, it seems you were treated to a most thorough introduction. I understand it was something of a chore, but 'twas necessary that you grasp these things before we proceed.
As for the Crystal Tower's origin, you may have noted that details were sparse. The structure is, in fact, the selfsame one you know from the Source, transported to the First in its entirety.

It was my first attempt at breaching the boundaries between worlds─something of a trial run for your eventual crossing. And although I do not know which era I tore it from, I do know that its arrival served to set the wheels of fate in motion.
TEXT_LUCKMA103_03281_GARLONDMAN03279_100: I've been keeping that device you uncovered safe and sound. Did you need to use it again...?
TEXT_LUCKMA103_03281_Q0_100_000: Touch the beacon and travel to the First?
TEXT_LUCKMA103_03281_MYSTERYVOICE_000_00: You've done as I requested, and learned something of the world in which you find yourself. Now it's time I fulfilled my half of the bargain, and explained what has befallen your comrades.
That is a conversation I would rather have in the privacy of my quarters, however. I must go on ahead to the tower and organize a few things, but I shall see that the guard knows to admit you.
TEXT_LUCKMA103_03281_A1_000_003: The tower's gate lies open, then?
TEXT_LUCKMA103_03281_A1_000_004: Just like that? Then...G'raha Tia is...?
TEXT_LUCKMA103_03281_MYSTERYVOICE_000_00: Well, yes, of course. It can be opened and closed just like any other. Does that seem strange to you?
I know not how the tower functioned in your time, but I assure you there is no danger of us being locked inside.
...I am not familiar with that name. Is there something I should know?

An extraordinary tale. But I'm afraid I found no such individual residing in the tower when it passed into my care. Mayhap we can revisit that mystery another time. For now, I think it best that we focus on the present.
TEXT_LUCKMA103_03281_CRYSTALGATEKEEPER_0: Greetings, . The Exarch awaits you within.
Touring the city with the Exarch, are you? You could have no finer guide!
TEXT_LUCKMA103_03281_MYSTERYVOICE_000_03: The Crystarium boasts a number of residential districts, but I have been informed that a room has just become available at the Pendants.
Which, as it turns out, is perfect. Our path there will take us past the markets, and I was hoping to give you my own introduction to their wares. Come along.
TEXT_LUCKMA103_03281_SYSTEM_000_035: As a result of your pact with Feo Ul, you now have access to delivery moogles, market boards, and summoning bells while in the First.
TEXT_LUCKMA103_03281_GUIDEOFTHEPENDANTS_: Welcome to the Pendants, . You're here with the Exarch...?
TEXT_LUCKMA103_03281_MYSTERYVOICE_000_05: Ah, there you are─I was just finalizing the matter of your accommodation. You'll have a private room here at the Pendants for the duration of your stay, to make use of as you see fit.
When you are ready to retire, the manager will show you to your lodgings. Pray rest and recuperate, and we shall reconvene in the Ocular anon.
I believe that covers all of the practical concerns...
...Thank you for answering my call, . We are denied the comforting blanket of night, but may peaceful dreams attend you nonetheless.
TEXT_LUCKMA103_03281_GUIDEOFTHEPENDANTS_: A pleasure to meet you, , and welcome to your new home at the Pendants.
Your room is ready, if you'd care to retire?
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_MYSTERYVOICE_000_00: You will visit Alphinaud in Kholusia, then? Excellent.
As I mentioned, your destination is an island off the west coast, so you will need a mount capable of making the journey.
Here is a letter of introduction. Present it to Szem Djenmai, the Master of Beasts at Temenos Rookery, and he will take care of you.
When you see Alphinaud, be sure to pass on my warmest regards.
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_SZEMDJENMAI_000_010: Your face is unknown to me. What business have you at my rookery?
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_SZEMDJENMAI_000_011: ...Hmph. Signed by the Exarch, no less.
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_SZEMDJENMAI_000_012: Yes, I can provide you with an amaro for passage to Kholusia. I will pick you out a friendly whelp.
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_A2_000_017: Amaro are often used for travel, then?
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_A2_000_018: And there I was expecting a chocobo...
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_SZEMDJENMAI_000_019: That's right. Mounts like my grey friend over there are a common sight in these parts.
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_SZEMDJENMAI_000_020: But I gather you hail from further afield. More accustomed to chocobos, perchance? I hear there are a few places where they ride little else.
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_SZEMDJENMAI_000_021: A chocobo? Do you hail from one of Norvrandt's more isolated settlements, perchance? I hear there are a few places where they ride little else.
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_SZEMDJENMAI_000_022: But here in the Crystarium, mounts like that grey fellow there are far more commonly used.
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_SZEMDJENMAI_000_023: ...Hm. Seeing as you are plainly unaccustomed to riding amaro, I think it best I accompany you on this flight myself.
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_SZEMDJENMAI_000_024: Any Zun worthy of the name could do it, of course, but the Exarch sent you to me. Ensuring you arrive safely is my responsibility.
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_SZEMDJENMAI_000_025: Gather your things and meet me at the Amaro Launch. One of the junior tamers will attend to you while I ready the mounts.
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_SZEMDJENMAI_000_030: Wait for me at the Amaro Launch. Just mention my name to the tamer on duty, and he will see you are taken care of.
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_BOARDINGGATETOKHOLU: You want to fly an amaro to Kholusia? Well, I suppose if Master Djenmai is going with you...
Wait here, please. The master should be along with the mounts shortly.
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_SYSTEM_000_042: You can now travel to Kholusia! Speak with the aspiring amaro tamer to fly to the island.
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_SYSTEM_000_043: You can also use your aether compass to assist with locating aether currents in new regions. The aether compass can be found under Collection in the Duty section of the main menu.
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_SZEMDJENMAI_000_060: We are arrived. This is Cracked Shell Beach, on the eastern coast of Kholusia. You should be safe here for the present.
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_SZEMDJENMAI_000_061: Compared to the mainland, sin eater attacks are far less prevalent. And the native beasts are not any more dangerous than elsewhere.
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_SZEMDJENMAI_000_062: It is the people you should be wary of...
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_SZEMDJENMAI_000_063: Spy you that city in the distance? That is Eulmore, the island's main settlement.
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_SZEMDJENMAI_000_064: It rivals the Crystarium in scale, and was once an ally in our battle against the abominations.
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_SZEMDJENMAI_000_065: For years, the Eulmoran elite have fancied themselves the masters of what remains of our broken world. They have gone as far as to offer the leaders of other settlements their protection─if we bend the knee.
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_SZEMDJENMAI_000_066: But to say their ideals are questionable would be putting it mildly. The Crystarium is one among many who resist their heavy-handed authority, and while we are not at war, our relationship with Eulmore is strained at best.
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_SZEMDJENMAI_000_067: It may be wise to conceal your ties with the Exarch during your stay here, especially in the vicinity of the city.
TEXT_LUCKMA201_03282_SZEMDJENMAI_000_068:
I am glad we understand each other.
Now, the Exarch has instructed me to divulge a secret that should make finding your friend a good deal easier. Listen closely...
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_SZEMDJENMAI_000_000: ...If you head south along the coast, you will eventually come to a fisherman's shack.
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_SZEMDJENMAI_000_001: A friend of the Crystarium lives there─a man who goes by the name of “Eybor.”
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_SZEMDJENMAI_000_002: Eybor keeps an eye on everything that happens in Kholusia, and will be able to point you in the right direction. Just hand him a sprig of thyme─that will let him know you can be trusted.
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_SZEMDJENMAI_000_003: Here─this should be enough. Find your friend. I will stay here with the amaro until you are ready to return.
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_EYBOR_000_010: What you after? Fish? Crab? Think I've got an eel in a barrel somewhere, if you've a taste for 'em...
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_EYBOR_000_011: Ooh, I do love a bit of thyme. Chuck some in the pan, and it's like a bloody festival of flavor.
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_EYBOR_000_012: ...Now what is it I can do for you? Can't say as there's been any major upsets to report these past few weeks.
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_EYBOR_000_013: Alphinaud, eh? Aye, I know the one. Our young champion of the downtrodden.
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_EYBOR_000_014: Eulmore's richer than all of Norvrandt put together, but it's a different story for them as live outside the city. Most spend every wakin' moment just tryin' to stay alive─which makes your friend's dedication to helpin' others stand out all the more.
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_EYBOR_000_015: Aye, I can hazard a guess as to where he is now, get a message to him. But you'll need somewhere quiet to meet, away from pryin' eyes...
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_EYBOR_000_016: Make for Stilltide─that's the fishin' village just up the path there. You're lookin' for a run-down excuse for a tavern the locals call the Leaky Keel. Wait there, and I'll see that Alphinaud joins you.
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_EYBOR_000_020: Get yourself to the Leaky Keel in Stilltide. I'll let Alphinaud know someone's waitin' for him.
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_THEVA_000_030: This your first time in a tavern? It's customary to buy a drink if you mean to loiter. What'll you be having?
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_THEVA_000_035: A fine choice. And what'll you be paying with?
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_THEVA_000_036: Well now...those are exotic. Where did you come by coins like that?
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_THEVA_000_037: I'm sorry, dear, I don't doubt they have value... But I don't have a touchstone to test their purity, and I'm not about to go begging for one from the neighbors─so we'll just have to come to some other arrangement.
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_THEVA_000_038: Ah, here's an idea... There's a common to the north where we grow our vegetables, but lately the pests have been eating more of them than we have. What do you say to a bit of extermination work?
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_THEVA_000_039: I want you to squash any vermin you find, then visit the caretaker and give him an earful from me for sleeping on the job. He'll be in the old silo next to the fence─snoring, like as not.
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_THEVA_000_040: Do that for me, and you can laze about here as long as you like.
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_THEVA_000_050: Head over to Governor's Row and rid the field of any vermin you see. Then call in at the old silo, and let our wastrel of a caretaker know what I think of the “care” he's been taking.
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_SYSTEM_000_060: No response. Maybe you need to knock louder.
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_SYSTEM_000_070: No response. Perhaps the occupant is hard of hearing...?
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_SYSTEM_000_080: You hear a faint squeaking from the room beyond. Time to burst in and save the day, brave adventurer!
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_SYSTEM_000_081: ...No one is home, and judging by the lack of furniture, they haven't been for some time. The gnawed scraps of vegetables on the floor suggest rats have taken up residence in their absence.
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_THEVA_000_090: Welcome back, dear. What did that good-for-nothing caretaker have to say for himself?
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_THEVA_000_091: ...Gone? Hmph. Must have left to join the rest of the hopefuls.
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_THEVA_000_092: ...In Gatetown. Outside Eulmore? You don't have a clue what I'm talking about, do you. And there I was thinking you were another dreamer.
TEXT_LUCKMA202_03283_THEVA_000_093: Well, never mind all that. Take a seat wherever you like, dear, you've more than earned it. I'll even throw in another drink, on the house.
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Assuming you have no objections, let us make our way directly to the city outskirts.
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_001: If we time our arrival just right, you may be lucky enough to see why I have yet to set foot in Eulmore─despite my best efforts to do so...
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Come. From here, we must head west, and then cross a small bridge...
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Kholusia seems peaceful, does it not? Almost...familiar? I had a similar impression of the Crystarium. Even in this distant world, people are much the same.
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_011: <sigh> To think that whenever a calamity struck the Source, a reflection such as this one─with all its culture and history─was being erased from existence...
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_FEARLADY03284_000_0: Oh, thank the fates, y─ Look out!
My poor heart... Thank you, young .
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_041: Ah, there you are! In my haste, I lost my bearings... But I see you have the situation well in hand. Fine work!
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_FEARLADY03284_000_0: Just a few bruises from where I fell. Nothing compared to what was in store for me before this brave soul came to my rescue.
I honestly thought I was done for. My feet are not as swift as they once were, and I knew there was no one left to hear me scream. Not that I let that stop me!
<sigh> I should probably leave my old house behind and queue up outside Eulmore with the rest of them.
Doubt those fancy lords and ladies would welcome an old crone like me... Still, even a shack near the gate has to be safer than staying here!
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_047: One would hope. Either way, I suggest you avoid wandering alone, lest you make the sin eaters' task any easier.
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_FEARLADY03284_000_0: Thank you again. You saved my life. Now, I'm sure a strapping  like you has little to fear, but I wouldn't linger long in this place. There's naught to be had here but cobwebs and memories.
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_049: 'Tis as the lady says. Many in these parts have abandoned their homes to live in Eulmore's shadow.
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Should the sin eaters descend upon this region, there are precious few with the strength to fight them off...
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_051: Speaking of which, what have you been told of these monsters?
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_052: Ah, yes. Alisaie would be well qualified to speak on the subject.
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_053: Compared with Amh Araeng, Kholusia is almost a haven... But as you saw, we cannot let our guard down. Had you arrived but a few moments later, the sin eaters would have claimed another victim.
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_054:
A brief history, then...
'Twas not long after the Flood swallowed the better part of the world that the sin eaters first appeared, some beastly, some beauteous.
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_055: Yet regardless of their form, all seem incapable of speech, and all are driven by the same insatiable appetite for mortal aether. They are predators─and we are their prey.
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_056: Kholusia suffers from far fewer attacks than most regions, but even so, the list of the sin eaters' victims grows longer by the day. A tragedy without end...
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_057: Still, we have won a small victory this time, at least. Now, shall we press on?
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_058: We need to return to where the road forks and follow the path that leads west...
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_GATETOWNMIDDLEAGE_0: Mmm, do I savor it piece by piece, or gobble it all in one go...?
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_DREAMINGLADY03284_0: Ah, Eulmore, you taunt me with your promised bounty...
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_080: Now you understand why my attempts to enter the city have thus far come to naught. The dubious privilege of residency must be won via a contest with ever-changing rules...
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_081: They say this policy has been in place for the past two decades, ever since Eulmore's current ruler came into power.
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_082: Yet from what I have seen, it does more harm than good. Not only does it distract people from our shared struggle against the sin eaters, it robs them of their self-sufficiency. I have tried to propose ways they could improve their lot, but my words invariably fall on deaf ears.
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_083: The attitude is so entrenched now, I worry that─ Well, mayhap you should take a turn around Gatetown, and judge the situation for yourself.
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_090: Go, take the measure of Gatetown. I shall wait here.
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_SYSTEM_000_100: A large pot bubbles over the flame. Pale chunks─meol, you realize─float in the otherwise plain broth.
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_GATETOWNMIDDLEAGE_0: Still here, are you? Can't blame you for wanting a slice of Eulmore's pie. If you ask me, you should ditch that sour-faced brat and make a home for yourself here!
Gatetown's not much to look at, aye, but at least it's safe. And the meol is the best thing I've ever tasted!
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_DREAMINGLADY03284_0: Just look at it... Can you imagine a more beautiful city?
Every day, I dream of the life that waits for me inside those walls. Oh, will they ever pick me...?
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_130: You've seen what Gatetown has to offer?
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_131: These people can no longer fend for themselves. They've become dependent on handouts of meol, and believe Eulmore is the answer to all their woes.
TEXT_LUCKMA203_03284_ALPHINAUD_000_132: Yet no matter how I frame my encouragement, they seem unwilling─nay, unable─to conceive of any other way of life...
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_A1_000_001: You disapprove of these people's way of life?
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_003: Disapprove...? It frustrates me, certainly. That is only part of it, though. The whole situation makes me uneasy.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_004: 'Tis difficult to make a final judgment without first seeing the city's inner workings. Mayhap it is that uncertainty which always makes me feel so ill at ease here...
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_005: Not that it matters. However unjust this system seems to me, if these people claim to be content with their lot, it is hardly my place to criticize their choices.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_006: But take that elderly lady you rescued─does it not seem that those who have chosen to forgo Eulmore's largesse are doomed to suffer for their independence?
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_007: In the end, they are all but forced to seek refuge in Gatetown. And so hamlets and fields across the island are left empty and untended, hastening the region's descent into ruin.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_008: Nay, I am not convinced that Eulmore's generosity truly serves the best interests of Kholusia's people.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_009: I am not so naive as to think there is some miraculous solution to all of this. Yet I cannot help but frown at the sight of hardworking villagers struggling to survive, even as the chosen few rejoice at being plucked from poverty by the hand of a capricious noble.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_010: There has to be a better way. I will not know for sure, however, until I have taken those long-delayed steps through Eulmore's gates.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_011: 'Tis fortunate that you arrived when you did, . I have been working on a scheme to insinuate myself into the city, and if all goes to plan, it should soon come to fruition.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_012: There is a beast tribe who makes its home in the seas surrounding the island. The Ondo, they are called, though you and I know them as Sahagin.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_013: For the most part, they keep to themselves in their ocean grottoes, and rarely have dealings with land-dwellers.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_014: But as Tataru took such great pains to impress upon me during our stay in Kugane, business favors the bold. And so I reached out to them.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_015: I duly discovered that the Ondo are inordinately fond of land-grown produce─fresh fruits in particular. And when I offered to procure such goods for them, they promised to pay me in pearls.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_016: An attractive business venture for any prospective investor, would you not agree? Surely even the most jaded Eulmoran lord would have time for a merchant who can make pearls from plums and pumpkins?
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_017: Yes, I've come a long way since my days of buying samurai swords without first negotiating a price!
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_018: My appointment with the Ondo is due to take place in a few hours. I just need to collect the produce and meet with them on the shore.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_019: Might you help me make the exchange?
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Excellent, I should be glad of your company.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_021: First things first, then─we must pay a visit to Mosha-Moa, my supplier in Wright. Come, it is just to the northwest of here.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_030: This is Mosha-Moa, the farmer of whom I spoke.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_MOSHAMOA_000_040: ...Is there something I can do for you, friend?
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_041: Good day to you, Mosha-Moa. This is my associate, . We are here to collect the produce I purchased.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_MOSHAMOA_000_042: ...Eh? I loaded your lackey up with the goods not long ago.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_043: My lackey? I know of no such person!
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_MOSHAMOA_000_044: Mystel lad, short blue hair? ...No? He said he'd come on your behalf, and since he seemed to know all the details, I just assumed...
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_045: Confound it. Someone must have been eavesdropping on our conversation...
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_046: If this charlatan was here not long ago, he cannot have gone far. We should split up and search the area. You find a vantage point on the south side of town, and I shall take the west!
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_MOSHAMOA_000_050: Forgive me, I had no cause to doubt the lad. Still, he shouldn't be hard to spot with that blue hair of his...
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_SYSTEM_000_060: Search the surroundings for a male Mystel with short blue hair. You may move the camera as well as zoom in and out. Target a likely suspect and inspect him with .
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_064: ...You've a keen eye. Let us move in, before he makes good his escape!
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Here! He's breathing, I think, though he won't last long without help.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_080: ...That should take care of the worst of his injuries.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_082: Breathe easy, sir. No harm will come to you here.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_083: The poor man is shivering. Pray keep an eye on him while I get a fire going.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_TRISTOL_000_084: I thought for certain I was d-dead. How am I ever to repay this kindness...?
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_085: We'll settle for the tale behind your current predicament. Why don't you begin by telling us your name?
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_TRISTOL_000_086: (-Tristol-)Tristol. I was invited into Eulmore to work as an artist...
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_TRISTOL_000_087: (-Tristol-)A wealthy couple took me in to paint pictures for them, but when my style proved contrary to their taste, they just as quickly turfed me out onto the street.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_TRISTOL_000_088: (-Tristol-)I was left penniless and patronless─a grave sin in Lord Vauthry's city.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_TRISTOL_000_089: (-Tristol-)Within days, they had brought me before the man himself, and he asked me what I meant to do. Dejected as I was, I told him that I wished to leave...
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_TRISTOL_000_090: (-Tristol-)Little did I know how soon he would grant me my wish! They flung me over the balustrade into the godsdamned ocean!
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_091: From up there!? How were you not dashed to pieces!?
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_TRISTOL_000_092: (-Tristol-)Don't ask me. Luck, I suppose. Though if you hadn't found me when you did, it wouldn't have counted for much.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_093: Monstrous... And the citizens condone such barbaric punishment!?
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_TRISTOL_000_094: (-Tristol-)Oh, without a second thought. When Lord Vauthry passes judgment, no one so much as blinks, let alone argues.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_TRISTOL_000_100: Ah, that fire's chased the chill from my bones. Thank you again...
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_101: The more I hear about Eulmore, the more determined I am to see what waits within its walls.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_102: I shall bend all my thoughts toward securing another way into the city. There must be something we can do...
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_103: But first, we should convey Tristol to the shelter of the village. Fire or no fire, he needs to be out of this chilly coastal air.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_110: I wonder what Tristol will do now...
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_TRISTOL_000_120: Pray accept my deepest gratitude. I owe you both my life.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_TRISTOL_000_121: And...if you'll permit me, I would assist you in your attempt to enter Eulmore─insofar as I am able, at any rate.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_TRISTOL_000_122: To be frank, the thought of sending my saviors into that awful place makes me sick to the stomach─but since it's plain you've set your minds on it...you should take this.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_TRISTOL_000_124: The Eulmoran elite are never satisfied until they get exactly what they want, and if I'm not mistaken, the couple I mentioned will be looking for someone to replace me. If you make a show of owning such a well-used brush, you may be able to convince people you have a talent for painting.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_ALPHINAUD_000_125: Are you certain? This is your livelihood. We cannot deprive you of such a treasured possession...
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_TRISTOL_000_126: I give it gladly after all you've done for me. Besides, I can't─ I...don't think I have the heart to paint anymore.
TEXT_LUCKMA204_03285_TRISTOL_000_127: As to what I'll do instead...I honestly haven't decided. But I shan't stay long in this place─not with that city brooding over me. Nay, I'll move on to new lands and a new profession. And I'll keep you in my prayers from now until my dying day.
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_TRISTOL_000_000: Should you make it into the city, have care what you say and do. I wouldn't want you to save my life only to lose your own...
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_ALPHINAUD_000_010: They say kindness is its own reward, but Tristol has repaid us with a gift as timely as it was unexpected.
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_ALPHINAUD_000_011: We will, however, need to act upon his advice before another painter steps in to fill the vacancy. Thankfully, I do have some modest skill with a brush. Nothing approaching that of a true artist, of course, but enough to play the role, I would hope.
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_ALPHINAUD_000_012: As for you... Hmmm... Well...if you don't mind taking a subordinate role, mayhap you could pose as my assistant?
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_ALPHINAUD_000_013: Then it is settled! All we need do now is return to Gatetown, and await the next appearance of those vile jesters.
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Now we wait. This should be as good a place as any.
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_CLOWNOFRED_000_031: Ladies and gentlemen! Your attention once more! What a day it's been for the folks at our door!
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_CLOWNOFBLUE_000_032: We've welcomed a peddler who made pearls from a plum, and now we've a place for a painter of aplomb.
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_CLOWNOFRED_000_033: So come along and don't be slow! It's time to let your colors show!
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_ALPHINAUD_000_034: I can paint. Portraits, at least. Landscapes and still lifes are so rarely commissioned these days...
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_CLOWNOFRED_000_035: Oho, I thought I spied some new faces in the crowd. What fortune that you should feel at ease around an easel!
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_CLOWNOFBLUE_000_036: What proof have you of your prowess? Any masterpieces on your person?
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_ALPHINAUD_000_037: Sadly not. Everything I paint is soon sold. Such is the life of a working artist.
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_ALPHINAUD_000_038: I have only my brush to testify for me─though you will note that it has seen no small amount of service.
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_CLOWNOFBLUE_000_039: Aha, hoho, hm hm. Flecks of paint, both old and new, a tool much loved and much used.
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_CLOWNOFRED_000_040: Not a prop to be conjured on the hop! Very well! Come with us, and we'll put those talents to the test!
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_CLOWNOFBLUE_000_041: And who is this hanger-on? Well-wisher or parasite?
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_ALPHINAUD_000_042: Why, this is my assistant.  whose unfailing support allows my art to flourish. I will go with  or not at all!
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_CLOWNOFBLUE_000_043: Parasite, then. We shall leave  fate in the hands of your new employer─it matters not a whit to us.
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_CLOWNOFRED_000_044: And having filled our latest vacant space, we retire to Eulmore's sweet embrace!
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_CLOWNOFBLUE_000_046: Oh, mercy me! The meol! We almost took our leave without leaving a loving token!
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_CLOWNOFRED_000_047: We must empty the sacks ere we make our way back!
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_Q0_000_048: Continue with the main scenario quest?
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_CLOWNOFBLUE_000_055: Looks even grander from this angle, eh? Eh?
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_CLOWNOFRED_000_060: Welcome, welcome, to the city of final pleasures! Feel free to weep at its magnificence! ...No? Not even a single tear? Moving right along, then!
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_CLOWNOFRED_000_061: Our first task is to register you as residents─you know, make it all nice and official. We'll smooth the way, so you just need to put on your happy faces and head through to Joyous Hall.
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_CLOWNOFRED_000_062: The Bureau of Immigration is in the first room on the left side of the passage. Declare your name and occupation in a nice loud voice─the clerks will tell you where to go from there.
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_CLOWNOFRED_000_063: Oh, and pay no mind to those folk off to the side of the road. Much like the hopefuls in Gatetown, they haven't earned the right to enter the city proper.
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_CLOWNOFRED_000_064: If, however, you enjoy basking in the envy of your fellow man, then by all means...take your time. But why waste another moment? Go! Enjoy the beginning of your new life in paradise!
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_ALPHINAUD_000_065: The Bureau of Immigration, was it? I suppose we had better show ourselves willing for the time being...
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_BUREAUOFIMMIGRATION: Welcome to Eulmore, fortunate friends! May I have your names?
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_ALPHINAUD_000_071: I am Alphinaud, an artist, and this is , my assistant.
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_BUREAUOFIMMIGRATION: Ah, yes, I was informed of your imminent arrival. We can forgo the usual interview and begin processing your registration papers forthwith.
Now, the citizens of Eulmore are divided into two classes. There are the “free,” who are blessed with the favor of Lord Vauthry, and the “bonded,” who work in the employ of the free.
You will be joining the ranks of the bonded. Your duties are to serve a patron in the capacity for which you were chosen─in your case, painting pretty pictures.
Should your patron dismiss you for any reason, you must find another sponsor among the free, or accept work as a general laborer.
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_ALPHINAUD_000_076: I see. And might you tell us something of the patron we are to serve?
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_BUREAUOFIMMIGRATION: The two patrons, actually. Chai-Nuzz and Dulia-Chai─a Mystel couple whom most refer to as the “Chais.”
They are both gentle souls, but I would ask that you conduct yourself with respect and humility...for your own sake as much as theirs.
Now. A moment, please, while I complete the relevant paperwork...
All in order. These are your registration documents.
Take those papers next door and submit them to the clerk. Once they've been stamped, you will officially be Eulmoran citizens.
Enjoy your new life in paradise!
Have you submitted your papers to the Bureau of Registration? Everything in its proper place!
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_BUREAUOFREGISTRATIO: Welcome to the Bureau of Registration. Papers, please.

What have we here...?
“Alphinaud, artist. , artist's assistant. To be employed in the service of Lord Chai-Nuzz and Lady Dulia-Chai...”
Yes, everything seems to be in order! Your registration is hereby approved.
I think it best that we deliver you to the Chai residence before─
Did you crawl here through a ditch? It's like an unholy miasma of dust and sweat and the musk of some unwashed beast!
Proceed directly to the Delousery next door and scrub yourselves clean. Use whichever showers are free.
After you've rinsed away that stench, you'll want to splash yourselves with this perfume. Liberally.
Once you've made yourself presentable, then you may proceed to the Chai residence. Cornenne, the guard by the stairs, will give you directions.
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_ALPHINAUD_000_110: I hadn't realized we were so...aromatic.
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_ALPHINAUD_000_120: We're to bathe in here, then...?
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_BUREAUOFREGISTRATIO: A clean Eulmoran is a happy Eulmoran! Don't forget to scrub behind your ears!
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_SYSTEM_000_130: You rinse yourself clean in the stream of water...
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_SYSTEM_000_140: You apply the perfume as directed, and the delicate scent of roses fills the air...
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_ALPHINAUD_000_150: Oh, you've showered and dressed already, have you...?
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_ALPHINAUD_000_151: Is it not─ Th-That is to say... Ahem. It seems rather...exposed for one's ablutions, does it not...?
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_A1_000_155: Alisaie would have been drying her hair by now.
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_ALPHINAUD_000_156: Fine. Just a quick rinse, then...
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_ALPHINAUD_000_157: Good gods... You will mention nothing of this! Swear to me!
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_ALPHINAUD_000_158: ...Wouldn't she just. Very well...I shall endeavor to emulate her boldness, then. Courage, Alphinaud!
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_ALPHINAUD_000_159: Well, that was bracing! I believe the lingering smells of the road have been successfully expunged.
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_ALPHINAUD_000_160: Shall we go and present ourselves to our new patrons, then?
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_ALPHINAUD_000_170: We'll need directions to the Chai residence.
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_CORNENN_000_180: You're looking to present yourselves to the Chais, are you? Let me explain how the city's laid out, then. Imagine three layers, one on top of the other...
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_CORNENN_000_181: This layer here is called the Buttress. Above us is the Understory, where the military has its headquarters. And above that, you've got the Canopy, which is where the free citizens of Eulmore spend their days.
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_CORNENN_000_182: So if you want to find your new patrons, you'll need to keep climbing until you run out of stairs, then look for the “Grand Dame's Parlor.” They'll be in there, like as not.
TEXT_LUCKMA205_03286_CORNENN_000_190: Up the stairs to the Canopy, I said! The Chais should be in the Grand Dame's Parlor.
TEXT_LUCKMA206_03287_LADY03287_000_000: That silly oaf, where could he be...?
TEXT_LUCKMA206_03287_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Now you've the opportunity to experience Eulmore, I suggest you make the most of it. Explore the city, top to bottom.
TEXT_LUCKMA206_03287_ALPHINAUD_000_011: In other words, I would start with the Canopy and go from there. Try wandering around the market stalls, mayhap...? Such places are usually filled with colorful characters, only too eager to share local gossip with a friendly visitor.
TEXT_LUCKMA206_03287_ALPHINAUD_000_012: ...I would appreciate it, of course, if you could share any discoveries with me in turn. We should both learn as much as possible about our, ahem, “new place of residence.”
TEXT_LUCKMA206_03287_ALPHINAUD_000_020: I shall remain behind and set up my painting paraphernalia. Very carefully and deliberately. It could take some time...
TEXT_LUCKMA206_03287_LADY03287_000_030: Oh, hello there. A fresh register, are we? You seem a little lost.
TEXT_LUCKMA206_03287_LADY03287_000_031: Well, 'tis lovely to make your acquaintance. Ahem, speaking of acquaintances, you wouldn't happen to have run into my attendant on your wanderings, would you? Big strong lad? Long hair, tied back?
TEXT_LUCKMA206_03287_LADY03287_000_032: He was escorting me on a shopping errand when I realized I'd dropped my handkerchief. And now I've been waiting here all alone while he's been off searching for it.
TEXT_LUCKMA206_03287_LADY03287_000_033: I'm not terribly fond of being alone. If you do see him, I would be obliged if you could pass on this message: forget the silly handkerchief and return to my side at once!
TEXT_LUCKMA206_03287_LADY03287_000_040: I think I may have lost the handkerchief in the hallway leading into the plaza. My attendant mentioned he would try looking there first.
TEXT_LUCKMA206_03287_EMPLOYEE03287_000_0: Wicked white, that was too close!
Thank you, friend. I don't know what I would've done if you hadn't come along.
I was trying to rescue my lady's handkerchief, you see. The wind must have blown it over the edge, but luckily it caught on something. I thought if I could just stretch out far enough...
TEXT_LUCKMA206_03287_A1_000_054: You risked your life for a scrap of cloth?
TEXT_LUCKMA206_03287_A1_000_055: You must think highly of your mistress.
TEXT_LUCKMA206_03287_EMPLOYEE03287_000_0: It's not just a scrap of cloth! Not if it belongs to her.
I would risk my life and more to spare my mistress but a single moment of sadness.
She is my entire world! Without her, I am nothing.
When I first came to Eulmore, I thought only of improving my lot in life.
But there was so much more to this city than wealth and plenty. There is no war here, no conflict... The residents all treat each other with warmth and respect.
My mistress has been ever so kind to me, and I can think of no other place in Kholusia where I could possibly be happier!
<cough> Sorry, I might've gotten a bit carried away. I find it hard to stop when I start counting my blessings these days.
Please, you should come with me to meet my lady. Once she hears of your deed, you'll be witness to her generosity firsthand.
Curse my clumsy feet! I must return to her immediately!
I will never leave my lady's side again!
TEXT_LUCKMA206_03287_LADY03287_000_080: My attendant told me everything. I am so very grateful you were there to offer your assistance!
TEXT_LUCKMA206_03287_LADY03287_000_084: Oh, my attitude is naught unusual, I assure you. Without the efforts of our bonded residents, we free citizens would not enjoy the pleasures of our daily lives. They are deserving of our unending gratitude.
TEXT_LUCKMA206_03287_LADY03287_000_085: As if he were a member of my own family! I could not live the wonderful life I lead without him. We free citizens owe the bonded our unending gratitude.
TEXT_LUCKMA206_03287_LADY03287_000_086: Mayhap in another society, our different standing would breed prejudice or resentment. But in Eulmore, a most glorious measure is in place to avert such unpleasantness.
TEXT_LUCKMA206_03287_LADY03287_000_087: Part of that measure requires that the free surrender their fortunes. Upon registration, all of our property─financial, intellectual, or otherwise─is given over to the city.
TEXT_LUCKMA206_03287_LADY03287_100_087: In exchange, we are provided with ample funds and commodities to live a life of pampered luxury.
TEXT_LUCKMA206_03287_LADY03287_000_088: Being liberated from the concern of earning coin has an almost miraculous effect on people's outlook. There are no rivals to compete against, only fellow residents with whom to enjoy our tranquil existence.
TEXT_LUCKMA206_03287_LADY03287_000_089: Now, if you'll excuse us, I must see what the markets have to offer as a reward for the return of my handkerchief. Oh, and I've not forgotten you, of course, our courageous messenger-turned-rescuer!
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_EMPLOYEE03287_000_0: I will never leave my lady's side again!
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_LADY03287_000_010: All this talk of relying on the bonded, and I haven't given a thought as to what your duties might be. I hope I haven't interrupted your work unduly?
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_LADY03287_000_011: A tour of the city, is it? Then you really must visit the Beehive─it's always buzzing with activity! Ahem, local humor...
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_LADY03287_000_012: Anyway, a lady by the name of Tista-Bie usually has her seat near the entrance. She will gladly speak with you on any number of topics, assuming you find yourself on her good side!
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_LADY03287_000_020: I think you will find the Beehive is far more diverting than watching me pick out new curtains for the parlor!
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_030: Welcome to the Beehive, my little drone. Seeking the sting of excitement to liven up your day?
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_031: ...Hm hm, I can tell at a glance when folk are new to our happy colony. It's the nervous fluttering, you see─always gives them away.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_032: Why don't we play some cards to set you at your ease, eh? A quick game of “High or Low”─it's simply a matter of guessing who has the bigger hand.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_033: If you win, I'll grant you a single favor...within reason, of course. Interested?
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_040: Ready for a game of “High or Low”, then?
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_045: “High or Low” is a guessing game. You must decide whether the total of your three cards is higher or lower than the total of your opponent's cards.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_046: The deck holds nine cards, with the pictures printed thereon representing the numbers one through nine. Each number appears only once in the deck, so there are no repeats.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_047: If you guess correctly, then you win the match. If both totals are the same, then another hand is dealt.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_048: Oh? Well, you know where to find me if you want to play a hand or two.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_049: Good for you! No time like the present, I say!
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_050: Three cards for you, three cards for me. You flip one of yours over, and I flip two of mine.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_051: Now, what's your call? Will your total be higher or lower than mine?
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_055: You're going with “low,” then? Right, let's see what we've got...
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_056: You're going with “high,” then? Right, let's see what we've got...
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_100_056: My cards add up to . And you have...
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_058: Hm... Usually I'd concede defeat at this point, but what do you say to a rematch? One more win, then we'll talk about that favor.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_059: Aw... Sorry, honeybee, but this match goes to me.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_061: That's what I like to hear. Let me shuffle the deck...
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_062: Had enough for now? Fine, fine─I'll be sitting right here should the mood strike you.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_063: Oho, it seems we came out equal. But as lovely a coincidence as that may be, we still need a clear winner...
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_070: Another match of “High or Low”? Come now, little honeybee, we all need our diversions.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_071: That's the spirit! Let me sort out the deck...
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_072: Well, well, would you look at that. I think you've got a knack for this, newcomer.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_073: Congratulations! Victory is yours...as is the prize I promised.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_074: Oh dear, looks like this match goes to me.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_075: Come whisper in my ear, then, and don't be shy. Tell ol' Tista what she can do for you.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_076: ...That's all? How delightfully wholesome. But if knowledge is what you want, then that is what you shall have.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_077: In my humble estimation, the most wondrous thing about this town is how safe we are from the sin eaters.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_078: They say Lord Vauthry was born with the power to command them─which means no Eulmoran need ever raise a weapon in defense of the city.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_TISTABIE_000_079: ...Was that the kind of thing you wished to know? If your itch still needs scratching, you might get a few words out of Atharn over there. There's naught that merry sot likes more than the sound of his own voice.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_ATHARN_000_080: Whassat? New to Eulmore, you say?
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_ATHARN_000_081: Gahaha! Only just arrived and already you're looking to peel away the layers of mystery. Oh, I'm all for chatting, but you need to slow down and enjoy life, my friend!
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_ATHARN_000_082: I tell you what: you hop up on stage and give us a dance first, and then we can have our little talk!
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_ATHARN_000_090: Go on, there's plenty of room up there! Give us your best shimmies and shakes!
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_ATHARN_000_100: (-Atharn-)That's the way! Dance like there's no tomorrow!
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_ATHARN_000_110: <whistle> Now that was a show! You're welcome to clamber up on stage any time you like!
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_ATHARN_000_111: So...what was it you wanted to ask me? Ah, yes, something about our fair city. Well, I can tell you it wasn't always so peaceful as it is today.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_ATHARN_000_112: The Eulmoran Army may be the very essence of military might, but even our forces saw grievous losses in the war against the sin eaters.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_ATHARN_000_113: Things changed for us, oh, around twenty years ago now, when the old ruler's son came to power!
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_ATHARN_000_114: He's got this way with the eaters, you see─turns them docile as house cats. I wouldn't be exaggerating to say they've become something of an ally to Eulmore. No longer an enemy to be feared.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_ATHARN_000_115: And yet elsewhere, there are still fools who insist on fighting their losing battles... Pah! A toast to Lord Vauthry!
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_SYSTEM_000_116: You've gained a preliminary sense of the city. The Chais─and Alphinaud─will be expecting your return.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_CHAINUZZ_000_120: Hm...? Ah, yes, the assistant. Was there something?
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_DULIACHAI_000_130: Oh, you've returned from your jaunt around the city? So soon?
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_DULIACHAI_000_131: You needn't have hurried back─young Alphinaud has yet to put brush to canvas.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_CHAINUZZ_000_132: One cannot rush good art, I'm told. Or good artists, apparently...
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_ALPHINAUD_000_134: I've put together an ensemble out of the garments you chose. Is this satisfactory?
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_DULIACHAI_000_135: Oh, goodness gracious me! That last outfit was precious, but this makes you look positively dashing!
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_DULIACHAI_000_136: You truly are a handsome boy! However am I to decide!?
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_A3_000_139: I don't recall this part of the artistic process...
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_CHAINUZZ_000_140: Exactly! The lad is an artist, dearest, not a dress-up doll. It's about time we set him to work for the reason we called him here!
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_DULIACHAI_000_141: ...Must we? I do love a good painting, but I thought since we were enjoying ourselves so thoroughly...
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_CHAINUZZ_000_142: Well, I'd not─ That is to say, as long as you...
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_CHAINUZZ_000_143: Ugh. Just...make sure you give the lad time to prepare. We know who'll be upset if he's not ready to paint at a moment's notice.
TEXT_LUCKMA207_03288_DULIACHAI_000_144: Whatever you say, darling. So! Shall we pick out some jewelry, next!?
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_ALPHINAUD_000_010: (Lady Chai has a very particular sense of beauty, and apparently that extends to how I should dress whilst painting...)
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_ALPHINAUD_000_011: (But this obsession of hers works in our favor. The time I spend indulging these distractions is time you can use to continue your explorations.)
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_ALPHINAUD_000_012: (For this excursion, I'd like you to delve into the layer below us, and sniff about the military headquarters. I'm sure the Understory has its own tale to tell...)
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_ALPHINAUD_000_020: (Now is your chance to squeeze in another round of reconnaissance. Go─I will cover your absence should the Chais become suspicious.)
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_SINGER03289_000_031: You...you're one of the bonded, aren't you? Like me?
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_SINGER03289_000_032: Please, I need your help! My throat, it's... I can't sing anymore...
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_SINGER03289_000_033: I've been making excuses, but it's just not getting any better. If my patron thinks I'm of no use to him, then... <sob>
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_SINGER03289_000_034: I need you to sneak out to the Derelicts and describe my condition to Thoarich.
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_SINGER03289_000_035: Here's a list of symptoms, and a hunk of meol to pay for his medicines... Please, I have no one else to turn to!
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_SINGER03289_000_040: ...You don't know the Derelicts? It's the mess of shacks and ships right outside Joyous Hall.
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_SINGER03289_000_041: That's where the apothecary lives. Or at least, that's what I heard...
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_THOARICH_000_050: Hee hee! You need medicines? Tonics? Potions?
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_THOARICH_000_051: Hmmm, a cure for an ailing voice, is it...?
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_THOARICH_000_052: No, no medicine will cure this. Methinks your songbird has a lump in her throat. It must be cut out, excised, and even then the voice may never heal completely.
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_THOARICH_000_053: Hee hee, poor little songbird. Will they kick her from the nest, I wonder? Or simply silence her chirps?
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_THOARICH_000_054: Hoho, your face! You didn't know!? Of the many hopefuls who enter the city, very few are ever seen to leave. Even as corpses...
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_THOARICH_000_055: Oh, you might see one or two fortunate fools hurled from the balconies, but the rest...? Gone.
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_THOARICH_000_056: A town of nightmares, it is. Not for this ship's rat, oh no no. I am content to scurry around down here, and nibble on the crumbs which fall from the table.
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_THOARICH_000_057: This consultation is over! You have my verdict, and I have my meol! Good day!
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_THOARICH_000_060: All the old hands, they know, oh yes, they know. They just don't like to talk about it. Wouldn't want to upset the status quo, hee hee!
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_SINGER03289_000_071: <sob> ...So that's it? What am I to do if I can't sing...?
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_GENTLEMAN03289_000_: Ah, there you are, my sweet canary. Have you been crying again? Don't tell me your voice is still not on the mend...
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_SINGER03289_000_073: Oh, generous sir, have mercy! I've done all I can, but even the apothecary said...
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_GENTLEMAN03289_000_: ...So you've been suffering all this time?
I am sorry, my pet. I hadn't realized your affliction was this grave... But you needn't fret! I'll not reward your hours of trilling by casting you out into the street!
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_SINGER03289_000_077: But what use am I if I cannot sing? I fear the day I become more burden to you than treasure...
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_GENTLEMAN03289_000_: Then I shall have a word with Lord Vauthry, and arrange for your ascension.
In that paradise where resides neither pain nor illness will your song ring out clearly once again.
...Or mayhap you think it a step too far?
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_SINGER03289_000_081: No, I... You would do that for me!?
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_GENTLEMAN03289_000_: Of course. Why, I would almost wish to hasten my own ascension, knowing your blessed instrument was waiting there to greet me.
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_A1_000_085: Sounds too good to be true...
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_GENTLEMAN03289_000_: Ah, you must be a new arrival. Allow me to explain.
Ah, you must be a new arrival to harbor such doubts. Allow me to allay your suspicions...
As all know, the sin eaters exist to devour the sinful. But also do they serve to gather the souls of the innocent, and shepherd them unto celestial paradise.
It is through Lord Vauthry that we learned this truth. It is through Lord Vauthry's grace that the free people of Eulmore are destined to embrace salvation.

We are blessed to spend our days surrounded by love and merriment, until at last we are called to our final rapture. Even the bonded may find a place within that host, should their patrons deem them worthy.
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_SINGER03289_000_091: Lord Vauthry truly is a great man, isn't he?
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_GENTLEMAN03289_000_: Now if you will excuse us, we must be on our way. May you find eternal salvation for the compassion you have shown my precious canary.
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_DULIACHAI_000_100: Oh, dearest, we really should have found you some new gloves.
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_CHAINUZZ_000_105: Yes, my love, you're probably right...
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_ALPHINAUD_000_110: 'Tis good to see you back. You were taking so long I began to worry something had happened.
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_ALPHINAUD_000_111: I've begun sketching an outline for the portrait, but...nay, the Chais appear otherwise occupied. Will you share what your investigations have gleaned thus far?
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_ALPHINAUD_000_112: So...Lord Vauthry boasts some manner of influence over the sin eaters, does he? That would explain the reverence in which he is held by the citizenry.
TEXT_LUCKMA208_03289_ALPHINAUD_000_113: And as for this “ascension” business, I cannot help but be put in mind of that apothecary and his ominous remarks. If so many folk have entered the city over the years, then where do they go...?
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_CHAINUZZ_000_010: Hmph. I take my eye off you for one moment and you're chattering away with that assistant of yours. Am I to assume the outline is done, then?
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_CHAINUZZ_000_013: Where is your artistic interpretation!? It should evoke images of affluence and nobility, and overwhelm the viewer with its boundless beauty!
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_ALPHINAUD_000_014: Lord Chai─you stated that this portrait was to commemorate your anniversary. Yours being a joyous union, it seemed to me that a realistic portrayal─
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_CHAINUZZ_000_015: Realistic!? I don't want realism! I want perfection! A spectacle to slacken jaws and weaken knees! To make people cry out in amazement!
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_CHAINUZZ_000_016: Now, fetch a blank canvas and─
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_CHAINUZZ_000_018: I say... Did that come from above...?
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_CLOWNOFRED_000_019: Ladies and gentlemen, your attention pleeease: a tale to make you quiver and your noble blood freeze!
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_CLOWNOFRED_000_020: There was a villain on the loose, set to ruin our fair city...
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_CLOWNOFBLUE_000_021: ...But our lord has got him now, and his fate will not be pretty!
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_CLOWNOFBLUE_000_022: Yes, the hammer of justice is poised to come crrrashing down! And one and all who'd watch it fall are invited to join his lordship in the Offer!
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_ALPHINAUD_000_024: And this man is to face sentencing...?
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_CHAINUZZ_000_025: That's right. In fact...if you're curious, it might be worth you going along for the experience. The Offer they mentioned is part of the Emergent─the level above us where Lord Vauthry resides.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_CHAINUZZ_000_026: Ordinarily, you would be barred from entering, but it seems they'll be opening its doors for the next little while. The Crown Lift will take you up there.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_DULIACHAI_000_030: You will be careful around that malcontent, won't you? I should so hate for you to come to any harm. Although I imagine Lord Vauthry has the villain well under control...
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_CHAINUZZ_000_035: If you want to see justice being served, stop dawdling and take the Crown Lift up to the Emergent.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_ALPHINAUD_000_071: Forgive me. In my anger, I seem to have marched us back outside again...though it is probably best we leave the island altogether. I believe we've worn out our welcome in Eulmore.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_ALPHINAUD_000_072: In any case, I've seen enough of the world's self-proclaimed “capital city” to convince me that our battle against the sin eaters will find few allies in Kholusia.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_ALPHINAUD_000_073: I will accompany you back to the Crystarium. We need to regroup and think on our strategy anew.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_ALPHINAUD_000_074: Kai-Shirr, I have done you a grave disservice.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_ALPHINAUD_000_075: You were hungry and desperate, and I offered you a solution without once considering the risks inherent in you accepting it. If I had but known the price you would be made to pay...
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_KAISHIRR_000_076: You gave me everything I needed to make your idea work. It was me who made a mess of things, not you.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_KAISHIRR_000_077: But even after all the trouble I caused, you still stepped in and saved me. And now Lord Vauthry wants us all dead...
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_ALPHINAUD_000_078: Why not come back with us to the Crystarium? I am certain we can find work for you there, if you are willing.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_KAISHIRR_000_079: No...that would just be me leaning on your kindness again.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_KAISHIRR_000_080: I need to do some thinking─learn how to stand on my own two feet.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_ALPHINAUD_000_081: ...Very well. But you must promise you'll be careful. The Eulmorans may yet come looking for us.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_KAISHIRR_000_082: I'll keep my head down, don't worry. And you take care too. Give me the chance to repay what you've done for me.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_CHAINUZZ_000_085: What in the blazes did you do!? They have the entire city looking for you!
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_DULIACHAI_000_086: ...I took a peek at your unfinished portrait, Alphinaud.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_DULIACHAI_000_087: Now I've had many a beautiful and striking picture painted for me, but there was something about your work... It was as if you had caught the very essence of our love, and rendered it naked upon the canvas.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_DULIACHAI_000_088: It was bold, unflinching...and I adored it. Please, you must come back with us and finish what you began! I will speak with Lord Vauthry, and vouch for your character. I'm sure we can smooth over any hard feelings!
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_ALPHINAUD_000_089: I am sorry, Lady Chai. There are more important matters to which I must attend.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_DULIACHAI_000_090: More important? What could be more important than enjoying the days we have left to us to the fullest?
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_ALPHINAUD_000_091: Pray press me no further. We are leaving. But I would not presume to take the garments you were so kind as to procure for me. One moment─
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_DULIACHAI_000_092: <gasp> I wouldn't hear of it! Keep the clothes, you silly boy─I insist!
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_DULIACHAI_000_093: And I shall make arrangements so that you can pass through the gate without causing a stir. I expect you to come and visit.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_ALPHINAUD_000_094: I will return, I promise you that. The outrage I witnessed must not go unanswered.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_ALPHINAUD_000_095: The next time we meet, I shall be better prepared to confront the corruption which hides behind the glittering facade.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_SZEMDJENMAI_000_100: Your search was successful, then? Good. But give the word, and we shall be off.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_DULIACHAI_000_105: The loyal assistant! Have you come with...? Ah. No. Of course not.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_DULIACHAI_000_106: By all means, take care of those “important matters” Alphinaud mentioned, but please─see that he comes back and finishes my painting just as soon as he can!
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_CHAINUZZ_000_110: Wh-What are you─ Have you gone mad!?
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_CHAINUZZ_000_111: We can bribe the guards with favors and such, but up here...? No matter what my wife says, you must leave before you bring disaster down upon all of our heads!
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_ALPHINAUD_000_120: Thank you, my friend...for staying at my side through this whole sordid endeavor.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_ALPHINAUD_000_121: Whilst not quite the joyous outcome I had hoped for, our efforts have nevertheless answered a great many questions. Suffice it to say, our plans for saving the First are unlikely to involve the aid of Lord Vauthry and his subjects.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_ALPHINAUD_000_122: Come, we must speak with the Exarch and chart a new course. This is far from over...
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_MYSTERYVOICE_000_13: I am told you and Alphinaud carried out his scheme to infiltrate Eulmore. I would ask what you thought of its base amusements, but I doubt you are eager to relive the experience...
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_ALISAIE_000_135: I see you've reunited with my brother as well. I'd dearly love to hear how that story went.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_ALPHINAUD_000_140: Ahhh...it is good to be back amongst friends. In such company, I can finally turn my thoughts to the future. But ere we discuss all we have learned and begin planning our next step, I think it best that you visit Alisaie.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_ALPHINAUD_000_0141: Her familiarity with Amh Araeng will no doubt provide us invaluable insight, and besides, I know she is as eager to see you as I was.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_ALPHINAUD_000_142: Bring a smile to her face, .
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_ALPHINAUD_000_143: Ahhh...it is good to be back amongst friends, not to mention my dear sister. I have not seen her for some time, but I gather she is as keen to press on with our plans as I am.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_ALPHINAUD_000_144: And you've seen quite a lot of the First yourself now─more than enough to appreciate the scale of the obstacles we face. Let us lay our discoveries before the Exarch, and discuss what must be done.
TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_DULIACHAI_000_000: Oh, dearest, we really should have found you some new gloves.
