TEXT_LUCKMA209_03290_CHAINUZZ_000_005: Yes, my love, you're probably right...
TEXT_LUCKMA301_03291_MYSTERYVOICE_000_00: Ready to depart for Amh Araeng? Alisaie will be overjoyed to see you safe─I know she was particularly concerned for your well-being.
She, uh...impressed upon me how regrettable the timing of her summoning was. Repeatedly.
I only hope that my part in sending you to her will garner me some measure of forgiveness. Here. This is a letter of introduction addressed to a man named Cassard, the master of a merchant caravan.
There are few who know the ways of the desert as well as he does. Find him at the Amaro Launch, and he will see that you reach your destination.
TEXT_LUCKMA301_03291_CASSARD_000_010: Hm? If you've come looking for work, I might have a spot for another guard─
TEXT_LUCKMA301_03291_CASSARD_000_011: Oh. Oh! A friend of the Exarch! Hoping to meet someone in Amh Araeng, are you?
TEXT_LUCKMA301_03291_CASSARD_000_012: Then I shall be your guide! I was about to set off for our outpost there, as a matter of fact, so we can leave right away─assuming you have everything you need?
TEXT_LUCKMA301_03291_CASSARD_000_013: All set? Then off to the unforgiving sands we go!
TEXT_LUCKMA301_03291_SYSTEM_000_014: You can now travel to Amh Araeng! Speak with the adroit amaro tamer to fly to the desert.
TEXT_LUCKMA301_03291_SYSTEM_000_015: You can also use your aether compass to assist with locating aether currents in new regions. The aether compass can be found under Collection in the Duty section of the main menu.
TEXT_LUCKMA301_03291_CASSARD_000_030: Oof, no matter how many times I come here, the  never fails to catch me off guard! , but it gets brisk enough to make you shiver.
TEXT_LUCKMA301_03291_CASSARD_000_031: Now, the Exarch's letter said I was to take you to the Inn at Journey's Head, which is where this Alisaie friend of yours is staying.
TEXT_LUCKMA301_03291_CASSARD_000_032: But that's a fair old distance. So I propose we make a stop in Mord Souq to break up the trek─allowing me to attend to some business, and you to enjoy the local hospitality. Sound good? Good!
TEXT_LUCKMA301_03291_CASSARD_000_033: All right, you lot! I'm off, and I'd better not see the goods covered in sand when I get back!
TEXT_LUCKMA301_03291_CASSARD_000_034: Right, we head southwest, straight as an arrow!
TEXT_LUCKMA301_03291_CASSARD_000_040: Stop here a moment. This is your first visit to Amh Araeng, is it not?
TEXT_LUCKMA301_03291_CASSARD_000_041: Before you cross the River of Sand, you need to turn around and feast your eyes on that!
TEXT_LUCKMA301_03291_CASSARD_000_045: Go on, take a look! We're not moving until you appreciate the majesty of that edifice!
TEXT_LUCKMA301_03291_CASSARD_000_050: They built them big, didn't they? That's Qasr Sharl, a fortress meant to protect the northern reaches of Nabaath Areng.
TEXT_LUCKMA301_03291_CASSARD_000_051: Seeing what was left behind, I believe it when they say that it was once one of Norvrandt's mightiest nations.
TEXT_LUCKMA301_03291_CASSARD_000_052: ...At least until the Flood came along. Great chunks of Nabaath Areng's lands were lost to the Light, its great city included. The few who survived didn't see much point in staying. Most of them, anyway.
TEXT_LUCKMA301_03291_CASSARD_000_053: No, not many choose to come here these days, not with everything in ruins. Even that hulking great fortress has become little more than an amaro roost for me and my caravan.
TEXT_LUCKMA301_03291_CASSARD_000_054: But not everywhere is as deserted as this place. Just wait until you see Mord Souq...
TEXT_LUCKMA301_03291_CASSARD_000_060: Here we are─Mord Souq! By the blessed shadow, I love this town!
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_CASSARD_000_000: Mord Souq... Not just full of Mord, but Humes and all manner of others, too! It has long been a refuge for folk displaced by the Flood, so the population is nothing if not diverse.
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_CASSARD_000_001: Oh, have you met a Mord before? They might look like shifty little blighters, but a more welcoming lot you could never wish to meet!
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_CASSARD_000_002: Speaking of which, we should pay our respects to Master Ghen Gen. I'll go ahead and let him know we've arrived.
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_CASSARD_000_005: Go on! Introduce yourself to Master Ghen Gen!
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_CASSARD_000_010: A full Voeburtite honor seems a bit rich for buying a dented pan or a bowl of worms. Did the Exarch lose to you at cards or something!?
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_GHENGEN_000_015: Rhon Ron's shop is best for eating! Crack your coinpurse and gorge on the delicious delicacies!
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_RHONRON_000_020: Welcome to Rhon Ron's, traveler! I have wares to empty your purse and fill your belly!
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_RHONRON_000_021: Take your time! Stare and sniff before you choose! But no drooling on the merchandise, yes?
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_SYTEM_000_022: Browse Rhon Ron's wares. You may move the camera as well as zoom in and out. Target a foodstuff and inspect it with .
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_RHONRON_000_040: They all look tasty, yes? Which to choose, which to choose!
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_RHONRON_000_041: Ah, very wise! You won't wither on the sands with a gut full of cactus fruit filling!
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_RHONRON_000_043: ...And done! One Voeburtite honor buys you forty loaves of bread!
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_RHONRON_000_044: Yes, put some spice in your step! You won't feel the cold this night...and probably not the next one either!
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_RHONRON_000_046: ...And done! One Voeburtite honor buys you ten sides of lizard meat!
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_RHONRON_000_047: Mmm, chewy! A quick, easy meal to carry you across the desert!
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_RHONRON_000_049: ...And done! One Voeburtite honor buys you sixty-five skewers!
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_RHONRON_000_050: Too good to resist, eh? (That's what I would've chosen!)
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_RHONRON_000_052: ...And done! One Voeburtite honor buys you fifteen jars!
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_RHONRON_000_053: What an appetite! What a belly! A new legend is born in Mord Souq!
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_RHONRON_000_054: Our visitor invites us to feast! Let us give thanks for  great generosity─and small appetite!
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_RHONRON_000_055: Consider your coinpurse cracked! I am pleased to accept your custom, and Ghen Gen will be pleased that you honored ours!
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_RHONRON_000_056: ...Keeping the merchandise down, yes? No returns!
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_RHONRON_000_060: I am honored to have been chosen! Go to Ghen Gen! Let him know that your coinpurse has been most decidedly cracked.
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_CASSARD_000_065: I've never seen anyone eat so much of Rhon Ron's “cuisine” in one sitting... You've a stronger stomach than I!
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_GHENGEN_000_070: I was watching from here, ! You honored our custom, and with great relish!
TEXT_LUCKMA302_03292_GHENGEN_000_071: You will always be welcome in Mord Souq─if you need anything in Amh Araeng, we are here to provide!
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_CASSARD_000_000: Gahahaha! You have courage, my friend! Rhon Ron's wares are more “exotic” than harmful, but I don't envy you the bellyache you'll have on the morrow.
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_CASSARD_000_001: Right. Now that you've eaten, I expect you're eager to get back on the road...
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_CASSARD_000_002: ...Would you mind if we delayed our departure a touch? I have a few deals left to close before I can conclude my business here in Mord Souq.
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_CASSARD_000_003: Oh! Offering your services, are you? Aye, well an assistant would certainly help hurry things along!
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_CASSARD_000_004: I have a receipt here for some goods that need picking up from the market. All properly paid for─you'd just need to do the lifting and carrying.
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_CASSARD_000_005: I'll go and take care of some last-minute haggling, then. See you in a bit.
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_SYSTEM_000_006: You may view the market receipt at any time during this quest by using the relevant item in the Key Items menu.
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_MEMO03293_000_010:
(-Market Receipt-)Table cactus ─ Thon Ton
Iron ore ─ Thol Tol
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_MEMO03293_000_011: (-Market Receipt-)Nabaath Areng antiques ─ Mhil Mil (to be collected from Mhul Mul)
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_THONTON_000_015: Lift with your legs, and not with your back!♪
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_THOLTOL_000_020: Now, then! ...What was I doing, again?
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_BHUNBUN_000_030: Wait, what? No no no! This is Bhun Bun's private worm stash. Not for sale!
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_RHONRON_000_031: Hm? Hungry again already? You have a strong stomach, friend, but I wouldn't eat those!
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_MHILMIL_000_032: Hands off! That water is for Mhil Mil's footbath! ...Unless you have coin or barter?
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_MHILMIL_000_033: Oh, you work for Cassard? Mhul Mul has his antiques all boxed up and ready for transport!
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_LATGAR_000_034: If you're handling Cassard's porter work, you've come to the wrong place. He has no outstanding orders with my shop.
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_THONTON_000_035: You came in with Cassard, yes? Good, good, I can finally stop thinking about that sack. Please, take your prickly purchase!
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_THOLTOL_000_037: Cassard sent you, did he? Right. Yes. ...What kind of ore was it, again?
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_THOLTOL_000_038: Yes! Wait, no. Are you sure? I don't seem to have any on hand...
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_THOLTOL_000_039: Iron ore, of course! That would explain this box I have here. It's all yours!
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_MHULMUL_000_041: Hey, no touching! That merchandise is spoken for! You couldn't possibly change my mind with a better offer...
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_MHULMUL_000_042: ...What? Cassard sent you!? Wh-Why didn't you say so? I wouldn't dream of selling his goods to a higher bidder! Oh no, no, no!
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_MHULMUL_000_043: Nabaath Areng relics, wasn't it? All packed in that box there. Handle with care!
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_THONTON_000_036: That's my business finished for the day! Come again if you need more spiky succulents!
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_THOLTOL_000_040: Now, then! ...Where was I going, again?
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_MHULMUL_000_044: Give my regards to Cassard, heh heh heh...
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_CASSARD_000_050: Don't tell me you've been round the entire market already!?
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_CASSARD_000_051: Aye, that's the lot, all right. Good work.
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_CASSARD_000_052: And quick work, too, considering you've not set foot in the place before. I'd thought you one to sit in the city like the Exarch, but something tells me you're not a stranger to visiting strange lands...
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_CASSARD_000_053: Unfortunately, your efficiency presents something of a problem. I'd hoped to conclude all my business before you returned, but it seems there's been some confusion over one of the orders I placed.
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_CASSARD_000_054: I'll have to drag in my middleman and sort this mess out. I'm sorry to make you sit around and twiddle your thumbs...
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_TESLEEN_000_055: (-???-)...Cassard? It feels like an age since I last saw you!
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_CASSARD_000_056: Well, if it isn't the lovely Tesleen! It has been a while, but your timing couldn't be better.
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_CASSARD_000_057: This  was on  way to meet with Alisaie. I'm supposed to be taking  to your corner of the desert, but a misplaced order has commandeered my attention...
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_TESLEEN_000_059: Alisaie has told me so much about you! You're , aren't you!?
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_TESLEEN_000_060: I knew it! How wonderful to meet you in the flesh after hearing all those stories!
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_TESLEEN_000_061: I'm Tesleen. I work as a carer at the Inn, and I've gotten to know Alisaie quite well since she took up guard duties there.
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_TESLEEN_000_062: Do you want me to take over as 's guide, Cassard? My shopping's all done and packed for the road, so it would be no trouble...
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_CASSARD_000_063: That would be a great help, thank you!
TEXT_LUCKMA303_03293_CASSARD_000_064: Well, it looks like you'll be able to head straight out after all. My caravan and I will be in the area for a while yet─seek me out when you've had your fill of Amh Araeng, and I'll send you back to the Crystarium.
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_CASSARD_000_000: Take care with your desert crossing and good fortune with meeting your friend! I'll be around when you're ready to head back to the Exarch.
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_010: Alisaie has been desperate to see you, , so let's get you to her sooner rather than later!
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_011: The Inn isn't too hard to find, really─you can actually see the top of the rock spires from here.
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_012: We just need to swing around the ridge, then head south. Come on, I'll get my supplies together and meet you outside!
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_020: All set? Oh, I should probably mention the wildlife...
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_021: While most of them will leave you be if you keep your distance, the local coyotes have learned to prey on folk heading home from the markets.
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_022: I can usually swing a sword well enough to fend them off, but I may have loaded myself down with too many bargains today...
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_023: Do you think you can handle any beasts that try to make a meal of us?
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_024: I thought you might. Alisaie was always saying how much y─ Um, I mean, let's get going, shall we?
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_030: Sorry, there wasn't much time to shout a warning. Were you bitten? Those things can be nasty.
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_031: And yet hardly a match for you, it seems! I'd always thought Alisaie was strong, but in her mind, she was never...hmmm. Now it makes sense.
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_032: Ahem, well we should push on! It might be best if you scout ahead and clear out any coyotes that have our scent.
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_033: I'll wait here so you can fight without any distractions!
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_035: It might save time if you could head down past the ridge and clear out any coyotes lurking nearby.
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_040: Oh, thank goodness you're back. I could hear the howling and snarling from here... Frightful creatures.
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_041: Let's hope the rest have seen your handiwork, and know to avoid us now. I need to get these supplies back to the Inn!
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_050: This is it! Thanks to you, I didn't have to drop my shopping even once! Come to think of it, I'm glad I didn't make the trip alone...
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_051: It seems you ended up escorting me! I'll have to repay the favor somehow, but first, let's head inside, shall we?
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_052: Welcome to the Inn at Journey's Head. You might be our first visitor from the Crystarium since Alisaie arrived.
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_053: It's not much, but it's home for the afflicted and a handful of carers.
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_A1_000_002: This illness isn't contagious, is it?
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_A1_000_003: I have some skill with healing...
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_055: Contagious...? Well, no, not as far as we know.
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_056: I'm not sure you can help in this case, but...that's good to know.
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_057: I don't think I've met anyone besides Alisaie who was so unfamiliar with our situation here. Most folk have grown up knowing someone who knew someone...
TEXT_LUCKMA304_03294_TESLEEN_000_058: Hm. I might leave out something obvious, so it may be best to have Alisaie give you the full explanation.
TEXT_LUCKMA305_03295_TESLEEN_000_001: ...Hm. I think she might be out on patrol.
TEXT_LUCKMA305_03295_TESLEEN_000_002: You could wait, I suppose─but why not go and surprise her!? She usually takes a look at things from the watchtower first, so you might be able to catch her there.
TEXT_LUCKMA305_03295_TESLEEN_000_003: It's not far─head out the south side and you'll soon see it. I'll stay behind, in case she comes back while you're gone.
TEXT_LUCKMA305_03295_TESLEEN_000_005: The watchtower's on the south side. I only wish I could be there to see Alisaie's face when she realizes it's you!
TEXT_LUCKMA305_03295_SYSTEM_000_010: Alisaie is nowhere to be seen, but you spot fresh footprints on the ground...and they look to be about the right size.
TEXT_LUCKMA305_03295_SYSTEM_000_020: The small footprints lead off to the northwest.
TEXT_LUCKMA305_03295_SYSTEM_000_030: The footprints continue on to the northwest.
TEXT_LUCKMA305_03295_SYSTEM_000_040: The footprints curve around to the west.
TEXT_LUCKMA305_03295_SYSTEM_000_050: There are more tracks here, but they end in a mess of disturbed sand...
TEXT_LUCKMA305_03295_ALISAIE_000_060: It's just a matter of time─more for some, less for others. Those patients will all become monsters in the end.
TEXT_LUCKMA305_03295_ALISAIE_000_061: And to add insult to injury, the afflicted are feared. Shunned. Cast out of society, and exiled here to the edge of the world...
TEXT_LUCKMA305_03295_ALISAIE_000_062: The only good thing I have to say about this hellish place is that it has served me well as a training ground. Tesleen and the others have also been kind enough to share their knowledge of the sin eaters.
TEXT_LUCKMA305_03295_ALISAIE_000_063: Which is knowledge I can now share with you...while you help me finish my patrol, of course.
TEXT_LUCKMA306_03296_ALISAIE_000_000: Here's what we'll do: I'll take the east side of the Inn, and you clear the west. That way you can have an undiluted experience with the resident terrors.
TEXT_LUCKMA306_03296_ALISAIE_000_001: These marks on your map are where the usual trouble spots are.
TEXT_LUCKMA306_03296_ALISAIE_000_002: You can assume that any beast with a white hide or carapace is a sin eater, but you'll know for sure soon enough when they come slavering after your aether. Remember: it's kill or be killed with these monsters.
TEXT_LUCKMA306_03296_ALISAIE_000_003: Once you've slain whatever's prowling around out there, we can rendezvous back at the north entrance. Good hunting.
TEXT_LUCKMA306_03296_ALISAIE_000_011: Ah, I thought there might be one or two lurking on the fringes. Nothing out of the ordinary for this area...
TEXT_LUCKMA306_03296_ALISAIE_000_012: I expect you noticed it yourself, but individually, these lesser sin eaters are no more deadly than any natural predator you might encounter in the desert.
TEXT_LUCKMA306_03296_ALISAIE_000_013: It's when they appear in numbers that they pose a threat. Much like the voidsent, they have an unfortunate tendency to flock to the strongest of their kind.
TEXT_LUCKMA306_03296_ALISAIE_000_014: Thus when a powerful sin eater goes on the hunt, it might be attended by a veritable swarm of weaker kin. Imagine an army of such creatures descending on a village or hamlet...
TEXT_LUCKMA306_03296_ALISAIE_000_015: That's the basic idea behind my patrols: to cull their ranks often enough that their numbers won't be overwhelming when the big ones come out to play. And you've certainly helped on that front.
TEXT_LUCKMA306_03296_ALISAIE_000_016: Let's report our victories to Tesleen, shall we?
TEXT_LUCKMA306_03296_ALISAIE_000_020: She hasn't been telling you stories, has she? Oh gods...
TEXT_LUCKMA306_03296_TESLEEN_000_030: Alisaie tells me you helped out on her patrol. You have our thanks...and my apologies for leading you from one battle to another ever since the moment we met!
TEXT_LUCKMA306_03296_TESLEEN_000_031: In any case, I'm glad to see the two of you found each other. You have no idea how badly Alisaie has missed your company! Everything is always, “If  were here,  would─”
TEXT_LUCKMA306_03296_ALISAIE_000_032: That's an exaggeration! And I don't sound like that, either! I was simply trying to view matters from another perspective, and I respect 's methods!
TEXT_LUCKMA306_03296_TESLEEN_000_033: Ahahaha! Honestly, after seeing  in action, I can understand why.
TEXT_LUCKMA306_03296_TESLEEN_000_034: The way  leaps into the fray without hesitation, it really is something to behold. I might be a little smitten myself!
TEXT_LUCKMA306_03296_TESLEEN_000_036: Heh heh! I'm only teasing! Though I've no doubt  deserves all the admiration  gets. Just as you do.
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_ALISAIE_000_000: This is what I get for sharing! Maybe I'll just head out on another patrol...
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_TESLEEN_000_010: I'd love to lay out a welcome meal, but the duties I put off when I went to the market are still waiting for me...
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_TESLEEN_000_011: Argh! There are a hundred and one things that need doing! I'm sorry, but would you mind waiting here with Alisaie?
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_ALISAIE_000_012: What, and twiddle our thumbs while you work yourself to death? Surely there's something we can help you with?
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_TESLEEN_000_013: ...I could do with a hand, it's true. Thank you. You can start by helping me sort out the larder, Alisaie.
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_TESLEEN_000_014: While we do that, could you tend to a few patients, perhaps? There are three in particular I meant to visit─it's just a matter of saying a few words to them, and seeing that their skin isn't caked in sand.
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_TESLEEN_000_015: Their names are Pawnil, Todden, and Halric. They may not give much in the way of a response, but I promise they'll be pleased to meet someone new!
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_ALISAIE_000_020: I would speak more on the subject of sin eaters, but let's see these tasks finished first.
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_TESLEEN_000_025: It will do them good to see a new face. There's not much in the way of novelty around here to distract them from their worries.
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_TODDEN_000_041: Todden glances up at you blankly, but you notice the tension in his face ease slightly.
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_SYSTEM_000_050: Halric remains utterly still as you wipe the sand from his cheek.
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_SYSTEM_000_051: The texture of his skin has hardened into something akin to plaster...
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_TESLEEN_000_070: You've seen to the patients? How were they?
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_TESLEEN_000_071: ...Good. That's good. I knew they would enjoy meeting you.
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_TESLEEN_000_072: I am concerned about Halric, though... I'll have to speak with the other carers, but I think his time may be near.
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_ALISAIE_000_073: We shall leave you to have that discussion, then. I was going to take  to Mord Souq if you have any errands there that need doing...?
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_TESLEEN_000_074: Well, I suppose there is one thing...
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_TESLEEN_000_075: Would you pick up a nectarine from the markets, please? Cassard's caravan just passed through, so Rhon Ron should have some fresh fruit.
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_ALISAIE_000_076: Come, then, ─there's something I want you to see. Right after we stop at Rhon Ron's stall, of course.
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_TESLEEN_000_080: Hm? Oh, my jobs are all under control now, thank you. Go and spend some time with Alisaie.
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_ALISAIE_000_085: Let's see about that nectarine, shall we?
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_RHONRON_000_090: Oho, back again, are you? You need another taste of Rhon Ron's wares?
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_ALISAIE_000_091: Actually, we're looking to buy a nectarine. Do you have any in stock?
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_RHONRON_000_092: Oh, yes! Nectarines, peaches, grapes! Fresh and juicy!
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_RHONRON_000_093: Hm... Given how richly you cracked your coinpurse with me, I might still owe you food... Here, take this one! Free of charge!
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_ALISAIE_000_094: Gods, I've never seen a Mord merchant give away something for nothing before. How much coin did you spend here...?
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_ALISAIE_000_095: Oh yes, I'll take a jar of honeyed worms as well.
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_ALISAIE_000_096: Hm? Oh no! They're not for me! It's...an offering of sorts.
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_RHONRON_000_098: Only the best wrigglers for you! Come again, my friends!
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_ALISAIE_000_099: Right, that's our shopping chores taken care of. Let's head up past the aetheryte to the main tower─the view I want to show you can only be seen from its very top.
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_RHONRON_000_105: See you again soon! Your belly won't let you stay away!
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_ALISAIE_000_120: Here are your precious worms. That buys us a trip to the top of the tower, does it not?
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_MORDGUARD_000_121: <gasp> Glazed Wrigglers! You actually brought them!
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_MORDGUARD_000_122: I really shouldn't let you, but...just this once, all right? Only once!
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_ALISAIE_000_130: I'm glad I was able to show you that. When it comes to understanding the catastrophe which befell the First, one glimpse of the empty wasteland beyond the wall is worth more than an hour of Urianger's lecturing.
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_ALISAIE_000_131: And I needed you to know beyond a doubt that Tesleen has no other choice. The nectarine will be a kindness.
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_ALISAIE_000_132: It isn't just the threat posed to others... When a person becomes an eater, the pain appears to be excruciating.
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_ALISAIE_000_133: The carers are truly fond of their wards, and would spare them that suffering. It is their way of fighting back against a fate worse than death.
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_ALISAIE_000_135: Go ahead. I think she's been waiting for us.
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_TESLEEN_000_140: You're back. I hope you had a nice time. Did you...manage to find a nectarine?
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_TESLEEN_000_141: Thank you. Alisaie's explained why I wanted this, has she? I can see it in your eyes.
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_TESLEEN_000_142: But we may not need it just yet. I spoke with the others, and we've decided to keep an eye on Halric for now.
TEXT_LUCKMA307_03297_TESLEEN_000_143: Thanks to you, though, if his time does come suddenly, we'll be ready to send him on his way with a taste of happier days...
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_TESLEEN_000_010: Well, nothing is going to happen for a little while yet, so let's see if we can't lighten the mood. We don't want our gloomy faces worrying the patients!
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_TESLEEN_000_011: I think it's time for that welcome meal, don't you? Take a seat, and I'll make us a nice stew!
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_JOURNEYSHEADNURSE_0: This is my fault. The patients were acting strangely, and I let it distract me...
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_TESLEEN_000_060: , Alisaie─we have to go look for Halric!
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_TESLEEN_000_061: I don't know what's gotten into him, but if he's wandering out there alone...
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_ALISAIE_000_062: We'll assign search areas and split up. Any idea where he might be headed?
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_TESLEEN_000_063: No, he's never done anything like this before. But it can't be a coincidence that the other patients are suddenly so agitated. They can sense something...
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_TESLEEN_000_064: In any case, let's keep the search close to the Inn. Halric isn't very sure on his feet, so he won't have gone far. I'll search the east side!
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_TESLEEN_000_065: Please, Halric... Please be all right...!
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_ALISAIE_000_066: I'll cover the north and west, then. You take everything from here to the south!
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_PAWNIL_000_067: They come... Come for new kin...
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_SYSTEM_000_070: You see no sign of Halric. Maybe he went further west...
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_SYSTEM_000_080: You scan your surroundings in search of Halric...and suddenly find yourself under attack!
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_PAWNIL_000_095: Going away, now... Further and further...
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_ALISAIE_000_131: I'm sorry, . I tried to tell the carers what happened, but...
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_ALISAIE_000_132: ...I can't be the shoulder they lean on. Not like this.
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_CASSANA_000_141: Tesleen was always so cheery with the patients, telling them not to be scared, that there wouldn't be any pain...
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_CASSANA_000_142: Of all the people in the world to suffer such a fate!
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_CASSANA_000_143: Oh, Tesleen... You thought only of others...and this was your reward.
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_WILLFORT_000_144: I imagine you're just as shocked as the rest of us, so I appreciate what you're doing here.
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_WILLFORT_000_145: Me? I can barely... I don't have the words. Without a body, we can't even give her a proper burial! And she cared about that sort of thing─about giving people the chance to say their good-byes...
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_WILLFORT_000_146: We'll manage, somehow. Someone needs to care for the patients. We're all they've got...
TEXT_LUCKMA308_03298_SYSTEM_000_151: Halric is as unresponsive as ever. He stands motionless, staring up into the sky where the sin eaters made their escape...
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_ALISAIE_000_010: ...Thank you. What you're doing, it...it means a lot to them. To me.
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_WILLFORT_000_011: ...Sorry to interrupt. We, uh... We realized we hadn't thanked you for rescuing Halric.
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_WILLFORT_000_012: ...You weren't hurt at all, were you?
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_ALISAIE_000_013:
Hurt...? There wasn't even a fight. I was too late. Too slow.
And I thought I could protect you...
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_CASSANA_000_014: You can't blame yourself for things beyond your control. You brought Halric back safe and sound─no one could have done any more.
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_ALISAIE_000_015: I'm sorry, but I've come to a decision: I won't be continuing in my role here.
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_ALISAIE_000_016: I hope you will forgive me for leaving you...and that you will delay Halric's last meal for as long as you possibly can.
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_ALISAIE_000_017: Not until it's too late, of course, just...give him what time you can.
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_ALISAIE_000_019: Of course. She would have done the same.
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_ALISAIE_000_020: Farewell, Halric. Keep Tesleen's words close to your heart.
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_CASSANA_000_021: Wait! You're leaving this very moment? I understand how you must feel, but surely this is a bit hasty? Do you even have anywhere to go?
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_ALISAIE_000_022: I have a destination in mind, yes. And a purpose.
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_ALISAIE_000_023: This damned Light, building without cease... It's the reason we can't save those corrupted by the eaters.
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_ALISAIE_000_024: But what if we corrected the balance? Even if it were only little by little─even if it took years─it would surely make things better.
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_WILLFORT_000_025: Now, hold on there. Everyone knows there's too much Light, but how could you ever hope to get rid of it? You'd have to change the whole world!
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_ALISAIE_000_027: We should return to the Crystarium. I may not be able to repel the eaters on my own...but I can still use the skills I have gained here to hurt them.
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_WILLFORT_000_030: Poor Alisaie... She was so close to Tesleen... I only hope she doesn't do something foolish.
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_CASSARD_000_040: ! Good to see you again! You look like you've a story or two to tell... But I sense you'd sooner get back to the Crystarium.
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_ALISAIE_000_050: Forgive me, ─I couldn't stay there a moment longer.
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_ALISAIE_000_051: But I was serious about what I said. While the men and women at the Inn battle against this blight with kindness, I must fight it in my own way. With steel.
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_A2_000_001: From Eorzea's sword in the darkness...to Norvrandt's sword in the light?
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_ALISAIE_000_052: Gods above. It feels like an age ago now...
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_CASSARD_000_053: Miss Alisaie!? ...Is there anything I can get you?
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_ALISAIE_000_054: Your swiftest amaro! I need to return to the Crystarium─immediately!
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_CASSARD_000_060: Ah, it's good to be back. Mord Souq has many charms, but there's nothing like a proper bed to recover from a long journey...as I'm sure you'd agree.
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_ALISAIE_000_070: Ugh, remind me to wear goggles if we ever fly over Amh Araeng again. I've barely gotten the sand out of my eyes.
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_ALISAIE_000_071: ...But the wind did help to clear my head at least.
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_ALISAIE_000_072: I think I'm ready to meet with the Exarch. We need to talk about how we're going to wipe the sin eaters out. Shall we?
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_MYSTERYVOICE_000_07: I see you were reunited with Alisaie, but I daresay you found little else to celebrate in Amh Araeng...
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_MALPHINAUD_000_080: Welcome back, . You will have to share the tale of your journey once the two of you are suitably rested.
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_ALISAIE_000_090:
Thank you for seeking me out, ─it meant a lot to have you there at my side.
...I was tempted to set off again the moment we had decided upon a direction, but you have still to visit Alphinaud, haven't you?
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_ALISAIE_000_091: And if I know my brother, he'll be on the cusp of discovering something vital to our success─if he hasn't already. I'm content to stay here and consider our options for the time being─but don't keep me waiting too long, eh?
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_ALISAIE_000_092: Thank you for seeking me out, ─it meant a lot to have you there at my side. And looking at Alphinaud, I'd say he's as eager to begin this discussion as I am.
TEXT_LUCKMA309_03299_ALISAIE_000_093: I say we lay our experiences before the Exarch, and step back to see what kind of picture they make. Then we can decide where to go from here.
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_MYSTERYVOICE_000_00: Holminster Switch is in the north of Lakeland, so we had best make haste with our preparations.
In fact, meet me outside the Crystarium at the crossroads northwest of the Accensor Gate, and I shall lead you there myself.
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_MYSTERYVOICE_000_01: All set? If we follow this road north, we will arrive at the Northern Staging Point.
The village itself lies not far beyond. Quickly, now!
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_ALPHINAUD_000_015: The Exarch asked that we wait, and so we waited...
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_ALISAIE_000_020: You're here! We are heading in together, yes?
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_MYSTERYVOICE_000_03: Holminster Switch is past these gates and through the woods. 'Tis not exactly a near neighbor to the Crystarium, but as we occupy the same region, we have built up something of a cooperative relationship.
What can we expect inside, Captain?
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_LYNA_000_032: The town is beset by a swarm unlike any we have seen in recent years. We did our best to evacuate the villagers, but as many as half remain...
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_LYNA_000_033: Judging by the number of eaters present, we have good reason to believe that a Lightwarden leads the attack.
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_ALISAIE_000_034: How convenient. It seems we'll have our chance to slay a Warden sooner than we expected.
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_LYNA_000_035: <snort> One does not simply “slay a Warden.” Has no one told you what happens if you defeat one of those fiends?
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_LYNA_000_036: They hold more Light inside them than all of their underlings put together.
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_LYNA_000_037: It can be struck down, aye, but its essence won't dissipate like the weaker kind. Vile aether will billow outwards and envelop the nearest living being─a reckless young swordswoman, perhaps─and turn her into a brand-new Warden.
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_MYSTERYVOICE_000_03: Ah, well you can leave that particular quandary to us. I must ask that the guard stand down and allow us to engage this leader of eaters alone.
Concentrate on the survivors─we must save every life we can.
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_LYNA_000_041: ...Understood, my lord. As captain of the guard, however, I will not watch you brave such danger without an escort from our ranks. I insist that I go with you.
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_MYSTERYVOICE_000_04: Very well. Then our Warden-slaying party shall include myself, the Leveilleurs, Captain Lyna, and last but not least...

A formidable group indeed.
Into Holminster we go! Once we reach the Lightwarden, do not hold back─we strike to kill!
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_SYSTEM_000_044: The instanced dungeons encountered in subsequent main scenario quests can be completed solo, alongside a supporting party of NPCs.
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_SYSTEM_000_045: To make use of this feature, simply speak with one of your NPC companions near the entrance to the instance and select the option to form a party.
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_SYSTEM_100_045: Alternately, you can also select Duty Support under Duty from the main menu, or interact with the instance entrance itself.
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_SYSTEM_000_046: When forming a party, you will need to follow the same role restrictions imposed when using the Duty Finder.
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_SYSTEM_000_047: Alternatively, you can find party members via the Duty Finder as usual, and complete the instance with fellow players instead.
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_A1_000_002: Form a party and enter Holminster Switch.
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_ALPHINAUD_000_050: As you may have deduced, the “troublesome quality” of the Wardens which I endeavored to raise earlier was this confounded capacity for spontaneous rebirth...
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_ALPHINAUD_000_051: ...But the Exarch seems confident he has matters in hand, so I shall trust that we may slay our foe without fear of the aetheric aftermath. My restorative spells are at your disposal.
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_ALISAIE_000_055: I can't help but wonder if the scale of this raid is related to the “recruiting” the eaters were doing in Amh Araeng.
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_ALISAIE_000_056: Not that it matters. After all the combat I saw there, I'm more than ready to test my magicks against one of these greater abominations!
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_MYSTERYVOICE_000_06: Command of this sortie is yours. Though I am not as spry as I once was, I hope my long years of experience will serve you in some capacity.
I can wield spells to heal or harm, or even fashion an arcane shield and sword should we have need of a defensive wall. Simply say the word.
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_LYNA_000_065: Destroy a Lightwarden for good...? Hmph. If it is possible now, then why not before? Whatever the Exarch believes, I will force a retreat if I deem it necessary.
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_LYNA_000_066: I did not become captain of the guard by being meek. Or weak.
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Without that constant glare, Lakeland seems an entirely different place...
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_ALISAIE_000_075: It's over, yes? I might need a moment...
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_LYNA_000_080: It's as if the sky itself had disappeared into the heavens... If I didn't have wounded to tend to, I'd never stop staring...
TEXT_LUCKMA401_03300_MYSTERYVOICE_000_09: How quickly you have justified my faith in you...
So many lives saved, and the sky itself heralds your success. A single victory in a larger struggle, perhaps, but a momentous one nonetheless!
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Without that constant glare, Lakeland seems an entirely different place...
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_ALISAIE_000_005: It's over, yes? I might need a moment...
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_LYNA_000_010: It's as if the sky itself had disappeared into the heavens... If I didn't have wounded to tend to, I'd never stop staring...
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_MYSTERYVOICE_000_02: Now, as for how we proceed from here...
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_LYNA_000_021: The villagers we evacuated earlier have arrived safely in the Crystarium.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_LYNA_000_022: They seem to be accepting their situation for the moment─most folk are far too distracted by the sky to worry about wounds or lost homes.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_LYNA_000_023: They whisper and wonder if the Warrior of Darkness has come...
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_MYSTERYVOICE_000_02: , I must ask a favor of you. Would you be so kind as to conceal your involvement in this endeavor for the time being?
Seeing the Light recede from Lakeland is a momentous occasion, and many will be swept up in a maelstrom of excitement and confusion.
Should you come forth as the legendary Warrior of Darkness, I fear that, no matter how good your intentions, such an appearance would throw the city into disarray.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_ALPHINAUD_000_028: I find myself in agreement with the Exarch, although my concerns are more focused on Eulmore.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_ALPHINAUD_000_029: It may be best if you maintain a low profile until we see how Vauthry responds to all of this.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_MYSTERYVOICE_000_03: My thanks. Though we cannot freely celebrate your success, pray allow your heart to be buoyed by the joy of our citizens─a joy you surely brought into being.

Ah, and I must ask the same discretion of you, Captain. 'Tis my intention to share with our people the tale of a great warrior who stood in defiance of the sin eaters. This unnamed champion defeated the Lightwarden, and has since departed for parts unknown, yes?
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_LYNA_000_032: As you wish, my lord. Your penchant for mystery is nothing new, and I will encourage folk not to question this either.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_LYNA_000_033: ...Although I expect to be told the whole truth of it one day. About all of you.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_MYSTERYVOICE_000_03: With that settled, I shall return to the Crystarium and make an address to the people.

These explanations and adjustments will consume much of my time, so pray take the opportunity to rest and recover from your exploits. And to think, you'll not even need to shutter the windows to enjoy a dark and peaceful night's sleep!
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_LYNA_000_036: I must stay behind and coordinate the evacuation of the remaining survivors.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_LYNA_000_037: And I hesitate to ask after all you've done here today, but could I ask you to pass on a message on your way to the Pendants?
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_LYNA_000_038: Please let Bragi know that we're bringing in a number of injured, and that any restoratives in the markets need to be reserved for the infirmary.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_ALPHINAUD_000_039: We should start making our own way back to the Crystarium─slowly, mind you. It wouldn't do to arrive too soon after the Exarch.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_ALISAIE_000_040: I'm staying behind as well. I... There's something I need to check on in Holminster.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_ALPHINAUD_000_041: We already went through the village top to bottom, Alisaie. We should all take the chance to rest, you included.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_ALISAIE_000_042: I knew one of those eaters, and I can't just... I can't rest, not now.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_ALISAIE_000_043: So please, I wish to be left alone for a while. And that means you as well, ─I shall be cross if you try to follow me!
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_ALISAIE_000_044: I promise to find you later, when I feel myself again.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_ALPHINAUD_000_045: Hm, just you and me, then. Shall we?
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_LYNA_000_046: I'd be grateful if you could pass that message on to Bragi. He should be standing in his usual spot in the markets.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_MYSTERYVOICE_000_04: Not to worry, ─I've given my address to the citizens, and soothed their most immediate fears.
Your only concern for the moment is recuperating from your victory.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Well, the Crystarium seems relatively ordered, wouldn't you say? The Exarch's speech must have been reassuring to hear.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_ALPHINAUD_000_051: On the contrary, there is something jubilant in the air─I have a feeling this night won't be quite as “peaceful” as our hooded friend predicted!
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_ALPHINAUD_000_052: I think I shall take a brief stroll around town before retiring to my chambers. Once you've discharged your duty to Bragi, I suggest you do the same.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_ALPHINAUD_000_053: Sleep well, . I hope untroubled dreams find you and Alisaie both.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_BRAGI_000_060: Aye, what can I do for you? Looking to buy a lantern, like every other stumbling soul in the city?
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_BRAGI_000_061: ...I see. Well Captain Lyna can rest assured that any potions I spot coming in will be set aside for the wounded.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_BRAGI_000_062: Hang on a moment, if you're carrying messages for the guard, does that mean you were there, then? The battle at Holminster?
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_BRAGI_000_063: A stalwart  like you might want to pay a visit to the Wandering Stairs, make  known...
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_BRAGI_000_064: I'm sure Glynard can introduce you to some interesting opportunities.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_BRAGI_000_070: The Wandering Stairs? It's just a short wander up the stairs there, thus the name. Rowdy crowd in attendance , if that noise is aught to judge by.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_GRANSON_000_075: I need to find me someone with a damn spine...
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_LUEREEQ_000_080: I might be able to take Andreia alone, but why take the chance? Never hurts to have someone watching your back when eaters are involved...
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_GIOTT_000_085: <gulp> <gulp> <gulp> <burp> Where's that wine I ordered? Do they mean to make me idle here without a drink in hand?
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_CERIGG_000_090: Ah, Phronesis, what am I to do? I've not the talents to counter your tricks, but if I could enlist the aid of a seasoned mage...
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_GLYNARD_000_100: Cyella, more beer for table two! And a couple of pints of mead for table three, while you're at it!
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_GLYNARD_000_102: Sorry, we're rushed off our feet , . Can I get you anything? Drinks are on the house!
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_GLYNARD_000_103: Hm? Oh, that Bragi has a twisted sense of humor...
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_GLYNARD_000_104: Gahahaha! To think he'd send you to me at a time like this!
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_GLYNARD_000_105: The first real “night” in near a hundred years has folk all riled up and then some!
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_GLYNARD_000_106: What's more, there was that eater business at Holminster Switch. They say a Lightwarden was destroyed without a damn trace, and it was the Warrior of Darkness who did the deed!
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_CYELLA_000_107: I really must apologize for Glynard─he's been almost as rowdy as our customers, and that's no small feat.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_CYELLA_000_108: A lot of our regulars are bounty hunters, you see. They mostly go after eaters, and the rumor of the Warrior's appearance was the spark to their kindling.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_GLYNARD_000_109: You know how the weak eaters are drawn to the strong ones, right?
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_GLYNARD_000_110: Aye, they swarm like angry bees around a queen. You need look no further than Holminster for proof of that. But attacks on that scale don't happen every day, praise the blessed shadow.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_GLYNARD_000_111: No, the more common threats are the strays. No one knows why, but every now and again, an eater will leave the pack to prowl alone. Those are the ones you run into on the road if your luck is foul.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_GLYNARD_000_112: They're a danger to everyone, so the Settlement council puts bounties on their heads. And our bar here is a convenient place for hunters to gather and share information.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_CYELLA_000_113: Seems a few of them were inspired by the Warden-slaying even more than most. These are the types who have their sights set on the absolute worst of the strays─a class of eaters that've been dubbed the “Cardinal Virtues.”
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_CYELLA_000_114: The Virtues showed up out of nowhere about three summers ago, and when historians heard the descriptions given by survivors, well...apparently they share an appearance with the villains who caused the Flood.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_CYELLA_000_115: And if that doesn't send a chill down your spine, they're also reported to be as tough as Lightwardens─not the kind of prey you can take down single-handed.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_CYELLA_000_116: Our Virtue-hunters had all but given up, but knowing the Warrior of Darkness is out there has lit a fire in their bellies. Just look at them...
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_CYELLA_000_117: That Hume over there with the oversized sword is Granson. He's in it for revenge. Wants to recruit a comrade-in-arms as tenacious as he is.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_CYELLA_000_118: The Mystel lad is Lue-Reeq. Don't be fooled by those dewy cheeks─he's as hard a hunter as they come. He just lost a partner, and seems to be on the lookout for a new one...
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_CYELLA_000_119: That's Cerigg. Word is he seeks an expert in magecraft to help fight the Virtue he's after.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_CYELLA_000_120: Last we have Giott, dwarf and drunkard both. Wanted to join forces with a healer, and only a healer. Something about needing a “mender's wisdom”...?
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_CYELLA_000_121: I've seen my share of competent veterans, and you have that look about you. Maybe you should introduce yourself to one of our hunters. Who knows? Together you might even collect the bounty on a Cardinal Virtue!
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_GLYNARD_000_122: Now there's a grand idea. Imagine the prestige my bar would earn if we boasted the patronage of a successful Virtue-hunter!
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_SYSTEM_000_123: You have gained access to role quests! A separate quest line and story is now available for tank, physical DPS, magical ranged DPS, and healer roles.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_SYSTEM_000_124: In order to reach the final stages of the Shadowbringers main scenario, you must complete at least one role quest line. Speak with a Virtue-hunter at the Wandering Stairs to accept a quest offer!
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_GLYNARD_000_130: My regulars have their quirks─some more than others─but it's odd how folk can grow on you. Spend enough time with them, and you might become a regular yourself. Always happy to welcome a new addition to the family!
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_CYELLA_000_135: Come again whenever you like, our doors are always open...or they would be, if we had any.
TEXT_LUCKMA402_03301_GUIDEOFTHEPENDANTS_: I wonder if anyone can sleep with the city in such an uproar, but will you be retiring to your quarters?
Very good. In light─ahem─of the present situation, I have had illumination prepared for all our rooms. No need to rush to the markets for lanterns or candles. Have a pleasant rest, .
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_GUIDEOFTHEPENDANTS_: Ah, begging your pardons, , but do you perchance intend to head outside?
If so, I would strongly advise you not to stray too far from the Crystarium. Word has it Eulmore has dispatched its military to Lakeland.
Given the timing, one can only assume they do not welcome the return of night. Even now, the Exarch is in the Ocular, deliberating a response.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MYSTERYVOICE_000_01: If Minfilia has indeed been captured, I daresay we will see another familiar face anon. But first things first─pray seek out Moren at the Cabinet of Curiosity.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_LYNA_000_015: We will continue to watch the Eulmorans.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_ALPHINAUD_000_020: It seems an age since we bade Minfilia farewell...
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_ALISAIE_000_025: Whatever you think Moren's going to tell you about Minfilia, it won't be what you're expecting. Just...trust me.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_030: Yes? If you're after books pertaining to the Warrior of Darkness, I'm afraid most are out on loan at present. They are experiencing quite a surge in popularity.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_031: Oh, you wish to learn about the Oracle of Light? Then it would be my pleasure to assist!
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_032: ...After I have finished off some few outstanding tasks, that is. While I attend to them, perhaps you could fetch me a book: The Illustrated Tale of the Oracle of Light, it's called.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_033: Though it's intended for younger readers, it provides an excellent summary of the subject matter, and the artwork is quite lovely besides! I would not hesitate to recommend it to anyone with an interest in learning about Minfilia!
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_034: ...But you must see for yourself. The book should be located on the level below.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_035: Should, I say...for while there is a place for everything here, not everything is always in its place─despite my best efforts. In short, if the book is not where it should be, it will almost certainly be somewhere it shouldn't. So, uh...good luck!
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_040: How goes the search? Remember, it's always in the last place you look!
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_ALISAIE_000_050: Is there a stepladder we can borrow?
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_SYSTEM_000_060: The book does not appear to be here.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_SYSTEM_000_061: Just as your eyes begin to blur, they finally come to rest on a copy of The Illustrated Tale of the Oracle of Light.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_081: Yes, this is the one! I hope it wasn't too difficult to track down.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_082: I'm happy to say I've finished all my pressing tasks. If you want to call your friends over, we can begin learning at once!
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_084: It began a hundred years ago, when the Flood of Light threatened to swallow Norvrandt. Just as all seemed lost, a savior appeared who halted the all-consuming radiance. A maiden with hair of spun gold and eyes of clearest sapphire.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_085: Naught was known about her save that her name was Minfilia. And for delivering the realm, she came to be revered as the Oracle of Light.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_086: After stopping the Flood, the mysterious maiden vanished without a trace. But fifteen years later, her name would unexpectedly reappear in the annals of history.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_087: When sin eaters laid ruin to the Kingdom of Voeburt, a young girl was discovered who was immune to the creatures' blighted touch.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_088: ...One with hair of spun gold and eyes of clearest sapphire. She was hailed as the Oracle reborn and came to likewise be called Minfilia.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_089: Enlisting in the Eulmoran Army, this Minfilia fought and vanquished countless sin eaters.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_090: Alas, like so many other soldiers, she eventually met her end in battle.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_091: Yet with her dying breath, she whispered unto her grieving comrades, “Minfilia will return.”
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_092: And true to her words, some years later, another young girl was discovered who possessed the selfsame eyes, that selfsame hair, and those selfsame powers.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_093: She too took the name Minfilia. She too fought sin eaters as a soldier of Eulmore. And she too fell in battle. Many more were to follow in her footsteps. And so the cycle continues to this day.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_095: By their valor and sacrifice, these women have saved Norvrandt on numerous occasions.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_096: And were it not for them, we might never have learned of the Lightwardens and their nature.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_098: Some, perhaps... The truth is rather less simple. Though the Oracle is reborn with certain common traits, she does not inherit the memories or the knowledge of her previous incarnations.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_099: All of the Minfilias thus far were discovered as ordinary girls, unversed in the ways of war and ignorant of the power they harbored.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_100: While some embraced their fate and devoted themselves to training, others did not... But all were made to face the sin eaters, and all died to keep our hopes alive.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_ALPHINAUD_000_101: What can you tell us of the current Minfilia?
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_102: She was found by the Eulmoran Army some ten years ago and taken into their care.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_103: ...Or rather their custody. She was a prisoner in all but name. For by that time, under Lord Vauthry's rule, Eulmore had already abandoned resistance in favor of decadence.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_104: Minfilia was an uncomfortable reminder of the war they no longer wished to fight. A potential threat to the peace. And so they kept her under lock and key.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_105: For a long while, we heard nothing more of her. We couldn't even be certain she was alive, save that it was in the Eulmorans' best interests for her to remain under their control.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MOREN_000_106: But then, three years ago, a gallant soul stole into the city and rescued her from their clutches! Just like a hero from the tales!
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_ALPHINAUD_000_107: Indeed. Well, I believe we now have a good grasp of Minfilia's tale. Thank you for your time, Moren.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_ALPHINAUD_000_108: Might I trouble you for a word, ? Outside?
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_ALISAIE_000_110: This seems a suitable place for a chat.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_ALPHINAUD_000_120: As you will have already surmised, the gallant soul who rescued Minfilia was none other than our own dear Thancred.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_ALPHINAUD_000_121: They have since been wandering the land together, never remaining in one place for long─which is why we have not yet had a chance to meet them.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_ALISAIE_000_122: We know that Minfilia journeyed here as Hydaelyn's emissary to halt the Flood of Light.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_ALISAIE_000_123: It could only be her that the people of the First witnessed a hundred years ago. The original Oracle of Light.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_ALISAIE_000_124: But while there's plainly some connection between the woman we knew and her namesakes, the fact that these girls do not share her memories must surely mean they are not the same person.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_ALPHINAUD_000_126: I have no doubt that he understands. The question is how he feels.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_ALPHINAUD_000_127: Regardless, the Thancred we know would not forsake his charge.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_ALPHINAUD_000_128: If she has been captured, we may be certain he will not stand idly by.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_ALISAIE_000_129: Hmph, there you go again, talking in your roundabout way. If you think we should rescue Minfilia, just spit it out.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_ALISAIE_000_130: It just so happens I agree with you.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_ALISAIE_000_131: It's quite clear that this Minfilia possesses Hydaelyn's blessing.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_ALISAIE_000_132: And it wouldn't hurt to have a second such individual on our side. Right, ?
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_A1_000_002: One's generally been enough... But fine.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MYSTERYVOICE_000_13: (-???-)I see you've made up your minds.
First, the report. Our scouts have confirmed that the Eulmoran forces at Laxan Loft do indeed have Minfilia in their custody.
For the present, they are holding her there, but we can be certain they will move her to Eulmore ere long. Should that happen, we may be forced to give her up as lost.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_ALISAIE_000_138: So if we mean to act, we should do so quickly.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MYSTERYVOICE_000_13: Which brings me to my proposal.
TEXT_LUCKMB101_03302_MYSTERYVOICE_000_14: I ask that you entrust this undertaking to us, the people of the Crystarium.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_ALPHINAUD_100_000: Let us hear what the Exarch has to say.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_ALISAIE_110_000: Entrust Minfilia's rescue to the people of the Crystarium? All right, then...
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_MYSTERYVOICE_000_00: Many here have a place in their heart for Minfilia. We must ensure this mission succeeds─for all of their sakes.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_ALPHINAUD_000_005: Though our hosts have offered to take the lead, we still have a part to play. Let's see that we play it well.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_ALISAIE_000_010: The people of the Crystarium have initiative. I respect that.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_LYNA_000_020: So, you will be joining the guard. But however highly the Exarch thinks of you, you will receive no special treatment from me. Is that clear?
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_LYNA_000_022: Better. More spirited than the Exarch's feeble attempts, certainly.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_LYNA_000_023: Now, first things first: you will need uniforms.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_LYNA_000_024: Go to the Crystalline Mean and report to Katliss. She will see you measured and fitted.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_LYNA_000_030: I don't see a uniform. Report to Katliss. She will see you measured and fitted.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_KATLISS_000_040: Ah, and there's the last of them! Your friends are being measured as we speak.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_KATLISS_000_041: Right this way. We'll see to it you look your dashing best for your first outing!
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_KATLISS_000_042: Done, are you? Let's have a look at those numbers.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_KATLISS_000_045: Sorry, Captain─I'm afraid we don't have anything on hand that's a ready fit.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_KATLISS_000_046: But we do have a few that are fairly close. We should be able to make them work with some minor adjustments.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_LYNA_000_047: Very well, then. See to it. And have the uniforms delivered directly to the field.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_LYNA_000_048: I shall take this opportunity to brief you on the mission.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_LYNA_000_049: As mentioned earlier, we will deploy amaro to scatter dream powder from the air.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_LYNA_000_050: Once the powder takes effect, an elite unit will storm the fortress to rescue the Oracle. Her safe liberation is our sole objective; engagement is to be avoided wherever possible.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_ALISAIE_000_051: I assume we're to be part of said unit?
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_LYNA_100_052: The unit will be divided into two contingents, one deploying from Fort Jobb and the other from the Ostall Imperative. You and Alphinaud will join the former.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_LYNA_000_053: , meanwhile, will join the latter with me.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_LYNA_000_054: Before you proceed to your positions, you are to report to Chessamile at Spagyrics.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_LYNA_000_055: She will issue you with a serum to ward off the effects of dream powder.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_ALPHINAUD_000_056: We shall be on our way, then. Take care, my friend, and we will see you in the field.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_LYNA_000_057: It's quite far to the Imperative, so you may make use of an amaro from the rookery. After you have collected the serum, of course.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_CHESSAMILE_000_060: Yes, sweetie? Is there something you need? ...Oh, one of the guard come for your dram, are you?
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_CHESSAMILE_000_061: Here you go. A dose of this will keep you firmly in the waking world while your enemies are off in dreamland.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_CHESSAMILE_000_062: Now, if this is your first time, I should warn you: it's bitter as sin. Prince's kiss, they call it, but if you ask me, it should be crone's kiss! Hee hee!
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_CHESSAMILE_000_063: Jests aside, the stuff really is foul. Most people gag like there's no tomorrow─but if you don't drain every last drop, you're liable to end up taking a trip to dreamland yourself. So I must ask you to drink it here and now, while I watch. Come on! Give the old crone a kiss, hee hee!
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_CHESSAMILE_000_070: What are you waiting for, sweetie? Go on and give the old crone a kiss, hee hee!
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_CHESSAMILE_000_080: (-Chessamile-)Well done, sweetie! I'm proud of you! Why, if I didn't know any better, I'd even say you enjoyed it! And now you needn't fear falling asleep on the battlefield. Just have care you don't lose any limbs out there, all right? They don't tend to grow back.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_SYSTEM_000_081: If you are to avoid being forced to consume a second dose, you must drink the serum somewhere Chessamile can see you.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_CHESSAMILE_000_082: Oh? You liked the taste so much, you want some more, is that it? Hee hee, you are a strange one! But as happy as I'd be to oblige, I'm afraid I must save some for the others. Run along now and see to the rest of your preparations!
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_SZEMDJENMAI_000_090: Yes? What do you require of me?
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_SZEMDJENMAI_000_091: An amaro to take you to the Imperative, eh?
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_SZEMDJENMAI_000_092: As much as I would like to oblige, all our mounts are reserved for the coming operation. I fear you will have to go by foot.
TEXT_LUCKMB102_03303_SZEMDJENMAI_000_093: Hmmm, but wait. There might be another way, assuming you are willing to lend a hand.
TEXT_LUCKMB103_03304_SZEMDJENMAI_000_000: I was about to deliver an amaro to Radisca's Round, one of the locations whence the beasts will fly for the operation.
TEXT_LUCKMB103_03304_SZEMDJENMAI_000_001: The tower lies along the route to the Imperative. If near enough is good enough for you, you may make the delivery in my stead.
TEXT_LUCKMB103_03304_SZEMDJENMAI_000_002: Very good. I shall ready the amaro for departure at once.
TEXT_LUCKMB103_03304_SZEMDJENMAI_000_010: Radisca's Round is to the north and west. You can take the road or you can fly─it is up to you.
TEXT_LUCKMB103_03304__SZEMDJENMAI_000_01: Upon arriving, make yourself known to the sentry, and she will give you further instructions.
TEXT_LUCKMB103_03304_SZEMDJENMAI_000_012: If you should become separated from the amaro, worry not─the beasts are trained to return to the rookery. That is all. Go well.
TEXT_LUCKMB103_03304_SZEMDJENMAI_000_020: The amaro returned without you. See that you deliver it safely, yes?
TEXT_LUCKMB103_03304_SOLDIEROFWATCHTOWER: Gah, where's that last amaro? It's supposed to be here by now.
Oh? You're delivering that amaro to us?
I'm afraid there's been a change of plans. We already have all the beasts we require here.
Instead, this one is to go to the Imperative to the west. Please see it to the handler on duty, Szeli Vantheu. If you encounter trouble along the path, return here and I'll set you rightwise.
TEXT_LUCKMB103_03304_SYSTEM_000_033: Speak with Szem Djenmai at the Accensor Gate to mount the amaro, then ride it to the sentry at Radisca's Round.
TEXT_LUCKMB103_03304_SOLDIEROFWATCHTOWER: If you're looking for the amaro, it's come back here. Let's get you on your way again.
TEXT_LUCKMB103_03304_SZELIVANTHEU_000_04: All of our amaro are in fine fettle. They won't let us down.
TEXT_LUCKMB103_03304_SZELIVANTHEU_000_08: Ah, the last amaro! My thanks, friend. You may leave the beast with me.
TEXT_LUCKMB103_03304_SYSTEM_000_081: Speak with the sentry at Radisca's Round to mount the amaro, then ride it to Szeli Vantheu.
TEXT_LUCKMB103_03304_SZELIVANTHEU_000_09: Say, I don't believe I know you. Did you join the guard recently?
Hah, so that is the way of it! Well, you managed to arrive, and that's all that matters in the end.
I bid you welcome to the Ostall Imperative, one of our key strongholds in Lakeland.
The first thing you'll want to do is report to the captain. You'll find her at the lookout across the way.
TEXT_LUCKMB103_03304_SZELIVANTHEU_000_10: The amaro are crucial to our success. We will spare them no preparation.
TEXT_LUCKMB103_03304_LYNA_000_110: So, it seems that rather than the amaro delivering you, you delivered the amaro.
TEXT_LUCKMB103_03304_LYNA_000_111: I'll not thank you─I expect all my soldiers to make themselves useful. Speaking of which, I have a task for you.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_LYNA_000_020: In readiness for the operation, the amaro will need to be treated with the same serum as us.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_LYNA_000_021: As you well know, however, it is not pleasant. In order to coax them into taking it, we have sprinkled it on their fodder.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_LYNA_000_022: All that remains is to feed it to them. A task I am sure you will enjoy. Fetch the fodder from the amaro launch and see to four of the beasts. Dismissed.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_LYNA_000_030: The treated fodder is by the launch. Report back to me when you've finished feeding the patients.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_SYSTEM_000_041: The amaro happily devours the fodder.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_SYSTEM_000_043: The amaro absent-mindedly munches on the fodder.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_SYSTEM_000_045: The amaro is wary at first, but appetite eventually wins out and it accepts the fodder.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_SYSTEM_000_047: The amaro reels at the smell, but accepts the fodder nonetheless.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_LYNA_000_071: Good. The rest have already been dosed, so we need not fear any of our mounts succumbing to the dream powder.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_LYNA_000_072: All units have now entered the final stages of their preparations. The time is nigh.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_LYNA_000_073: Make ready, and await deployment atop the main watchtower. I will send your uniform along as soon as it arrives.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_LYNA_000_074: That is all. May night smile upon us.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_LYNA_000_080: Why are you still here? Go and await deployment atop the main watchtower.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_CRYSTARIUMGARDPICKE: The operation is about to commence! Stand ready!
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_SYSTEM_000_091: During the operation, some of your gear will be glamoured. Your attributes and abilities will be unaffected.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_RYNE_000_092: Th-Thank you. Are you...from the Crystarium?
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_LYNA_000_093: Correct. We've come to rescue you.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_LYNA_000_094: Your weapons─made to the same specifications as Thancred's.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_SYSTEM_000_100: Continue with the main scenario quest?
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_ALISAIE_000_115: I was worried about the others back in Lakeland, but maybe I should be worried about us.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_RYNE_000_120: I'm trying my best to remember...but it feels like peering through fog.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_THANCRED_000_130: Il Mheg is the faerie kingdom, and as one might expect, it is home to the fae folk.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_THANCRED_000_131: The most prominent among them are the pixies, who have a penchant for making mischief. They use powerful illusions to play tricks on all who venture into their domain.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_THANCRED_000_132: By way of an example, they can make a familiar path seem wholly unfamiliar, or lead you to believe you're somewhere you're not.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_THANCRED_000_133: And we are now, I am sorry to say, entirely at their mercy.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_LYNA_BATTLETALK_000: The first contingent has already entered. Let us follow.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: There you are, ! Mayhap you could lend us a hand!
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_LYNA_BATTLETALK_000: My men will occupy the enemy while we rescue the Oracle.
Come, we keep close to the wall!
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_EULMORESOLDIER03305: They're here too! To arms, to arms!
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_LYNA_BATTLETALK_000: Damn it. Let's make this quick!
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_ALISAIE_BATTLETALK_: You certainly took your time. Let's cut a path through this rabble and keep moving!
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: Your zeal is admirable, Sister, but we were told to avoid enemy attention, not invite it!
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_LYNA_BATTLETALK_000: We do not have time. Leave them to the guard.
Eulmore may boast the world's largest army...
But woman for woman, we are no less mighty!
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: This is no token force. They were serious about invading.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_EULMORESOLDIER03305: If you can stand, you can fight! Push them back!
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_LYNA_BATTLETALK_000: There are more still standing than I would have liked...
But we must press on regardless. The longer we take, the harder our task will become.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: We don't seem to be getting anywhere...
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_ALISAIE_BATTLETALK_: , Lyna─go on ahead! We'll hold them here!
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_LYNA_BATTLETALK_000: The way is relatively clear. Good.
Let's rejoin the others and quit this place.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_RYNE_BATTLETALK_000: All this trouble because of me... I'm so sorry...
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_LYNA_BATTLETALK_000: Save your apologies until after we've escaped.
Is that...Ran'jit!? This will not end well...
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_RYNE_BATTLETALK_000: N-No! I won't go back to that cell!
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_RANJIT_BATTLETALK_0: It is for your own protection.
Stay there while I tend to these vermin.
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_LYNA_BATTLETALK_000: The tales do not lie. He is fierce beyond reckoning. We are outmatched!
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: He cannot maintain this onslaught forever! Be prepared to run!
TEXT_LUCKMB104_03305_RANJIT_BATTLETALK_0: You will do no such thing.
And now it is just you and me.
You are made of sterner stuff than the rest.
It seems you are no ordinary soldier.
You are persistent, that I will allow.
I have your measure now. The game is up.
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_ALISAIE_000_005: I was worried about the others back in Lakeland, but maybe I should be worried about us.
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_RYNE_000_010: I'm trying my best to remember...but it feels like peering through fog.
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_THANCRED_000_020: As it stands, we cannot hope to find the way to Urianger. For that, we must convince the pixies to lift the spell.
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_THANCRED_000_021: From what I could make of the voices, the creatures want to play with us. If that is the case, they should permit us to find their village─Lydha Lran.
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_THANCRED_000_022: Come. I have a sneaking suspicion this path will lead us directly into their midst.
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_THANCRED_000_023: Oh, and I should mention that Minfilia has been informed of our situation. Of the different worlds and our mission. You may consider her an ally.
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_ALPHINAUD_000_030: The sense of disorientation is quite overwhelming. I cannot take a dozen steps without forgetting whence we came.
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_ALISAIE_000_035: There's not a soul in sight, yet I feel eyes all over us...
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_RYNE_000_040: Hmm... There was a plant which might help us...if only I could remember what it looked like...
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_THANCRED_000_050: Well, here we are. Yet the pixies are nowhere to be seen. Knowing them, their games have already begun. In which case...
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_THANCRED_000_051: ─there is a variety of plant native to these parts with a distinctive furled tip.
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_THANCRED_000_052: "Looking grass“ is its name─so called because it can be used to spy pixies, believe it or not. I'll...explain how I know all of this later, but first, I need you to help me find some.
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_THANCRED_000_053: Oh─if a voice calls to you, under no circumstances should you respond. You will only subject yourself to further mischief.
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_THANCRED_000_060: Remember, the plant has a furled tip. And I cannot stress this enough, but do not respond to any voices you hear.
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_SYSTEM_000_070: You search the scrub, but find nothing resembling looking grass. Suddenly, a voice rings out...
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_PIXIEVOICEA03306_00: (-Adorable Voice-)Hee hee hee... Greetings, mortal! What is your name?
(-Adorable Voice-),  ! A wonderful name! Pretty like morning dew and funny like caterpillars!
(-Adorable Voice-)I shall slice it and splice it and make it mine! All mine! And when your name is mine, so are you! Hee hee hee...
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_SYSTEM_000_074: Your body begins to feel heavy...
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_PIXIEVOICEA03306_00: (-Adorable Voice-)Oh, you don't have a name? How very, very sad. I could have had sooo much fun with it, hee hee hee...
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_PIXIEVOICEB03306_00: (-Kindly Voice-)What is it that you seek, child? Perhaps I can help you find it.
(-Kindly Voice-)Ah yes, I know the plant. And being the kindly pixie that I am, I shall take you to it.
(-Kindly Voice-)Just close your eyes and focus on my voice. Set your mind adrift, and together we shall go to the ends of the realm.
Hmph, such a rude child, and too clever by half! I shall seek my fun elsewhere!
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_SYSTEM_000_079: Searching the scrub, you find what appears to be looking grass. Suddenly, a voice rings out...
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_PIXIEVOICEC03306_00: (-Playful Voice-)Ooh, a visitor! Where are you from, pray tell?
(-Playful Voice-)What is that? Where is that? When is that? In your dreams, perhaps?
(-Playful Voice-)Forget all about that place, for Il Mheg is your home now. Today and tomorrow and forevermore...
(-Playful Voice-)Hmmm... Perhaps this one's hard of hearing... AHEM! WHAT BRINGS YOU HERE!?
(-Playful Voice-)Ah, so you can hear me! Good, good!
(-Playful Voice-)Come, let's chitter-chatter, jibber-jabber, bibble-babble! Today and tomorrow and forevermore...
(-Playful Voice-)Still...picking plants at our village is as good as indulging in our hospitality. And who are we to turn you away? Hee hee, stay awhile...stay forever!
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_THANCRED_000_089: I take it you met with some trouble. Apologies for subjecting you to that.
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_THANCRED_000_090: Can I assume from your presence that you managed to find us some looking grass?
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_THANCRED_000_091: Yes, this is the stuff. Thus armed, we should be able to see through the pixies' veil of invisibility. And seeing them is the first step to dealing with them.
TEXT_LUCKMB105_03306_THANCRED_000_092: Come, let's gather everyone and put Urianger's little trick to good use.
TEXT_LUCKMB106_03307_SULUIN_000_000: Ooh, ooh! Look at me, look at me! I have a task for you!
TEXT_LUCKMB106_03307_SULUIN_000_001: Lydha Lran is our beloved village, and we want it to always look lovely. And it can't look lovely without flowers blooming. And no flowers bloom lovelier than everblooms!
TEXT_LUCKMB106_03307_SULUIN_000_002: So, here are some everbloom seeds. Take them and sow them here, there, and everywhere around the village. Simple as a dimple, yes?
TEXT_LUCKMB106_03307_SULUIN_000_010: No flowers bloom lovelier than everblooms. Take those seeds and sow them here, there, and everywhere around the village!
TEXT_LUCKMB106_03307_PIXIEA03307_000_020: (-Curious Pixie-)Helping us grow flowers, are you? They'll make this house look so much lovelier!
TEXT_LUCKMB106_03307_PIXIEA03307_000_021: (-Curious Pixie-)There used to be a city of mortals here. A great big, bustling place called Voeburt or Boevurt or some such. But the sin eaters came and everyone disappeared.
TEXT_LUCKMB106_03307_PIXIEA03307_000_022: (-Curious Pixie-)Since then, we pixies have been living here, and we've given the old houses our touch. Lovely, don't you think?
TEXT_LUCKMB106_03307_PIXIEB03307_000_023: (-Jovial Pixie-)Ooh, I can't wait for the flowers to bloom! Perhaps I'll make pretty curtains out of them!
TEXT_LUCKMB106_03307_SULUIN_000_030: You're done sowing the seeds? Thank you! This shall help Lydha Lran live up to its name─which means “flower house,” in case you weren't aware.
TEXT_LUCKMB106_03307_SULUIN_000_031: We weren't always here, you know. We used to live deep in a lush forest. It was beautiful beyond compare, but almost all of it was swallowed up by Light.
