TEXT_LUCKMB106_03307_SULUIN_000_032: For a while we roamed, but eventually we found a place that men had abandoned. Together with our fellow fae folk, we decided to make it our new home.
TEXT_LUCKMB106_03307_SULUIN_000_033: The land of everlasting spring─this is our home, and it could be yours too. Forever and ever and ever...
TEXT_LUCKMB107_03308_YSIALA_000_000: Unnngh... I'm so hungry I may faint...
TEXT_LUCKMB107_03308_YSIALA_000_001: Fruit─a little fruit will set me aright... Will you go and fetch some for me?
TEXT_LUCKMB107_03308_YSIALA_000_002: Just outside the village, you'll find a hillock. Two great belltrees grow there. If you give them a shake, they should render up their sweet, succulent burdens.
TEXT_LUCKMB107_03308_YSIALA_000_010: The trees grow on the nearby hillock. Please hurry and fetch me their fruit─I'm liable to faint at any moment now...
TEXT_LUCKMB107_03308_SYSTEM_000_020: A bug comes tumbling down with the fruit!
TEXT_LUCKMB107_03308_YSIALA_000_030: Unnngh... So hungry... Did you get the fruit?
TEXT_LUCKMB107_03308_YSIALA_000_031: Oh, thank you ever so much... You've saved me, hehehe...
TEXT_LUCKMB107_03308_YSIALA_000_032: Yes, saved me from my boredom! You should have seen the look on your face when the bugs came down! Tee hee hee!
TEXT_LUCKMB107_03308_YSIALA_000_033: Ahhh, you've done me a great service, mortal. If there's one thing we pixies are serious about, it's having fun!
TEXT_LUCKMB107_03308_YSIALA_000_034: Dull and painful things? Hate, hate, hate them! Sin eaters are dull and painful both, so we hate them especially!
TEXT_LUCKMB107_03308_YSIALA_000_035: You mortals try to fight those monstrosities, but there's no fun in that. Best to avoid them altogether, we say!
TEXT_LUCKMB108_03309_OULSIGUN_000_000: Mortal, mortal, hear my plea! Our precious children are thirsty, and I need you to bring them water.
TEXT_LUCKMB108_03309_OULSIGUN_000_001: Who are our children, you ask? Why, they're the leafmen you see standing about our village. Adorable, aren't they?
TEXT_LUCKMB108_03309_OULSIGUN_000_002: Now, you'll need to go to Longmirror Lake to draw the water. Once you have it, see that our children have a good drenching.
TEXT_LUCKMB108_03309_OULSIGUN_000_003: Oh, but be warned: the Fuath make their home in the lake. They tend to play rough, so have care!
TEXT_LUCKMB108_03309_OULSIGUN_000_010: They may look alike to strangers, but to us each of our children is unique and special!
TEXT_LUCKMB108_03309_BALLOON_000_021: You want water? We'll give you a lungful!
TEXT_LUCKMB108_03309_OULSIGUN_000_030: You've given water to our children? Thank you ever so much!
TEXT_LUCKMB108_03309_OULSIGUN_000_031: They're all very dear to us. They wandered into Il Mheg as stray mortals, but we grew attached to them and decided to take them in.
TEXT_LUCKMB108_03309_OULSIGUN_000_032: You and yours would've been our children too, but the enchantment didn't catch as well as we'd hoped. It's never too late of course...
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_THANCRED_000_001: So, a mix of menial tasks and pranks.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_THANCRED_000_002: Yes, that pretty much sums up my own experience. They have no troubles worthy of the name.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_ALISAIE_000_003: <sigh> How long are we supposed to keep at this? They're clearly playing with us.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_ALPHINAUD_000_004: Indeed. Whenever I inquire how much more there is to be done, the answer is ever the same: “A little.” I doubt they have any intention of releasing us in the near future.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_RYNE_000_005: Urianger once told me a story about the pixies.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_RYNE_000_006: They're born from the souls of those who died as children, or so it's believed.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_RYNE_000_007: Though they don't have memories of their previous lives, the desire to have fun remains, imprinted on their souls.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_RYNE_000_008: And so they live only to play, keeping hapless mortals for their pleasure for years on end. Sometimes even until death...
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_ALPHINAUD_000_009: Hmmm... In the past, when I sought to identify the true nature of ghosts, I came upon literature examining a similar subject.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_ALPHINAUD_000_010: The soul was likened to a core that resides in the aether, and its presence is what differentiates us from such beings as sprites and arcane entities.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Upon death, said core ordinarily dissipates alongside the aether that composed the flesh. However, it may be held together and bound to the corporeal realm, either by the will of its owner or by means of certain arts.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_ALPHINAUD_000_012: In time, the soul may regather aether unto itself to assume another form, or find newly emerged life in which to abide. The pixies may be one such instance of this.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_ALISAIE_000_013: ...If ghosts are merely souls without bodies, what does that make us? I think you've become that which you fear most, Brother dearest.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_THANCRED_000_014: However the pixies may have come into being, if we leave them to judge when they are satisfied, they will never be satisfied.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_THANCRED_000_015: Nay, we must negotiate new terms with the creatures... But where to begin? It seems to me we would need at least one among them to sympathize with us...
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_THANCRED_000_016: In the course of your chores, did any of you encounter a pixie who seemed even faintly amenable to reason?
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_THANCRED_000_017: What? You knew a pixie from before?
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_THANCRED_000_018: Not only are you acquainted, but you've entered into a pact? You might have mentioned this sooner!
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_THANCRED_000_019:
At any rate, I dare to hope this will offer us a way out.
Without further delay, then, summon this Feo Ul, if you please.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_SYSTEM_000_020: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter “Feo Ul” to summon your pixie friend at the designated location.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_ALPHINAUD_000_030: We're ghosts too... I suppose it makes sense on a certain level...
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_ALISAIE_000_035: A pact with a pixie. Why am I not surprised?
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_THANCRED_000_040: Come along, . Summon your pixie friend.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_RYNE_000_045: I hope Feo Ul will be able to help us.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_SYSTEM_000_051: A voice rings out in your mind...
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_FEOUL_000_052: (-Feo Ul-)So! My sapling has finally remembered about  lovely branch!
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_FEOUL_000_053: (-Feo Ul-)But with such a half-hearted call,  may as well lop me off and cast me aside! Hmph, I have no sapling!
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_SYSTEM_000_054: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter “Feo Ul” to summon your pixie friend at the designated location.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_SYSTEM_000_060: Please, Feo Ul, I need you
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_FEOUL_000_061: (-Feo Ul-)Hmph, is that your idea of a fervent call? A sodden log could do it with more fire!
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_SYSTEM_000_062: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter “Please, Feo Ul, I need you” to summon your pixie friend at the designated location.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_SYSTEM_000_070: O loveliest of branches, please grant me your succor!
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_SYSTEM_000_071: With the chat mode in Say, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter “O loveliest of branches, please grant me your succor!” to summon your pixie friend at the designated location.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_ALPHINAUD_000_080: Worry not, we shall be fine. Go on and find Urianger.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_ALISAIE_000_085: Send Urianger my regards...and tell him to live somewhere less annoying next time.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_RYNE_000_090: Feo Ul certainly has a way with the other pixies.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_THANCRED_000_100: For Alphinaud and Alisaie's sakes, let us be quick. It would be a shame to return only to find that they had been made to play one game too many.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_THANCRED_000_101: Now, the place we seek is the abandoned manor of a nobleman and scholar. The Bookman's Shelves, it's called, after the fellow's vast collection of tomes. An agreeable habitat for our friend, I'm sure you'll agree.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_THANCRED_000_102: If we follow the path north, we should soon find the place. Come along.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_RYNE_000_110: It's been quite a while. I hope Urianger is well.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_THANCRED_000_120: And here we are at long last. I give you Urianger's humble abode.
TEXT_LUCKMB109_03310_THANCRED_000_121: Come, let's see if he's home.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_ALPHINAUD_000_000: All is well with us...for the time being. There's no telling what manner of games the pixies will dream up.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_ALISAIE_000_005: Have you met Urianger yet? The sooner you do, the sooner we can leave this place.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_THANCRED_000_010: We will be much bolstered for Urianger's company.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_RYNE_000_015: Oh...er, no need to worry about me. I'm quite familiar with the manor.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_RYNE_000_016: During our wanderings, Thancred and I would often return here. It's where I imbue his ammunition.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_URIANGER_000_020: My friend. Ere I speak of the task at hand, there is a question I would pose to thee.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_A1_000_003: I didn't recognize you at first.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_URIANGER_000_022: Indeed. Though the night be lost, behind the shroud of blinding light, doubt not but that the stars shine still.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_URIANGER_000_023: I have chosen to avail myself of their guidance, that I might navigate the sea of uncertainty that stretcheth before us. For a blessing, my prior studies of astrology did provide me with adequate grounding in the art.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_URIANGER_000_024: Did I...lose weight? If 'tis of flesh thou speakest, I cannot rightly say. However, in taking up astrology, I may have shed with some yalms of fabric. My present attire better suiteth the art.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_URIANGER_000_025: Though the night be lost, behind the shroud of blinding light, doubt not but that the stars shine still. I have chosen to avail myself of their guidance, that I might navigate the sea of uncertainty that stretcheth before us.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_URIANGER_000_026: Come now, 'tis scarce the first time thou hast beheld these fair features. Lest thou wonderest, I have taken up astrology. My present attire better suiteth the art.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_URIANGER_000_027: Though the night be lost, behind the shroud of blinding light, doubt not but that the stars shine still. I have chosen to avail myself of their guidance, that I might navigate the sea of uncertainty that stretcheth before us.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_URIANGER_000_028: But enough of myself. Let us now speak of our task.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_URIANGER_000_029: As I did mention, if we are to enter Lyhe Ghiah, we must needs gain the pixies' cooperation.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_URIANGER_000_030: This is a simple matter of presenting unto them a suitable gift.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_URIANGER_000_031: I shall procure a selection of viands that shall please their palates. Thancred, pray assist me in this endeavor.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_URIANGER_000_032: Meanwhile, , I bid thee obtain that which will please their eyes. In these parts, there abideth a vilekin known for its beauteous wings: the hawker. I shall lend thee a receptacle within which thou mayest capture a weakened specimen.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_THANCRED_000_040: There's no avoiding chores, is there? Far better under Urianger than the pixies, of course.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_URIANGER_000_045: Thou shouldst find a hawker nearby. Pray use the receptacle I have lent thee to capture a weakened specimen.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_URIANGER_000_050: Thou art returned. Wert thou able to capture a hawker?
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_URIANGER_000_051: Ah, a truly magnificent set of wings. I shall treat them at once to make fast their vibrant colors.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_URIANGER_000_052: Thancred too should return anon, upon which I shall ready all the items for presentation. Pray take thine ease meanwhile.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_ALPHINAUD_000_060: You couldn't have returned at a better time. The pixies had just decided that it would be amusing to have Alisaie and I exchange outfits...
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_ALISAIE_000_065: Ahaha, thank the gods you arrived when you did! Any later, and I don't think I would've been able to live it down!
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_THANCRED_000_070: When you have a moment, be sure to show your appreciation to the twins. They've endured a great deal on our behalf...
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_RYNE_000_075: I dare not ask what happened in our absence...
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_URIANGER_000_080: As much as I should like to savor the reunion with Master Alphinaud and Mistress Alisaie, it must wait. I have taken the liberty of presenting our gifts unto the pixies; let us see how well they are received.
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_SULUIN_000_090: We weren't expecting you all back so soon. We had scarcely begun playing with the twins...
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_SULUIN_000_091: That said, your gifts are truly wonderful! Let me tell you, the milk and honey and biscuits won't last a day, and the wings are the loveliest we've ever seen!
TEXT_LUCKMB110_03311_SULUIN_000_092: You've done us a great kindness, and it's fae custom to return the gesture. If you desire anything of us, you need but name it!
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALPHINAUD_000_000: You couldn't have returned at a better time. The pixies had just decided that it would be amusing to have Alisaie and I exchange outfits...
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALISAIE_000_005: Ahaha, thank the gods you arrived when you did! Any later, and I don't think I would've been able to live it down!
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_THANCRED_000_010: When you have a moment, be sure to show your appreciation to the twins. They've endured a great deal on our behalf...
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_RYNE_000_015: I dare not ask what happened in our absence...
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_URIANGER_000_020: Full glad am I to see that our gifts were gratefully accepted. Confident though I was in our choice, there is no accounting for mood.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_SULUIN_000_030: So, what is it that you desire? Rusty old coins like you mortals are wont to collect, perhaps?
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_URIANGER_000_031: We are resolved to vanquish the Lightwarden of this land. To that end, we desire entry to Lyhe Ghiah.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_SULUIN_000_032: What a strange thing to wish for! You might as well ask for your death!
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_SULUIN_000_033: But if that is what you want, who are we to argue? Very well, I shall speak with the others.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALISAIE_000_034: You've clearly been busy, Urianger. Would you be so kind as to tell us what we've missed?
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALPHINAUD_000_035: ...So that was the purpose of the gifts.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALISAIE_000_036: Is there anything you can tell us about this Lightwarden?
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_URIANGER_000_037: Aye, my lady. By circumstances most tragic, the Lightwarden of this land...
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_SULUIN_000_039: It was not always so, of course. Our king fought the first Lightwarden that threatened our home, you see. Fought it, and won.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_SULUIN_000_040: But all the horrible light that came out went and corrupted them, turning them into a new Lightwarden.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_SULUIN_000_041: Now, they're king only in name. Naught remains of the wise and just ruler that used to be. We had no choice but to seal them in the castle.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_SULUIN_000_042: The magick for breaking the seal, we divided into four, and wove each into a different relic, to be kept apart until the time was right...
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_SULUIN_000_043: And this dress is one of them. It's been in our safekeeping for years and years, but we've decided to entrust it to you.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_SULUIN_000_046: Though you're most certainly going to your deaths, we thought we should at least let you try. That way, we get to watch what happens!
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_SULUIN_000_047: Of course, you can't break the seal unless you have the other relics too.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_SULUIN_000_048: The shell crown is with the Fuath, the stone scepter is with the Nu Mou, and the crystal shoes are with the amaro.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_URIANGER_000_050: The facts thus disclosed confirm mine own understanding. Our quest lieth now before us.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_URIANGER_000_051: First, let us hie to the lake, there to claim the shell crown from the Fuath.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_URIANGER_000_052: If we call to them before the Untouchable Gate, they will answer.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALISAIE_000_065: I was about to say the Fuath couldn't be any more unreasonable than the pixies, but that's just asking for trouble.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_THANCRED_000_070: During our sojourns in Il Mheg, we avoided the lake at all costs. Let that suffice to warn you of its dangers.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_RYNE_000_075: I was taught never to talk to the Fuath under any circumstances... Are you sure this is a good idea...?
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_URIANGER_000_080: Through the gate lieth the domain of the Fuath.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_URIANGER_000_090: Hearken to me, O spirits of the water. We are come with an entreaty.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_THANCRED_000_091: Not in a talkative mood, apparently.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALISAIE_000_092: I'm not exactly sure how the gate works...
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALISAIE_000_093: But if the Fuath are water spirits, perhaps we should take our search into the lake.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALPHINAUD_000_094: O-Oh? I...I suppose a brief dip wouldn't hurt...
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALISAIE_000_095: We all know Thancred swims like an eel, but what about you, Minfilia?
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_RYNE_000_096: I can swim well enough. Thancred taught me.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALISAIE_000_098: What about you, Urianger? I'm not sure I've ever asked.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_URIANGER_000_099: ...Rather than swim, mayhap it would be more...expeditious to walk upon the surface by means of magic.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALPHINAUD_000_100: You too, Urianger!? That you should be a kindred spirit!
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALPHINAUD_000_101: Worry not, my friend. I know some helpful tricks, and I should be more than happy to share them with you. Together, we shall conquer the waves!
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_BOSSOFFUATH_000_102: (-Watery Voice-)Well, well, aren't we a lively lot! And you have an entreaty for us, you say? An entreaty from mortals─what a treat!
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_URIANGER_000_103: Aye. My comrades and I are on a quest to vanquish the Lightwarden.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_URIANGER_000_104: To that end, we would humbly beg the loan of the shell crown, which we are given to understand is in the safekeeping of your people.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_BOSSOFFUATH_000_105: (-Watery Voice-)Oh? Is that all? Of course, of course! You may have it! You shall have it!
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_THANCRED_000_106: Just like that? What do you want from us?
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_BOSSOFFUATH_000_107: (-Watery Voice-)Ohoho, no need to be so suspicious! The crown simply doesn't mean much to us, is all.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_BOSSOFFUATH_000_108: (-Watery Voice-)As a matter of fact, nothing means much to us. For we Fuath, it's over before it's begun, and we couldn't care less what becomes of the faerie king, nor the world for that matter.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_BOSSOFFUATH_000_109: (-Watery Voice-)Having said that...we do so seldom have mortal visitors, and it would seem a shame not to make the most of you...
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_BOSSOFFUATH_000_110: (-Watery Voice-)Touch the Untouchable Gate, and come hither to our domain, Dohn Mheg. In your tongue, it means “forbidden realm.” Sounds forbidding, yes?
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_BOSSOFFUATH_000_111: (-Watery Voice-)And so it should, for we are one with the water, our home wrought of ripples and waves and currents. Find your way through. Give us thrilling sport. And we will give you the crown!
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_A1_000_002: Form a party and enter Dohn Mheg.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALPHINAUD_000_120: So they desire sport. It seems safe to say we must proceed fully prepared.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALISAIE_000_125: I'll take sport over pixie chores. Let's give the Fuath what they want.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_THANCRED_000_130: When we sally forth, allow me to lead the van. Bearing the brunt is my specialty these days.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_THANCRED_000_131: While I was in imperial territory, I learned how to wield the gunblade, but I subsequently let my skills go to rust for want of the ability to replenish my own ammunition.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_THANCRED_000_132: When I decided to rescue Minfilia, however, I knew I needed a more defensively minded style, so I placed a special order at the Crystalline Mean, and the rest is history.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_RYNE_000_135: I can fight too. I promise I won't be a burden.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_URIANGER_000_140: 'Twas never like to be simple. Hard though it may seem to believe, the Fuath's love of games surpasseth even that of the pixies.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_URIANGER_000_141: And in the name of their games, full many men have drowned. We must needs take all care if we are to avoid meeting a watery end.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_URIANGER_000_161: Nay, my lady. Exhausted as thou art, thou wouldst only endanger thyself. I prithee, rest a moment.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_THANCRED_000_162: There was nothing where we looked.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALPHINAUD_000_164: Dear gods... Were it not for Soroban's blessing... But I need not labor the point. I am glad to see you safe and well, my friend.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALISAIE_000_165: Have you any idea how worried we were!? To wash up on the shore, only to find you weren't with us!?
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALISAIE_000_166: Oh, but I'm forgetting─here's your crown, Your Majesty! The Fuath kept that part of the bargain, at least!
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_THANCRED_000_167: While there were certain twists and turns, our work here is done, with everyone none the worse for wetness.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_SULUIN_000_168: Oh! Thank goodness you're still here!
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_SULUIN_000_170: A great big mob of mortals is marching to Il Mheg. Mortals with ugly weapons and uglier faces!
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_SULUIN_000_171: They wouldn't happen to be your friends, would they?
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_THANCRED_000_172: Rather the reverse, I fear. The Eulmoran Army, at a guess.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALPHINAUD_000_174: As much as you like. But just to be sure, I will return with you to confirm their identities. If they are who we suspect, we will require your aid.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_SULUIN_000_175: If Alphinaud is coming, then Alisaie will be too, yes? Can't have one without the other, you know!
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALISAIE_000_176: <sigh> All right. Just remember, we're not your playmates this time.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALPHINAUD_000_177: I'm afraid we must leave the rest of the relic hunt in your hands.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_A2_000_001: Don't worry. I've done this sort of thing before.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_A2_000_002: It's fine. Defeating the Lightwarden would always have fallen to me.
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALPHINAUD_000_178: Indeed you have! Very well, then. See you afterwards, my friend!
TEXT_LUCKMB111_03312_ALPHINAUD_000_179: Perhaps. But I would feel better if we were there to assist you. <sigh> Back to cheering you on from afar. See you afterwards, my friend.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_THANCRED_000_000: If it is indeed the Eulmoran Army, we may soon have to contend with Ran'jit again...which may prove problematic, even for you.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_RYNE_000_005: If only I hadn't been caught...
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_010: With our enemies fast approaching, time is of the essence. We must needs accomplish our mission with all possible haste.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_011: Of the two remaining bearers of the relics, the Nu Mou are the nearer. We shall seek them out next.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_012: Among the fae folk, they bear the distinction of having abided in these lands since before the Flood. They are also the friendliest to men, and have served me faithfully whensoever I have called upon them. Indeed, they are the source of much of the knowledge I have acquired in my time here.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_013: The path leadeth past my dwellings. Let us away.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_020: Past yonder cliff lieth Pla Enni, home of the Nu Mou.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_021: The others have gone ahead to scout the way. Come, let us follow.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_030: If the path striketh thee as precipitous, 'tis because it was once a mountain trail.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_031: For where the lake now lieth, there was a valley, in whose midst thrived the city of Voeburt. 'Twas only when the Fuath came, in the wake of the Flood, that the settlement was drowned.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_032: We stand now upon its former outskirts. Grazing lands where shepherds once tended their flocks.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_033: Though one cannot help but feel a pang of loss when faced with such a spectacle, one can scarcely blame the fae folk for so altering the land.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_034: The blame for that lieth rightly with the Light─a force terrible enough to bring an entire civilization to its knees. An entire world. That it should have been allowed to rise up unchecked is the greater regret.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_035: Yet, in spite of all the tragedy which surroundeth me, full glad am I for the chance to be here.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_036: 'Twas these hands which brought together the Warriors of Darkness and Minfilia, lest thou forget.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_037: Therefore, even were there no Eighth Umbral Calamity to forestall, it seemeth only right that I strive to deliver the First from its doom.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_038: Only right, I say, though such words ill convey the strength of my resolve.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_039: In truth, I can no more ignore the plight of this world than I can choose to stop breathing. And thus do I labor─for those we have lost. For those we can yet save.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_040: The coming struggle promiseth to test us to our limits, but so long as we stand together, I doubt not but that we shall prevail.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_PIXIEA03313_000_041: (-Boisterous Pixie-)Aha! Mortals, just as we thought!
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_PIXIEA03313_000_043: (-Boisterous Pixie-)Business? Ha! Nothing so boring! We smelled you coming, and thought we'd come to play!
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_044: They do not appear to be pixies of Lydha Lran.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_045: Mine apologies, but we are in some haste. Mayhap another day.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_PIXIEA03313_000_046: (-Boisterous Pixie-)Ohhh, in some haste, are you? Then allow me to hasten you on your way! Tee hee hee!
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_047: Teleportation magick. For a mercy, we were not sent far from our course.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_048: Should the pixies find us again, however, they will most assuredly repeat the trick.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_049: We have not the time to waste. Let us avail ourselves of an enchantment I have learned.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_050: “Fae cloak,” 'tis called─a most ingenious magick which rendereth one invisible to fae folk, albeit briefly.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_PIXIEA03313_000_060: (-Boisterous Pixie-)Oh, no you don't! Back you go, tee hee hee!
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_070: I shall cast the enchantment upon thee. Under its aegis, thou art to make thy way past the pixies and rejoin our comrades.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_071: Know, however, that the enchantment shall suffice to veil thee and thee alone. Be not tempted to employ a mount, as it will only serve to give thy presence away.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_080: I shall cast the enchantment upon thee once more. The effect is quick to fade, so thou must needs be swift.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_PIXIEB03313_000_110: (-Boisterous Pixie-)Hee hee, found you! Aaand away you go!
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_PIXIEC03313_000_115: (-Earnest Pixie-)You've nothing to fear, mortal! I'm not like the other pixies.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_PIXIEC03313_000_116: (-Earnest Pixie-)I'm WORSE! Ahahaha! Better luck next time!
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_SYSTEM_000_120: The pixies leave, disappointment writ on their faces.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_RYNE_000_130: We lost sight of you. Is everything all right?
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_THANCRED_000_140: I assumed you were right behind us. What took you so long?
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_THANCRED_000_141: I see... Yes, I'd say that's a valid excuse for lateness. You are hereby forgiven.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_THANCRED_000_142: In other good news, the Nu Mou village lies just through here. We'll enter as soon as Urianger deigns to join us.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_TYRNEE_000_143: Ah! Ahhh! Mortals! Mortals are here! Lots of them!
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_THANCRED_000_144: I thought you said the Nu Mou were men's best friends. The poor thing was beside itself with fear.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_145: 'Twas beside itself, perhaps...but not with fear.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_WYDAENC_000_146: This is unacceptable! Unacceptable, I tell you! To have so many mortals appear at once...
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_WYDAENC_000_147: It's more excitement than we can bear!
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_148: Greetings, Elder Wyd Aenc, Tyr Nee. It hath been a while.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_149: Pray forgive my brevity, but time is against us. We are come to borrow the stone scepter of the Nu Mou.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_WYDAENC_000_0150: Th-The stone scepter? Then...you mean to lift the seal over Lyhe Ghiah!?
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_WYDAENC_000_151: That is unacceptable! Unacceptable, I tell you! If the king is set free, none here will be safe!
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_WYDAENC_000_152: Unlike our fae cousins, we Nu Mou have called this land our home since time immemorial. Leaving is unthinkable.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_WYDAENC_000_153: Thus did full many of us lay down our lives to seal away our king when they were corrupted by Light! If we do as you ask, our sacrifice would have been in vain!
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_A1_000_002: No one will come to harm.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_A1_000_003: Just hand over the godsdamned staff.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_WYDAENC_000_154: But then you'll only become another Lightwarden! It changes nothing!
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_WYDAENC_000_155: Easily said for one who hasn't experienced the king's wrath!
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_WYDAENC_000_156: S-Such discourtesy! It's unacceptable! Unacceptable, I tell you!
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_157: Honored Elder, pray believe me when I say that this  is possessed not only of the strength required to vanquish the king, but of something still more valuable: a means to resist the resultant corruption. Indeed,  hath already laid low the Lightwarden of Lakeland, all without succumbing to the influence of its Light.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_158: is yet a stranger to this land, 'tis true, but  harboreth the selfsame desire to see the sin eaters eliminated as we do.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_159: Wilt thou not lend us thy hand, that we might see thy beloved home restored to its former glory?
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_WYDAENC_000_160: Hmmm... You have always done right by us, Urianger. If you have placed your faith in this , then so shall we.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_WYDAENC_000_161: As you say, we want nothing more than to be rid of the sin eaters.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_WYDAENC_000_162: Be that as it may, this is not a decision to be made lightly. We require time to deliberate. A turn of the moon, perhaps...
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_THANCRED_000_163: We don't have a turn of the moon. Unless we want to debate this with the Eulmoran Army.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_164: Elder...given all that is at stake, I cannot well expect thee simply to roll over, and acquiesce to our request.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_URIANGER_000_165: But even now, a powerful foe draweth near, and I fear I must beseech thee to hasten thy deliberations, that thou mightst fetch us the scepter while there is yet time to use it.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_WYDAENC_000_167: You know full well that naught gives us greater pleasure than to render aid to men!
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_WYDAENC_000_168: You know full well, yet you speak the words of power regardless? It's unfair! Unfair, I tell you!
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_WYDAENC_000_169: <sigh> In happier times, it was our honor to assist mortals in need and receive rewards befitting our deeds.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_WYDAENC_000_170: Since the Kingdom of Voeburt fell, however, we've been starved of man's patronage. After so many years of deprivation, it is...difficult to ignore such an earnest entreaty.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_WYDAENC_000_171: Very well, Urianger. I promise to give you as swift an answer as I may.
TEXT_LUCKMB112_03313_WYDAENC_000_172: In return, I ask that you and yours remain here the while, and bestow upon us your patronage. Is this arrangement agreeable?
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_THANCRED_000_000: Well enough to be served. The question is whether we can provide a fitting reward.
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_RYNE_000_005: What do I need help with? Hmmm...
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_URIANGER_000_010: Though the Nu Mou may appear placid and amicable, be fairly warned that they live by uncompromising codes.
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_URIANGER_000_011: Codes such as that which sayeth the payment must precisely befit the service. Be it an item or a task, have care thou givest neither more nor less than what is requested.
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_WYDAENC_000_020: You will offer your patronage to our people too, yes?
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_WYDAENC_000_021: Let's see... Perhaps you can begin with Marn Ose. They are one of our foremost artisans, once held in the highest esteem by the knights of Voeburt.
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_WYDAENC_000_022: With the knights gone, however, Marn Ose has had no opportunity to put their skills to use. They would be overjoyed for your patronage.
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_030: One thousand one hundred and eighty-two, one thousand one hundred and eighty-three, one thousand one hundred and eighty-four... Wait, did I already count that leaf?
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_031: Uwaaaaaah! Who─ What─ Where─ Wait, you're a...a mortal!? Huzzah! Huzzah!
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_032: Well met! Yes, very well met indeed! Have you old and tired arms and armor that are threatening to fall apart at critical junctures in battle?
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_033: If you answered yes, you've come to the right Nu Mou! I will restore your equipment to pristine condition for a payment of a pair of moss fungus legs!
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_034: Moss fungi roam just outside the cave. Please, please, please give their legs─and your patronage─to me!
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_040: Have you obtained the moss fungus legs? Bring them to me, and I will restore your equipment to pristine condition!
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_050: Ah, you are returned! And with the moss fungus legs, I hope?
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_051: They are tools of my trade, lest you wonder, used to polish metal and leather alike to a lustrous sheen. Now that I have work again, I must replenish my stores!
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_Q1_000_000: How many moss fungus legs will you give?
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_053: Grrr! No, no, NO! This wasn't the agreement!
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_054: You think my work cheap? Well then, you will have cheap! Oh yes, I'll make a fine mess of everything you're wearing! Rip it to shreds!
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_055: ...Hm? Wait, there are two legs here. <sigh> You mustn't tease us faeries so. In my agitation, I could've done much worse than simply snap at you.
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_056: You see, for there to be honor in a task, we must receive precisely what it is worth. Too little means you belittle our ability, too much means you question our integrity.
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_057: You've given me fitting payment, so my services are at your disposal. I shall begin by inspecting your equipment.
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_058: Huzzah! Two moss fungus legs as befits the work! Ahhh, to have neither more nor less expected of us than what we can provide─there is no greater joy!
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_059: You see, for there to be honor in a task, we must receive precisely what it is worth. Too little means you belittle our ability, too much means you question our integrity.
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_060: You've given me fitting payment, so my services are at your disposal. I shall begin by inspecting your equipment.
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_062: Grrr! No, no, NOOO! This wasn't the agreement!
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_063: You doubt that I'll fulfill the work for two moss fungus legs, so you tempt me with another? May as well call me a grasping mutt and spit in my eye!
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_064: Well, if you think me a bad Nu Mou, then a bad Nu Mou I will be! Oh yes, I'll make a fine mess of everything you're wearing! Rip it to shreds!
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_065: ...Hm? Wait, there are two legs here. <sigh> You mustn't tease us faeries so. In my agitation, I could've done much worse than simply snap at you.
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_066: You see, for there to be honor in a task, we must receive precisely what it is worth. Too little means you belittle our ability, too much means you question our integrity.
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_067: You've given me fitting payment, so my services are at your disposal. I shall begin by inspecting your equipment.
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_069: Though I must ask for a small fee for the materials, I'm pleased to say that all your arms and armor may be restored. If you mean to change them in the near future, however, there's no need to hurry.
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_070: My first repair is complimentary─here's the coin which you may pay me with when you desire to have work done. Many thanks for your patronage!
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_SYSTEM_000_071: Marn Ose's shop is open for business!
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_072: Oh, and if you mean to offer your patronage to another, may I suggest Ys Gyuf yonder?
TEXT_LUCKMB113_03314_MARNOSE_000_073: Judging from your equipment, 'tis plain you're no stranger to battle. I believe Ys Gyuf will have something to offer you!
TEXT_LUCKMB114_03315_YSGYUF_000_000: Ah, to have so many men visit us at once! This is a joyous day indeed!
TEXT_LUCKMB114_03315_YSGYUF_000_001: If it please you, please give me your patronage. As my patron, I ask that you remove the noxious mushrooms that grow in our cave. Flamespores, they're called.
TEXT_LUCKMB114_03315_YSGYUF_000_002: We would tend to them with magicks, except they leave behind a harmful ash. We've no choice but to pluck them one at a time.
TEXT_LUCKMB114_03315_YSGYUF_000_003: Now, you will be curious as to what I have to offer. I am a purveyor of wares that will aid you in your travels. In exchange for your fitting payment, I will give you my choicest items!
TEXT_LUCKMB114_03315_YSGYUF_000_010: Please let me know when you have removed all the flamespores. Scour every corner of the cave, leave no stone unturned!
TEXT_LUCKMB114_03315_YSGYUF_000_020: You've already removed the flamespores? How very quick you are!
TEXT_LUCKMB114_03315_YSGYUF_000_021: Oh, but did you perchance search by the western entrance as well? I'm told that more have cropped up in that area.
TEXT_LUCKMB114_03315_YSGYUF_000_030: I'm told more flamespores have cropped up by the western entrance. Please tend to them as well!
TEXT_LUCKMB114_03315_SYSTEM_000_040: As you pluck the last of the flamespores, you sense a gaze from the entrance.
TEXT_LUCKMB114_03315_RYNE_000_042: I-I wasn't spying on you or anything. I've just finished my task, and...
TEXT_LUCKMB114_03315_RYNE_000_043: I...I should go and report back.
TEXT_LUCKMB114_03315_YSGYUF_000_050: Ah, you are returned. Have you dealt with the flamespores by the western entrance as well?
TEXT_LUCKMB114_03315_YSGYUF_000_051: Excellent! No more poisonous spores irritating our noses, for a little while at least!
TEXT_LUCKMB114_03315_YSGYUF_000_052: Oh dear, I believe I'm getting sentimental. Having a patron again...it reminds me of the old days. Fair every day, I would carry my wares to the castle to offer in exchange for men's patronage.
TEXT_LUCKMB114_03315_YSGYUF_000_053: Back then the castle wasn't called Lyhe Ghiah. The Voeburtites built it, and they named it Gruenes Licht.
TEXT_LUCKMB114_03315_YSGYUF_000_054: It was their last bastion in the struggle against sin eaters. And now they're gone, all of them. Nobles and knights and commonfolk alike...
TEXT_LUCKMB114_03315_YSGYUF_000_055: But enough reminiscing─I must give you what you've earned!
TEXT_LUCKMB114_03315_YSGYUF_000_056: And if you desire anything else I possess, I would be glad to offer them to you─for a fitting price, of course!
TEXT_LUCKMB114_03315_SYSTEM_000_057: Ys Gyuf's shop is now open for business!
TEXT_LUCKMB114_03315_YSGYUF_000_058: Now, will you be offering your patronage to anyone else? If so, would you consider Wyd Lad?
TEXT_LUCKMB114_03315_YSGYUF_000_059: They've been under the weather of late, and the chance to perform an honorable task would cheer them up.
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_WYDLAD_000_000: What? You...you would be my patron!?
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_WYDLAD_000_001: But...I can't do anything for you. The lawless ones took my invisible ink, and without it I can't make my arcane wares.
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_WYDLAD_000_002: Who are the lawless ones? They're Nu Mou like us, except they've turned their backs on our values. Curs without honor, they are.
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_WYDLAD_000_003: They refuse to work, instead spending all their time cavorting and making a nuisance of themselves. It was when I was outside for a walk that they set upon me and robbed me of my possessions, the ink included.
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_WYDLAD_000_004: I was too weak to resist them...but you, mortal─you look quite strong. Do you think you could take my ink back from those villains?
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_WYDLAD_000_005: If you do this, I will consider it your patronage. And by way of my service, I will make you something very special!
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_RYNE_000_006: E-Excuse me, , but I couldn't help overhearing. If you mean to undertake this task, will you let me accompany you?
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_RYNE_000_007: I would learn from you...and help in what little way I can.
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_A1_000_002: Just don't get in the way.
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_RYNE_000_009: Thank you! I promise I won't be a burden!
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_WYDLAD_000_010: The lawless ones make their lair to the south, inside a cave called Father Collard's Chambers. They took many vials of ink, and I would be grateful if you could bring as many back as possible.
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_WYDLAD_000_020: The lawless ones make their lair to the south, inside a cave called Father Collard's Chambers. When they see you, they're like to attack on sight, so please take care!
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_RYNE_000_030: Father Collard's Chambers is through here. I peered inside, and sure enough, it was milling with Nu Mou. They looked none too friendly.
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_RYNE_000_031: If Thancred were here, he'd tell me to go about it quietly and quickly. Let us split up.
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_RYNE_000_032: I'll find all the ink I can and then come back outside. See you shortly, .
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_WYDAENC_000_040: Still offering your patronage to us? When you have a moment, I would speak with you all.
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_WYDLAD_000_050: M-M-Mercy, Your Majesty! We had no choice! Please forgive us!
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_WYDLAD_000_051: ...O-Oh, it's you. M-M-My ink─were you able to retrieve it?
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_WYDLAD_000_052: Haha! Yes, this is the ink, and almost all of it too!
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_WYDLAD_000_053: When our king spoke to me, my day went from bad to worse, but thanks to you it's simply bad again!
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_WYDLAD_000_054: What? You had the vision too? Oh, woe is us...
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_WYDLAD_000_055: Ordinarily, when a living being turns into a sin eater, it loses everything about its mind that defined it. However, the king has retained some of their instincts.
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_WYDLAD_000_056: This manifests in the desire to play and be free. So strong is that desire, it often leaks through the seal to invade our consciousness.
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_WYDLAD_000_057: For a long time we've ignored it, but we can't do so forever...
TEXT_LUCKMB115_03316_WYDLAD_000_058:
But forgive me, I was going to thank you for reuniting me with my ink. You did exactly as I asked, so I will give you the service I promised.
...Ahem! Nothing up my sleeve, and...voilà! May it serve you well!
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_WYDAENC_000_000: Still offering your patronage to us? When you have a moment, I would speak with you all.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_WYDLAD_000_010: Ahhh, there's nothing like honorable work. Thanks again for giving me the opportunity!
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_WYDLAD_000_011: Oh, I should mention that Elder Wyd Aenc returned a moment ago. If you seek them out, I daresay they'll have tidings for you.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_WYDLAD_000_020: Elder Wyd Aenc is at the inner cookfire. If you seek them out, I daresay they'll have tidings for you.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_WYDAENC_000_030: Ah, there you are. I'm informed that you've been an excellent patron to our people. For that, you have my thanks.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_WYDAENC_000_031: Now then, you will be pleased to hear that we've come to a decision regarding the scepter. If you would gather your companions, I will deliver our answer.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_WYDAENC_000_032: Before I begin, please allow me to express my gratitude for your kind patronage.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_WYDAENC_000_033: Having been deprived of purpose for so long, our people are overjoyed at being able to serve again.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_WYDAENC_000_034: But on to the matter of the stone scepter.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_WYDAENC_000_035: During our deliberations, we were forced to concede that we will never have the power to deal with our fallen monarch. We can release Titania neither from the castle nor from torment.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_WYDAENC_000_036: In light of this, we have decided to entrust their fate to you.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_WYDAENC_000_037: Take it─the stone scepter of the Nu Mou.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_THANCRED_000_038: This makes three relics. One more and we can arrange a meeting with the Warden.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_WYDAENC_000_039: Ere you continue your quest, allow me to enlighten you as regards your foe.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_WYDAENC_000_040: Know that Titania is not a name, but a title bestowed upon one chosen to lead the pixies by the grace of nature.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_WYDAENC_100_040: This leader, upon Il Mheg's founding, arose as ruler of all fae folk to bring order to our riotous kind. In our turn, we fae folk render our blessing unto nature─unto water, wood, and wind─that our king might be further empowered.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_WYDAENC_000_041: Though they are become a sin eater, their powers remain unchanged. When you face them, be prepared to face the full fury of nature.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_RYNE_000_042: Oh dear... Is there anything else that we should know?
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_WYDAENC_000_043: Anything else...? Hmmm... Only that if you feel unready for the challenge─and none here would blame you for it─you are welcome to remain among us awhile longer.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_WYDAENC_000_044: After all, I myself have yet to enjoy your patronage, and who knows when I will next have the chance? We would see that you were comfortable, of course, and do all in our power to make you feel...at home. Eh heh heh...
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_FEOUL_000_046: Honestly! I look away for one moment, and every faerie and their nuncle tries to steal my sapling from me!
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_FEOUL_000_047: This is my sapling! Mine, do you hear!? Not yours and not the Fuath's! And anyone who so much as thinks about trying to seduce  will wish they hadn't!
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_URIANGER_000_048: The final relic is a pair of shoes wrought of crystal. They are held in the amaro's safekeeping at their settlement, Wolekdorf.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_URIANGER_000_049: It beareth mentioning that these amaro are unlike those which thou hast heretofore encountered. Owing to a peculiarity of evolution, they are capable of speech, and thus we might negotiate with them as we have the fae folk.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_WYDAENC_000_050: Though it saddens us to see you leave, we wish you well on your way.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_WYDAENC_000_051: When you arrive in Wolekdorf, seek out the largest of the amaro. His name is Seto, and he is their leader and the bearer of the relic.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_WYDAENC_000_060: Oh, you're still here? Do you perhaps wish to remain with us after all...?
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_NIMBUS_000_065: Ghrrr... You seek our leader? Continue on past the aetheryte. You cannot miss him.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_TRAVELLER_000_070: Seto? He makes his roost in the next building.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_SETO_000_083: ...Oh. Forgive me, I was...having a dream. Seldom do men visit us. What brings you to our village?
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_SETO_000_084: Did I hear you aright? You desire the crystal shoes...that you may confront the Lightwarden?
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_SETO_000_085: No. No, you mustn't think such thoughts.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_SETO_000_086: Even if you are indeed immune to the Light's corruption, as you claim, vanquishing the king will bring you naught but sorrow.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_SETO_000_087: Forget this folly. Return whence you came.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_THANCRED_000_088: While we appreciate your concern, we have no choice in the matter. Will you not reconsider?
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_URIANGER_000_090: Come, my friends, let us leave him with his thoughts.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_URIANGER_000_091: Hmmm... 'Tis harder by far to change the minds of they who mean well than they who mean ill.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_RYNE_000_092: Forgive me...but I'm not sure I understand...
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_URIANGER_000_093: And little wonder. 'Tis the first time thou hast set foot here. 'Twould behoove you all to learn something of the nature of this community, I think, and there is no surer way than to speak with its members.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_URIANGER_000_094: In such wise, you will come to understand Seto's reason for refusing us─and, I hope, gain an insight into how he may yet be persuaded...
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_URIANGER_000_095: So I bid ye seek out the amaro and make yourselves known unto them. A gentle touch shall suffice by way of a greeting.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_THANCRED_000_100: Despite their seclusion, the amaro here appear to be quite familiar with men.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_RYNE_000_105: They're so fluffy, it's like touching a cloud!
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_URIANGER_000_110: Go, my friend─make thyself known unto the amaro. It requireth no more than a gentle touch.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_SETO_000_115: I cannot give you the crystal shoes. Abandon this folly.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_RISPA_000_120: Well now... It is not often that we are visited by men─much less unglamoured ones. What brings you so far from your own kind?
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_RISPA_000_122: Khrrr...khrrrrrr... Ah, how long has it been since last I felt man's touch? I cannot help but be reminded of my master's hand...
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_RISPA_000_123: He was a knight of Voeburt. A noble and valiant soul.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_RISPA_000_124: But like so many others, he died fighting the sin eaters. Though he is long departed, I remain in this land out of respect for his memory.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_RISPA_000_130: Such a fine feeling it is to be petted. My master had a heavy hand, made heavier still by his gauntlet, but I loved it nonetheless.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_EOAN_000_0140: Are you one of those treasure hunters? There is nothing left for you here.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_EOAN_000_141: What are you doing? I do not understand...
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_EOAN_000_142: Agh! Th-That tickles! Enough! I never had a master─I'm not accustomed to it!
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_EOAN_000_143: Not that I dislike your kind, you understand. On the contrary, we amaro were bred to be fond of men.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_EOAN_000_144: In the beginning, we were all of us mindless beasts. But then a mage of Ronka gave us the gift of intelligence, that we might better serve our masters.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_EOAN_000_145: After that empire fell, those with the gift eventually died out. On rare occasions, however, we are born with the seed of our ancestors in us.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_EOAN_000_146: If we live long enough amongst men, this seed may quicken, restoring the power of speech to us amongst other things. So it was with me...though I never had a master, as I told you.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_EOAN_000_150: But I will not bore you with my sorry tale. Let it suffice to say that I am no stranger to abandonment.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_NIMBUS_000_160: What is all the commotion? Did something happen while we slumbered?
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_NIMBUS_000_162: Ghrrr!? What's happening!? Why am I being patted!? It's...it's wonderful...
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_NIMBUS_000_163: Seldom do we have the chance to enjoy the attentions of men. Your kind are loath to come here for fear of the fae folk.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_NIMBUS_000_164: ...But then we are fae folk too. When first we made our home here, we swore an oath to the faerie king, you see. 'Tis easy to forget sometimes.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_NIMBUS_000_170: Ghrrr... You may pat me whenever you wish, and for as long as you like. My plumage is very resilient!
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_URIANGER_000_180: Thou hast peered into the hearts of the amaro, I take it?
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_URIANGER_000_181: Then thou canst not choose but see the intense and abiding love they bear for men. It is out of concern for our welfare, and not scorn, that Seto seeketh to dissuade us from confronting their king.
TEXT_LUCKMB116_03317_URIANGER_000_182: Yet confront their king we must, and to that end we must needs have the crystal shoes...
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_THANCRED_000_000: I see now what Urianger meant. Our feathered friend is plainly concerned for our safety. We need to show him that we can look after ourselves.
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_RYNE_000_005: It's nice of them to worry about us...but we really need those shoes.
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_URIANGER_000_010: ─might I prevail upon thee to confer with Seto in private?
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_URIANGER_000_011: The task of slaying the Lightwarden will ultimately be thine, and it is for thee, I believe, that he worrieth most.
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_URIANGER_000_012: Tell him of thy many great deeds. Spoken in earnest, thy words may yet move him to change his mind.
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_URIANGER_000_020: Prithee do as I bade and speak with Seto in private. I shall turn my thoughts towards other solutions meanwhile.
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_SETO_000_030: You have spoken with my brethren.
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_SETO_000_031: Then you see it is not out of scorn that I deny you the relic...
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_SETO_000_032: I simply cannot bear to see men fight and die. Not anymore. None of us can. To lose one who has placed a gentle hand on us even once fills our hearts with untold sorrow, as my brothers and sisters will readily attest.
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_A1_000_001: This is something I must do.
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_SETO_000_033: <sigh> What am I to make of such declarations?
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_SETO_000_034: Tell me, why do you wish this?
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_SETO_000_035: This land is no longer man's to fight for, nor will your doing so compel the fae folk to change. And in order to obtain the other relics, you will already have paid the due price. Naught more is owed.
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_SETO_000_036: Why then would you risk all to face our fallen king?
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_A2_000_002: To keep a promise to my friends.
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_A2_000_003: To do what no one else can.
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_SETO_000_038: The very words... Could it be mere coincidence?
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_SETO_000_039: Very well. You may believe what you say, but we shall see if you have the strength to do it.
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_SETO_000_040: Sin eaters have been prowling the area of late. Prove yourself against them, and I will consider giving you the relic.
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_SETO_000_041: See that you are well prepared, then meet me in the clearing to the east.
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_SETO_000_042: There, I will lure out the fiends, that you may slay them.
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_URIANGER_000_050: Whatever Seto hath in store for thee, I wish thee godsspeed.
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_SETO_000_060: I will use my voice to lure out the sin eaters, as I once did when I hunted with an old friend.
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_SETO_000_061: A feeble cry for the ravenous; a mighty roar for the territorial... I still remember the tricks.
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_SETO_000_062: But come. We begin at your signal.
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_SETO_000_080: You made short work of those creatures, I will not deny it...
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_SETO_000_081: I have seen enough. Let us return to Wolekdorf.
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_THANCRED_000_090: Urianger tells me you've been busy trying to win Seto over, and I agree that you're the best  for the job. A silver tongue can only get one so far.
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_RYNE_000_095: I heard a fearsome roar... Is everything all right?
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_SETO_000_100: By the ease with which you slew those sin eaters, I see that you are capable.
TEXT_LUCKMB117_03318_SETO_000_101: However, I still require time to think. And if you should be willing, there is a favor I would ask of you.
TEXT_LUCKMB118_03319_THANCRED_000_000: Urianger tells me you've been busy trying to win Seto over, and I agree that you're the best  for the job. A silver tongue can only get one so far.
TEXT_LUCKMB118_03319_RYNE_000_005: I heard a fearsome roar... Is everything all right?
TEXT_LUCKMB118_03319_URIANGER_000_010: Whatever Seto hath in store for thee, I wish thee godsspeed.
TEXT_LUCKMB118_03319_SETO_000_020: This is not a test of your strength, but a personal request. Please hear my tale.
TEXT_LUCKMB118_03319_SETO_000_021: A while ago, I fought sin eaters who had wandered into Il Mheg. In the heat of battle, I dropped a prized possession─a medallion. Of all the places that it should fall, it was Longmirror Lake.
TEXT_LUCKMB118_03319_SETO_000_022: We amaro are not fond of water─we certainly cannot dive very deep. I briefly entertained the thought of turning to the Fuath, but they are more likely to keep my medallion out of mischief than return it to me.
TEXT_LUCKMB118_03319_SETO_000_023: I had despaired of retrieving my treasure, but having seen what you are capable of, perhaps you will be able to find it.
TEXT_LUCKMB118_03319_SETO_000_024: While I ponder your request for the shoes, will you not go and search for my medallion? If it should elude even you, I will accept that it is gone forever.
TEXT_LUCKMB118_03319_SETO_000_030: As I recall, I was above the waters west of the castle when I dropped the medallion. I wish you luck.
TEXT_LUCKMB118_03319_SYSTEM_000_040: This does not appear to be Seto's medallion.
TEXT_LUCKMB119_03320_SETO_000_000: Forgive me, it seems my indecision has cost you precious time.
TEXT_LUCKMB119_03320_SETO_000_001: But I am convinced now. Convinced that you will triumph.
TEXT_LUCKMB119_03320_SETO_000_002: To the south you will find the bridge to Lyhe Ghiah. As the bearer of the four relics, the gate to the castle will open to you.
TEXT_LUCKMB119_03320_SETO_000_010: I could not say these words to Ardbert, but I say them now to you: go safely.
TEXT_LUCKMB119_03320_FEOUL_000_020: The gate has recognized that you bear all four relics. The seal is broken.
TEXT_LUCKMB119_03320_FEOUL_000_021: All that remains is to enter the castle and confront Titania─a being bereft of reason and mercy.
TEXT_LUCKMB119_03320_FEOUL_000_022: It is sure to be a ferocious battle. But if anyone can bring an end to our king's torment, it is you.
TEXT_LUCKMB119_03320_FEOUL_000_023: Yet know this, my adorable sapling: though we fae folk may appear to live unfettered lives, there are still laws that bind us.
TEXT_LUCKMB119_03320_FEOUL_000_024: To take back as much as is taken. To create as much as is destroyed. To give as much as is received.
TEXT_LUCKMB119_03320_FEOUL_000_025: In all things, balance must be preserved...and the same will be asked of you.
TEXT_LUCKMB119_03320_FEOUL_000_026: But worry not. Come what may, your beautiful branch will ever be at your side.
TEXT_LUCKMB119_03320_ALPHINAUD_000_030: It was pure luck that we managed to hold the Eulmorans at bay long enough for you to succeed─but we have earned some good fortune. And while it is plain we've not seen the last of General Ran'jit, I for one am glad to delay our reckoning with him awhile longer.
TEXT_LUCKMB119_03320_ALISAIE_000_035: It seems I was wrong about your friend. Had Feo Ul not stepped in, you'd be frolicking with the faeries by now.
TEXT_LUCKMB119_03320_THANCRED_000_040: Well done, my friend. You put me to shame, laying low a Lightwarden while I struggle to land a blow on a man old enough to be my great-grandsire.
TEXT_LUCKMB119_03320_RYNE_000_045: I'm going to train harder. Having seen what you've achieved, it's the least I can do.
TEXT_LUCKMB119_03320_SULUIN_000_046: Madbloom or no, we have a new Titania! The king is returned! All hail the king!
TEXT_LUCKMB119_03320_YSIALA_000_047: If you ever see that wrinkly old man again, pay him back for me ten─nay, a thousandfold!
TEXT_LUCKMB119_03320_OULSIGUN_000_048: Did you see the looks on their faces as they ran? Ohhh, it was delicious!
TEXT_LUCKMB119_03320_URIANGER_000_050: Ne'er for a moment did I doubt that thou wouldst triumph over thy foe─yet the majesty of thine achievement delighteth me nonetheless!
TEXT_LUCKMB119_03320_URIANGER_000_051: Night hath returned to Il Mheg, and we stand one step closer to delivering the First from its doom, and averting the Eighth Umbral Calamity.
TEXT_LUCKMB119_03320_URIANGER_000_052: 'Tis but a pity thou wert not present to see the fae folk put the Eulmorans to flight. 'Twas a sight to raise the spirits, I do assure thee!
TEXT_LUCKMB119_03320_URIANGER_000_053: Ah, but what valuable allies they might prove...were the mood only to take them.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_ALPHINAUD_000_000: It was pure luck that we managed to hold the Eulmorans at bay long enough for you to succeed─but we have earned some good fortune. And while it is plain we've not seen the last of General Ran'jit, I for one am glad to delay our reckoning with him awhile longer.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_ALISAIE_000_005: It seems I was wrong about your friend. Had Feo Ul not stepped in, you'd be frolicking with the faeries by now.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_RYNE_000_010: I'm going to train harder. Having seen what you've achieved, it's the least I can do.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_URIANGER_000_015: Though the battle is over, the war is far from won. Let us fix our gaze upon the road ahead.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_THANCRED_000_020: I knew you could do it. And not only because of your blessing. You have a strength all your own, and it has seen us through many a trial.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_THANCRED_000_021: With the Warden defeated, I believe our work here is done. It is time we were going─together, needless to say.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_THANCRED_000_022: ...To the bitter end─the fate of our two worlds being at stake, and all that.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_THANCRED_000_023: Now then, I suggest we hurry back to the Crystarium. Much and more may have happened while we were frolicking with the fae folk.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_THANCRED_000_024: That Ran'jit elected to pursue us makes me hopeful the city was spared Eulmore's attentions, but I would sooner see for myself.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_THANCRED_000_025: Besides, I believe I speak for us all when I say that I've had a bellyful of Il Mheg. Let us away before the faeries think to play with us again.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_ALPHINAUD_000_030: I see nothing out of the ordinary.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_THANCRED_000_035: Though we've spent most of our time on the road, Minfilia and I actually have apartments here. Perhaps now we may finally make use of them.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_URIANGER_000_045: The city appeareth unchanged from when last I visited. There is the selfsame comforting hum of activity in the air.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_MYSTERYVOICE_000_04: ? I...I was not expecting you so soon.
Glad though I am to see you, I daresay you are missed by your comrades. Mayhap you should rejoin them first.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Finding common ground with an Ascian... My entire being rebels at the very notion.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_THANCRED_000_055: He appears to be gone, but I won't be lowering my guard just yet.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_RYNE_000_060: So that was an Ascian... Thancred told me about them.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_URIANGER_000_065: That an Ascian of Emet-Selch's standing should willingly reveal himself unto us─and at this of all junctures─is...most interesting.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_ALISAIE_000_070: Cooperation? He can't be serious...can he?
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_ALISAIE_000_071: Well, we've certainly been given much to ponder, but first things first: we should report to the Exarch.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_ALISAIE_000_072: You can run along, . We're perfectly capable of handling this little task.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_ALISAIE_000_073: In light of your recent exertions, I'd say you've earned a rest.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_ALISAIE_000_074: Go on, take yourself off to bed. We'll see you later, refreshed and ready for more.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_MYSTERYVOICE_000_07: That your safe and triumphant return should be spoiled by an uninvited guest...
But let us not dwell on it here and now. I will have the details of your mission from the others. You, meanwhile, should get some rest.
TEXT_LUCKMB120_03321_GUIDEOFTHEPENDANTS_: Ah, welcome back, . We've been expecting you.
You will find refreshments laid out in your quarters. We hope they are to your liking.
Very good, . I bid you a pleasant evening.
TEXT_LUCKMC101_03322_GUIDEOFTHEPENDANTS_: to you, . I do hope you are well rested.
The Exarch and your companions are presently gathered in the Ocular. He asks that you convene with them at your earliest convenience.
TEXT_LUCKMC101_03322_ALPHINAUD_000_010: I confess, a great deal of my time in Kholusia was spent befriending the people, but that is not to say I gave no thought to our primary goal.
TEXT_LUCKMC101_03322_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Once I have escorted the Exarch to Eulmore, you can be certain I will do all I can to discern the whereabouts of any Warden that may be hiding in Kholusia.
TEXT_LUCKMC101_03322_ALISAIE_000_015: There are so many ruins scattered throughout Amh Araeng... I'm honestly not even sure where to start.
TEXT_LUCKMC101_03322_THANCRED_000_020: Minfilia and I are no strangers to Rak'tika, but this is perhaps the first time we've bothered entering through the proverbial front door.
TEXT_LUCKMC101_03322_RYNE_000_025: At last I can finally meet Y'shtola. Thancred has told me so much about her.
TEXT_LUCKMC101_03322_URIANGER_000_030: I should be glad to apprise thee of Y'shtola's recent endeavors during our journey to Rak'tika.
TEXT_LUCKMC101_03322_MYSTERYVOICE_000_04: Before you leave, I would make a request of you.
There is a church─or rather, the ruins of a church─at Fort Jobb. Might I ask that you go there before seeking out Y'shtola?
It was a place where people once gathered to worship the Light. Alas, it has long since fallen into disuse.
Yet within that hall there remains a tablet whose writings I believe may prove of use to Y'shtola. At the very least, such a relic would make a suitable gift for your reunion.
TEXT_LUCKMC101_03322_URIANGER_000_044: A most considerate proposal. Very well. Ere we depart to Rak'tika, we shall journey unto Fort Jobb that we might secure this relic.
TEXT_LUCKMC101_03322_MYSTERYVOICE_000_05: Safe travels, . I pray that tablet and its contents prove of interest to Y'shtola.
TEXT_LUCKMC101_03322_THANCRED_000_055: I do not doubt this place may weather another assault by the sin eaters, but they cannot hope to hold it should the Eulmoran soldiers return.
TEXT_LUCKMC101_03322_THANCRED_000_056: Even with their limited numbers, the guard can use the terrain to their advantage. Perhaps I can convince the captain to lay a few traps out in the field.
TEXT_LUCKMC101_03322_RYNE_000_060: Thancred and I have come across these ruined churches before. I wish I could've seen them before the Flood. The windows were works of art, I'm told...
TEXT_LUCKMC101_03322_URIANGER_000_070: Here amidst these ruins we will find the Church of the First Light, and within that hallowed hall the tablet we seek.
TEXT_LUCKMC101_03322_URIANGER_000_071: Time is of the essence, my friend. Let us be quick.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_THANCRED_000_000: I do not doubt this place could weather another assault by the sin eaters, but if the Eulmorans return in force, it will be quite another matter.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_THANCRED_000_001: That said, the guard could perhaps use the terrain to their advantage... Hm. I will see if I can convince the captain to lay a few traps out in the field.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_RYNE_000_005: Thancred and I have come across these ruined churches before. I wish I could've seen them before the Flood. The windows were works of art, I'm told...
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_URIANGER_000_010: At the height of Lakeland's prosperity, these sites served not as man's final bastion, but as testament to his ingenuity and architectural prowess.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_URIANGER_000_011: The Church of the First Light was responsible for many such marvels, building majestic chapels in every corner of the realm.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_URIANGER_100_011: Alas, the Flood with its inexorable tides would drown nigh every one, and did all but put an end to the religion as a whole. For the creatures which then did rise from that fulgent deluge were seen as agents of divine punishment, sent to devour sin and sinner both─whence came the name of “sin eater.”
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_URIANGER_110_011: The people were lost, seemingly forsaken by their god.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_URIANGER_000_012: Yet where there is light, there hath ever been shade, and 'twas in the dark they sought solace.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_URIANGER_000_013: The most devout of these worshipers of shadow did then migrate to the Rak'tika Greatwood. But that is a tale for another time.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_URIANGER_000_014: For now, let us find what remaineth of the chapel here.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_THANCRED_000_020: Despite their architectural prowess, I can make neither head nor tail of anything in this place. You would think the remnants of a church would be more conspicuous.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_RYNE_000_025: I've seen no sign of the church, but it must be around here somewhere...
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_URIANGER_000_030: 'Twould be most unusual, but...mayhap the hall was built below ground.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_URIANGER_000_040: ...Aye. This is indeed the church we seek.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_RYNE_000_042: What little is left of the churches I've seen until now has always borne the scars of decades of disuse.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_URIANGER_000_043: Its subterranean construction hath done much to protect the hall from the ravages of time. Yet the reason for its remarkable preservation may be deduced from its decoration.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_URIANGER_000_044: As faith in the Light did wane, so rose reverence for the Dark.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_URIANGER_000_045: ...And its followers did want for places of worship. To be plain, the standards which do adorn these walls belong not to those who built them, but to worshipers of the Dark─the Night's Blessed.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_URIANGER_000_047: Indeed. 'Twas beneath the shaded boughs of the Rak'tika Greatwood that they finally found sanctuary.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_URIANGER_000_048: Oft and many times did Eulmore make spurious overtures of friendship unto them, but they are no fools.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_URIANGER_000_049: The Exarch knoweth full well that Y'shtola, in her seclusion, doth labor to learn all she may of the Blessed and their past. 'Tis why he sent us here, I now see.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_URIANGER_000_050: The tablet of which he spoke no doubt provideth a glimpse into the history that she so yearneth to comprehend.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_THANCRED_000_051: Well then─we'd better hurry up and find it.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_THANCRED_000_060: Can anyone tell me what this infernal tablet even looks like?
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_RYNE_000_065: I can barely see my hand in front of my face. If only that torch were a little closer...
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_URIANGER_000_070: Were the tablet a fragment of holy scripture, 'twould most assuredly rest here on this altar. Yet this would, I presume, also have been where the Blessed placed the Font of Seeing used in the practice of their faith... Whither, then, would they have set the tablet?
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_SYSTEM_000_080: Search your surroundings for the tablet. You may move the camera as well as zoom in and out. Target an area and inspect it with .
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_THANCRED_000_090: I certainly hope this is what we were looking for.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_RYNE_000_095: How were you able to see it in the dark? And inside the altar of all places...
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_URIANGER_000_100: Naught escapeth thine eye, 'twould seem. This is indeed the tablet we seek.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_URIANGER_000_101: Curious... These engravings predate the Night's Blessed. If I am not mistaken, they are writ in the script of the ancient empire of Ronka, whose capital once stood in the midst of what is now Rak'tika.
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_URIANGER_000_102: 'Twill be no small matter to decipher them... Hm! A fine gift for our seeker of truth. 'Tis plain the Exarch understandeth Y'shtola only too well...
TEXT_LUCKMC102_03323_URIANGER_000_103: But come─let us quit this place and make ready for our journey into the woods.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_THANCRED_000_000: Should we not be going? We have a gift to deliver.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_RYNE_000_005: Thancred mentioned Y'shtola's passion for learning. I expect the tablet is...just the sort of thing she'd like?
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_URIANGER_000_010: Ere we depart, there is a custom of the Night's Blessed which I feel compelled to elucidate.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_URIANGER_000_011: As one might expect, they deem Light to be abhorrent, and everything it touches befouled. Thus do they take the utmost pains to protect all they can from its taint─including their very names.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_URIANGER_000_012: To speak plain, it is the belief of the Blessed that one's own name must ne'er be uttered in the light of the everlasting day. Yet this commandment precludeth not the use of another's. Thus do parents protect their children, and, in rare cases, masters their disciples.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_URIANGER_000_013: So it is that Y'shtola hath taken the name of Master Matoya. Lest we offend them, I bid you speak not her true name in the Blessed's presence.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_URIANGER_000_014: With that in mind, let us speak with the guard who keepeth vigil at the Greatwood's border.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_THANCRED_000_020: It will be good to see Y'shtola again.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_RYNE_000_025: I know I have no reason to, but I can't help feeling nervous about meeting Y'shtola.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_URIANGER_000_030: I pray thee heed mine explanation of the Blessed's customs. 'Twould be ill-advised to provoke their ire.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_MYRCANT_000_040: Well met, traveler. What business brings you here?
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_MYRCANT_000_041: Yes, of course! Right this way.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_MYRCANT_000_050: You need but say the word and I will open the gate.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_THANCRED_000_065: <sigh> If he never opened his mouth again, it would be too soon.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_RYNE_000_070: Thancred has told me of the Ascians and what they have done. If he isn't willing to help, is it wise to let him stay with us?
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_EMETSELCH_000_075: What is it now? Do you expect me to regale you with friendly banter?
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_EMETSELCH_000_076: ...Oh, very well. I will humor you this once. You may consider it my latest act of good faith. Come on, then. What do you wish to know?
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_A2_000_001: Why choose this form here in the First?
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_EMETSELCH_000_077: Well, well, what a curious question.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_EMETSELCH_000_078: Mortal flesh is but the vessel into which we Ascians pour the elixir of our souls, molding it as fits the occasion. Or not, if we so choose.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_EMETSELCH_000_079: Be it for a year or a millennium, I prefer to retain the same form until my duty is done. So, after arriving here in the First, I fashioned some hapless body into the man you see before you.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_EMETSELCH_000_080: Though as your friend over there can attest, there are those of us who forgo such alterations.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_EMETSELCH_000_081: He was ever the rash one, Lahabrea. Jumping from vessel to vessel. Never heeding the toll it took on him.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_EMETSELCH_000_082: If you've nothing to ask me, why are you still here? Don't you have Wardens to vanquish? A realm to save?
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_URIANGER_000_090: 'Tis plain our Ascian counterpart meaneth to follow wheresoever we lead. Were it otherwise, he would not suffer the overabundance of light in these woods.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_URIANGER_000_091: Verily, it pervadeth every corner... And so long as the Lightwarden remaineth, the sin eaters shall be free to prey upon these lands without surcease. If naught is done, 'tis but a matter of time before the Blessed succumb.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_URIANGER_000_092: Two years past, a swarm of sin eaters did lay waste unto their largest settlement, killing a great many of their priests in so doing.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_URIANGER_000_093: Though some few did survive, they knew not how to go on. Wayward souls in want of a guiding hand. For a mercy, Y'shtola hath provided that which they sorely needed.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_URIANGER_000_094: They have since endeavored to restore their home, and thither shall we bend our steps─to Fort Gohn.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_THANCRED_000_100: We both know how Urianger enjoys painting pictures with his words, but he did not exaggerate about this place.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_RYNE_000_105: Urianger said they were rebuilding, but...there's no one here.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_EMETSELCH_000_115: Well? Where is this friend of yours we've come to meet?
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_THANCRED_000_120: That ended a lot better than it might have. No thanks to Emet-Selch...
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_RYNE_000_125: I didn't expect her to be so...imposing in person.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_URIANGER_000_130: That she should imagine  a stranger...
