TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_YSHTOLA_000_140: You have been busy since arriving in the First, I gather. But I would hear the tale of your travails in more suitable surroundings.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_YSHTOLA_000_141: With Fort Gohn yet to be rebuilt, the Night's Blessed have made their home in a settlement to the northeast. I will await you at its entrance. Follow the path through yonder gate and you will find me soon enough.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_YSHTOLA_000_150: There you are. I was beginning to worry. Much like the Twelveswood, this forest has a way of dealing with those who stray too far from the beaten path.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_YSHTOLA_000_151: But I digress. Let me show you the home of the Night's Blessed.
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_RYNE_000_165: Have you ever seen such a tree? To think these are only the roots!
TEXT_LUCKMC103_03324_URIANGER_000_170: To make their home here, and so swiftly, would surely have required no small amount of ingenuity. A most impressive feat, wouldst thou not agree?
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_YSHTOLA_000_010: I am not indifferent to Thancred's troubles. Nevertheless, I will not apologize for holding him to a higher standard after all these years. He has ever been a man of considerable resolve, and that is what I will continue to expect.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_YSHTOLA_000_011: Though it heartens me to know that some of us remain ourselves in spite of our present circumstances.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_YSHTOLA_000_012: I can but imagine how Alisaie and Alphinaud have changed since arriving here in the First.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_A1_000_001: Change is part of life. We can but hope it's change for the better.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_A1_000_002: Perhaps you should be concerned with how you have changed.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_YSHTOLA_000_013: <sigh> You're right. And after my untoward remarks to Thancred, no doubt he thinks I changed for the worst. I will have to speak with him later.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_YSHTOLA_000_014: I realize I am not as I was on the Source, but I cannot say I regret the decisions that allowed me to come this far.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_YSHTOLA_000_015: Ahem. Returning to the matter at hand─I really must begin work on deciphering this tablet. In the meantime, perhaps you should take a look about Slitherbough.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_YSHTOLA_000_016: If there is anything you need, pray speak with Runar at the plaza.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_YSHTOLA_000_020: I have instructed Runar to help you with anything you should require.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_030: Welcome, friend. Welcome! My apologies for our less-than-hospitable greeting earlier.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_031: Tell me, what is your name? From where do you hail?
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_032: From the Crystarium! I see. And this tablet you've brought may help us find the Lightwarden here in Rak'tika?
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_033: Well, you are welcome to stay with us for as long as you need. Come, let me show you around.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RYNE_000_034: Would it be all right if I joined you?
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_035: Of course, of course. Anything for the guests of our dear Master Matoya.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RYNE_000_036: Thank you. She means a great deal to the Night's Blessed, doesn't she?
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_037: If not for her, we may have all perished in the great fire.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_038: With our priests slain and our home in ruins, we were at the mercy of the sin eaters.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_039: It was she who drove them back. And with her sage guidance, we were able to rebuild.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_040: Before long she became a central figure in our community─a great oak within whose shadow many have come to find solace.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_041: That is not to say there were not those hesitant to grant an outsider such authority, myself included.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_042: Perhaps it is the smile in her eyes when she speaks of the sunless sea. I feel...whole again, now that she is with us, and I have no doubt the others feel the same.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_043: She is as much a part of the Night's Blessed as any of us, and we are grateful for all she does in service to the Dark.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_044: But you did not hear this from me, yes?
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_045: Now, you should know there are certain customs we ask guests to adhere to so long as they reside within Slitherbough.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RYNE_000_046: To show reverence to the Dark?
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_047: In a word, yes. But fear not, it is not too involved.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_048: Let us begin with something simple. Follow me.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RYNE_000_050: I thought Master Matoya kept her room dark because she didn't need the light, but they're all like hers, aren't they...
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_060: Should you see any of our people come to this chamber, they have likely returned from a journey beyond the borders of Rak'tika.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_061: We use the water stored here to cleanse ourselves of the Light's impurity.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_062: A simple and perhaps peculiar custom, but it is one of our most important.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_063: Would you two kneel for just a moment, that I might rid you of the Light's impurity?
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RYNE_000_070: We mustn't be rude to our hosts.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_075: Please, this will only take a moment.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_076: This will only take a moment, I promise.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_SYSTEM_000_080: As Runar lightly sprays you with water, your skin begins to tingle.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_081: And with that, you have been cleansed of the Light's blighted touch. How do you feel?
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RYNE_000_082: I'm not sure, to be honest. Not refreshed, exactly, but I do feel different.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RYNE_000_083: Has this water been treated in some way?
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_084: Only blessed by our priests. They are practiced in the arcane arts. As such, it is said their prayers imbue the water with a faint dark energy.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_085: A prickling sensation? No one has ever spoken of such a reaction before.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RYNE_000_086: I wouldn't say it was an unpleasant sensation, but I too felt something strange.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_087: Hmmm. The dark aspect of this water should have no discernible effect. Unless...
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_088: By the gods! Master Matoya was right─you are sin eaters!
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_089: I jest, I jest. What you felt was likely no more than the chill of the water.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_090: Perhaps now would be a good time for you to acquaint yourselves with the people of Slitherbough.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_091: For that, I must teach you a customary greeting.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_092: Allin tuta. In the language of Ronka, it is one of several ways one might say “good evening.”
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_093: The world is not as safe as it once was, and this greeting lets us quickly discern friend from foe.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RYNE_000_094: Is there a handshake or gesture we should know too? I would hate to offend anyone.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_095: You need not worry. Merely speak the words “allin tuta,” and they will know you as friends of the Blessed.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_096: I will await your return here. Now go. They are like to be heartened by your knowledge of our ways.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_SYSTEM_000_097: With the chat mode in Say, enter “allin tuta” to greet the villagers of Slitherbough.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_100: No need to be shy, my friend. The Blessed are a warm and welcoming people.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_VONDIA_000_125: Ah, a newly come traveler. Allin chi'si, and welcome to Slitherbough.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_VONDIA_000_126: You must forgive us if we seem strangely reserved. We are a quiet and taciturn people.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_VONDIA_000_127: Silent and serene as the sunless sea. The quiet makes it easy to discern the presence of eaters and other dangers here in the woods.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_VONDIA_000_128: Tread lightly friend, and may the shadows keep you.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_ASGEIR_000_130: Allin chi'si. Welcome, friend. I take it you will remain in these woods for some time, yes?
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_ASGEIR_000_131: Be wary of these woods, you will find poison in near everything you see. But fear not─our medicinal tea will keep you healthy. Ask and it is yours.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_ASGEIR_000_132: You are more than welcome to our medicines, friend. You need only ask.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RUNAR_000_140: I hope your stroll about Slitherbough proved enlightening.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RYNE_000_150: Everyone was so kind and gracious...
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RYNE_000_151: I was nervous at first, but already I'm starting to feel at home.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RYNE_000_152: There is still much I have to learn about the Night's Blessed, but their faith and strength of will is nothing short of inspiring.
TEXT_LUCKMC104_03325_RYNE_000_153: I can see now how they've built such a thriving community...
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RYNE_000_000: I can see now how they've come to thrive in these woods, even with all the sin eaters.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RUNAR_000_010: Ah, you are returned. Very good.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RUNAR_000_011: No doubt they were glad of your company. It has been too long since we have had visitors.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RUNAR_000_012: Remember: if you have any questions, or there is anything you need, do not hesitate to ask.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RUNAR_000_013: Speaking of which, we must arrange food and lodgings for your stay.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RUNAR_000_014: As friends of Master Matoya, we cannot ask for payment, but if you would be willing to lend a hand...?
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RUNAR_000_015: We are fortunate indeed to play host to such generous souls. The task I have in mind is simple enough.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RUNAR_000_016: Come now, it is but a single task. As reward, I will give you an extra helping of my famous stew at dinner!
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RUNAR_000_017: All I ask is that you take a jug and water the crops in the square.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RUNAR_000_019: Of course! One of you can do the filling, and the other the watering.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RUNAR_000_020: Speak with Ersabel when you have finished. She will be relieved to hear the crops have been tended to.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RUNAR_000_021: While you take care of that, I will see to your room and a warm meal.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RYNE_000_022: Right, then. I'll fill, you water!
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RYNE_000_030: This was the only jug I could find which was small enough to lift, but I'm afraid there's a crack in the bottom.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RYNE_000_031: You'll need to hurry to the garden before all the water leaks out.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_SYSTEM_000_032: Take the jug of water to the square before the contents leak out.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_SYSTEM_000_033: You will have forty-five seconds to complete the task. Should you fail, return to Minfilia and try again.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RYNE_000_040: Oh no, did all the water leak out? Here, let me refill it for you.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_SYSTEM_000_050: You have watered half of the plot. Fetch another jug of water to take care of the rest.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_SYSTEM_000_051: You have no water for the crops. Speak with Minfilia to receive a fresh jug.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RYNE_000_060: Was there enough water for the plot?
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RYNE_000_061: Only half? I see. Well, let me refill the jug for you.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_SYSTEM_000_062: Take another jug of water to the square before the contents leak out.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_SYSTEM_000_063: You will have thirty seconds to complete the task. Should you fail, return to Minfilia and try again.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_SYSTEM_000_070: The whole plot has now been thoroughly watered.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RYNE_000_080: All done? Then we just need to speak to...Ersabel, was it?
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_ERSABEL_000_090: Well met, travelers. I observed you earlier speaking with the others. Have you need of something?
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_ERSABEL_000_091: You watered the crops? Ah, my apologies for not noticing sooner. I have been...rather distracted of late.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_ERSABEL_000_092: Watering the crops was always Toddia's duty, but she...she is no longer with us.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_ERSABEL_000_093: We have since taken to sharing the duty─though never with guests... You are most kind.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RYNE_000_094: Is there anything else we can do to help? We could plant something if you like.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_ERSABEL_000_095: There is no need. The plot is small, it is true, but it provides us with enough to survive. We ask for no more.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RYNE_000_096: I don't know how you manage...
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RYNE_000_097: Have the Blessed not considered leaving? Life would surely be easier almost anywhere else.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_ERSABEL_000_098: I can understand why you might say that, but the easiest path is not always the right one.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_ERSABEL_000_099: Tell me, do you know our history? How our faith came to be?
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RYNE_000_100: Ah, er...yes, I believe so. The Night's Blessed was initially formed by those who lost their homes in the wake of the Flood.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RYNE_000_101: What began as an occasional gathering of survivors eventually grew into a community, which ultimately decided to strike out on its own in the Rak'tika Greatwood.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_ERSABEL_000_102: I see you have read your history.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_ERSABEL_000_103: But there is a history that is told, and one that is lived.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_ERSABEL_000_104: Like so many in those times, the first of the Night's Blessed lost everything. Their homes, their loved ones─all they held dear.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_ERSABEL_000_105: To make matters worse, none could say what became of the souls of those lost to the Flood when their bodies were reborn as sin eaters.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_ERSABEL_000_106: The people were without answers, without hope, their gods having drowned along with everything else. It seemed that nothing was beyond the reach of the Light.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_ERSABEL_000_107: But soon they realized that where there is Light, there must be Darkness.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_ERSABEL_000_108: And in that truth, they found new faith─a belief that the souls of the departed could yet find peace beyond these burning skies, in the sunless sea above.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_ERSABEL_000_109: That is why we pray. For the safe passage of wayward souls unto that blessed black abyss. For the return of the night, that we might someday look upon the kingdom of heaven with our own eyes.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_ERSABEL_000_110: We remain in these woods for the selfsame reason our founders first chose them─that we may lead lives of simplicity, with the shade of these trees as a constant reminder of our faith.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_RYNE_000_111: With so many seeking paradise in Eulmore, it's refreshing to find people who value a humbler existence.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_ERSABEL_000_112: You are kind to say so. Many consider our way of life foolish─and so it must seem to those who yet cling to their worldly possessions.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_ERSABEL_000_113: In times such as these, when everything can be taken away in an instant, it is all too easy to lose sight of why we fight to go on living.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_ERSABEL_000_114: ...It is not to hold fast to material things, but to hold those who went before us in our hearts─to keep alive the legacy they have left us.
TEXT_LUCKMC105_03326_ERSABEL_000_115: This we must do for them, our children, and generations yet unborn.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RUNAR_000_010: Done tending to the crops already?
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RUNAR_000_011: Very good. It should not be long before your room is ready.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_MANOFNIGHT03326_000: In the woods... <pant> <pant> Sin eaters. I fear they may have the touch.
In the grove to the southwest. For a mercy, they've yet to wander any closer to Slitherbough.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RUNAR_000_016: Then we have no need to engage. Inform the guard that no one is to set foot outside the village until they have moved on.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_MANOFNIGHT03326_000: But sir, what of Toddia's heartstone?
It must be retrieved before the service.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RUNAR_000_019: Of all the times for sin eaters to appear...
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_020: Are you just going to leave them alone?
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RUNAR_000_021: Under normal circumstances, we would not hesitate in striking the beasts down. But if they indeed have the touch, I will not risk them corrupting one of our own.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_022: What was that you said about a stone?
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_MANOFNIGHT03326_000: A few days past, Toddia, a child of the Night's Blessed, was slain by the sin eaters.
We succeeded in retrieving her body, but in our haste, we failed to notice her necklace was gone.
Strung to it was a pendant of jade─her heartstone. All of the Night's Blessed are given such a stone at birth. It is the most valuable possession one can own.
It is custom to present the heartstone of the deceased at their funeral, as an offering to the heavens. But now...
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_027: What if... What if I could find it for you?
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_028: I have experience fighting sin eaters. And the Light's...corruption does not touch me like it does others.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RUNAR_000_029: Master Matoya called you Minfilia, did she not? Are you truly the Minfilia? Descended from the Oracle?
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RUNAR_000_030: Even so, I dare not ask you to risk your life for the Blessed.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_031: I understand how you feel, but I can't stand by knowing that your people are in need and I can help. Please, let me do this.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RUNAR_000_032: Very well. But if the danger proves too great, you must retreat. I could never forgive myself if we were forced to hold a second service.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_033: <gasp> I nearly forgot about Thancred. What if he returns before I do?
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_A1_000_001: Don't worry. I'll come with you.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_034: Thank you. With you at my side, I'm certain we can deal with them in no time at all.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_035: Wh-What!? Do you mean to say...you'll come with me?
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_036: Thank you. Let's hurry then, before he returns.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RUNAR_000_037: Go swiftly, and may the shadows keep you both.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RUNAR_000_040: Do not be reckless. We would be glad to have her heartstone returned to us, but it is not worth both of your lives.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_MANOFNIGHT03326_000: Please, I beg of you. We must have that gem.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_050: It should be around here somewhere, I think.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_061: I was hoping there would only be one...
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_062: There's no way we can search for the stone without dealing with them first.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_A2_000_002: Perhaps we should split them up.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_A2_000_003: What do you propose we do?
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_063: What? Shouldn't we make a plan first?
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_065: I'll draw one of them away. You can deal with the other.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_066: Good idea. I'll draw one away while you handle the other.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_067: Fighting them together here would make a lot of noise, which might attract beasts or other eaters...
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_068: But if we fought them separately and quietly, we might not have to worry about that.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_069: All right, then. I'll draw one away while you handle the other.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_081: It's done. Though, I fear I was a bit careless. I'll do better next time, I promise.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_082: I... I'm fine. You needn't worry about me. More importantly, we have to find that heartstone.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_083: They said it was made of jade, right? I'll search over there in the brush.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_SYSTEM_000_100: There seems to be no trace of the heartstone here.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_SYSTEM_000_101: You brush away the leaves and uncover a brilliant green gem.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_111: It's beautiful! This has to be it.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_112: ...You know, Thancred always said you were a  of many talents, and I think I'm beginning to understand what he meant.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_113: I have much to learn if I'm to be even half the hero you are.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_115: Ah, I'm sorry. Forget I said anything.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RYNE_000_116: We should hurry back to Slitherbough. Runar and the others are probably worried.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RUNAR_000_130: Thank goodness you are safe. I had begun to fear the worst.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RUNAR_000_131: By all that is dark, you found it!
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RUNAR_000_132: We can proceed with her service as planned.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RUNAR_000_133: These blessed gems serve not only to protect us in life, but to guide our spirits unto the sunless sea in the hereafter.
TEXT_LUCKMC106_03327_RUNAR_000_134: Even should we be felled by the sin eaters, so long as these gems are recovered, our souls are ensured peace in the dark.
TEXT_LUCKMC107_03328_RUNAR_000_010: Words fail to express my gratitude for this kindness you have done for the Blessed.
TEXT_LUCKMC107_03328_RUNAR_000_011: I must insist you and your friends attend Toddia's service as honored guests.
TEXT_LUCKMC107_03328_RUNAR_000_012: There is still much we must do to prepare, but please go and inform the others it will be held in the Darker.
TEXT_LUCKMC107_03328_RUNAR_000_013: When you arrive, there should be an attendant present to explain the proceedings.
TEXT_LUCKMC107_03328_RYNE_000_020: and I learned so much about the Night's Blessed while you were away.
TEXT_LUCKMC107_03328_RYNE_000_021: And we helped them recover a lost heirloom out in the woods. I know I wasn't supposed to leave, but they really needed our help! There were sin eaters, and─
TEXT_LUCKMC107_03328_THANCRED_000_022: As long as  accompanied you. But do try to be more careful. Your injuries could have been a lot worse.
TEXT_LUCKMC107_03328_THANCRED_000_024: Let's just say a little bird told me. And it's telling me now that  has business with us.
TEXT_LUCKMC107_03328_RYNE_000_026: They've asked us to attend the service?
TEXT_LUCKMC107_03328_RYNE_000_027: Of course we'll go. It's being held in the Darker, is it? We'll take care not to be late, I promise.
TEXT_LUCKMC107_03328_RYNE_000_030: It's such a relief to know everything is going as planned. I'll join you in the Darker shortly.
TEXT_LUCKMC107_03328_THANCRED_000_035: Between your earlier excursion and my patrol of the area for sin eaters, hopefully Y'shtola and Urianger will be able to finish their work in peace.
TEXT_LUCKMC107_03328_SYSTEM_000_041: The elderly woman hands you a candle. She then points over at a nearby corner where you might place it.
TEXT_LUCKMC107_03328_THANCRED_000_060: Hopefully Y'shtola has good news to share.
TEXT_LUCKMC107_03328_THANCRED_000_061: A chance to reclaim the night has lit a fire in Minfilia that I would see kindled.
TEXT_LUCKMC107_03328_RYNE_000_065: What do you suppose she's gleaned from the tablet?
TEXT_LUCKMC107_03328_URIANGER_000_070: I have no doubt thou wilt find the contents of the tablet most informative.
TEXT_LUCKMC107_03328_RUNAR_000_075: I had no right to involve you in our troubles. Still, without your help, today's service would not have been possible. The Night's Blessed are in your debt.
TEXT_LUCKMC107_03328_YSHTOLA_000_080: Good, you're here. Thanks to the Exarch's gift, our next course of action is now clear.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_THANCRED_000_000: Hopefully Y'shtola has good news to share.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_THANCRED_000_001: A chance to reclaim the night has lit a fire in Minfilia that I would see kindled.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_RYNE_000_005: What do you suppose she's gleaned from the tablet?
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_020: Let me begin by first explaining the origins of this tablet.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_021: I initially believed it might detail the history of the Church of the First Light. Much to my surprise, it dates back to the end of the Ronkan Empire, and was likely written under the direction of the reigning ruler.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_022: It was a time of strife and unceasing war with neighboring nations. With each passing day they yielded more and more territory to their enemies.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_023: In their desperation, petitions for aid were sent out to their allies. This was one such petition.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_RYNE_000_024: And you think this ancient petition will somehow help us get into Yx'Maja?
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_URIANGER_000_026: For etched into this tablet is a method by which one may prove themself an ally of the Ronkan Empire.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_URIANGER_000_027: Provided we are able to decipher said instructions, we may entreat the ruin's protectors to grant us safe passage.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_028: The problem, however, is I presently lack the resources to decipher them in their entirety.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_029: We have but one recourse: there exists a stone monument inscribed with ancient Ronkan text and translations into a more modern dialect which came into use after the fall of the empire. I am confident it will suit our purposes.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_RYNE_000_030: Where can we find this monument?
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_031: Here in Citia, quite close to Slitherbough, in fact.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_032: The good news ends there, however, for it is in the possession of a rather radical faction of Dark worshipers─the Children of the Everlasting Dark.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_033: If I am to study the monument, I must infiltrate their encampment.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_034: I have no intention of taking longer than absolutely necessary, but I will nevertheless require time to transcribe the text I need. To ensure that I will have enough, I am afraid I must ask you and Thancred to assist me.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_THANCRED_000_035: And before you even ask, the answer is no. If we're to remain unseen, our group must be as small as possible.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_RYNE_000_036: ...All right. I'll stay here until you return.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_THANCRED_000_037: We won't be long. If anything should happen, you keep her safe.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_038: Then let us convene outside, to the west of Slitherbough where the path diverges.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_URIANGER_000_045: For my part, I shall make all possible preparations that Y'shtola may begin translating the tablet upon her return.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_060: The encampment we seek is to the north, but it would be foolish to simply rush in.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_061: A guard has been posted at Cleric to keep watch over the Children. Perhaps he has aught to share of their recent activity.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_062: But we must tread carefully. There is a chance we may encounter them along the way.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_063: Stay close and stay alert. I would avoid a confrontation if possible.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_064: They rejoice in dealing death to others, claiming that in doing so they cleanse their victims of sin and usher them unto the sunless sea. I would rather not sully my hands defending myself against such madmen.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_BALLOON_000_080: Do not interfere with our work!
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_THANCRED_000_092: We would have arrived sooner, but we too had a rather unwelcome visit from the Children.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_WATCHER03329_000_09: You are an acquaintance of Master Matoya, then. My apologies.
The Children have been acting strange of late, so I thought to take a closer look. I was careless...
At first there seemed to be nothing out of the ordinary─the usual gathering of ingredients for poisons from flora and fauna.
But then I took notice of their venomous spiders. They've been breeding them in much greater numbers.
It's as if they're preparing for something...
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_100: It could be anything, really. If it meant the end of the Blessed, nothing would be too cruel or violent for them.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_101: But perhaps we can use their present preoccupation with spiders to our advantage.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_102: If we were to introduce a threat to the nests where they keep them, the Children would be compelled to save them. Bees, for example, are a natural predator of spiders.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_103: Set them loose on the nests and we would have our opportunity to sneak into their encampment.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_THANCRED_000_104: What a mischievous plan. I like it. With a bit of smoke we should be able to subdue a few colonies long enough to secure their hives.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_THANCRED_000_105: Have you anything we might be able to use?
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_WATCHER03329_000_10: We should have smoke bombs at the outpost just over there.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_THANCRED_000_108: Grab a few smoke bombs from the outpost and search about for beehives.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_THANCRED_000_109: I imagine the bees won't take too kindly to your visit, but once they're knocked out, take the beehives and bring them back here. Two will suffice, I should think.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_WATCHER03329_000_12: If it's all the same to you, I'll be returning to Slitherbough. I don't want to get in the way. Stay safe, and may the shadows keep you.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_THANCRED_000_140: Were you able to find any?
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_150: The guard returned to Slitherbough, but not before offering his thanks.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_151: As for the beehives, Thancred and I were successful in acquiring what we need. How did you fare?
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_152: This is more than enough. The Children are certain to be displeased.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_YSHTOLA_000_153: Let us hurry, before the bees begin to stir.
TEXT_LUCKMC108_03329_URIANGER_000_010: I have no doubt thou wilt find the contents of the tablet most informative.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_THANCRED_000_000: The bag is sealed tight, but I'd rather not keep the bees buzzing about in there longer than we have to.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_YSHTOLA_000_010: The Children's settlement is to the west, a place they call Woven Oath.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_YSHTOLA_000_011: According to the guard, there is an airway apart from the entrance which leads to the spiders' nests.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_YSHTOLA_000_012: If the fates are kind, the way will be clear.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_THANCRED_000_020: We should move quickly, before any of the Children arrive.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_YSHTOLA_000_030: Up there is the airway. Do you see it?
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_THANCRED_000_031: A bit far, perhaps, but we should be able to toss the bag through.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_THANCRED_000_032: Though we should probably loosen the ropes keeping it closed. Enough that it falls open when it lands inside.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_THANCRED_000_034: That should do it. Now we wait...
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_SCREAM03330_000_035: (-Villager of the Everlasting Dark-)What is that!?
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_SCREAM03330_000_036: (-Villager of the Everlasting Dark-)Bees! By the abyss, they're everywhere!
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_SCREAM03330_000_037: (-Villager of the Everlasting Dark-)Help! Someone help! We have to save the spiders!
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_YSHTOLA_000_038: It sounds like our plan is working.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_YSHTOLA_000_039: Still, it is quite likely not all were drawn away from their posts.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_THANCRED_000_040: If you should come to blows with the Children, I'll see to it any signs of struggle are concealed. Failing that, I'll create a distraction to buy Y'shtola more time.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_THANCRED_000_041: Should anyone get past me, it falls to you to guard her.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_YSHTOLA_000_042: Your concern is appreciated, but I sincerely doubt it will come to that.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_THANCRED_000_043: Why do I get the feeling you enjoy the idea of my loafing about bored in the shadows?
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_YSHTOLA_000_044: Come now, Thancred. The shadows are a fitting place for a Warrior of Darkness. Now, if you both are ready?
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_THANCRED_000_050: Go on. I'll be right behind you.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_YSHTOLA_000_060: The Font of Seeing suggests this is a chamber for prayer. At the very least, they would not place this near potential distractions from their worship.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_YSHTOLA_000_061: Perhaps the monument is further in.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_YSHTOLA_000_071: I will be but a moment. Keep watch of the entryway.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_YSHTOLA_000_072: On second thought, would you mind examining the murals on these walls while I look over this?
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_YSHTOLA_000_073: At a glance, I can tell they are old. Predating the founding of the Blessed and the Children, in fact.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_YSHTOLA_000_074: We're not like to come here a second time. 'Twould behoove us to learn all that we can.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_YSHTOLA_000_080: Hmmm... Then what does this mean...?
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_SYSTEM_000_090: Examine the murals and take note of what events they may depict. You may move the camera as well as zoom in and out. Target a mural and examine it with .
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_THANCRED_000_100: Good to see my distraction proved successful.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_YSHTOLA_000_110: I believe I now have everything needed to finish deciphering the tablet.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_YSHTOLA_000_111: Tell me, , did the murals appear to be of any significance?
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_YSHTOLA_000_112: Depictions of heroes? From the age of gods, the Ronkan Empire, and immediately before the Flood.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_YSHTOLA_000_113: Very astute observations. Perhaps in another lifetime you could be a curator of antiquities.
TEXT_LUCKMC109_03330_YSHTOLA_000_114: Though it has no bearing on the task at hand, perhaps that knowledge may prove to be of use in the future.
TEXT_LUCKMC110_03331_THANCRED_000_000: Glad to see my distraction proved successful.
TEXT_LUCKMC110_03331_YSHTOLA_000_010: Let us hurry to Slitherbough. The others are waiting.
TEXT_LUCKMC110_03331_YSHTOLA_000_011: After we've returned, the two of you should rest a while. No doubt Runar will be eager to have you sample his cooking.
TEXT_LUCKMC110_03331_YSHTOLA_000_012: As soon as I discover anything of import, you will be the first to know.
TEXT_LUCKMC110_03331_THANCRED_000_020: Urianger has tended to Minfilia's wounds, but I fear his garrulous nature has gotten the better of him.
TEXT_LUCKMC110_03331_RYNE_000_025: Welcome back, . Now that you're here, there's something I want to ask you.
TEXT_LUCKMC110_03331_RYNE_000_026: Urianger told me that Thancred was something of a rogue in the past. “As a wolf among sheep,” he said. What did he mean by that? Do you know?
TEXT_LUCKMC110_03331_URIANGER_000_030: Rest assured Y'shtola and I shall work with all haste to decipher the tablet and its secrets.
TEXT_LUCKMC110_03331_YSHTOLA_000_035: Please, go and rest. Urianger and I will call you the moment we finish.
TEXT_LUCKMC110_03331_RUNAR_000_040: ! The guard told me you left with Master Matoya to Woven Oath.
TEXT_LUCKMC110_03331_RUNAR_000_041: And no sooner do you return than she locks herself away in her chambers without so much as a word.
TEXT_LUCKMC110_03331_RUNAR_000_042: She knows how I worry when she leaves without telling me. <sigh> But she is safe, and that is all that matters.
TEXT_LUCKMC110_03331_RUNAR_000_043: You must be hungry after such a journey. Why not have a seat there by the fire? The stew will soon be ready.
TEXT_LUCKMC110_03331_RUNAR_000_050: I confess I am not the greatest of cooks, but I have yet to hear any complaints.
TEXT_LUCKMC110_03331_THANCRED_000_060: That Eulmore has gained a foothold here in these woods bodes ill for the Night's Blessed.
TEXT_LUCKMC110_03331_RYNE_000_065: Surely there's something we can do to help the Night's Blessed... Isn't there?
TEXT_LUCKMC110_03331_URIANGER_000_070: The guard hath been afflicted with a most terrible and efficacious poison.
TEXT_LUCKMC110_03331_URIANGER_000_071: We have attempted all manner of healing incantations. Alas, his condition remains unchanged.
TEXT_LUCKMC110_03331_URIANGER_000_072: At present, we can but slow the poison's advance. I pray it will afford us sufficient time to find a cure.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_THANCRED_000_000: That Eulmore has gained a foothold here does not bode well for the Night's Blessed.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_RYNE_000_005: There must be something we can do to help the Night's Blessed... Mustn't there?
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_011: The poison spread throughout his system long before he was brought here. At present, there is naught we can do but try to ease his pain.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_RUNAR_000_012: Do not blame yourselves, my friends. All that can be done has been done.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_RUNAR_000_013: Even had we reached him sooner, it would have made little difference. The Children employ countless poisons. Finding a suitable antidote is a nigh impossible task.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_THANCRED_000_014: ...What of the rest of the Blessed? How have they taken the news of Eulmore's generous proposition?
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_RUNAR_000_015: With anger and dismay. We cannot hope to oppose both them and the Children.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_RUNAR_000_016: I considered a convocation of all the Night's Blessed that we might consider their ultimatum, but I know how they will answer.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_RUNAR_000_019: But there is no reason for you to suffer for our decision. Your work is not yet done, and you still have time to flee.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_021: I am not wont to run from my troubles. In fact, with 's arrival, I am minded to take the offensive.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_022: The Eulmorans' presence here plainly stems from a desire to protect the Lightwarden. I say we seek it out and slay the creature before they return.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_023: Were darkness to fall over Rak'tika, they would have no cause to remain.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_THANCRED_000_024: ...All of which is rather easier said than done. Unless, of course, you've finally deciphered that tablet?
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_025: I have, as a matter of fact. And with it we can prepare everything we need to enter Yx'Maja.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_026: What say you all? We will need to act quickly, but I believe it can be done.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_URIANGER_000_027: We cannot deny our fate. But one course lieth before us.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_A1_000_003: Well, we are villains, are we not?
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_028: Good. I leave the Blessed in your capable hands, Runar.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_RUNAR_000_030: I see there is no changing your mind. By all that is dark, I swear to keep the Blessed safe.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_031: According to the tablet, we will first need to obtain a seal used to identify the allies of Ronka in times past.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_032: One such seal should be waiting for us in a complex of underwater ruins not far from here. You have some experience with subaquatic excursions, do you not?
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_033: Then this should prove a simple task for you. The ruins we seek are at the bottom of Lake Tusi Mek'ta.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_THANCRED_000_034: While you see to that, Minfilia and I will remain here to help shore up Slitherbough's defenses.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_RUNAR_000_035: Your aid would be greatly appreciated.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_040: There you are. Ready for a swim?
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_041: The seal we seek should be stored in a chamber somewhere inside the ruins beneath the lake.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_042: However, the entrance is seemingly protected by a subtle locking mechanism rooted in the symbolism of Ronkan culture.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_043: The Ronkans sought to live in harmony with nature, and considered certain animals to be sacred. Foremost in their pantheon was the snake, portrayed as the protector of the wood, and arbiter of life and death. Below it were four others, each equal in rank: the coeurl, the colibri, the opo-opo, and the wolf, characterized as the bringers of liberty, words, enlightenment, and harmony, respectively.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_044: To open the chamber containing the seal, the tablet states that one must pay due deference to three of these beasts by placing one's palm on monuments wrought in their image, and that this must be done in a specific sequence.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_045: If my interpretation is correct, the order can be discerned from the three commandments which follow.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_046: “Give praise unto the snake. By its strength do our lands prosper.”
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_047: “Be as the opo-opo, rival thy kin. As all parts seek betterment, so too does the whole.”
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_048: “Be as the wolf, move as one. Peace comes to all who seek harmony with their kin.”
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_049: The tablet says naught of the placement, size, or appearance of the monuments, alas. Hopefully all will become clear when you reach the bottom of the lake. Go safely.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_060: You have forgotten the sequence? <sigh> Mind that you listen this time, yes? The commandments were as follows...
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_061: “Give praise unto the snake. By its strength do our lands prosper.”
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_062: “Be as the opo-opo, rival thy kin. As all parts seek enlightenment, so too does the whole.”
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_063: “Be as the wolf, move as one. Peace comes to all who seek harmony with their kin.”
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_064: As I told you before, the tablet says naught of the position, size, or appearance of the monuments in question, so you will just have to use your eyes.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_SYSTEM_000_070: You find a statue of a snake.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_Q2_000_071: Place your palm on the snake statue?
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_SYSTEM_000_072: You sense something stir elsewhere in the lake.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_SYSTEM_000_080: You find a statue of an opo-opo.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_Q3_000_081: Place your palm on the opo-opo statue?
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_SYSTEM_000_082: You sense something stir elsewhere in the lake.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_SYSTEM_000_083: You find a statue of a coeurl.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_Q4_000_084: Place your palm on the coeurl statue?
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_SYSTEM_000_085: You sense a malign magick emanating from the monument.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_SYSTEM_000_090: You find a statue of a wolf.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_Q5_000_091: Place your palm on the wolf statue?
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_SYSTEM_000_092: Once more, you sense something stir elsewhere in the lake. Perhaps the chamber containing the seal is open.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_SYSTEM_000_093: You find a statue of a colibri.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_Q6_000_094: Place your palm on the colibri statue?
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_SYSTEM_000_095: You sense a malign magick emanating from the monument.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_100: I sensed a stirring in the water. Assuming you've found the chamber, it may be wise to check the entrance.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_SYSTEM_000_110: A door opens to reveal a pedestal upon which rests a medallion. You take it and secure it inside your clothing.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_121: This medallion... It bears the owl insignia of the empire. There can be no doubt─this is the seal of Ronka.
TEXT_LUCKMC111_03332_YSHTOLA_000_122: Well done, . We can begin our preparations to enter Yx'Maja in earnest.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_YSHTOLA_000_000: Bearing this seal, it should be possible to enter Yx'Maja unmolested by its guardians.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_YSHTOLA_000_001: I will go ahead to Slitherbough and inform the others. When you have recovered from your exertions, meet with us in the cavern leading east out of the village.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_THANCRED_000_010: We've done what we can to prepare them for the worst.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_THANCRED_000_011: Still, we should hurry, before the Children return with Eulmoran reinforcements.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_RYNE_000_015: I'm so glad to see you're safe. Everyone is ready to go if you are.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_URIANGER_000_020: That you all found the seal is perhaps bittersweet proof that the aid for which it was so painstakingly forged never came.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_URIANGER_000_021: Thus did the empire crumble, its ruins reclaimed by the wood. Fate is ever a fickle mistress.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_YSHTOLA_000_030: Good, you're here. Runar opened the gate for us but moments ago.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_YSHTOLA_000_031: Beyond lies Yx'Maja, and presumably the Lightwarden.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_YSHTOLA_000_032: It did not take long for the wood's protectors to find me when last I came here, and I expect them to fall upon us just as quickly this time.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_YSHTOLA_000_033: Though we carry the seal, that is no reason for us to let down our guard.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_YSHTOLA_000_034: Now, let us seek out the Warden, and put an end to its reign over these woods.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_UIMET_000_040: Good to see you didn't lose your way.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_CYMET_000_045: You outsiders are a strange lot, aren't you?
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_ALMET_000_050: (-Bow-wielding Sentinel-)I would have the seal, that we may confirm its authenticity.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_YSHTOLA_000_051: Straight to the point, I see. Very well.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_ALMET_000_052: (-Bow-wielding Sentinel-)Hmmm. There is no mistaking the crest of the royal family.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_ALMET_000_053: (-Bow-wielding Sentinel-)It is of proper size, and by its weight it is plain it was made from gold. The seal is indeed genuine.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_ALMET_000_054: (-Bow-wielding Sentinel-)For three thousand years we have waited for this moment, and now you are finally here. I bid you welcome, allies of Ronka.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_CYMET_000_057: Cymet. A pleasure. We were beginning to lose hope that you would come.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_ALMET_000_059: (-Almet-)These are troubled times for my people.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_ALMET_000_060: (-Almet-)Though I can but imagine what has compelled you to venture into our woods.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_ALMET_000_061: (-Almet-)You must be tired after your journey. Come, take your ease.
TEXT_LUCKMC112_03333_UIMET_000_062: If you'd like I will show you about the village. Though I must warn you it is a long way down to the forest floor, so do watch your step.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_CYMET_000_000: This way, um... What is your name?
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_CYMET_000_001: ? ...And this is a common name nowadays? How times change.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_CYMET_000_002: But I digress. Come, and be sure to watch your step.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_THANCRED_000_010: They call themselves Viis, is that right? Not a terribly diverse people from what I can see.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_RYNE_000_015: For a moment, I was worried they wouldn't accept the seal.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_URIANGER_000_020: For three thousand years did they wait... Incredible.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_YSHTOLA_000_025: No dawdling. Once we have learned all we can of the Warden and its whereabouts, we should be on our way.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_UIMET_000_030: My apologies for the hostile greeting.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_UIMET_000_031: It is a miracle our arrows did not find their mark.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_CYMET_000_035: If you would hear the tale of our people, speak with Almet. As eldest, she is our voice.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_040: As bearers of the seal, you have a right to know what became of the empire, and my people's purpose here.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_041: We are descendants of the palace guard which served under the last emperor. And to this day, we carry on the duty of our forebears, the final decree of His Eminence before Ronka's fall.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_042: “By the wisdom of our people was Ronka made to thrive. Such knowledge must never be forgotten, nor may it be suffered to fall into the hands of the wicked.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_043: “Keep it secret. Keep it safe. And look to the coming of our allies. Unto them you shall bequeath our all, and thus will Ronka live on.”
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_044: By his command we have remained in the Rak'tika Greatwood, guardians of Ronka's ruins, and the wisdom held within.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_URIANGER_000_045: I hope thou wilt not think the question impertinent, but did thy people's famed longevity perchance play a part in the emperor's decision to entrust this mission unto thee and thine?
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_046: That was one reason, yes. We Viis would easily live to see three of your elven lifetimes.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_047: We were also the fiercest fighters. There are none more fit than us to stand watch over the remains of Ronka.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_UIMET_000_048: But our duty has grown ever more perilous in the wake of the Flood.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_CYMET_000_049: Settlements such as this one were plentiful before the Light claimed dominion over the land. But now...
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_051: Our numbers dwindle year by year...
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_052: Before long, there will be no one left to honor the emperor's wishes.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_YSHTOLA_000_053: And you believe we are the allies for whom you have waited?
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_UIMET_000_054: You have the seal, do you not!? After three millennia of waiting, that alone is nothing short of a miracle! Truth be told, I had begun to think you would never come!
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_056: We are glad of your presence here in the Greatwood.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_057: The wisdom of Ronka is yours should you wish it. You need only ask.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_058: You come in search of the Lightwarden...
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_059: My apologies, but I do not know where it makes its lair.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_060: Uimet, do you recall any sightings of this creature?
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_UIMET_000_061: Hmmm... Not these past thirty summers.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_RYNE_000_062: Thirty? But that would mean... How old are you, exactly?
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_064: With age comes knowledge. There may yet be one among us who has seen or heard of the abomination you seek.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_YSHTOLA_000_065: We have leave to speak with the other Viis, then?
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_YSHTOLA_000_067: Then we should split up and inquire individually. If someone knows something, I would hear it while there is yet time to act.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_070: In the name of Ronka and the late emperor, I promise we will do all we can to assist you and yours.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_UIMET_000_075: Let not our looks deceive you. It is true we are still in our youth, but we are older than you might think.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_CYMET_000_080: I pray you find the knowledge you seek. Oh, what I would not give to see the Warden brought low.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_KORILLE_000_091: By the gods─allies of the empire! My sincerest apologies for failing to note your arrival.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_KORILLE_000_092: It was the Warden you wished to know about, yes? My mother─may she rest in peace─told me once of its appearance in these woods.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_KORILLE_000_093: Before settling here in Fanow, she lived in a village near Rak'tika Falls─until it was destroyed by the sin eaters.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_KORILLE_000_094: While out on patrol one day, she spotted a swarm of the abominations, one of which was different from the rest.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_KORILLE_000_095: It was larger, for one thing, but what struck her was the way its fellows seemed to revere it. She was convinced that what she had seen was the Lightwarden.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_SYSTEM_000_096: Your exchange with Korille has taught you something about the Lightwarden's possible whereabouts.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_KORILLE_000_097: Would that my mother were still with us. I am certain she could help you find the Warden.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_NYMET_000_098: It was not my intention to pry, but your voices carry far. I know what it is you would ask of me.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_NYMET_000_099: Unfortunately the answer is no, I have not seen the Lightwarden. I patrol the ruins' perimeter regularly, and if it were hiding nearby, I would know about it.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_NYMET_000_100: I apologize that I cannot be of more help, but I have told you all I know.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_LOYMET_000_101: You search for the Lightwarden? I cannot say I have ever laid eyes on it.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_LOYMET_000_102: Our duty is to protect the ruins, nothing more. We have no need to strike out in search of such a foe.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_LOYMET_000_103: I see no reason to pursue one who poses no threat to the ruins.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_SHOINA_000_104: The Lightwarden? No, I have not seen it.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_SHOINA_000_105: But I have witnessed the horrors of the lesser eaters. How they are wont to hunt in packs and carry off their victims rather than consuming them on the spot.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_SHOINA_000_106: I suspect the Warden is a grotesque, corpulent thing, waiting patiently for its minions to bring its next meal.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_SHOINA_000_107: I have not seen the Lightwarden, and I pray I never do.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_THANCRED_000_110: No one I spoke to had seen hide nor hair of the Warden. But that may not be surprising, given their disinclination to stray far from the ruins.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_RYNE_000_115: Did you have any luck speaking with the Viis?
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_URIANGER_000_120: Myriad are the tales the Viis did share with me. Alas, none made mention of the Warden or its lair.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_YSHTOLA_000_125: Were you able to learn aught of the Warden's whereabouts?
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_130: I pray the others were able to provide what I could not.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_131: Near Rak'tika Falls!? Why was I not told of this?
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_UIMET_000_132: I think I see now why it has never been spotted on our patrols.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_YSHTOLA_000_133: I have never heard of this Rak'tika Falls. I can but assume it lies deep within the woods of Yx'Maja.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_CYMET_000_134: Just so. But the tunnel which leads there collapsed after a rather bloody battle with the eaters, and has not been passable for many years.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_CYMET_000_135: We made several attempts to clear away the rubble, yet each time we were driven back. In the end, we were forced to give it up as lost.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_136: ...Thereby making it a suitable place for the Warden to take sanctuary.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_137: There is perhaps one way to enter. Though it would be at great peril to you and your companions.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_138: The Qitana Ravel, a temple to the northeast.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_139: It has been sealed for centuries, but within is a path that leads to the falls.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_141: For the allies of Ronka, it can.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_142: First we must go to the K'mul Astropolis. Once the flow of magic is restored there, the path through the Qitana Ravel can be opened.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_UIMET_000_143: This may sound a simple task, but there are certain...obstacles which prevent us from attending to it ourselves.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_UIMET_000_144: ...And we know not how to overcome them.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_CYMET_000_145: The emperor never granted our forebears leave to look upon the secrets we are charged with protecting. That we might not be tempted, the means to do so were withheld from us.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_CYMET_000_146: We can but show you the way. The rest will be up to you.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_YSHTOLA_000_147: It would seem we have our work cut out for us, then. Shall we?
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_YSHTOLA_000_148: Let us be about it then.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_149: If that is your wish, it is my duty to escort you.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_YSHTOLA_000_150: While we attend to matters at the K'mul Astropolis, I would ask that your sisters accompany Urianger and Thancred, and share with them all they can of these woods.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_YSHTOLA_000_151: While we have every intention of investigating Rak'tika Falls, 'tis yet possible the Lightwarden dwells elsewhere.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_YSHTOLA_000_152: With that in mind, it would behoove us to prepare an alternative course of action.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_ALMET_000_153: Uimet. Cymet. I leave them to you.
TEXT_LUCKMC113_03334_URIANGER_000_155: Should our present course prove false, doubt not but that Thancred and I shall find any and all possible paths forward.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_000: We must make haste and see this done. The Qitana Ravel and the Lightwarden await.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_010: What you seek lies in the heart of the K'mul Astropolis.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_011: Unfortunately, it too was sealed shut by order of His Eminence.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_012: If we are to open it, we must first look to the Morning Stars. Come, I will show you the way.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_020: Looking upon these structures, I cannot help but be reminded of ruins in Gyr Abania. Yet the manner in which they appear to be suppressing the natural flow of aether is more akin to the Allagan pillars in the House of the Crooked Coin...
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_030: You were able to keep up, I see. Well done.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_031: Ahead lie the Morning Stars, four monuments built in tribute to the guardians of Rak'tika.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_032: Beyond them is the Great Pyramid of Ux'ner, where the flow of magic must be restored.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_033: It is said that the monuments are themselves the keys to opening the pyramid.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_034: Though I know not how. That is for you to discover.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_036: I would have a closer look.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_040: I must confess, there are times when I too wonder what lies within these ruins. But I would never defy the will of the emperor.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_050: It is indeed another puzzle, but for a blessing, it appears to be similar to the one we encountered at the lake.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_051: These statues are all depictions of the divine beasts mentioned on the tablet.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_052: No doubt they will open the way into the pyramid in like manner.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_053: We have but to discern the correct order. Let's split up and search the area for clues.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_054: These ruins are covered in ancient inscriptions. The answer may well be hiding among them.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_055: Indeed. It may be best to transcribe them if they are as numerous as you say. Better that than risk overlooking something.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_056: Though transcription would prove impractical for you, not being versed in Ronkan script... No matter. You will employ a different approach: impressions.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_057: Here. I had thought to use these clay tablets to record any significant imagery we discovered, but they will serve you just as well. Take impressions of any inscriptions you find.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_058: We will start at the base of the pyramids. You begin at the top.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_059: When you have finished, return here and I will translate your findings.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_075: There are so many inscriptions... I scarcely know where to start.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_SYSTEM_000_080: You take an impression of the writing inscribed on the monument.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_090: Finished? Take what you have to Y'shtola. I will join you anon.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_100: I trust you've made good use of those clay tablets?
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_101: Well done. A moment while I decipher what you've found.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_103: Nothing we saw at the base of the pyramids gave any hint as to the solution of the puzzle, focusing instead on how to proceed having solved it. Your findings, on the other hand, appear to form a riddle. Once assembled, it reads as follows...
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_108: I had assumed that the puzzle would involve a sequence, but from what Almet and I were able to gather, it is but a matter of suffusing one of the statues with aether.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_120:
“Come together, share despair,
Go thy ways, dread burdens bear...
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_121:
“Mark the crown, heed its call,
Avert thy gaze, forever fall.”
Such cryptic writings. How are they related to the divine beasts?
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_SYSTEM_000_125: Examining the serpent statue, you notice it is facing away from the coeurl statue.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_SYSTEM_000_130: Examining the coeurl statue, you notice it is facing away from the serpent statue.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_SYSTEM_000_135: Examining the colibri statue, you notice it is facing south toward the woods.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_SYSTEM_000_140: Examining the owl statue, you notice it is facing north toward the Great Pyramid.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_SYSTEM_000_145: Examining the wolf statue, you notice it is facing towards the opo-opo statue.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_SYSTEM_000_150: Examining the opo-opo statue, you notice it is facing towards the wolf statue.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_160: Given your talent for finding solutions to vexatious problems, I think it best that you choose the statue. What say you, ?
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_161: If you need more time to consider, take it─but do make haste. I would suggest seeking Almet's counsel, but she seems rather preoccupied with reciting the riddle.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_162: At the very least, you should consider having a second look at the statues themselves. Perhaps they offer some clue as to which is the correct choice.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_163: Right, then. After you have selected a statue, I will imbue it with the required aether.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_164: Should it prove to be a trap, I am more than capable of warding off any malign magicks it may contain.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_165: Now, which statue will it be?
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_A2_000_007: Might I hear the riddle one more time?
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_166: Yes, of course. I have it written here.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_167:
“Come together, share despair,
Go thy ways, dread burdens bear...
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_168:
“Mark the crown, heed its call,
Avert thy gaze, forever fall.”
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_169: Did that serve to inspire you?
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_170: All right. I pray this works.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_172: I am fine. Though I would rather not go through that again.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_174: All right. I pray this works.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_176: You really do have a talent for these things.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_180: A moment. Maintaining my wards has proven more taxing than anticipated.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_190: The way should be clear now. Come, let us─
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_194: What are you doing here? What has happened?
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_CYMET_000_195: Eulmoran soldiers. They have entered Yx'Maja!
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_196: Eulmoran soldiers!? And what of the Blessed?
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_CYMET_000_197: Nothing specific, but it seems the Eulmorans had little interest in Slitherbough or its people.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_CYMET_000_198: According to our scouts, their general and his men made all haste for the gate to Yx'Maja upon finding it.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_CYMET_000_199: Together with Thancred, Uimet and some few others have engaged them at the border.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_200: You are to return and assist Uimet at once.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_201: They are not to set foot near the ruins or Fanow.
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_ALMET_000_202: We will see to matters here and return as quickly as we can. Understood?
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_204: Though I knew time was short, I did not expect the Eulmorans to move so swiftly...
TEXT_LUCKMC114_03335_YSHTOLA_000_205: But we have come too far to turn back now.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_YSHTOLA_000_000: I swear, if the Eulmorans harm so much as a hair on the heads of the Blessed...
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_YSHTOLA_000_020: Our way has been barred...again. I am beginning to lose my patience.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_ALMET_000_030: The switch should be through these doors, in the Confessional of Toupasa the Elder. But why is it not open?
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_YSHTOLA_000_031: Magic appears to be flowing through the walls, but it's being obstructed as it approaches the door.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_YSHTOLA_000_032: ...Hmmm. Is it not strange that only one of these pedestals bears an owl statue?
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_ALMET_000_033: Strange indeed. The second statue was likely hidden to keep the door sealed.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_YSHTOLA_000_034: We can cover more ground if we split up. Almet, take the chamber to the south. , the one to the east.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_YSHTOLA_000_035: I will search the chamber to the west.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_YSHTOLA_000_040: Still no sign of the statue. It has to be around here somewhere...
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_ALMET_000_045: I can spot trespassers from four hundred yalms away, and yet this simple statue eludes me. How embarrassing...
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_ALMET_000_050: I have looked everywhere, and─ Wait, is that...?
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_ALMET_000_052: It looks light enough. We need but return it to the other altar, no?
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_YSHTOLA_000_053: One might assume so, but nothing about these ruins has ever been quite so simple.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_YSHTOLA_000_054: I sensed a strange energy emanating from the eyes of the statues in the corridors of this place. Should this figure be moved, it would not surprise me for them to suddenly stir to life.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_ALMET_000_055: A trap, then. For the unsuspecting as they attempt to return this to its rightful place.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_YSHTOLA_000_056: Precisely. Caution would serve us well here.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_YSHTOLA_000_057: Which is why I would ask you to deliver this statue to the main chamber.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_YSHTOLA_000_058: An abundance of magick yet courses through these walls. For my eyes, distractingly so. I believe yours, on the other hand, would more aptly perceive the traps for what they are.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_YSHTOLA_000_059: All right, then. We will meet you at the door to the Confessional of Toupasa the Elder.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_YSHTOLA_000_070: Beware the stare of those statues, . I dare not think what will happen should they catch sight of you.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_ALMET_000_075: Would that I could bear the statuette in your stead, but it is not my place. Take care, and beware the owls.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_SYSTEM_000_080: The owl statue's eyes take on an eerie glow. As the light fades, you realize the statuette has disappeared from your hands.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_SYSTEM_100_083: Deliver the owl statuette to the altar at the entrance of the Confessional of Toupasa the Elder. Be wary of attacks from enemies, which will sap your strength.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_SYSTEM_000_084: Though the altar remains vacant, the top appears worn, suggesting something once rested here.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_SYSTEM_000_085: You successfully deliver the statuette to the altar.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_ALMET_000_086: The statue is returned, but was that enough?
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_YSHTOLA_000_087: I believe it was. I can see aether flowing to the door now.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_YSHTOLA_000_088: I pray this means an end to the tricks and traps of these ruins.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_YSHTOLA_000_100: The sooner we can enter the Qitana Ravel, the better.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_ALMET_000_110: You are but one step from entering the Qitana Ravel, but I must warn you: this last step is without question the most perilous.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_ALMET_000_111: Overcome this final trial, and the path forward will open to you.
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_YSHTOLA_000_112: A path laden with more puzzles and traps, I'm sure. Did the emperor always take such pleasure in wasting the time of his allies?
TEXT_LUCKMC115_03336_YSHTOLA_000_113: <sigh> Let us end this, . While time is yet on our side.
TEXT_LUCKMC116_03337_YSHTOLA_000_000: Let us do what needs be done and quit this place. We've precious little time.
TEXT_LUCKMC116_03337_ALMET_000_010: Before we enter, I would tell you of the trial that awaits you.
TEXT_LUCKMC116_03337_ALMET_000_011: The chamber is said to be filled with all manner of devices to keep trespassers away from the switch.
TEXT_LUCKMC116_03337_ALMET_000_012: The most potent being wards of displacement. They may very well force you into danger.
TEXT_LUCKMC116_03337_ALMET_000_013: Should we become separated, please use these.
TEXT_LUCKMC116_03337_ALMET_000_014: Whisperweeds. They will allow us to communicate no matter where we may find ourselves.
TEXT_LUCKMC116_03337_YSHTOLA_000_015: I think  and I can work out how to use these well enough. Thank you.
TEXT_LUCKMC116_03337_YSHTOLA_000_016: All right, . The sooner we finish here, the sooner we can return to the others.
TEXT_LUCKMC116_03337_ALMET_000_017: I will do all I can to assist you, but I cannot guarantee your safety once we enter.
TEXT_LUCKMC116_03337_YSHTOLA_000_020: Shall we get this over with?
TEXT_LUCKMC116_03337_RYNE_000_030: Why would she do such a thing?
TEXT_LUCKMC116_03337_URIANGER_000_035: Oh, Y'shtola... Had we been but a few steps faster.
TEXT_LUCKMC116_03337_ALMET_000_040: I have failed you. Words fail to express my shame...
TEXT_LUCKMC116_03337_CYMET_000_045: We should have tried harder to repel them.
TEXT_LUCKMC116_03337_THANCRED_000_050: Thankfully Ran'jit's cohorts had the good sense to fall back.
TEXT_LUCKMC116_03337_THANCRED_000_051: Uimet should be here soon with word from Fanow.
TEXT_LUCKMC116_03337_THANCRED_000_052: We should hold our position here until she arrives.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_RYNE_000_005: Why would she do such a thing?
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_URIANGER_000_010: Oh, Y'shtola... Had we been but a few steps faster.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_CYMET_000_015: We should have tried harder to repel them.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_THANCRED_000_020: Almet. Please tell me you know if that hole might lead out into the woods somewhere.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_ALMET_000_021: Were there another means of exiting the temple, there is no question that we would know of it.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_ALMET_000_022: But I fear that is of little consequence, for we have tried to mark the depth of the pit. And failed.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_ALMET_000_023: To fall from such a height...
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_UIMET_000_025: The Eulmoran soldiers and the Children have fled Yx'Maja.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_UIMET_000_026: They abandoned Slitherbough as well, though they yet remain in the swamps near Lakeland.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_UIMET_000_027: Unfortunately, a number of the Blessed were poisoned while fending off the soldiers.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_UIMET_000_028: One we believe to be of their order was found lost in Yx'Maja, feverish and badly wounded.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_UIMET_000_029: He was taken to Fanow for treatment, but I fear there is little we can do for him.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_UIMET_000_030: He and the other Blessed will not last long without an antidote.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_THANCRED_000_031: Then we must act quickly. If you've a spare vial, Minfilia and I can deliver it to the Blessed at Slitherbough.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_THANCRED_000_032: You and Urianger should return to Fanow and tend to the wounded villager there.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_THANCRED_000_033: I know it seems callous of us to leave, but she leapt into that hole for a reason.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_THANCRED_100_033: We have to save the Blessed. Whatever it takes.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_ALMET_000_034: My sisters and I will remain here. We must be certain no soldiers are still lurking about.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_URIANGER_000_035: Come, . Let not Y'shtola's sacrifice be in vain.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_URIANGER_000_051: 'Twas he who forestalled the Eulmorans' procession. And in so doing, afforded thee time to traverse the temple.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_URIANGER_000_060: Quickly, . I fear he hath precious little time.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_SYSTEM_000_080: Runar still appears visibly pained. Perhaps he requires another dose of medicine.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_SYSTEM_000_090: The medicine seems to take effect as the color slowly creeps back to his cheeks.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_URIANGER_000_100: It would appear the worst hath passed, though his wounds yet want for mending.
TEXT_LUCKMC117_03338_URIANGER_000_101: I shall minister to him forthwith.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_URIANGER_000_010: Rest, , I prithee. I shall attend to Runar's ministrations.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_THANCRED_000_020: Though I am loath to trust him, I suppose we have no choice. For now, at least.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_RYNE_000_025: Do you really think he can bring her back?
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_URIANGER_000_030: Could it truly be within his power to pluck Y'shtola from the Lifestream as he claimeth? 'Tis a feat beyond even the greatest practitioners of the arcane. Yet if he would attempt it, we cannot well stand in his way.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_RUNAR_000_035: By the blessed Dark, there is yet hope!
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_ALMET_000_040: I confess, I do not fully understand what is happening here─but I gather we were right to bring this man to you.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_UIMET_000_045: We found him asleep in the shade of a tree near the ruins. A fine way to behave when one's companions are in dire straits.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_CYMET_000_050: I am relieved to know he is an acquaintance of yours. Though I see you are not close. If he should displease you, we would be happy to deal with him...
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_EMETSELCH_000_060: Now then, if I'm to fetch her for you, I will require a suitable place to work. We must find somewhere that resonates strongly with the Lifestream.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_EMETSELCH_000_061: And by we, I mean you. To that end, I give you this─an aetherial lamp of my own design.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_EMETSELCH_000_062: Keep it close as you venture out into the woods. The brighter the glow, the stronger the location's resonance with the Lifestream. Once you've found a likely spot, all you need do is whistle.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_EMETSELCH_000_063: You do know how to whistle, don't you, hero? Just put your lips together and blow.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_SYSTEM_000_064: To find a location that resonates with the Lifestream, you will need to search the area marked on your map.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_SYSTEM_000_065: Use your aetherial lamp to pinpoint an ideal location then call for Emet-Selch.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_EMETSELCH_000_070: Well, what are you standing around here for? Get searching! You do want to save her, don't you?
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_SYSTEM_000_080: The lamplight is near blinding. Perhaps now would be a good time to call for Emet-Selch.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_SYSTEM_000_084: The lamp is dim, as if it might go out at any moment.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_YSHTOLA_000_090: Did Emet-Selch not return with you?
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_THANCRED_000_095: Though I struggle to form the words...I am glad that Emet-Selch was here.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_THANCRED_000_096: We can but pray Y'shtola never does anything so reckless again.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_RYNE_000_100: Urianger once told me that being immersed in the Lifestream can cause irreparable harm to the body. Do you suppose Y'shtola is all right?
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_URIANGER_000_105: In all of history, there are but few who have returned from a misadventure in the aetherial sea possessed of mind and body both.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_URIANGER_000_106: To have done so twice beggareth belief. 'Tis plain Y'shtola wanteth not for favor among the Twelve.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_RUNAR_000_110: By all that is dark, Master Matoya is returned! She stands here before me yet still I cannot believe it.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_ALMET_000_115: We are both gladdened and relieved to see your companion returned hale and whole.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_UIMET_000_120: With your friend returned, you will resume your exploration of the ruins, yes? But say the word and we shall assist you.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_CYMET_000_125: It was fate who brought you to us, and fate who returned your companion to you. She yet smiles on Ronka, I am sure of it.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_EMETSELCH_000_130: What a touching reunion that was. It fair brought a tear to the eye. But as we both know, such tender moments are nothing if not momentary.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_EMETSELCH_000_131: Before long, they will remember their many differences, and return to squabbling.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_A1_000_001: You're wrong. They're better than that.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_A1_000_002: Says the arch Bringer of Chaos.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_EMETSELCH_000_132: Oh, if I had a gil for every time one of you heroes made that claim...
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_EMETSELCH_000_133: Ah hah hah! Flattery will get you nowhere, .
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_EMETSELCH_000_134: But seriously, we Ascians do what we do for the greater good. For the Rejoining.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_EMETSELCH_000_135: Though we may sow the seeds of chaos, it is man who tends them, he who reaps their bountiful harvest.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_EMETSELCH_000_136: But I grow tired of these arguments. If you would kindly refrain from retorting and return to your customary brooding silence, I will take it as thanks for rescuing your companion and leave it at that.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_EMETSELCH_000_137: Now, we mustn't keep your friends waiting.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_EMETSELCH_000_140: I told you, I tire of these inane arguments. Shouldn't you be getting ready to slay the next Lightwarden or something?
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_YSHTOLA_000_150: My apologies for having put you all through such an ordeal. I could see no other way to save the Night's Blessed. Happily, both they and I yet live─thanks to you.
TEXT_LUCKMC118_03339_YSHTOLA_000_151: But our work here is not yet done. We must make ready to enter the Qitana Ravel, and put the Lightwarden to the sword.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_YSHTOLA_000_000: Tell me, what has happened since our encounter with the Eulmorans?
