TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_THANCRED_000_005: Though it leaves a rather sour taste in my mouth saying so... I'm glad that Emet-Selch was here.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_THANCRED_000_006: We can but pray Y'shtola never does anything so reckless again.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_RYNE_000_010: Urianger once told me that being immersed in the Lifestream can cause irreparable harm to the body. Do you suppose Y'shtola is all right?
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_URIANGER_000_015: In all of history, there are but few who have returned from a misadventure in the aetherial sea possessed of mind and body both.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_URIANGER_000_016: To have done so twice beggareth belief. 'Tis plain Y'shtola wanteth not for favor among the Twelve.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_RUNAR_000_020: By all that is dark, Master Matoya is returned! She stands here before me yet still I cannot believe it.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_UIMET_000_025: With your friend returned, you will resume your exploration of the ruins, yes? But say the word and we shall assist you.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_CYMET_000_030: It was fate who brought you to us, and fate who returned your companion to you. She yet smiles on Ronka, I am sure of it.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_EMETSELCH_000_035: I told you, I tire of these inane arguments. Shouldn't you be getting ready to slay the next Lightwarden or something?
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_ALMET_000_040: With the Eulmorans gone, and your companion now returned, I think it best you go now before they can regroup.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_ALMET_000_041: With magic flowing once more through the Great Pyramid of Ux'ner, the entrance to the Qitana Ravel should now be open.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_YSHTOLA_000_042: Before we leave─Urianger, did you discover anything that may suggest the Lightwarden hides elsewhere?
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_URIANGER_000_043: Nay. Though we had but little time before the Eulmorans' most unwelcome arrival, we scoured the nearby environs and spoke once more with the one called Korille.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_URIANGER_000_044: Having hearkened to her tale, it is my judgment that the sin eater which her late mother did espy was indeed the being we seek, and that it most likely resided in the vicinity of Rak'tika Falls.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_URIANGER_000_045: In the absence of any subsequent sighting, I have no reason to believe our quarry hath sought out a new sanctuary. And given the considerable difficulty we face in reaching the falls, we may be certain it hath not been disturbed by man.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_YSHTOLA_000_047: We must navigate the Qitana Ravel and make for Rak'tika Falls.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_ALMET_000_048: Though you see it as but another obstacle to be navigated, the Qitana Ravel is the oldest and most sacred of our temples. The accumulated knowledge of the empire is said to reside within.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_ALMET_000_049: Knowledge which is rightly yours as allies of Ronka. You are welcome to explore.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_YSHTOLA_000_050: I fully intend to survey every ilm of it─once our mission is complete.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_UIMET_000_051: Were the emperor still alive, he would be overjoyed to hear you say so.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_UIMET_000_052: But I must warn you─though the way is open, it will still be heavily guarded.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_CYMET_000_053: To discourage trespassers and test the worth of our allies, it had to be so.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_ALMET_000_055: Head east and you will find the path of azure flowers leading to the Ravel. I wish you safe passage through its halls.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_RUNAR_000_056: Master Matoya. I know I cannot dissuade you from going, so please─promise me you will return safely. The Night's Blessed need you...
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_YSHTOLA_000_057: You need not worry, Runar. I shall return, and bring with me a long-awaited gift. One the Night's Blessed will treasure now and forevermore.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_YSHTOLA_000_060: This had better work. I have no wish to return to the Great Pyramid.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_RYNE_000_070: I can't imagine what could have survived in there after so many years...
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_URIANGER_000_075: At long last, the time hath come to find out what wonders yet remain at the heart of Ronka.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_RUNAR_000_080: See that you take good care of Master Matoya, and may the shadows keep you.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_ALMET_000_085: Travel east along the path of azure flowers. The Qitana Ravel is not far.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_UIMET_000_090: The Qitana Ravel is said to be fiercely guarded. Please be careful.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_CYMET_000_095: You need not worry about the Eulmorans while you are inside. Should they return, we will be ready.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_EMETSELCH_000_100: Lest you doubt, I won't be helping you do battle with the Lightwarden. To accompany you thus is quite taxing enough.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_EMETSELCH_000_101: Now, if you've no further questions...?
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_A1_000_001: Are there any other Ascians here in the First?
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_EMETSELCH_000_102: Not a single one. Happily, I am quite content to mingle with the masses. And even if I did crave the company of my own kind, one might say we're understaffed at present.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_EMETSELCH_000_103: There are no strict rules governing how we work, though that has not been without its consequences. In the beginning, we were each responsible for a shard, and free to do as we wished, but Igeyorhm's impetuous temperament showed us the folly in that.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_EMETSELCH_000_104: In light of her failings, we took to working in tandem as the situation demanded.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_EMETSELCH_000_105: Mitron and Loghrif were supposed to take care of the First, of course.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_EMETSELCH_000_106: Alas, they were slain by the champions of this realm shortly before the Flood. Expendable though they were, I found them quite useful.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_EMETSELCH_000_107: But that is a tale for another time.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_EMETSELCH_000_108: Then run along back to your friends and leave me be!
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_SYSTEM_000_110: You can feel the aether flowing through the door. A gentle push may be all that's required...
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_YSHTOLA_000_111: Our earlier efforts were not in vain, it seems.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_YSHTOLA_000_112: Stay on your guard, . We know not what awaits us inside.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_A2_000_002: Form a party and enter the Qitana Ravel.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_YSHTOLA_000_120: I never did tell you why I chose to take up thaumaturgy, did I?
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_YSHTOLA_000_121: As you will no doubt have noticed, life here in the First can be exceedingly unforgiving. Brutal, in a word.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_YSHTOLA_000_122: I had not long been in Norvrandt when I realized my mastery of conjuring magicks would not suffice to protect the people. 'Twas a struggle at first to embrace the change, but I confess the path of the thaumaturge suits me rather well.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_THANCRED_000_125: Keep an eye on Y'shtola and Urianger, would you? It wouldn't surprise me in the slightest if one of them wandered off to inspect the temple's relics.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_THANCRED_000_126: Well, let's get this over with, shall we?
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_RYNE_000_130: To think we'll be the first people in thousands of years to set foot inside this place.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_RYNE_000_131: It's humbling. Knowing they've entrusted us with the history of their people. With their legacy...
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_URIANGER_000_135: When Thancred and I spoke with Korille, she described unto us the form of our quarry, just as her mother had once done unto her.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_URIANGER_000_136: 'Tis a feathered beast possessed of three heads, both simian and canine in nature. An abomination amongst abominations. Were Alphinaud to paint the picture sketched by the lady's words, the result would surely turn the blood to ice.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_THANCRED_000_140:
The eldest and most powerful of primals... Gods. If that were Hydaelyn's origin, then what would that make─
...No. No, I will not take the words of an Ascian on trust. It has to be a lie.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_RYNE_000_145: Thancred did tell me about primals...but I don't fully understand what all of this means.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_URIANGER_000_150: 'Tis oft said truth is a matter of perspective. Yet upon this matter, there can be but one truth. I only pray it is not his.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_ALMET_000_160: , you are returned! But...something troubles you. Is aught amiss?
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_UIMET_000_165: What has happened to the sky!? I have never seen anything like it!
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_YSHTOLA_000_180: That was an enlightening experience. Though not in the way I had hoped.
TEXT_LUCKMC119_03340_YSHTOLA_000_181: Do you suppose there is any truth in Emet-Selch's claims?
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_THANCRED_000_000:
The eldest and most powerful of primals... Gods. If that were Hydaelyn's origin, then what would that make─
...No. No, I will not take the words of an Ascian on trust. It has to be a lie.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_RYNE_000_005: Thancred did tell me about primals...but I don't fully understand what all of this means.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_URIANGER_000_010: 'Tis oft said truth is a matter of perspective. Yet upon this matter, there can be but one truth. I only pray it is not his.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_ALMET_000_015: , you are returned! But...something troubles you. Is aught amiss?
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_UIMET_000_020: What has happened to the sky!? I have never seen anything like it!
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_YSHTOLA_000_030: Though recent events plainly warrant further discussion, I think it best that we wait until Alphinaud and the others are present.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_YSHTOLA_000_031: ...Emet-Selch included. How convenient that he should choose this moment to keep to the shadows.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_YSHTOLA_000_032: Well...no matter. For the present, we should return to Fanow and make certain of the Eulmorans' withdrawal.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_YSHTOLA_000_033: After that, Slitherbough. The Blessed are no doubt elated by what has become of the sky.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_ALMET_000_040: You are returned. And unharmed, I see.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_YSHTOLA_000_041: Indeed. I am pleased to report that the Lightwarden is no more, thanks in large part to you.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_ALMET_000_042: That the death of a single sin eater should make such a difference...
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_ALMET_000_043: As our numbers waned, so too did our hope that the ruins we have devoted our lives to guarding would ever find purpose.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_ALMET_000_044: Yet here you are, the allies for whom we have waited these many centuries. And with your arrival came the chance to pass on our legacy─the ancient wisdom of the empire.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_ALMET_000_045: That alone would have been reward enough... Never did we imagine it would serve to banish the Light that pervaded these woods.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_ALMET_000_046: On behalf of the Viis, our forebears, and the late emperor of Ronka, you have our deepest thanks.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_YSHTOLA_000_047: It is we who should be thanking you. Our journey through the Qitana Ravel proved...most enlightening.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_YSHTOLA_000_048: To be privy to such knowledge is an honor. One for which we never hoped...
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_CYMET_000_049: Please, you need not be so humble!
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_ALMET_000_050: We but do our duty as decreed by the late emperor. Would that he were still with us to express his gratitude in person.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_UIMET_000_051: But Sister, does this not mean our duty is fulfilled?
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_ALMET_000_052: To our allies, perhaps, but the ruins cannot be left unguarded.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_ALMET_000_053: So long as we live here in these woods, the secrets of Ronka must not fall into the wrong hands.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_ALMET_000_055: No, we escorted him back to Slitherbough shortly after you set out.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_ALMET_000_056: If you would return to the Night's Blessed, we will not keep you any longer. I suspect they would be glad of your company.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_YSHTOLA_000_057: Thank you, Almet. I look forward to a day when we might share a more leisurely visit to the ruins of Ronka.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_ALMET_000_058: We will await your return, then.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_ALMET_000_060: Should you have need of the wisdom of Ronka again, you know where to find us.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_UIMET_000_065: Be it a year from now or ten, we look forward to your return.
TEXT_LUCKMC120_03341_CYMET_000_070: Perhaps someday we will visit your home instead.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_THANCRED_000_000: What Master Matoya did was completely and utterly reckless... But if not for her, a great many of the Night's Blessed would not be here.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_RYNE_000_005: Considering the Blessed have only just recovered from their encounter with the Eulmorans, Thancred and the others thought we should stay a while longer to be sure they're all right.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_RYNE_000_006: They're such a kind and caring people. I pray they never again have to face such hardship.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_URIANGER_000_010: It seems the Blessed were spared the worst of the Eulmorans' assault, for the better part of Ran'jit's forces abandoned Slitherbough in our pursuit.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_URIANGER_000_011: Had he been but a few steps faster, he may well hath foiled our efforts to slay the Lightwarden.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_YSHTOLA_000_020: Though it pains me to leave, it is time I returned with you and the others to the Crystarium.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_YSHTOLA_000_021: But before we go, might I speak with you in private? I will await you in my chambers.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_YSHTOLA_000_030: Thank you for coming. I thought to keep my suspicions to myself, but after witnessing your victory at Rak'tika Falls, I fear they prove true, and so I must share them with you.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_YSHTOLA_000_031: From the first when we met at Fort Gohn, your aether has appeared...tainted. Suffused with an overabundance of light not unlike the sin eaters.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_YSHTOLA_000_032: When you defeated the Lightwarden, I fear the light which poured forth from it was not negated by Hydaelyn's blessing. Rather, it was absorbed into your being.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_YSHTOLA_000_033: Urianger also suspects as much, though he is unwilling to share his thoughts on the matter.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_YSHTOLA_000_034: One thing is certain: with every Warden you defeat, the danger to you grows greater. Greater perhaps than we can imagine. If you begin to feel anything strange─anything at all─pray inform me at once.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_YSHTOLA_000_035: You should hurry, before the others begin to worry. Once I have sorted my things here I will join you.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_YSHTOLA_000_040: Pray go on ahead. I would first attend to this unsightly collection of books.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_YSHTOLA_000_041: <sigh> I'd always complained that her cave was such a mess, books and scrolls strewn about like a child's playthings. Gods, I really am turning into her...
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_THANCRED_000_050: We took one last patrol of the perimeter. All things considered, Slitherbough remains relatively unscathed.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_RYNE_000_051: Thanks to the antidote, all those who were poisoned will make a full recovery.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_RYNE_000_052: And with the night sky returned, their prayers have at last been answered.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_YSHTOLA_000_053: Sorry to keep you all waiting. Shall we be off, then?
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_URIANGER_000_054: Art thou certain this is best?
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_YSHTOLA_000_055: ...I'll not deny there is a part of me that wishes I could stay.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_YSHTOLA_000_056: For two years I have lived with the Blessed, learned their culture, even going so far as to adopt Master Matoya's name as my own. I but pray I did honor to it.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_YSHTOLA_000_057: Now is not the time for doubt or hesitation. Come, we must return to the Crystarium.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_THANCRED_000_060: Hopefully the others will arrive before long.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_RYNE_000_065: I know he said he would be watching from the shadows, but doesn't it seem wrong to leave without at least telling Emet-Selch?
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_URIANGER_000_070: 'Twas passing strange to see the Crystarium so seemingly desolate, yet it appears all is well.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_YSHTOLA_000_080: All things considered, it is hardly surprising that Alphinaud and Alisaie have yet to arrive, but where is the Exarch?
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_ALPHINAUD_000_081: My friends! 'Tis good to see you all again.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_YSHTOLA_000_082: Alphinaud! It has been too long.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_ALPHINAUD_000_083: I assume your presence here means you've brought word of the Warden hiding in Rak'tika?
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_ALPHINAUD_000_084: Found and slain, you say? I should have known.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_MYSTERYVOICE_000_08: Eulmore has but recently dispatched soldiers to all corners of Norvrandt to defend them. I am glad to see their efforts were wasted on the Greatwood.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_THANCRED_000_086: Speaking of Eulmore, what came of your meeting with Vauthry?
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_MYSTERYVOICE_000_08: Yes, about that. It proved to be...
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_ALPHINAUD_000_089: Exarch, you mustn't push yourself. Your time away from the tower has clearly taken its toll.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_ALPHINAUD_000_090: No doubt you all are tired as well, having traveled so far. Why don't we all take a much-needed rest before we discuss our findings?
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_YSHTOLA_000_091: I thought to propose the very same. After your clash with the Warden, you deserve a chance to recuperate.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_THANCRED_000_092: It's settled, then. We reconvene after everyone has had time to settle in.
TEXT_LUCKMC121_03342_GUIDEOFTHEPENDANTS_: Welcome back, . Returned from a lengthy excursion, I take it.
Well, your room has been made ready, if you'd care to retire?
Very good. I pray you sound sleep and pleasant dreams.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_GUIDEOFTHEPENDANTS_: Ah, I suspected that you might be awake. I could scarce imagine you sleeping through such a commotion.
An entire host of sin eaters appears to be advancing upon the Crystarium. Emergency measures are being taken as we speak.
Rest assured, however, that we are safe so long as we remain under the Crystal Tower's aegis. You may return to your quarters, if you wish.
Yes, I thought you might feel that way. And I cannot say that your assistance would be anything less than welcome.
I must remain here to disseminate information to the other residents, but you are under no such obligation─and thus free to aid any of the townsfolk who may be in distress.
The Exedra tends to become a point of congregation in times of need, crowded with those seeking solace in companionship. You would have my personal gratitude if you would offer succor to those there.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_SYSTEM_000_010: Few townsfolk are about, and you spy none who appear to be in distress.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALISAIE_000_012: I've only just returned from Amh Araeng, yet I find the Crystarium moments from being beset by sin eaters!?
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALISAIE_000_013: Where are they coming from? This shouldn't be possible─we restored the darkness!
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALPHINAUD_000_014: Well, this is a fortunate coincidence.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALISAIE_000_015: Brother! Tell me you have some idea why this is happening.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALPHINAUD_000_016: I may─but for the moment we'll need to postpone such discussions in favor of action.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALPHINAUD_000_017: The Crystal Exarch is preparing to deploy a barrier around the Crystarium as we speak. Ensuring that he is able to do so should be our first concern.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALPHINAUD_000_018: There are a number of instruments placed about the Crystarium that function as anchors for the barrier. I'm on my way to activate them now.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALISAIE_000_019: ...In which case, three pairs of hands would be better than one? Very well. I'll take the ones to the south.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALPHINAUD_000_020: I shall deal with the northern apparatus, then. Will you handle the western two? They're ensconced on platforms extending from the upper level of the aetheryte plaza.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_SYSTEM_000_030: Despite having very little idea as to how it functions, it appears that you have activated the device successfully.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALISAIE_000_040: If Alphinaud is opting to act first and speak later, I don't doubt the urgency of the situation. Let's go.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALPHINAUD_000_050: We ought to join the vanguard as soon as possible. If the number of eaters we just saw is any indication, we'll be facing a formidable host.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALISAIE_000_100: What lovely weather. Just what we needed.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALPHINAUD_000_101: It seems the battle has already begun in earnest. Make haste!
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_SYSTEM_000_102: Crystarium forces are engaging the sin eaters at various locations across Lakeland.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_SYSTEM_000_103: Assist them in defeating the eaters before they are decimated.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALPHINAUD_000_105: But our task is as it ever was─turn the tide!
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALPHINAUD_000_110: Bear it just a moment longer...
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_YSHTOLA_000_120: Take a deep breath for me. That's it...
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALISAIE_000_130: It seems we've driven them back─for the time being, at least.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALISAIE_000_131: The wounded have been collected and are undergoing treatment now. Once they're ready to be moved, we'll have them carried back to the Crystarium.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALISAIE_000_132: The dead as well, of course. Those whose bodies remain, anyway...
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: More eaters. Don't let your guard down.
Those eaters...they're moving toward Radisca's Round.
We should follow─but we cannot neglect those in need of aid.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALISAIE_BATTLETALK_: If it's this bad here, I shudder to think what it's like elsewhere...
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_YSHTOLA_BATTLETALK_: A timely arrival, . I have my hands full here.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_URIANGER_BATTLETALK: Mine own magicks shall suffice to aid Y'shtola. I bid thee offer succor to the guard.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_YSHTOLA_BATTLETALK_: The eater's aether swells. I would hate to find out what it intends to do next.
Defend me─let none interrupt my incantation.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_URIANGER_BATTLETALK: Draw the lesser eaters within the perimeter!
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_YSHTOLA_BATTLETALK_: Master Matoya has a few tricks up her sleeve. Allow me to demonstrate.
As if you've none of your own. Let's make for the Imperative, shall we?
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_URIANGER_BATTLETALK: Hesitate not should any eaters cross our path.
Someone hath made short work of these eaters...
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_RYNE_BATTLETALK_000: ! You'll be glad to know that the locals have all taken shelter.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_THANCRED_BATTLETALK: Nevertheless, we can't allow the eaters to gain any ground. With me!
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_SOLDIER_BATTLETALK_: Hold your ground, even if it cost you your life!
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_THANCRED_BATTLETALK: Gods damn it all, we're too late...
I'll follow the eater. You press on to the Imperative.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: We've lost too many already. We must hurry.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_YSHTOLA_BATTLETALK_: These eaters are too organized. They cannot merely be acting on instinct.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: The lives of the wounded are in our hands!
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_URIANGER_BATTLETALK: Have care. That is no ordinary eater.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_YSHTOLA_BATTLETALK_: They're protecting it, somehow. We shall need to deal with them first.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: I feel a swell of aether! Gather around me, quickly!
Perhaps now is the time to put my research to the test.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALISAIE_BATTLETALK_: , buy me some time. Alphinaud─I'll need aether.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: Right. Everyone, channel your aether into Alisaie!
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_URIANGER_BATTLETALK: The power of the stars do I bequeath to thee.
TEXT_LUCKMD101_03606_ALISAIE_BATTLETALK_: We fight for those who cannot!
I must keep fighting... I must...
TEXT_LUCKMD102_03607_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Bear it just a moment longer...
TEXT_LUCKMD102_03607_YSHTOLA_000_010: Take a deep breath for me. That's it...
TEXT_LUCKMD102_03607_ALISAIE_000_020: The others are helping to treat the wounded. I'm planning to assist in moving them, but even so, we simply don't have enough hands.
TEXT_LUCKMD102_03607_ALISAIE_000_021: I'm sure you're fit to fall over after what we've been through─gods know I am─but if you could see to a few of the patients, it would be an enormous help.
TEXT_LUCKMD102_03607_ALISAIE_000_022: Captain Lyna is about somewhere, so you might also consider asking her if there are any other outstanding areas of need. We'll talk later.
TEXT_LUCKMD102_03607_ALISAIE_000_025: Just hold on. You'll be in the next carriage back to the Crystarium, I promise...
TEXT_LUCKMD102_03607_SYSTEM_000_031: With tear-filled eyes, the prone man gazes up at you. His fingers twitch, as if to reach for you, but he lacks the strength to raise his hand.
TEXT_LUCKMD102_03607_INJUREDB03607_000_0: If I turn, please... Please, kill me, I beg you.
TEXT_LUCKMD102_03607_INJUREDC03607_000_0: I killed her... I killed her! She was one of them, I know, but I... <sob>
Maybe I deserve this... But she...
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_ALPHINAUD_000_000: A conveniently timed proclamation, to say the least. If he authored this tragedy, I swear...
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_ALISAIE_000_005: We've everything sorted here, and the wounded will be conveyed back to the Crystarium as soon as possible.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_URIANGER_000_010: If thy work here is done, I beseech thee seek out the Exarch. He will doubtless know other ways in which thou mayest be of service to the many.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_YSHTOLA_000_015: I assume Vauthry's words were heard in the Crystarium as well. We can only hope that they don't incite the unrest he so clearly hopes for.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_LYNA_000_020: Vauthry's ship is already gone. How flattering that he came all this way just to give his little speech.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_LYNA_000_021: ...I apologize for my earlier outburst. Rest assured that I have no intention of allowing any of my wounds to affect the performance of my duties─especially not now.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_LYNA_000_022: If I may─could I ask that you seek out Thancred and Minfilia for me? They endangered themselves on my behalf, and I would feel better knowing that they are well looked after.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_LYNA_000_023: Thancred, in particular, sustained quite an injury from that sin eater. I would not be surprised if he were in Spagyrics still.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_LYNA_000_030: I am fine, truly. Save your concern for those who were not so fortunate.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_THANCRED_000_040: ...You're here for me? I'm sorry to put you to the trouble─I'm fine. Really.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_THANCRED_000_041: The eater landed an unfortunately solid blow, but the healers here have done wonders.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_THANCRED_000_042: I'm more worried about Minfilia. She's not taken it well.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_THANCRED_000_043: Could I ask you to speak with her? My attempts to reach out seem to have had the opposite effect. She's gone off to the Hortorium, ostensibly to fetch herbs for Chessamile, but... Just talk to her, will you?
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_THANCRED_000_050: Please, find Minfilia. I'll be fine.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_SYSTEM_000_061: Minfilia appears to be lost in thought. Perhaps a gentle poke will get her attention.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_RYNE_000_071: Oh, . What are you doing here?
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_RYNE_000_073: It's my fault, you know. I jumped at the chance to help Lyna, but I was careless. And now...
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_A1_000_001: You can make up for it. By being there for him.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_A1_000_002: Then you'll be wanting to get those herbs for the healers.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_RYNE_000_075: I...are you sure? I've brought him nothing but trouble thus far.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_RYNE_000_076: And what if it's worse, next time? All I do is make mistakes, put others in danger...
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_RYNE_000_077: I'm sure that he'll resent me. For being this weak. Maybe he already does.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_RYNE_000_078: Oh, what have I done? I promised I'd be right back, and yet here I am...
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_RYNE_000_079: I know that I need to be better. I'm only allowed to be a part of this because I'm Minfilia, and I need to be...more like her.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_RYNE_000_080: All I do is make mistakes, put others in danger...
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_RYNE_000_081: But you're right. I can still help─if only by seeing these herbs safely to Chessamile.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_RYNE_000_082: There are only two left on the list, but I'll need to ask about this one. I've looked high and low, and I can't seem to find it anywhere. Would you mind collecting the other? I would hate to delay any longer than I already have.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_RYNE_000_083: You're looking for something with soft leaves that's very fragrant─“in an unmistakably medicinal way,” I was told. We only need two sprigs or so.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_RYNE_000_084: Once you've got them, you can bring them directly to Chessamile. Whoever gets there first can explain that the other will be back shortly. Thank you─I appreciate the help!
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_SYSTEM_000_090: This plant has no scent whatsoever. It is unlikely to be the herb Chessamile asked for...
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_SYSTEM_000_091: This plant has rigid leaves and smells of fruit. It is unlikely to be the herb Chessamile asked for...
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_SYSTEM_000_092: This plant has soft leaves and smells strongly medicinal!
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_THANCRED_000_100: I see you got roped into helping. Some things never change, eh?
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_RYNE_000_105: I asked someone who looked like they knew what they were doing, and they pointed me toward the herb I was looking for right away! I hope you didn't have too much trouble with yours.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_CHESSAMILE_000_110: Ah, Minfilia told me that you would be bringing the rest.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_CHESSAMILE_000_111: Marvelous. With this, I can replenish our store of medicines. We're struggling to keep up with the number of wounded that are being brought in.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_CHESSAMILE_000_112: I wasn't on the field, but it doesn't matter. The patients' faces make plain that it was a horrible battle.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_CHESSAMILE_000_113: And we're still fighting it, I suppose, though with bitter medicine rather than sharp steel. But we'll win─I promise you that.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_THANCRED_000_114: It seems that I owe you an apology for dragging you to yet another battlefield when you've just come off the front lines!
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_THANCRED_000_115: In both cases, I'm sure your efforts saved more than a few. With Spagyrics in good working order, the Crystarium's people will be well cared for.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_THANCRED_000_116: More lie ahead, of course─battles only you can fight. Not that we intend to let you do it alone. But that's a matter to discuss with the Exarch.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_THANCRED_000_118: We do. Was there something you needed?
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_SOLDIER03608_000_11: I need you to tell him something. For me.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_SOLDIER03608_000_12: My dearest friend, you see... He was there on the battlefield with me. But only the one of us is here to speak of it.
At the end, before the wound killed him, I heard his dying words.
"I never knew that our world was this beautiful,“ he told me. ”I'm so glad that I got to see the night sky...“

I don't know how the Exarch feels about what happened out there. I don't know if what Vauthry said is true─if our losses were our just deserts, and we doom ourselves to worse by continuing to fight this fight.
But I believe in the Warrior of Darkness. In the Crystal Exarch. I don't think what they've done is wrong, and I don't think we're wrong to fight with them, either.
My friend, he smiled in the end. Just as he smiled when he raised his glass to celebrate the return of the night. That's how I want to remember him.
So I... I want to tell the Exarch. Don't give up. Don't give in. Please.
TEXT_LUCKMD103_03608_THANCRED_000_127: We'll tell him. You have my word.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_RYNE_000_000: If I were stronger...how many people would still be alive?
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_THANCRED_000_020: If you're ready, why not go on ahead to the Ocular? You can keep the Exarch company while I fetch Alphinaud. Don't worry, I mean to borrow the swiftest amaro I can find, so we shouldn't keep you long.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_THANCRED_000_021: Be sure to pass on that message, eh?
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_MYSTERYVOICE_000_03: Welcome, my friend. Tales of your heroism on the battlefield precede you─though I confess I found them more gladdening than surprising. I hear no few of our people have you to thank for plucking them from the jaws of death.
Would that they had not needed saving to begin with. But the responsibility for that lies with me.

...One of our soldiers said that?
...Thank you.
Rest assured that I fully intend to continue our work. I will not shrink from what must be done. Now least of all.
Though I mourn the lost, I will not lose myself to grief. And even should regret be my constant companion, I will follow the path I have chosen to its end.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_A1_000_001: We have some time before the others arrive, if you'd like to talk?
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_MYSTERYVOICE_000_03: ...And if I were to confess any doubts I might harbor, no one need ever know?
No, I believe you have enough burdens without my adding to them. Nevertheless... Thank you.
Of that I have no doubt. And if ever we should appear to falter...it will only be because we are fatigued after a battle well fought.
I thank you for your kind words. Now, we have plans to make, do we not?
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_MYSTERYVOICE_000_04: If this is the course you have agreed on, I will not object─though I am afraid it will be difficult for us to spare any of the guard to accompany you.
I can but promise that you will be well looked after upon your return. Just...see to it that you do return, all right?
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_ALPHINAUD_000_045: If I had only been able to locate Kholusia's Lightwarden, it might not have come to this...
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_ALISAIE_000_050: I can't imagine what Thancred must be feeling to behave this way. To say he's changed since coming here would be an understatement. He may as well be a different person. He reminds me of─
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_ALISAIE_000_052: He argued with us for months about our plan to go to Eorzea, but in the end, he accepted our decision. I...do hope he's doing well.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_URIANGER_000_055: Though Thancred hath long known whither this path doth lead, his journey hath brought him no closer to acceptance.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_YSHTOLA_000_060: Minfilia demonstrated impressive resolve just now. It seems that she understands what must be done...though I do wonder if she is truly prepared to make the choice.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_YSHTOLA_000_061: Should she falter, it will fall to Thancred to guide her. However much he wishes it were otherwise.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_EMETSELCH_000_065: <sigh> Will you never grow tired of shuffling your feet?
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_EMETSELCH_000_066: If you have something to ask me, ask.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_EMETSELCH_000_067: As I told you before─Zodiark is the creation of my people. The first people.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_EMETSELCH_000_068: We summoned Him, as your kind might summon a primal─albeit an infinitely more powerful one.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_EMETSELCH_000_069: And like one of your primals, He tempered us. It was only natural. There is no resisting such power.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_EMETSELCH_000_070: And so we Ascians came to exist solely to bring about the rule of darkness. His darkness.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_EMETSELCH_000_071: Of course, some would call us “evil” for it...and they would be fools. Though that is only to be expected, given their innate inability to conceive of the nature of our universe.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_EMETSELCH_000_072: ...But I believe I am repeating myself. Do you not trust me to speak honestly? Do you hope to catch me in a lie?
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_EMETSELCH_000_073: Really. I have no need of deception─and even if I did, I assure you: you would find it quite indistinguishable from the truth.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_EMETSELCH_000_074: Hmph. Perhaps I flatter myself expecting you to take an interest in the knowledge I possess. Or perhaps I flatter you.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_RYNE_000_080: I'm sorry to be so insistent. But I know this is the only way.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_RYNE_000_081: If you're willing to give me a chance, come with us.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_RYNE_000_090: Sorry for the wait─I'm ready now.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_A3_000_001: And you're sure you want to do this? Completely sure?
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_A3_000_002: There has to be another way.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_RYNE_000_091: Look...no matter what happens to me, I'm sure that I don't want to go back to being who I was.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_RYNE_000_092: I want to be stronger─strong enough to face my destiny. And I want to believe that I can play a part in saving this world.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_RYNE_000_093: I hope you can find it in yourself to believe it, too.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_YSHTOLA_000_094: When you put it that way, how could we not?
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_YSHTOLA_000_095: It is your decision to make. Just be sure that you are prepared, when the time comes.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_URIANGER_000_096: If all are assembled, shall we depart?
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_THANCRED_000_097: We'll follow your lead. What route would you have us take?
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_ALISAIE_000_098: About that─there's something I neglected to mention.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_ALISAIE_000_099: I saw a Eulmoran airship coming in to land over Amh Araeng while I was on my way back to the Crystarium.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_ALISAIE_000_100: No doubt the same vessel that bore Vauthry's forces to Rak'tika.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_ALPHINAUD_000_101: ...Meaning we can expect to encounter armed resistance on our journey through the region.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_ALISAIE_000_102: Right. Now, Nabaath Areng lies in the southern reaches of Amh Araeng, and there are two routes we can take to get there.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_ALISAIE_000_103: The first is the eastern route, which would lead us past Mord Souq.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_ALISAIE_000_104: The other is the western route, which would require us to pass through the Hills of Amber.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_THANCRED_000_105: Minfilia and I took the eastern route last time.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_ALISAIE_000_106: Yes, that's the more well-trodden path. It also makes for easier traversal of the Nabaath Severance.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_ALISAIE_000_108: If we did, we'd need to cross the Severance from a point nearby the Inn at Journey's Head.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_ALISAIE_000_109: If the Eulmorans caught wind of our approach, it could very well bring them into contact with the Inn and its patients─and we can be sure their activities would not meet with Vauthry's approval.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_ALISAIE_000_110: It will make the journey more arduous, but I believe it would be safer to take the western route. Which brings me to my proposition.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_ALISAIE_000_111: While you make for the Hills of Amber in the west, I will draw the Eulmorans' attention elsewhere─to an area in the east that I know to be uninhabited.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_ALISAIE_000_112: That way, you'll have a chance at reaching Nabaath Areng unopposed, and without risk to civilians.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_ALPHINAUD_000_113: Hm. I cannot deny that it's a sound plan─but nor can I allow you to go alone. My skills will make your task at least somewhat easier, will they not?
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_YSHTOLA_000_114: I will accompany you as well. It will afford us a chance to have a proper conversation.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_YSHTOLA_000_115: ...And if I go with the others, I'm likely to say something Thancred will regret.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_THANCRED_000_116: Well then, we'll leave the work of distracting Vauthry's forces to you. The rest of us will take the western route, and try to avoid attracting attention.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_THANCRED_000_117: With that in mind, I think it best that we follow the road from the Bridges. We'll move faster with a solid path under our feet.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_ALISAIE_000_118: We'll borrow a few amaro for our own journey. I leave the rest to you, Minfilia.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_RYNE_000_119: Thank you. I'll try not to disappoint.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_RYNE_000_130: We'll need to move quickly. The longer the others need to keep the Eulmorans busy, the more likely they are to be caught.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_URIANGER_000_135: Would that we all had thy surety of purpose.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_THANCRED_000_140: There you are. The gate leading to Amh Araeng is just up ahead.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_THANCRED_000_141: In all the time I've been here, I've never ventured into the Hills of Amber. Not that I'm particularly intimidated by new lands, at this point─but we have more than enough reasons to be cautious as it is.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_THANCRED_000_142: ...Keep an eye on Minfilia for me, would you?
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_THANCRED_000_150: Amh Araeng lies just beyond the gate. We need only speak to the sentry.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_URIANGER_000_156: Who shall walk among us upon our return, I wonder...
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_HARDYSS_000_160: Off so soon,  ? You've barely had time to recover from the battle!
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_HARDYSS_000_161: Well, if you're certain, I'm hardly in a position to question you.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_HARDYSS_000_165: The Hills of Amber lie beyond.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_THANCRED_000_170: A village so near? How convenient.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_URIANGER_000_175: Sound though Mistress Alisaie's logic was, I fear the road less traveled hath other perils in store for us.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_RYNE_000_180: This place has been scarred by the Flood too. Who can say what lies ahead?
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_RYNE_000_181: But whatever else this road may be, it is mine to travel. And I don't plan to take a moment of the time I spend upon it for granted.
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_CHESSAMILE_000_005: We have everything we need now. Leave it to me to administer the medicine. Though the patients may not be keen on the taste, they will soon forgive it when their hurts are healed.“
TEXT_LUCKMD104_03609_SOLDIER03608_000_01: Once I'm properly back on my feet, I will fight again. For him, and for all of us.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_RYNE_000_000: Our only path forward lies ahead─I'm sure of it. So...onward, I suppose!
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_URIANGER_000_005: Sound though Alisaie's logic was, I fear that other perils awaiteth upon this road less traveled.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_THANCRED_000_010: I take it you're seeing what I'm seeing?
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_THANCRED_000_011: Finding a village when we're hardly ten paces into the hills is a surprising stroke of luck─especially given our recent fortunes─but you won't hear any complaints from me. Let's see if the folk who live here can tell us what to expect from the road ahead.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_ZHUNZUN_000_020: You sell? No... No, you are no merchant. But then, why do I know your face? Hm...
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_ZHUNZUN_000_021: Oh, I remember! You spent Voeburt gold!
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_ZHUNZUN_000_022: Such a coinpurse cracking! You are already a legend among Mord traders!
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_THANCRED_000_023: You're a traveling merchant, then. Can you tell us anything of this village?
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_ZHUNZUN_000_024: Of course, anything for valued customers!
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_ZHUNZUN_000_025: This place is Garik. Before the Flood, it was home to many miners. After, not so many. Now, none.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_ZHUNZUN_000_026: So Master Ghen Gen borrowed the village─made it into a trading post. Very convenient location!
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_RYNE_000_027: In which case, you all must be familiar with the local roads, correct?
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_RYNE_000_028: We're on our way to Nabaath Areng, ourselves. If we continue south from here, will we have any difficulties reaching it?
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_ZHUNZUN_000_030: The Flood rent the stone and crushed the mines surrounding Nabaath Areng. Only steep cliffs and collapsed tunnels remain.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_RYNE_000_032: But surely there must be some way. Do you think any of the other Mord might have some sort of hidden route?
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_ZHUNZUN_000_033: Perhaps. You ask, they tell. Tell for free, even, to friends of our best customer.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_RYNE_000_034: Wonderful! Thank you for your help.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_THANCRED_000_035: Well then, “best customer,” let's see what information your reputation buys us.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_THANCRED_000_040: If we're not lucky enough to encounter anyone who knows a route to Nabaath Areng here, perhaps they can at least point us in the direction of others who might.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_RYNE_000_045: I've got it! I'll lead by asking how business is, then mention you, and then ask about the route. That...should work, right?
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_URIANGER_000_050: Perhaps we ought to inquire upon the matter of Eulmoran forces in the region, as well.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_ZHUNZUN_000_055: Remember Zhun Zun next time your pockets grow heavy with coin, yes?
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_RHILRIL_000_060: You wish to go to Nabaath Areng? Hm...
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_RHILRIL_000_061: There was a way, once. A gondola down from the cliffs. But it was built for those who had left something behind that they wished to retrieve. Now there is nothing left, and no one to use it.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_RHILRIL_000_062: You may search for it, if you like. But I doubt that its rusted wires would bear your weight.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_SYSTEM_100_062: You hastily take down a memo regarding the gondola on a spare scrap of parchment.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_RHILRIL_000_063: Do try not to end up dangling upside down over a cliff.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_SHULSUL_000_064: Oh, that is a surprise! Not many bound for Nabaath Areng these days.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_SHULSUL_000_065: I do know of a trolley that once went there─it used to travel between all the settlements and mines of the Hills of Amber.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_SHULSUL_000_066: It is locked behind a gate, however. I assume that will have kept it from being stolen or damaged, but it also prevents it from being of much use.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_SYSTEM_100_066: You take down information regarding the trolley on a wrinkled piece of parchment before stuffing it unceremoniously back into your bag.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_SHULSUL_000_067: If you want to use the trolley, you will need to do something about that gate.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_GHONGON_000_068: For Nabaath Areng, airship is best. Nothing is faster than an airship!
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_GHONGON_000_069: The Eulmorans have one, I hear. You can ask them to take you!
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_SYSTEM_100_069: Though it seems somewhat superfluous to do so, you dutifully make note of Ghon Gon's words.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_GHONGON_000_070: You must find your own airship, if the Eulmorans will not help you.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_THANCRED_000_080: Ah, . I'm afraid I've learned little of use about how to reach Nabaath Areng. The Eulmoran presence, though─that's another matter.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_THANCRED_000_081: Apparently, though their army is definitely in Amh Araeng, there have been no sightings of Eulmorans at all in the Hills of Amber. Perhaps we can take that as a sign that Alisaie's plan has borne fruit.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_THANCRED_000_082: Did you have any better luck finding us a route forward?
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_THANCRED_000_083: So these are our options... Well, what do you think?
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_A1_000_001: We can try the gondola. Might die, but eh.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_A1_000_002: Can we get an airship anywhere? Not from Vauthry, obviously.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_A1_000_003: Gate aside, the trolley seems most feasible.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_THANCRED_000_084: I'd rather not, if it's all the same to you. If it went poorly, we couldn't simply wave our hands and vanish into the aether like Y'shtola─not that I would recommend it, even if we could.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_THANCRED_000_085: Hmm... We could perhaps use amaro, but even from a distance, I can't imagine that the Eulmoran Army wouldn't spot us if we were to travel by air.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_THANCRED_000_086: It does seem to be the least risky of our options, and I can't imagine one gate is enough to thwart you.
TEXT_LUCKMD105_03610_THANCRED_000_087: I'd like to know a bit more before we dash off in search of it, though. Perhaps Zhun Zun can offer some insight.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THANCRED_000_000: Though Zhun Zun didn't mention the trolley before, he's like as not at least heard of the thing. If we remind him, he may recall something of use.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_RYNE_000_005: I hope you've had more luck than I...
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_URIANGER_000_010: Shall I take the glimmer in thine eye to mean that thou hast struck upon a promising lead?
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_ZHUNZUN_000_020: Oh, valued customers! Were the other Mord of help?
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THANCRED_000_021: Of a fashion. They told us of a trolley that runs to Nabaath Areng, at least...
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THANCRED_000_022: But am I correct in thinking that there was a reason you did not do so yourself, when first we asked?
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_ZHUNZUN_000_023: Mm, yes... The gate, you see. It is impassable.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_ZHUNZUN_000_024: Before, there was a hulking thing of stone─the Talos. It opened the gate, they say.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_ZHUNZUN_000_025: But none operate such a thing now. I do not even know if it yet exists.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_ZHUNZUN_000_026: I do not know, but... You should travel east to Mount Biran Mines! That is where the trolley controls stand.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_ZHUNZUN_000_027: I still see miners there from time to time. If anyone knows what happened to the Talos...
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_RYNE_000_028: ...It would be them! Thank you, you've been a great help!
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THANCRED_000_029: We're off to Mount Biran, then. Let's hope that someone will be there to answer our questions.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_RYNE_000_041: Oh, pardon me! It's only... It's a bit daunting, isn't it?
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_URIANGER_000_045: Mayhap the pall of light is the root of this land's desolation. Or mayhap the fault lies with man and his insatiable greed...
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_ZHUNZUN_000_050: Watch for beasts in the Hills! I do not like to lose customers.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THANCRED_000_060: The scale of the track is impressive, I'll give them that. Now we only need follow it until we come to the mines.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_RYNE_000_070: This lever can't have been designed for a person to operate...
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_URIANGER_000_075: ...But by what means did they harness the necessary aether?
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THANCRED_000_080: Bit of a mess, isn't it? But the mechanisms for dispatching the trolley are here, just as Zhun Zun said.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THANCRED_000_081: Unfortunately, anyone who might know how to use them is not. We might wait for Zhun Zun's mysterious miners to appear, or have a look around and see if we can deduce anything useful in their absence. I'm in favor of the latter.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THANCRED_000_082: Something near the entrance to the mines proper caught Urianger's eye. Meet us there if you find anything.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THANCRED_000_090: As much as I wish we could count on someone conveniently appearing to explain all of this to us, I'm sure you're aware that we don't have the time to waste.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_SYSTEM_000_100: Flecks of rust adorn the rails, but they nevertheless appear sturdy enough to bear the trolley without issue.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_SYSTEM_000_101: The benches within suggest that this must have been a passenger car. Oddly enough, though it is clearly old, it appears to be well maintained.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_SYSTEM_000_102: The cup is slightly warm, and a fair amount of tea─steeped overlong, if the color is any indication─remains within.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_URIANGER_000_111: I see... Indeed, thine observations are consistent with mine own.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_URIANGER_000_112: But let us refrain from further discussion ere our comrades arrive...
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THANCRED_000_113: Ample evidence of recent maintenance, and lukewarm tea besides...
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_RYNE_000_114: The levers for switching tracks looked like they were in good condition, though I couldn't move them myself. No ordinary person could, I think...
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_URIANGER_000_115: It is my belief that no person is meant to.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_URIANGER_000_116: This “Talos” beareth more than a passing resemblance to golems of the Source...
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_URIANGER_000_117: Nor doth it appear to be the sole example of its kind. The proliferation of Talos fragments, as well as the enormity of the mechanisms here, suggest a considerable number were once in operation.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_URIANGER_000_118: Alas, this specimen and its fellows now lie lifeless and broken, and I know not how to repair them that they might facilitate our passage through the gate.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_URIANGER_000_119: And without the aid of the Talos, even if thou wert somehow able to unbar the trolley's path, we would still have no means of propelling it.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THANCRED_000_120: We might not know how to repair the Talos, but someone must. Otherwise, why keep everything else in working order? Whoever is maintaining the cars and rails must know something that we don't.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THANCRED_000_121: Let's ask them what it is, shall we?
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THANCRED_000_122: , I do believe you'll find a person of some interest skulking in the shadows behind the warehouses on the northwestern side of the tracks.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THANCRED_000_123: While you two have a friendly chat, the rest of us will gently encourage those to the south to come out of hiding.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THANCRED_000_124: Defend yourselves as necessary, of course, but do try to keep everyone in one piece.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_UNSUREMAN03611_000_: Wicked white! Where did you come from?
No, never mind that─you have no business here, of that I'm sure!
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_RYNE_000_140: I feel a bit bad for them...
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_URIANGER_000_145: They elected to take up arms against us, though the outcome was plain from the first.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THANCRED_000_161: These two weren't much trouble either. Let's see what they have to say for themselves.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THAFFE_000_162: Us? We're not the brigands come to...to take what isn't ours!
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THANCRED_000_163: Do we honestly look like we'd need to steal─what, some rusted bits of iron? Don't be absurd. We're not here to rob you.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THAFFE_000_164: A likely story. You look, well...
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THAFFE_000_165: You don't look normal, that's for certain. You don't have any wares, so you're clearly not merchants. Travelers never pass this way. The only reason you would come all the way out here is to strip the machinery for parts.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_JERYK_000_166: Oh, Thaffe, I have an idea! What if, once upon a time...
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_JERYK_000_167: A lovely lady of noble birth ventured forth in search of her lost love, joined by her two most loyal servants, sworn to follow her unto world's end. On their journey, they met a sorcerer, as ancient as time itself. Moved by the lady's devotion, he offered to be their guide, and they...
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THANCRED_000_169: ...I can only assume that you're being intentionally obtuse, but in the unlikely event that that's a serious conjecture─no. I suppose I am a bodyguard of a sort, but we have rather larger concerns than faerie tale romances.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_URIANGER_000_170: Though I would fain hear more of this ageless sorcerer and his heroic deeds...
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_RYNE_000_172: Um, if I may─we're actually searching for a means by which to travel to Nabaath Areng. We were hoping that the trolley here might offer a solution.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_RYNE_000_173: I realize that we haven't gotten off to the best of starts, but if you know anything about how we might get it working again...
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_JERYK_000_176: You should have led with that! We're always keen to discuss the trolley!
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_JERYK_000_177: (-Jeryk-)We're both engineers-in-training, in fact. Jeryk and Thaffe, at your service.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THAFFE_000_178: (-Thaffe-)Technically, I'm a miner, and he does repair work. But our true passion is the trolley.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_JERYK_000_179: (-Jeryk-)We're working with a few other folks to get it up and running again.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_JERYK_000_180: (-Jeryk-)And before you ask─yes, it's true that there's little in need of transport these days. But that's no reason to consign a miracle of mechanical innovation to dust. The mere sight of it traveling the track once again would make hearts soar, mark my words!
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THANCRED_000_181: You'll hear no argument from us. What progress have you made thus far?
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_JERYK_000_182: (-Jeryk-)Not as much as we'd like, truth be told.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_RYNE_000_183: Well, is there anything we could do to assist you? We could gather materials, or help put pieces together...
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THAFFE_000_184: (-Thaffe-)It's a sight more complicated than that, I'm afraid. If you spoke with Magnus, you'd understand. He's the only one with full knowledge of the trolley's operation.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THAFFE_000_185: (-Thaffe-)I suppose you could speak with him, if you like. We'll introduce you.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THANCRED_000_186: Very well. Our options are limited, and if this Magnus can explain whatever is preventing the trolley from being restored, I'd like to hear it.
TEXT_LUCKMD106_03611_THAFFE_000_187: (-Thaffe-)Right. It looks like you'll be following us back to Twine, then!
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THANCRED_000_000: <sigh> Come to think of it, Urianger always was fond of faerie tales...
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_RYNE_000_005: A quest for a lost love... Perhaps that could have been me, had things been different.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_URIANGER_000_010: Dost thou seek the sorcerer's wisdom, young one?
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_JERYK_000_015: To be honest, I'm impressed that you thought of the trolley to begin with. So few seem to, these days. Too used to living without it, I suppose.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THAFFE_000_020: If you're ready, we can leave right now.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THAFFE_000_021: Though...you haven't seen another fellow around here, have you? I thought he'd have come out by now.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THAFFE_000_022: You “think” he'll be all right? That's, er... Well, I suppose we did force your hand a bit.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_JERYK_000_023: I'll have a look. Just in case. You go on ahead, Thaffe.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THAFFE_000_024: Alright. Looks like it'll just be you lot and me, then. Try not to let anything take a bite out of you on the way out of the rail yard.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_JERYK_000_030: We'll catch up with you in Twine.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THAFFE_000_040: Damn, that smarts. Did he have to thump me so hard? I'll be feeling that for the next fortnight at least...
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THAFFE_000_041: Naught to be done about it now, though. I've pointed your overeager companions in the right direction and they've gone on ahead, so we need to get moving.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THAFFE_000_042: Normally we walk atop the tracks, but seeing as the young lady has a much shorter stride, that's more perilous a route than I'm comfortable suggesting. Wouldn't want anyone falling through the gaps.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THAFFE_000_043: Of course, the low road presents other dangers, but having been on the receiving end of your friend's blows, I'm not worried on that account.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THAFFE_000_050: Wait a moment. I think I hear something...
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THAFFE_000_051: Oh, that's something, all right! Run!
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THAFFE_000_060: Out of the frying pan and into the fire...
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THAFFE_000_070: Sorry about that. I'll admit─I didn't expect this route to be quite so fraught with danger.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THAFFE_000_071: We're nearly to Twine, though, so we should make it without further incident.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THANCRED_000_080: Odd to find a place like this still occupied─it must have come dangerously close to being consumed by the Flood.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_RYNE_000_085: The town is small, but everything in it seems so purposeful. It's amazing.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_URIANGER_000_090: A testament to man's resilience, that civilization may yet be found at the very edge of the world...
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THAFFE_000_100: This is it. Welcome to Twine!
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THAFFE_000_101: The original dwellings were built to house those laborers tasked with building the track. Over time miners came to seek their fortunes─and that's what made the town grow to what you see before you today. But it was still the trolley that brought them here.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THAFFE_000_102: As you've doubtless noticed, the track goes to the very heart of the town. It was the heart of the town, back when the trolley still carried everyone home at the end of each hard day in the mines.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THAFFE_000_103: Now there is no trolley─nor much work to be had in the mines, for that matter. The only residents that remain are the destitute, the delusional, and those with nowhere else to go. Or so they say.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THAFFE_000_104: That should give you some indication of what to expect when you meet Magnus. As I said, it will help you understand why we can't get the trolley running. Just...don't expect too much aside from that.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THANCRED_000_105: Well, that's encouraging. But I don't see that we have much choice. Let's go and meet the man.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THAFFE_000_110: This is Magnus. He's our boss, of a fashion.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_MAGNUS_000_120: Who are you supposed to be? Never seen the three of you in my life.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_MAGNUS_000_121: Or the...four of you? Wicked white, if you're going to bother me, at least have the damned courtesy to stand still!
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_URIANGER_000_122: Methinks this one is deep in his cups.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THAFFE_000_123: These are my guests, Magnus. We ran into them at the mines.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THAFFE_000_124: They're looking for a way to reach Nabaath Areng, so they came to ask about the trolley, you see...
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_MAGNUS_000_125: What? There's nothing in Nabaath Areng. Not anymore.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_MAGNUS_000_126: And especially not for frail little girls. Give it up.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_RYNE_000_127: ...No. We must reach Nabaath Areng. I must.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_MAGNUS_000_128: Bah. So you have your heart set on it─the world doesn't care. The place is a ruin, nothing more.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_MAGNUS_000_129: And you're not getting there in the trolley. The thing doesn't run on hopes and dreams.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THANCRED_000_130: We're not fools─it's necessity that drives us to Nabaath Areng. If you insist that the trolley is not an option, at least tell us why.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_MAGNUS_000_131: No. I'm sick of people asking me about the blasted thing. Leave me be.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_URIANGER_000_145: I sense there is more to this belligerent drunk and his tale...
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_THAFFE_000_155: I'd be lying if I said that I didn't expect that. But for what it's worth, I'm sorry.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_JERYK_000_160: Hello, again! Judging by the look on your face, I suppose you've met Magnus?
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_RYNE_000_170: He only said that because...because he thinks I'm weak. And he's right. But I can't be─I won't be forever.
TEXT_LUCKMD107_03612_RYNE_000_171: There has to be some way... I must find it.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_URIANGER_000_005: I sense there is more to this belligerent drunk and his tale...
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_THAFFE_000_015: I'd be lying if I said that I didn't expect that. But for what it's worth, I'm sorry.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_020: Hello, again! Judging by the look on your face, I suppose you've met Magnus?
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_RYNE_000_030: Oh! I'm sorry. I was...stuck in my own head again.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_RYNE_000_031: It's clear that Magnus has no intention of helping us, but perhaps we should ask the other residents? They may know something of the trolley.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_RYNE_000_032: I'll take the north side of town. Let me know if you learn anything!
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_URIANGER_000_033: Thancred, art thou truly content to stand witness to fate's course and take no part?
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_THANCRED_000_034: This isn't a matter of fate, Urianger. It's about choice. And I've had years to decide where I stand.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_THANCRED_000_035: Minfilia has spent too long in chains already. I would not shackle her again by making my hopes known.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_THANCRED_000_036: It is for her to choose what shape her destiny will take. It is for me to stay silent. To protect her, teach her, and stand by her. That, at least, I can do for her.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_URIANGER_000_037: ...So be it. Come, let us make our own inquiries.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_040: Oh, there you are! You'll be pleased to know that I got our friend back home with no trouble, and he's just fine. He was a bit shaken up, is all.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_041: And you? What did Magnus have to say?
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_042: Ah. I did have a faint hope that your need might prompt him to action where our interest has not, but I suppose that was foolish of me.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_043: I am sorry that we couldn't be of help, though. I could at least show you the trolley car we have here, if you like? You could give it a stroke or two─it has some very smooth wood...
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_044: You mean to say you're not giving up? Even knowing that Magnus is...Magnus?
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_045: I don't see much point in your being stubborn about it. Though...perhaps stubbornness is exactly what this situation calls for. Can't forge iron without an anvil, after all.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_046: I can't imagine that anything you try will work. But if you're certain, you can help me make preparations in the event that it does!
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_047: To that end─take this toolbox. We're going to inspect the rails!
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_048: I'll have a look along the tracks for anything that's in need of repair. You bring the tools, and be ready to hand them to me whenever I stop to work.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_050: This spot looks like it could use a bit of work. Can you ready the tools for me?
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_SYSTEM_000_055: Though rifling through hammers is doubtless someone's pastime, it would be more effective to open the toolbox where Jeryk can use its contents.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_SYSTEM_000_060: You open the box, revealing the proud array of lovingly maintained tools within.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_061: Brilliant! Now, if you could hand me what I need as I work, that would be a help.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_062: In this case, hmm... Well, this bolt is loose, for one matter. We can't have that. I'll need to tighten it.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_063: That's...not how this works. That's not how any of this works.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_064: I need something to tighten the bolt, please.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_065: Thank you! This one will do nicely.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_066: Now give me one moment, and...
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_067: There! I don't see any other problems here, so let's continue along the track.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_068: I could use this to wipe any excess oil clinging to the bolt, but I don't think that will be necessary in this case.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_069: I'd like to move right to tightening the bolt, so please hand me the tool for that.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_080: I'm a bit concerned about this lantern post. Would you ready the tools for me?
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_SYSTEM_000_090: You set down the toolbox, the muscles of your arms enjoying profound relief, and open it once again.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_091: You're quite handy to have around, you know?
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_092: As to the lamp here... These aren't often necessary these days, but if we're going to do this, we might as well do it properly.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_093: And if, by some miracle, the night returns, as it did in Lakeland... Well, it's a nice thought.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_094: Anyhow, a bit of this post seems to have splintered. Whether its lamp is to be lit or not, we wouldn't want these little pieces of wood jabbing the next person who comes through here to do maintenance. I'll need to sand it down a bit.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_095: Sure, I'll simply hack at it with this massive saw...
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_096: Honestly, are you away with the fae!? We're trying to prevent splinters, not chop down the post like a tree!
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_097: Now, hand me something a bit more delicate, if you please.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_098: Er... You have an interesting sense of humor.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_099: Now, can I have the proper tool this time?
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_102: That should do it. I'll bring some varnish along next time to finish the job.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_103: I haven't spotted any other problems, so we can move along now. Unless you'd like to take in the view of the tracks from here for a bit longer? It's breathtaking, I know.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_104: Mining has always been the primary vocation of folks in the Hills of Amber, you see. But after a certain point, they had dug up everything that could easily be reached and carried back by manpower alone.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_105: It was then that the Nabaath Empire struck upon the idea of the Talos, which they had seen at work abroad.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_106: At great expense, the Nabaath brought the Mystel engineers who specialized in Talos here, to the Hills. And wouldn't you know it, the mining industry picked right up again.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_107: Twine itself sprung up around that time, as a matter of fact.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_108: It was named after the “entwining of tails”─the fruitful cooperation between the native Ronso and the newly come Mystel.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_109: But that, like so much else, fell apart in the wake of the Flood. The Mystel left, taking their knowledge with them.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_110: It was fifteen years ago that the last of them, the folks from Daedalus Stoneworks, took off for Eulmore. And now no one remains that can repair and operate the Talos.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_111: But there's no use in lamenting what can't be changed. And there's one more thing we need to do while we're out here, so we might as well get to it.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_112: Vultures occasionally make their nests on the tracks, you see, and it falls to us to remove them when they do. The creatures are angry when disturbed─which is natural, but nevertheless a danger to anyone passing by.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_113: It's not my favorite task, to be honest with you. As you may have noticed, I'm not terribly suited to confrontation. That said─would you follow the tracks north and remove any nests you find for me? I'll keep an eye on things from here.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_120: Be careful when removing the nests─the vultures who made them never seem to be far away. Of course, they never could be far enough away for my tastes, so my perception may be a bit biased.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_130: Thank you. That should be everything taken care of.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_131: In return for your help, I'll tell you a bit more about the trolley. Nothing that can get it started again, though─as I said, the only people who knew how to repair the Talos are long gone.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_132: When they left, the life began to bleed out of the town. The trolley's tracks rusted, and its cars fell into disrepair. Now, I was born in Twine, raised there─my first word was “trolley,” dammit─and those were the worst years of my life.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_133: But then, about seven years past, Magnus and his wife returned to us.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_134: Magnus is a real, proper trolley engineer, and perhaps he would never have left in the first place─if it hadn't been for his son. As you're well aware, Amh Araeng is hardly the safest place, and Magnus wanted his child to grow up away from its dangers.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_135: It didn't help, in the end. The sin eaters got the boy. Isn't that always the way?
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_136: The child had always said that someday, he wanted to see Magnus's trolley running again─so in his memory, they returned to Twine. Started fixing those rusted rails and broken cars. And it was going well, for a time...
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_137: Wicked white, vultures? Are they back for revenge? Never mind, I don't want to find out!
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_141: And now you know the story of the trolley. Won't do you much good without the Talos, though.
TEXT_LUCKMD108_03613_JERYK_000_142: If there was even a single one that still functioned, things might be different, but...well, here we are.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_THAFFE_000_005: I'd be lying if I said that I didn't expect that. But for what it's worth, I'm sorry.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_JERYK_000_010: Not that it'll do you any good, but we do have a Talos we've been meaning to repair.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_JERYK_000_011: I can show you if you'd like. It'd certainly be nice to hear something other than Magnus's griping for a change.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_URIANGER_000_020: Thou art come to examine the Talos?
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_JERYK_000_025: Looks like someone's already beat us here, but please─look about as much as you like.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_URIANGER_000_030: Truly a most vexing state of affairs. I thought mayhap a closer examination might yield something of value...
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_URIANGER_000_031: I see. The means to build Talos stone by stone are lost to us, 'tis true, but here before us slumbers a most fine specimen.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_URIANGER_000_032: Indeed, were it not for a few minor failings it would be in working condition.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_URIANGER_000_033: 'Twill likely require naught but a few modest repairs and a suffusion of aether.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_JERYK_000_034: Well, if you think you can get the thing up and running, far be it from me to stop you. But, what exactly do you reckon is the problem?
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_URIANGER_000_035: I should stress that I have performed only the most cursory of examinations, though such arcane constructs are not wholly unfamiliar to me. As I did suspect from the first, it is host to a network of veins through which aether floweth freely.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_URIANGER_000_036: Or so it would, were it not for several fractures which now impede said flow.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_JERYK_000_037: How in the hells did you get all that from just a glance? I take it you've thought up a solution as well, then?
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_URIANGER_000_038: To bridge these fissures requireth a material highly conductive to aether. Once in place, I believe it will be possible to restore the Talos to life.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_URIANGER_000_039: Might I prevail upon thee to acquire that which we require?
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_URIANGER_000_040: Not far beyond the walls of Twine dwelleth a creature of living stone─the debitage. Full sure am I that stone from such a being would prove most suitable to our needs.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_URIANGER_000_041: Very good. I shall have Thancred and Minfilia attend me in the remaining preparations.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_URIANGER_000_042: I spied but three obstructions to the flow of aether in the Talos, and thus would I ask you provide three stones of the debitage. All else will be made ready upon thy return.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_URIANGER_000_050: Worry not, . Preparations here will be complete ere long.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_JERYK_000_055: Wish we had a mage like him around sooner. As you might imagine, we've had trouble convincing people to come here to help. They either refuse outright or demand payment far beyond anything we could hope to afford.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_JERYK_000_056: It's why we've made such little progress in repairing the Talos. We've pored over every scrap of paper left behind by Daedalus Stoneworks hoping we might learn how it's done, but there just isn't enough.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_URIANGER_000_060: Thancred and Minfilia will return ere long with the remaining supplies we require.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_URIANGER_000_061: Didst thou succeed in procuring stone from the debitage?
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_URIANGER_000_062: Fine specimens one and all. You have my thanks. We need now but wait for Thancred and Minfilia's return.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_URIANGER_000_063: From end to end, the paths by which aether may flow through the Talos have been duly mended.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_URIANGER_000_064: They but require a sufficient enduement.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_URIANGER_000_066: Strange... The core refuseth to stir. I fear the condition of this Talos is more dire than I previously surmised.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_URIANGER_000_067: As a heart driveth blood through a man's veins, so doth the core aether throughout this massive frame. Failing its repair or replacement, the Talos cannot be restored.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_JERYK_000_068: So it was the heart after all...
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_JERYK_000_070: Well, no. Not exactly. We'd never gotten this far in trying to repair it, so we had no way of knowing the heart was the real problem.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_JERYK_000_071: We tried to find another. In case things turned out as they are now, but...
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_JERYK_000_073: This isn't really my story to share.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_RYNE_000_074: Please, Jeryk. If something went wrong, maybe we can help.
TEXT_LUCKMD109_03614_JERYK_000_075: All right, all right. After all you lot have done for me, I suppose it's the least I can do.
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_MAGNUS_000_000: I thought I told you to leave!
