TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_THAFFE_000_005: I'm sorry, but I think it'd be for the best if you just forgot about the Talos.
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_THANCRED_000_010: What could be so terrible he'd want to keep it from us?
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_RYNE_000_015: I hope Jeryk doesn't get in trouble for telling us what happened.
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_URIANGER_000_020: Though the Talos yet wants for a beating heart, it would appear thine efforts were not for naught.
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_JERYK_000_030: Right, then. The Talos...their hearts cannot be made of just any stone. You need a special sort with sufficient aetherial conductivity. Both it and the other materials used in the construction of Talos bodies are mined in the same place...
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_JERYK_000_031: That place, of course, being here. The Hills of Amber...
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_JERYK_000_032: And it was three years ago when...when she...
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_JERYK_000_033: No, no I can't. I'm sorry, but you'll have to hear it from Thaffe or someone else.
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_THANCRED_000_040: You don't suppose Thaffe is going to run off too, do you?
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_RYNE_000_045: This is all my fault. I never should have pressured him.
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_URIANGER_000_050: What terrible tragedy befell him years ago, I wonder...
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_THAFFE_000_060: Still here, eh? You can ask again, but the answer's the same. Our trolleys are─
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_THAFFE_000_061: What!? Godsdammit Jeryk. You could've at least finished so I wouldn't have to clean up your mess.
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_THAFFE_000_062: Seeing how you made such quick progress in fixing that Talos and all, he was probably thinking you could help change things around here.
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_THAFFE_000_063: And I think he may be right... Gather your friends, and I'll tell you what you want to know.
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_RYNE_000_070: Why must he always treat me like this...
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_MAGNUS_000_075: If not for those damned Talos, she'd...she'd...
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_THAFFE_000_080: I wish there was more we could do for you, I truly do. But after Agna's accident, no one is allowed near those mines.
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_URIANGER_000_090: Full well do I know the pain of loss and how heavily it can weigh on one's heart. Nevertheless, there is but one way forward.
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_URIANGER_000_091: We must needs procure a new heart for the Talos.
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_URIANGER_000_092: Thaffe. Knowest thou any location wherein we might find the stone we require? No matter how scant the possibility, we would seize it.
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_THAFFE_000_093: I told you near all of the veins were tapped dry years ago. ...Though I suppose, if you really wanted to try, you may find something at Nuvy's Leavings.
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_THAFFE_000_094: It was opened well before Talos became commonplace, which is why the mining there was never quite as deep.
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_THAFFE_000_095: When you get there, look for Guthjon and tell him I sent you. But don't be surprised if he tells you the same thing.
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_URIANGER_000_097: . I think it best Thancred join thee in this search.
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_URIANGER_000_098: Though he wouldst be quick to deny it, his heart is in turmoil, and his thoughts clouded.
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_URIANGER_000_099: 'Twould be unwise to ignore his distress.
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_URIANGER_000_110: I prithee attend Thancred and keep him occupied with the task at hand.
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_THAFFE_000_115: Guthjon has worked in these mines longer than near anyone I know. You'd do well to heed his advice in there.
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_THANCRED_000_121: At last, a lead on the stone we need to power the Talos.
TEXT_LUCKMD110_03615_THANCRED_000_122: I can't very well have you go on your own. Lead the way.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_RYNE_000_000: Why must he always treat me like this...
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_URIANGER_000_005: I prithee attend Thancred and keep him occupied with the task at hand.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_MAGNUS_000_010: If not for those damned Talos, she'd...she'd...
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THAFFE_000_015: Guthjon has worked in these mines longer than near anyone I know. You'd do well to heed his advice in there.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_000_020: I'd say we're long overdue for a good turn. I can only hope the gods feel the same way.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_000_021: Now, Nuvy's Leavings was to the south, was it? Let's get going.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_000_030: The way you described it, I was expecting the place to be abandoned.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_000_031: Perhaps our fortunes are finally improving. Though we should probably hear what Guthjon has to say before we celebrate─assuming we can find him, that is...
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_GUTHJON_000_050: Hm? Who are you, and what are you doing in here?
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_GUTHJON_000_051: Well, you should have listened to Thaffe. You're wasting your time.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_000_052: But this site is not as developed as the others, is it not? Surely there must be something left.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_GUTHJON_000_053: I should explain. The stone you're looking for is leonine. All the Talos in the Hills of Amber are powered using them.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_GUTHJON_000_054: Or were, at least. Anyway, whatever's left─if anything─is too far below to be safely excavated.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_GUTHJON_000_055: In the deepest reaches of the mine, we used Talos to keep the pathways from collapsing. They're still there, but they could give out at any time, which is why much of the mine is closed off.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_000_056: Then our only option is to search the higher levels for any fragments of leonine that may have been overlooked.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_GUTHJON_000_057: Hmm... I suppose there may be one other way.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_000_058: Well? Don't leave us in suspense.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_GUTHJON_000_059: What you're asking for is a trade secret. I'll need to be duly compensated in exchange.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_GUTHJON_000_061: The other day I found a Voeburt gold piece down in the mines. A bloody Voeburt gold piece! And wouldn't you know it, I dropped the damned thing somewhere while I was working.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_GUTHJON_000_062: Find it, and I'll tell you what you want to know.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_000_063: You drive a hard bargain, sir, but we'll take it.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_000_064: It seems we have our work cut out for us, . Thankfully, I have an idea for how we might hurry things along.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_GUTHJON_000_070: I wasn't working that deep in the mines, so don't go searching too far.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_000_080: As I'm sure you've noticed, despite their best efforts to illuminate the corridors, it's rather dark in here. Meaning it will be that much harder to find a single coin hiding in the shadows.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_000_081: That's why I propose we use these─sundrops. They help the eye take in more light.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_000_082: Why don't you start your search further in, and I handle this area here? I'll retrace your steps after in case you happen to miss it.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_000_083: If you feel the drops' effects wearing off, I can give you more, so don't worry.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_000_090: Back so soon? I thought the drops would last longer than that.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_000_091: Here. Now keep searching. It has to be here somewhere.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_SYSTEM_000_100: You fumble through the dark, but you fail to see anything. Perhaps Thancred's sundrops could help in your search.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_SYSTEM_000_101: You search the shadows but find nothing. Perhaps the gold piece lies elsewhere...
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_SYSTEM_000_102: As you search the shadows, a glint catches your eye. You turn over a rock and find the Voeburt gold piece!
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_100_102: I was hoping he dropped the gold piece somewhere closer to the entrance. More fool me for thinking Lady Luck was on our side...
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_110_102: ...Or maybe she is. Yours at least. In the end, my contribution was little more than poor company.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_A1_000_001: Well, I couldn't have done it without your sundrops.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_A1_000_002: Come now, Thancred. You were far more prepared for this task than I.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_120_102: So you say, but you have a proven knack for success regardless of circumstances. I doubt very much I could've discovered it unassisted.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_130_102: No more than usual, I assure you.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_140_102: I only managed to survive the Coerthan wilderness and the imperial capital by virtue of extensive preparation─a habit of mine since childhood, and one of my few positive traits which endeared me to Louisoix, I imagine.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_150_102: It hasn't been easy finding ways to compensate for my...condition. Every tool and trinket has proven vital to my continued success─such as it is.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_160_102: Had I chosen to pursue the arcane arts rather than espionage, well... I'd rather not think on it.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_170_102: So long as I have the means to protect those dear to me, and to see my duties through, that's all that matters.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_180_102: Now let's hurry and see that returned to Guthjon. The sooner we get back to Urianger and Minfilia, the better.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_THANCRED_000_103: I'd rather not stay here any longer than necessary. Let's get going.
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_GUTHJON_000_110: You're back. Wait, does that mean...?
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_GUTHJON_000_111: I'll be damned. You actually found it!
TEXT_LUCKMD111_03616_GUTHJON_000_112: Well, a deal's a deal. But don't think this means you'll find what you're after.
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_THANCRED_000_000: Perhaps our luck really is starting to turn around.
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_GUTHJON_000_010: To be honest, I wasn't sure you could pull it off.
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_GUTHJON_000_011: But you did, and I'm a man of my word. Come with me.
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_THANCRED_000_020: I hope you waited for the sundrops to wear off. They work wonders in the dark, but in the light of day they'll only bring you pain.
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_GUTHJON_000_030: <sigh> Every time I step out of those mines the sky seems to get brighter. I'd never leave them if the air weren't so stale...
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_GUTHJON_000_031: But you're not come to hear my grievances. You're after leonine.
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_GUTHJON_000_032: First, I have to ask─you ever heard of rockworms?
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_THANCRED_000_033: Rockworms? I know them by another name, though I'm fairly certain the locals call them knockers.
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_GUTHJON_000_034: Aye, that they do. Whatever you want to call them, those little bastards may be the answer to your troubles.
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_GUTHJON_000_035: They can fit through cracks and crevices down where we could never hope to reach.
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_GUTHJON_000_036: And, on occasion, they come back with something valuable.
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_THANCRED_000_037: They dig up leonine in the mines?
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_GUTHJON_000_038: It's a rare occurrence, but yes. That said, it usually amounts to no more than a few flakes.
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_THANCRED_000_039: Well our only other option sounds tantamount to suicide. So how can we draw out these rockworms?
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_GUTHJON_000_040: Over by that shack you'll find a bag full of smoke bombs. Set off a few in the mines and you'll flush them out in no time.
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_GUTHJON_000_041: Once they're out in the open, knock 'em senseless and check their backs.
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_GUTHJON_000_042: I should warn you this method of mining, if you can even call it that, is used as a last resort on account of what little they're like to bring back. You'll want to cover as much ground as you can if you hope to find anything of value.
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_GUTHJON_000_043: Assuming you do find something, bring it here and I'll have a look.
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_THANCRED_000_044: We should split up if we're to cover more ground as he suggests. If you can cover these three areas on your map, I'll see to the parts between them.
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_GUTHJON_000_050: The smoke bombs are on top of the crates next to the shack just over yonder. You can't miss them.
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_GUTHJON_000_060: I see you've got the smoke bombs, but they'll do you no good out here.
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_GUTHJON_000_061: Light them in the mines and the rockworms will come scampering out before long.
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_SYSTEM_000_070: The air in the mines grows thick with smoke. Nearby you hear the soft rumbling of stones.
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_SYSTEM_000_080: You sense a hostile presence beneath the rubble!
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_THANCRED_000_090: I found my fair share of rocks. Hopefully there's leonine among them.
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_GUTHJON_000_100: There you are. Find anything promising?
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_GUTHJON_000_101: Between the two of you I'd say you've got quite the haul.
TEXT_LUCKMD112_03617_GUTHJON_000_102: Best get comfortable, friends. It's going to take time for me to sift through all this.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_THANCRED_000_000: I had hoped we would find leonine, but to find that particular specimen is nothing short of a miracle.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_GUTHJON_000_010: I wouldn't believe it had I not seen it for myself.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_GUTHJON_000_011: Before you set it in the Talos, would you take it to Magnus?
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_GUTHJON_000_012: For three long years he's believed she died for nothing. He must know the truth─that her sacrifice was not in vain.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_THANCRED_000_013: We'll take it straight to him. You have my word. Thank you, Guthjon, for all your help.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_THANCRED_000_014: Right, then. Let's not keep everyone waiting.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_GUTHJON_000_025: I can only imagine the look on his face when he sees that.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_MAGNUS_000_031: If you've come to complain about the trolley, you'll find no sympathy from me. I told you before it won't run, and you wouldn't listen.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_THANCRED_000_032: Oh, but it will. Now that we have this.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_THANCRED_000_033: Your name is engraved on it, along with your son's. It was a gift from your wife, Magnus. From Agna.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_MAGNUS_000_036: Take it. Do with it what you will.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_THANCRED_000_037: Are you certain? It would delay our plans, but─
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_MAGNUS_000_038: I said take it. It was you who found it, you who needs it.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_MAGNUS_000_039: Looking at that stone, all I can see is...is...
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_THANCRED_000_041: I hope you'll be there when the Talos stirs to life.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_THANCRED_000_042: I'm sure she'd want you to see it.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_THANCRED_000_043: Would you do the honors of delivering this to Urianger?
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_THANCRED_000_050: Finally we can move on to Nabaath Areng. Assuming this works, of course.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_RYNE_000_055: Sorry I couldn't be of more help. By the sounds of it, you have a knack for handling strange requests.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_RYNE_000_056: On the bright side, Urianger taught me a lot about the Talos and their hearts. I think I can help if they need further repairs.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_THAFFE_000_060: You what!? By the gods, I didn't think it possible.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_JERYK_000_065: You found leonine? Truly? Then what are we waiting for─let's get that trolley moving!
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_URIANGER_000_080: Thou art returned, and with leonine it would seem.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_URIANGER_000_081: As promised, the Talos hath been made ready to receive its heart, thanks in no small part to Jeryk, Thaffe, and Minfilia.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_URIANGER_000_082: At last we shall return time to the timeless, this sentinel of stone, that we may press on towards Nabaath Areng.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_URIANGER_000_083: Very good. Now, let us begin.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_THANCRED_000_090: I only want what's best for her. If only she could see that...
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_RYNE_000_095: <sniff> I'm fine. Really. It's just been a long day.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_MAGNUS_000_100: I must confess you've impressed me. I did not expect the Talos to be in such fine condition.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_THAFFE_000_105: You've done us a kindness far greater than anything we deserve. Thank you. Thank you so much.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_JERYK_000_110: Just thinking about the trolley running down the tracks, gears churning─gods, I can't stop smiling!
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_URIANGER_000_120: Mine apologies for the delay. Minfilia and I had a private matter to discuss.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_URIANGER_000_121: Which bringeth me to the question─how didst thou find Thancred during your search?
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_URIANGER_000_122: He spoke of Minfilia? Of his own accord? I see...
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_URIANGER_000_123: 'Tis well that he did, and with such candor.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_URIANGER_000_124: I attempted to broach the subject before. Mine intention was to ensure no words remained unspoken between them, lest tragedy intercede. A regret I myself know all too well. Alas, in the end he refused to heed my counsel.
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_URIANGER_000_125: A time will come when they must face the reality of their circumstances. But I have faith that all will be well in time...
TEXT_LUCKMD113_03618_URIANGER_000_126: Now, let us not tarry any longer. The Talos and Nabaath Areng await.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_THANCRED_000_000: I only want what's best for her. If only she could see that...
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_RYNE_000_005: <sniff> I'm fine. Really. It's just been a long day.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_URIANGER_000_010: Magnus maketh ready for our departure even as we speak. Might I prevail upon thee to inquire as to his progress?
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_THAFFE_000_015: You've done us a kindness far greater than we deserve. Thank you. I mean it.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_JERYK_000_020: Just thinking about the trolley speeding down the tracks, gears whirring─gods, I can't stop smiling!
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_MAGNUS_000_030: It's been years since I've seen a Talos in such fine shape. Would that Agna was here to see it. Or our son...
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_MAGNUS_000_031: I was ready to let her dreams die down there in the mines. Even after you'd found the leonine, I refused to believe it could work. Gods, what a fool I was.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_MAGNUS_000_032:
But I tell you now─I'm going to take good care of this Talos. For both their sakes.
On behalf of my family, and all the miners of Twine, thank you.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_MAGNUS_000_033: Well, enough chitter-chatter. Let's get you lot to Nabaath Areng, eh?
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_THANCRED_000_034: Everything seems to be in order. I take it the Talos's presence resolves the issue of the gate?
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_MAGNUS_000_036: It's designed to open at the Talos's approach.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_RYNE_000_037: Then we can finally go to Nabaath Areng.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_MAGNUS_000_038: You certainly can. All that remains is a final check of the control box over at the mines.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_MAGNUS_000_039: You hear that, boys? Get that Talos over to the mines, and keep a close eye on it around the curves. Understood?
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_URIANGER_000_041: Let us repair to the mines, then.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_RYNE_000_043: While you were away with , I prepared an extra set of cartridges for you.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_RYNE_000_044: And this one. It's the practice cartridge you gave me.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_RYNE_000_045: I know I should've thrown it away ages ago, but I've been adding a little extra to it every day. After so many charges, I'm honestly not sure what it will do. But I wanted you to have it. For luck.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_RYNE_000_047: We should hurry. Magnus and the others are probably wondering where we are.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_THANCRED_000_050: I know what you're thinking, and I will talk to her. When the time is right.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_URIANGER_000_055: All appeareth ready for the grand departure. But one task yet remaineth...
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_MAGNUS_000_060: Luckily, Thaffe and Jeryk didn't spend the last few years trying to drink themselves to death, and had the good sense to maintain this stuff. I'll have to thank them later.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_THAFFE_000_065: Ever since we got the Talos moving again, Jeryk has been acting strangely. Perhaps strange isn't the right word. More...overexcited. But as long as he gets the job done, I suppose I can't complain.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_JERYK_000_070: Is this not the most beautiful sight you've ever seen? Oh, if only I could capture this moment in a painting, or even a quick pencil sketch.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_JERYK_000_071: Hey, you seem pretty good at...everything. You wouldn't happen to be an artist too, would you?
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_RYNE_000_080: So this is it. We're finally going to Nabaath Areng.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_RYNE_000_081: I've thought long and hard about what to say to her. To the real Minfilia.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_RYNE_000_082: I hoped when the time came I would know, but with every step we take I feel more uncertain.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_RYNE_000_083: That's no reason to give up, though. Not when so much is at stake.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_RYNE_000_084: Thank you, all of you, for helping me to get here. Now, let's not keep Magnus waiting.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_RYNE_000_090: One last step... I'm glad to be taking it with you.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_MAGNUS_000_100: There you are. So, what do you think?
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_MAGNUS_000_101: A little primitive-looking, I'll admit, but Daedalus Stoneworks has always favored a simple, intuitive design, and that philosophy has served us well enough.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_MAGNUS_000_102: Much of the trolley network uses single tracks, making it easy for the Talos to navigate them as needed.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_MAGNUS_000_103: And plotting a route is so simple, even we can do it, which makes for fewer accidents in transit.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_MAGNUS_000_104: Speaking of which, are you ready to board?
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_MAGNUS_000_105: All right, then. Watch your step.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_RYNE_000_110: This is the place, . This is where she stopped the Flood.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_RYNE_000_111: The last time I was here, when I felt her presence overwhelming me...I tried to pretend it wasn't happening─to just...turn away.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_RYNE_000_112: But I can't turn away now. Not this time. For Thancred and the others, I have to face her.
TEXT_LUCKMD114_03619_SYSTEM_000_113: In the event that you leave the area, speak with the apprentice engineer at Twine in Amh Araeng to return to Nabaath Areng.
TEXT_LUCKMD115_03620_RYNE_000_000: (-Minfilia-)I can sense her presence, albeit faintly.
TEXT_LUCKMD115_03620_RYNE_000_001: (-Minfilia-)Come on, let's look over by the crystal wall.
TEXT_LUCKMD115_03620_RYNE_000_010: (-Minfilia-)She was here. On the top of this building...
TEXT_LUCKMD115_03620_RYNE_000_021: (-Minfilia-)What happened? I remember speaking with Minfilia...and then...
TEXT_LUCKMD115_03620_RYNE_000_024: (-Minfilia-)Until now, I've walked the path she set before me. The path she set before all the Minfilias.
TEXT_LUCKMD115_03620_RYNE_000_025: (-Minfilia-)But she's given me a new path─a new life─that I can call my own.
TEXT_LUCKMD115_03620_RYNE_000_026: (-Minfilia-)And even though she's gone, I can still feel her...warm and calm and gentle.
TEXT_LUCKMD115_03620_RYNE_000_027: (-Minfilia-)I can feel the beating heart of the world, the Light that swells within it.
TEXT_LUCKMD115_03620_RYNE_000_028: (-Minfilia-)And the Lightwardens. There's one here in Amh Araeng.
TEXT_LUCKMD115_03620_RYNE_000_029: (-Minfilia-)Let's hurry back. The others need to know.
TEXT_LUCKMD115_03620_RYNE_000_030: (-Minfilia-)You don't think Thancred will be angry with me, do you?
TEXT_LUCKMD115_03620_A2_000_001: It's what Minfilia wanted. I'm sure he'll understand.
TEXT_LUCKMD115_03620_A2_000_002: There's only one way to find out.
TEXT_LUCKMD115_03620_RYNE_000_031: (-Minfilia-)I'd like to think so too, but... <sigh>
TEXT_LUCKMD115_03620_RYNE_000_032: (-Minfilia-)<sigh> I know there's no getting around it, but...
TEXT_LUCKMD115_03620_RYNE_000_033: (-Minfilia-)Would you mind going on ahead? I'll be right behind you. I promise.
TEXT_LUCKMD115_03620_ALPHINAUD_000_040: You're back! We were beginning to worry about you.
TEXT_LUCKMD115_03620_ALISAIE_000_045: ! Thank the gods you're all right.
TEXT_LUCKMD115_03620_URIANGER_000_050: Thou art returned. But where is Minfilia?
TEXT_LUCKMD115_03620_YSHTOLA_000_055: Welcome back. I see you fared better than Thancred.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Minfilia will be sorely missed. Though it was Grandfather's legacy which first brought me to Eorzea, I would never have become a Scion were it not for her. Indeed, there would be no Scions, and two worlds would be the worse for our absence.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Tataru and the others will no doubt be heartbroken to hear the news of her passing. Until such time as we can return to them, however, we must keep our heads held high. Though we have lost one Scion, we have gained another, after all.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_ALISAIE_000_005: Do you have any idea how worried we were when word reached us that Ran'jit was alive, and headed for the Hills of Amber?
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_ALISAIE_000_006: Oh, I can't wait for this to be over, so we can all go home. Assuming we even can.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_THANCRED_000_010: Thank you for standing by Ryne. And Minfilia. I'm sure it meant a lot to her, seeing you one last time.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_THANCRED_000_011: Would that I could have been there to hear what words were exchanged between them. When all of this is over, perhaps I'll ask.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_URIANGER_000_015: Despite this glad turn of events, the suffering born of mine all-too-arrogant meddling paineth me still.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_URIANGER_000_016: And yet...their smiles do give me hope for the morrow.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_YSHTOLA_000_020: Ryne's aether has changed. It has taken on a faint, golden hue. Curious...
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_RYNE_000_030: I honestly don't know how to repay you for all you've done, but I promise to do whatever I can to help.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_ALISAIE_000_031: Are you certain you're up to fighting so soon? I can't imagine the power of the Oracle is something one learns to wield in the space of a few hours.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_RYNE_000_032: Maybe not, but the presence of the Lightwardens is unmistakable to me now.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_RYNE_000_033: In fact, I sense one here in Amh Araeng, to the west. I think it might be hiding underground.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_ALPHINAUD_000_034: Underground? Then it's as we suspected!
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_YSHTOLA_000_035: We thought it prudent to take a brief survey of the area prior to your arrival.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_YSHTOLA_000_036: To the west we found the remains of a site known as Malikah's Well.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_YSHTOLA_000_037: If I recall correctly, the well was built in remembrance of one of the ancient kings of Nabaath Areng to serve as a source of respite from the desert heat.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_YSHTOLA_000_038: It fell into disuse after the Flood, whereupon the miners of Amh Araeng thought to turn part of it into an excavation site.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_ALPHINAUD_000_039: Judging by its size, the underground waterways are no doubt extensive. The perfect hiding place for a Warden.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Ryne, are you certain you can track it down?
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_THANCRED_000_042: Then it's settled. We make for Malikah's Well.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_ALPHINAUD_000_050: A marvel of ingenuity, is it not?
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_ALISAIE_000_055: Something about this doesn't feel right...
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_THANCRED_000_060: I didn't expect to see Talos wandering about─much less of their own accord. How long must it have been since their creators' bones turned to dust?
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_RYNE_000_065: The Warden is down there. I can feel it.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_URIANGER_000_070: That the walls should still bear so great a burden after countless years of neglect bespeaketh the surpassing skill of their architects.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_YSHTOLA_000_075: Though I cannot see it as you do, it is a no less awe-inspiring sight.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_RYNE_000_080: It's here. I can taste its aether on the wind.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_ALISAIE_000_081: Then we've finally found our mark.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_ALISAIE_000_082: Let's put an end to this, , and return the night sky to Amh Araeng.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_A1_000_002: Form a party and enter Malikah's Well.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_ALPHINAUD_000_090: Our battle with the Warden of Holminster Switch was an eye-opening experience, to say the least. Alisaie and I have trained tirelessly that we might be better prepared for our next such encounter.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_ALPHINAUD_000_091: For Minfilia, and the countless souls who struggled to carry on her legacy, we must end this.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_ALISAIE_000_095: I can't help thinking about all the children at the Inn. Abandoned to wait for the inevitable.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_ALISAIE_000_096: So long as the Light holds sway here, there is no hope for them. But if we defeat the Wardens, if we restore the night, then maybe...maybe they can still be saved.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_THANCRED_000_100: No need to worry about me. Urianger and Y'shtola were quite thorough in their ministrations.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_THANCRED_000_101: A pity their magicks did nothing for my clothes.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_THANCRED_000_102: At any rate, we cannot well stop now. Not after all Ryne and Minfilia have given to bring us this far.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_RYNE_000_105: The Warden's presence feels...familiar somehow. Now that I think about it, it reminds me of...
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_RYNE_000_106: But that makes no sense. Sorry. I'm sure I'm just imagining things.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_URIANGER_000_110: Lest thou worry, I did relay unto Magnus word of thine untimely accident whilst I waited for thee to return from thine audience with the Oracle. He hath since reclaimed his Talos and trolley both, and meaneth to begin repairs anon.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_URIANGER_000_111: For a blessing, the damage was but superficial, the leonine heart unmarred by Ran'jit's onslaught.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_YSHTOLA_000_115: I was surprised to hear Ran'jit survived the fall. Though I suppose I did the same.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_YSHTOLA_000_116: More surprising is how he so readily saw through our diversion.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_YSHTOLA_000_117: A foe possessed of such cunning would be sufficient cause for concern in itself, but one capable of besting Thancred in combat too...? We would do well not to underestimate him when next we meet.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_ALPHINAUD_000_120: The end to Light's dominion over this world is fast at hand.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_THANCRED_000_125: Perhaps their ministrations were not as thorough as I thought. Or perhaps I was a touch too reckless.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_RYNE_000_130: If only I could've seen the look on Magnus's face when the night sky returned. They must all be so happy.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_RYNE_000_131: But what about you, ? Do you feel...different at all?
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_URIANGER_000_135:
Once more shall the night share equal dominion over the firmament.
And yet our travails are far from over...
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_YSHTOLA_000_140: Is this not the moment Emet-Selch usually chooses to descend upon us? Whatever will we do without his feigned praise and backhanded compliments?
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_ALISAIE_000_150: We did it. We really did it. I only wish there were time to visit the Inn. We can but hope the return of night has granted the residents some shred of comfort.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_ALISAIE_000_151: They thought the world beyond changing. But today I think we proved them wrong.
TEXT_LUCKMD116_03621_ALISAIE_000_152: We will fix this broken land, . Together.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_ALPHINAUD_000_000: The end to Light's dominion over this world is fast at hand.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_ALISAIE_000_005: When all of this is over, it would mean a lot to me if we could go and visit Tesleen's grave together. I have such a lot to tell her...
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_THANCRED_000_010: Perhaps their ministrations were not as thorough as I thought. Or perhaps I was a touch too reckless.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_URIANGER_000_015:
Once more shall the night share equal dominion over the firmament.
And yet our travails are far from over...
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_YSHTOLA_000_020: Is this not the moment Emet-Selch usually chooses to descend upon us? Whatever will we do without his feigned praise and backhanded compliments?
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_RYNE_000_030: Are you feeling all right, ? After you defeated the Lightwarden, I could swear I saw its aether─
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_RYNE_000_031: Uh...never mind. I'm still getting used to my powers. It's probably nothing.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_RYNE_000_032: I'm just relieved I was right about where the Warden was hiding.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_RYNE_000_033: The last one is hiding in Kholusia, isn't it? I can't feel it from here, believe it or not...
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_RYNE_000_034: But perhaps we should head back to the Crystarium first. We have a lot to tell the Exarch...and I think we could all do with some rest.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_RYNE_000_040: Y'shtola said she needed to speak with us. It sounded rather urgent.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_YSHTOLA_000_050: The others are with the Exarch. Before we join them, there is something I wish to confirm.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_YSHTOLA_000_51: Tell me, Ryne─have you noticed anything peculiar about 's appearance of late? Anything at all? Speak freely.  won't mind.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_RYNE_000_052: Well...since Minfilia bequeathed her power to me, I've been able to see the Light inside ...though I didn't think anything of it at first. But after we defeated the Warden in Amh Araeng, I realized something was wrong.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_RYNE_000_053: You've absorbed its aether, . And the Light within you has grown monstrous.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_YSHTOLA_000_054: Then it is as I suspected.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_YSHTOLA_000_057: If naught is done, this will only get worse.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_YSHTOLA_000_058: Ryne─with the power of the Oracle, you have gained some measure of control over Light, have you not? Is there anything you can do for ?
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_RYNE_000_059: Extinguishing it is out of the question. Even at her strongest, Minfilia could only hold back the Light.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_RYNE_000_060: I might be able to suppress it...but I don't know for how long.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_YSHTOLA_000_061: Then we have no choice but to rely on Urianger and his secrets.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_YSHTOLA_000_062: If the next battle is to be the last, you may yet be able to play your part. But you will need all of your strength.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_YSHTOLA_000_063: I will discuss strategy with the others and see that everything is made ready for our departure. You are to return to your chambers and rest until then. Understood?
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_YSHTOLA_000_064: Good. Whether you want it or not, you have most certainly earned some respite.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_YSHTOLA_000_065: This is not the time for false bravado. Should your condition worsen, it could have dire consequences for us all.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_YSHTOLA_000_066: Now please, return to your chambers and rest.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_YSHTOLA_000_067: Hah. None of that cheek, or I will take you across my knee.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_YSHTOLA_000_068: Now, off with you to the Pendants. We will call for you when the time comes.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_GUIDEOFTHEPENDANTS_: Is everything all right, ? You don't seem quite yourself.
Perhaps a hot meal and a freshly made bed will improve matters. Your room is ready, if you'd care to retire?
Very good. If you should have need of anything─anything at all─pray do not hesitate to call.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_MYSTERYVOICE_000_90: It would need to be later. After the liberation of Ala Mhigo, perhaps...
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_BLUECLOTHESMAN_000_: We have to go. They'll be upon us any moment.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_MYSTERYVOICE_000_90: Very well. Where to next, then?
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_BLUECLOTHESMAN_000_: Let's just worry about getting out of the city, and pray the airship is still in one piece.
Anywhere we go from here will just be more of the same.
Gods. By the sound of that last one, I reckon the knights twelve might be the knights' rubble now.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_MYSTERYVOICE_000_90: Is there nothing else we can do?
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_BLUECLOTHESMAN_000_: Do? Look around you─this isn't war.
It's a sickness, and it's spread to every corner of Eorzea. The city-states are in disarray, and by all accounts the Far East's faring no better.
There'll be nothing left of us when this is over.
I never tire of that story. When the hero swoops in astride a white dragon to save the little girl...
I could die happy knowing someone like that was still around.
TEXT_LUCKMD117_03622_MYSTERYVOICE_000_91: Indeed. But not today. Not while our message remains undelivered.
Have faith, my friend: we will find ...
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_GUIDEOFTHEPENDANTS_: Ah,  . I trust you had a pleasant rest.
While you were ensconced in your chamber, a message arrived for you from the Exarch. He bids you come to the Ocular at your earliest convenience.
...And, ? Wherever your duties may take you next, I shall pray for your safe return. May the night keep you.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_MYSTERYVOICE_000_01: Your condition is unchanged? Good. If you can but hold out until the end of the coming battle, I am confident that we will find a remedy for your affliction.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_LYNA_000_015: We've not spoken for a while, have we? Not since the aftermath of the eaters' attack.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_LYNA_000_016: Rest assured I am fully recovered, and will do my utmost to support you and your fellow Warriors of Darkness.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_EMETSELCH_000_020: Yes? Did my lesson provoke thought, giving rise to further questions?
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_A1_000_001: Three of you escaped the sundering. But what of those who didn't...?
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_EMETSELCH_000_021: Why, their very beings were divided into fourteen, of course. Yet by our power, we unsundered Ascians may raise up one of their fragments to their original office.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_EMETSELCH_000_022: Ah, but I suppose this in itself bears explaining. So...the names by which you know us are not, in fact, our names.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_EMETSELCH_000_023: Be it Elidibus or Lahabrea or Igeyorhm, all are titles of office. And when an office is vacated, it may be filled by another.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_EMETSELCH_000_024: Over the eons, I have overseen several changings of the guard among our sundered brethren.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_EMETSELCH_000_025: And in such instances, the vacant title ordinarily goes to another fragment of the selfsame soul.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_EMETSELCH_000_026: While it is by no means impossible to raise up wholly unrelated individuals, 'tis we whose fervent entreaties brought forth Lord Zodiark─whose souls He claimed in the beginning─who make the truest servants.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_A2_000_001: So, if we were to defeat all the Ascians of the Source...
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_A2_000_002: What is your true name, then?
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_EMETSELCH_000_027: Then none would remain to raise up new Ascians, and our kind would eventually fade from existence. You would like that, wouldn't you? Well, feel free to dream─'tis no crime to do so.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_EMETSELCH_000_028: Hm! There may come a day when I reveal my true name to you─but this is not it. Of course, you may well die none the wiser, but life is full of such disappointments.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_EMETSELCH_000_029: If that is all, then run along. You have a Lightwarden to slay.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_RYNE_000_035: This aura... What could it be?
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_ALPHINAUD_000_040: There you are, . The others have gone ahead to reconnoiter Gatetown. We are to follow shortly.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_ALPHINAUD_000_041: It has been a while, has it not? Since the two of us infiltrated Eulmore.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_ALPHINAUD_000_042: ...Since we faced Lord Vauthry, and I felt such fury as I have never felt before.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_ALPHINAUD_000_043: His actions are unconscionable, of course, and any abhorrence I felt for him entirely justified. Yet mingled with my rage, there was...something else. At first I was unsure what it was, but in the course of our struggles, I found the answer.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_ALPHINAUD_000_044: In Vauthry's self-righteousness─in his absolute belief that he, and he alone, is the cure to the world's ills─I saw a reflection of myself. And it brought the memories of all my past follies flooding back.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_ALPHINAUD_000_045: He is the vainglorious, ignorant fool I once was. And having shared in his affliction, I feel duty-bound to open his eyes to the truth.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_ALPHINAUD_000_046: Whether he will accept it with the good grace I did is another question...
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_ALPHINAUD_000_047: What is it, Ryne? Do you sense the Lightwarden?
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_RYNE_000_048: I-I'm not sure. The aura is...different.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_RYNE_000_049: Perhaps if we were a little closer...
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_ALPHINAUD_000_050: 'Tis time we were on our way in any case. Let us join our comrades in Gatetown.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_ALPHINAUD_000_051: , as a precaution, may I ask that you go first, to ensure that the path is clear?
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_ALPHINAUD_000_052: The closer we are to Eulmore, the more I worry that Ryne may be recognized. If you see any prying eyes along the way, pray encourage their owners to look elsewhere.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_ALPHINAUD_000_060: Go on, . We will follow anon.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_RYNE_000_065: As I am now, I don't think people will recognize me as the Oracle, but Thancred did always warn against taking unnecessary risks.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_SYSTEM_000_071: You hail the civilian, but he does not respond and continues his incoherent rambling.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_SUSPICIOUSB03630_00: Lord Vauthry... We hear...we obey... Aaahhh!
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_SUSPICIOUSC03630_00: Long live...Lord Vauthry... Long live...Lord Vauthry...
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_URIANGER_000_080: Our mission hath begun on a strange note...
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_RESIDENT03630_000_0: Wh-What's happening!? What's wrong with everyone!?
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_THANCRED_000_090: Ah. Good of you to join us. I was debating whether to warn you, but it's too late now.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_THANCRED_000_091: I take it you noticed the people behaving strangely along the path? It's more of the same here.
TEXT_LUCKME101_03630_THANCRED_000_092: Y'shtola and Alisaie are investigating as we speak. Let's wait and see what they have to say.
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_THANCRED_000_000: The gears are clearly turning in Urianger's mind. Why don't you ask him what he makes of all this?
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_RESIDENT03630_000_0: Wh-What's happening!? What's wrong with everyone!?
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_ALISAIE_000_010: I'm fine, . Shaking with fury, but fine. Let's go.
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_THANCRED_000_015: We are like to encounter Ran'jit again. One can only hope he's still licking his wounds.
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_THANCRED_000_016: Yet even without him, Eulmore is an eminently defensible city─as you doubtless gleaned during your visit.
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_THANCRED_000_017: When last I set foot inside its walls, I almost mistook it for dear old Limsa─but it is full of unpleasant surprises. All of which is a long way of saying: be on your guard.
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_RYNE_000_020: The uppermost level of the city houses Vauthry's chambers. He must keep the Warden close.
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_URIANGER_000_025: My heart is gripped by an unshakable sense of foreboding. Let us proceed with all care.
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_YSHTOLA_000_030: That Vauthry should so brazenly exert his influence over the people bespeaks his desperation. He will not go quietly.
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_KAISHIRR_000_035: Meol...is sin eater? Wicked white, we all scoffed the stuff without a second thought...
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_KAISHIRR_000_036: I never got near as much as the others, but...ugh...
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_KAISHIRR_000_037: Heh... The bitter greens and bony fish I got by on don't seem so bad no more...
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_ALPHINAUD_000_040: When we step through the gates, we shall find not the place of hedonistic pleasure we remember, but a battlefield.
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_ALPHINAUD_000_041: If you are prepared for this, then let us sally forth!
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_THANCRED_000_051: The citizens appear to have calmed down for the moment. I can only assume Vauthry is otherwise engaged. Let's get to the upper level while we can.
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_ALPHINAUD_000_060: My thanks again, . We will seek out the wounded and render what aid we can.
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_ALISAIE_000_065: Some managed to shake off the mind control only to be caught in the chaos. We'll make sure they receive treatment as well.
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_RYNE_000_070: It's all right. You're safe now.
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_URIANGER_000_080: Bereft of leadership, the soldiers have lost the will to fight. They pose no threat to us.
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_YSHTOLA_000_085: So this was how the citizens lived─the Eulmoran dream. They are in for quite a rude awakening.
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_THANCRED_000_090: Good news, . It would seem that Ryne is indeed able to reverse the effects of Vauthry's influence.
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_THANCRED_000_091: Even as we speak, she tends to the afflicted in turn. The problem being: there's no end to them.
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_THANCRED_000_092: We're trying to provide what relief we can to those who are waiting, and would appreciate your help, if you're willing.
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_SYSTEM_000_093: You can now attune with the aetheryte in Eulmore!
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: Do no more than is necessary to subdue the civilians!
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_THANCRED_BATTLETALK: We're wasting time. Ryne─we hold them here while the others press on!
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: Have care, you two! The rest of you, with me!
Their minds are not their own, remember! Avoid harming them wherever possible!
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_YSHTOLA_BATTLETALK_: There is no end to them... Urianger─would you care to make a stand?
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_URIANGER_BATTLETALK: Gladly. ─pray press on with the others when the opportunity doth arise.
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_ALISAIE_BATTLETALK_: The way's clear! Come on, you two!
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: Confound it! More of them! And we were almost through!
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_ALISAIE_BATTLETALK_: Right, my turn to make a heroic stand! As soon as there's a lull, push on!
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: Now, ─into the tower! And my thanks for the timely assist, Alisaie!
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_CLOWNOFRED_BATTLETA: Apologies, friends...but you've reached a dead end. And on this sorry track, there's no turning back.
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_CLOWNOFBLUE_BATTLET: We've a good life here, see, and we're not about to lose it. But fair's fair─we'll give you a good death.
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: If you would fight us of your own volition, then we will not hold back!
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_CLOWNOFBLUE_BATTLET: But at least you'll die laughing!
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_ALPHINAUD_BATTLETAL: Let us climb to the Canopy. From there we will take the Crown Lift.
Still more soldiers... Leave them to me and press on!
TEXT_LUCKME102_03631_RANJIT_BATTLETALK_0: Ever since I submitted to my master's authority, I have been naught but a weapon.
I exist only to destroy. And destroy you I will.
It is time we settled this, villain.
If you would pass me, you must endure all that I have learned on the battlefield... For I am a weapon forged in the fires of war!
TEXT_LUCKME103_03632_ALPHINAUD_000_000: My thanks again, . We will seek out the wounded and render what aid we can.
TEXT_LUCKME103_03632_ALISAIE_000_005: Some folk managed to escape the mind control but were caught in the chaos. We'll make sure they receive treatment as well.
TEXT_LUCKME103_03632_RYNE_000_010: It's all right. You're safe now.
TEXT_LUCKME103_03632_URIANGER_000_020: Bereft of leadership, the soldiers have lost the will to fight. They pose no threat to us.
TEXT_LUCKME103_03632_YSHTOLA_000_025: So this was how the citizens lived─the Eulmoran dream. They are in for quite a rude awakening.
TEXT_LUCKME103_03632_THANCRED_000_030: So, here is some dream powder.
TEXT_LUCKME103_03632_THANCRED_000_031: We're administering it to the enthralled to keep them calm until they can receive proper attention. I would appreciate it if you could assist with this task.
TEXT_LUCKME103_03632_THANCRED_000_032: Now, those affected are scattered all over the city. I suggest starting your search at the Derelicts and working your way up.
TEXT_LUCKME103_03632_THANCRED_000_033: When you are done, be sure to let Ryne know.
TEXT_LUCKME103_03632_THOARICH_000_040: O Lord Vauthry... You are...my daily meol...
TEXT_LUCKME103_03632_LADY03287_000_070: Ahhh...it hurts... Please, Lord Vauthry...take away the pain...
TEXT_LUCKME103_03632_EMPLOYEE03287_000_0: You're the kind soul who saved me from falling to my death!
M-My mistress, she's been injured! Please help her, I beg you!
Please, is there nothing you can do for her?
She's...sleeping. A medicine to help her rest while she awaits treatment, you say?
Oh, thank you so much! When she began acting strangely, I didn't know what to do...
I won't leave my mistress's side.
TEXT_LUCKME103_03632_GENTLEMAN03289_000_: <snort> Where did you fly to...my sweet canary...?
TEXT_LUCKME103_03632_RYNE_000_131: I've just finished aiding this man. Now, for the next one...
TEXT_LUCKME103_03632_RYNE_000_132: More out in the Derelicts and below, you say? So many of them...
TEXT_LUCKME103_03632_RYNE_000_133: But Minfilia entrusted this power to me. I won't rest until I've helped everyone.
TEXT_LUCKME103_03632_A1_000_001: I can bring the enthralled to you.
TEXT_LUCKME103_03632_A1_000_002: I'll go and see to the wounded.
TEXT_LUCKME103_03632_RYNE_000_134: Oh, that would certainly make it easier for me to work.
TEXT_LUCKME103_03632_RYNE_000_135: Thank you, . I'll do my best to keep pace.
TEXT_LUCKME103_03632_RYNE_000_136: I'm sure Alphinaud and Alisaie would appreciate the help.
TEXT_LUCKME103_03632_RYNE_000_137: And should you find other enthralled civilians, please see that they are brought to me.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_ALPHINAUD_000_000: The Ladder is situated to the north and west of Wright. Let us make our way there, .
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_ALPHINAUD_000_010: The Ladder is a sturdy piece of engineering, but much may go wrong after twenty years of disuse. Let us be doubly thorough with its maintenance.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_YSHTOLA_000_015: Bottom Rung, they call this place. How very apt.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_YSHTOLA_000_016: Apparently, it used to be the control center for the Ladder and a bustling hub of transport. Its glory days are far behind it.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_CHAINUZZ_000_020: First things first─a fifty-point inspection. Wouldn't do to have them falling to pieces, now!
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_CHAINUZZ_000_025: ...Wh-Why are you standing there gawping? There's lots to be done, so go and make yourself useful!
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_DULIACHAI_000_030: To see my darling Chai so engrossed in his work... I think I'm falling in love again. <sigh>
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_URIANGER_000_040: , dost thou see yonder pair of Talos?
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_URIANGER_000_041: For a blessing, they were found to be in good repair. Master Chai prepareth to activate them as we speak.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_URIANGER_000_042: With our arcane knowledge, Y'shtola and I will serve as his assistants. At the appointed hour, we shall imbue the golems with aether.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_URIANGER_000_043: Others, meanwhile, attend to the Ladder itself, which hath too long lain neglected. Extensive maintenance will be needed ere it can move again, as well as myriad materials with which to perform it.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_URIANGER_000_044: If thou art willing, we would prevail upon thee to procure lumber.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_URIANGER_000_045: My thanks, . Directly to the south thou wilt find a dry dock─Venmont Yards. Pray see if thou canst persuade the folk there to part with some lumber for our cause.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_URIANGER_000_050: Venmont Yards lie directly to the south. Pray see if thou canst persuade the folk there to part with some lumber for our cause.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_IRVITHE_000_060: Ho there, sinner. Haven't seen you around before. New to Gatetown, I take it. If you need lumber for a shack, you've come to the right place. We can do the building for you too, though that'll cost extra.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_IRVITHE_000_061: ...You want lumber to restore the Ladder? Why in the world would anyone want to do that!?
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_IRVITHE_000_062: If you don't have the coin, least you could do is come up with a believable excuse!
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_IRVITHE_000_063: But look, I'm not one to turn folk away. I'll give you your lumber if you do me a favor in return.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_IRVITHE_000_064: I'd just finished taking stock of our supply and was about to do another round for good measure. I want you to do the counting instead, and we'll see if your total matches mine.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_IRVITHE_000_065: Now, some of the lumber's lying about the yard, but most of it is kept in the storehouse. For these, you can just ask Grithil for the number. Here, I'll lend you some writing material so you can take notes.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_SYSTEM_000_066: Take stock of the supply of lumber at the shipyard. What you learn can be reviewed in your key items.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_IRVITHE_000_070: When you're done counting the lumber, come back here and we'll see if your total matches mine.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_IRVITHE_000_071: Remember, for the stuff that's stowed in the storehouse, you can just ask Grithil for the number.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_SYSTEM_000_080: You count eleven planks in the stack.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_SYSTEM_000_081: You count twenty-four planks in the stack.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_GRITHIL_000_082: Eh? Taking stock for Irvithe, are you?
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_GRITHIL_000_083: Well, last I counted, we had sixty-eight planks in the storehouse here.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_GRITHIL_000_084: Nine of those were rotted through, though, so we tossed them out.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_CARPENTER03633_000_: Oi, Grithil, another load's just arrived.
Thirteen planks all told, but one's damaged. It's only good for kindling now.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_GRITHIL_000_087: Right, then. Bring the good ones here, and be sure to let Irvithe know as well.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_GRITHIL_000_088: So, er...how many planks does that make now?
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_GRITHIL_000_089: Eh, you're writing down those numbers anyway, right? I'm sure you can work it out.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_SYSTEM_000_090: You jot down the details of the conversation.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_GRITHIL_000_100: You're writing those numbers down, right? I'm sure you can work it out.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_SYSTEM_000_101: What you learned can be reviewed in your key items.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_IRVITHE_000_110: Done, are you? So, how many planks did you count?
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_IRVITHE_000_111: Eh? That sounds awful low. Reckon you should look at your notes again.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_IRVITHE_000_112: Hmmm, seems to me you forgot the stacks lying outside. Why don't you take another look at your notes?
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_IRVITHE_000_113: Ooh, close. Seems you haven't accounted for the planks that were delivered or thrown out. Might want to check your notes again.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_IRVITHE_000_114: Aye, that's exactly what I counted!
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_IRVITHE_000_115: Thanks for your help, friend. Taking stock fair puts me to sleep, but it has to be done. As promised, I'll give you your lumber. What do you need it for, anyway?
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_IRVITHE_000_116: You were serious about the Ladder!? I'll be damned...
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_IRVITHE_000_117: If that's the case, please let us help with the work!
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_IRVITHE_000_118: We're shipwrights with no ships to build, only shacks. While it's a living, we all itch to do something greater.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_IRVITHE_000_119: This fellow you say is in charge─you reckon he'd mind the likes of us barging in on his project?
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_IRVITHE_000_120: Wonderful! I'll round up the lads and lasses and we'll head over to the Ladder─along with all the lumber you need!
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_IRVITHE_000_121: Hmmm, that's on the high side by my reckoning. You sure you subtracted all the planks that weren't good?
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_IRVITHE_000_122: Whoa, I don't think we have that many. Reckon you should take another look at your notes.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_IRVITHE_000_130: We'll be along soon, and we'll bring all the lumber you need!
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_GRITHIL_000_135: Heh, some real work at last! It's been too long!
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_ALPHINAUD_000_140: The work proceeds apace, I'm pleased to say. When it is restored, the Ladder will not only be our way forward; it will represent a momentous step towards lasting change for Kholusia.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_ALISAIE_000_145: I've rounded up as much material as I could for the work. Just my little bit for the cause.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_THANCRED_000_150: The Eulmorans have rallied quite impressively. Amidst great adversity, a little purpose never goes astray.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_RYNE_000_155: Oh, . I heard you went to find lumber.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_RYNE_000_156: From afar, the Ladder looked like it was made entirely of metal, but there's actually a lot of wood if you look for it.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_YSHTOLA_000_160: By the intensity with which he works, 'tis as if all of that reluctance was a lie.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_CHAINUZZ_000_165: Hmph, such a primitive, inefficient design! A much smaller Talos from our company could just as easily perform the same task!
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_DULIACHAI_000_170: Oh, he'll have them moving again soon! I know he will!
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_URIANGER_000_180: Ah, thou art returned. Wert thou able to procure the lumber?
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_URIANGER_000_181: Well, well, to secure not only the material, but the eager cooperation of the shipwrights besides. Their expertise shall greatly avail our efforts.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_URIANGER_000_182: Master Chai's own efforts have not been without struggle, but he hath proven himself to be a determined soul. I doubt not but that the work shall be complete ere long, and we may continue on our way once more.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_URIANGER_000_183: Though it hath been years in the making, at long last do the people stand united in defiance of the world's fate, their hopes spurring us ever onward towards journey's end.
TEXT_LUCKME104_03633_URIANGER_000_184: Whatsoever may await us, when thou takest those final steps, I pray that it shall be with a smile upon thy face.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALPHINAUD_000_000: The work proceeds apace, I'm pleased to say. When it is restored, the Ladder will not only be our way forward; it will represent a momentous step towards lasting change for Kholusia.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALISAIE_000_005: I've rounded up as much material as I could for the work. Just my little bit for the cause.

TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_URIANGER_000_040: Ah, but prematurely do I give myself to sentimental musings. Many more pressing concerns demand our attention, not the least of which is the matter of how we might reach the mountain, detached from the land as it is.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_URIANGER_000_041: For the present, 'twould appear we have matters here well in hand. Perhaps thou shouldst take thine ease for a time? Thou wilt need every onze of thy strength for the trials ahead.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_URIANGER_000_050: Thy zeal is commendable, my friend, but rest assured we shall not want for hands. Pray take thine ease in preparation for the trials ahead.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_EULMOREMAN03634_000: If you're looking for your friends, they were about to board the lift when someone or other arrived.
They said not to mind them, that they'll be along soon.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALPHINAUD_000_070: And here we finally are, at Top Rung.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALPHINAUD_000_071: The others should arrive ere long─
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALISAIE_000_072: (-Alisaie-)Alphinaud, ! Come up here! There's something I need you to see!
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALPHINAUD_000_080: That appears to be a village...
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALISAIE_000_090: There's a village, . Over to the northeast.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALPHINAUD_000_091: So there is. Yet after two decades without the Ladder in operation, I would not be surprised if such an isolated settlement had long since been abandoned.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALISAIE_000_092: Nor I. But that was before I spied someone leave it and proceed to head in our direction, all the while trying to remain unseen...
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALISAIE_000_093: Whoever this mysterious person is, they should still be out there. Go on and take a look, .
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALPHINAUD_000_100: So long as they have the resources to sustain themselves, it's entirely possible that people could still be about...
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALISAIE_000_105: Go on and take a look, . The mysterious person should still be out there.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_SYSTEM_000_110: Search your surroundings for the mysterious person. You may move the camera as well as zoom in and out. Target the figure and inspect them with .
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALISAIE_000_111: There's someone, right? And they were spying on us. Personally, I don't feel comfortable not knowing who they are. What do you say we investigate?
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALPHINAUD_000_112: I'm curious too, I must admit. And I daresay we have a bit of time ere the others ascend.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALISAIE_000_113: It's settled, then. Let's head to the village and see if it's indeed inhabited.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALPHINAUD_000_120: The crates and barrels are laden with unknown contents.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALISAIE_000_125: I could have sworn I heard a noise...
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_SYSTEM_000_130: You hear faint sounds from inside the building. However, the door refuses to budge.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_SYSTEM_000_131: Food has been hung out to dry in the sun, and quite recently by your reckoning.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_SYSTEM_000_132: The cups are half-empty...or half-full, depending on how you see such things. Behind the counter, a kettle bubbles steadily over the stove.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALPHINAUD_000_140: What news, ? Were you able to find anything of note?
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_A1_000_001: People are definitely still living here.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_A1_000_002: I couldn't find our mysterious person.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_A1_000_003: Maybe this place really is abandoned.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALPHINAUD_000_141: Indeed. While there's no one to be seen, 'tis plain that this village is anything but abandoned.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALPHINAUD_000_142: Nor I. But while there's no one to be seen, 'tis plain that this village is anything but abandoned.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALPHINAUD_000_143: I don't think so, my friend. While there's no one to be seen, 'tis plain that this village is anything but abandoned.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALISAIE_000_144: If the villagers are trying to conceal themselves, they are doing a rather poor job of it. But if they don't wish to be seen, what are we to do?
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_TRISTOL_000_145: (-???-)I say, aren't you the ones who saved my life?
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALPHINAUD_000_146: You're Tristol, the artist from Eulmore!
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_TRISTOL_000_147: You remembered! Ever since we parted ways, I've worried for you, bound for the city as you were. Never did I imagine that we would meet again, and here of all places!
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALPHINAUD_000_148: We could say the very same thing to you, my friend. I'm glad to see you hale and whole. But tell me, what is this village?
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_TRISTOL_000_149: This is Amity, a settlement made up of those who survived being exiled from Eulmore.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_TRISTOL_000_150: As I wandered the wilds, I chanced to cross paths with an inhabitant of these parts.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_TRISTOL_000_151: He took me through a secret tunnel which led to the top of the Bright Cliff. I've been here ever since. Life is hard, but we know a semblance of peace.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_TRISTOL_000_152: Well, we did at any rate─until Mt. Gulg broke away from the earth. Then just as suddenly, the Ladder started moving again...
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALISAIE_000_153: And you feared whoever was coming up would threaten your lives.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_TRISTOL_000_154: Aye... But I see now there's no cause for concern. Will you tell me what has brought you here?
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_TRISTOL_000_155: So Vauthry is a sin eater, and he's fled to Mt. Gulg...
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_TRISTOL_000_156: 'Tis a strange tale, but I have no reason to doubt your words.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_TRISTOL_000_157: I owe you my life. If there is anything I can do to help, you need but say the word.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALPHINAUD_000_158: Your help would be most welcome, Tristol. To begin with, we request your people's permission to reconnoiter the area.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_ALPHINAUD_000_159: If we are to confront Vauthry, we must find a way to reach Mt. Gulg.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_TRISTOL_000_160: Of course, you hardly need our permission to be here. I will tell the others about you and yours.
TEXT_LUCKME105_03634_TRISTOL_000_161: Now, we haven't much to offer in the way of hospitality, but our village is at your disposal. Please use it as you see fit in your quest.
TEXT_LUCKME106_03635_ALPHINAUD_000_000: I'm pleased to see that the villagers are no longer wary of us. I shall take the opportunity to ask about Mt. Gulg.
TEXT_LUCKME106_03635_ALISAIE_000_020: Yet another hapless soul that Alphinaud saved from mortal danger, I see. Some things never change.
TEXT_LUCKME106_03635_ALISAIE_000_021: At any rate, it seems that Brother has a mind to linger. Meanwhile, I have a mind for us to explore.
TEXT_LUCKME106_03635_ALISAIE_000_022: and I are going to scout out the area. We'll be back in a while.
TEXT_LUCKME106_03635_ALPHINAUD_000_023: O-Oh? Very well, then. Just take care out there.
TEXT_LUCKME106_03635_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Take care out there. If you sense even the slightest danger, pray turn back at once.
TEXT_LUCKME106_03635_ALISAIE_000_040: The path diverges. Let's split up so we can cover more ground. I'll go east if you would be so kind as to head west.
TEXT_LUCKME106_03635_ALISAIE_000_041: We can aim to meet at the foot of the mountain, taking note of what we see along the way. In a short while, then.
TEXT_LUCKME106_03635_ALPHINAUD_000_060: Soon after you left, who should arrive in Amity but Urianger and the Exarch. I'm glad they were able to find you.
TEXT_LUCKME106_03635_THANCRED_000_065: I'm told you went ahead to scout out the volcano. I don't suppose some grappling hooks will suffice?
TEXT_LUCKME106_03635_RYNE_000_070: A-All that grinding and shaking... I-I was afraid the lift floor would fall out from underneath me...
TEXT_LUCKME106_03635_RYNE_000_071: B-But don't worry! I-I'm sure the trembling will go away s-soon!
TEXT_LUCKME106_03635_URIANGER_000_075: Thus are we all gathered...though Ryne, I am afeared, did not much enjoy the ascent.
TEXT_LUCKME106_03635_YSHTOLA_000_080: Forgive us our delay. The Exarch arrived and we took some time to apprise him of our mission.
TEXT_LUCKME106_03635_MYSTERYVOICE_000_08: ...Concerned for my health, are you? Indeed, we are a little far from the Crystarium, but rest assured this old man can muster up another wind for what is to come.
TEXT_LUCKME106_03635_CHAINUZZ_000_090: Oh, don't mind us. We're just taking in the sights.
TEXT_LUCKME106_03635_DULIACHAI_000_095: Ahhh, such an exhilarating ride! And such a magnificent view! Nothing in Eulmore compares to this!
TEXT_LUCKME106_03635_ALISAIE_000_100: Hm... I didn't expect to see the Chais here. Though I suppose it's well within their rights.
TEXT_LUCKME106_03635_ALISAIE_000_101: At any rate, it's time to tackle our next little obstacle: finding a way to reach Mt. Gulg.
TEXT_LUCKME106_03635_ALISAIE_000_102: For this, we'll need to put all our heads together...

TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_MYSTERYVOICE_000_04: Shall we see how we might be of service?
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_DULIACHAI_000_045: When he asked for my hand, my husband promised that he would one day build a Talos that could take us to the very heavens. And now he'll do it!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_050: Have the design ready, she says! In good time, she says! Does she even understand what's involved!?
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_051: Before I can even attempt to design anything, I need intimate knowledge of the land─the knowledge of locals. Last I heard, no one lives here!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_052: What? A village of Eulmoran exiles!?
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_053: B-But...those people have every reason to loathe a free citizen like me! They couldn't possibly be willing to cooperate!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_054: <sob> This will never work. Never. I never should've fixed that ruddy lift. Never should've ridden it up here... Never should've...never should've...
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_060: I can't do it... It's impossible...
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_DULIACHAI_000_070: Oh dear, darling appears to have lost the plot...
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_DULIACHAI_000_071: But he has it in him, . He's the cleverest man I know─he just wants for confidence sometimes. If you were to give him some words of encouragement, I'm sure he can give you your Talos.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_DULIACHAI_000_072: A bit of advice I learned from his mother: he responds poorly to obvious praise. You'll need to find another way to stoke the fires of his motivation─awaken his sense of daring!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_SYSTEM_000_073: Choose words that will best encourage Chai-Nuzz.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_SYSTEM_000_074: In order to succeed, you must lift his spirits sufficiently during the conversation.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_081: I can't do it. No one can. A Talos of that size...no one's even dreamed of it.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_A1_000_001: Alphinaud once struggled to collect firewood.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_A1_000_002: Dulia is counting on you as well.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_A1_000_003: You're a genius! You can do this!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_082: He did? But...he's such a capable lad, brimming with confidence.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_083: Hmmm... I suppose even the most capable among us have struggles to overcome...
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_084: But regardless of my own feelings, I can't do a damn thing without help from those villagers...and they're not bally likely to give it!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_085: I know, I know! You hardly need to tell me that! Do you think I'd disappoint her if I could help it!?
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_086: But regardless of my own feelings, I can't do a damn thing without help from those villagers...and they're not bally likely to give it!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_087: Oh, it's simple as that, is it? You say some magic words and I can suddenly do the impossible? Don't make me laugh!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_088: As I said, I can't do a damn thing without help from those villagers...and they're not bally likely to give it!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_089: Tristol's among them, you said so yourself! Lest you've forgotten, we essentially sent him to his death! Even if the others don't bear a personal grudge, he would never forgive us!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_A2_000_001: You don't know until you apologize. I'll come with you.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_A2_000_002: Don't worry! He'll forgive you for sure!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_A2_000_003: Things won't improve by themselves. You have to take the first step.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_090: Hmmm... If you were there too, perhaps he'd be more willing to accept an apology...
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_091: W-Wait... What am I thinking, relying on others to fight my battles? It's disgraceful, is what it is, and it might even make things worse...
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_092: And in the end, it's not even a question of forgiveness. Building such an enormous Talos is impossible, and no amount of contrition will change that!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_093: How can you make such blithe claims without proof? You're either naive or you think I am─and I most certainly am not!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_094: And whatever you say, in the end it's not even a question of forgiveness. Building such an enormous Talos is impossible, and no amount of contrition will change that!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_095: I know, I know... Unless we take the first step, there can never be reconciliation.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_096: This is a chance for everyone to come together. Even if they hurled stones at me, perhaps it's worth trying to apologize...
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_097: But what then? In the end, it's not even a question of forgiveness. Building such an enormous Talos is impossible, and no amount of contrition will change that.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_098: And even if by some miracle the people of Amity were willing to let bygones be bygones, they'd think that the plan is absurd! I think it's absurd!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_A3_000_001: It's less absurd than the change that's come to Eulmore.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_A3_000_002: We liberated a castle with a strategy that many would call absurd.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_A3_000_003: Everything you touch turns to gold! No one would doubt your plan!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_099: Well, I can't argue with that logic... Enormous as the task is, it's simply a matter of finding a solution to a practical problem. From that perspective, it's not entirely unrealistic.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_100: But realistic or no, there's no guarantee of success. There are risks to consider should the venture fail.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_101: Well now, to flood the very castle you sought to reclaim... Such a strategy could indeed be considered absurd. Yet you succeeded not in spite of, but because of it.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_102: Our own strategy may likewise seem absurd, but maybe─just maybe it stands a better chance of success for it...
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_103: But be that as it may, there are risks to consider should the venture fail.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_104: I've no idea where that absolute confidence of yours comes from, but it only makes me feel more wary!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_105: And even assuming there's a semblance of realism to the plan, have you considered the risks should the venture fail?
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_106: Aye, imagine for a moment that we fail to reach Vauthry and only succeed in provoking him. In his fury, he may well unleash his hordes of eaters and we'll meet a horrible end!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_A4_000_002: I'll protect you. I'll protect everyone.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_A4_000_003: We could build Talos for battle.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_107: Oh, so I can die with you!? How very kind of you to offer! But if it's all the same, I'd rather keep on living!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_108: <sigh> How can you remain so...so optimistic throughout all this? It's downright tiring...
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_110: I-I see what you did there. That's how you win over the masses─with that irrepressible aura of dependability.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_111: But very well, you've made your conviction clear...and I'm assured in spite of myself. I won't let my fears get the better of me. It's unseemly if nothing else.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_112: Still, I find it astounding that you can have such certainty given the circumstances.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_113: I've thought of that, I assure you, but I'm afraid Talos cannot contend with sin eaters. If they could, I would never have come to Eulmore.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_114: Nonetheless, I appreciate your earnest attempt to find a solution.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_115: It makes me wonder, what is it that drives you?
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_116: Tell me, why did you throw yourself into the midst of such a grueling struggle?
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_118: Indeed... What else could compel us to face such dangers? I too have someone I wish to protect, with whom I want to live out my days in peace...
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_119: Adventure... Such a strange word coming from my lips... I used to have a sense of adventure too. Strove to challenge myself. Whenever did I lose it?
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_120: So you do not fight willingly. Just like me. We may put on a smile, but behind it there's only doubt. If even your heart isn't in it, there's no hope for any of us. No point in building the Talos.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_SYSTEM_000_121: You failed to encourage Chai-Nuzz. Speak with Dulia-Chai to try again.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_122: Yes... Yes! By the gods, I can do this! I just need to have a little faith in myself!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_123: Right, let's head to Amity and speak with the villagers─with Tristol.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_124: My love, things are liable to become more dangerous. I want you to wait for me back in Eulmore.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_DULIACHAI_000_125: No. Wherever you go, I'm going too.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_DULIACHAI_000_126: Besides...you're not the only one who has to apologize.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_127: B-But there's no telling what may happen out here! I don't know if I can keep you safe!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_128: P-Perhaps this is a bad idea after all... I-I don't think I have what it takes...
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_MYSTERYVOICE_000_12: Master Chai. That you are beset with doubt is proof that you can envision the task ahead.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_MYSTERYVOICE_000_13: And that which man can envision, he can make reality. Thus did some old friends of mine once say.
Even should it be a feat fit for the divine, if something has been done before, then it most assuredly can be done again by our own hands.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_132: That's a little idealistic, don't you think!?
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_MYSTERYVOICE_000_13: Perhaps, Master Chai, perhaps. But what is man if not an idealistic creature?
'Tis not an easy thing to achieve one's dreams─my friends can attest to that. Countless times did they meet with frustration in the course of their endeavors.
