None would have found fault with them had they given up, yet they never did. One step after the next, they forged on towards their goals.
And for their determination, they accomplished numerous feats that many believed lay beyond the reach of mankind.
Like them, you are a man of science. Amidst your doubts, surely there is a spark of desire. The desire to make the impossible possible.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_DULIACHAI_000_138: Come, darling. Like the old days, I would be the first to see your Talos.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_139: And you shall be, my dear. I would have none other at my side when my greatest masterpiece awakens.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_MYSTERYVOICE_000_14: I am glad my words struck a chord. Shall we?
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_151: You have every right to be angry with us. But please listen to what I have to say.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_152: I am tasked with delivering these people to Mt. Gulg─by means of a Talos of heretofore unseen proportions.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_153: However, I cannot do this without the cooperation of those with intimate knowledge of this land. That is, you and your fellow villagers.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_TRISTOL_000_154: ...Cooperation? After you ignored my desperate pleas and cast me out, you have the gall to come here and ask for my cooperation?
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_155: You've every right to be upset. Vauthry's not the one to blame for your suffering─we are.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_156: We were free citizens without a care in the world, indifferent to the hardship of others. We didn't know what would become of you, and frankly, we didn't care.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_157: But we know now that what we did to you─to full many─was wrong. Terribly wrong. No words will suffice to make amends, but I want you to know that we are deeply sorry.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_TRISTOL_000_158: I'm not sure how I feel.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_TRISTOL_000_159: Should I forgive you? Hate you? Perhaps it's not even my place to judge. After all, I sought a place in your city. I wanted to be you, once...
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_TRISTOL_000_160: But one thing is clear to me.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_TRISTOL_000_161: All of that is in the past. And we mustn't let past wrongs stand in the way of a brighter future.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_TRISTOL_000_162: And so...I will cooperate with you. Please see our friends to Mt. Gulg.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_164: I'll set to work on the design at once. Wouldn't do to have nothing to show the others when they return with help.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_165: Make no mistake, this venture is unprecedented in the history of Talos building─nay, the history of all mankind! But rest assured this genius of Daedalus Stoneworks will deliver!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_168: Well...er, you see... I've been promised people to procure the stone as well as imbue magic.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_169: When I was put on the spot earlier, I thought that was all we required.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_170: But I forgot about one rather important item needed to bring a Talos to life...
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_171: That's right, the heart! I'm pleased to see you have some familiarity with Talos!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_172: The heart! The godsdamned, bally heart! Without one, a Talos is just a hunk of rock!
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_173: So, while I work on the design, I'd be much obliged if you could see to procuring the ore with which to fashion a heart.
TEXT_LUCKME107_03636_CHAINUZZ_000_174: A heart suitable of bringing to life a Talos that shall embrace the very firmament!
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_MYSTERYVOICE_000_00: A quest for the Talos's heart... This presents an unexpected opportunity.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_CHAINUZZ_000_005: Ideally, a Talos heart should be made from ore found in the selfsame region as the stone for the chassis. Let's see what Tristol can tell us.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_DULIACHAI_000_010: I'm glad Tristol was willing to lend us an ear. It's but a small step, but I pray this will pave the way for reconciliation.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_TRISTOL_000_020: If you seek material for the Talos's heart, I know people who may be able to assist.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_TRISTOL_000_021: They are the Tholls, a dwarven family that have long mined this land. No one knows its bounty as well as they.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_TRISTOL_000_022: If you explain your situation, I'm sure they would be willing to cooperate. Indeed, 'twas one of them that showed me the secret tunnel to the top of the cliff.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_TRISTOL_000_023: You will find the Tholls at their village to the northwest, a place called Tomra. When you arrive, seek an audience with Chief Xamott...and do not forget to greet him with a hearty lali-ho!
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_MYSTERYVOICE_000_02: Permit me to join you, . I would keep my joints limber, and mayhap I can provide some manner of assistance.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_CHAINUZZ_000_025: I'll leave the heart to the two of you, then. The variety of ore doesn't matter so long as it's rich with aether.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_CHAINUZZ_000_026: I'll aim to have my design complete by your return.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_CHAINUZZ_000_030: If aether-rich ore proves elusive, we can make up for it with quantity. The Stoneworks had techniques for such situations.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_DULIACHAI_000_035: Is the Exarch unwell? Do take care out there.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_TRISTOL_000_040: After the Ladder stopped moving, the Tholls used secret tunnels to move freely around the island. While they mostly keep to themselves, they are a friendly folk.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_MYSTERYVOICE_000_05: Seldom do we see the dwarven folk at the Crystarium. To now be in the presence of so many...
I shall enjoy not having to crane my neck for a change.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_A1_000_003: What did you just call me!?
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_054: (-Boisterous Dwarf-)Ah, a rousin' greeting! You've clearly been practicin'!
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_055: (-Boisterous Dwarf-)What sorry excuse for a greeting was that!? Where's your heart, !? Your stones!?
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_056: (-Boisterous Dwarf-)It's a greeting, ! A lali-ho for a lali-ho─that's the way it works!
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_059: (-Boisterous Dwarf-)Hmmm, not bad, not bad. But there's room for improvement.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_060: (-Boisterous Dwarf-)Anyroad, now that we've observed common courtesy─who are you and what're you doin' here?
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_061: (-Boisterous Dwarf-)Anyroad, now that we've observed common courtesy─who are you and what happened to your helm?
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_MYSTERYVOICE_000_06: At the recommendation of the denizens of Amity, we have come to seek the aid of the Tholl family. May we speak with Chief Xamott?
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_063: Why, yes you may! I am Xamott, and I bid you welcome to Tomra!
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_064: If it's the folk of Amity what sent you here, you must have quite a tale to tell. Come, let's hear it!
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_065: Well, well! And there I thought those below had no fight left in 'em!
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_066: Havin' said that, it's not like we know how to deal with that floatin' volcano and all them sin eaters neither.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_067: If you're serious about restorin' peace to these parts, though, we'll gladly lend you a hand.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_069: The kind of ore you seek's precious to us too.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_070: If I let you have it only for you to bungle things up and squander it, like, no amount of ale will wash away my chagrin.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_071: First, I need to make sure you're worthy─by means of a trial! Aye, a trial most tricksy, passed down through the line of Tholl!
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_073: Heh heh heh... Come with me and I'll tell you all.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_091: As you know, we're a minin' folk. And in the minin' life, danger's a constant companion.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_092: So, when we come of age, each of us must prove our readiness to take to the mines.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_093: This we do by undertakin' a trial what tests the three traits all good miners can't do without: discernment, diligence, and dexterity. We call it...3-D MineRunner!
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_094: Now, look on my helm. Mark its features well. You'll be given a slingshot, which you must use to shoot dwarves as wear helms what are different.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_095: I've already made the necessary arrangements. When you're ready to take the trial, report to the observer nearby. Best of luck to you!
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_MYSTERYVOICE_000_10: Well, I am pleased that the trial isn't needlessly dangerous. Though the dwarves who are our targets may beg to differ.
Would you care to do the honors, my friend? It scarce needs to be said, but you are best suited of the two of us.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_105: Aye, take a good look at my helm. The pair of magnificent horns. It's the mark of our clan, and if you see it─for goodness' sake, stay your hand!
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_GUIDEDWARF03637_000: Lali-ho! You must be the challenger the chief mentioned. I'll show you to the rooftop at once.
As I'm sure you've been told, in 3-D MineRunner, you use a slingshot to shoot them as wear the wrong helm. Let's begin with a spot of practice, eh?
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_SYSTEM_000_112: Search for the dwarf wearing the wrong type of helm. You may move the camera, as well as zoom in and out. Target the dwarf and use the slingshot with .
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_GUIDEDWARF03637_000: Next time, it's the trial for true. Let me know when you're ready, eh?
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_MYSTERYVOICE_000_12: I shall pray for your success.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_125: Good form there, , but that was only practice. The actual trial's a deal harder!
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_GUIDEDWARF03637_000: Ready for the trial? Right this way, then!
This time, there'll be them as wear the right helm. You shoot them, you fail, so look carefully afore you let the stone fly!
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_SYSTEM_000_132: Search for the dwarf wearing the wrong type of helm. You may move the camera, as well as zoom in and out. Target the dwarf and use the slingshot with .
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_GUIDEDWARF03637_000: Well done, well done! The trial never lies─you've got what it takes to be a miner!
Run along back to the chief, now, and get on with puttin' an end to all this strangeness of late!
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_MYSTERYVOICE_000_15: Welcome back, . Though such a trial must be as a relaxing diversion compared to your usual endeavors, it was still an impressive display.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_GUIDEDWARF03637_000: Oh, no need to worry about them as you struck. They wouldn't have felt it through their armor.
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_160: That was some impressive shooting, ! Consider me satisfied!
TEXT_LUCKME108_03637_XAMOTT_000_161: Aye, 'tis plain you didn't come this far with luck alone. So I'll place my faith in you, and help you find the ore you seek.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_MYSTERYVOICE_000_00: Welcome back, . Though such a trial must be as a relaxing diversion compared to your usual endeavors, it was still an impressive display.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_XAMOTT_000_010: Did you know that Kholusia's rich in sulphur? Well, it is. We've been minin' the stuff since ancient times.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_XAMOTT_000_011: And every so often, the selfsame veins yield what's called earthseed, a rare ore steeped in magick.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_XAMOTT_000_012: Time was, we used to refine earthseed for this and that, but the technique's been lost. The stuff's still out there to be had, though, provided you know where to look. And no place is surer'n the Duergar's Tewel.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_XAMOTT_000_013: Problem is, the site's occupied by our age-old rivals─the Goggs. Greedy sods claim the place is theirs, and refuse to let any other bugger near!
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_XAMOTT_000_014: Oh, there never was a more odious lot than them Goggs. I could go on forever about those hornless whoresons... But then we'd be here forever, and that won't get us nowhere.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_XAMOTT_000_015: What it boils down to is this: if you want the earthseed, you've got to deal with the Goggs. Reckon you're up to the challenge?
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_MYSTERYVOICE_000_01: We have dealt with far worse. I am sure we can find a way to obtain what we need.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_XAMOTT_000_017: That's the spirit! Now, to help you find your way, I'll have one of ours go with you.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_KORUTT_000_018: (-???-)I'll do it! I'll go with them!
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_KORUTT_000_020: I couldn't help overhearing. I knew the eaters had flocked to Mt. Gulg, but I didn't know why. To think the last Lightwarden's hiding up there...
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_KORUTT_000_021: The fate of Kholusia─no, the world─hangs in the balance. If I can be of some help, then I want to do my part!
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_XAMOTT_000_022: Your zeal is commendable, lad, but it isn't so simple...
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_XAMOTT_000_023: This here's Korutt. Young as he is, he's one of the village's finest miners. The lad's got an uncanny sense of where to dig, and his aim with a pickaxe is as true as any dwarf's.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_XAMOTT_000_024: But put him in the thick of battle, and he couldn't hit the side of a mine cart if he was sitting in it.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_XAMOTT_000_025: If all he needed to do was dig, he'd be your dwarf, but he's liable to become a sin eater's breakfast before he can even manage a swing.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_KORUTT_000_026: It's true... I'm hopeless in a fight...
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_KORUTT_000_027: But I still want to try! Please! Please let me go with you!
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_A1_000_001: I take care of you, you take care of the ore.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_A1_000_002: As long as you're aware of the dangers.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_KORUTT_000_028: Oh, thank you so much! I'll try my best not to be a burden!
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_XAMOTT_000_029: If you want to take Korutt, far be it from me to stop you. Keep him safe, though, will you?
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_MYSTERYVOICE_000_03: We will most assuredly encounter sin eaters along the way.
Though, with you in our company, they will be more a spectacle than a concern.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_MYSTERYVOICE_000_04: See to your preparations, my friend. We will depart as soon as you are ready.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_XAMOTT_000_045: Seriously, though, take care of Korutt. Lad's weaker'n a pint of pisswater.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_KORUTT_000_050: The Duergar's Tewel lies in a cave to the east. I'm ready when you are!
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_KORUTT_000_052: J-Just as we're about to get there!
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_MYSTERYVOICE_000_05: One last push, then. Shall we, ?
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_MYSTERYVOICE_000_06: 'Twas a near thing in the end, but what matters is that we pulled through. Well fought, my friend.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_KORUTT_000_071: Let's hurry inside before any more sin eaters come!
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_KORUTT_BATTLETALK_0: We'll keep to the road and head east. I'm in your hands!
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_MYSTERYVOICE_BATTLE: It seems we have a fair distance to cover. Be on your guard for sin eaters.
Speak of the devils... , the one on the left is yours.
See that Korutt comes to no harm.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_KORUTT_BATTLETALK_0: Amazing! You two are really strong!
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_MYSTERYVOICE_BATTLE: Ah heh... It may interest you to know that  is a great hero in the land whence  hails. Some would say the greatest.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_KORUTT_BATTLETALK_0: Really? Oh, you must have some stories to tell, !
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_MYSTERYVOICE_BATTLE: That  does. Tales to impress and inspire you in turn. By all means, have  regale you with a few once our work is done.
Stay behind us, Korutt.
, focus on the enemy. I will protect our charge.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_KORUTT_BATTLETALK_0: Phew... I don't know much about fighting, but you two make a great team!
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_MYSTERYVOICE_BATTLE: is a team unto self. I merely follow  lead.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_KORUTT_BATTLETALK_0: Well, it looks like you've been doing this for years to me!
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_MYSTERYVOICE_BATTLE: ...Is that so? I...I shall take that as a compliment.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_KORUTT_BATTLETALK_0: Um...did I say the wrong thing?
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_MYSTERYVOICE_BATTLE: Not at all. Your words are most heartening. Indeed, I feel like a young man again.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_KORUTT_BATTLETALK_0: You talk as if you're old! How long have you two known each other, anyway?
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_MYSTERYVOICE_BATTLE: Well...
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_KORUTT_BATTLETALK_0: Uwaaah! There's even more of them!
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_MYSTERYVOICE_BATTLE: This is too close to Amity for comfort. Let's finish them quickly and move on.
How much farther to the cave?
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_KORUTT_BATTLETALK_0: Not far. It's just past this rise.
TEXT_LUCKME109_03638_MYSTERYVOICE_BATTLE: Ah, I believe I see it.
It appears we are surrounded...
Fortunately, I have a little trick for such occasions.
, draw them in!
'Tis done. Let us press on.
I will shield Korutt! Give the eaters everything you have!
I will ward off the attack! Stand with Korutt, !
Not good... Quickly, spread out!
It appears the commotion drew this one out. ─time to bring all to bear!
Ungh... Not now...
Your tale will not end here!
Concentrate on the ones coming for Korutt! I will see to the rest!
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_MYSTERYVOICE_000_00: 'Twas a near thing in the end, but what matters is that we pulled through. Well fought, my friend.
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_KORUTT_000_010: Right, follow me please! I will take you to the Duergar's Tewel, where the purest sulphur in the land may be found!
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_KOGGDWARFA03639_000: Who the hells are you!? We don't take kindly to outsiders, so bugger off afore we kick you out!
Who the hells are you!? If you're not one of us, you must be one of the Tholls! Bugger off afore we kick you out!
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_KOGGDWARFB0363_000_: Ahhh! Intruder! Send word to Chief Glagg!
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_KOGGDWARFC03639_000: ...Hmmm? Well, such a strange-looking Talos you are.
...Hmmm? Are you a Gogg? You don't look like a Gogg. That must make you...a Talos. Yes, a Talos.
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_MYSTERYVOICE_000_03: If the terrain and─<cough>─stench are any indication, we are at the tewel.
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_KORUTT_000_032: The Goggs! With their ugly, unkempt beards!
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_KORUTT_000_033: If they realize we're here, they'll come after us. Best to take them down first!
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_MYSTERYVOICE_000_03: Be not so hasty, Korutt. The animosity between your two clans notwithstanding, I would not resort to violence unless necessary.
I will use an enchantment to render you invisible. It will not fool sin eaters, but it will suffice to hide you from the eyes of men.
While you are thus concealed, do you think you could find us the earthseed?
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_KORUTT_000_037: Aye, I'll dig up the choicest stuff there is!
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_MYSTERYVOICE_000_03: We would be much obliged. Without further ado, then...
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_KORUTT_000_039: Hah, I can see straight through me! Right, a-digging we will go!
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_MYSTERYVOICE_000_04: Let us not be idle either.
Though Korutt cannot be seen, he may still be heard. I would aid him by removing some few Goggs from the field. To that end...
Dream powder. As you may recall, we used it for the rescue mission at Laxan Loft.
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_A1_000_001: We used it in Eulmore too.
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_MYSTERYVOICE_000_04: Truly? It seems our alchemists got a little carried away with the latest batch...
But if it has been useful in our endeavors, then I have no cause to complain.
Now then, I shall make you invisible as well, that you might steal close to the dwarves and give them a dose of dream powder.
Even should it fail to put them to sleep outright, it should render them drowsy enough to seek their beds.
Say the word, and I will cast the enchantment.
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_MYSTERYVOICE_000_05: Should the enchantment fade before you finish tending to all the dwarves, return to me and I will cast it anew.
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_MYSTERYVOICE_000_06: Need another dose of invisibility, do you? Very well.
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_KOGGDWARFA03639_000: Who the hells are you!? We don't take kindly to outsiders, so bugger off afore we kick you out!
Who the hells are you!? If you're not one of us, you must be one of the Tholls! Bugger off afore we kick you out!
Unnngh, can barely keep my eyes open... Time to call it a day...
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_KOGGDWARFB03639_000: Ahhh! Intruder! Send word to Chief Glagg!
<yawn> So drowsy... Not safe to work when drowsy... Better get some rest...
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_KOGGDWARFC03639_000: ...Hmmm? Well, such a strange-looking Talos you are.
...Hmmm? Are you a Gogg? You don't look like a Gogg. That must make you...a Talos. Yes, a Talos.
<yawn> All work and no ale makes...something a something. And I'm spent...
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_MYSTERYVOICE_000_08: All the dwarves have taken their leave. Good work, my friend.
We have done all that we can. Let us await Korutt's return.
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_KORUTT_000_083: This is the purest stuff there is. Think it's enough, or shall I go and dig up some more?
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_MYSTERYVOICE_000_08: I daresay it will suffice for our purposes. You have our gratitude, Korutt.
Let us carry this back to...to...
...Worry not, I shall be fine. Long as I have been away from the Crystarium, a little weakness is to be expected.
I may have also overexerted myself in the moment. Ah, to have this rare opportunity yet be unable to enjoy it to the full...
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_KORUTT_000_090: Uwaaah! Th-That's Glagg, chief of the Goggs!
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_GLAGG_000_091: You! You're one of the Tholls!
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_GLAGG_000_092: I see, I see... Word was our miners were comin' back drowsy, one after the next. I immediately suspected foul play...
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_GLAGG_000_093: And what should I find here but Tholl scum skulkin' about! It's a spineless act befittin' your limp beards!
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_KORUTT_000_094: What!? I won't stand for that insult!
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_KORUTT_000_095: Our beards are soft and luscious and smell like freshly tapped ale! Gogg beards are dry and crusty and smell like a knocker's arse!
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_GLAGG_000_096: Impudent whelp! Better a hobgoblin's nose hairs than the feeble, floppy things you Tholls have hangin' from your faces!
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_MYSTERYVOICE_000_09: Like oil and water... This is not like to end of its own accord.
, do you perchance have some dream powder left?
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_A2_000_001: Enough to put an end to this.
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_A2_000_003: But this was beginning to get interesting...
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_MYSTERYVOICE_000_10: Then let us put it to use and be on our way. Though something tells me we've not seen the last of their bickering...
You are a kind and considerate soul, my friend, but I believe we would be forgiven for needing to hurry. Let us put an end to this and be on our way.
Worry not, my friend. Something tells me you'll have ample opportunity later to witness their bickering. For now, however, we should be on our way.
Forgive me, Korutt, but we need you to be calm as well.
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_KORUTT_000_106: I-I'm sorry... It's just, when it comes to the Goggs, I can't help but see red...
TEXT_LUCKME110_03639_MYSTERYVOICE_000_10: You needn't apologize, my friend. You are here on our account, and we have naught but gratitude for you.
Now that we have what we came for, however, it is time to take our leave. The Talos awaits its heart!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_KORUTT_000_000: I'm glad I could be of help! If you need any more earthseed, just let me know!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_MYSTERYVOICE_000_01: Well, my friend, much as I have enjoyed our time together, I think it best we split up, that we might accomplish our tasks more swiftly.
I shall see the earthseed safely into the hands of Chai-Nuzz.
While I am thus employed, would you be so good as to deliver Korutt back to Tomra?
My thanks, . Brief though it was, 'twas an honor to go adventuring with you. I shall see you back in Amity.
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_MYSTERYVOICE_000_02: Leave the earthseed to me, my friend, and see Korutt safely back to Tomra. While you are there, a word of thanks to Chief Xamott would not go astray.
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_KORUTT_000_025: Phew! Not a single brush with death! Thanks for coming back with me!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_XAMOTT_000_030: Lali-ho! Glad you're back, and in one piece! How did you fare with the earthseed, then?
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_KORUTT_000_031: I got them all they needed! The Exarch's on his way to Amity with it now!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_XAMOTT_000_032: Good to hear that young Korutt was of help. As it happens, a few others came forward while you were gone sayin' they wanted to do their bit as well.
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_XAMOTT_000_033: Given that you're buildin' a Talos, we reckoned you'd be needin' some minin' tools. So we went and modified our spare pickaxes for use by bigger folk.
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_XAMOTT_000_034: Here, take these with you. Should be plenty to go 'round.
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_XAMOTT_000_035: From what our scouts tell me, there's a crowd gathered at Top Rung already. Go and see that everyone has a pickaxe to swing, eh?
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_XAMOTT_000_040: We did the folk of Amity a kind turn in case we needed a kind turn ourselves one day. Can't say as I expected things to turn out like they have, but I don't regret makin' friends!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_KORUTT_000_045: This is just the start! I'm going to go and see what else I can do!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Ah, , you are come at a good time.
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_KAISHIRR_000_055: Alphinaud came and rounded all of us up. It's funny, I used to be afraid of Eulmorans, and yet here we all are...
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_EMPLOYEE03287_000_0: No few free citizens wanted to help, but years of leisure meant that most were in no condition to contribute. Instead, they send their fervent hopes for our success.
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_IRVITHE_000_065: As if restoring the Ladder weren't enough of a task, you're trying to build a giant Talos! I love it!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_GRITHIL_000_070: Did you doubt that we'd be back for more? We've got motivation to spare!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_MAGNUS_000_075: There I was thinking you lot had come up with the stupidest plan known to man, when I find out you've managed to drag old Chai-Nuzz into it. Once the job's done, I'll have to go and give the lazy sod a good heckling.
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_THAFFE_000_080: , good to see you again! How have you been keeping?
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_JERYK_000_085: A-A giant Talos? Can such a thing be done...? Oh, be still my beating heart!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_RHONRON_000_090: Worms! Get your worms! They're the best you'll taste this side of the Bright Cliff! Live and juicy or cured and crunchy, there is something for everyone!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_JOURNEYSHEADNURSE_0: Alisaie came looking for willing workers...so here I am!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_ALISAIE_000_100: Look, ! People from all over have come to help us quarry stone!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_ALISAIE_000_101: And this isn't even all of them. As we speak, the volunteers Thancred and Ryne recruited are being escorted to the work site─and by both Crystarium and Eulmoran soldiers, no less.
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_ALISAIE_000_102: So as you can see, we have plenty of hands. There's just one problem─we don't have enough tools to put in them. We've been desperately trying to round up more, but we haven't had much luck so far.
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_ALISAIE_000_103: Pickaxes from the dwarves!? Trust you to have exactly what we need, exactly when we need it!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_ALISAIE_000_104: Well, what are you waiting for? Go and hand them out to everyone so they can get to work!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_ALISAIE_000_110: Honestly, , you can already slay gods. You could at least have left the uncanny sense of timing for one of us. It's greedy is what it is.
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_KAISHIRR_000_120: We're ready to do our bit, ! We just, er...need tools to do it with.
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_EMPLOYEE03287_000_1: Now we may all work to our hearts' content!
While I don't have many talents, I do have a strong back. And what strength I have, I'll gladly use for the sake of peace.
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_IRVITHE_000_124: We got the Ladder moving again, didn't we? If we join hands, there's no Talos we can't build!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_KAISHIRR_000_125: I still haven't repaid you and Alphinaud for saving me, and I'm not sure I ever could.
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_KAISHIRR_000_126: But that ain't going to stop me trying! I'm with you to the end!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_KAISHIRR_000_127: Come on, you lot! Look lively!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_MAGNUS_000_128: We've come, . In case you're wondering, Guthjon is here too.
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_MAGNUS_000_129: Couldn't wait to start breaking rocks, though, so he's gone on ahead. Bah, he could've at least left us a spare set of tools...
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_MAGNUS_000_130: Ah, wonderful! Now we can be about it too!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_MAGNUS_000_131: Quarrying isn't exactly my stock-in-trade, but this time...this time I feel as though my wife will be with me, guiding my hand...
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_MAGNUS_000_132: So let's make it happen. Let's build a world where everyone can live without fear. Where everyone has a place they can go home to.
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_MAGNUS_000_133:
Right, then, let's be on our way.
...Hm? What are you still doing here, Thaffe? I thought you'd brought your own tools.
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_THAFFE_000_134: I did. And I was just about to head off, when I saw Jeryk...
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_JERYK_000_135: Oh gods, oh gods... If this plan works and the giant Talos comes to life...
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_JERYK_000_136: Just imagine the size of the trolley it could push! Imagine it!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_THAFFE_000_137: <sigh> Are you still raving on about that? How many times do I have to tell you, that's not what the Talos is for! Where the hells would the tracks even go?
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_JERYK_000_138: There's bound to be somewhere! You just need a little imagination! Seeing as the Stoneworks is involved, maybe we could have a trolley added to the design...
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_MAGNUS_000_139: Enough! We're going to work! And if I hear any more about trolleys from you, I'll have you pushing one yourself!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_RHONRON_000_140: Long time no see, traveler! Are you waiting to be issued a pickaxe too?
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_RHONRON_000_141: Oho, you clearly weren't, and now neither are we! Rest assured, we will put these to good use and work very, very hard!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_RHONRON_000_142: Of course, one cannot work on an empty stomach─which is why I brought some tasty worms to share!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_JOURNEYSHEADNURSE_0: Er, as much as we would all enjoy a treat, perhaps the worms are best saved for...afterwards?
Greetings, . You may not remember me, but I'm one of the carers from the Inn at Journey's Head.
After night returned to Amh Araeng, we noticed a change in our patients. The transformation had halted in every one of them.

I can't express what it did to the mood of the place. We were still celebrating, days later, when who should come along but Alisaie. She said that she sought the aid of those who believed in the Warrior of Darkness.
We all answered her call right there and then. Of course, some few carers had to remain behind, but as many of us came as could be spared.
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_RHONRON_000_148: I too have great respect for the Warrior of Darkness! When we meet, I'll be sure to treat them to a nice, plump worm!
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_ALPHINAUD_000_150: Everything appears to be in order here. In all my time in this world, I do not recall seeing so many optimistic faces.
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_ALISAIE_000_160: My thanks, . With that, everyone is now equipped to work.
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_ALISAIE_000_161: I think I'll go and join the soldiers standing guard over the volunteers. It would be a shame if they fell prey to sin eaters after all the trouble we've gone to.
TEXT_LUCKME111_03640_ALISAIE_000_162: Right! Let us see that this plan is a resounding success─for the sake of all in Norvrandt!
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Well, my friend, it appears we are the only ones left here.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_ALPHINAUD_000_001: If you've no other pressing tasks, would you care to accompany me to Amity? There, Y'shtola is overseeing those who will imbue the Talos with magicks.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_ALPHINAUD_000_002: Come, let us join them at once.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_ALPHINAUD_000_010: All proceeds smoothly here, and everyone is being moved into position. The moment of truth is nigh.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_URIANGER_000_015: Pleased am I to say that I was able to call upon a sizable contingent from the Crystarium guard, Captain Lyna herself among them.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_URIANGER_000_0016: Not only do they stand watch over civilians─when the time cometh, they too shall pour their magicks into the Talos.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_RUNAR_000_020: , it does me well to see you again. When Master Matoya told us of the undertaking, we struggled to comprehend the enormity of it.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_RUNAR_000_021: Nonetheless, we have complete faith in you and yours. All that is within our power, the Night's Blessed will do. And as you can see by the presence of their people, Fanow is of the same mind.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_CHAINUZZ_000_025: Hmmm... If the stone is laid out in this manner, the imbuing should begin...ah, yes─here.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_DULIACHAI_000_030: Oh, , my dear. I regret to say that all this moving about has begun to take its toll. Yet my darling husband soldiers on like the redoubtable soul he is.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_DULIACHAI_000_031: I am entirely unqualified to help him with the Talos, of course, but I do what I can to make him more comfortable. A cup of water here, a massage there...
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_GUARDMAN03641_000_0: Let the eaters come! We'll keep everyone safe!
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_YSHTOLA_000_040: Ah, good of you to join us. I'm pleased to say we have gathered ample help for the imbuing.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_YSHTOLA_000_041: With Master Chai in the process of finalizing his design, I have taken the liberty of dispatching all hands to their positions.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_CHAINUZZ_000_042: You hurtle along as though I have my house in order, but quite frankly this is the most disorganized mess of a project I've ever overseen! And I haven't spent nearly as much time as I would like on my calculations!
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_URIANGER_000_043: So thou hast proclaimed loudly and frequently, Master Chai. Yet from my perspective─a layman's though it may be─haste notwithstanding, thou hast gone to great lengths, abiding by proven methodology, to ensure the integrity of thy design.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_CHAINUZZ_000_044: Aye, well, that's just the bare minimum that's expected of us at the Stoneworks. Though our glory days are behind us, I've not forgotten our time-honored traditions.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_CHAINUZZ_000_045: Ah, but I should mention that the Exarch delivered the ore I asked for. Earthseed, I believe he called it.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_CHAINUZZ_000_046: In that quantity, I believe we can fashion a suitable heart for the Talos.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_CHAINUZZ_000_047: And then everything will be in readiness...or so I would like to say.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_CHAINUZZ_000_049: In a Talos of, well, any reasonable size, a single heart will serve to circulate aether throughout the chassis. But given the unprecedented proportions of that which we seek to build, I doubt that will be the case.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_CHAINUZZ_000_050: By installing smaller peripheral hearts at intervals, I believe that we can maintain a stable aether flow, thereby solving the problem. However, we don't have enough ore for this purpose.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_CHAINUZZ_000_051: Naught for it but to procure more, I suppose...
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_YSHTOLA_000_052: Runar, mayhap now is a good time to bring them out.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_RUNAR_000_053: A moment, friends. There is something I would show you.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_URIANGER_000_054: I say, are these not heartstones?
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_RUNAR_000_055: They are. The most prized possession of we of the Night's Blessed. And these belonged to our kindred who have left us.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_YSHTOLA_000_056: Immersed in water imbued with fervent prayer, these stones harbor no small amount of magic.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_YSHTOLA_000_057: And we may imbue them with yet more prior to their installation on the Talos. What think you?
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_CHAINUZZ_000_058: Being from a different region, these cannot be used for the main heart. The peripheral ones, on the other hand... Aye, I believe they will serve.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_RUNAR_000_059: Excellent. When Master Matoya spoke to us of the role we are to play, the heartstones immediately came to mind.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_RUNAR_000_060: Of course, before bringing them with me, I made certain to consult my fellows first. After all, the stones bear the precious lives of those who have gone to the sunless sea.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_RUNAR_000_061: But we have now beheld the sunless sea with our very own eyes, and by the gentle lights that glimmer on high, we know that there is peace beyond.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_RUNAR_000_062: Thus are we also at peace. If our heartstones may serve to restore night to all the world, gladly do we give them.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_YSHTOLA_000_063: So, Master Chai. If you could instruct us how to distribute the heartstones?
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_YSHTOLA_000_064: And ─for good luck, may I ask that you imbue one as well?
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Full many have placed their hopes in our plan, both those who are here and those who could not be. We must not fail them.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_URIANGER_000_075: Yet again, that which was bequeathed by the departed paveth the way for the living.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_CHAINUZZ_000_085: Go on and do your imbuing. I'll see to it the stones are put to good use.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_YSHTOLA_000_090: Rest assured it is not difficult. Simply raise your hand and focus as you would when attuning to an aetheryte.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_YSHTOLA_000_091: Imbue the jade-colored stone here, if you would be so kind.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_SYSTEM_000_110: The familiar-looking heartstone appears to glow faintly.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_YSHTOLA_000_112: If this heartstone appears familiar, it is because it belonged to Toddia.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_YSHTOLA_000_113: It bears the collective hope of the Night's Blessed─the hope that none shall ever again be sacrificed to sin eaters.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_CHAINUZZ_000_114: Right, I've identified the spots on the Talos where the stones are needed. See that they're amply imbued, then install them as I've indicated on this diagram.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_YSHTOLA_000_115: Understood. We will set about the task at once.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_ALPHINAUD_000_116: When the Talos awakens and the way to Mt. Gulg is secured, we shall sally forth.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_ALPHINAUD_000_117: It promises to be a trying climb, so take what rest you can in the meantime. We will see you soon.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_YSHTOLA_000_118: A moment, Urianger. You said that you would have measures ready in the event that our friend fails to contain the Light. Do you?
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_URIANGER_000_119: Be assured that I do. All which I require lieth in this land.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_URIANGER_000_120: So do we all hope, my friend. To that end, thou shouldst take such ease as thou mayest, the better to ready thyself for the trials to come.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_URIANGER_000_121: And I swear to thee that thy trust is not misplaced. As ardently as I pray for the preservation of this world, so too do I pray for thy safety.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_URIANGER_000_122: So rest easy, my friend, and take such ease as thou mayest, the better to be ready for the trials to come.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_URIANGER_000_123: To my deepest regret, I cannot reveal the plan to thee. In order for it to succeed, 'tis vital that thou remainest ignorant of its nature until the time is right.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_URIANGER_000_124: Yet though I may thus keep my counsel, know that I have only thy safety at heart. So rest easy, my friend, and take such ease as thou mayest, the better to be ready for the trials to come.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_CHAINUZZ_000_130: I'm told the rock for the chassis is more or less ready─all quarried and shaped and laid out. That just leaves the imbuers to do their work.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_CHAINUZZ_000_131: I'll continue checking my calculations up until the very last moment, but it's only a matter of time now.
TEXT_LUCKME112_03641_CHAINUZZ_000_132: We managed to rally nigh everyone in Norvrandt for this endeavor. That's a remarkable feat in itself...but will it be enough?
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_DULIACHAI_000_000: Oh, , my dear. I regret to say that all this moving about has begun to take its toll. Yet my darling husband soldiers on like the redoubtable soul he is.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_DULIACHAI_000_005: I am entirely unqualified to help him with the Talos, of course, but I do what I can to make him more comfortable. A cup of water here, a massage there...
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_CHAINUZZ_000_010: Gah, there's no point worrying about such things now. I'll get back to my calculations. You, meanwhile, should go and rest as your friends suggested.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_CHAINUZZ_000_011: My wife and the Exarch should be in the tavern. Why don't you join them?
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_CHAINUZZ_000_020: Why are you still here? Go and get some rest while you can!
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_DULIACHAI_000_030: ...The Exarch? He went outside a moment ago, my dear. I would've thought you'd have seen him.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_DULIACHAI_000_031: He kept me company for a short while, but then he came over rather pale. He's clearly been straining himself, the poor thing.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_DULIACHAI_000_032: Anyway, he excused himself, saying that he needed a breath of fresh air. Weak as he looked, I did offer to go with him, but he assured me he would be fine. I do hope he's all right...
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_DULIACHAI_000_040: Did you find the Exarch? I don't imagine he could have gone far...
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_SYSTEM_000_050: The Exarch does not appear to be nearby.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_SYSTEM_000_052: The Exarch does not appear to be anywhere in the vicinity. There is only the shoebill, gazing unflinchingly southward.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_CHAINUZZ_000_060: There you are! Ahhh, what a relief... When Dulia told me that the Exarch had disappeared, and that you had been a long time finding him, I had feared the worst had happened right before the moment of truth!
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_DULIACHAI_000_065: The Exarch is back, thank heavens, and it seems the sea breeze did him a world of good! I do hope you managed to get a spot of rest as well!
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_MYSTERYVOICE_000_07: Worry not, my friend. I am much revived for the fresh air─and your fine company, of course. Now then, let us turn our thoughts back to the task at hand.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_SYSTEM_000_900: Meanwhile, in the imperial palace in the Source...
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ROBEMAN_000_901: (-Zenos-)Your Radiance. I have taken the liberty of quashing the vile rumors that your heir is possessed by a devil.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ROBEMAN_000_902: (-Zenos-)With the nation in the grip of war, we may rely on patriotic zeal to prevent them from resurfacing.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ROBEMAN_000_904: (-Zenos-)He has taken himself to the First, to usher that world to its end.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ROBEMAN_000_905: (-Zenos-)Or so I believe. He did not disclose the details of his mission, having ever preferred to work alone.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ROBEMAN_000_906: (-Zenos-)Even to those who have known him since the beginning, his actions can prove...unpredictable.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_VARIS_000_907: I am no stranger to his ways. He joys in playing me for a fool. Full many times have I been convinced I was acting of my own volition, only to discover all was as he willed it.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ROBEMAN_000_909: (-Zenos-)On the subject of our esteemed colleague: his last report, though brief, did contain one item of interest.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ROBEMAN_000_910: (-Zenos-)You have doubtless wondered why the Scions of the Seventh Dawn have not taken the field of late.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ROBEMAN_000_911: (-Zenos-)It is because they are no longer in the Source.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ROBEMAN_000_912: (-Zenos-)The hero of the Scions has journeyed to the First─as have  comrades, albeit incompletely. Their bodies yet remain here in the Source.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ROBEMAN_000_913: (-Zenos-)This presents an opportunity. If we can defeat the Alliance prior to the Scions' return, we may eliminate their order at a stroke.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ROBEMAN_000_914: (-Zenos-)And with the Scions gone, none shall remain to thwart our plans. It will be but a matter of striking down the hero upon  homecoming.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ROBEMAN_000_915: (-Zenos-)Which, lest you forget, is essential to the realization of our objective. Of both of our objectives.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ROBEMAN_000_916: (-Zenos-)Through Hydaelyn's meddling, Her champions threaten to wrest the reins of fate from our grasp. The world is at risk of being dragged down the false path.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ROBEMAN_000_917: (-Zenos-)One which will never see man reclaim his true form.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ROBEMAN_000_918: (-Zenos-)'Tis unthinkable that he should supplant us, incomplete as he is. Such a devolution is abhorrent. And it must be stopped─before it is too late.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ROBEMAN_000_919: (-Zenos-)The hour is come, Your Radiance. Order your armies to march once more. Crush all who stand in your way.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ROBEMAN_000_920: (-Zenos-)This is your heart's desire, is it not? To seize a victory that is yours and yours alone─for the future of Garlemald!
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ZENOS_000_921: (-???-)Oh dear... You do not wear the mummer's motley well. I was never one to take an interest in tedious conflicts.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ZENOS_000_922: The whereabouts of my one true friend, however─they interest me greatly. I but hope the beasts of this “First” are providing  proper sport.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ZENOS_000_923: I would know every detail, Lord Zenos. Or would you rather I called you Elidibus?
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ROBEMAN_000_925: (-Elidibus-)That immortality should be within the reach of one with a borrowed Echo.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ROBEMAN_000_926: (-Elidibus-)You have outdone yourself, Zenos yae Galvus.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ZENOS_000_927: I have no particular attachment to that name─but I am rather fond of that body. Without it, I cannot enjoy my hunt to the fullest.
TEXT_LUCKME113_03642_ZENOS_000_928: Your secrets or my flesh. I care not which you give me first. The choice is yours.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_DULIACHAI_000_000: The Exarch is back, thank heavens, and it seems the sea breeze did him a world of good! I do hope you managed to get a spot of rest as well!
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_MYSTERYVOICE_000_00: Worry not, my friend. I am quite well. Let us ask Master Chai where things stand with the Talos.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_CHAINUZZ_000_010: Right, so, while the two of you were away, I received word that everything is in place, meaning we can proceed with awakening the Talos.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_CHAINUZZ_000_011: Once we imbue the magic, it will stir itself and immediately carry out its designated function: namely, taking Mt. Gulg in its grasp.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_MYSTERYVOICE_000_01: , we may be certain that Vauthry will not look on in idleness as we beat a path to his front door. Once our plans are set in motion, there will be no turning back.
So see to your preparations as meticulously as you may, and I will give the order to proceed as soon as you are ready.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_CHAINUZZ_000_020: I did everything I could. It will work. It will! I hope it will.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_DULIACHAI_000_025: Everything will be fine, I assure you! No Talos my husband has poured himself into has ever failed, and that is not about to change now!
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_MYSTERYVOICE_000_03: Give the word, and I will relay the order to awaken the Talos.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_A1_000_002: Sorry, but I need more time.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_MYSTERYVOICE_000_03: It's quite all right. Better to take what time you require than set out unprepared.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_MYSTERYVOICE_000_04: I will see that everyone else is a safe distance away. Go and join your comrades, my friend, and focus only on reaching Vauthry.
Come what may, we must prevail this day!
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_CHAINUZZ_000_045: Hahaha! Is there anything you can't do!? A genius is what you are, old boy! A genius among─
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_CHAINUZZ_000_046: ...Ahem. I've played my part. The rest is up to you lot now. Carry on!
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_DULIACHAI_000_050: Take care, do you hear? Make sure you all come back safe and sound, or I shall be most upset!
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_RYNE_000_070: Vauthry cannot hide from us now!
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_URIANGER_000_075: 'Twill not be long before the sin eaters mark our presence. We must expect fierce resistance.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_YSHTOLA_000_081: The Talos has taken hold of the mountain. As planned, we will use its body as a bridge to reach Vauthry's sanctuary.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_ALISAIE_000_082: The sin eaters will make us work for every yalm, of course.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_ALPHINAUD_000_083: But we will carve a path through their ranks, and meet with their master, regardless.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_A2_000_002: Last one there's a rotten egg!
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_A3_000_002: Form a party and enter Mt. Gulg.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_ALPHINAUD_000_090: Above us lies Vauthry's new paradise.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_ALPHINAUD_000_091: A paradise swarming with sin eaters, in which his own people have no place...
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_ALPHINAUD_000_092: It ends here. And it ends now.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_ALISAIE_000_095: When our hunt for the Lightwardens began, I couldn't imagine ever being done with the task.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_ALISAIE_000_096: Yet here we are, ready to lay the last one low. We'll get you there, . Mark my words!
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_THANCRED_000_100: How many eaters await us up there, do you suppose? A hundred? A thousand?
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_THANCRED_000_101: Not that it matters, of course. Whatever the odds, we will overcome them. Minfilia wanted this world saved, and save it we shall.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_RYNE_000_105: Until Thancred freed me, I knew nothing of Norvrandt.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_RYNE_000_106: But in the course of our journey, I've come to love this land and those who call it home. And I will give my all to protect them.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_URIANGER_000_110: That which now graspeth the mountain is no mere man of stone.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_URIANGER_000_111: 'Tis the hopes of all who have dwelled in this world, both in the past and in the present. 'Tis the prayers of all who yearn for peace, be they near or be they far.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_YSHTOLA_000_115: 'Tis a trivial concern, but I cannot help feeling self-conscious knowing that some of the Night's Blessed are watching.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_YSHTOLA_000_116: In the guise of Master Matoya, I took great pains to cultivate an image of restraint. Yet I don't suppose they will be able to make out all that much from such a distance...meaning I may wreak havoc to my heart's content. I do believe I'm going to enjoy this.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_GUIDESOLDIER03643_0: ! Will you be heading to the Crown of the Immaculate?
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_Q4_000_000: Proceed to the Crown of the Immaculate?
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_ALPHINAUD_000_130: With your powers, you could have done so much good...
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_ALISAIE_000_135: Well, it looks like we missed it all yet again.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_THANCRED_000_140: We've secured an escape route. Do what you must.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_URIANGER_000_145: There lieth the last of the Light...
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_YSHTOLA_000_150: A dramatic transformation. The result of the sin eater within emerging to claim dominance, I assume.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_GUIDESOLDIER03643_0: ! Will you be heading to the Crown of the Immaculate?
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_RYNE_000_161: I see... It's finally over, then.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_RYNE_000_162: Now night will return to all of Norvrandt, bringing salvation to both of our two worlds...
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_SYSTEM_000_163: Upon speaking with Ryne, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_SYSTEM_000_164: It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_LUCKME114_03643_SYSTEM_000_165: Should you leave the area, you may return here by speaking with the sentry posted at the entrance to Mt. Gulg.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_GUIDEOFTHEPENDANTS_: You were injured during the foray on Mt. Gulg, yes? I was here at my station, as always, when they carried you in on a makeshift stretcher looking disturbingly bereft of vigor...
And to compound my worry, the sky has...well, I'm sure you've seen. It has everyone rather concerned, to say the least.
Seeing you up and about is the first good news we've had in a while. Assuming you feel strong enough, would you mayhap consider a stroll around the city to reassure our anxious citizens?
Bragi was one of those who helped convey you to your chambers, and he has visited several times since to inquire after your condition...
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_BRAGI_000_010: Well, well, look who's back from the dead!
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_BRAGI_000_011: Aye, it was a grim sight. Your companions looked fair ready to drop when they brought you in, so I offered a helping hand. Couldn't bear to see them struggle so...
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_BRAGI_000_012: And you, my friend, I feared you had one foot in the grave. Cold and lifeless, you were, like a corpse that was somehow still breathing.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_BRAGI_000_013: Then they told me some evil bastard went and snatched our poor Exarch away in the midst of the chaos. Wicked white, what is this world coming to...?
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_BRAGI_000_014: ...Bah, but moaning never solved a thing, did it? Nay, it's times like these that we Crystarium folk stand tall and do what needs to be done.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_BRAGI_000_015: Trade with Eulmore is back on the table. We'd best make use of those resources to fortify the city against the eaters─or whatever misery the fates deem fit to throw at us next.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_BRAGI_000_016: ...Speaking of misery, Chessamile was worried sick about you. A healer wringing her hands is not a sight you ever wish to see, let me tell you...
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_BRAGI_000_020: Full glad I am to see you walking again, my friend. But this business with the Exarch...it weighs heavily upon all our minds.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_CHESSAMILE_000_031: No one's been allowed to see you─even Spagyrics chirurgeons were forbidden from making visits...
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_CHESSAMILE_000_032: Ryne was kind enough to tell me you were showing symptoms similar to eater corruption─so I suppose there was little any of us could have done for you in any case.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_CHESSAMILE_000_033: As for your companions, they've been rushing hither and yon, seeking a cure to your condition. I worry to see their faces grown ever more haggard every time they pass through the Crystarium...
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_CHESSAMILE_000_034: I shall let them know you're awake. And when they come to see you, sweetie, please do convince them to rest a bit─they won't be helping anyone if they all collapse of exhaustion.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_CHESSAMILE_000_035: Ah, and our own Moren has been little better, I'm afraid. He hasn't left the Cabinet, too busy with his nose buried in one dusty tome or another...
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_CHESSAMILE_000_040: I wish I could brew you a tonic, sweetie, but I've no idea how it might affect you...
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_CHESSAMILE_000_041: ...No, it's too dangerous. In the end, I can but pray for your well-being. May blessed shadow keep you, your friends, and the Exarch as well.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_MOREN_000_050: Confound it, this says the same thing as the last! Mayhap I should approach the problem from a different perspective...
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_MOREN_000_051: ! Is it truly you and not some figment of my imagination!?
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_MOREN_000_052: Oh, but this is wonderful! 'Twould seem our prayers have been answered!
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_MOREN_000_053: Feeling otherwise helpless, I've been scouring our shelves for the wisdom to explain this most worrisome conundrum: why, with all the Lightwardens defeated, has the Light returned to obscure the sky?
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_MOREN_000_054: I must have pored over a hundred tomes, but no definitive conclusion seems forthcoming. So many questions I would pose to the Exarch...and thus do I feel his absence all the more keenly.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_MOREN_000_055: Now that you are awake, however, I am hopeful the search for our stolen steward might begin in earnest.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_MOREN_000_056: Katliss, meanwhile, leads the Crystalline Mean in preparations for battle...though against what foe, we are as yet uncertain. Why not pay her a visit? I expect seeing you upright would be a much-welcome relief!
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_MOREN_000_060: I shall forge ahead with my search for answers. I'll not have it said that I abandoned my efforts at the first sign of hardship!
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_KATLISS_000_071: You gave us all a proper fright, you know that? The friends you've made in the facets have been talking with me, wondering what they could do to help...
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_KATLISS_000_072: You gave us all a proper fright, you know that? Not a day's gone by that I haven't heard folk worrying what's to become of you or the Exarch...
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_KATLISS_000_073:
Anyway, I'm glad you've recovered enough to stand.
...You're not planning on striking out straightaway, though, are you? I was hoping to have a better look at your equipment...
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_KATLISS_000_074: If we'd been able to provide you with better weapons or sturdier helms...then maybe you would have won the day, and the Exarch would still be here.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_KATLISS_000_075: As such, we're keeping busy consulting each other on new forging techniques and designs and the like. If you could stand still a moment, I'd like to assess the gear we're trying to improve...
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_KATLISS_000_076: Aye, well... That's some fine work, I must admit.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_KATLISS_000_077: It wouldn't be impossible to make something better, but we'd need to experiment with different patterns and materials. And I'm not sure we have that kind of time...
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_GLYNARD_000_078: (-???-)That sounds like a challenge that he would enjoy.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_KATLISS_000_079: Greetings, Glynard. The master of the Stairs is running his own errands now, is he?
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_GLYNARD_000_080: Aye, well, my servers are distraught enough as it is, and I didn't want to crack the whip too hard.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_GLYNARD_000_081: But never mind that. I'm thinking our absent genius and his epiphanies are the perfect answer to this predicament of yours.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_KATLISS_000_082: And by “genius,” you mean old Grenoldt? He is a man of unrivaled gifts, I won't argue with you there.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_KATLISS_000_083: But what good does his talent do us if we can't bloody find him? No one's seen hide nor hair of Grenoldt since he wandered off some years ago.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_KATLISS_000_084: You know what he's like once he latches onto an idea─he's probably cloistered himself in some forgotten cave, completely absorbed in his latest creation. I wouldn't even know where to start looking...
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_GLYNARD_000_086: Still, if that eccentric is someone you're destined to meet, I wager he'll show up soon enough.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_GLYNARD_000_087: In my time at the bar, many's the tale I've heard told of strangely fated encounters─even if a few of them might be stretching the truth just a bit.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_KATLISS_000_088: We'll keep our noses to the grindstone for the time being. But on the off chance you do encounter Grenoldt, you'd be wise to take advantage of his brilliance rather than wait on our slow-and-steady progress.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_KATLISS_000_089: This is all talk for when you're fully recovered, of course. I'll let you get back to convalescing, eh?
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_GLYNARD_000_090: Ah, before you do that... You're actually the reason I came over here in the first place.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_GLYNARD_000_091: I don't suggest partaking of my stock until you're properly well, but if you're passing near the Stairs, then I've a regular who's eager to see you.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_GLYNARD_000_092: I don't suggest partaking of my stock until you're properly well, but if you're passing near the Stairs, then I've a few regulars I'd like to introduce you to.
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_GLYNARD_000_093: I'd best be getting back. Just because the world's coming apart at the seams doesn't mean we have to follow suit now, does it?
TEXT_LUCKMF101_03644_KATLISS_000_094: Hear, hear. We can't forget the heart upon which this city was founded, or the Exarch might not have much of a home to return to.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_KATLISS_000_001: I think a return to your sickbed might be in order. Ah, or you might consider resting a while atop the watchtower next to the rookery.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_KATLISS_000_002: This damnable sky doesn't make for the most soothing scenery, but the Exarch often liked to stand there and feel the wind upon his face.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_KATLISS_000_010: Whatever you decide to do, I suggest you do it slowly. You are not yet well...
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_SZEMDJENMAI_000_020: Oho, I did not expect to see you on your feet so soon. Surely you have not come in search of an amaro...?
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_SZEMDJENMAI_000_021: ...What do I know of the Crystal Exarch? I am happy to share, but I fear there will be no surprising revelations. As any in this city could tell you, he is a man of wisdom and compassion and many untold secrets.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_SZEMDJENMAI_000_022: But none can doubt his generosity. When the Crystarium was being constructed, he even allowed folk to plunder the tower for resources.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_SZEMDJENMAI_000_023: He has imposed no restrictions upon us but one: no one except the Exarch is permitted to dwell within the spire.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_SZEMDJENMAI_000_024: Many seasons past, a comrade of mine was bold enough to ask the reason why.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_SZEMDJENMAI_000_025: The Exarch merely smiled and said, “Because one day, the Crystal Tower may vanish as suddenly as it arrived.”
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_SZEMDJENMAI_000_026: To this very day, the tower remains as it always has, solid and imposing. Yet I do not think our steward's warning was a falsehood.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_SZEMDJENMAI_000_027: And even if it were, none would dream of breaking that one rule and risk shattering the community we have worked so hard to build.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_CASSARD_000_028: ! It is good to see you awake and alert, my friend!
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_CASSARD_000_029: ...What's this about? You're not writing the Exarch's memoirs, are you? I'm not sure how much I can tell you, considering we avoid asking too many questions. Unspoken rule, and all that.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_CASSARD_000_030: Hmmm... If anyone has fresh insights to share, then it'd be Captain Lyna, I'd say.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_CASSARD_000_031: She lost her parents to an eater attack not long after she was born, and the Exarch saw to her upbringing. Outward appearances aside, those two are like grandfather and granddaughter.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_CASSARD_000_032: I imagine the news of his predicament hit her doubly hard...not that our proud captain would ever let it show. If you do decide to talk to Lyna, she'll be at her usual post at the Accensor Gate.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_CASSARD_000_033: While we're on the subject, I'm concerned for that Alisaie of yours. I'd thought her face stormy on that ride back from Amh Araeng, but now...it's closer to a raging tempest.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_MOREN_000_034: Oh, was there something else you needed? If you've come for the results of my research into this persistent Light, I'm afraid there's little to tell as of yet...
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_MOREN_000_035: ...Records pertaining to the Exarch? Well, I need no documentation to relay what little I know of his history, if that is what interests you.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_MOREN_000_036: Ahem. Less than a decade had passed since the coming of the Flood when the Crystal Tower first flashed into existence. Its summoner─the Exarch himself─became known to the refugees in Lakeland soon thereafter.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_MOREN_000_037: He welcomed all who sought out the spire, be they locals who had lost their homes or Voeburtites fleeing their ruined kingdom, and together did they found the city which would become the Crystarium.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_MOREN_000_038: Some thought to call him “king,” for he refused to share his name, but the summoner did not deem himself worthy of royal address.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_MOREN_000_039: Thus did the people consider his scintillating skin, so alike to the tower he had summoned, and bestowed upon him the title of “Crystal Exarch.” As for his true name, well...'twould seem that is a mystery that remains unsolved to this day.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_MOREN_000_040: Aye, the Exarch has ever been one to conceal his full appearance. Although I have, on occasion, spotted what could only have been a tail...
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_LYNA_000_060: , I was not told you had awoken!
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_LYNA_000_061: A welcome surprise. Now, if only the Exarch was returned to us...
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_LYNA_000_062: He was taken by this rival of yours, was he not? Your companions mentioned they had an idea of where to find him...
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_LYNA_000_063: And so I bristled when they asked for patience. I did not understand their hesitation...until I saw that you had fallen. Only then did I realize that I had no business rushing ahead.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_LYNA_000_064: Even so, the delay has been no less agonizing...
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_LYNA_000_065: In the moments before he left to join you in Kholusia, the Exarch entrusted me with a key.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_LYNA_000_066: It opens a door in the Ocular, to a chamber known as the “Umbilicus.” This room is the heart of the tower, into which only the Exarch himself is permitted to enter.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_LYNA_000_067: He bid me allow none into the tower once he had departed. Only in the event that an army of eaters descended upon the city was I to access the Umbilicus and awaken the defensive barrier.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_LYNA_000_068: Never before had he left me with such instructions, but the battle with Vauthry loomed near, and at the time I accepted the key without much thought.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_LYNA_000_069: Since then, however, that moment is all that occupies my mind.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_LYNA_000_070: When I recall the look upon his face... He knew that some terrible fate awaited him.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_LYNA_000_071: Tell me, ! I need to know what he feared─what battle you and your companions are truly fighting!
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_LYNA_000_072: ...Forgive me. I trust in the Exarch, and I should not be voicing these doubts when he is not here to respond to them personally.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_LYNA_000_073: But you have come to me with a question of your own, have you not?
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_LYNA_000_074: Ah...I see I am not the only one who burns for answers.
TEXT_LUCKMF102_03645_LYNA_000_075: The time has come to open the tower's heart. Though we do not face an invasion of eaters, I suspect the city will be in far more danger if you do not gain the knowledge you seek.
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_LYNA_000_000: Come. Meet me in the Ocular, and I will unlock the door within.
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_CRYSTALGATEKEEPER_0: . The captain said to expect you.
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_LYNA_000_010: Did you find the answers you sought? If there is nothing more you need, I will go and lock the door...
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_A1_000_002: I have questions about the Tempest...
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_LYNA_000_011: You wish to know the way to the Tempest? ...You mean the sea itself, and not the island of Kholusia?
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_LYNA_000_012: If you make a request to the tamers, they will provide you with an amaro, but...
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_LYNA_000_013: The Tempest? That is the name given to the seas by which Kholusia is bound.
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_LYNA_000_014: If you make a request to the tamers, they will provide you with an amaro to fly you over the waters, but...
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_LYNA_000_015: ...Do you mean to leave right this moment? Alone?
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_LYNA_000_016: I am not sure that─ Nay, I will not seek to stop you. Go with the blessings of the shadow, and I shall await your safe return.
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_LYNA_000_020: A word to the tamers at the Amaro Launch, and they will lend you a beast to carry you over the Tempest. I only hope that will be close enough to where you need to be...
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_BOARDINGGATETOKHOLU: You require an amaro? Just a moment, and I shall saddle our swiftest beast to fly you to the island...
...The open water? To the depths of the Tempest!? Our amaro can swim, yes, but to reach the ocean floor...
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_ALPHINAUD_000_040: I once said that I wanted to fight for Estinien─that I wanted to save him, not let him be sacrificed for a cause. And now I say the same to you.
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_ALISAIE_000_045: Just so you know, I will not look kindly on any further attempts to leave us behind. We do this together.
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_THANCRED_000_050: Gods know you've spent enough time charging into danger on our behalf. It's only fair that we return the favor!
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_RYNE_000_055: There's nothing I can do to cleanse you of the Light's corruption...but I'll do everything in my power to keep it in check.
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_RYNE_000_056: If the Wardens' aether overwhelms you again, you will become a sin eater, so please, save your strength for when it really matters.
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_YSHTOLA_000_060: The volunteers who journeyed to Kholusia have all been safely returned to their homes. They've also assured us that they will do their best to hold the eaters at bay in our absence.
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_CASSARD_000_065: I might offer some words of encouragement to the masses while I'm out and about on business. You need proper support to do what you need to do, and we can't let morale start flagging now, can we?
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_KATLISS_000_070: Not to worry─the Mean will keep the cogs greased and turning, as we always do. I'll see our crafting quotas are filled, and then some!
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_CHESSAMILE_000_075: Hm? Do you need a tonic for your travels, sweetie? Oh, and maybe you should take one for the Exarch as well. Invigorating stuff if you can abide the smell...
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_SZEMDJENMAI_000_080: My fellow tamers and I will keep an eye on the horizon. Should the need arise, we shall speed to your side with a flock of amaro in tow.
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_GLYNARD_000_085: A good, strong pint to see you down the road? ...Ah, best not, eh? You'll need your wits about you by the sound of things.
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_GLYNARD_000_086: Tell you what: I'll put aside one of my finest bottles, and you can have a bracing victory drink when you return!
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_BRAGI_000_090: All stocked up on supplies then? Better to have it and not need it, than need it and not have it, as my old man used to say. Be safe, and bring the Exarch back to us...
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_URIANGER_000_100: Thou didst plan to commandeer an amaro for thy journey to the open sea? I fear the following dive down unto Emet-Selch's underwater abode would drain even thy legendary stamina...
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_URIANGER_000_101: Thus, during thy convalescence, we considered the most efficacious method for reaching the depths of the Tempest. And I believe we have arrived at an elegant solution.
TEXT_LUCKMF103_03646_URIANGER_000_102: Yet ere we discuss this step, I suggest thou dost conclude such pressing business as remains to thee in the Crystarium. Once the sea closeth above our heads, we are unlikely to surface again until our grand deed is done.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_ALPHINAUD_000_000: I once said that I wanted to fight for Estinien─that I wanted to save him, not let him be sacrificed for a cause. And now I say the same to you.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_ALISAIE_000_005: Just so you know, I will not look kindly on any further attempts to leave us behind. We do this together.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_THANCRED_000_010: Gods know you've spent enough time charging into danger on our behalf. It's only fair that we return the favor!
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_RYNE_000_015: There's nothing I can do to weaken the Light that's trapped inside you...but I'll do everything in my power to keep it from breaking free.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_RYNE_000_016: If the Wardens' aether overwhelms you again, you will become a sin eater, so please, save your strength for when it really matters.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_YSHTOLA_000_020: The volunteers who journeyed to Kholusia have all been safely returned to their homes. They've also assured us that they will do their best to hold the eaters at bay in our absence.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_URIANGER_000_030: Thine affairs are in order? Then I shall unfold to thee my proposal.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_URIANGER_000_031: Our destination is the ocean floor, yet our goal is not simply to arrive there. Nay, we must needs have the means to breathe and fight freely.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_URIANGER_000_032: Thus would I petition the aid of one of the fae─a being with whom I have yet to meet face-to-face.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_URIANGER_000_033: ...Rather than waste words on explanation, I bid thee follow me unto the hamlet of Sullen, which lieth to the south and west. All will become abundantly clear, I promise thee.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_URIANGER_000_040: There, to the west. Canst thou discern the hump of an isle rising above the water?
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_URIANGER_000_041: That foliage-covered mass hideth the key to our safe descent. Swim close and plunge thee beneath the surface. Thou shalt soon divine the reason for mine insistence.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_URIANGER_000_042: ...Though it be much to my shame, I can but flail and flounder where thou mayest glide as a fish. I shall board a boat to the island, and spare one and all the spectacle of mine inept strokes.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Ah, there you are. Once you've completed your underwater investigations, the path here leads to the top of the island.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_ALISAIE_000_055:
This lake is enormous...
Assuming my geography is correct, this would be the mirror of Silvertear back in the Source, although the size hardly compares.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_THANCRED_000_060: The locals call this the “Isle of Ken,” which I presume must refer to knowledge. Either that or someone was being awfully zealous about marking his territory.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_RYNE_000_065: Even seeing it up close, I'm still not sure what's so special about this island...
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_URIANGER_000_070: If thou wouldst divine the secret of this isle, I prithee inspect the view from beneath the water's surface.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_YSHTOLA_000_075: If you've solved Urianger's little mystery, then you can find him further up the slope. 'Twas all rather obvious to my eyes, though I concede I have an unfair advantage.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_SYSTEM_000_080: Two curved slabs of rock seem squeezed together here, giving the impression of giant stone eyelids.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_SYSTEM_000_081: Though it appears solid enough, the rock yields slightly under your touch. Was the surface gently shifting, or was it just your imagination...?
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_A1_000_001: I've discerned...that it's an ordinary island?
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_A1_000_002: It reminds me of a certain primal...
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_A1_000_003: It's just like the Big One, yes, yes!
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_URIANGER_000_091: Truly? Naught could be further from the truth. According to the lore of the pixies, we are, even now, perched upon the back of an ancient fae entity...
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_URIANGER_000_092: Most perceptive. According to the lore of the pixies, we are, even now, perched upon the back of an ancient fae entity...
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_URIANGER_000_093: Hah! Thine impression is not inaccurate. According to the lore of the pixies, we are, even now, perched upon the back of an ancient fae entity...
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_URIANGER_000_094: Its name is “Bismarck.” Aye, the selfsame title by which we know the great feathered whale revered by the Vanu Vanu of the Source.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_URIANGER_000_095: I would enlist its aid to bear us unto the deep, and thence banish the water with an airy sphere, alike in form to the domes which do shelter the hamlets 'neath the Ruby Sea.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_URIANGER_000_096: Within its compass, we may move unencumbered, and defend ourselves when the hour of battle cometh, as it most surely shall. Now, I must needs ask for silence whilst I make my supplication...
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_ALPHINAUD_000_110: Bismarck must be powerful indeed to create a dome of this size. I can only pray to whichever gods are listening that it continues to hold...
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_ALISAIE_000_115: I remember being impressed by the domes of the Ruby Sea, but this makes them look like bubbles in a stream!
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_THANCRED_000_120: With all that water out of the way, we'll be able to venture quite some distance. Emet-Selch must be hiding around here somewhere...
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_RYNE_000_125: This is amazing. I can't even see the surface!
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_YSHTOLA_000_130: I daresay Urianger endured much “playful” attention from the pixies to learn the lore of Bismarck. He is nothing if not a dedicated scholar.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_URIANGER_000_140:
Haaa... Haaa...<gulp>
Full glad am I...that Bismarck was true to his word.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_URIANGER_000_141: We are arrived in the Tempest, safe and dry. 'Tis here that we shall find the lair of Emet-Selch, and, I believe, the imprisoned Exarch as well.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_URIANGER_000_142: For an Ascian alone, it is of course a trifling matter to flee unto the rift─yet I suspect such travel is nigh impossible with a mortal in one's custody.
