TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_URIANGER_000_143: Nay, he would not soon risk his prize when the Exarch's very body serveth as the key to the Crystal Tower and its powers of temporal transportation.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_URIANGER_000_144: Thus am I all but certain that this underwater realm harboreth our friend and enemy both. We have but to find them.
TEXT_LUCKMF104_03647_SYSTEM_000_145: In the event that you leave the area, speak with Inewyl at Venmont Yards in Kholusia to return to the Tempest.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Bismarck must be powerful indeed to create a dome of this size. I can only pray to whichever gods are listening that it continues to hold...
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALISAIE_000_005: I remember being impressed by the domes of the Ruby Sea, but this makes them look like bubbles in a stream!
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_URIANGER_000_010: Come, let us begin our search.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_RYNE_000_0015: This is amazing. I can't even see the surface!
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_YSHTOLA_000_020: I daresay Urianger endured much “playful” attention from the pixies to learn the lore of Bismarck. He is nothing if not a dedicated scholar.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_THANCRED_000_030: Now, as for where we should be looking, I rather doubt Emet-Selch will be sitting around out in the open.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_THANCRED_000_031: I propose we follow the slope down towards the deeper trenches, and keep an eye out for rock formations large enough to house a stronghold.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_THANCRED_000_032: Let's be off, then─but watch your footing. The ground is still wet, and like to be slippery.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALISAIE_000_040: I think Thancred has the right idea, but I can't help wondering what Emet-Selch would be doing down here without the aid of gills and fins.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_URIANGER_000_045: Hm. This outcrop seemeth natural enough...
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_YSHTOLA_000_050: The ocean floor is a strange place to be, of course, but this aether...'tis like naught I've ever seen.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_055: Naught out of the ordinary here...as far as I can tell.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_THANCRED_000_060: What about that large formation over there...?
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_RYNE_000_065: The gloom down here is so suffocating compared to that endless night sky we saw... But I suppose Emet-Selch had nowhere else to go.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_MANOFONDO03648_000_: Why have you come! Was it you who took away our water!?
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_092: Ah, so this is where the Ondo make their home. I had wondered...
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_093: Pray forgive us any inconvenience we have caused─we were not aware your people lived here in the Tempest.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_094: We need this great dome of air that we might conduct a most urgent search, and thus beg you for your understanding...
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_MANOFONDO03648_000_: Chieftain, what are we to do...?
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_TOLSHSAATH_000_096: ...Are you emissaries of the ancient ones?
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_TOLSHSAATH_000_097: The mysteries have ssstirred. We have ssseen the illuminated land shhhining through the gloom of the abyss...
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_TOLSHSAATH_000_098: If you are the emissaries─the chosen─I bid you welcome. If you are not, I bid you leave.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_099: I am...not sure I understand. Would you be willing to elaborate...?
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_101: ...It would seem not. I suggest we withdraw for the moment.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_THANCRED_000_102: So, what's the plan? Given your “condition,” I'm reluctant to suggest lingering here.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_THANCRED_000_103: That said, our presently meandering search would proceed far more swiftly if we could call upon the Ondo's local knowledge.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_RYNE_000_104: Yes, I'd like to know more about this “illuminated land” the chieftain spoke of.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_RYNE_000_105: Could it be Emet-Selch's stronghold, do you suppose? Perhaps he...lit the lanterns upon his return?
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_106: We cannot dismiss the possibility, but if these Ondo refuse to speak with us...
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_107: ─do you remember my first scheme for entering Eulmore? How I had planned to ingratiate myself by offering lucrative trading opportunities with the Ondo?
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_108: The individual I dealt with was reticent in manner and curious in custom, but we were able to reach an agreement, nonetheless.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_109: I believe that with the right approach, we can build a similar relationship here.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_THANCRED_000_110: What kind of approach did you have in mind? That chieftain fellow didn't leave us many options.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_URIANGER_000_111: If we are to tread the swiftest course, then we must needs locate its beginning. 'Tis plain our all too dramatic arrival hath thrown this settlement into confusion...
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_URIANGER_000_112: Were we to solve such problems as we have caused, and assure our hosts thereby that our purpose here is not inimical to them, they may yet prove amenable to reason.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_THANCRED_000_113: ...I smell chores. But very well─if it can be done quickly.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALISAIE_000_114: What do you think? I've nothing better to offer, but I do worry what will happen if the Ondo's tales end up leading us to a dead end.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_YSHTOLA_000_115: I cannot say for certain, but I sense this tribe has a deeper connection to the Ascians than first meets the eye.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_YSHTOLA_000_116: It warrants further investigation. Thus I cast my vote in favor of aiding the settlement for the time being.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_A1_000_001: We will make allies of the Ondo!
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_A1_000_002: Let's do what we do best!
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_A1_000_003: I'll do what I can, I suppose...
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_117: Then it is settled. Y'shtola─pray proceed with your investigations. The rest of us will see about fostering some goodwill!
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_TOLSHSAATH_000_120: Was it fate that brought you to usss...?
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_130: ! You won't believe who I've just bumped into!
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_131: This is Paushs Ooan, the very fellow I did business with prior to our ill-fated stay in Eulmore!
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_PAUSHSOOAN_000_132: I waited, and you did not come. Then the Myssstel came, but his visits did not continue...
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_133: I am truly sorry, Paushs Ooan─things did not proceed as planned. Is there aught we can do for you by way of an apology?
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_PAUSHSOOAN_000_134: Hmmm... Perhapsss... “Where the Dry Return,” a cavern to the north, is home to giant crabs. We do not fear the crab, for we are the swifter ssswimmers.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_PAUSHSOOAN_000_135: But now there is no water. We run, and they ssscuttle close behind, snipping and sssnapping with their claws. There are too many of them. Too many...
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_136: Ah, I believe I can be of assistance there.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_137: And what of you, ? If you've not found a task, you are most welcome to join me. Indeed, I should appreciate the company. “Where the Dry Return” has a rather ominous ring to it...
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_PAUSHSOOAN_000_140: Where the Dry Return is filled with crimson coral. We imagine its branches to be the veins of finless ones─the cave a resting place for those who perishhhed at sssea.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_PAUSHSOOAN_000_160: You could crack their shells? You must be ssstronger than you look...
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_161: I see you've reached your quota first again. I shall never be your equal in such tasks...
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_162: Still, I would say we have reduced the local crab population to a far less threatening number.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_PAUSHSOOAN_000_163: My thanks─to both of you. You mussst have a reward...
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_164: Nay, Paushs Ooan, this was to be a part of my apology to you, remember? Besides which, the lack of water is our doing, for which we must also make amends.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_165: Might I convince you to tell us something about your village, instead? I would very much like to learn more of you and your people.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_PAUSHSOOAN_000_166: ...Very well. Before the Flood came, it is said that our ancestral home was found in the seas to the sssouth. It was utterly destroyed by the Light.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_PAUSHSOOAN_000_167: Only those who were out hunting sssurvived. They swam, aimless and lossst, until they spied buildings here on the ocean floor.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_PAUSHSOOAN_000_168: Strange buildings they were, and long had they ssstood under the water. Yet somehow they had been ssspared the scars of time and current...
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_PAUSHSOOAN_000_169: These ssstructures provided shelter for my people─protection from the Tempest's turbulent waters and the predators which hunted within them. Their very existence ssseemed a miracle.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_PAUSHSOOAN_000_170: The first sssettlers pondered their good fortune. It was clear that the race who had built sssuch wonders had guided their course. And from this did they discern the truth...
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_PAUSHSOOAN_000_171: ...That the ancients had chosen us to ssserve as caretakers of their eternal sssanctuary, until sssuch time as they returned.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_PAUSHSOOAN_000_172: Thus, if it is judged that your coming─and this great vanishing of water─was by the ancients' design, you will find warm welcome here.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_173: A truly astonishing history. Yet I cannot help but wonder, how will the significance─or otherwise─of our arrival be decided?
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_PAUSHSOOAN_000_174: The ancients have blessed us with protection and prosperity. If your presence serves to bring us the sssame, there will be no doubt in the matter.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_175: ...Then it would seem our earlier decision was the correct one.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_176: We thank you for the lesson, Paushs Ooan, and will continue to do all we can to assist your people. Should you desire our help with any other trouble, pray do not hesitate to ask.
TEXT_LUCKMF105_03648_ALPHINAUD_000_177: We should return to the task at hand. Only...do try not to overexert yourself, my friend. The risk far outweighs the gain.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_000: ...Ah, . Have you learned aught of note?
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_001: Fascinating...and precisely the sort of information I was hoping to hear.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_002: In fact, if you have a moment, I'd like to borrow your eyes to confirm a theory I've been working on. Come.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_010: Now, there are two tasks I would have you perform.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_011: The first requires you to inspect the buildings which surround the Ondo settlement, and note their most distinctive characteristics.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_012: For the second, I wish you to use this knife to take scrapings from one of the remnant walls.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_013: Pray be as thorough as you can. I shall be waiting here for the results of your investigations.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_020: 'Tis strange to be here, under the ocean. It seems a lifetime ago that we stood amidst the trees of Rak'tika...
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_SYSTEM_000_030: Inspect the structures of the Ondo Cups for distinctive features. You may move the camera, as well as zoom in and out. Target a building and examine it with .
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_SYSTEM_000_040: You set the point of the knife against the wall, but even after applying considerable pressure, you cannot remove so much as a flake of stone.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_051: Yes, I would agree that the windows are most distinctive. 'Twould seem the structures appear the same to both your sight and mine...
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_052: And you say you could not so much as scratch the wall? Even with all your might behind the blade?
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_053: , everywhere I turn in this place, my gaze is drawn by peculiar materials for which I do not have a name.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_054: The buildings I had you investigate are prime examples. They may appear to be constructed of ordinary stone, but I assure you it is nothing of the sort...
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_055: If pressed, I would describe the substance as a composite of several mineral properties, blended to create a material of unparalleled durability.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_056: Even the Ronkan Empire, once the greatest power in Norvrandt, produced nothing which compares to this level of perfection.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_057: But if not the Ronkans, then who? Who were these ancients the Ondo claim as the architects of their sanctuary?
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_058: I suspect our answer lies with the reason Emet-Selch withdrew here to the Tempest.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_059: He may simply have wished to retreat somewhere mere mortals would struggle to reach...but there are many such remote locations. Why here, specifically?
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_060: Emet-Selch is devoted to his role, and thus we might assume his choice of stronghold somehow serves the Ascian agenda.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_061: Or mayhap...'tis a place more dear to him than any other.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_A1_000_001: Are you saying this was built by ancient Ascians...?
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_A1_000_002: Could this place provide power to Emet-Selch?
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_062: That is my theory, that these structures are remnants of a time before history─of a star that was yet whole and unbroken.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_063: That was my first thought as well. Yet no matter how superior the materials, a ruin is just a ruin. 'Tis naught that would decide a battle's outcome.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_064: Which brings us to my second theory: that he has some other, more personal connection to this site. What if these structures are remnants of a time before history─of a star that was yet whole and unbroken?
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_065: It is my theory that these structures are remnants of a time before history─of a star that was yet whole and unbroken.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_066: Such traces in the Source would have been obliterated by the succession of Umbral Calamities, but here in the First they might have remained untouched for millennia...
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_067: ...A copy of the mural in the Qitana Ravel. Almet presented it to me during my visit to Fanow, after our victory in Kholusia.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_068:
Here, in the first scene...
By Emet-Selch's own words, it depicts a city of eons past and the disaster which befell it.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_069: The design is much simplified, of course, but do you see the similarities between its towers and those you have just inspected?
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_070: We are close to the truth, I feel. Let us search the surrounds for another tower─one which matches the picture near enough to remove all doubt.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_071: From what I have seen, naught more than sand and more sand lies to the east, and the south held no such structures. I suggest we try our luck further to the northwest.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_SYSTEM_000_072: You may view the Qitana Ravel mural at any time during this quest by using the relevant item in the Key Items menu.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_SYSTEM_000_073: The quest destination will not be displayed on the map. You must search for a structure which resembles the buildings in the mural, then inspect it from the survey point. The survey point will be found nearby, in a location which allows a full view of the structure.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_SYSTEM_000_075: Search for a structure which resembles one of the buildings in this mural, then inspect it from the survey point. The survey point will be found nearby, in a location which allows a full view of the structure.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_SYSTEM_000_076: According to Y'shtola's investigations, the area further northwest of the Ondo Cups may be a good place to start.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_080: Aye... This is the mural writ large...
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_081: Though I cannot guess at its purpose, it must have been an imposing sight. How much of the tower's height lies hidden beneath the ground, I wonder...
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_082: Centuries of our history have settled upon such ruins. Countless layers of dust and sediment...
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_083: ...An entire civilization, its existence forgotten by all except a handful of Ascians.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_084: And yet it did exist. They lived here, in this city...
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_085: But let us focus on what we've learned thus far. The Ondo chieftain spoke of mysteries stirring─of a land illuminated.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_086: Judging by his words, he believes this phenomenon related to the ancients' return.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_087: Thus can we surmise that what the Ondo saw shining in the abyss was, in all likelihood, yet another remnant of this age-old civilization.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_088: And who else would “light the lanterns” as Ryne put it, than Emet-Selch himself? 'Tis almost certain he is there!
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_090: But if we are to find this stronghold in a timely manner, it seems gaining the Ondo's trust remains our swiftest path forward.
TEXT_LUCKMF106_03649_YSHTOLA_000_091: I only hope our deeds are enough to win them over...
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_YSHTOLA_000_000: Thank you for assisting me with my investigations. I shall seek out our companions and share what we have learned.
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_YSHTOLA_000_001: ...Much as I would like to tell you to sit down and leave the rest to us, your condition demands that we make all reasonable haste.
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_YSHTOLA_000_002: If you are not too weary, it may be useful to speak with Paushs Ooan again, and ask if there is aught else he is willing to divulge.
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_PAUSHSOOAN_000_010: Ah, Alphinaud's friend. You and your companions have done much to repair the damage caused when the waters parted...
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_PAUSHSOOAN_000_011: ...Anything elssse you can do? Hmmm... Have you been to the Walls of the Forgotten?
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_A1_000_001: I...think I've just come from them.
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_A1_000_002: Are they the ruins to the northwest?
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_PAUSHSOOAN_000_012: The remnants to the northwest, yesss? You visited them unbidden? Pshhh... Could it be that your footsteps were guided by the ancientsss...?
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_PAUSHSOOAN_000_013: Yesss, that is the sacred site of which I ssspeak. Could it be that your footsssteps were guided there by the ancientsss...?
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_PAUSHSOOAN_000_014: I believe it may be ssso. Listen then, and I will tell you of our plans to bring light to the Walls, that we might answer the shining call of the illuminated land.
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_PAUSHSOOAN_000_015: We have requested a finless craftsman to shape for us a sssacred lamp. He is odd for a land-dweller, choosing as he does to live in the ocean, but his ssskill is beyond question.
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_PAUSHSOOAN_000_016: It is concerning, however, that we have heard nothing of his progress. If you were to visit this artisan and return with our long-awaited light, then any doubt as to your purpossse would be laid to ressst.
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_PAUSHSOOAN_000_017: His name is “Grenoldt.” You will find his workshop in a metal structure to the sssouth.
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_PAUSHSOOAN_000_020: Go, visit Grenoldt in his “Workbench.” Bring back the lamp we asssked for, and all will be as the ancients desired.
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_030: Oh, that's just great, that is. Me mind's playin' tricks on me now. “Look, Grenoldt! Someone's come to visit ye at the bottom o' the bleedin' ocean!”
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_031: Or might be as yer a ghost, eh? Go on, foul shade, feast yerself on me rotten soul...
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_032: I've got no use for it. A craftsman what can't craft is more pointless than a sea slug with a domin' hammer. An' that's an insult to bloody sea slugs...
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_SYSTEM_000_033: Grenoldt appears to be suffering from a crushing bout of self-doubt. Maybe you can help psych him up.
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_SYSTEM_000_041: Grenoldt appears to be suffering from a crushing bout of self-doubt. Maybe you can help psych him up.
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_042: What is it ye want, specter? If yer not here to end me misery, then bugger off back to damnation...
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_043: ...Eh? Ye wouldn't be tryin' to raise me spirits now, would ye, spirit? Not what ye'd expect from a servant o' the netherworld...
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_A2_000_001: Has it really come to this...?
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_044: ...What's that supposed to mean? Not impressed with what ye see, ?
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_045: Aye, well...I may have let meself go a bit. This was meant to be me underwater sanctuary─a place where I could concentrate on me work, far from the distractions o' the outside world...
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_046: Er... Might be as we crossed paths back in the Crystarium, but I don't reckon we've been formally introduced.
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_047: Name's Grenoldt. An' this here's meant to be me underwater sanctuary─a place where I can give meself over to me work, far from the distractions o' the outside world...
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_048: Aye. Though I wonder how ye bloody well found me...
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_049: This here's meant to be me underwater sanctuary─a place where I can give meself over to me work, far from the distractions o' the outside world...
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_050: ...An' yet, here ye stand. Now what's so damned important that ye'd dive all the way down to the bottom o' the bleedin' Tempest to bother me?
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_052: Gods curse me empty head! I've not so much as made a start!
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_053: I'm worth less than a sea slug... Nay, the slime left by a sea slug. Me delivery date's long past, me workbench is untouched... An' I call meself a bleedin' artisan!
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_054: Ye've heard their beliefs, have ye? Bringin' light to them ruins'll be an act of deep religious an' cultural significance!
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_055: An' it was my privilege as a craftsman to be tasked with providin' a ritual instrument worthy o' the occasion. But I just...can't...bloody well...
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_056: GAAAH! Me mind's a bleedin' blank! It's like I've pissed away me last drop of inspiration!
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_057: Tell me ye've got summat to show me─summat as'll give me muse a right good kick up the arse...?
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_058: The Ondo want to honor the comin' o' these ancients, so their answerin' light's got to blaze with the right kind o' brightness.
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_059: Like...like the spark o' life caught in a crystal. But just bein' sparkly's not enough─it's got to dance with joy an' sorrow an' a sense o' hardship endured... Ye know what I mean!?
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_SYSTEM_000_060: Your thoughts turn to the Warriors of Light from the First, and the crystals you discovered at the end of their journeys. Maybe Grenoldt would find them inspiring...
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_SYSTEM_000_061: Your thoughts turn to Branden, and the crystal you discovered at the end of his journey. Maybe Grenoldt could find inspiration in that...
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_SYSTEM_000_062: Your thoughts turn to Lamitt, and the crystal you discovered at the end of her journey. Maybe Grenoldt could find inspiration in that...
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_SYSTEM_000_063: Your thoughts turn to Renda-Rae, and the crystal you discovered at the end of her journey. Maybe Grenoldt could find inspiration in that...
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_SYSTEM_000_064: Your thoughts turn to Nyelbert, and the crystal you discovered at the end of his journey. Maybe Grenoldt could find inspiration in that...
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_SYSTEM_000_065: Grenoldt seeks a particular kind of inspiration─the kind that crystallizes only at the culmination of a long and tragic tale.
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_SYSTEM_000_066: Complete any of the role quest lines available at the Wandering Stairs in the Crystarium, then return to Grenoldt once more.
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_070:
It's no good...
I need summat special to light a fire under me piss-sodden imagination.
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_071: Like...like the spark o' life caught in a crystal. But just bein' sparkly's not enough─it's got to dance with joy an' sorrow an' a sense o' hardship endured... Ye know what I mean!?
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_SYSTEM_000_072: Grenoldt seeks a particular kind of inspiration─the kind that crystallizes only at the culmination of a long and tragic tale.
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_SYSTEM_000_073: Complete any of the role quest lines available at the Wandering Stairs in the Crystarium, then return to Grenoldt once more.
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_074: I've let the Ondo down, aye... But more'n that I've let meself down. Might as well go back to mendin' kettles...
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_A3_000_000: Show Grenoldt a crystal which once belonged to one of Ardbert's companions?
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_076: Such strikin' beauty... It shines with heartache an' laughter an' the transience o' life, like the turmoil o' history made manifest!
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_077: Aye, I can see the brilliance o' the crystal's legacy! Ahhh...ye'd never capture such a gleam, not if ye labored a hundred years...
TEXT_LUCKMF107_03650_GRENOLDT_000_078: But bugger me if I don't mean to try! Where're me tools, gods damn ye!? I must set to work before the feelin' fades!
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_GRENOLDT_000_000: I can feel it! A vision formin' in me mind! Step aside, , an' let me itchin' hands get to work!
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_GRENOLDT_000_002: I've taken the wonders that crystal showed me, an' channeled 'em into a new shape what befits the Ondo's spiritual character.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_GRENOLDT_000_003: Not a bad job, if I do say so meself.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_GRENOLDT_000_004: ...An' to think, I was this close to hangin' up me hammer after studyin' the craft o' them ancients.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_GRENOLDT_000_005: I've been across the length an' breadth o' Norvrandt, an' gobbled up every scrap o' craftin' wisdom what I could find.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_GRENOLDT_000_006: But no matter which technique I tried, me work was jus' no comparison. I couldn't even figure out how they put them damn buildings together.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_GRENOLDT_000_007: A mystery for the ages─that's what drew me here in the first place. I built me workshop, got the forges burnin'...then lost me bleedin' will to craft.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_GRENOLDT_000_008: Thank the gods for that crystal o' yers, or I might never have gotten it back.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_GRENOLDT_000_009: I won't pry into yer business, but I reckon yer little miracle there has been through the kind o' journey they sing songs about. The echoes o' the memory it holds jus' speak directly to yer heart...
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_GRENOLDT_000_010: Aye, I can still feel 'em coursin' through me! The inspiration's not fadin' away─it's wellin' up stronger an' stronger!
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_GRENOLDT_000_011: Give me the chance, an' I reckon I can weave the crystal's saga into other things as well!
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_GRENOLDT_000_012: ...But bugger me, I'd almost forgotten the Ondo's commission. If ye could drag that lamp over to Tolshs Aath for me, I'll stay here an' dream up new armaments for ye to try.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_SYSTEM_000_013: You now have access to Grenoldt's forge. Equipment rewards will become available for collection based on the role quests you have completed.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_TOLSHSAATH_000_020: ...What is it that you have there?
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_TOLSHSAATH_000_021: ...The sssacred lamp! Then the finless one has kept his promise...
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_TOLSHSAATH_000_022: My people tell me of the many deeds you have performed in the name of aiding the Cups. And now you come to me, bearing the light we had almost surrendered hope of ever ssseeing...
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_TOLSHSAATH_000_023: We can doubt your purity no longer─your arrival was the will of the ancients!
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_TOLSHSAATH_000_024: Yes, the time for fear has passed. We shall take the lamp, and unveil its austere illumination upon the Walls of the Forgotten.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_TOLSHSAATH_000_025: Gather there with your companions, and we shall ssspeak again once our prayers have been offered.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_TOLSHSAATH_000_030: A guide awaits you at the entrance to the Cups. He will show you the way to the illuminated land.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_GUIDEOFONDO03651_00: The chieftain has bid me guide your steps to the illuminated land.
Come, the way lies downwards. Follow the path of coral and rock, and join your comrades below.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_ALPHINAUD_000_050:
We're on our way at last!
Hm, it seems far darker down here, but I'll not start at a few shadows. ...We are moving as a group, yes?
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_ALISAIE_000_055: If Emet-Selch is in that trench, then we'll have to assume he's not swimming in saltwater. I wouldn't want to suddenly find ourselves at the edge of Bismarck's bubble with no air to breathe...
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_THANCRED_000_060: During the time I've spent helping the Ondo, I've been introduced to quite a few of the local varieties of sealife...
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_THANCRED_000_061: Although “sea monsters” is mayhap the more apt term. Probably best to avoid them, if we can.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_RYNE_000_065: Meeting the Ondo was fascinating. They live just like us in some ways, but act completely different in others. The way they think, the way they play...
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_RYNE_000_066: I'd love to come back here and learn more about their culture. Will the dome last that long, I wonder...?
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_URIANGER_000_070: Emet-Selch hath made himself difficult to reach, yet every step we take bringeth us nearer to his stronghold. Let us not linger, lest the Exarch suffer for our late arrival.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_YSHTOLA_000_075: You have everything you need? If that artisan fellow is as skilled as they say, then you may wish to avail yourself of his services ere we press on.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_GUIDEOFONDO03651_00: All are gathered, yes? Then I shall describe the path you mussst take.
Enter the cavern beyond, and follow the wall down, and down, and down... Once at the bottom, find a passage to the northwest, then continue west, and west, and west...
The way is not sssimple. Keep your friends within shouting distance, and do not ssstray into the deep.
Jussst before the journey's end you will find the Caliban Gap and the barrier we placed at its mouth. This obstacle will fade should you raise a hand towards it─we have made it ssso.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_ALPHINAUD_000_084: A most succinct explanation. We thank you for your guidance.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_ALISAIE_000_085: Right! Deeper into the depths we go!
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_GUIDEOFONDO03651_00: Once in the cavern beyond, you must follow the wall all the way down. At the bottom, you will find a passage to the northwest─follow it far, far to the west...
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_RYNE_000_095: The rocks and coral bunch up by the cavern wall like a staircase of sorts, but be careful─you wouldn't want to slip from up here!
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_THANCRED_000_100: Hmmm... I'd wager these bursts of water could carry you clear to the top again. Not that I'm eager to try it.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_URIANGER_000_110: Our guide bade us travel to the cavern floor and thence to the west...
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_URIANGER_000_111: Yet 'twould seem these twisting tunnels defy such simple instruction. Rather than rely on direction alone, I suggest we scout with care, and relay the path ahead to those who come behind.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_URIANGER_000_120: Y'shtola hath forged ahead. Shall we continue our own advance?
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_YSHTOLA_000_125: The rock drops off sharply here, but I should think this coral thick enough to serve as a bridge...
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_ALPHINAUD_000_130: Ah, . You have a choice of two routes from here.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_ALPHINAUD_000_131: You can either take the long way to the south along the rocks, or skip along this coral branch as Alisaie has done. I, for one, shall be following my sister's example. Ahem... <gulp>
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_ALPHINAUD_000_140: Phew... N-Naught to it! Alisaie has already gone on ahead─we should catch up to her.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_ALISAIE_000_150: There you are. Come on, I think I've found the tunnel we were looking for!
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_ALISAIE_000_160: Here. This must be the barrier the Ondo spoke of...
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_YSHTOLA_000_161: ...Well, that was rather more arduous than expected. I feel a sudden rush of gratitude for the smooth roads our ancestors cut through the wilderness.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_ALPHINAUD_000_162: 'Twas a treacherous path, indeed. Now, I believe one of us needs but raise a hand to banish this next obstacle?
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_ALPHINAUD_000_163: . I elect you to do the honors!
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_RYNE_000_164: Gone, just like that! I suppose we should head in.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_THANCRED_000_165: Like as not, this tunnel will be just as perilous as the road we walked to get here. Let's all stay aware of our surroundings, shall we?
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_ALPHINAUD_000_170: Watch your footing here. I wouldn't envy the climb back up if you fell...
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_THANCRED_000_175: Nay, I'd not want to chance that leap. Hugging the northern wall on the way down seems the wiser proposition.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_RYNE_000_180: That...is a very long drop. Please, no heroic jumps over the edge, ─I don't think my heart could take it!
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_URIANGER_000_185: Ware thy footfalls, my friend. Our road taketh us ever onwards, unto ever deeper darkness...
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_YSHTOLA_000_190: If we weren't so pressed for time, I should like to explore these side passages. Mayhap another day.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_ALPHINAUD_000_200: Emet-Selch holds the Exarch captive somewhere within that vast city... Yet even if we must search every alleyway, we will find them!
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_ALISAIE_000_205: When the chieftain spoke of lights shining from the abyss, this is not at all what I imagined. Why would Emet-Selch do this...?
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_THANCRED_000_210: It's big, I'll grant you. But cluttered city streets are far more conducive to infiltration than wide-open spaces. This will work to our advantage. Trust me.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_RYNE_000_215: You'd think all those tall, dark buildings would be frightening, but for some reason they just make me feel sad...
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_URIANGER_000_220: One cannot blame the Ondo for fleeing the spectacle of these brooding edifices. We, however, have not the luxury of fear...
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_YSHTOLA_000_230: , did you note the style of the architecture? 'Tis the same used for the remnants at the Cups and the mural's painted towers.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_YSHTOLA_000_231: Look closely. Emet-Selch has not simply reclaimed these ruins...he has layered the semblance of an entire city upon them.
TEXT_LUCKMF108_03651_YSHTOLA_000_232: Gods, the magnitude of his artifice is staggering. Though it pains me to admit, we did not fully understand the feats of which an old world Ascian is capable...
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Emet-Selch holds the Exarch captive somewhere within that vast city... Yet even if we must search every alleyway, we will find them!
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_THANCRED_000_005: It's big, I'll grant you. But cluttered city streets are far more conducive to infiltration than wide-open spaces. This will work to our advantage. Trust me.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_RYNE_000_010: You'd think all those tall, dark buildings would be frightening, but for some reason they just make me feel sad...
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_URIANGER_000_015: One cannot blame the Ondo for fleeing the spectacle of these brooding edifices. We, however, have not the luxury of fear...
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_YSHTOLA_000_020: We have found our destination, but how to descend into the city itself...?
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_ALISAIE_000_030: It's intimidating, yes, but we have to start somewhere...
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_ALISAIE_000_031: Why don't we have a closer look at that tower to the southeast? We might be able to reach it from the edge of the trench.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Look at the size of those doors... Now I know how pixies must feel.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_ELEVATOR03652_000_0:
(-Echoing Voice-) recognized...
Welcome to the city of Amaurot.
(-Echoing Voice-)Will you be riding the lift?
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_ALISAIE_000_043: Wh─!? Did the building just welcome you?
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_URIANGER_000_044: Mayhap it is not so passing strange... Did Emet-Selch not invite  to visit his abode?
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_YSHTOLA_000_046: And where will this lift be taking us?
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_ELEVATOR03652_000_0: (-Echoing Voice-)The lift services every level of Achora Heights, but is presently configured to convey passengers directly to the ground floor.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_YSHTOLA_000_048: Well, there you have it. In the absence of some few hundred yalms of rope, we have little choice but to accept the offer.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_ALISAIE_000_049: With emphasis on the we. I'm not about to let you walk into that place alone.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_A1_000_001: I wish to ride the lift.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_ELEVATOR03652_000_0:
(-Echoing Voice-)As you wish.
The lift will arrive shortly.

(-Echoing Voice-)Next stop: Ground Floor.
Facilities include the Bureau of the Administrator, the Bureau of the Architect, and the Capitol...
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_ALPHINAUD_000_060: Each of these towers seems a veritable city in itself... Even a gigas would feel inadequate in such surroundings.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_THANCRED_000_065: Seems peaceful enough─he said, tempting fate.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_RYNE_000_070: I just can't believe how tall everything is!
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_URIANGER_000_075: If mine eyes do not deceive, we stand in some manner of communal square...
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_YSHTOLA_000_080: Just a moment. I thought I saw something.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_SYSTEM_000_085: Descend to the ground floor of Achora Heights?
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_ALISAIE_000_090: It's only at this distance that you start to realize just how big the buildings truly are... What did that voice call the city? “Amaurot”?
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_THANCRED_000_092: Is that...a person? Ah, no, my mistake. That's a giant.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_THANCRED_000_093: It doesn't seem to have noticed us yet...
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_ALPHINAUD_000_094: Giant or no, a resident of this place may have much and more to tell us. I say we make the first move.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_ALPHINAUD_000_096: Pray excuse my boldness, but might I ask you a few questions...?
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_AMAUROTRESIDENT0365: Oh, what adorable costumes. Are you children on an excursion? This district has much to teach you.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_RYNE_000_098: How odd... That sounded like no language I've ever heard, and yet I understood every word...
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_ALPHINAUD_000_100: Ahem. And which district is this, exactly?
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_AMAUROTRESIDENT0365: You must be lost, poor things.
You stand in the Polyleritae District, wherein lie the institutions most vital to the management of our star.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_A2_000_001: Can you tell us where to find Emet-Selch?
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_A2_000_002: Can you tell us who rules this city?
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_AMAUROTRESIDENT0365: Ah, I see. You've come to marvel at the workings of the Convocation of Fourteen.
Who rules...? What a curious question. Mayhap you refer to our supervising body, the Convocation of Fourteen?
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_ALISAIE_000_105: So Emet-Selch isn't the leader here...
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_AMAUROTRESIDENT0365: Emet-Selch is a member of the Convocation. Were you hoping to witness its deeds firsthand?
Hm hm hm... Hardly surprising, I suppose. The whole world holds its breath as the Final Days draw near, and our brightest minds race to implement their plans.
...Thus you must understand that gaining an audience at this time will be next to impossible.
You should hurry home now, before your families begin to worry. Do you need me to walk you back?
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_ALPHINAUD_000_110: N-No thank you. We will be fine.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_AMAUROTRESIDENT0365: Very well. Take care, little ones...
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_YSHTOLA_000_113: To my eyes, these people appear as arcane entities. I suspect Emet-Selch wove them from aether, much as he reconstructed the rest of the city...
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_URIANGER_000_115: Such words well befit the oblivion described to us by our Ascian foe.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_URIANGER_000_116: A catastrophe of unprecedented scale, which did set in motion the summoning of Zodiark...and thence Hydaelyn Herself.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_RYNE_000_117: But...that happened centuries and centuries ago, didn't it?
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_RYNE_000_118: That man spoke as if they were rushing to avert a disaster here and now.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_ALPHINAUD_000_119: Unless... For these people, the distant past is the here and now!
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_URIANGER_000_120: I believe thou hast the right of it, Master Alphinaud. This aetherial Amaurot and its residents appear to be phantoms of a different age.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_URIANGER_000_121: Emet-Selch hath resurrected a memory─a moment in time from before the star was sundered.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_THANCRED_000_122: So, we find ourselves in a long-destroyed city inhabited by the long-departed. An unusual situation, to be sure─but at least we're able to parley with these ancients.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_THANCRED_000_123: ...In fact, they seem downright eager to chat. I say we use this to our advantage─split up, strike up some conversations, and see if we can't learn the location of our quarry.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_THANCRED_000_124: And while we're at it, it wouldn't hurt to wheedle out a few more details regarding this Convocation of Fourteen and their impending disaster.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_THANCRED_000_125: To mingling, then. Let's meet back here when our jaws start aching.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_AMAUROTRESIDENTA036: Hm? 'Twould seem the Hall is host to a most precocious visitor this day. And what, pray tell, shall be the subject of our discussion, young one?
Ah...the Convocation and their handling of the coming peril. 'Tis only natural that you should have questions.

Shall we begin with the members themselves? As all know, the Fourteen are the wisest and most puissant among us. They are the stewards of order, responsible for decisions which keep this star turning season after season.
Be it the speaker, Lahabrea, or the emissary, Elidibus, each seat is occupied by an elected sage of surpassing intellect.
Loghrif, Mitron, Emet-Selch... Their individual titles have, as a gesture of respect and a matter of tradition, become synonymous with their incumbents.
Thus it is with great incredulity that I greet this recent rumor that a seat in the Convocation is soon to be left vacant.

If proven true, 'twould be an unprecedented development─and testament to the immense pressure under which our saviors are toiling... In any event, I for one am confident they shall deliver our star unto salvation.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_AMAUROTRESIDENTB036: Good gracious, child, where is your family? You should not be alone at a time like this. Run along home. Quickly now!
Have you not heard? Though yet confined to the lands across the sea, a terrible phenomenon afflicts our star. They are calling it the “Final Days.”
'Tis said it starts suddenly, a cacophonous keening from beneath the earth. The sound distorts all living things within earshot, and wrests from us control of our creation magicks.
Once that happens, all is lost. Fear, pain, despair...every dread impulse is siphoned from our minds and given substance: an eternal fall of fiery rain; an incessant spawning of nightmarish beasts...
None can point to the source of the phenomenon. 'Tis as if the star itself has fallen ill─as if a force inimical to life now festers and spreads.
'Tis only a matter of time until Amaurot, too, resounds to that discordant squall. You should stay with your loved ones, child... Stay with them...
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_AMAUROTRESIDENTC036: An audience with Emet-Selch? I am afraid you have the wrong office, little one. And besides, he will be far too busy to field the questions of curious children.
Surely you have been told of the looming catastrophe? Every resource available to the Convocation must be spent upon ensuring our world survives.
They have yet to make an official announcement, but it is said the Fourteen are moving forward with a plan of scarce credible proportions─one which promises to grant will to the very star itself!
They will invoke our mightiest spells of creation to birth an entity of all-encompassing magnificence...and then they will rewrite the laws of existence.
'Tis a huge undertaking, and it must be completed ere the corruption spreads this far. Thus I say to you again: do not hold out hope for an audience...
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_ALISAIE_000_150: Well, that was an experience. I was never very fond of being treated like a child, but it did make asking questions less suspicious.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_ALPHINAUD_000_160: . If I was not certain before, then I am now─the people of this city believe they face the end of the world.
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_ALPHINAUD_000_161: I cannot imagine what purpose compelled Emet-Selch to recreate this ancient “Amaurot.”
TEXT_LUCKMF109_03652_ALPHINAUD_000_162: And yet...I fancy I hear his words to us echoing throughout this ocean trench. He would have his story known.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_ALISAIE_100_000: Well, that was an experience. I'm not sure I care for being treated like a child, but it did make asking questions less suspicious, I suppose.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_ALPHINAUD_000_000: We can compare notes once the others return. Hopefully then our next move will become clear...
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_YSHTOLA_000_001: 'Twould seem our conversations were much alike: a looming disaster, creation magicks running rampant, and this Convocation's efforts to bring salvation out of chaos.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_ALPHINAUD_000_002: I suppose there was talk of little else in the time when these events came to pass.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_YSHTOLA_000_003: Ah, Urianger, if I may. What are your thoughts on the ancients' art of creation?
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_URIANGER_000_004: A fascinating discipline, indeed. Aught the mind can conceive may be rendered in reality─all that is required is a clear “concept” upon which to focus one's will.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_URIANGER_000_005: 'Tis not dissimilar to the primal rites taught by the Ascians, wherein ritual ceremony breatheth life into figments of myth and legend.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_YSHTOLA_000_006: I see we arrived at the same conclusion, then.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_YSHTOLA_000_007: The people who lived in the age before the sundering were blessed with vast reserves of mana...
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_YSHTOLA_000_008: No matter how draining these creation magicks must be, it seems they paid the cost with naught more than a fraction of the aether which coursed through their own bodies.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_YSHTOLA_000_009: If we were to attempt the same, such spells would soon deplete our energies, and then seek to draw the balance from elsewhere─from a hoard of crystals, mayhap, or from the very land itself.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_YSHTOLA_000_010: Thus when this art of creation was placed into our hands, it became, in effect, a means for destruction.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_ALISAIE_000_011: An interesting matter which no doubt bears further study. But despite all these revelations, I worry we are no closer to finding Emet-Selch.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_ALISAIE_000_012: Has anyone learned aught which might lead us to his location?
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_THANCRED_000_013: Not directly, mayhap, but from what we've heard, it seems the Convocation of Fourteen is sequestered in the nearby Capitol building.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_RYNE_000_014: When we went to see for ourselves, the attendant wouldn't let us through without a writ of permission...
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_RYNE_000_015: So we tried our luck at the Bureau of the Administrator, where we thought these permissions might be issued. But the clerk there said he couldn't help us since our names didn't appear in the registry...
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_THANCRED_000_016: And that was where we gave up. I wonder, though, ... Could you be eligible for one of these writs?
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_THANCRED_000_017: The voice in the lift seemed to know who you were─it might be that your name is registered at the bureaus as well. Worth a look, I'd say.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_THANCRED_000_018: Meanwhile, I'll head back to the Capitol and search for a less “official” point of entry. Just in case.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_URIANGER_000_019: Pray allow me to accompany thee on thy reconnaissance. An arcane perspective may prove needful.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_RYNE_000_020: Ahem, I... I think I'd like to speak with more of these ancients. Maybe they know something that could help cure 's condition.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_ALISAIE_000_022: Of course I don't mind! Just lead the way!
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_ALPHINAUD_000_023: Then Y'shtola and I will busy ourselves with further exploration. There is surely more intelligence to be had.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_ALPHINAUD_000_024: And so we part ways once more... This time, however, let us reconvene in front of the Capitol.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_OFFICIALA03653_000_: ...A visitor's writ? Yes, I can assist you. Full name, please.
.... Please wait near the counter while I confirm your details.
One moment, please. I need to check your details against the registry.
(-Administrative Clerk-). Your application is ready for collection.
As your residency was approved by Emet-Selch himself, further forms of identification will not be required.
Here are your application documents. Submit them at the Bureau of the Secretariat and the clerk will issue you with a visitor's writ for the Capitol.
Your visitor's writ will be issued at the Bureau of the Secretariat. Just submit those application documents to the clerk on duty...
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_AMAUROTADMINISTRATO: ...Visiting the Capitol, are we? Please take a seat. Your name will be called once your application has been processed.
I will process your application in turn. Please take a seat so that others might state their business.
When you wish to gain admittance to the Capitol, simply present the document to the attendant within.
It seems no else is waiting. My duty is done for another day...
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_ALPHINAUD_000_115: Y'shtola and I have just returned from an institution the locals called the “Akadaemia Anyder.” Well, from its public offices, at least.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_ALPHINAUD_000_116: We thought an Ascian place of learning the ideal spot to research your condition, but it seems we lacked the credentials to enter the Akadaemia proper...
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_URIANGER_000_130: ...Master Thancred can best describe our chances for infiltrating the Capitol. I only hope thine efforts to secure permissions were successful.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_YSHTOLA_000_135: Ah, good, you're here. Everyone seems to be present and accounted for...
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_THANCRED_000_140: Finally! You were gone so long, I was on the verge of mounting a rescue party. How fared you in your bureaucratic ventures?
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_THANCRED_000_141: Ah, I see my instincts were correct!
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_THANCRED_000_142: And a good thing, too. Urianger and I weighed our chances of breaking into the Capitol, and an official entrance is by far the more attractive option.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_URIANGER_000_143: The Capitol boasteth not a single armed sentry. 'Twould seem that in their time, they did not deem it needful to post guards.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_URIANGER_000_144: The windows and doors, however, appear heavily warded. Though mightily did we strive, with strength mundane and magical, we failed to budge them even a fraction of one ilm. Mayhap 'twas simply the case that Emet-Selch's recreation did not extend to their usual function.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_THANCRED_000_145: We didn't try everything, of course, but we thought it best to conserve our time and energy for more pressing matters.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_ALISAIE_000_146: ...Speaking of which, Ryne and I tried asking about a cure for you.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_ALISAIE_000_147: The problem is, these ancients didn't exist beyond Amaurot's “today.” They will happily tell their own tales, but whenever we attempted to explain our situation, the conversation quickly became muddled...
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_YSHTOLA_000_148: What of you, ? Was aught worthy of interest said during your efforts to obtain a writ?
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_ALPHINAUD_000_149: A great sacrifice of life in exchange for their brethren's resurrection... And you say all the Ascians' scheming has been leading to this!?
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_ALPHINAUD_000_150: All this time... But if they still mean to enact this plan, then things won't end with the Rejoining...
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_YSHTOLA_000_151: ...Aye, I thought we knew their intentions in full: restore the world to its former glory, and, in turn, empower Zodiark to reclaim His throne as the will of the star.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_YSHTOLA_000_152: Yet that was merely a step along the way. I hesitate to put it into words, but we have to assume that following the final Rejoining, the Ascians mean to draw on the lives of the Source to make their sacrifice to Zodiark.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_ALPHINAUD_000_153: That does seem the most likely scenario. Mayhap those who ally with the Ascians would be spared that fate...
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_ALPHINAUD_000_154: But what value is there in surviving when all our history, all our struggles will be erased? I cannot conscience such an act.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_ALISAIE_000_155: Of course not. And that's to say naught of what Emet-Selch plans for the Exarch's power. Do we stand by and let him threaten our future as well as our past?
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_ALISAIE_000_156: We need to find him, . And when we do...
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_ALISAIE_000_157: Make your mark. Change the course of history in a way that's felt by those who came before, and those who came after; by everyone you've ever met.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_ALISAIE_000_158: Change things so that even my other self, dying somewhere in that future Calamity will smile and say, “I knew you would win.”
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_RYNE_000_160: He created an entire city. It will take everything we have to defeat him...if we even can.
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_RYNE_000_161: And if you push that hard in your current state, the Light will break free...
TEXT_LUCKMF110_03653_YSHTOLA_000_162: The decision to press on lies with you. Just as it lies with each and every one of us...
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_SYSTEM_000_000: Alphinaud is lost in thought, his eyes downcast. There is, however, no sign of the self-doubt which once assailed him at the Falling Snows.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_SYSTEM_000_005: Thancred stares quietly into the distance. He seems calm and assured, his easy stance born of confidence rather than false bravado.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_SYSTEM_000_010: Ryne appears to be brooding over her choices, her faintly trembling hands betraying her mounting trepidation.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_SYSTEM_000_015: Urianger glances your way, his expression hesitant. You can see the struggle as he agonizes over the words he wishes to say.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_SYSTEM_000_020: Y'shtola meets your gaze with a strained smile. You seem to recall her wearing the selfsame expression when speaking with Lyse and Runar.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ALISAIE_000_030: Do you remember that talk we had atop the tower in Mord Souq?
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ALISAIE_000_031: I'm still of the same mind now as I was then. I don't abandon you, you don't abandon me, and together we make a difference in this fight.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ALISAIE_000_032: There's always hope if we look for it─I saw it again and again as you tore those veils of Light from the sky.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ALISAIE_000_033: If we keep taking that next step forward, there's a chance we'll find a way to save you. So no matter how long it takes or how much it hurts, you can count on me to keep on walking.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Vauthry spoke of the disaster we would bring upon our own heads. The ceaseless conflict...
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ALPHINAUD_000_041: Imagine how he would sneer to see what's become of the First, not to mention your perilous predicament.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ALPHINAUD_000_042: And yet who can deny the fire your deeds have ignited in people's hearts?
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ALPHINAUD_000_043: You achieved what my logic and ideals never could: uniting disparate peoples under the banner of hope and common purpose. Without you, that giant Talos would never have raised its head.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ALPHINAUD_000_044: I have borne witness to many such miracles at your side, and would do so again. This is but another obstacle in the road.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ALPHINAUD_000_045: So come, let us travel it. Drag me through wonder and danger, as you are wont to do, and I shall endeavor not to slow you down.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_URIANGER_000_050: As well thou knowest, if we are to usher Emet-Selch unto his rest, we must needs bind his Ascian soul...and then shatter it with overwhelming force.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_URIANGER_000_051: The former task requireth auracite, and such have I prepared─upon the Exarch's asking, no less, though 'twas ever mine intent to provide said boon.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_URIANGER_000_052: The future whence our noble friend doth hail is a world fallen to Ascian artifice, and he would not see such grim history repeated.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_URIANGER_000_053: In a sense, Emet-Selch's destruction will be the culmination of the Exarch's efforts─a reward for all he hath endured these many years.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_URIANGER_000_054: Yet even as thou stridest into the jaws of peril, forget not but that his fondest wish─and that of many others, besides─is to see thee survive unto the morrow.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_URIANGER_000_055: 'Tis in pursuit of that happiest of outcomes that I do pledge to remain at thy side.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_YSHTOLA_000_060: Our time in the First has been a never-ending succession of trials, as arduous as our path in the Source ever was.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_YSHTOLA_000_061: Yet through all our journeys together─through that deep and foreboding wood─you have helped me to stay true to my convictions.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_YSHTOLA_000_062: Thus would I return the favor. Do as your heart decrees, without hesitation or regret. And that is all I will say on the matter.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_THANCRED_000_070: Well, this has put everyone in a solemn mood, hasn't it? Honestly, we're not even sure this will be the end of it.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_THANCRED_000_071: But I suppose we should speak our minds when we have the opportunity. You taught me that much in Amh Araeng.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_THANCRED_000_072: So forgive me this moment of sentiment, . By dragging me into this sorry mess, you've given me the chance to think and act as I should have. For Ryne's sake.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_THANCRED_000_073: Words cannot express how much this has changed my life, or how grateful I am for your support...
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_THANCRED_000_074: ...So I shall express my gratitude through action instead. No matter where you decide to go, I will be there, guarding your back.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_RYNE_000_080: When Minfilia entrusted me with her power, she warned me that no matter how strong you become, you can still fall victim to despair; you can still feel powerless.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_RYNE_000_081: And she was right. After you collapsed on Mt. Gulg, my hands wouldn't stop shaking...
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_RYNE_000_082: If I made a mistake, if I failed to bind the Light within you... I was terrified you would die.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_RYNE_000_083: Even now, you could be moments from turning, and I wouldn't know how to save you!
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_RYNE_000_084: You, Thancred, the others, you've all been there when I needed help. Minfilia surrendered her life to me─her legacy.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_RYNE_000_085: I should be ready to do the same for you! And I want to, I do! But I just...
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_RYNE_000_087: She told me to follow your example, and I've tried, I've really tried... <sob>
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_A1_000_001: Then you shouldn't hang your head.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_A1_000_002: I'm not asking to be saved.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_RYNE_000_089: But the Light, it─ You'll─ How can you go on?
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_A2_000_001: Fate can be cruel, but a smile better suits a hero.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_A2_000_002: We must all keep looking forward, like the heroes who never gave up hope for this world.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_RYNE_000_092: ...Actually, never mind. I think I'll understand better if I try it for myself.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_RYNE_000_095: ...Actually, never mind. I think the answer might be different for all of us.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_RYNE_000_096: ...I see. If I'm to become what I wish to become, then there are some answers I need to work out for myself.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_RYNE_000_097: No, nothing will come of brooding here in self-pity. I've made my decision, ─I'm going with you!
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_OFFICIAL03654_000_1: Welcome to the Capitol. All visitors must present an official writ of permission before admittance will be granted.
Your documents appear to be in order. You may proceed into the Capitol─but any guests you may choose to bring with you must remain in your vicinity at all times.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_A3_000_002: Form a party and enter Amaurot.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ALPHINAUD_000_110: Just say the word, . However harrowing the scenes that await us, they will not sway us from our course.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ALISAIE_000_115: I won't ask you to hold back─that time is long past. I'll just try to snuff out the worst of the embers before they reach you.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_THANCRED_000_120: Ready when you are, . If it's proof he wants, we'll give him a fight the likes of which he's never seen.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_RYNE_000_125: I can feel it, beyond the flames...a Darkness waiting to swallow our Light.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_RYNE_000_126: Wherever you are, Minfilia, watch over us and guide our steps...
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_URIANGER_000_130: In those Final Days, 'tis said that monstrous beasts were set loose in the city─terrors made flesh by sorceries run rampant.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_URIANGER_000_131: If Emet-Selch hath been faithful in his reconstruction, then we must be prepared to face many such abominations.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_YSHTOLA_000_135: I reasoned that Emet-Selch would not harm the Exarch until he had learned the tower's secrets, but his parting words suggest otherwise.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_YSHTOLA_000_136: Let us make haste. Your friend may not have the luxury of decades to wait for you this time.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ALPHINAUD_000_140: It would seem that the city celebrated long into the night...not that I would know. As embarrassing as it is to admit, I woke to find myself in the infirmary, having apparently collapsed from exhaustion.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ALPHINAUD_000_141: My aching pride was somewhat soothed by the sight of Alisaie asleep in the bed next to mine. She must have been just as weary. Long has it been since I've seen her face so peaceful in repose...
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ALPHINAUD_000_142: Ah, 'twas a rare, tranquil morning, made unforgettable by the sight of those clear blue skies.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ALISAIE_000_145: <sigh> It would seem I don't know my own limits. I had thought to push on till dawn, but my body had other plans...
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ALISAIE_000_146: Still, I did enjoy the carousing while it lasted. Even I need to forget my cares every now and then.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ALISAIE_000_147: What I don't need is to wake up to Alphinaud smirking at my bedside! He said my face was “a rare sight” while I slept. Gods, I hope I wasn't drooling...
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_THANCRED_000_150: People came from malms around to join the festivities, but most seem to have stumbled home by now.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_THANCRED_000_151: Even so, I daresay Norvrandt will echo to the sound of clinking mugs for some while yet.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_THANCRED_000_152: I thought to indulge in a little revelry myself last night...until Urianger began to list all the names of my drunken conquests. I ended up drinking water. Water.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_RYNE_000_155: Oh, , are you well? No ill aftereffects? To my eyes, you seem completely healed. It really is a miracle...
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_RYNE_000_156: Speaking of happy surprises, I was amazed to see the crowd that greeted our return! I hadn't realized just how many people we'd met along the way...
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_RYNE_000_157: And did you see their smiles!? Right then and there, I vowed to do whatever I could to keep that joy from fading!
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_URIANGER_000_160: The ending to this tale hath been a joyous one indeed. Myriad were the lessons learned, yet there is one of particular import...
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_URIANGER_000_161: 'Tis imperative that I master magicks to grant my feet purchase upon the water...or else allow me to part the sea at will.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_URIANGER_000_162: I must needs visit Bismarck in due course, and scrub his teeth in thanks. Mayhap the airy arts of a faerie whale might be imparted to mortal men...? We shall see. We shall see...
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_YSHTOLA_000_165: I knew the Night's Blessed were amongst the revelers, aye... But the Crystarium was so crowded, I thought it safe to speak my true name.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_YSHTOLA_000_166: Poor Runar and his ilk were gripped with panic. As you may recall, 'tis customary not to reveal one's true name outside of family and ceremony...
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_YSHTOLA_000_167: Yet when I hurried to explain that all present were like family, I was greeted with an outpouring of tears. <sigh> An emotional people, the Blessed...
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_COINACHINVESTIGATOR: Oh, you've returned! Was there a lull in the fighting over there, or...?
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_TATARU_000_182: B-B-But how? When!? We didn't think you'd be back for ages!
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_A5_000_002: Would you rather I went again?
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_TATARU_000_183: Right! So it does! The reports you had delivered by that excitable little pixie said as much!
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_TATARU_000_184: Oh, don't be daft! I just can't believe you're actually back!
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_TATARU_000_185: We heard the good news from your pixie friend, but nothing compares to seeing you in the flesh!
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_TATARU_000_186: As for the situation on this side, the imperials are still eyeing our forces from afar.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_TATARU_000_187: From what I'm told, the Garlean armies have been slow to react, and seem reluctant to commit to any large-scale engagements. It's an odd sort of stalemate.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_TATARU_000_188: Otherwise, we've yet to see any sign of that awful “Black Rose” weapon we were warned about...
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_TATARU_000_189: Oh! But I suppose we did call in an old friend to help out on that count.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_TATARU_000_190: Hee hee! Krile and I had a terrible time tracking him down, though it will be worth it to see the look on your face when you find out who it is!
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_TATARU_000_191: Anyway, I was just about to make contact with this helper of ours, and then confirm the latest news from the front. Might you fancy having a rest while I do?
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_TATARU_000_192: Ah, the Warrior of Light, back where  belongs, just as if nothing had happened! ...Though you do seem different somehow. You'll have to tell me all about your adventures when we next have a spare moment!
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ELIDIBUS_000_901: Emet-Selch...gone. Lahabrea...gone. I alone remain─the last of the unbroken.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ELIDIBUS_000_902: Once more, I am moved to reevaluate the potential of these tattered souls.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ELIDIBUS_000_903: Ah, Zenos. Never did I dream you could overpower me so completely, possessed as I was of your body, and all its uncanny strength...
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ELIDIBUS_000_904: And now that I have shared with you the truth of this world and its reflections, who can predict how events will unfold? ...Not I.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ELIDIBUS_000_905: “Emissary”... What a poor jest that title has become. The flow of history has become muddied, its currents wild beyond my capacity to direct them.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ELIDIBUS_000_906: You have wrested the advantage, Hydaelyn. The thieving hands of Your disciples tighten their grip on our star.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ELIDIBUS_000_907: The origins of the world remain hidden and its inhabitants ignorant of their broken existence, just as You and Your creators desired.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ELIDIBUS_000_908: They celebrate the gift of imperfect life─uncaring, unknowing as we weaken and fade.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ELIDIBUS_000_909: But do not imagine Yourself rid of us.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ELIDIBUS_000_910: Though Your champion has indeed proven the most egregious obstacle to our ascendance─a barbed thorn in my side─ may yet be removed and cast into the abyss.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ELIDIBUS_000_911: Oh yes...it can be done. I will keep these “heroes” mired in the First, and victory will be ours at the last.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ELIDIBUS_000_912: Warriors of Darkness now, are they? Then their fate is decided.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_ELIDIBUS_000_913: They shall meet the same end as those who came before─death at the hands of Warriors of Light!
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_RYNE_000_931: Yes, there is something out there...
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_THANCRED_000_932: But it would mean crossing malms and malms of this infernal emptiness. Which is rather unhealthy for living creatures, as I understand it.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_THANCRED_000_933: Even were we to restrict ourselves to brief forays, I don't like to imagine the effect it would have on our aether...
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_THANCRED_000_934: But...you still want to go. Don't you.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_RYNE_000_935: We may have saved the world, but we haven't reclaimed it.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_THANCRED_000_936: Ah, when you put it that way...
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_THANCRED_000_938: Well, of course I'm going with you─that's what family is for, isn't it?
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_THANCRED_000_939: Come. Let's head back and prepare for this mad journey of yours.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_SYSTEM_000_200: By completing the main scenario quest “Shadowbringers,” you have unlocked the Trust system!
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_SYSTEM_000_201: Trust allows you repeat previously completed main scenario dungeons with a party of NPC avatars, who will gain EXP and level up in accordance with their duty participation.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_SYSTEM_000_202: To bring up the interface, select Trust under Duty from the main menu. For more information, please refer to the help found within the interface itself.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_SYSTEM_000_203: Furthermore, bolstered by your experiences in the First, you are now able to accept new quests from job-related NPCs in the Source. In order to access them, the following conditions must be met:
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_SYSTEM_000_204:
・ Reach level 80 in a given job
・ Complete the relevant level 70 job quest
・ Complete the associated role quest line
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_SYSTEM_000_205: Quest locations and other details can be reviewed in the level 70 job quest journal entry.
TEXT_LUCKMF111_03654_SYSTEM_000_206: In addition, quests to unlock new content have now become available in the Crystarium. Rest well, Warrior of Light and Darkness, for two worlds of adventure await your return!
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_TATARU_000_000: ! Gods, it's good to see you. I hope your being here means you've had your fill of rest?
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_A2_000_500: Not so much as forty winks, truth be told...
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_TATARU_000_105: You're too selfless, that's your problem. But you'll be no good to anyone if you don't take a break every once in a while. Anyway...
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_TATARU_000_001: Not much has happened since your last visit. I had planned for you to meet that helper I told you about, but he refuses to answer his linkpearl. I do hope he's all right.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_TATARU_000_002: We've been exchanging messages with the Eorzean Alliance throughout, though. They say the fighting has finally stopped at the Ghimlyt Dark, and that the Empire's shown no sign of movement.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_TATARU_000_003: Which means we might actually have a moment to ourselves for a change. Seeing as you're back, maybe you could tell me more about your time in the First?
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_TATARU_000_004: Great! Oh, and if you don't mind, I'd like to ask F'lhaminn to join us. She'll want to know what happened to Minfilia, and I think it's best she hears it from you.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_TATARU_000_005: We'll meet you on the terrace at the House of Splendors.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_SYSTEM_000_006: You have now begun “The Voyage Home.” To proceed to the end of this chapter, you must complete the Crystal Tower quests.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_SYSTEM_000_007: Crystal Tower quests can be experienced alongside the main scenario.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_SYSTEM_000_008: The starting quest, “Legacy of Allag,” may be undertaken by speaking with the outlandish man in Revenant's Toll.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_SYSTEM_000_009: You may review your progress under “Chronicles of a New Era - The Crystal Tower” in your journal.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_TATARU_000_010: We'll be waiting for you at the House of Splendors. And I expect you to tell us absolutely everything about your time in the First!
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_FLHAMINN_000_020: . My, it has been too long. Tataru did mention that I would be joining you, did she not?
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_FLHAMINN_000_021: Thank you... Words cannot well express how I have longed to know more of the First. This world Minfilia has sacrificed so much to save.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_FLHAMINN_000_022: But come, rest your feet. Tataru should be arriving shortly.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_TATARU_000_030: And so Minfilia chose to pass on her gifts to the next Oracle? This girl who Thancred named Ryne?
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_FLHAMINN_000_031: To have such a burden thrust upon her as a child...only to embrace it when given the choice...
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_FLHAMINN_000_032: In that respect, they are quite alike. It would seem her legacy is indeed in capable hands.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_FLHAMINN_000_033: ─might I ask a favor of you when next you return to the First? To tell Ryne what I cannot.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_FLHAMINN_000_034: And I would offer thanks to you as well. For staying with her to the end.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_RIOL_000_035: (-???-)Beggin' yer pardon, but could I have a word?
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_TATARU_000_036: Riol! I hope you're here to tell me you've received word from our helper.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_RIOL_000_037: I wish. Nay, I've not had a peep out of him. An' it's been a good long while now. Too bloody long.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_RIOL_000_038: On account o' which, I'm goin' to sneak over the border an' see if I can't get a signal to him from closer up.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_TATARU_000_039: But what if they catch you!? There must be another way.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_RIOL_000_040: Well, it ain't as if we can ask Thancred to do it. Besides, I shouldn't have no trouble pickin' me way through Ghimlyt now the fightin's died down. Gods know there's enough shadows to hide in.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_RIOL_000_041: An' it beats waitin' 'round here twiddlin' me thumbs. Anyroad, I just thought I'd let ye know. Now, I'd best be─
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_RIOL_000_042: Ack! I nearly forgot! Krile's at the Stones, an' she wants a word.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_RIOL_000_043: Somethin' to do with the patients. She was gettin' ready to examine 'em again when I left.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_TATARU_000_045: We'd best head back, then. I'm sure it's important.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_FLHAMINN_000_060: You needn't worry about me. Go and see what Krile has to say.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_TATARU_000_070: It seems she's still examining them. Oh, I do hope it's nothing bad...
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_TATARU_000_080: Take care over in the First, . We're counting on you and the Crystal Exarch to bring our friends home.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_KRILE_000_085: Don't you worry. Master Matoya and I will think of something.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_EPHEMIE_000_090: Tataru has apprised us of the Archons' condition. Rest assured, we will do our utmost to assist Mistress Krile in her ministrations.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_MYSTERYVOICE_000_10: Ah, , you are returned. I hope your time in the Source was suitably restful?
...But of course it wasn't. Go on...
Their corporeal aether shows signs of instability? By the gods... The possibility never even occurred to me...
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_MYSTERYVOICE_100_10: If you have returned in the hope that my research has yielded a solution, I fear you will be sorely disappointed.
TEXT_LUCKMG101_03673_MYSTERYVOICE_000_10: 'Tis but a mercy we have the likes of Mistress Krile and Master Matoya to keep our friends' bodies safe while we wrestle with the problem.
But they cannot forestall the separation of body and soul indefinitely. Come, the others must be told.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_ALPHINAUD_000_000: The Nu Mou seemed such a welcoming folk in Il Mheg. What do you suppose could have driven this one to a life of seclusion?
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_ALISAIE_000_005: I'm sick and tired of the Exarch's attempts at selfless sacrifice. If he suggests dying one more time, I swear I'm going to grant him his wish.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_YSHTOLA_000_010: A mage of surpassing skill living a life of seclusion. Now where have I heard that before? One can only hope they are more receptive to unsolicited visitations.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_URIANGER_000_015: 'Tis said the Kingdom of Voeburt was once home to the realm's greatest knights and magicks both.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_URIANGER_000_016: To command a place at the royal court, the Nu Mou whom we seek must needs have been a mage among mages.
