TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_MYSTERYVOICE_000_03: The Grand Cosmos─that is, the palace we seek─stands on the opposite shore of the Source. I will arrange for a boat to carry us there.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_URIANGER_000_031: Whilst thou journeyest thither, I think it best that I devote mine energies to the creation of white auracite─by thy leave, of course. The process requireth no small amount of time, and should the Nu Mou consent to lend us their aid, we will have need of a suitable vessel ere long.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_MYSTERYVOICE_000_03: Agreed. Then I would ask the rest of you to meet me in Sullen. And...do be prepared for a warm reception.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_URIANGER_000_040: Pray join the others in Sullen. I shall turn my thoughts to the auracite, and apprise Thancred and Ryne of our progress.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_ALPHINAUD_000_042: I was relieved to hear the Exarch intended to arrange for a boat to carry us across the lake. N-Not that I would be opposed to swimming, mind you.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_ALISAIE_000_044: The Exarch said to prepare for a warm reception at the palace. Let's hope it's more cordial than his last visit.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_YSHTOLA_000_046: He said the palace is on the opposite shore, but I see nothing on the horizon save empty sky. Curious...
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_MYSTERYVOICE_000_05: As I told you before, I had scarcely set foot on the palace grounds when I was set upon by our host's familiars, and I expect our reception today to be no different. Which is why I propose we march through the main gate, weapons drawn.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_ALISAIE_000_051: I'm sorry, but are we not here to petition for assistance? You can't honestly think barging in looking for a fight is going to persuade them.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_YSHTOLA_000_052: Actually, I believe the Exarch may have the right of it.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_YSHTOLA_000_053: They have no doubt poured a great deal of time and energy into their creations. Were I them, I should be most interested to meet with those who could overcome my defenses.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_MYSTERYVOICE_000_05: As would any true seeker of knowledge. And there is little we can say or do to convince them to help us if we know nothing of their character, nor less why they chose to hide themself from the world.
But if we can seize their interest, mayhap we can earn ourselves an audience.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_ALISAIE_000_057: Though I must say, Exarch, you certainly seem to be enjoying all of this.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_MYSTERYVOICE_000_05: Do I? Well, I will not deny that I enjoy the thought of fighting alongside you all rather than pacing about inside the Crystal Tower.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_ALPHINAUD_000_059: You both seem to be in rather high spirits, if you ask me. Not that I'm surprised. Your moods invariably improve when  is around.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_ALISAIE_000_060: Uh─ What exactly are you implying?
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_MYSTERYVOICE_000_06: averted a Calamity, and the Light which seemed destined to consume  has been extinguished. 'Tis only natural that we be pleased to see .
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_YSHTOLA_000_062: Yes, well, you will have plenty of time to celebrate  good health after we've finished here.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_MYSTERYVOICE_000_06: O-Of course. Then let us proceed to the palace.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_A1_000_002: Form a party and enter the Grand Cosmos.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_ALPHINAUD_000_080: How long has it been since we last went on such an expedition? I cannot help but be reminded of the ruins of Skalla...
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_ALISAIE_000_085: I think we've done enough talking, don't you? We have a Nu Mou to impress.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_YSHTOLA_000_090: I can but imagine what manner of beasts keep guard here. No doubt they will afford us scant opportunity to explore the palace. A pity...
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_MYSTERYVOICE_000_09: 'Tis good to be here with you for a change. Whatever you would have me do, you need but say the word.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_ALPHINAUD_000_150: There you are. The others have gone ahead to the Crystal Tower with Beq Lugg.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_ALPHINAUD_100_150: For the record, I truly wish we hadn't had to resort to using such words when treating with them. I have ever sought to convince, not compel. Yet I cannot deny that a part of me is glad Urianger shared his knowledge of the Nu Mou with us. Had he not, Beq Lugg wouldn't be here.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_ALPHINAUD_000_151: Speaking of whom─we should hurry. To keep our guest waiting would only add insult to injury.
TEXT_LUCKMG102_03674_SYSTEM_000_180: You may now enter the Grand Cosmos with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_ALPHINAUD_000_000: We mustn't dally here any longer, . If Beq Lugg is to hear the truth of our travails in the First, you of all people should be present.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_ALPHINAUD_000_050: Beq Lugg has a fine eye. Though we have yet to begin, I rather think the Exarch was right to call on them.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_ALISAIE_000_055: I sometimes forget we're not truly here in the First. It will be good to be whole again...
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_YSHTOLA_000_060: Did you happen to notice the magicked brooms strewn about the Grand Cosmos? Uncanny.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_MYSTERYVOICE_000_06: Fortunately for us, Beq Lugg is of a mind to see you and your fellow Scions justly compensated for your efforts.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_000_110: You have spun quite a tale. But tell me─have you given any thought as to how you might return to your world?
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_000_111: ...White auracite, you say? An intriguing proposition.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_000_112: But one which fails to account for the present state of your souls.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_100_112: They have become highly charged, likely as a consequence of having maintained tangible forms for so long. In such an energetic, unstable state, there is no telling what may happen to their souls within the auracite. They could very well become immutable to transference, never to be restored to their bodies.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_YSHTOLA_000_113: Then...would it be possible to force our souls into a state of dormancy, prior to transference?
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_000_114: In theory, yes. But the soul is not a candle to be snuffed out and relit on a whim.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_ALISAIE_100_114: Well, that sounds ominous. What exactly would rendering our souls dormant entail?
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_101_114: In order to maintain a corporeal form, your souls constantly draw aether from your surroundings. This process must be halted, and the resulting surfeit of aether removed.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_102_114: Your minds would ultimately be separated from these faux bodies of yours, rendering you incapable of interacting with the world around you. A cruel fate under normal circumstances, but one which will be rectified upon your return home.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_ALISAIE_000_115: Leaving lifeless husks... Like those poor souls at the Inn at Journey's Head─corrupted by the sin eaters, their aether made stagnant by the Light.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_000_120: Might I see these unfortunate individuals?
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_MYSTERYVOICE_000_12: Why? Do you think you might be able to help them?
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_000_122: I might...or I might not. But I shan't know for sure until I have seen their condition firsthand.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_ALISAIE_000_123: Then I would be glad to take you to them...on the understanding that you won't do anything which might increase their suffering.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_000_124: It was my faith in man I lost, not my compassion.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_YSHTOLA_000_125: Well, I see no need for all of us to accompany you. While you escort our guest to the Inn, I will assist Urianger in creating the requisite auracite.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_MYSTERYVOICE_000_12: I believe my talents would be better applied to that endeavor as well. Might I leave the three of you to assist Beq Lugg as necessary?
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_ALPHINAUD_000_127: Let us make for Amh Araeng, then.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_YSHTOLA_000_140: Urianger is more than capable of creating the auracite on his own, but if aught should go awry, I would be on hand to assist him.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_MYSTERYVOICE_000_14: It pains me that there are those who yet suffer despite our victory over the Light. We must hope a way can be found to help both them and our friends.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_ALISAIE_000_150: Beq Lugg told me they wished to meet the worst afflicted. Halric... <sigh> There are times when I swear there's something he wants to tell me, if only he could form the words.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_ALPHINAUD_000_155: Having broken Light's stranglehold on the First, I would like to believe they will one day recover. Yet I fear that day may not come soon...
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_000_180: So this is Halric, is it? ...Yes, his aetheric balance leans perilously toward the Light.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_ALPHINAUD_000_182: What do you suppose will happen to him?
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_000_183: Not too bright, are you, boy? The same as all poor souls corrupted by the Light─he will become a sin eater.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_ALISAIE_000_184: You don't know that. We've defeated the Wardens and banished the Light from the night sky. Halric was completely unresponsive before, but now...
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_000_186: Then perhaps there is yet hope. Hmmm...
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_000_187: If I may, there is a treatment I wish to administer to the patients.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_000_189: In the course of my studies of the soul, I once created a tonic which could temporarily stimulate the aether in one's body. After some refinement, it came to be used by the knights of Voeburt.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_101_189: Lest it fall into the wrong hands, I swore never again to make it. But for their sakes, I will break that oath.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_000_190: It is not like to reverse the stagnation, mind you, but it should offer some measure of relief.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_000_210: Come. Let us see what effect my tonic will have on their aether, if any.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_SYSTEM_000_221: Todden stares blankly at you. It would seem the tonic has had no effect.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_PAWNIL_000_225: ...Hm? What is this...warmth I feel in my chest?
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_VOYNE_000_230: I...I feel...warm! And my legs, they...they don't feel as heavy...
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_SYSTEM_000_241: Todden stares blankly at you. It would seem the tonic has had no effect.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_PAWNIL_000_245: Strange... Is it me, or is it suddenly warmer? It feels rather nice.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_VOYNE_000_250: Well, fancy that... My hands don't feel quite so stiff. Thank you, .
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_000_270: Now then, have you noted any change in the patients?
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_ALPHINAUD_000_271: A notable rise in body temperature and increased motor function. In most of the patients, at least.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_ALISAIE_000_272: The more severely afflicted show no response.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_000_274: 'Tis true that with the restoration of night, the corrupting influence of Light will no longer grow. And yes, their bodies will naturally return to equilibrium given time...
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_000_275: But this holds true only for their corporeal aether. Their incorporeal aether─that of the soul─is not so easily mended.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_ALPHINAUD_000_276: Which is why those in the later stages of corruption─like Halric─appear unaffected by your tonic.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_000_278: The boy's soul is too far gone, his mind held together by the finest of threads.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_000_279: There is a chance he may one day recover, of course, but it could take years─decades, even.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_ALISAIE_000_280: By the gods, he could wake to find himself an old man.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_ALPHINAUD_000_281: A fine reward for his persistence... The opportunity to mourn the life he never had a chance to live.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_ALISAIE_000_282: No, there must be something we can do.
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_ALISAIE_000_283: Look, I realize this is not why we petitioned your aid, but do you think it possible we can find a way to hasten their recovery?
TEXT_LUCKMG103_03675_BEQLUGG_000_285: Nor do I think it impossible that in treating them, we might learn something of relevance to your own predicament...
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Corporeal and incorporeal aether... I confess I have never had cause to make the distinction.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_005: Did they just say what I think they said? Might there really be a way to help Halric and the others? And help ourselves in the process?
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_020: I suspect the Crystal Exarch has told you of my past. That I was once a mage of the royal court of Voeburt, and that soulcraft was my field of study.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_021: The tonic you administered to the patients here is one of the fruits of my labors. I hoped to do great things for the kingdom...
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_022: <sigh> But in the end, my knowledge brought only suffering. A plague the like of which none had ever seen.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_100_022: In the hands of unscrupulous men, what should have been my greatest triumph instead became my greatest shame...
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_A1_000_000: You mustn't dwell in the past.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_A2_000_000: And now you have a chance to redeem yourself.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_A3_000_000: At least the Warriors of Light brought those responsible to justice.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_025: I know that only too well. Alas, the knowledge we require is steeped in such bitter memories.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_030: That I do. A comforting thought indeed.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_035: Aye, that they did. I shudder to think what might have happened had they not.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_040: But let us return to the task at hand─finding a means by which we might revitalize these people's incorporeal aether.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALPHINAUD_000_041: Do you think it can be done?
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_042: Were the skies still ablaze with primordial Light, I would call it an exercise in futility. But now─now we may have a chance.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_043: The method I have in mind will entail the conjuring of a familiar. They are able to amplify the energies poured into them, making them the perfect conduit for the aether-revitalizing magicks we will ultimately employ.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_044: If you're about to launch into a lengthy explanation of the metaphysics of your plan─don't bother. I'd rather get on with doing whatever it is that needs to be done, if it's all the same to you.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_045: Whatever reagents must be procured, or spells invoked─I'll do it.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_047: Very well. Your first task will be to gather the necessary materials.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_048: The purest of waters and finest of clays, as well as a fae lantern brimming with pixie magick.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_049: If you're convinced the resulting familiar could help the patients─fine.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_050: Alphinaud─the water and clay will be simple enough, but I think you know what we'll have to do to get the lantern.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_052: The pixies took quite a liking to us before. If we humor them with our company, I'm sure they'll be willing to help us.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALPHINAUD_000_054: ...Fine. We'll pay a visit to Il Mheg. Though I never thought you would be the one to suggest going back there.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_055: I'm impressed you've been there at all, let alone befriended the fae folk.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_056: Oh, while you're about it, seek out the Nu Mou of Pla Enni. They will be able to supply you with water suitable for our needs.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_057: Right. Let's get this over with, shall we.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_058: There still remains the matter of the clay. Might I prevail upon you to find it?
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_070: Clay from Amh Araeng would likely be best. Know you of anyone who might be able to assist us?
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_A1_000_100: I could ask the miners at Twine.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_A2_000_100: Well, there are the scavengers at Mord Souq.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_075: Ah, yes! They will be able to point you in the right direction, I am sure.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_080: Scavengers, you say? Well...they may know the lie of the land, but I daresay they are more interested in the trinkets and baubles hiding in the earth than the earth itself. Now, miners on the other hand...
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_081: What's that? You know the miners of Twine? Perfect! Speak with them and you should have no trouble procuring what we need.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_085: While you and the twins are occupied, I will see if there is aught else I can learn of the stagnation which afflicts the people here.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_100: I have no doubt that the miners of Twine can help you find what we need. While you are away, I will do what I can to learn more about the nature of the patients' affliction.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_JERYK_000_105: I can't stop thinking about that giant Talos we built. Can you imagine what it could do with a matching trolley? It feels like a waste not to build one.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_THAFFE_000_110: <sigh> Sometimes I wish we'd never got that trolley running again. Now Jeryk wants more of the bloody things, and refuses to shut up about it.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_THAFFE_100_120: You've come at a good time. We've just this moment finished repairing the Talos and trolley you lot took to Nabaath Areng.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_MAGNUS_101_120: The trolley was no trouble, but the Talos would have been another matter, had we not had a visit from Master Chai.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_MAGNUS_102_120: He offered us a share of the leftover building materials from Daedalus Stoneworks, as well as a few trade secrets to help us along.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_JERYK_000_121: Clever man, that Chai-Nuzz. He seemed pretty keen on the ideas I had for putting the giant Talos to work.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_JERYK_101_121: Like a giant trolley! But Magnus still refuses to see all the good we could do with it...
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_THAFFE_000_122: You're entitled to your dreams, Jeryk, but that doesn't mean you can go harassing our guests with them. Master Chai was just being polite.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_MAGNUS_100_122: And something tells me  here didn't come all this way to talk about trolleys. What is it you need, friend?
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_MAGNUS_000_123: I see. And this...familiar requires clay from Amh Araeng.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_JERYK_000_124: Well, look no further. If anyone can find you some quality clay, it's us.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_THAFFE_000_125: Saying that, it isn't exactly a commodity nowadays... But there must be some lurking somewhere or other, waiting to be dug up.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_MAGNUS_000_126: If I'm not mistaken, there was a time when they used to take clay from Mount Biran Mines to make adobe bricks.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_MAGNUS_000_127: Place is swarming with coyotes now, but if you're after the good stuff, you could do worse than to look there.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_JERYK_000_140: I still say a trolley for that Talos is a good idea. You agree, don't you?
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_THAFFE_000_145: You'll want to be on your guard at the mines. Spend too long peering at the ground, and a coyote is sure to come and bite you on the arse.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_MAGNUS_000_150: Stay safe out there. And remember: you don't need an excuse to come and visit us.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALPHINAUD_000_160:
The pixies were constantly confusing me with Alisaie. In jest, I assume. I mean, it's not as if we look that much alike!
We, uh...don't look that much alike, do we?
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_165: That had better be the only thing we need from the pixies. If I have to endure one more prank, so help me gods...
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_200: The twins have returned, and in one piece at that. I was convinced the pixies would turn at least one of them into a garden ornament...but no.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_100_200: ...You have the clay, I take it?
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_201: Wonderful. We need but combine the clay and the water, then heat the mixture with the fae lantern. After that, it will be a simple matter of settling upon a suitable form, and performing the necessary incantation.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_202: Beq Lugg. I have a question. In the event that we had need of this spell and you weren't around, would it be possible for another to perform the incantation?
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_203: Assuming they possessed the requisite skill, yes.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_204: Halric and the others have suffered so much, and I swore to do everything in my power to save them. If there is a chance this spell could do that, I would be the one to invoke it.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_205: ...Hmmm. Mayhap you should be the one to do so.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_206: A deep understanding of the subjects' physical state, combined with a strong desire to help them, can drastically increase the magick's effect. And you are plainly more familiar with these people than I.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALPHINAUD_000_207: I daresay there are few in all of Norvrandt more dedicated to finding a cure. Is that not so, ?
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_A1_000_200: Absolutely. She's the best woman for the job.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_A2_000_200: Very few. But if aught should go awry...I'll see what I can do.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_210: I'll give it my all. For Halric. For Tesleen...
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_215: Is that a challenge? Well, I'll be damned if I let it come to that.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_220: Then we are all of a mind on the matter. Alisaie shall be the one to conjure the familiar.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALPHINAUD_000_280: By the Twelve! Though it was only for a moment, he spoke! There may yet be hope for these people!
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_285: The girl's resolve is quite impressive. One might almost think she drew strength from another...
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_300: How is he, Beq Lugg? Did it work?
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_301: I believe it did. You and your fledgling familiar have done well.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_302: If my eyes do not deceive, a hint of color has returned to his soul.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_303: Gods... I would jump for joy if I weren't so exhausted.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_305: As you are even now in the process of discovering, this magick asks much of the invoker. What you may not have realized is that the same is also true of the subject. As such, we must proceed with caution. However, with further treatment, I have the utmost confidence the boy will make a full recovery.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_306: Observing the reanimation of his stagnant soul has been most enlightening. I will need time to put my theories to the proof, but I believe I can fashion a spell to produce the opposite effect. That is, to induce stagnation.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALPHINAUD_000_307: Thus enabling our safe transport back to the Source via auracite!
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_308: A thought occurred to me─about this treatment.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_309: Beq Lugg said when the soul is rendered dormant, the mind is separated from the body. That a person becomes incapable of interacting with the world around them.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_310: Does that not sound a lot like some of the tempered back in the Source?
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALPHINAUD_000_311: Not really. It is the fate of most tempered to become slaves to primals─save in a handful of cases. Or am I missing something?
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_312: If I can master this technique─the art of revitalizing the soul─I know of at least one in the Source who could desperately use such treatment.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_A3_000_300: Do you really think it could work?
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_315: Ga Bu. His condition is eerily similar to Halric and the others', the only difference being that his soul was suffused with earth-aspected aether from summoning Titan, rather than Light. It follows that if his soul is subject to a similar kind of stagnation, there may be a chance we can save him...right?
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_320: Exactly! His condition is uncannily similar to Halric's, is it not? The only difference being that his soul was suffused with earth-aspected aether instead of Light. It follows that if his soul is subject to a similar kind of stagnation, there may be a chance we can save him...right?
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_325: Why shouldn't it? Ga Bu's condition is virtually identical to Halric's, is it not? The only difference being that his soul was suffused with earth-aspected aether instead of Light. It follows that if his soul is subject to a similar kind of stagnation, there may be a chance we can save him.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_326: Forgive me, but who is this Ga Bu fellow of whom you speak?
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_330: ...I see. His condition does sound similar...yet there is much and more about the soul that remains unknown even to me. I say this not to discourage you, you understand, but to remind you that this is delicate work we do here. Work requiring patience.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_331: Of course. And as long as there is hope for the patients here, I will devote whatever time is needed to see this through.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_332: But I refuse to spend that time in idleness. If it's all the same to you, I'd like to stay here with Angelo and continue with their treatment.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALISAIE_000_333: The two of you should return to the Crystarium with Beq Lugg and see if you can't make some headway with their newly posited theories.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_334: I would tell you to rest first, but I see you're not to be convinced. Ah, the fire of youth.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALPHINAUD_000_335: Let us return to the Crystarium, then.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALPHINAUD_000_337: Kai-Shirr!? What are you doing all the way out here?
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_KAISHIRR_000_338: There's trouble back in Eulmore. Lady Chai's beside herself. Sighing, pacing, the whole lot. Near enough begged me to go and find you.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_ALPHINAUD_000_339: ...Sighing and pacing, you say? It must be urgent.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_BEQLUGG_000_340: I take it I will be returning to the Crystarium alone. Go on, then. It's not as if I have anything for you to do.
TEXT_LUCKMG104_03676_KAISHIRR_000_342: Sorry for bothering you and all that, but she says the future of Eulmore's at stake.
TEXT_LUCKMG105_03677_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Whatever could be so urgent for Lady Chai to summon us thus?
TEXT_LUCKMG105_03677_KAISHIRR_000_020: Lady Chai's up in the parlor. Best not keep her waiting, eh?
TEXT_LUCKMG105_03677_KAISHIRR_000_040: It was the folks over at the Crystarium that told me you'd be down at Journey's Head. And lucky for me, you still were. Running 'round after people's tiring work.
TEXT_LUCKMG105_03677_ALPHINAUD_000_060: Well, naught here seems out of the ordinary, though I do not see Lady Chai anywhere.
TEXT_LUCKMG105_03677_KAISHIRR_000_061: Probably pacing around outside again. Staring off into the distance and all that. Sighing.
TEXT_LUCKMG105_03677_ALPHINAUD_000_062: Strange. Let's see if we can find her, and discover the source of her distress.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_KAISHIRR_000_000: Y'know, Eulmore's nothing like I thought it'd be. But somehow, I can't picture going anywhere else.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_KAISHIRR_000_001: The Chais are part of it, I s'pose. They've been good to me. I only wish there was something more I could do to help them...
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_ALPHINAUD_000_020: It makes no sense for Master Chai to have left without a word. But even if he had, he would not have done so unobserved.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_ALPHINAUD_000_021: Someone here will have seen something. I am sure of it.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_ALPHINAUD_000_022: We should split up and inquire as to whether anyone saw him leave or, failing that, if they have any idea where he might have gone. I will meet you at the Glory Gate to compare notes later on.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_ALPHINAUD_000_040: It would seem Master Chai paid a visit to the Beehive before taking his leave of Eulmore. Unfortunately, the patrons I spoke with were too deep in their cups to remember aught else.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_KAISHIRR_000_045: ...You ever get the feeling you're being watched? Ahh, I'm probably just imagining things.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_SYSTEM_000_048: You find a shoebill gazing in Kai-Shirr's general direction. Silent. Vigilant. Plotting...?
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_MOWEN_000_060: Master Chai? Why yes, I spoke with him recently, though I recall he was in a rather dour mood. Concerned about Eulmore's neglect of industry, you see.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_MOWEN_000_061: With Lord Vauthry's apparently inexhaustible stores of meol, and no great need for money, it's little wonder our businesses were all but forgotten under his rule.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_MOWEN_000_062: But I assured Master Chai that the Boutique of Splendors will do all it can to contribute to the revival of trade here in Eulmore─which seemed to satisfy him. He took his leave soon after.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_SYSTEM_000_063: Your exchange with Mowen has taught you about “The stagnant state of business in Eulmore.”
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_CORNENNE_000_070: Looking for Master Chai, are you? Is something amiss? When last I saw him, he seemed ready to collapse from exhaustion. I insisted he rest and catch his breath, and we talked for a while─about his concerns over the city's defenses amongst other things.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_CORNENNE_000_071: He made more than a few valid points. Many of our men are still recovering after your confrontation with Lord Vauthry, and finding General Ran'jit in a heap in the middle of the plaza shook us all to the core.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_CORNENNE_100_071: The man commanded no small amount of loyalty, and some of our longest-serving soldiers seemed lost without him. Indeed, a number of them left.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_CORNENNE_000_072: N-Not that we blame you, of course. Without you and yours, we would still be blind to the error of our ways.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_CORNENNE_000_073: Anyway...funding permitting, I proposed replenishing our ranks with volunteers from the Derelicts and Gatetown.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_CORNENNE_000_074: We have a duty to protect not only Eulmore, you see, but the surrounding regions of Kholusia as well, and I for one would welcome any man or woman willing to take up arms for that cause. Indeed, I told him as much, and he seemed relieved to hear it. It was on that note that we parted ways. He headed outside, as I recall.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_SYSTEM_000_075: Your exchange with Cornenne has taught you about “The perilous state of Eulmore's defenses.”
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_HATHENBET_000_080: Aye, I recall a man fittin' that description. Asked to speak with the poor buggers lately come from Wright.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_HATHENBET_000_081: Said he wanted to know the state of things down in the Derelicts. And you can be sure we gave him an earful. Lack of food, medicine, clothin'─there was plenty to tell.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_HATHENBET_000_082: We hunt high and low for whatever we can scavenge, and it's barely enough to fill our bellies. But folk here don't just want to survive, they want to thrive!
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_HATHENBET_000_083: When he heard that, he started mumblin' to himself. Somethin' about findin' us work, I think.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_HATHENBET_000_084: Fair play to him, though─not content with havin' his ear chewed about the Derelicts, he asked about the other settlements an' all. After that, I can't really say. Looked like he was headed for Gatetown when I last saw him.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_SYSTEM_000_085: Your exchange with Hathenbet has taught you about “The poor living conditions of Kholusia's downtrodden.”
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_MOWEN_000_090: I know not what Master Chai is planning, but if he intends to bring business back to Eulmore, he has my wholehearted support.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_CORNENNE_000_095: Master Chai seemed genuinely concerned over our lack of numbers. Would that we had the money to hire more guards...
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_HATHENBET_000_100: What? I told you everythin' I know. If you're after that Chai bloke, you won't find him here.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_KAISHIRR_000_105: Any luck? I got nowhere myself, but it sounds like Alphinaud might have.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_ALPHINAUD_000_120: Ah, there you are. How did you fare? Have you learned anything which might offer a clue as to Master Chai's whereabouts?
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_ALPHINAUD_000_122: He apparently paid a visit to the Queen Bee as well.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_ALPHINAUD_000_123: They discussed the possibility of granting admission to customers from outside Eulmore, an idea to which the proprietor was surprisingly receptive.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_KAISHIRR_000_124: Sounds like he's got big plans for the place. Eulmore, I mean─not the Bee.
TEXT_LUCKMG106_03678_ALPHINAUD_000_125: Perhaps. But the question remains─where did he go after leaving the city?
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_KAISHIRR_000_000: It didn't take long for folks to start moaning after Vauthry left. Now everyone in Eulmore's got something to complain about. Wouldn't want to be in Master Chai's shoes, having to keep that lot happy...
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_000_020: All we know for certain is that Master Chai has shown great concern not only for Eulmore, but its surrounding settlements.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_000_021: It seems logical, then, that having consulted those within the city walls, he would wish to do the same to those without.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_000_022: , if you would go and make inquiries in Wright, I shall do likewise in Stilltide. Gatetown I leave to you, Kai-Shirr.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_KAISHIRR_000_023: Fair enough. Where should we meet when we've finished?
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_000_024: Well...Top Rung would seem to me to be his next most likely destination.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_000_025: Let us reconvene there. With any luck, one of us will have stumbled upon him by then, but if not, we will be well situated to continue our search.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_000_030: With Vauthry gone, I had hoped things would change for the better, but this place seems little different from before. Perhaps they need more time...
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_KAISHIRR_000_033: Don't worry, . I know Gatetown like the back of my hand. If Master Chai's here, I'll find him in no time.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_HASTELOT_000_040: ...No, the name doesn't ring any bells. But there was a rather dapper-looking Mystel gentleman here not long ago. He wanted to talk about relations between Wright and Eulmore─or rather the lack of them.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_HASTELOT_000_041: We lost a great many people to their promises of meol and the chance of a lavish life among the free.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_HASTELOT_000_042: And Vauthry thought to take even more from us, conscripting the few able-bodied men we had left to guard his paradise.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_HASTELOT_000_043: I needn't tell you what happened when the sin eaters came... Such things are hard to forgive.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_HASTELOT_000_044: But Vauthry's gone now, and we're curious to see what will become of Eulmore in his absence.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_HASTELOT_000_045: That's what I told your friend...Chai-Nuzz, was it? And I'm sure the others said the same. Not what he wanted to hear, I suppose, because he left soon after. And that was that.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_HASTELOT_000_060: I hope we didn't do anything to give him offense, but you can't blame us for being wary. Not after all that's happened. If Eulmore one day shows signs of real change, perhaps we'll lend him a friendlier ear.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_KAISHIRR_000_065: Turns out Master Chai was over in Gatetown too. He spoke to a few of the residents, apparently. They told me they'd never seen a posh bloke look so miserable.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_000_080: So he paid a visit to both Wright and Gatetown as well, did he?
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_100_080: I see. Kai-Shirr and I gleaned much the same.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_000_081: He seems determined to salvage what goodwill might yet remain among the settlements of Kholusia, the only likely place he has left to go being Amity.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_000_082: Come. If we are quick, we may yet catch up with him.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_119: ! Alphinaud! Kai-Shirr! Wh-What are you doing here!?
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_000_120: We might ask you the same, Master Chai. We have been looking all over for you.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_000_121: Lady Chai has been nigh inconsolable in your absence. She claims you disappeared without so much as a word, and bade us return you to her side.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_122: What in blazes are you talking about? I left a letter for her in our chambers.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_123: Though I suppose she could have overlooked it... And when she gets an idea into her head... <sigh> I can only apologize.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_000_124: No harm done, Master Chai. But since we are here, might I ask what compelled you to come all this way?
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_000_125: We were told you had been elected mayor, and from what we have gathered from the nearby villages, you have been inquiring about the people's grievances.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_100_125: Is it safe to assume you mean to take office?
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_102_125: Now, now, let's not jump to conclusions!
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_103_125: I did seek to learn about the problems faced by the people of Kholusia, that much is true. But I am by no means sure I am the man to solve them.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_126: Tackling our many challenges will require resources, and until I have secured them, it would not be right to assume the role of mayor.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_000_127: I see. And you believe said resources can be found here?
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_128: Indeed. The people's grievances are many, but in the course of my inquiries, I have already met with several individuals willing to lend their aid in addressing them.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_129: However, there remains one individual crucial to my plans. A man whose counsel might yet make a mayor of me.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_000_130: With respect, such forethought is, in itself, proof of your suitability.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_000_131: The city needs you, Master Chai. And I am certain this man of whom you speak─whoever he may be─will reach the same conclusion. For what little it is worth, we will vouch for you should he require convincing.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_A1_000_500: Whatever you need, you can count on us.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_A2_000_500: We believe in you, Master Chai!
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_133: I...I don't know what to say...
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_KAISHIRR_100_133: You don't need to say anything. You've got your actions to speak for you.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_KAISHIRR_101_133: For as long as I can remember, all I ever wanted was to make it into Eulmore. But that dream's gone now, burst like a bubble─or a boil, more like.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_KAISHIRR_102_133: Anyway, outside of repaying Master Alphinaud, I haven't had a clue what to do with myself. Spent most days in a daze. But you? You've been running up and down, trying to find a way to fix this mess for everyone.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_KAISHIRR_103_133: And I reckon you can do it. You got this lot up Mt. Gulg, didn't you? How hard could mayoring be? You're going to steer Eulmore to a better future, I know it.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_KAISHIRR_104_133: And I want to help. Properly help. Do something that makes a difference.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_KAISHIRR_105_133: I don't know what it is yet, but I'll work it out on the way. If you let me come with you, that is.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_100_134: You give me entirely too much credit, the lot of you...but I can't deny it gives me heart. Come, then. Let us press on together.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_102_134: But we mustn't get ahead of ourselves. Eulmore needs more than a man with good intentions. Which is why I am here─to find one with the experience needed to see the city thrive.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_103_134: Who is this man, exactly, and are you certain he's here in Amity?
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_135: Wrenden is his name, and yes, he is. Or was. I had scarcely begun to explain myself when he decided his time was better spent elsewhere.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_136: He served as chief advisor to Vauthry's father when he was in office.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_100_136: If Ran'jit was the mayor's right hand, one might say Wrenden was the left, and between them, they kept Eulmore on the road to prosperity.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_137: The city needs more than a mere man of business─which is why I must find him.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_000_138: But even if you do, what makes you think he will listen?
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_000_139: Before giving chase, might it not be wise to speak with those who know him, here in Amity? They may be able to shed some light on his reason for rejecting your overtures out of hand.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_140: Yes, I suppose that makes sense. Perhaps we should start with Tristol, then. As I recall, you made rather a favorable impression on him. I'm certain he would be willing to talk to us.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_KAISHIRR_000_150: I reckon Eulmore could learn a thing or two from Amity about standing on its own two feet. Then again, so could I.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_000_155: According to Master Chai, this Wrenden fellow occupied a position of considerable influence in the Eulmoran leadership. Which begs the question: why did he choose to leave?
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_160: I realize it was me who suggested speaking with Tristol, but who's to say he will be any more receptive than Wrenden? Why should any of them give me the time of day? ...Bah, that's no way to think. Ignore me.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_TRISTOL_000_180: Greetings, friend. And to you too, Master Chai. I presume you are here to ask after Wrenden? I couldn't help overhearing your earlier...exchange.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_181: Yes, well...with Vauthry gone, Eulmore wants for a leader. Should no one rise to the challenge, the city could very well collapse. I came here seeking Wrenden's counsel in the hope that we could build a better Eulmore together─and that is still my wish. But given how abominably you were mistreated there, I will quite understand if you choose not to help.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_TRISTOL_000_182: Worry not, Master Chai. I bear no grudge against you or the people of Eulmore, and I would not see you suffer for Vauthry's villainy.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_TRISTOL_000_183: As you no doubt gathered from your meeting earlier, Wrenden can be rather uncompromising. He has his principles, you see, and little patience for anyone he deems less committed to their own.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_TRISTOL_000_184: Your desire to right the wrongs of your past, of Eulmore's past, is quite admirable. But I fear the guilt you bear on the city's behalf works against you.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_TRISTOL_000_185: I can see it in your eyes, in the way you carry yourself. It goes without saying he sees it as well. You must let those feelings go, Master Chai. Be more assertive─commit to this course─and prove to him Eulmore has the resolve to change.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_TRISTOL_000_188: I believe he was heading towards Pit 8 when he left. If you plan to go and speak with him, I suggest you be firm and clear in your intentions.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_189: Very well. To Pit 8 we shall go. And I will not take no for an answer. Nay, not even a maybe!
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_TRISTOL_000_200: Despite our previous...artistic differences, I do believe Master Chai means what he says. But until he starts believing it, I fear it won't amount to an awful lot.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_KAISHIRR_000_300: Imagine it... A Eulmore that even a bloke like me could help to build...
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_000_305: People cannot be brought together on the strength of high ideals alone. This I know from painful experience. Wrenden was right to demand proof of Master Chai's commitment.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_WRENDEN_000_310: It remains to be seen if his words will translate into deeds, but I shall endeavor to keep an open mind.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_320: Ahem! Right, then. Is there a particular issue you would have me resolve?
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_WRENDEN_000_321: You seem to have conducted an assessment of the problems Eulmore now faces. I assume you will agree, therefore, that the matter of dwindling food stores is the most pressing.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_ALPHINAUD_000_322: Ah, yes... Meol being neither a desirable, nor less sustainable option, I assume alternative foodstuffs are now required to fill the void.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_WRENDEN_000_323: And a man who hungers is not like to contribute much to society...save violence, perhaps.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_WRENDEN_000_324: So tell me: how do you propose to solve this problem? Give me a satisfactory answer, and I will consider offering you my counsel.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_325: Hmmm... A combination of measures would seem to be in order. One to address the immediate issue of supply, and another, that of production.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_327: For the present, Eulmore's coffers can be used to purchase food from our neighbors. This would afford us time to address the underlying problem that affects us all─the long-standing neglect of agriculture.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_328: The villages that once served as sources of trade for foodstuffs must be repopulated, their means of production restored.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_330: This assumes, of course, that we can rekindle relations with our neighbors, guarantee security and stability in the region, and most importantly, find people willing to leave the city and take up the rebuilding effort.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_WRENDEN_000_331: My, my... Think of that all by yourself, did you?
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_332: Well...yes. It began as a rather abstract plan I drafted some time ago, after speaking with the peoples of Eulmore and the nearby settlements.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_334: Uh─ I have? Well, that is a relief!
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_WRENDEN_000_335: Oh, you haven't secured my support just yet. Only my attention. Grand plans will not be enough to persuade the masses. If you would ask them to rebuild, you must provide them the means to do so.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_336: A fair point, Wrenden. And one to which I have given much thought. I propose the use of Talos to aid in the establishment and maintenance of these settlements. Their employment should drastically improve efficiency, and ultimately increase production.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_WRENDEN_000_337: Talos? But Daedalus Stoneworks closed their doors years ago. Without a ready supply of the necessary equipment, the people would starve before your plans could be put into effect.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_338: Well, as the heir to Daedalus Stoneworks, it just so happens that Talos are my field of expertise.
TEXT_LUCKMG107_03679_CHAINUZZ_000_339: And with a little help, I'm quite certain we can acquire what we need in no time at all.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_KAISHIRR_000_000: That Wrenden geezer doesn't seem so bad. What was Master Chai worried about? He's got to give himself a bit more credit!
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_ALPHINAUD_000_005: Do you see it? There is a fire in Master Chai's eyes that was not there when first we met. A fire we had best keep kindled if we wish to see Eulmore change for the better.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_WRENDEN_000_010: You had a hand in constructing that giant Talos to the north, did you not?
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_WRENDEN_000_011: When the Eulmoran volunteers began arriving, I hid myself away, lest I be recognized...thus depriving myself of what I am reliably informed was a once-in-a-lifetime spectacle. Bugger.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_020: Wrenden is quite right. Building Talos from scratch would require time we simply do not have.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_021: Which is why I propose to make use of the long-abandoned Talos which wander the wilds of Kholusia.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_022: They will need to be deactivated, of course, and if memory serves, the tools required to do so should still be at Top Rung. Come with me.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_KAISHIRR_000_040: How'd you catch a Talos, then? Dig a hole and lure it in?
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_ALPHINAUD_000_045: It is one thing to repair an immobile Talos, as Urianger did, but quite another to catch one, surely? Does this not sound a trifle dangerous?
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_WRENDEN_000_050: So he is an authority on Talos, is he? Hmph! What other surprises could he be hiding, I wonder...
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_070: Aha! The old memory hasn't let me down!
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_071: This chest contains canisters filled with a dashedly potent insulating powder capable of halting the flow of aether in a Talos. We need only get within throwing distance of one and let fly.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_ALPHINAUD_000_072: ...Thus disabling them without damaging them! Ingenious!
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_073: An old trick of the trade, nothing more. Once disabled, it should be a simple enough matter to get them to march to Eulmore. More extensive repairs can wait.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_074: Ordinarily, this is where I would ask you to run along and do the deed, but as I have said before, it's high time we learned to stand on our own two feet.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_075: Thankfully, throwing canisters is something even I should be able to manage.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_KAISHIRR_000_077: Even if the Talos ain't a threat, there's a hundred and one other things out there waiting to make a meal of you!
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_078: That's as may be, Kai-Shirr, but Wrenden tasked me with solving this problem, and I will not sit idly by while others risk everything to see my harebrained schemes realized. Not this time!
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_079: ...Which isn't to say the mere thought of it doesn't fill me with dread. Truth be told, I can't feel my legs.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_080: But if I'm to prove I'm a man worth following, I must lead by example.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_A2_000_000: All right, but if there's any trouble, we call it off.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_085: Yes, well, it should go without saying that I have no intention of dying for this. I've always preferred living to see the fruits of my labors.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_086: And to make sure I do, I will require your help. It is as Kai-Shirr says─these lands are dangerous if one is not careful. I would ask you to use my spyglass to look out for any beasts that could get in the way of my work. I will also need you to alert me when it is safe to subdue the Talos. Understood?
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_088: Good. Then let's be off to the Quick Way, through the north gate, and see if we can't find a suitable vantage point for you.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_KAISHIRR_000_100: Either Master Chai's off his nut, or this means more to him than he's been letting on.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_ALPHINAUD_000_105: There is little point in us both shouting instructions. Keep him safe, .
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_WRENDEN_000_110: When first he arrived, I could barely hear him over the knocking of his knees. And now this. I'm not sure what's gotten into him, but whatever it is, I like it.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_115: All right. Nothing to worry about. Just a simple matter of sneaking up on the Talos while avoiding the slavering, bloodthirsty beasts lurking behind every rock. Child's play... Ahem. When you're ready, let us begin.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_SYSTEM_000_130: Keep a lookout for danger and alert Chai-Nuzz when it is safe to incapacitate the Talos. You may move the spyglass, as well as zoom in and out. Point the spyglass at Chai-Nuzz and give him the signal to sneak near the Talos with .
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_300: I...I did it? I did it! Let's move on to another Talos, shall we?
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_320: I do believe I'm getting the hang of this.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_340: You may leave the next one to me, .
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_341: Haha! That should do it! Now we have all we need to proceed.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_KAISHIRR_000_150: Blimey... Thought my heart was going to stop for a moment there. Make that a couple of moments.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_ALPHINAUD_000_155: Our friend returned with nary a scratch. Well done.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_WRENDEN_000_160: It would seem I misjudged Master Chai. There may yet be hope for Eulmore.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_180: I can scarcely believe it. It was a reckless, foolish plan. But somehow...it worked.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_WRENDEN_000_182: Master Chai. I believe I owe you an apology.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_WRENDEN_000_183: Your plan to replenish Eulmore's food stores showed forethought and sound judgment. What's more, it is plain your time at Daedalus Stoneworks has equipped you to lead, as evidenced by the extraordinary company you keep.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_WRENDEN_000_184: You, sir, are more than qualified to be the next mayor of Eulmore.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_185: I thank you for your vote of confidence, but the fact remains, I am wholly ignorant of the world of politics.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_186: Which is why I would ask you to join me, and grant Eulmore the benefit of your counsel.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_WRENDEN_000_188: When the people behold these Talos, I have no doubt they will lend you their support.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_ALPHINAUD_000_189: It would seem Eulmore's leadership is at last in capable hands, would you not agree?
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_KAISHIRR_000_190: We should probably be getting back soon, Master Chai. After you've tinkered with the Talos and all that. Lady Chai's worried sick.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_KAISHIRR_000_220: Sorry I wasn't much help. Still, seeing Master Chai go after those Talos was something, eh? Inspiring stuff.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_ALPHINAUD_000_225: I daresay the future of Eulmore has never looked brighter.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_CHAINUZZ_000_230: <cough> <cough> I...I'm fine... I just need...a moment... <wheeze>
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_DULIACHAI_000_235: Thank you again for finding my husband. I confess, I was not expecting your return to be quite so grand!
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_DULIACHAI_000_236: That dear, sweet man. He is going to make the most wonderful mayor. I just know it!
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_WRENDEN_000_250: That was quite a reception. One Master Chai will struggle to forget.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_WRENDEN_000_251: More seriously, the arrival of the Talos has seized the public's attention.
TEXT_LUCKMG108_03680_WRENDEN_000_252: Once word has spread around Eulmore, it will be that much simpler to gather one and all so that Master Chai can make his inaugural address.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_KAISHIRR_000_000: Sorry I wasn't much help. Still, seeing Master Chai go after those Talos was something, eh? Inspiring stuff.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_ALPHINAUD_000_005: I daresay the future of Eulmore has never looked brighter.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_DULIACHAI_000_010: Thank you again for finding my husband. I confess, I was not expecting your return to be quite so grand!
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_DULIACHAI_000_011: That dear, sweet man. He is going to make the most wonderful mayor. I just know it!
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_WRENDEN_000_015: There is no time to lose. We must begin making preparations for the inaugural address. Once Master Chai has caught his breath, of course.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_CHAINUZZ_000_030: No need to fret, . I have never felt better. <cough>
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_CHAINUZZ_000_031: And not at all overawed by the prospect of addressing the assembled masses of Eulmore...
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_CHAINUZZ_000_032: As for where to do it... If we're to accommodate everyone who might feasibly wish to attend, I suppose the only place large enough would be the Emergent.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_WRENDEN_000_033: Then I will go and spread the word among the citizens─both free and bonded─that they are to assemble there to meet their new mayor.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_WRENDEN_000_034: You there, uh...Kai-Shirr, was it? Would you go and inform the residents of Gatetown and the Derelicts?
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_CHAINUZZ_000_035: Good lad. I will let the guards know not to bar the way to Vauthry's chambers.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_CHAINUZZ_000_036: ...It goes without saying that I expect the Warrior of Darkness to attend─assuming 's available? Might as well see it through to the bitter end, eh? The doorman at the Crown Lift will show you up.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_KAISHIRR_000_050: Don't worry, I'll make sure everyone's there for Master Chai's big speech. So get yourself down to the Emergent! Go on!
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_CHADDEN_000_070: Ah, yes. Master Chai told us to expect you. The Emergent is already filling up with people of all persuasions─free and bonded, citizens and non-citizens.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_CHADDEN_000_071: But for you, our guest of honor, we have reserved a place at the front. Right this way, .
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_KAISHIRR_000_090: Seeing everyone come together like that... <sniff> It was beautiful, that was.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_WRENDEN_000_095: Now our work can begin in earnest. I very much look forward to seeing this Eulmore for the people.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_DULIACHAI_000_100: Wasn't he simply wonderful? Seeing him take charge of the room as he did! Oh, it reminds me why I fell for him in the first place...
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_CHAINUZZ_000_105: The city of final pleasures, they used to call this place, back when the world was ending. But now...now I hope it will become the city of new endeavors.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_ALPHINAUD_000_120: That was a fine speech, Master Chai. I believe your words stirred every soul in attendance.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_CHAINUZZ_000_121: Stirred them to action, I hope. If I have learned anything from all of this, it is that change begins with the individual.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_CHAINUZZ_000_122: 'Tis but a matter of finding the strength to take the first step.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_WRENDEN_000_123: Assuming my fellow Eulmorans can, it shall be my honor and privilege to help them walk this road we have chosen.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_CHAINUZZ_000_124: But we must not forget the individuals who made all of these changes possible.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_CHAINUZZ_100_124: Were it within my power, I would carve a tribute to your heroism into the very stone upon which this city stands.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_DULIACHAI_000_127: I hate to change the subject, darling...but now that you have officially taken office, have you given any thought to your mayoral seat...?
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_CHAINUZZ_000_128: We will not be moving into the Emergent, dearest. It's too big, for one thing, and too far from the people for another. We will retain our current residence, and I will govern here in the Parlor.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_DULIACHAI_000_130: Oh, I was hoping you'd say that! I much prefer the view from the Parlor.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_HATHENBET_000_131: (-???-)Beggin' your pardon, Master Chai... But have you got time for a word?
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_CHAINUZZ_000_132: Ah, y-yes. Yes of course, er...Hathen...bet?
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_HATHENBET_000_133: Aye, that's me. I liked your speech. But there's folk outside these walls as don't even have enough food to last till tomorrow, and more who're countin' their crumbs. If ye've a plan to change that, I want to help set things in motion.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_CHAINUZZ_000_135: No sooner do I take office than my work begins in earnest. Well, I suppose I brought it upon myself. Thank you again for your help, . I hope to see you again before long.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_KAISHIRR_000_137: What a day... I dunno what it means exactly, but I do know I've got plenty to think about.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_ALPHINAUD_000_138: I sense we all have a great deal to consider.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_ALPHINAUD_000_139: I had resolved to remain here until such time as Eulmore's future was secured, but it is clear to me now that the city is in capable hands.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_ALPHINAUD_000_140: I have every confidence they will find their way, and I believe it is time we went on ours.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_ALPHINAUD_000_160: With Master Chai at the helm, if only for the interim, I feel I can bid farewell to Eulmore, and return to the Source with no regrets.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_KAISHIRR_000_180: So Alphinaud's leaving too, is he? Seems like everyone's moving on. Everything's changing...
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_KAISHIRR_000_181: I've been thinking about what I should do in all this. Like I told you, I spent most of my life dreaming about living here with my friends. In paradise.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_KAISHIRR_000_182: That paradise is gone, but something better's taken its place. And I reckon I want to be a part of it.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_KAISHIRR_100_182: This “Eulmore for the people” Master Chai's been going on about ain't gonna build itself, after all. Not that I'm much of a builder.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_KAISHIRR_000_183: Me and my friends'll find a way to make a difference, though─help keep things changing for the better.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_ALPHINAUD_000_185: A far nobler dream than the one to which you clung before─and one I am happy to say we share. Whatever path you choose, I will pray for your success.
TEXT_LUCKMG109_03681_KAISHIRR_000_186: Well, when you put it like that, there's no going back now, is there? We've got a few ideas on how we can do our bit. Just a matter of taking the first step!
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Truly, to see Kai-Shirr thus inspired by our actions is inspiring in itself.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Yet however much I may wish to stay and see what comes of his efforts here in Eulmore, we have matters of our own to attend to. Come, we should return to the Crystal Tower. Mayhap Beq Lugg's studies have borne fruit in our absence.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ALPHINAUD_000_010: 'Twould seem Alisaie has yet to return from the Inn at Journey's Head. I do hope she doesn't overtire herself...
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_YSHTOLA_000_015: In the course of preparing more auracite, we made a significant discovery. We thought it best to wait for your return before sharing our findings.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_URIANGER_000_020: My congratulations, . Glad tidings from Eulmore did precede thy coming. I will see that Thancred and Ryne hear of these momentous events, that they too might take joy in that which thou hast helped to bring about.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_BEQLUGG_000_025: I take it you are ready to resume our work?
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_MYSTERYVOICE_000_04: Welcome back. We are given to understand a new mayor has taken office in Eulmore.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ALPHINAUD_000_041: Indeed. Our good friend Master Chai was elected by popular vote, and─after some considerable soul-searching─chose to accept the post.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ALPHINAUD_000_042: It is a shame you weren't able to attend his inaugural speech. Though I have no doubt you will see more of him in the future.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ALPHINAUD_100_042: But tell me, how fared you in preparing the white auracite?
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_YSHTOLA_101_042: Our work...did not proceed quite as expected.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_YSHTOLA_102_042: In your absence, we had a frank discussion on the principles of soul transference, and concluded at length that white auracite was ill-suited for our purposes.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ALPHINAUD_103_042: But Urianger─did you not say that, compared to the massy soul of an Ascian, the stone could house one of ours with ease?
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_URIANGER_104_042: That I did. And armed as we are with Beq Lugg's invaluable insight, 'twould indeed prove a trifling matter─were we to disregard the inviolable link 'twixt mind and soul...
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_URIANGER_105_042: ...A link which would─we did belatedly realize─be weakened most perilously in the process of rendering our souls dormant, as auracite doth require. Thus, the shedding of these fleshly simulacra, and the surfeit of aether which compriseth them, would in all likelihood deprive us of our psyches as well.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_BEQLUGG_102_047: It would, theoretically, be possible to channel your minds into the auracite instead, but we would more than likely sacrifice your souls in the process.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_BEQLUGG_103_047: Which is why we have abandoned that plan, and instead devoted our time to finding a means by which mind and soul might be transported together.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ALPHINAUD_113_047: Then we are no closer to a solution than when we first began...
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_BEQLUGG_104_047: It is a vexing conundrum indeed. But one for which the Crystal Exarch has posited a most intriguing solution.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_MYSTERYVOICE_105_04: When our discussions turned to the transference of memories and the psyche, I could not help but be reminded of a technique with which I have personal experience.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_MYSTERYVOICE_000_05: , do you recall what we learned of my eyes from our encounter with Doga and Unei?
I speak of the Royal Eye of the Allagan imperial line, gifted to my forebears through the blood and memories of the ancient Allagans. It is by this gift that I am able to control the Crystal Tower.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_MYSTERYVOICE_000_06: To explain─in the latter days of the Allagan Empire, the last of their kind devised a means to pass on their blood and memories to my forebears. It is through these gifts that I am able to control the Crystal Tower.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_BEQLUGG_000_065: If we were to gain an understanding of the technology by which the Allagans were able to accomplish this transference, perhaps then we could keep mind and soul together.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_URIANGER_000_066: Imagine, if you will, a device like unto a soul crystal, replete not only with our worldly memories, but also the bountiful energies of the soul.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_MYSTERYVOICE_000_06: That is our current avenue of investigation. And we will follow it wheresoever it leads.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_YSHTOLA_000_072: While we are thus engaged, I think it best that  return to the Source and inform Krile and the others of our findings.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ALPHINAUD_000_073: Agreed. I imagine Tataru will be relieved to hear we've made progress of a sort.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_URIANGER_000_074: Then I would beg leave to relay our findings unto Thancred and Ryne, and to assist where I may in their investigation of the Empty.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_MYSTERYVOICE_000_07: Yes, please do. Should we have need of your counsel we will not hesitate to summon you.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ALPHINAUD_000_076: Give our regards to Tataru, won't you?
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ALPHINAUD_000_090: With the benefit of our combined knowledge, and the aid of the First's leading authority on soulcraft, we must surely be able to find a solution. Surely...
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_YSHTOLA_000_095: Beq Lugg insists we resume our work forthwith, but I grow weary at the thought... <sigh> What I would not give for a cup of tea, and perhaps a vanilla tart.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_BEQLUGG_000_100: I pray the link to their bodies in your world will endure awhile longer. Should it fail, our efforts will be for naught.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_MYSTERYVOICE_000_10: Mark my words, ─we will unlock the secrets of the Allagan Eye, and see the others returned home.
There was a time when I thought these eyes a curse, you know... But for what they have enabled me to do, and what they may yet make possible, I see now they are a blessing.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_TATARU_000_121: How did everything go in the First? Wait─don't tell me. Krile will be here shortly, and she'll want to hear too. She's just tending to the others. Their bodies, I mean. Gods, I don't think I'll ever get used to saying that... Anyway, you can tell us everything the moment she gets here!
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_SYSTEM_100_122: Upon speaking with Tataru, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_SYSTEM_100_123: It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_SYSTEM_100_124: You must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 80 or above to proceed.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ESTINIEN_000_500: I've seen him in action. His body at least. You will not best him alone.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_SHADOWHUNTER_000_50: Nay...death will not come easily to that thing. If you would join me, then by all means...
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ESTINIEN_000_502: For what good it will do...
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ZENOS_000_503: The Black Wolf...and the Azure Dragoon. I suppose this might suffice.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ZENOS_000_505: Ah, the simple pleasure of one's own flesh. Truly, there is no place like home.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ESTINIEN_000_507: Whatever he is,  was barely a match for him. If we stay here much longer─
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ANNIAQUOSORANUS_000: (-???-)Emperor Varis! Your Radiance, are you all right!?
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ZENOS_000_512: <sigh> Must even the most middling of sport be spoiled? The world conspires to bore me.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ZENOS_000_513: But I have no cause to remain. I leave these vermin to you.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ANNIAQUOSORANUS_101: What are you waiting for? Open fire!
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_JULIAQUOSORANUS_104:
The intruders have taken flight. I repeat, the intruders have taken flight.
Deploy all available magitek armor. We cannot let them escape!
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ESTINIEN_000_551: And you would bar my way, would you? ...So be it.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ESTINIEN_000_552: Come, Nidhogg! Lend me your strength!
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ESTINIEN_000_580:
Garleans and their machina...
Now...where are you, Gaius?
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_KRILE_000_600: Though they have yet to find a workable solution, Y'shtola and the others are making progress, and we cannot ask for more than that.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_TATARU_000_605: You must be shattered after all that hopping back and forth between worlds. Why not stay here and rest for a while? I'm sure Beq Lugg can manage without you. They've got enough Scions to help them, if you ask me!
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_THIRDLEGIONCENTURIO: Traitors! You would dare deny Lord Nerva the throne!?
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_FIRSTLEGIONCENTURIO: Onward! Before this day is done, victory shall be ours!
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_MYSTERIOUSCOOPERATO: (-???-)Do you think? I find it amusing. Like dogs herding cattle to the slaughterhouse.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_ZENOS_000_706: That hue. Your soul is... Who are you?
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_MYSTERIOUSCOOPERATO: Before your majesty, I am but another dog. Lost, in want of a new master. A hunting dog if you should wish it so.
For I know full well the prey you would seek next.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_SYSTEM_000_750: Meanwhile, in Eulmore in the First...
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_DIRTYMAN_000_751: Did you hear? The mayor's reopening Daedalus Stoneworks, and they're looking for laborers!
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_SHABBYWOMAN_000_752: There's talk of resettling some of the old, abandoned villages too. They're even laying on free Talos to help anyone willing to make the move.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_DIRTYMAN_000_753: Free Talos? Hah! We'd best get packing.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_SHABBYWOMAN_000_754: Steady work, board and lodging... If that's not a recipe for hope, I don't know what is.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_PALEFACEMAN_100_755: (-Wayward Warrior-)Yes. So long as I yet live, I would see that feeble flame rekindled.
TEXT_LUCKMG110_03682_PALEFACEMAN_000_756: (-Wayward Warrior-)It is my destiny. To see our dream fulfilled.
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_KRILE_000_001: If you've come to inquire after the Archons, fear not. Master Matoya's treatment has proven effective in stabilizing their corporeal aether.
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_KRILE_000_002: We mustn't grow complacent, however. Potent though these magicks may be, they are not without limits.
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_KRILE_000_003: We can only hope they afford us enough time for the Crystal Exarch to complete his work.
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_TATARU_000_005: If only we could go with you to the First and help...
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_MAXIMA_000_006: (-???-)Pardon the interruption, but I come bearing urgent news.
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_MAXIMA_000_007: Ah, . It has been far too long, my friend.
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_MAXIMA_000_008: Forgive me, I don't believe we have been formally introduced.
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_MAXIMA_000_009: Maxima, former Garlean ambassador. I remain here in Eorzea under the auspices of Commander Aldynn, offering what counsel I can in the hopes of resolving the present conflict with the Empire.
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_KRILE_000_010: Ah, yes. I have heard stories of a defector from Garlemald. But never mind that─you said you have urgent news?
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_MAXIMA_000_011: Indeed. As you may have heard, the imperial capital is in turmoil, and a sizable portion of the Garlean forces have been recalled from the Ghimlyt Dark.
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_MAXIMA_000_012: With their numbers so greatly diminished, the main host of the Alliance has withdrawn, leaving the Ala Mhigan Resistance to keep watch over the border.
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_MAXIMA_000_013: And it is there we have welcomed a most unexpected visitor who claims that this de-escalation may belie growing dangers and unforeseen threats.
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_MAXIMA_000_014: Commander Aldynn has arranged for an impromptu meeting to discuss these revelations. He has also requested a representative of the Scions attend as well, though it was clear to whom he wished I extend this invitation.
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_KRILE_000_015: It would seem time is of the essence.
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_KRILE_000_016: Well, you'll not be attending this meeting alone. Though I am not as well versed in the affairs of city-states as our comrades, I see no reason to burden a single Scion with all this.
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_MAXIMA_000_019: Yes, of course. Then we must make for the Ala Mhigan Quarter with all haste.
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_TATARU_000_020: Well? What are you waiting for? Get going, you two!
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_TATARU_000_025: Don't worry about the others. I'll keep an eye on them while you and Krile are away.
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_KRILE_000_026: Much has changed since the first time we set foot in this city. Now we strive to preserve their freedom rather than reclaim it. But we've no time to reminisce─we mustn't keep the commander waiting.
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_MAXIMA_000_030: Commander Aldynn awaits us in the Royal Palace. If you would follow me.
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_RESISTANCEOFFICER_0: Commander Aldynn has instructed me to escort you to Alliance Headquarters for further briefing. When you are ready to depart, you need only ask.
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_KRILE_000_040: As ever, the way forward is paved with difficult decisions.
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_KRILE_000_041: We can ill afford to ignore the threat of a new Ultima Weapon. But with each passing day, the plight of the Scions grows ever more perilous.
TEXT_LUCKMH101_03761_KRILE_000_042: If you cannot stay for...a debriefing on the Ultima Weapon, I will not stop you. I only ask that you confer with me before returning to the First.
TEXT_LUCKMH102_03762_KRILE_000_000: I take it you're ready to return to the First?
TEXT_LUCKMH102_03762_KRILE_000_001: Then I would ask that you apprise the others of recent events here in the Source. Namely, Zenos's return and the development of a new Ultima Weapon. As for their bodies, you may assure them Master Matoya and I will continue doing what we can to keep their corporeal aether stable.
TEXT_LUCKMH102_03762_KRILE_000_002: Safe travels, . I hope to see you, and the other Scions, soon.
TEXT_LUCKMH102_03762_MYSTERYVOICE_000_01: You've come at a most opportune time, my friend. I've made something of a breakthrough in my research on the soul and a means to return the Scions home. I trust you too have been making good use of your time?
Ill tidings from the Source, you say?
Then I will summon the others that we might all be apprised of the situation.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_MYSTERYVOICE_000_00: It may simply be my imagination, but Lyna has been rather...brusque with me of late. You don't suppose she's still upset over that mishap with the salmon fillet, do you?
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_YSHTOLA_000_001: To think we will not only have Zenos to contend with once we return, but a new Ultima Weapon as well. <sigh> Why must all of our enemies insist on returning from their graves?
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_URIANGER_000_002: Upon white auracite's crystalline foundation we have built not a prison, but a refuge for the soul. Would that Moenbryda were here to see the wonders inspired by her research.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_BEQLUGG_000_003: Never have I seen such a repository of knowledge. A stark reminder what little we truly know of the world.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_ALPHINAUD_000_010: I must confess, while I enjoy my fair share of scholarly research, it will be good to step outside for a spot of fresh air.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Now, then─shall we go and speak with Lyna?
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_ALPHINAUD_000_015: I suggest we hurry. Lyna does not strike me as one who enjoys being made to wait.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_LYNA_000_020: We have little time, so I will be brief. A sin eater has been sighted in Lakeland, and I ask for your assistance in slaying it.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_ALPHINAUD_000_021: A sin eater? I had heard some few yet remained after the night had returned, but...perhaps we should call the others.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_LYNA_000_022: That will not be necessary. It is only a single sin eater. A simple task for our guard, I should think.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_LYNA_000_023: That said, I believe fighting alongside the Warrior of Darkness would be a valuable experience for them.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_LYNA_000_024: Peace can lead to complacency, and they gain nothing from an easy victory. But you do not underestimate your foes, however harmless they may seem. My men would do well to learn from your example.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_ALPHINAUD_000_026: You cannot be serious. Come now, ─what could be more inspiring than fighting alongside the renowned Warrior of Darkness ?
