TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_LYNA_000_027: Excellent. Then let us make for Fort Jobb.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_ALPHINAUD_000_029: The sin eaters that remain no longer have a leader to guide them, but they are no less dangerous. They cannot be suffered to live.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_LYNA_000_030: If you would wait here a moment, I will gather the others.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_LYNA_000_031: You may not remember, but you have met these soldiers once before, though only in passing.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_LYNA_000_032: Long have they awaited the opportunity to fight at your side.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_INJUREDB03607_000_0: I was at death's door that day after the sin eaters attacked. If you and yours hadn't come along, I'd have likely stepped through. And I wouldn't have been alone.
Your courage and selflessness is something we all aspire to.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_INJUREDC03607_000_0: I too was there that terrible day. My friend was transformed into a sin eater before my very eyes, and I had no choice but to cut her down. The thought of returning to the field, of holding a blade again─it filled me with dread.
But that is no way to honor her or my comrades. And so I have returned! I swear I will not let you or anyone else down from this day forward.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_CRYSTARIUMGARDPICKE: A pleasure to meet you, . Truly. It seems like only yesterday I watched as you took flight astride an amaro to go and save the Oracle.
Strange to think the Eulmoran soldiers we once locked blades with are now on our side, but we will do our utmost to keep the peace here in Lakeland.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_LYNA_000_039: We seem to be missing one─
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_SOLDIER03608_000_04: (-Honest Soldier-)My apologies, Captain Lyna. An elderly gentleman asked that I escort him to Clearmelt. It...took longer than I anticipated.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_LYNA_000_041: I'll not begrudge your desire to help those in need, but a soldier must be punctual. Especially when we play host to honored guests.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_SOLDIER03608_000_04: The name's Theyler. I'm sure you don't remember, but we met once before in the infirmary.
I asked you to deliver a message to the Exarch and the Warrior of Darkness. Little did I know I was already talking to .
Don't give up. Don't give in. I keep those words close to my heart. And the boundless, beautiful skies above serve as a reminder of their importance.
My friend got to see the night's return shortly before he passed. He left this world with a smile, satisfied with a glimpse of what was to come.
But there are countless others who weren't so fortunate.
They gave their lives for the promise of a future they'll never know. And so it falls to us to do everything we can to fulfill that promise.
No matter what happens, we won't give up. We won't give in!
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_LYNA_000_050: Your heroism has inspired all of our guardsmen in much the same manner.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_LYNA_000_051: Our scouts at the Northern Staging Point have not had the pleasure of meeting you in person.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_LYNA_000_052: Let us not keep them waiting.
TEXT_LUCKMH103_03763_BRAVESOLDIER_000_05: If I hadn't seen him with my own eyes, I'd have sworn it was you who killed that sin eater.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_ALPHINAUD_000_016: I've apprised the others of this purported Warrior of Light who slew the sin eater. I take it you've seen to Captain Lyna?
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_MYSTERYVOICE_000_01: Alphinaud tells me a Warrior of Light has slain the sin eater. Quite frankly, I'm not sure what to make of this.
Ah, yes. I was hoping to speak with you about, er... Hmm. On second thought, never mind. It would be rude of me to pry.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_YSHTOLA_000_012: An adventurer calling themself a Warrior of Light... Why would anyone tie themselves to the legacy of individuals held in such low regard in the First?
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_URIANGER_000_013: Warriors of Light. Harbingers of the Flood and all the world's woes. That this wanderer would so boldly claim their title is most curious indeed.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_BEQLUGG_000_015: 'Tis strange to think how heroes so beloved by the people could be brought so low in so short a time.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_LYNA_000_000: I will not keep you. You and your comrades have much to discuss.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_LYNA_000_001: I will see the others back to their posts.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_ALPHINAUD_000_020: The others were quite shocked to hear of what we found in Lakeland.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_ALPHINAUD_100_020: But now that you're here, there is a proposal I should like to make.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_ALPHINAUD_000_021: I have been spending a great deal of time in the Cabinet of Curiosity, and of late I have noted more and more people perusing books on history─the years leading up to the Flood, in particular.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_ALPHINAUD_000_022: I suspect they wish to know more about the Warriors of Light─as well they should─but nearly everything I've come across describes them as sin eaters or worse.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_ALPHINAUD_000_023: Regardless of whether or not this “Warrior of Light” is who they claim to be, I worry that their sudden appearance, in conjunction with this renewed interest in their predecessors, may lead to growing unrest and fear.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_ALPHINAUD_000_024: If the people of the Crystarium seek the truth, I say we give it to them.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_URIANGER_000_025: I too can attest to the falsehoods found within full many of the Cabinet's tomes, with nary a mention of the noble deeds of Ardbert and his comrades.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_YSHTOLA_000_026: To be fair, they bear some responsibility for the Flood. But when the tale is told again and again over the course of a century, I am not surprised to see their roles distorted and them painted as villains.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_MYSTERYVOICE_000_02: Were it not for the records stored within the Crystal Tower, I would have had no reason to question the narrative.
Unfortunately, that knowledge was of no use, for when I arrived here in the First, their reputation had already been irreparably tarnished.
That said, there still remained those who worked tirelessly to defend their good name in those early days following the Flood.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_BEQLUGG_000_030: Considering all the good they had done, I find it a wonder they needed defending at all.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_BEQLUGG_100_030: They brought to justice the man who misused my knowledge to bring about the fall of Voeburt. That such heroes could be spoken of in the same breath as sin eaters is absurd.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_MYSTERYVOICE_000_03: Under normal circumstances I would agree, but as time passed, those who knew firsthand of their deeds dwindled. In the end, only one truth remained─that they were the cause of the Flood.
With the world on the brink of oblivion, it was all too easy for the Warriors of Light to become villains deserving only of resentment and hate.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_YSHTOLA_000_034: At that point, the truth mattered little. It would not change their lot.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_MYSTERYVOICE_000_03: Thanks to all of you, however, their lot has changed, and now they may heed the long-forgotten truth.
You claimed it was Ardbert who helped you overcome Emet-Selch, correct? Such a revelation would do well to sway the hearts of those who know him only as a villain.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_MYSTERYVOICE_100_03: I have shared this with a select few, but one and all must be told of his sacrifice.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_MYSTERYVOICE_000_03: To that end I say we proceed with Alphinaud's plan. We call together the people of the Crystarium and recount to them the true tale of the Warriors of Light and the Flood that followed in their wake.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_A2_000_500: I wish we had done this sooner.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_ALPHINAUD_000_039: Then we're all of one mind on the matter. Good.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_ALPHINAUD_000_040: In hindsight, I agree. But better late than never, no?
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_ALPHINAUD_000_041: Exarch, might I ask you to continue working with Beq Lugg on our means of returning home? The rest of us will see to gathering the people of the Crystarium in the Exedra.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_ALPHINAUD_000_042: We have to reach out to anyone and everyone who might be willing to lend an ear. With any luck, word will spread and more will accompany them.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_MYSTERYVOICE_000_04: There can be no darkness without light, and so it was that Ardbert was there in your hour of need. The people must be told.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_BEQLUGG_000_046: I have seen many a great and terrible thing in my long life, as has the Exarch no doubt. Of man I can say this: his memory is short, his heart fickle. Let us pray that your words reach him.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_CHESSAMILE_000_050: ! My, what a wonderful surprise. Though I hope your being here doesn't mean someone's been hurt.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_CHESSAMILE_000_051: Thanks to you I've had far fewer patients coming through my door of late. Which is a shame, come to think of it─I've had fewer opportunities to test my new medicines.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_CHESSAMILE_000_052: Hee hee, I jest, of course! It's actually been quite pleasant to have a few moments to myself now and again.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_CHESSAMILE_000_053: The truth about the Warriors of Light? But the Exarch has already spoken with me about them. Well, if there's more to the tale, I'd very much like to hear it.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_BRAGI_000_054: Come to browse wares in the market, have you? Well I can guarantee you'll have no trouble finding what you need, whatever it may be. Under Eulmore's new leadership, trade has never been more prosperous.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_BRAGI_000_055: Word is that fellow from Daedalus Stoneworks has taken over as mayor. Did he really? Little wonder business is booming the way it is.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_BRAGI_000_056: I imagine it won't be long before all of Norvrandt reaps the benefits... But you've not come to talk about the market. Something on your mind?
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_BRAGI_000_057: I see. The Exarch did mention they had something to do with your returning the night to Norvrandt. All right, consider my interest piqued.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_GLYNARD_000_058: Well, well. To what do I owe the pleasure? Whatever it is, I must ask you be brief─with the night returned, visitors have been flocking to the Crystarium, and I find myself too busy by half.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_GLYNARD_000_059: I don't mind it, though. Seeing the Stairs so full of life and excitement, one can almost forget the Flood ever happened.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_GLYNARD_000_060: The Warriors of Light? Yes, the Exarch has mentioned them before, but everyone knows them now as the Cardinal Virtues. Or are you suggesting there's more to it than that?
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_GLYNARD_000_061: Well, you've yet to steer us wrong, so I'm willing to hear what you have to say.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_GLYNARD_000_062: The truth about the Warriors of Light? But you already told me all there is to know...didn't you?
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_GLYNARD_000_063: Well, if there's more to their story, I'd love to hear it. Maybe then I can compete with Cyella in regaling patrons with stories of their heroism. Perhaps I'll even inspire a few aspiring adventurers.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_KATLISS_000_064: Well, well, what a coincidence! I was just reading over a letter I received from Grenoldt not long ago.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_KATLISS_000_065: He says a visitor from the Crystarium found him at the bottom of the ocean, and that  inspired him to reach new artistic heights. Well, I can only think of one person capable of both feats─though I'd say the latter is far more impressive.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_KATLISS_000_066: To think fate could bring the two of you together in such a place...
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_KATLISS_000_067: I'm sorry? You mean the Exarch didn't tell us the whole story of the Warriors of Light? Well whatever he's left unsaid, I'm all ears.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_MOREN_000_068: No, this can't be... Surely there is at least one book here that does not cast the Warriors of Light and their deeds in such a negative light...
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_MOREN_000_069: Oh, ! Forgive me. The Cabinet of Curiosity has been bustling with visitors of late, but I fear our repository lacks for the knowledge they seek.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_MOREN_000_070: The people wish to know the truth of the Flood. Of the Warriors of Light.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_MOREN_000_071: I have searched high and low, but alas... Every account portrays them as no better than sin eaters─abominations worthy only of scorn and resentment.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_MOREN_100_076: I know they were not always judged so harshly, yet I can find no proof. And I dare call myself a librarian...
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_MOREN_100_077: You would address the people and tell them the truth of the Warriors of Light? Of the Flood?
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_MOREN_100_078: How wonderful! You have regaled me with the tale once before, but I should love to hear it again. Oh, and you may be assured I will not come alone.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_CHESSAMILE_000_080: I wouldn't miss this for anything. And I promise I'll bring others with me.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_BRAGI_000_081: We're to gather in the Exedra, is that right? If it's all the same to you, I'd like to bring a few others with me. People deserve to know about this.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_GLYNARD_000_082: Cyella has agreed to keep watch over the Stairs in my absence. I'll be along to the Exedra soon.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_KATLISS_000_083: I'm sure everyone would like to know what really happened all those years ago.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_MOREN_000_084: I will make for the Exedra as soon as I finish cataloging these manuscripts.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_YSHTOLA_000_085: Those I spoke with at the orchard and the Rookery were quite keen to hear what we have to say. For as much hope as they have for the future, the scars of the past weigh heavy on them still.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_URIANGER_000_086: 'Tis good to see the people of the Crystarium so eager to learn the truth.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_URIANGER_000_087: And with this newfound knowledge of the past, they will at last be able to look to the future with eyes unclouded.
TEXT_LUCKMH104_03764_ALPHINAUD_000_090: There you are. Between the four of us, I daresay we've swept the Crystarium from top to bottom. Now we need but wait for the people to gather.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_YSHTOLA_000_000: We were a hair's breadth from defeat when we faced Emet-Selch, and now we must contend with yet another Ascian. We must tread carefully.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_URIANGER_000_001: We must not act until Ardbert hath made plain his plans. 'Twould be folly to proclaim him false at this juncture.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_BEQLUGG_000_002: What a despicable practice, appropriating corpses. Such depravity eclipses any horrors I witnessed in the age of Voeburt. They must be stopped.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_MYSTERYVOICE_000_01: You did well to dispel the falsehoods surrounding the Warriors of Light and their actions prior to the Flood. Though I must say the reappearance of Ardbert─or rather, one who appropriated his identity─was a rather curious development.
He is an impostor, of that there is no doubt. But to the masses he will appear as a hero returned from the grave.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_BEQLUGG_000_012: After the Warriors of Light were laid to rest in Eulmore, the people prayed fervently for the gods to deliver them from their plight. Prayed that these fallen heroes be born again for their sacrifices. What bitter irony.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_YSHTOLA_000_013: I for one would like to know why Ardbert urged the people to become Warriors of Light themselves.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_URIANGER_000_014: Ere we take action, we must needs ascertain his intent.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_URIANGER_100_014: Let us pray that Master Alphinaud returneth soon with that most essential knowledge.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_URIANGER_000_015: For now, I think it best to apprise Thancred and Ryne of our efforts. When we do confront Ardbert, we shall no doubt have need of their strength.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_MYSTERYVOICE_000_01: Agreed. I think it prudent we all take measures to prepare for what's to come.
Beq Lugg and I will continue our research into how we might improve the spirit vessel, that it might one day carry you home.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_YSHTOLA_000_018: Hmmm... Then I think it time I return to the Greatwood.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_YSHTOLA_000_019: Until now, everything we have learned of the Ascians has been handed to us at their leisure.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_YSHTOLA_000_020: But that was one of Emet-Selch's unique failings. I have no reason to think Elidibus will be as forthcoming.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_YSHTOLA_000_021: Fortunately, I recently received word from Fanow that heretofore unexplored chambers have been discovered deep within the Qitana Ravel.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_YSHTOLA_000_022: Almet believes the relics within tell of a great calamity that befell an ancient civilization─that of the Ascians, perhaps. They may lead us to the truths we seek.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_A2_000_500: Be sure to let me know how that works out.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_A3_000_500: You mean the ruins of the great serpent?
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_YSHTOLA_000_023: I wouldn't dream of going without you.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_YSHTOLA_000_024: I fail to see why that would be necessary given that you will be accompanying me. Don't be coy─it doesn't suit you.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_YSHTOLA_000_025: The great serpent? I see you've been studying your Ronkan history. But no, I've heard nothing relating to the woods' protector. Still, should it prove relevant to what lies within, your expertise would prove invaluable.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_YSHTOLA_000_026: When you are ready, make for Fanow. Almet and her sisters will be expecting us.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_URIANGER_000_027: Then let us be about our tasks. Pray give my regards to the Viis.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_MYSTERYVOICE_000_03: Though I would like to join you in untangling the Ascian's machinations, I think it best I stay here and devote my energies to finding a way to deliver the Scions back unto the Source.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_BEQLUGG_000_031: I will help the Exarch in any way I can, but the key to solving our problem lies with him and the Allagan Eye.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_YSHTOLA_000_032: Let us pray these new ruins are not as unwelcoming as the last.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_UIMET_000_033: You look as if you haven't seen us in an age. Is the passage of time really all that different ?
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_CYMET_000_034: The allies of Ronka! My, it feels as if an age has passed since you last graced us with your presence.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_ALMET_000_040: Welcome, allies of Ronka. We have accomplished much since last you came. With the Lightwarden dead and its minions dispersed, we have at last reclaimed our hunting grounds near Rak'tika Falls.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_ALMET_000_041: It was there that we discovered more ruins. Although we ran afoul of no traps while exploring its halls, we determined that the innermost chambers were warded by magick.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_ALMET_000_042: We all were in agreement─before any investigation could proceed, you should be summoned.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_YSHTOLA_000_043: We are grateful that you did. From what you have told me, I strongly suspect that the wisdom my comrades and I seek can be found within.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_YSHTOLA_100_043: This wisdom could prove invaluable, for we may soon face a foe whose greatest asset is our ignorance.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_ALMET_000_044: ...I see. Then it is good that you have come. For Ronka was once home to the greatest of weapons─knowledge and understanding.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_ALMET_000_045: And it is our duty to ensure you and yours do not want for either.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_ALMET_000_046: That said, we must proceed with caution. To have reached the inner chambers unmolested suggests a more formidable deterrent yet lies within.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_UIMET_000_047: Come now. Surely any threats sleeping within the ruins pale in comparison to those we have faced thus far.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_CYMET_000_048: This is not a game, Sister! You should not be so eager to run headlong into danger!
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_UIMET_000_049: Oh? And who was it pining for the return of our allies that we might venture into the ruins? Clutching her staff at night, wishing it were─
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_UIMET_000_051: Then I suggest we be going.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_YSHTOLA_000_053: Remind me: exactly how old are you and your sisters? ...On second thought, perhaps it's for the better I do not know.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_ALMET_000_054: Pray forgive their...overzealous nature. None save we three have been privileged to escort you and yours into the ruins and bear witness to its secrets.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_ALMET_000_055: Their hearts now burn with a curiosity that is not easily satiated.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_YSHTOLA_000_056: Please, you needn't apologize. As a seeker of knowledge myself, I understand full well their enthusiasm. And if not for your sedulous efforts to protect the ruins, we would not be afforded this opportunity.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_ALMET_000_057: Speaking of which, I believe I have kept you away from the ruins long enough. Come, let us make for the Qitana Ravel.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_YSHTOLA_000_060: Even Emet-Selch was taken aback to find a mural illustrating the Final Days in these ruins. What other surprises do you suppose yet lie within?
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_CYMET_000_062: I feel oddly ill-equipped to venture inside, but with you here, I'm sure things will work out.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_ALMET_000_070: It is most strange for these halls to be left unguarded. Have care when breaking the seal on the chamber door. Danger surely awaits us on the other side.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_SYSTEM_100_071: It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_YSHTOLA_000_075: We learned nothing of the Ascians, but the potential link between the Echo and preternatural starshowers is intriguing.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_UIMET_000_076: I sorely underestimated the defenses of these ruins. Perhaps Cymet was right to urge caution.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_CYMET_000_077: Tiuna is the reason I took up spellcraft, you know. <sigh> Never in my wildest dreams did I imagine her tomb would be found, let alone that we would be the ones to have the honor to do so.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_ALMET_000_080: By your pensive expression, I take it the tomb has given you much to think about. That is well. In time, the knowledge you have gleaned will lead to understanding, and thus arm you for what is to come.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_ALMET_000_081: Before you leave, however, I would speak again of the teachings of our forebears. Of histories learned, not lived.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_ALMET_000_082: The legend of Tiuna and her exploits has been told countless times over the centuries. Yet as it is handed from one generation to the next, the story changes.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_ALMET_000_083: With each telling of the tale there are new flourishes─details changed or lost. We can never truly know how she lived, for we were not there to see it.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_ALMET_000_084: But we are here now to bear witness to your life. We have seen the change you have wrought, the echoes that will endure long after you are gone. And though it too will change in time, I swear to you, we shall do our best to preserve your story.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_UIMET_000_085: I hope you'll forgive me if I don't make an oath of my own, but I think it goes without saying we could never misspeak of your heroism.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_CYMET_000_086: Perish the thought! So long as we are here, there are none among the Viis who will not know of all you have done for Norvrandt.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_YSHTOLA_000_087: We are not deserving of such reverence, but we are grateful all the same. You can be certain we will have our own tales to tell of the great guardians of Rak'tika and the ruins of Ronka.
TEXT_LUCKMH105_03765_ALMET_000_088: I pray you safe travels, then. As ever, we shall await your return with open arms.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_ALMET_000_000: So long as we Viis live, we shall preserve the truth of your deeds.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_UIMET_000_001: In the short time we've known you, it feels as though we've experienced a lifetime of adventures. Adventures we are not like to forget.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_CYMET_000_002: Perhaps we should create a new mural in your honor, and as a record for future generations. What do you think?
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_YSHTOLA_000_010: Although we learned naught of the Ascians, the insight we gained into the Echo made our trip worthwhile.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_YSHTOLA_000_011: Before we return to the Crystarium, however, there is a small matter I would attend to in Slitherbough. Might I trouble you to come with me?
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_YSHTOLA_000_012: Thank you. After we arrive, we should have a brief word with Runar.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_YSHTOLA_000_015: Runar appears to be in characteristically high spirits.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_RUNAR_000_020: ! It is so good to see you!
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_RUNAR_000_021: You've arrived at a most opportune time. I was preparing a pot of my famous stew. Come, I will ready a place for you.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_YSHTOLA_000_022: I'm sorry, Runar, but we haven't the─
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_RUNAR_000_023: Please, I insist! It will take only a minute.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_YSHTOLA_000_024: <sigh> My apologies, . It seems our return to the Crystarium will be delayed.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_YSHTOLA_000_025: But perhaps only for a bit─if you assist me with my work.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_YSHTOLA_000_026: I say “work,” but it is rather more a chore. I must clean my chambers here in Slitherbough from top to bottom. If you would be so kind as to go and fetch a broom from Asgeir, we might finish before Runar is done cooking.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_YSHTOLA_000_029: I require a broom if I'm to make any meaningful progress here. I'm sure you can find one if you speak with Asgeir.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_ASGEIR_000_031: I cannot imagine why she would have need of such a thing, but here you are. It is old but sturdy and sure to suffice.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_ASGEIR_000_032: You don't suppose she might be cleaning, do you? ...Should we be concerned?
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_YSHTOLA_000_040: I trust Asgeir was able to find a broom for us?
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_YSHTOLA_000_041: Well worn. Good. This would prove difficult otherwise.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_YSHTOLA_000_042: Though I must say, I think I did rather well for not having a broom thus far.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_YSHTOLA_100_042: ...Yes, well, you weren't buried beneath a veritable avalanche of books when you entered, were you? Right. Anyway, it is time I finished cleaning with the help of that broom.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_YSHTOLA_000_050: You didn't honestly think I'd do it the old-fashioned way? That broom is more than capable of sweeping by itself. Or rather, it will be... Ahem.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_YSHTOLA_000_051:
Time to rise, to swish and sweep,
A tidy chamber you must keep.
To this task you shall be bound,
Until no dust is to be found.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_YSHTOLA_000_052: In this one particular respect, I've no objections to following in Master Matoya's footsteps.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_YSHTOLA_000_053: (-Y'shtola-)In future, I may need you to remind me the pursuit of knowledge does not preclude other equally important duties... Such as maintaining clean quarters for said pursuit.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_YSHTOLA_000_054: (-Y'shtola-)<sigh> I will dearly miss this place. These people...
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_RUNAR_000_055: (-Runar-)M-Master Matoya! Pardon the interruption, but the stew is ready.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_YSHTOLA_000_056: Is something troubling you? You've been rather quiet.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_RUNAR_000_057: N-No! Everything is fine, I assure you. It has been a long day, is all.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_YSHTOLA_000_060: Alphinaud? I thought you were following Ardbert.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_ALPHINAUD_000_061: I was, though I'm sad to say I lost track of him shortly after entering these woods.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_ALPHINAUD_000_062: He seems determined to traverse every ilm of Norvrandt in his quest to spread the truth of the Warriors of Light and the Flood.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_ALPHINAUD_000_063: And it seems news of your address at the Crystarium precedes him at every destination, making his task all the more simple.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_ALPHINAUD_000_064: It remains to be seen to what end he encourages the people to become Warriors of Light themselves...
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_ALPHINAUD_100_064: ...But there is no denying that his words have struck a chord with many.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_ALISAIE_000_065: Well, we're all agreed that this is just another Ascian ploy, yes?
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_ALISAIE_000_066: They've commandeered corpses before, and to no good end. I see no reason to think this time is any different─especially when it's that of a fallen Warrior of Light.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_ALPHINAUD_000_067: I doubt we'll learn more if we remain a step behind.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_URIANGER_000_068: His next destination is, in all likelihood, Slitherbough...
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_YSHTOLA_000_069: Alisaie, are you certain you should be here?
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_ALISAIE_000_070: If you're concerned about Halric and the others, you needn't be. Their treatment is going well, but progress is slow and exhausting─for all of us. The best thing I can do now is let them rest. So─I believe we were about to discuss how to arrange a meeting with our would-be Warrior of Light?
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_ALPHINAUD_000_071: Before visiting any towns or villages, Ardbert would hunt down and slay a nearby sin eater to earn the locals' trust.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_ALPHINAUD_000_072: Our best chance of getting ahead of him is to find one before he does.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_URIANGER_000_073: Thankfully, Thancred and Ryne are returned from the Empty and have taken up the search.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_URIANGER_000_074: Ryne believeth one may lurk beneath the boughs of Woven Oath.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_ALPHINAUD_000_075: Then that is where we will start our search.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_RUNAR_000_077: I...er... A warm bowl of stew will be awaiting your return.
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_RUNAR_000_080: Please, , I beg of you... Keep her safe...
TEXT_LUCKMH106_03766_RYNE_000_081: I can sense no other sin eaters in the area. I hope this means Ardbert will be coming this way soon.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Would that I had found the words to deny Elidibus. We are so much more than he believes us to be, and yet...
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_ALISAIE_000_001: ...Am I the only one who sees the irony in “Ardbert” calling us puppets?
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_URIANGER_000_002: Disdain and obfuscation. What is thy true design, Emissary...?
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_THANCRED_000_003: I hate to leave him like that. Gods, they can't even let a man rest in peace...
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_RYNE_000_004: Thancred told me what Lahabrea did to him. I can't imagine how he's feeling right now.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_YSHTOLA_000_010: Alphinaud has the right of it. Let us pay visit to the Ondo.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_YSHTOLA_000_011: We should speak with Tolshs Aath first. As chieftain, he is doubtless privy to a great many secrets.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_ALPHINAUD_000_015: Perhaps we might look in on Paushs Ooan while we're in the area.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_ALISAIE_000_016: This place feels much less ominous than the first time we were here. Then again, we did have the shadow of your impending death hanging over us.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_URIANGER_000_017: Mayhap we shall find the secrets we seek in these depths...should their keepers consent to aid us.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_THANCRED_000_018: The last time we were here, the Ondo sent us to slay a massive creature. 'Twas as large as Leviathan, twice as angry, and... Yes, of course I jest. It was only half as large.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_RYNE_000_019: I'm glad to have the opportunity to visit the Tempest again. It's so lovely here─like a different world entirely.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_020: I have sent for no finless ones. Perhaps you instead come seeking something of usss?
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_021: Ruins which your kind have yet to explore... I sssee.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_022: I know of one such place. Alas, under these circumstances, I am afraid we can spare none to guide you there.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_024: Rather than hunt for their own meals, the benthos have pillaged our stores of mnyiri liver. They must be replenished with haste.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_ALPHINAUD_000_025: The benthos... A particularly violent tribe of Ondo, if I recall?
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_026: A band of bottom-feeders. We all lost much in the Flood, but while others work to rebuild, they resort to thievery and murder.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_027: Revenge, they call it, when they prey upon your kind─but do not be fooled. They care not who they harm. Would that we had the warriors to challenge them.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_028: This is not the first time they have ssstolen from us, but there is no resource more precious than liver. All must dedicate themselves to the hunt.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_YSHTOLA_000_029: Unless, of course, we were to reclaim the livers for you.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_YSHTOLA_000_030: It seems a fitting payment for vital information, does it not?
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_YSHTOLA_100_030: Moreover, one could argue that by employing Bismarck to reach these depths, thereby driving back the waters, we are in part responsible for the deeds of those driven to desperate ends by the changing climes.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_A2_000_500: We certainly can't leave them like this.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_A3_000_500: Could we not simply hunt mnyiri ourselves?
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_YSHTOLA_000_031: I thought you might say that. You've never been one to miss an opportunity to help.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_YSHTOLA_000_032: We might...but that wouldn't discourage the benthos from stealing from the Ondo again, now would it?
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_ALPHINAUD_000_033: Reclaiming the stores it is, then.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_034: We would be grateful beyond words if you did.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_035: The benthos have surely taken the livers back to the Flounders' Floor. But be warned─there will be no shortage of guards waiting to ssspear intruders.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_YSHTOLA_000_036: Then we will have care not to draw their attention. Shall we?
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_100_040: The Flounders' Floor is to the northwest. We Ondo keep our distance. Were we not in dire straits, I would advise you to do the same...
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_ALPHINAUD_000_040: N-Nervous? Me? Not at all! It's a bit dark, though, isn't it...? Definitely not haunted, though. Certainly not...
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_ALISAIE_000_041: They're not much of a threat one-on-one, but Tolshs Aath was right about their numbers. If we fight them all, we'll be here a fortnight.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_YSHTOLA_000_042: If I were a bandit leader, I'd surely keep my spoils deep within my stronghold...
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_THANCRED_000_043: These aren't the livers, but they're certainly stolen from somewhere...unless wheat has started growing on the sea floor since last I checked.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_URIANGER_000_044: Ryne scaled the wall with remarkable swiftness. Thancred taught her well.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_RYNE_000_045: I haven't forgotten why we're here, I swear! Only...this bird hasn't taken its eyes off me since I found it. I think it might be lonely.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_SYSTEM_000_046: The shoebill is staring at Ryne. Just. Staring.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_SYSTEM_000_050: On cursory sniff, you detect the faint aroma of fresh oranges, a far cry from the rather memorable scent of mnyiri liver.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_SYSTEM_000_051: Thrusting your hand into each sack in turn, you find that all are filled with wheat down to the bottom. You also find that raw wheat is unpleasantly pointy.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_SYSTEM_100_051: These boxes are filled with assorted vegetables. Liver is not a vegetable.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_SYSTEM_000_052: From the squelching noise they make when prodded and the vile stench, you conclude that these bags are bursting with livers. Brilliant.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_THANCRED_000_054: Perhaps you've deduced this already, but it seems the benthos have been raiding Kholusian storehouses as well as those of the Ondo.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_THANCRED_000_056: But we can discuss this after we see the livers safely back to Tolshs Aath. It wouldn't do to keep him in suspense.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_ALPHINAUD_000_060: So the benthos have been stealing supplies from the Kholusians. Hmm...
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_ALISAIE_000_061: I'm glad you had better luck than I did. I spent the whole time fighting one benthos after another.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_YSHTOLA_000_062: I have a feeling that there is more to this...
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_THANCRED_000_063: Did you happen to see a bird while you were in the caves? Ryne insists that there was one...but how?
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_URIANGER_000_064: To venture ashore and steal from the Kholusians entaileth unconscionable risk. Yet there is no denying the truth of our eyes.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_RYNE_000_065: I know it sounds strange, but there really was a bird in those caves.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_070: I am relieved to see you unspeared.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_071: Our precious livers! I knew you would not fail!
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_THANCRED_000_072: We also found all manner of foodstuffs from Kholusia in the Flounders' Floor. Tell me, Tolshs Aath, does that seem odd to you?
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_073: It is brazen, to be sure...
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_ALPHINAUD_000_074: I'm reminded of rumors I've heard recently concerning a rash of thefts from Kholusian warehouses. The perpetrators enter in the dead of night and are gone before anyone has realized what has happened.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_ALPHINAUD_000_075: The Eulmoran Army has been investigating, but thus far to no avail.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_ALPHINAUD_000_076: Perhaps the reason they have struggled so is that their quarry is of the sea...
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_YSHTOLA_000_077: The true question, then, is what we mean to do about it. Much as I would like to proceed to the ruins without further delay, we cannot allow the benthos to carry on as they are.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_078: If I may─I believe that the ruins are, in fact, key to the benthos' plans.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_080: These ruins, which lie deep within the illuminated land, are a recent discovery.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_081: We have seen signs that the benthos are preparing to claim them with all haste. We could not fathom why, but in light of the knowledge that they have been stockpiling resources...
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_082: It is clear that their queen will sssoon give birth.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_083: They require space to raise their young, and food for both queen and hatchlings to thrive.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_YSHTOLA_000_084: Well, we can hardly fault them for that.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_085: Under normal circumstances, perhapsss. But conditions in the Tempest are far from suitable for spawning, its resources barely able to sustain our current population. There is only one reason they would disregard this.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_086: They seek to build an army, and with it take revenge upon the finless.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_087: It is not a surprise. They came to us not long ago, seeking allies for the cause. We rebuffed them, of course─the suffering of others will not serve as balm to their own. Their queen, however, desires only bloodshed, and will gladly send her children to die in our stead.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_ALPHINAUD_000_088: If they are planning to wage war, that changes matters considerably.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_YSHTOLA_100_089: I doubt that this can be resolved without violence, but perhaps with a show of force we can convince them to see reason before the die is cast.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_YSHTOLA_000_090: I would rather not risk your people in the attempt. If we travel to the illuminated land, is there a way we might identify the ruins ourselves?
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_091: Yes. Once you reach its depths, go deeper still. You will see a monstrous structure there upon the sea floor.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_092: That you have come to us now is the will of the ancient ones. They have guided you here that you may drive out the usurpers─those who seek to use their magnificent creations with vile purpose.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_TOLSHSAATH_000_093: I have no doubt that they will show you the way forward.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_YSHTOLA_100_093: I'm afraid that the dead do not speak quite so clearly. Nevertheless, we shall try not to disappoint.
TEXT_LUCKMH107_03767_URIANGER_000_094: If what we seek lieth deeper still, beyond Amaurot, I would call upon the assistance of another...
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_ALPHINAUD_000_000: It doesn't feel all that honorable or heroic to strike first, but if it leads to less bloodshed in the end...
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_ALISAIE_000_001: Why do these problems always turn out to be so much more complex than they seem? Couldn't we have a simple, straightforward adventure for once? The good guys good, the bad guys bad, no drama or intrigue, and it all ends with tea and tarts!
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_YSHTOLA_000_002: The will of the ancients... If only it were so simple.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_003: I would not care for what happened in Limsa to be repeated a world away. The benthos know not what they do...
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_RYNE_000_004: Is it wrong of me to be a bit excited? I know the circumstances are grave, but imagine what those ruins might hold!
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_010: Though our course hath been decided, to pursue it we must needs beseech the aid of a friend.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_011: Aye, I speak of Bismarck. Pray follow me to Sullen that we might seek an audience with him once more.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_040: From here, we press onward to the Isle of Ken. I myself shall proceed on foot.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_042: Just so─the water will be as glass beneath my feet, and provideth purchase fragile yet true. Watch closely.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_ALISAIE_000_044: Forgive me, but would it not be easier to perfect your swimming technique?
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_045: Aye, 'twould be a pity if you drowned. Truly.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_RYNE_000_046: Oh, hush. I'm sure it'll be brilliant!
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_051: M-Mine apologies. The technique requireth the purest of focus, and mine...'twas lacking.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_052: To perfect this magick I went so far as to deal with the Fuath, and with their aid mine efforts finally met with success...albeit on a single occasion.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_053: I know not why I cannot repeat it.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_054: I thought I saw you waver a bit toward the end there. Perhaps you're simply...tired...?
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_056: It's nothing to worry about─only a dizzy spell. Though it may not be wise to go for another swim just now...
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_YSHTOLA_000_057: Thankfully, we have an alternative. A wonderful little invention, I'm certain you'll agree.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_ALPHINAUD_000_060: I must admit I'd been keen to attempt walking on water myself. Though I know what Alisaie would say...
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_ALISAIE_000_061: I'll stick to swimming, thank you very much.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_YSHTOLA_000_062: What sort of dealings with the Fuath, I wonder...
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_064: Before you make some quip about age catching up with me─you'd be out of breath too, if you had to drag Urianger out of the sea without so much as a warm-up.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_RYNE_000_065: Do you think those two are really all right? Perhaps we should take a moment to rest.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_070: I will petition Bismarck's aid on our behalf. Let us pray my diplomacy proveth more effective than mine experimental magicks...
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_BISMARCK_000_071: (-Bismarck-)[You speak with the voice of the king, little neighbors. I will not deny you.]
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_BISMARCK_000_072: (-Bismarck-)[As before, if you seek what sleeps beneath the sea, I will be your guide.]
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_073: [Thy kindness is as boundless as the depths, serene one.]
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_BISMARCK_000_074: (-Bismarck-)[Before we depart, however, I would ask a favor.]
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_BISMARCK_000_075: (-Bismarck-)[After our last flight, I found many creatures clinging to me. I am...itchy.]
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_BISMARCK_000_076: (-Bismarck-)[Remove them, and I will take you below.]
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_077: [With all haste shall it be done.]
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_079: Aye, though I agreed to a favor in kind...
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_080: Regrettably, 'tis not one I possess the power to grant. Bismarck hath asked us to cleanse his underbelly of barnacles.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_081: Alas, one must needs dive beneath the surface to do so. Even if I could master the power to walk upon it, it would avail me naught.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_ALISAIE_000_082: Oh, for heavens' sake, is that all!?  and I are more than capable of that.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_ALISAIE_000_083: With the Kojin's blessing, we'll have done with it in moments─and better that than standing here and listening to this nonsense! I'll take the right, you the left. Now go!
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_ALPHINAUD_000_090: None of us is much of a match for Alisaie when she's like this. Aside from Y'shtola, perhaps.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_YSHTOLA_000_092: It's a minor miracle that we accomplish anything at all, wouldn't you say?
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_093: Mine apologies. This venture hath not proceeded as smoothly as I had hoped...
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_094: Yes, I'm perfectly well recovered, thank you.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_SYSTEM_000_100: After a good deal of prying from various angles, you dislodge the barnacle.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_ALPHINAUD_000_105: The power to breathe underwater seems most convenient. Mayhap the Kojin might be persuaded to grant me it when we return to the Source─I can swim, after all.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_ALISAIE_000_106: Well, that was disgusting. I pray we'll not be required to attend to any other matters of personal hygiene.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_108: Apologies for sitting this one out, but it did seem more appropriate for those of you with the Kojin's blessing to handle it.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_RYNE_000_109: Would you please keep an eye on Thancred and Urianger? I'm still not convinced they're all right...
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_110: Thine efforts are most sincerely appreciated. I will inform Bismarck that we may depart without further delay.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_BISMARCK_000_111: (-Bismarck-)[Much, much better. Thank you, little neighbors.]
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_BISMARCK_000_112: (-Bismarck-)[I remember...a long time ago, another did this favor for me.]
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_BISMARCK_000_113: (-Bismarck-)[After the Flood, when I chose this spot for my slumber... He came and made a home on my back. Ken was his name.]
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_BISMARCK_000_114: (-Bismarck-)[When I grew itchy, I stirred. But he was not afraid. No─he asked me what was wrong.]
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_BISMARCK_000_115: (-Bismarck-)[I told him of the creatures clinging to my belly, and he dove into the water. He helped me. He was my friend.]
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_BISMARCK_000_116: (-Bismarck-)[He told me he wished to live in peace, away from his people and their wars. This, I understood.]
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_BISMARCK_000_117: (-Bismarck-)[I treasured our time together, brief though it was. Brief though it always is. But I remember him, and how he laughed when we flew...]
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_BISMARCK_000_118: (-Bismarck-)[...I remember when he slept. I too slept that day, and many days since.]
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_BISMARCK_000_119: (-Bismarck-)[But the light fades and the darkness returns. Ken sleeps, but in memory he laughs, and together we fly. And I am here. I am awake.]
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_BISMARCK_000_120: (-Bismarck-)[Mmm... It feels good to speak and to be heard again. A shame others cannot understand me.]
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_121: [If thou art willing to learn, I would gladly teach thee the language of man.]
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_BISMARCK_000_122: (-Bismarck-)[Thank you, little friend. But it is time I grant you your request.]
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_BISMARCK_000_123: (-Bismarck-)[But first, I will take flight to cleanse my body and prepare. The dive will be swift, and I would not have you struck by errant debris.]
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_124: So this “island” was named for a man. How easily the past is forgotten.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_YSHTOLA_000_125: He passed not even one hundred years ago, yet the truth has slipped from history. Like so many grains of sand...
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_ALISAIE_000_126: ...Might I have some explanation of what he just said, or shall we all stand about making vague and mysterious allusions?
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_127: While he maketh ready to deliver us unto our destination, Bismarck bade us wait for him on the shore of Kholusia.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_ALISAIE_000_128: That's all...? I feel as though there was more to it.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_129: Indeed, there was...but it hath no bearing on the task at hand. I should be glad to share the rest with you anon.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_YSHTOLA_000_131: If Bismarck requires time to prepare, might I suggest a short respite? For Urianger and Thancred, in particular.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_132: I require no such thing. I am the picture of perfect health.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_133: Mine was but a momentary lapse in concentration. Worry not on my account.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_RYNE_000_134: You mustn't push yourselves so! Please, rest! For me?
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_135: Oh, all right. If you insist.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_RYNE_000_136: You too, ! You've been running yourself ragged!
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_YSHTOLA_000_138: In that case, I leave the old men in your care. The rest of us will meet you at the Split Hull anon.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_138: <sigh> Word of advice─never let it show. When she realizes she's struck a nerve, she remembers. By the gods, she remembers...
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_139: In any case, if we must be made to rest, I know a place in Sullen that's better for it than most. Come with me.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_140: With age cometh wisdom─or so I pray.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_150: May as well have a seat. We wouldn't want our elderly knees to give out.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_151: To hear her speak you'd think I'm on my deathbed. By the Twelve, I wish that girl wouldn't worry so much.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_152: Thy countenance belies thy words, Master Thancred.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_153: I'm sure I don't know what you mean. Let the record show that I am here under protest.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_154: ...Though I can't say I mind the view.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_155: And if the abundance of anglers is any indication, even an amateur might land an impressive catch. Shall we try our hands at it?
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_PANICKEDFISHER_000_: It's Nightshade! We was attacked on the road from the Crystarium─barely escaped with me life!
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_158: I suppose we might have predicted this.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_PANICKEDFISHER_000_: Y-You mean you'll help? For free? Th-Thank you!
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_160: If I recall correctly, “Nightshade” is a local band of outlaws.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_161: I doubt they'll trouble us overmuch. No more than they already have by interrupting our relaxation, at any rate.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_FISHERA03768_000_16: We was ambushed. I ran, but my friend...he weren't fast enough.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_FISHERB03768_000_16: Can you believe this? I don't even have anything worth stealing!
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_167: All save our miscreant appear unharmed.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_SOLDIER03608_000_16: Fortunately, this one wasn't clever enough to bring support.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_BRAVESOLDIER_000_16: Never fear! Nightshade ain't no match for the guard.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_170: These two have matters well in hand, by the looks of it.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_FISHERB03768_000_17: I'll not forget this kindness. May we meet again!
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_SOLDIER03608_000_17: Is that you, ? Don't tell me we just deprived that poor fellow the honor of being rescued by the Warrior of Darkness! We had no idea you were in the area. Fancy us meeting again so soon, eh? Why, I believe I even recognize your companion.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_173: ...Ah yes! From the infirmary. You had a message for the Crystal Exarch, did you not? It's good to see you back on your feet─and on patrol, no less!
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_SOLDIER03608_000_17: Oh, it's nothing as official as all that! Strictly speaking, we're off duty. But as we had a free moment, we thought we'd give a few of the less-traveled roads a look. The guard doesn't have enough hands to patrol them regularly, you see.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_175: That's admirable. There are few so devoted to their duty─in Lakeland or beyond.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_SOLDIER03608_000_17: Well, we've been talking about it for a while, and neither of us is satisfied with just seeing out our service. It feels like we could be doing more─like we should be doing more.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_BRAVESOLDIER_000_17: (-Gallant Guardsman-)It's all about having the will to help your fellow man, and the resolve to see it through!
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_A1_000_600: I remember you. The excitable one.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_BRAVESOLDIER_000_17: Sorry, ! I got a bit overexcited the other day─couldn't get my words out.
(-Vonard-)The name's Vonard, . I'm with the guard, but I don't just want to protect Lakeland─I want to protect the lot. Just like the Warriors of Light.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_SOLDIER03608_000_18: Sadly, our duties prevent us from venturing too far from our own little corner of Norvrandt.
What we'd really like to do is travel─to better ourselves, and go where the need is greatest...
But everyone has to start somewhere, don't they? For now, if we can stop Nightshade from robbing the odd fisherman, then that's what we'll do.
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_THANCRED_000_183: Well, well... Future heroes of the First, do you think?
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_184: They want not for spirit. 'Tis but a pity they draw inspiration from so clouded a wellspring...
TEXT_LUCKMH108_03768_URIANGER_000_185: Yet it availeth us naught to fret in idleness. We must needs press on if we are to bring Elidibus's schemes to light.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_THANCRED_100_000: It pains me to think that men with such pure intent are being made to serve Ascian ends, however directly. But they're right. The people need heroes.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_URIANGER_000_000: Though our respite was cut short, I daresay we are all eager to avail ourselves of such knowledge as the ruins may hold.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_THANCRED_000_001: Aye, and I doubt further contemplation of Elidibus's machinations will be conducive to relaxation. We may as well make for the Split Hull now.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_ALPHINAUD_000_010: So, how much of a respite did you actually enjoy? Half a moment's?
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_ALISAIE_000_011: What's keeping Bismarck? Surely it doesn't take this long to shake off a few loose stones.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_YSHTOLA_000_012: Perhaps we ought to have clarified what Bismarck meant by “a short while.” To his mind, our whole lives might be as the blink of an eye...
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_RYNE_000_014: You arrived rather early. Are you certain you did as you were told?
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_URIANGER_000_020: All are present. Now we need but await Bismarck's coming.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_A1_000_002: Form a party and enter Anamnesis Anyder.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Whether or not we find the knowledge we seek, we have a duty to stem the benthos' aggression. Eulmore has only just begun to rebuild.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_YSHTOLA_000_042: We must hope that whatever slumbers in the depths will help to shed some light upon Elidibus's recent activities.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_THANCRED_000_043: We can't be certain that the benthos are all we'll find down there. Stay alert.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_RYNE_000_044: I like to think my skills have improved in some small way since the last time we fought together. I won't let you down.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_URIANGER_000_045: Unlike Amaurot, the ruins which we now seek are no illusion. There is no knowing what awaiteth below.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_ALPHINAUD_000_050: I had always assumed Elidibus to be of the same ilk as Lahabrea and Emet-Selch. But if the real Elidibus sacrificed himself before the sundering...
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_THANCRED_000_052: And there I was thinking “immortal” was bad. Would someone explain to me how we're meant to kill a being who doesn't technically exist?
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_RYNE_000_053: Do you think we might be able to activate the device again? I should like to hear how those discussions ended.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_URIANGER_000_054: That this facility shared intimate ties with the Akadaemia Anyder may readily be discerned from the common element in their names. Based on mine observations, 'tis like that the forms housed here were conveyed unto the Akadaemia only when required, and thence returned for safekeeping.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_URIANGER_000_055: Yet...such procedural minutiae are of largely academic interest, I concede. 'Tis unto the parties which did frequent these institutions that our thoughts should rightly turn. Specifically, the followers of Venat, and the Convocation of Fourteen...
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_URIANGER_000_056: ...To say naught of the matter of Elidibus.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_YSHTOLA_000_060: The device appears to activate via a form of aetherial attunement, not unlike an aetheryte. Beyond that, I can say little for certain, save that we should take this opportunity to see what other records it contains.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_URIANGER_000_062: If I may, milady─the panel did formerly emit a soft-yet-perceptible glow. That it doth so no longer may betoken the depletion of some essential energy within.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_ALPHINAUD_000_063: Given how long it has lain dormant, I think it fortunate it functioned at all.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_ALISAIE_000_064: That may be, but if we can't get it to work again, we'll be leaving with more questions than we've answered.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_URIANGER_000_065: The white-robed emissary hath ever named himself “Elidibus.” Yet if the shade spoke true, Elidibus ceased to be ere even the sundering came to pass.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_URIANGER_000_066: This calleth to mind a truth that Emet-Selch did once reveal in passing─that the names by which we know our foes are not those given to Ascians at birth. Rather, they are titles of office, afforded to individuals of merit at such time as the role becometh vacant.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_URIANGER_000_067: Perchance the Elidibus at Zodiark's heart and the emissary with whom we are acquainted be not one and the same, but predecessor and successor.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_YSHTOLA_000_069: It's possible. If the previous Elidibus perished before the Final Days, the one we know could still be a survivor of the sundering.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_YSHTOLA_000_070: And yet...something in that explanation rings false.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_YSHTOLA_000_071: I will remain for a time. I would not abandon my attempts to revive the device so soon. There is more to learn here─I can feel it.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_URIANGER_000_072: In matters of aetherology, I know of none as capable as thee. If there existeth a means to learn more, thou wilt surely find it.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_URIANGER_000_073: Whilst thou art thus engaged, we shall attend to matters on the surface.
TEXT_LUCKMH109_03769_SYSTEM_000_080: You may now enter Anamnesis Anyder with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_ALPHINAUD_000_000: While it is true our findings have raised more questions than they have answered, it is not impossible that Y'shtola will gain access to additional records. And if nothing else, we have spared Eulmore from invasion.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_ALISAIE_000_001: Hopefully, this will make the benthos think twice before raiding the stores of their fellow Ondo again.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_THANCRED_000_003: Answers never did come to us tied neatly with a bow. We'll get to the bottom of things eventually.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_RYNE_000_004: Does she really not mind working alone...?
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_URIANGER_000_010: Can we but uncover Elidibus's true origins, we may yet come to understand his designs. To that end, Y'shtola must needs be afforded as much time as she doth require to complete her investigation.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_ALPHINAUD_000_011: ...To the extent that such things are within our control, yes. Speaking of which, perhaps we might trouble the Exarch for news of his progress with the spirit vessel?
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_ALPHINAUD_000_012: He will no doubt wish to hear of our own discoveries as well, such as they are.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_ALISAIE_000_020: And there he goes again... Though I don't suppose he would have given us an honest answer about his history had he stayed.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_THANCRED_000_021:
Unsettling though this is, I'm certain our friends in the guard will use the Echo well.
...Or with good intentions, at least.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_RYNE_000_022: It did remind me of it... Amaurot, I mean. All the fear, and the sadness...
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_URIANGER_000_023: Though I like not what it portendeth, having been treated to so unambiguous a demonstration, I cannot well conclude aught but that starshowers are indeed instrumental in awakening the Echo.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_URIANGER_000_024: Yet we need not attribute such credence to all that Elidibus hath claimed. That he too seeketh this star's salvation, for one...
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_ALPHINAUD_000_030: The more Elidibus reveals, the less I understand. But that he has made a fine mess of things is plain.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_MYSTERYVOICE_000_03: I've managed to persuade a number of our would-be deserters to reconsider, or at least delay, their departure. But as many are deaf to my entreaties.
Young Theyler and Vonard among them, I am sorry to say. They have quit the guard.
Nevertheless, I wish them well. Whatever Elidibus's plans for them might be, the pair have only ever had the best of intentions.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_THANCRED_000_035: One can hardly blame them for thinking themselves heroes elect─not after having been “blessed” with the Echo. And it's not as if they haven't shown the requisite spirit.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_MYSTERYVOICE_000_03: I quite agree. Though the impetus for their sudden departure may have been words falsely spoken, the men and women in whose footsteps they would follow are heroes in truth. Warriors of Light. Ardbert. Yourself, most of all.

And so I would ask a favor of you─speak with them ere they embark on their journey, and furnish them with what wisdom you can. They've set off for the Amaro Launch, but you should still be able to catch them if you leave now.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_THANCRED_000_038: Worth the effort, I'd say. If I recall correctly,  took the time to usher you out into the wider world, many moons ago.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_ALPHINAUD_000_039: I...think that comparison rather flatters Theyler and Vonard. But the point still stands. They would doubtless be greatly encouraged were the Warrior of Darkness  to see them off.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_URIANGER_000_040: If thou art willing, I prithee go. Thou mayest safely leave the task of unfolding that which did transpire at Anamnesis to us.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_MYSTERYVOICE_000_04: You will need to leave now if you are to catch them before they depart. They are...eager to be on their way.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_ALPHINAUD_000_042: I daresay I needn't wax poetical on the value of well-placed words of encouragement to you of all people. I have gained that much self-awareness in our time together...
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_ALISAIE_000_043: Honestly, don't listen to all this prattle about the life-changing importance of your words to impressionable young heroes. You could nod mutely in their general direction and they'd still be inspired.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_THANCRED_000_044: You caused quite a stir when you set forth as the  newly anointed envoy, you know.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_THANCRED_100_044: Minfilia was delighted. “The world is ever in need of heroes,” she said...
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_RYNE_000_045: “This land is our home...and it is we who must protect it...” Even if he didn't believe a word he was saying, and it's all part of some terrible scheme, it's hard not to take his message to heart.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_URIANGER_000_046: In days to come, when Elidibus's machinations have all come to naught, the First shall be stronger for its people's readiness to rise to the challenges of their time. We have but to defeat our foe to make it so.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_BEQLUGG_000_047: I was so deeply immersed in my research that I entirely failed to notice the starshower... Bugger.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_BRAVESOLDIER_000_04: ...“Where in Amh Araeng”? I mean... You know... Around.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_SOLDIER03608_000_05: You again!? Uh, I mean─it's you, ! Sorry...it's been a funny old day.
You can be sure we'll take those words to heart.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_BRAVESOLDIER_000_05: I still can't believe it─you coming all this way just to speak to us.
I swear we won't let you down. So long as it helps someone, we'll do what needs doing out there─no matter how small!
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_SOLDIER03608_000_05: And when larger threats loom, we'll be ready to face them. You see if we aren't.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_A2_000_500: ...Well, what are you waiting for? Get out there!
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_SOLDIER03608_000_05: We'll be off, then. Farewell, Warrior of Darkness─and thank you.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_ALPHINAUD_000_058: I take it they were suitably inspired?
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_URIANGER_000_059: Thou art returned! And at a most opportune time. We have but this moment concluded our account of all that came to pass in the deep.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_MYSTERYVOICE_000_06: Thank you for making the effort. I'm certain your words will be a boon to them.
While you were away, the others told me of your investigation. We have yet to discuss how to proceed, however.

While your findings in Anamnesis Anyder do raise important questions as to the identity of our adversary, we are no closer to discerning his design. Nor do I know of any other potential avenue of investigation.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_URIANGER_000_063: For which reason, we must needs trust to Y'shtola's ingenuity, and wait for her efforts to revive the ancients' device to bear fruit.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_THANCRED_000_064: ...What if I were to attempt to follow the emissary? Elusive as he is, his plan compels him to court public attention. He shouldn't be impossible to find.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_ALPHINAUD_000_065: Especially for one of your experience. It does seem worth the attempt.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_RYNE_000_066: Then I'll come with you. Safety in numbers.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_THANCRED_000_067: In combat, perhaps─but where stealth is required, the opposite is true. Happily, I don't plan on getting myself caught, so you've no need to worry.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_THANCRED_100_067: Nor do I intend to vanish for moons on end. We still have the Empty to attend to, don't we?
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_RYNE_000_068: All right. Then I look forward to your return.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_ALISAIE_000_069: Then it sounds like the rest of us should avoid doing anything which might prompt Elidibus to look too closely at our movements. Insofar as it's possible, I recommend we limit our activities to the Crystarium.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Speaking of which─Exarch, might I ask if you've made any progress with the spirit vessel?
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_MYSTERYVOICE_000_07: Of course. We are presently studying the principles underpinning memory transference and, I believe, nearing the requisite level of understanding.
Less hearteningly, practical trials of transference methods suited for use with the vessel have yet to yield satisfactory results...to put it mildly.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_BEQLUGG_000_075: But there are still many promising possibilities we have yet to test!
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_MYSTERYVOICE_000_07: Indeed. Though it may take some time yet, we are well on our way to a solution.
And I shall not rest until one is found.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_URIANGER_000_078: Though we are all grateful for thine unstinting efforts, thou need'st not labor to the exclusion of all else. If it would serve to lighten thy burden, however little, I should gladly offer mine assistance.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_ALPHINAUD_100_078: Quite. I, for my part, will do what I can to ensure that the Crystarium continues to run smoothly, in spite of recent disruptions.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_RYNE_100_079: Then perhaps I could help? There must be something I can do, even if it's just guard duty.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_MYSTERYVOICE_000_07: Thank you... All of you. I shall breathe easier for your assistance.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_MYSTERYVOICE_100_08: Of course, on the evidence of the recent past, it will not be long before some new crisis arrives to throw our plans into disarray─at which time your services will be in particular demand. That being the case, perhaps you might take this opportunity to retire to your suite at the Pendants?
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_MYSTERYVOICE_000_08: One of these methods will work. It must.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_MYSTERYVOICE_101_08: ...Of course I don't wish to worry Lyna─she has more than enough to worry about already. But I swore that I would return you all home.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_MYSTERYVOICE_0102_0:
All right! Fine. I will henceforth endeavor to take breaks when appropriate.
...While Lyna is watching.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_ALPHINAUD_000_081: Ought we to inform the citizens that the starshower was an illusion, do you think? They might sleep better for the knowledge that no damage was done.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_ALISAIE_000_082: I will accompany my brother, and make sure he doesn't get carried away. You will do as you're told, and get some rest─both of you.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_ALISAIE_100_082: Honestly, he's a danger to himself. If I were Lyna, I think I would've hit him over the head with a blunt object by now. At least then he'd lie down.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_THANCRED_000_083: There is sure to be no shortage of potential heroes upon whose good nature Elidibus will try to prevail. The trick will be in anticipating which settlement he'll direct his attentions toward next...
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_RYNE_000_084: There's so much to be done, and so little I can do to help... But you can count on me to play my part in the Empty.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_URIANGER_000_085: Knowing not whether Elidibus or our ever-waning connection to the Source representeth the more pressing problem, we must needs attend to both...and risk solving neither.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_BEQLUGG_000_086: Never fear─I too will continue to assist the Exarch to the best of my ability. And if that means casting the odd sleeping charm, so be it.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_GUIDEOFTHEPENDANTS_: I am relieved to see you were unharmed in the earlier commotion. Though, if I may─you do look somewhat weary. I presume you will be retiring to your suite?
Very good. Do let me know if there is anything you require.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_SYSTEM_100_100: A new Eden quest is now available from Yalfort in Mord Souq.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_GLYNARD_000_090: ? It's Glynard─from the Wandering Stairs. I apologize for calling so late.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_GLYNARD_000_091: A friend of yours was asking after you. You may remember them from that business with the Cardinal Virtues...
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_GRANSON_000_101: I was looking forward to a welcome respite here in the Crystarium, but the mood here's not exactly conducive to relaxation, as I'm sure you've noticed.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_GRANSON_000_102: Aye, I'd wager you know more about what's going on than anyone else in this city. Care to share?
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_GRANSON_000_103: Hmmm... I can't say that I envy you your prey.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_GRANSON_000_104: Dark work, this twisting of the Warriors of Light's legacy. Reminds me of what became of ol' Dikaiosyne─though this “Ascian” of yours is a fair bit more chatty.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_GRANSON_000_105: I'm tempted to silence him myself. Branden made his mistakes─I'm sure they all did─but the past is the past. They've earned their rest.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_A2_000_001: I'm not about to let him sully Ardbert's good name.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_A2_000_002: I'll see that they have their peace.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_GRANSON_000_106: What, you want me to leave it to you?
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_GRANSON_000_107: ...Right, right. I'm not the only one carrying all that weight. Very well. But only because you asked.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_GRANSON_000_108: Remember: if you ever need me, just say the word. I'll be there.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_GIOTT_000_201: So there I am─minding my own business, quaffing my ale─when I hear a ruckus outside. And then, clear as day: “Warrior of Light”!
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_GIOTT_000_202: That sounded like trouble to me, and I knew that if anyone was going to trouble  over that trouble, it'd be you. So I gave Glynard the ol' “But I'm your best customer!” routine until he agreed to bring me here, and now I know where you live! Great, ain't it?
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_GIOTT_000_203: Some bastard's walking around wearing Ardbert─Lamitt's Ardbert─like a secondhand jerkin!?
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_GIOTT_000_204: I don't know what's more offensive─that, or that you let him leave without a proper dwarven decking!
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_A3_000_001: He did vanish into thin air.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_A3_000_002: A certain hobson refused to teach me...
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_GIOTT_000_205: Bah! In a pinch, an improvised decking would've been fine!
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_GIOTT_000_206: Tell you what. I'll show you how to knock that bastard flat in the blink of an eye here and now. Taboos be damned.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_GIOTT_000_207: After all, we ain't about to let him keep on like that, are we? Pretending to be Ardbert. Lamitt's Ardbert.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_GIOTT_000_208: Step one: make a fist. Step two: extend your arm, like so. Step three: beat 'em senseless. Got it?
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_LUEREEQ_000_301: I had come to dine at the Wandering Stairs, you see, when I spied a considerable gathering of locals. Then the sky caught fire, and, well...
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_LUEREEQ_000_302: You must know what it all means. Anything you'd care to share with a friend?
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_LUEREEQ_000_303: That is...alarming, to say the least.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_LUEREEQ_000_304: It's all well and good that others have come to appreciate the Warriors of Light, but we cannot allow this charlatan to exploit their legacy. So...
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_LUEREEQ_000_305: Yes! Why not? We shall reform the indomitable duo that is Reeq and , and put an end to his shenanigans!
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_LUEREEQ_000_306: Yes, I know. No need to say it. You've no intention of involving me. I'm stupid, but I'm not naive.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_LUEREEQ_000_307: You're the better hunter, and the better person besides. I'm reminded of Renda-Rae...though that's hardly a surprise, is it?
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_LUEREEQ_000_308: For her sake─for all of theirs─show this pretender what it truly means to be a hero!
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_TAYNOR_000_400: Pray forgive my late visit... I heard the man who called himself a Warrior of Light speak, you see, and saw the stars falling from the heavens.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_TAYNOR_000_401: Cerigg grew tired of my endless fretting and bade me call upon you if it would put my mind at ease. Is there aught you can tell me?
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_TAYNOR_000_402: An impostor. I feared you might say that.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_TAYNOR_000_403: I believed him─I wanted to believe him. How wonderful it was that even one of them returned, I thought...
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_TAYNOR_000_404: Yet if he is not the man you knew, then...I'm sorry. I know all too well how that feels.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_TAYNOR_000_405: I can only imagine how it must hurt to be unable to speak the truth─how you must abide the lie for fear of condemning those fallen heroes once more.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_TAYNOR_000_406: It may not be my place, but allow me to offer you a few words of advice. As you once did me.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_TAYNOR_000_407: Remember how dear he was to you, and be brave.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_TAYNOR_000_408: O-Oh! I'm not half so eloquent as you, but I hope that it helps!
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_CYELLA_000_501: I was in the Exedra. I saw everything.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_CYELLA_000_502: That was Ardbert...and it was not. Twice now he has appeared, calling the people to arms. Speaking of “heroes.”
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_CYELLA_000_503: I knew this day might come. Ardbert never did reappear as a Virtue.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_CYELLA_000_504: But to see his flesh stolen by the selfsame Ascian that made mock of their sacrifice...
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_CYELLA_000_505: I spent years searching for a means to redeem their legacy. His legacy. And in you, I found it. You slew the Virtues, reclaimed the stars...
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_CYELLA_000_506: You spoke the truth, and the people listened. When I heard our patrons speak of how the Warriors of Light had been their saviors all along, I thought at last, at long last...
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_CYELLA_000_507: I cannot ask more of you, not after what you've given. But I must.
TEXT_LUCKMH110_03770_CYELLA_000_508: Set him free. Lay him to rest with the others, in honor and triumph.

TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_GUIDEOFTHEPENDANTS_: Ah,  . Will you be venturing forth today?
Do be sure to take care if so. Though they say the starshower was harmless, one can never be too careful.
...But I concede it is not for me to tell the Warrior of Darkness how to look after . Old habits, you understand.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_014: Greetings, my friend. Do you perchance have a moment to spare?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_016: I wanted to thank you, you see. For revealing to us the truth of the Warriors of Light.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_017: After all these years, your tale set the record straight. Finally, the people see them as the great heroes they were.
