TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_018: Or the great hero he is in the case of Ardbert. You too were surprised to see him, I think?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_019: At the time, I was not certain what to make of it all, but I could see the effect his words had on those around me. And then the stars rained down from the sky, and...well, you know the rest.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_020: When the commotion died down, you were nowhere to be seen, but I was determined to express my gratitude. And so here I am.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_021: Thank you, ─for giving voice to the truth, and restoring the Warriors of Light to their rightful place in history.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_022: Should you, perhaps, wish to have your account of these matters committed to writing, I would be more than willing to serve as your scribe. Indeed, if there is anything I can do to help─anything at all─you need only say the word.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_A1_000_024: What can you tell me about the Warriors of Light?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_A1_000_025: Very well. Tell me what the situation is like in the city.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_026: I beg your pardon? You wish to ask me about the Warriors of Light?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_027: Forgive me, but I daresay you already know more about them than any living soul─save for Ardbert himself, of course.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_028: Unless...you refer to the Warriors of Light more broadly?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_029: If so, I may yet be able to assist you in some small way.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_030: The situation in the city? Do you mean...the people's awakening as Warriors of Light?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_031: Well, while questions remain about the circumstances surrounding Ardbert's return, history tells us that what took place may not be entirely unprecedented.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_032: Ah, but to understand that requires an understanding of “Warriors of Light” in a broader Vrandtic context.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_033: If it please you, I should be glad to provide an overview. I flatter myself that it may grant you a better grasp of that which is occurring not only in the Crystarium, but the world at large.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_034: Excellent! I shall return to the Cabinet at once and look up the relevant texts. Pray join me at your earliest convenience.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_GUIDEOFTHEPENDANTS_: No rest for the righteous, it would seem.
Do not let me keep you, . I bid you a pleasant day.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_050: Ah, , excellent timing. I have but this moment finished gathering the materials for our lesson.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_051: As a great many works make reference to the Warriors of Light, I shall─with your permission─focus only upon the details that seem most relevant.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_052: The Warriors of Light, you say? Forgive us, but we couldn't help overhearing.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALISAIE_000_053: We've been out keeping watch over the Crystarium, but it appears to be business as usual.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALISAIE_000_054: So I thought I'd spend some time brushing up my knowledge of familiars, and Alphinaud volunteered to help.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RYNE_000_055: I...actually came on a different errand, but I'd be interested in hearing about the Warriors of Light as well.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_057: Of course, of course! The more the merrier!
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_058: If you would care to find a table below, I shall be down with the books in a moment.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_059: Were one to pore over the annals of Vrandtic history, one would note the comparatively frequent recurrence of individuals hailed as “Warriors of Light.”
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_060: Ardbert and his comrades require no introduction, but many others bore the epithet long before them.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_061: To name but a few, there was Tolthewil, legendary first king of Lakeland, Roddfort and Saulard, the fabled Drahn and Galdjent duo of Voeburt...
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_062: And no list of Vrandtic heroes would be complete without the archmage Tiuna of Ronka. In older texts, she too was called a Warrior of Light.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALISAIE_000_063: It did surprise me how ready people were to forget the negative associations of the title. But it makes sense if it's been around for centuries.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_064: Verily. In ages past, it was simply a synonym for “hero.”
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_065: In the wake of the Flood, however, Light came to be regarded with fear; the title used not to exalt, but to revile.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_066: A far cry from its beginnings...
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_067: This, my friends, is Norvrandt's oldest epic. The original tale of the struggle between good and evil.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_068: In a time when all lay shrouded in Darkness, a prophesied hero rose to deliver the world from its doom. Fighting in the name of the Light, the hero styled himself its foot soldier. And thus did he come to be known as “The Warrior of Light.”
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_069: Curiously, in the centuries that followed, other heroes appeared who claimed the selfsame epithet, despite sharing no discernible connection with their predecessors.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_070: And in time, Warrior of Light came to be a name accorded to all men and women of uncommon skill and valor.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_072: As you know, the title of Warrior of Light is also used in the Source.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_073: Though the manners in which individuals have earned it are many and varied, heroes have been honored thus since antiquity.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_074: Nor does the custom show any sign of dying out─as you can well attest.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RYNE_000_075: It makes you wonder, doesn't it... It surely can't be a coincidence.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_077: Let us imagine a man who has awakened to the Echo and is able to hear Hydaelyn's voice. As She styles him, so too does he style himself─a Warrior of Light.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_078: Of course, being blessed with the Echo does not in itself make one a hero. And conversely, there will have been no few heroes who were not blessed with it.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_079: But such distinctions are immaterial to the masses, and over time they came to use the title “Warrior of Light” and the word “hero” interchangeably.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALISAIE_000_080: Sounds about right. It would be interesting to see if the theory holds true in the other worlds─if crossing the rift were that easy.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_A2_000_082: Hydaelyn did call me a Warrior of Light.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_A2_000_083: What's in a name? It doesn't change anything.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_A2_000_084: And there I was thinking I was special...
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RYNE_000_085: She did? I've never heard Her voice myself.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RYNE_000_086: But I can feel Her presence. Perhaps through Minfilia.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RYNE_000_087: Well...I think a name can mean a lot. And I imagine it would be terrible to have people call you something which didn't feel right.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RYNE_000_088: B-But you are special! No matter how many Warriors of Light there are out there, there's no one like you!
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALISAIE_000_089: At any rate, assuming all of this is true, and there's a common thread behind the epithet, I doubt the Ascians will have been amused.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALISAIE_000_090: To have the world at large associate Light, and by extension Hydaelyn, with “good” must have added insult to injury.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_091: Ahem. While this discussion is undeniably fascinating, I wonder...should I be privy to it? Mayhap it would be better if I excused myself...?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_092: Oh! No need for that, my friend! Pray accept our apologies. Your lesson on the Warriors of Light has given us much to ponder...
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_093: (-Little Girl's Voice-)Ooh, ooh! Did someone say Warriors of Light!?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_095: Ahhh, my precious tomes... <sigh> Did I not say you must take care in the Cabinet?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_100: M-My name's Riqi-Tio, and...and I want to help everyone!
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_101: Please, tell me what I have to do to be a hero─to be a Warrior of Light!
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_110: Setting aside our misgivings, it would seem churlish to discourage the young lady. Let's hear what she has to say.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALISAIE_000_115: No harm done. To the children, at least...
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RYNE_000_120: Even children want to become Warriors of Light...
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_125: The children's inquisitiveness is to be commended, but...ahhh, my precious tomes...
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_EIRWEL_000_130: We're sorry we knocked over the books...
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ARKIL_000_136: When you returned from the sea with the Exarch, I asked you how you became so strong.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_140: So, I want to be a Warrior of Light. But not one that fights with a sword and all that.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_141: No, I want to be the kind that fights with potions and heals people! An apothecary!
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_142: And I'm going to help everyone in the Crystarium. No, in all of Norvrandt!
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_143: When I told Arkil and Eirwel this, they said that the Cabinet should have lots of tomes about potions.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_144: But this place is so big, and we don't have the faintest idea where to begin searching. At this rate, I'm not going to get anywhere...
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_145: If one knew where to look, one should indeed be able to find treatises on potions here. Even so, I fear they may prove a little difficult for ones so young. But hmmm...
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_146: Esteemed Warrior of Darkness, perhaps you might accompany young Riqi-Tio to Spagyrics? Rather than through tomes, I believe she stands to learn more by observing the chirurgeons at their work.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALISAIE_000_147: Sounds like a plan. It seems we've finished here, so we'll come with you.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_A3_000_149: Last one to Spagyrics is a rotten egg!
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_A3_000_150: I'll go, but only for a little while.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_A3_000_151: I don't have time for this...
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_152: Hah, I'll have you know I'm really fast! You're going to be the rotten egg!
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_153: Really? Thank you so much, Warrior of Darkness! We'll see you at Spagyrics!
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_154: I know you are a busy , but we can't well leave them without guidance. And it would only be for a little while.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_155: You can find your way to Spagyrics, I trust? Off you go, then, and have care you do not knock anything else over.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_MOREN_000_160: I shall remain here and tidy up. I hope that today's lesson will be of some use to you.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_165: See how her eyes shine, my friend. We have made her day.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_170: Ascian machination or no, it wouldn't do to dash the dreams of one so young. The Exarch would feel the same, I believe.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALISAIE_000_175: A warrior who fights with potions... It's certainly innovative. I prefer a blade myself, but to each her own.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RYNE_000_180: It appears there aren't so many patients at the moment. I only pray that such peaceful days continue.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_185: Right, I'm here! What do I do? What do I do?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ARKIL_000_190: Chessamile's medicines work really well. I just wish they didn't taste so bad.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_EIRWEL_000_195: After you've finished helping Riqi, can you help us become Warriors of Light too?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_CHESSAMILE_000_200: Well now, to what do I owe the pleasure of so many bright-eyed visitors?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_CHESSAMILE_000_201: Is that the way of it, sweetie? You wish to learn about medicine?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_202: That's right! I want to become a Warrior of Light who uses potions to help people all over the world!
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_CHESSAMILE_000_203: Well, that is a very noble endeavor, and you aren't alone in it. No few at our infirmary yearn to venture forth as Warriors of Light.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_CHESSAMILE_000_204: But ultimately, they have all decided not to pursue that dream.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_CHESSAMILE_000_206: Because the people here need them too, sweetie.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_CHESSAMILE_000_207: The guards who place themselves in harm's way to keep us safe. The artisans who toil tirelessly that we might sustain our way of life. And younglings like you, who are the future of the Crystarium.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_CHESSAMILE_000_208: They couldn't simply abandon them, you see. And so, difficult though it was, they made the decision to remain.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_209: Then...does this mean my dream isn't any good?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_CHESSAMILE_000_210: Oh, sweetie, yours is a wonderful dream. And it would be my pleasure to help you to pursue it.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_CHESSAMILE_000_211: If we all work hard, the day will come when our chirurgeons may set forth to aid folk in every corner of the realm.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_CHESSAMILE_000_212: As we strive towards that day, I hope that we can rely upon you as well. Though I must warn you, ours is not an easy path. No, you must work very, very hard.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_213: I'm not afraid of hard work! I'll become the best apothecary ever, just you watch!
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_CHESSAMILE_000_214: Hee hee, that's the spirit! Without further ado, then, may I entrust you with a task?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_CHESSAMILE_000_215: I have placed an order at Sweetsieve for a potion ingredient, and I would like you to go and collect it.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_216: Ooh, an ingredient! Leave it to me, miss!
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_CHESSAMILE_000_217: My, such an abundance of energy. Though I can't help wonder if she'll be all right by herself...
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_CHESSAMILE_000_218: My apologies, but would you mind accompanying her? When you arrive at Sweetsieve, speak with a woman named Gracine, and she will point you in the right direction.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_219: I shall join you. As the one who suggested this course to Riqi-Tio, I would assist in her first steps.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALISAIE_000_220: And what about the two of you? Are you coming along too?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_EIRWEL_000_221: Well, we do want to become Warriors of Light, just not the same kind as Riqi.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_EIRWEL_000_222: So we'll wait for you here, Warrior of Darkness. When you return, please teach us how to fight!
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALISAIE_000_223: In that case, Ryne and I shall keep them company and take the opportunity to ask about their aspirations.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALISAIE_000_230: Too many grown-ups would only diminish Riqi-Tio's sense of accomplishment. We'll stay here and talk to her friends.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RYNE_000_235: If it's to be had at Sweetsieve, I assume the ingredient is some manner of crop.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ARKIL_000_240: We know you're busy, but we want to be just like you. We hope you'll teach us how.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_EIRWEL_000_245: We won't move an ilm until you return!
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_CHESSAMILE_000_250: Thank you, sweetie. I feel better knowing that you're keeping an eye on Riqi-Tio.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_255: Ah, there you are. As it turns out, the ingredient still wants for harvesting, so we are going about that now.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_GRACINE_000_270: <gasp> If it isn't the Warrior of Darkness ! May I assume you are with Master Alphinaud?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_GRACINE_000_271: Right. Lest you wonder, Chessamile's order is for grapes.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_GRACINE_000_272: As busy as we have been of late, however, I regret to say we didn't have the time to harvest them.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_GRACINE_000_273: So it was with apologies that I asked Master Alphinaud and his young companion to help themselves to the fruits on the vines. Perhaps you could lend them a hand?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_GRACINE_000_274: It's the undersized grapes you'll want to pick. They're too small for normal consumption, but suitable for making wine and medicine.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_GRACINE_000_280: My apologies again for failing to have the grapes ready. Next time, please let us treat you to the pick of the crop!
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_290: I've harvested all the undersized grapes I could find here. How goes the picking effort?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_300: Oh, you're here too? We're picking little grapes. It's quite fun!
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_301: Wow, you've picked this many already!? Amazing!
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_302: I daresay we have enough between us. Shall we take them back to Chessamile?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_303: Heh heh! I can't wait to see what she's going to do with them!
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_304: Tell me, Riqi─what made you want to become an apothecary and Warrior of Light?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_306: A while ago, I fell sick. Really sick. My body was burning up, and I felt so weak I couldn't even get out of bed.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_307: Then a traveling apothecary came and gave me a potion to drink. It was the foulest thing I'd ever tasted...but it made me get better!
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_308: She was so brave─the apothecary, I mean. She went around taking care of people, even when it was dangerous. And I decided I wanted to help people, just like her.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_309: So I started brewing potions out of grass and giving them to my friends. But I didn't really know what I was doing, or if there was anything else I could do.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_310: Then not long ago, a neighbor told me he was going to become a Warrior of Light, and go traveling the world, helping people.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_311: And I thought, that's the same as what I want to do!
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_312: I see. Out of curiosity, what did your neighbor do in the end?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_313: Theyler? I haven't seen him for a bit, so he must already be out there looking for people to help.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_314: Theyler... One of the guards awakened by the starshower.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_315: Thank you for sharing your tale with us, Riqi-Tio. I myself took inspiration from one not unlike your traveling apothecary, and I hope her good example will spur you on to realize your dreams.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_316: But it will not be done in a day. Such lofty goals are reached through hard work and persistence, through countless little acts of heroism─like delivering the grapes to Chessamile.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_317: ...It would seem I have been laboring under a misapprehension.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_318: I had convinced myself that it was Elidibus who had sowed the desire to become Warriors of Light within the hearts of the people.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_319: But I see now that the impulse to aid their fellow man abided within them from the first.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_320: Elidibus did no more than give it a name.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_321: And as he so kindly proclaimed, we must return to our own world ere long.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_322: With the Exarch laboring tirelessly, I doubt not but that a way will be found.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_323: Yet I believe I speak for us all when I say I cannot leave in good conscience─not until we have dealt with Elidibus.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_324: This is no longer a strange and distant land, after all. Norvrandt has become as a home to us, and her people our own.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_325: Hm. Let us return to Spagyrics. It wouldn't do to keep your admirers waiting.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALPHINAUD_000_330: Riqi-Tio has delivered her grapes, as have I.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ALISAIE_000_335: After chatting with Arkil and Eirwel here, we came to an agreement─but I'll let them explain their request themselves.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RYNE_000_340: Riqi-Tio was beaming with pride when she returned.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RYNE_000_345: It may only have been a simple task, but she won't soon forget this achievement.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_RIQITIO_000_350: Thanks for helping with the grapes, Warrior of Darkness. In return, I promise to brew you a potion one day!
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_ARKIL_000_355: Riqi didn't make you drink one of her grass potions, did she?
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_EIRWEL_000_360: Huzzah, you're back! We're ready to start learning!
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_CHESSAMILE_000_370: My thanks for your kind help, sweetie. We now have all the ingredients we require.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_CHESSAMILE_000_371: From the grapes we shall make a vinegar, to which we will add elf grass and a few other herbs to produce an invigorating syrup. Though it's unspeakably sour, it does wonders for the constitution.
TEXT_LUCKMI101_03771_CHESSAMILE_000_372: As part of her studies, I may just have to give Riqi-Tio a little taste. Hee hee!
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Riqi-Tio has duly delivered her grapes, as have I.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_005: After chatting with Arkil and Eirwel here, we came to an agreement─but I'll let them explain their request themselves.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_RYNE_000_010: Riqi-Tio was beaming with pride when she returned.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_RYNE_000_015: It may only have been a simple task, but she won't soon forget this achievement.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_RIQITIO_000_020: Thanks for helping with the grapes, Warrior of Darkness. In return, I promise to brew you a potion one day!
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ARKIL_000_025: Riqi didn't make you drink one of her grass potions, did she?
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_EIRWEL_000_040: Warrior of Darkness! If you've finished helping Riqi, won't you show us some fighting? Not play fighting, but honest-to-gods fighting?
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_EIRWEL_000_041: We already have some enemies that you can deal with: vampire bats! The guards say they've become a pest around the Crystarium of late.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_EIRWEL_000_042: We tried to sneak outside to hunt them, but the guards caught us and sent us home... But they shouldn't mind if you were doing the fighting and we were just watching!
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_043: The children told us as much while you were away. And in preparation, Chessamile kindly furnished us with some lures for the bats.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_044: While the creatures won't give you any sport, bear in mind that the younglings will be watching. That's to say: put on a good show, yes?
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_045: Right, let's head outside at once. Everyone, follow me!
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_RYNE_000_046: A-Alisaie, wait just a─ <sigh> Come on, then, children.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALPHINAUD_000_050: I shall remain here with Riqi-Tio. The other children, I leave in your care─my unruly sister included.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_RIQITIO_000_055: What? Everyone's going outside to see you fight? <whimper> I want to watch too...
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_RIQITIO_000_056: But...no! I have to study! I'll stay here and help Chessamile make the syrup!
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_CHESSAMILE_000_060: Be careful out there, yes? But if you can't be careful, you can always come back here.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_RYNE_000_065: It should be safe enough for the children here.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ARKIL_000_070: We've heard the tales, but at last we can see you fight with our own eyes!
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_EIRWEL_000_075: We've been waiting for you, Warrior of Darkness!
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_080: Everyone's here. Good. Let's get started, shall we?
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_081: As their name suggests, vampire bats feed on blood. And originally being nocturnal creatures, they've grown more active with the return of night and become a nuisance.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_082: To draw them out, we'll use Chessamile's lures, which work by exploiting their heat-seeking behavior.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_083: The bats are wont to nest under the eaves, so you are like to attract more if you place the lures near buildings.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_084: I have here six lures─three each for you and me. As proof of a successful kill, I want you to gather up their fangs. Whoever collects the most is the winner!
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_086: Y-Yes, well, there's nothing like friendly competition to bring out the best in !
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_087: Anyway! While we hunt the bats, the two of you are to stay with Ryne. She's really strong too, and will keep you safe.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_088: Without further ado, then, let the contest begin!
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_RYNE_000_090: Don't mind us. We'll be watching from a safe distance.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ARKIL_000_095: I won't blink! Not even once!
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_EIRWEL_000_100: So the bats nest under the eaves... It's important to know your enemy!
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_EIRWEL_000_115: The bats didn't stand a chance!
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_RYNE_000_120: Well fought, ! The children were hanging on your every move!
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_RYNE_000_121: ...As was I, to be honest. Though I know the tally, may I see your fangs for good measure?
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_123: My fangs. Not a bad haul, even if I do say so myself.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_RYNE_000_124: ...Five, six, seven. Seven fangs from Alisaie.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_RYNE_000_125: ...Which means that victory goes to , who collected !
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_126: Bah, seems you found the better spots for the lures.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_127: I would be lying if I said I wasn't disappointed, but you're still within reach. I'll get the better of you next time!
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_RYNE_000_128: ...Which means that we have a draw!  also collected seven fangs!
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_129: Argh, why does this feel even worse than losing? Just another measly fang and victory would have been mine!
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_130: Don't look so surprised! I've no intention of remaining lost in your wake forever, you know!
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_RYNE_000_131: ...Which means that victory goes to Alisaie!  collected !
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_132: Hah, I did it! I bested ...
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_133: ...In another godsdamned life! You didn't even try, did you!?
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_134: <sigh> And there I was taking it seriously... Spare me your pity next time, will you?
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_135: ...So, children─you've now seen the Warrior of Darkness in action. What are your impressions?
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_EIRWEL_000_136: 's incredible, miss! The bats were down before they knew it!
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_EIRWEL_000_137: Our guards are strong, but the Warrior of Darkness is much, much stronger! We want to be just like !
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_138: Good. If you're looking for an example to emulate, you may as well pick the best.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_139: I want you to remember how you felt when you watched , and train hard. Keep at it for long enough and you'll be strong too.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_RYNE_000_140: If you don't mind telling us, when did you decide that you wanted to become Warriors of Light?
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_EIRWEL_000_141: Well, we were there listening with everyone when Ardbert appeared, but I've wanted to be strong since before I came to the Crystarium.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_EIRWEL_000_142: The sin eaters killed my father and my sister, see, and I promised myself I'd learn how to protect people one day.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_EIRWEL_000_143: Like Ardbert said, this is our home. We're the ones who have to protect it. We're the ones who have to rise up as new Warriors of Light!
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ARKIL_000_145: M-Me? To be honest, I'm still not sure what I want to do.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ARKIL_000_146: But if my friends were in trouble, I know that I would want to help them.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ARKIL_000_147: And...I want to go on adventures with them. See the world together.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ARKIL_000_150: It's hard to explain...but it's something I felt when I saw the starshower the other day.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ARKIL_000_151: I felt as though...there was something I'd lost, and that I had to go out there and find it.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_152: Well, for the both of you, there's nothing for it but to train. When we return to the city, I'll teach you some exercises you can do by yourselves.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ARKIL_000_153: Thanks for showing us your fighting skills, Warrior of Darkness! We'll never forget it!
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_155: The starshower didn't awaken me to Hydaelyn's voice. But that vision of the Final Days, of Amaurot burning...
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_156: It filled me with sadness to the very pit of my being.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_157: Things I once knew, people I once loved, promises I once made... It felt as though long-forgotten memories were dancing at the edges of my mind. But when I try to focus on them, they simply fade away.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_158: An effect of having a fractured soul, I shouldn't doubt. But lest you worry, I'm perfectly happy to remain fractured and have no intention of donning an Ascian mask.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_159: <sigh> I just wish we knew what Elidibus was plotting...
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_160: Hah, but look at this pair of incurable brooders... If we're going to stand around, lost in thought, we may as well do it back in the city.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_161: Rest assured, Ryne and I will take the children from here. Their heads will be in the clouds after meeting you, but we'll see to it their feet remain firmly planted on the ground.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_163: It's nothing. Just a dizzy spell. Seems I tried a little too hard to beat you.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_ALISAIE_000_164: I'm fine now, not to worry. I'll see you soon.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_SYSTEM_000_165: As you ponder Alisaie's words, you are taken by an urge to revisit the scene of that fateful meeting...
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_RYNE_000_170: I'm so glad I found both you and the Exarch.
TEXT_LUCKMI102_03772_MYSTERYVOICE_000_18: The fates seem determined not to allow us a quiet moment. But come, let us have the details from Ryne.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_MYSTERYVOICE_000_00: The rest of our conversation must wait. Let us hear the situation from Ryne.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_RYNE_000_010: It happened after Alisaie and I saw the children back to Spagyrics.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_RYNE_000_011: We chanced to meet Thancred there, returning from his mission.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_RYNE_000_012: He'd been shadowing Elidibus around the realm, only to lose sight of him near the Crystarium.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_RYNE_000_013: And he was in the middle of telling us where he'd been when he just...crumpled to the ground.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_RYNE_000_014: The chirurgeons are looking after him now, with Alphinaud standing by, just in case his healing magicks are needed.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_RYNE_000_015: Since I couldn't do anything to help, I thought it best to find you, and the guard at the Exedra told me where to look.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_MYSTERYVOICE_000_01: I see. It cannot have been easy leaving Thancred's side. My thanks for bearing word to us.
Come, let us hurry to Spagyrics.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_ALPHINAUD_000_020: I fear this bodes ill...and not just for Thancred.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_ALISAIE_000_025: Ryne found you, then. We had to send the children off earlier than planned, but they understood.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_MYSTERYVOICE_000_03: It appears our friend has already awakened. For that, at least, we can be thankful...
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_CHESSAMILE_000_040: The infirmary is at your disposal. If there is anything you need, don't hesitate to let us know.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_THANCRED_000_050: They dragged you here too, did they? My apologies...
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_THANCRED_000_052: Embarrassed. But otherwise well enough. I won't be staying overnight.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_ALPHINAUD_000_053: This episode was not the result of any injury I could find. Thancred's aether, however, did show signs of instability, and I did what I could to calm the fluctuations.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_MYSTERYVOICE_000_05: Hm. And all of this happened without warning...?
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_THANCRED_000_056: You will doubtless recall the time Urianger nearly drowned and I gallantly went to his rescue.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_RYNE_000_057: When his water-walking charm failed. He was tired. As were you when you got back.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_THANCRED_000_058: We were both spent, yes. On account of which, you begged us to rest─which, in retrospect, may have been a good idea.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_THANCRED_000_059: The fact is, I've been experiencing regular bouts of light-headedness ever since. But there was no actual fainting until now.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_THANCRED_000_060: As Alphinaud observed, I have no lingering injuries, and it most assuredly isn't old age. Which leaves but one likely cause...
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_MYSTERYVOICE_000_06: The link between body and soul has weakened further.
Time grows short. We must complete the spirit vessel with all haste.
To that end, , might I trouble you to make a trip to the Source?
In addition to looking in on our friends' bodies, I would have you consult Krile about our plan. If she has any concerns, we should at least endeavor to address them prior to proceeding.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_THANCRED_000_065: In the meantime, we should get back to laying bare Elidibus's plot.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_THANCRED_000_066: Thus far, I have learned this much: that in each of the places he has visited, there have been sightings of suspicious black-clad strangers.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_THANCRED_000_067: Moreover, the coming of these shady individuals has invariably coincided with some manner of misfortune─beasts terrorizing settlements, blight ravaging crops, you know the sort of thing.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_ALPHINAUD_000_068: All of which serves, rather conveniently, to make Elidibus's call for new heroes reverberate that much more loudly in the hearts of his audience.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_ALPHINAUD_000_069: And you think these black-clad strangers are Ascians.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_THANCRED_000_070: I do. And I fully intend to investigate further─though for that I shall require additional feet on the ground.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_ALISAIE_000_071: You can count on mine. Gods know I've been itching to get out there for a while.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_MYSTERYVOICE_000_07: Mayhap Urianger too can be prevailed upon to join in your efforts.
He has already provided copious guidance on the matter of the spirit vessel's construction. It is for Beq Lugg and I to wrestle with the rest.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_THANCRED_000_074: Well, if you can spare the old boy, we may as well make use of him. I'll go and give him the good news.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_ALISAIE_000_075: You'll do no such thing. However heedless you are of your own well-being, if you care at all for Ryne's feelings, you'll stay in bed until you're needed. Alphinaud and I will find Urianger.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_ALPHINAUD_000_076: All being well, we will have news to share by the time you return. Safe travels, .
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_THANCRED_000_080: Lest you misunderstand, I'm not averse to putting my feet up. It's being coddled like a brittle-boned nonagenarian that chafes.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_RYNE_000_085: I know you cross the rift all the time, but please take care.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_TATARU_000_091: You see, our friends... They've taken a turn for the worse.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_TATARU_000_092: Krile's hardly had a moment's rest these past few days.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_TATARU_000_093: She didn't want everyone to worry, so we've been keeping it quiet...
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_TATARU_000_094: Oh, but listen to me! I call myself a receptionist, and I haven't even bothered to ask you why you're here!
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_TATARU_000_095: So, they think the spirit vessel will be ready soon? And they want to make sure there are no problems at this end...
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_TATARU_000_096: Hm. You'd better talk to Krile.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_TATARU_000_097: She's with the others in Dawn's Respite. Let's go and see her.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_TATARU_000_100: Dawn's Respite is through that door. Lead the way when you're ready.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_TATARU_000_110: As you probably noticed, we've put them in nightclothes. I know they're not exactly asleep, but...it seemed like the right thing to do.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_TATARU_000_111: I've made them some new clothes for when they wake up. So they have to come back. A-And they will!
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_KRILE_000_121: I see. Work on the spirit vessel proceeds apace, but our friends begin to falter...
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_KRILE_000_122: As they themselves have observed, the link between body and soul has weakened. It's as simple as that.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_KRILE_000_123: For now, I'm still able to quell the fluctuations in their aether, but it's only a matter of time.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_KRILE_000_124: We'll lose them if we don't act soon. So if the Exarch is ready to attempt something, let him attempt it.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_KRILE_000_125: As for the spirit vessel itself...
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_KRILE_000_126: If we seek to draw upon Allagan wisdom, we could do worse than consult an expert in the field.
TEXT_LUCKMI103_03773_KRILE_000_127: And I think I know just the man. Time being against us, it may be best if I go and solicit his aid in person─even if it does mean leaving my patients...
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_KRILE_000_000: You've come a long way, so do take your ease while you can.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_010: Um...? Could you spare a moment? While Krile goes and finds this expert of hers, I mean.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_011: There's a gift I was hoping to send to our friends in the First, you see...and since we might be waiting a while, I wondered if you wouldn't mind giving me a hand with it.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_012: My first attempt turned out well, so now I'm going to make it properly.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_013: I'll be in the kitchen at the House of Splendors. Meet me there!
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_KRILE_000_014: Well, I had better be off too. I shall see you soon, either here or at the House, depending on how our patients fare in my absence.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_020: There you are, ! As I'm sure you've guessed, the gift is a bit of home cooking.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_021: Unlike Krile, I can't do much to help our friends directly. But that doesn't mean I've been idle.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_022: No, I've been doing my best for the order, taking on this job and that to keep our coffers full. I've even helped out with the Ishgardian restoration.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_023: And in the course of all this, my culinary skills have come on quite a bit. So I thought, why not make something for our friends?
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_024: It's baking in the oven even as we speak. Shouldn't be long now!
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_025: There! Baked to perfection, even if I do say so myself!
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_030: But not just any old bread! This here is Old World bread. “Archon loaf,” to be precise. It's what they eat over in Sharlayan!
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_031: Doesn't it just! It's called “Archon loaf,” in case you're wondering, and it's what they eat over in Sharlayan.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_032: It is bread, silly! And not just any old bread. This here is Old World bread. “Archon loaf,” to be precise. It's what they eat over in Sharlayan!
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_033: Simple fare, I admit, but I thought it would remind our friends of home.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_034: If nothing else, Krile tells me it's a good source of aether.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_035: So it should lend them a bit of strength at least.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_KRILE_000_036: Mmm-mmmmmm! There truly is nothing like the smell of bread fresh from the oven!
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_037: Krile! And if it isn't Rammbroes too!
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_KRILE_000_038: I trust you require no introductions either, .
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_RAMMBROES_000_039: Greetings, my friend. Full glad am I to see you well.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_RAMMBROES_000_040: I confess, I have a malm-long list of questions to ask you, but I will endeavor to contain my curiosity for the present. I understand our mutual friend is struggling with the application of certain Allagan technologies.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_KRILE_000_041: I have been keeping Rammbroes apprised of events in the First. Suffice it to say, he knows about the Exarch.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_KRILE_000_042: If anyone alive can provide insight into this matter, it is him and his fellow Sons.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_RAMMBROES_000_043: Ahem. Loath as I am to disappoint you after so glowing an endorsement...
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_RAMMBROES_000_044: Memory transference was the sole province of Allagan royalty, its mechanisms closely guarded secrets. If any record of them remains, we have yet to find it. To wit, I regret that I can offer no solution to your problem.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_RAMMBROES_000_045: ...Which begs the question of why I bothered to come here, empty-handed as I am─the answer being, rather brazenly, to ask a favor. I would have you relay a message to our comrade.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_RAMMBROES_000_046: Tell him... Tell him that we never doubted him.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_RAMMBROES_000_047: Never doubted that he would achieve all that he said he would.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_RAMMBROES_000_048: Those of us who remained behind have yet to play our part.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_RAMMBROES_000_049: But when the time comes, he may rest easy in the knowledge that we will most assuredly do so.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_RAMMBROES_000_050: And then the tower shall shine once more as a beacon of hope, in this world and beyond.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_RAMMBROES_000_051: So tell him that we consider his duty done─and that he should follow his heart now.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_KRILE_000_052: Forgive me, but do you say this to discourage him from overexerting himself? Or to encourage him to hold nothing back?
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_RAMMBROES_000_053: That is for our friend to decide, but either way, I daresay a certain someone will be unimpressed.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_KRILE_000_054: Well, there you have it, . If you would be so good as to see Rammbroes's message and Tataru's bread to their intended recipients─along with my report, of course.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_055: Um, Krile? Before I wrap the bread up, would you mind giving it a try? Just to make sure everything's as it should be?
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_KRILE_000_056: But of course! I'm always happy to lend my taste buds!
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_KRILE_000_058: Excuse me, Rammbroes. As a fellow Sharlayan, may I trouble you for your opinion?
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_RAMMBROES_000_059: Well, I usually have mine with a good dollop of rolanberry jam, but I suppose plain is best for sampling purposes.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_061: Oh no... Is it that bad?
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_KRILE_000_062: It is indeed, Tataru. Dense and unpleasant...exactly as it should be!
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_RAMMBROES_000_063: Gahaha! Just so! The very taste of home!
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_RAMMBROES_000_064: As you might expect, our countrymen have amassed a wealth of culinary wisdom from every corner of the world. But our native cuisine is...shall we say, a little lacking.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_RAMMBROES_000_065: In Sharlayan, the majority regard food as a source of nourishment rather than enjoyment. Save for those few who actually research the culinary arts, we pay little heed to the niceties of taste and texture.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_RAMMBROES_100_065: It was against such a gastronomic landscape that what is now called the “Archon loaf” was born, the creation of an Archon who devoted himself to the study of bodily sustenance.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_RAMMBROES_110_065: In order to maximize its nutritional value, he incorporated copious quantities of pulverized fish and vegetable matter into the dough─all with nary a care for those qualities which make bread enjoyable. The result is a flavor that continues to defy description.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_RAMMBROES_000_066: Yet for its many shortcomings, the loaf's nutritional value cannot be denied. And being a damnably convenient way to cater to one's bodily needs, it quickly found an audience amongst busy scholars. Why, when I was a lad, nigh every meal was a sandwich made with this very bread and whatever ingredients happened to be on hand.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_KRILE_000_067: Hm hm! I suspect just about every Archon could say the same.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_KRILE_000_068: Having been away from home for so long, I thought I might have forgotten the taste. But no─it is all too familiar. Ahhh, how it takes me back...
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_RAMMBROES_000_069: If there is enough, perhaps you can spare some for the Exarch? He is certain to appreciate it.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_070: Oh, there's plenty to go around. I'll be sure to wrap up an extra slice!
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_071: , when you deliver the loaf, please be sure to send everyone my regards.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_072: Tell them we're doing everything we can, and that we'll be praying for their safe return until the moment they get back.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_080: Well...it sounds like it'll do them good, anyway.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_TATARU_000_081: And when everything's back to normal, I'll cook something for you too, . Gods know you deserve a treat!
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_BEQLUGG_000_085: Ah, you are returned! Good, good. There is much to discuss. The others are making their way hither as we speak.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_MYSTERYVOICE_000_09: Welcome back, my friend. How was your journey?
By the Twelve... Archon loaf! However did you come by this? I'd swear it had come straight from Sharlayan...
Rammbroes said that, did he? <sigh> His words are very nearly as heavy as the bread...but I appreciate the sentiment.
Should you have the chance, you may tell him that he needn't worry. That which I seek to do, I do of my own volition, and with all my heart.
In pursuing this path, I fully expect to earn the censure of our friends─and to deserve it─but I shall forge on regardless.
Forge on as you yourself did when faced with a similar predicament. So I ask that you have faith in me. In what we do.
...But we were talking about your journey. Before the others arrive, I would hear how their bodies fare.
Oh, and the bread I shall save for later. Though it has been many years, I have not forgotten the feats of mastication required to consume it, nor how unconducive they are to conversation.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_MYSTERYVOICE_000_10: As Beq Lugg said, the test will take a while. I ask for your patience in the meantime.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_BEQLUGG_000_105: Off you go and help your friends. Even assuming the test is a success, I doubt they would feel comfortable leaving with business unfinished.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_ALPHINAUD_000_110: When our grandfather first decided to journey to Eorzea, Alisaie did not take kindly to my silence on the subject. “Don't pretend to understand things you don't,” she said...or rather shouted.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_ALPHINAUD_000_111: Having oft been the object of her scorn, I am predisposed to sympathize with the Exarch, but I do understand how she feels─better now than ever I did, certainly.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_ALISAIE_000_115: I'm sorry, I know it was childish to storm off like that. And probably to feel the way I do as well. Agh, pull yourself together, Alisaie!
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_THANCRED_000_120: I for one support the Exarch's choice. To be alive is to be driven by a purpose, and few are as driven as him.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_RYNE_000_125: It's stupid, but I've never really stopped to think about what would happen once the vessels were complete. And now...
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_RYNE_000_126: No. There's no point. I...I hope the test is a success. Truly.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_URIANGER_000_130: Hast thou a moment, ? I would speak with thee on the matter of the Exarch's mooted return unto the Source.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_URIANGER_000_131: Thou wilt have observed that our friend spake not in certainties. Yet if Beq Lugg hath the right of it, 'tis possible to predict the outcome of his plan with some confidence.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_URIANGER_000_132: And it is their assessment that, given the opportunity, the Exarch's soul should successfully merge with that of his younger self.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_URIANGER_000_133: Which is not to say the process is without complications. For one, the Exarch hath been subjected to an additional Rejoining, an experience which will have wrought a change in his aetherial composition.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_URIANGER_000_134: As thou thyself didst demonstrate in merging with Ardbert, however, there existeth an affinity 'twixt like souls, and this doth give us cause to hope.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_URIANGER_000_135: ...Yet there remaineth one immutable condition upon which success doth hinge.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_URIANGER_000_136: The Exarch must needs recognize his past self as simply that─himself.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_URIANGER_000_137: As our recent travails have demonstrated, memories are essential to the soul. Any discrepancy in the former may feasibly cause the latter to spurn its former flesh.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_URIANGER_000_138: 'Tis a seemingly simple yet complex problem. For nigh on a century, our friend hath striven only to deliver this realm, to deliver thee. And to that singular end did he cast aside his very name, that he might assume the mantle of the Crystal Exarch.
TEXT_LUCKMI104_03774_URIANGER_000_139: Henceforth, none can say what choices our friend will make, but I thought it only right that thou be made aware of these truths.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_ALPHINAUD_000_000: When our grandfather first decided to journey to Eorzea, Alisaie did not take kindly to my silence on the subject. “Don't pretend to understand things you don't,” she said...or rather shouted.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_ALPHINAUD_000_001: Having oft been the object of her scorn, I am predisposed to sympathize with the Exarch, but I do understand how she feels─better now than ever I did, certainly.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_ALISAIE_000_005: I'm sorry, I know it was childish to storm off like that. And probably to feel the way I do as well. Agh, pull yourself together, Alisaie!
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_RYNE_000_010: It's stupid, but I've never really stopped to think about what would happen once the vessels were complete. And now...
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_RYNE_000_011: No. There's no point. I...I hope the test is a success. Truly.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_URIANGER_000_015: Lest there be any doubt, the Exarch hath long been aware of the possibilities he but recently unfolded to us. Wherefore he did refrain from sharing them until now, I cannot say.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_THANCRED_000_020: Right then! While the Exarch literally pours his own sweat and blood into his allotted task, it seems only fair that we attend to our own.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_ALPHINAUD_000_021: Dealing with Elidibus and his minions.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_THANCRED_000_022: Just so. And there is one other matter.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_THANCRED_000_023: In light of our deteriorating health, Y'shtola should not be left alone at Anyder. Might I trouble you to visit her, ? See that all is well?
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_THANCRED_000_024: I would go myself, but I think she might be safer in the hands of one less prone to collapsing.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_THANCRED_000_025: My thanks. You may leave the Ascians to us.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_THANCRED_000_026: Once they are out of the way, we will retire to Eulmore. And when Y'shtola has finished plumbing the depths, I'd like the two of you to join us there.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_ALPHINAUD_000_027: If you are bound for Anyder, I suggest you go via Venmont Yards. Our friends there will be glad to provide a boat for you.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_THANCRED_000_028: Let us be on our way, then. Don't do anything I wouldn't do.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_A1_000_030: Wait, I have a gift for you, from Tataru.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_A1_000_031: I have a delivery from the Source, kupo! Courtesy of one Tataru Taru.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_THANCRED_000_032: From Tataru, you say? Whatever could it be...?
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_THANCRED_000_033: You're a long way from home, moogle. And this is from Tataru, is it? Whatever could it be...?
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_URIANGER_000_034: Archon loaf, thou sayest? Why, even to hear the name doth transport me to times long past...
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_RYNE_000_035: Bread from another world!? May I try some?
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_URIANGER_000_036: Mayest thou, child? Thou must! ...That said, though I personally disagree with the consensus, I do nonetheless advise thee to temper thine expectations.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_THANCRED_000_037: Wiser words have never been uttered.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_ALPHINAUD_000_038: Though it rarely darkened our dining table at home, I can attest that it was standard fare at the Studium. Indeed, a slice was never far from our peers' hands.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_ALISAIE_000_039: Alphinaud, you really are an unbearable snob sometimes, do you know that?
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_THANCRED_000_040: What I believe my colleagues are trying to say is that we appreciate the gesture. Tell Tataru we'll do our best to return before she's forced to seek further supplementary employment.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_ALISAIE_000_041: Right, let's really be off now. We can find a drink to wash down the bread on the way.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_SHIPWRIGHT03775_000: Oho, if it ain't the Warrior of Darkness ! What brings you to these parts?
Headin' out to sea, eh? But of course we'd be happy to help! Just say the word, and I'll ready a boat.
Oh, you're back. Headin' out again, are you?
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_ELIDIBUS_000_070: You are familiar with this place, I believe. This...remembered Amaurot.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_ELIDIBUS_000_071: Proceed to the Capitol. I shall return your comrade to you there.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_ELIDIBUS_000_075: You speak as if you were disappointed in me. Why?
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_ELIDIBUS_000_076: I am your enemy, and you mine. Our goals are in conflict, and we are fated to clash.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_ELIDIBUS_000_077: Or had you hoped that feigned sympathy and false understanding would cast your crimes in a less reprehensible light? That I would come to look upon you as a friend?
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_ELIDIBUS_000_078: You who have slaughtered my people. Who would tear down everything we have built.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_ELIDIBUS_000_079: You do not deny it, then. Very well, let us change the cast of this trial. You will know what you have stolen from us.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_ELIDIBUS_000_080: But do not imagine I crave remorse. Only justice.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_ELIDIBUS_000_091: But surely no more than a foretaste of that which Emet-Selch's conqueror is capable.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_ELIDIBUS_000_092: Such might requires a fairer measure. To compare like with like. Yes...
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_ELIDIBUS_000_093: I shall just have to test you myself.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_ELIDIBUS_000_094: (-Ardbert-)Come on, ! Show me what you can do!
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_YSHTOLA_000_100: It has been an eventful morning─if indeed it is morning. I've no idea how long I was unconscious.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_YSHTOLA_000_101: Regardless, I am gratified to see that my efforts at Anyder have borne fruit. We have confirmed the nature of our foe and his plot.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_YSHTOLA_000_102: Now then, what news from the surface?
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_YSHTOLA_000_103: I see. Then let us make for Eulmore at once. We have much to share with our comrades, Elidibus's parting threat not least of all.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_YSHTOLA_000_104: Ah, but forgive me. It would seem my belongings did not accompany me here. I will need to retrieve them from Anyder.
TEXT_LUCKMI105_03775_YSHTOLA_000_105: With luck, the aetherial stream you traversed still lingers. I won't be long.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_SYSTEM_000_000: A peculiar crystal lies on the floor. Upon its surface, an array of lights twinkle like a tiny constellation of stars...
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_REDCRYSTAL_000_001: (-Crimson Crystal-)...day forth...bring honor to the seat of...
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_SYSTEM_000_002: The distorted voice of an ancient rings out in your mind. A moment preserved in the crystal, it would seem.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_SYSTEM_000_003: You notice something else glinting up ahead.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_SYSTEM_000_010: You find three more crystals lying on the floor. Though they differ in color and decoration, each is identical in shape.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_SYSTEM_000_011: You focus on the crystals, and find that the words they hold ring clearer than before.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_YELLOWCRYSTAL_000_0: (-Yellow Crystal-)Embraced by the earth and caressed by the wind, vibrant life flourishes. All is right in creation.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_GREENCRYSTAL_000_01: (-Green Crystal-)There can be no greater joy than to use our wisdom for the good of our people. No greater pride.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_GRAYCRYSTAL_000_015: (-Grey Crystal-)May all know happiness, now and forevermore.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_SYSTEM_000_016: There do not appear to be any more crystals in the hall. Perhaps it would be wise to continue the search outside.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_SYSTEM_000_020: Your instincts serve you true, and you discover another two crystals.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_SYSTEM_000_021: As you reach out with your consciousness, new voices begin to echo in your mind...
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_SEAGREENCRYSTAL_000: (-Pale Green Crystal-)The heavens are ablaze and the land rent asunder. What will become of the world? Is life itself to be denied?
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_PURPLECRYSTAL_000_0: (-Purple Crystal-)Come what may, we must not surrender to despair. If we but hold fast to hope, we may yet find a path to salvation.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_SYSTEM_000_024: The voices tell an incomplete tale. Might more remain to be found?
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_SYSTEM_000_030: You soon discover two more crystals. Rather too soon, in fact, as if someone wanted you to find them...
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_NAVYCRYSTAL_000_031: (-Blue Crystal-)Everything burns. Crumbles. Decays. I hear the lamentations of my brethren. And soon there will be only silence.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_PEACOCKGREENCRYSTAL: (-Turquoise Crystal-)We will deliver our star from its doom, this we swear. So please, dry your tears.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_SYSTEM_000_033: Whatever awaits at the end of your search, it is plain you have yet to find it.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_SYSTEM_000_040: Sure enough, your persistence is swiftly rewarded, this time with three crystals.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_SKYBLUECRYSTAL_000_: (-Sky Blue Crystal-)The time is come. We shall rewrite the laws of creation. And we shall save our star.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_COLORLESSCRYSTAL_00: (-Colorless Crystal-)From this life, our savior born... May I be worthy of the honor.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_PINKCRYSTAL_000_043: (-Pink Crystal-)I feel my soul turning. Slowly but irrevocably. And the power I wield begins to seem terrible... But this is right. It is right.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_SYSTEM_000_044: The tale the crystals weave seems to near its end, but it isn't over yet...
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_SYSTEM_000_050: With almost melancholy inevitability, the twelfth crystal soon reveals itself to your questing eye.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_SCARLETCRYSTAL_000_: (-Scarlet Crystal-)Though salvation is ours, it came at great sacrifice. All that remains is to pray...
(-Scarlet Crystal-)To pray that we will one day meet again, beneath a blue sky.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_SYSTEM_000_053: Judging by its testimony, it would seem the voice was recorded in the wake of the Final Days.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_SYSTEM_000_054: As you scan the area, another glint catches your eye.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_YSHTOLA_000_060: Ahhh... Fresh air at long last. I would celebrate my return to dry land with a pot of tea─had we the luxury of time.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_YSHTOLA_000_061: But we must be prepared for Elidibus. Given what we know, it is plain he will not be deterred from his course.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_YSHTOLA_000_062: And nor would I, were I him. Not if it meant forsaking everything I loved.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_YSHTOLA_000_063: That said, I have not forgotten how Emet-Selch sought to find common ground with us, for all our misgivings.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_YSHTOLA_000_064: Ultimately, our differences were not to be bridged, of course, but one must always try. Emet-Selch understood this, and if his gesture resonated with you, perhaps you might consider reaching out to his brethren.
TEXT_LUCKMI106_03776_YSHTOLA_000_065: Though it may all be for naught, you of all people know that there is no such thing as a foregone conclusion.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_YSHTOLA_000_000: Right─no more musing. We have taken far too long as it is.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_YSHTOLA_000_001: Our friends await us in Eulmore, yes? Let us hurry and join them.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_ALPHINAUD_000_010: So the rumors have reached this far...
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_ALISAIE_000_015: You certainly took your time. Did something happen?
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_THANCRED_000_020: Ah, there you are. Eventful trip?
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_RYNE_000_025: We were starting to worry─but I see we shouldn't have. No?
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_URIANGER_000_030: 'Tis my pleasure to report that we accomplished our task without further bouts of faintness─a feat we attribute to Tataru's most generous gift.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_CHAINUZZ_000_035: Yes, people have been talking about little else of late...
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_DULIACHAI_000_040: Oh, if it isn't ! I confess, I'm not entirely sure what's going on, but with you and your friends here, I'm sure it will all be all right in the end!
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_WRENDEN_000_045: We have been apprised of the situation. Suffice it to say, we can ill afford to lose able-bodied citizens during this vital period of rebuilding.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_YSHTOLA_000_050: It appears we are fashionably late.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_YSHTOLA_000_051: Come. Our tale will not wait.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_YSHTOLA_000_060: This will be my first time meeting Master Chai in his capacity as mayor. The fellow behind him is his advisor, I take it─Wrenden.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_A1_000_072: Form a party and enter the Heroes' Gauntlet.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_ALPHINAUD_000_075: We should first make for the western edge of Amh Araeng before bending our course towards the Crystarium.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_ALPHINAUD_000_076: This route will allow us to land and contend with the enemy if necessary. Given that they can appear out of thin air, we must be prepared for anything.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_ALISAIE_000_080: First the starshower, then these specters... And something tells me the worst is yet to come.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_ALISAIE_000_081: Urianger is right, though─the Exarch didn't send them. He would sooner harm himself than us.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_ALISAIE_000_082: But that only makes me want to get back to the Crystarium more quickly.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_THANCRED_000_085: Cutting down that swordsman felt like slicing through thin air. I only wish his blade had felt similarly intangible.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_THANCRED_000_086: We must lead them away from the civilians. The rest we can work out en route to the Crystarium.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_THANCRED_000_087: There are sure to be a few surprises along the way, but we are nothing if not resourceful.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_RYNE_000_090: I think they were after us. Us specifically, I mean. And that's not all...
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_RYNE_000_091: I sensed the aura of Light around them. As if they were blessed, like you and me.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_URIANGER_000_095: Fiery stars illuminating a blackened sky... By this vision, many and more shall have awakened to Hydaelyn's voice.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_URIANGER_000_096: And as Elidibus hath designed, their hearts shall swell with the desire for salvation. The desire which doth empower him.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_URIANGER_000_097: We must needs move swiftly against him, ere this mania seizeth every soul, and his might exceedeth all measure.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_YSHTOLA_000_100: If we are dealing with the selfsame magick employed by the Exarch, we may safely assume that our enemies are being summoned from other worlds.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_YSHTOLA_000_101: Beyond that, all is speculation. But I would wager the fact that their summoning seems still less complete than our own has rendered them more susceptible to external influence. The suggestion to kill us, for example.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_YSHTOLA_000_102: But I am musing again. Let us away ere more of them manifest.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_CHAINUZZ_000_105: What are you still doing here!? To the airship with you!
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_DULIACHAI_000_110: I don't know what this sky portends, but I do know it can't be good.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_DULIACHAI_000_111: So please take care, and return to us safe and sound.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_WRENDEN_000_115: We will see that order is restored in the city. Go now, and do not look back.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_EULMOREMANA_000_120: Wh-Who were those ghostly figures? W-Were they the ones talking inside my head?
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_EULMOREMANB_000_125: When the stars were raining down, I thought I saw a city in the sky. But then the fighting broke out, and when I looked again, it was gone...
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_EULMOREMANB_000_126: Did you see it too? It was so beautiful! So heartbreakingly beautiful...
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_GUIDEOFTHEPENDANTS_: M-My ! Sincerest apologies, but the way to your room is blocked at the moment. In their rush to see the starshower, a number of residents lost their footing and fell down the stairs, you see... Our chirurgeons are presently attending to them, and we ask for your patience and understanding until such time as they can be moved.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_BEQLUGG_000_130: Don't worry about me─I merely need a rest... Go on, off with you! I'd be no help at all...
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_MYSTERYVOICE_000_14: With your permission, I would make a brief stop at Accensor Gate─just long enough to send the guard to Beq Lugg's aid, you understand.
Were it not for them, we would never have escaped Elidibus, much less with the spirit vessels.
Though mine fell into our foe's clutches, Beq Lugg gathered up the rest at great risk to themself.
I must see that they are safe before we press on. Enough good people have given their lives that I might fulfill my duty.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_CRYSTARIUMGUARD0377: W-Warrior of Darkness! Exarch! Forgive us this paltry greeting. We were not notified of your coming!
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_MYSTERYVOICE_000_15: It wasn't planned. I need you to assemble a rescue party.
Our friend Beq Lugg lies wounded in a clearing to the west. Pray go to their aid with all haste.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_CRYSTARIUMGUARD0377: At once, my lord! M-May I ask how they came to harm?
There've been reports of enemies in our midst─specters who appeared after the starshower. Do they have something to do with it?
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_MYSTERYVOICE_000_15: Yes. The man who attacked Beq Lugg is also responsible for the starshower and the appearance of the specters.
I have no time to explain, but know that the individual in question does not seek to do indiscriminate harm. If you do not bar his servants' path, they will not turn on you.
You are to leave this foe to us, understood? Meanwhile, I ask that you alert the rest of the guard, and focus on maintaining calm in the city.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_LYNA_000_160: I shall take charge of matters in the city. Find Beq Lugg─now!
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_LYNA_000_162: The graver the matter, the less inclined you are to speak of it. Even when it is plain for all to see─like what is happening to you.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_MYSTERYVOICE_000_16: Lyna... This time there truly is no time.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_LYNA_000_164: I know, my lord. Were matters otherwise, I believe you would even be willing to speak of your past if pressed.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_LYNA_000_165: Yet I remain afraid to do so.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_LYNA_000_166: Afraid that what I might learn would make a stranger of you.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_A2_000_169: Perhaps a few words are in order.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_MYSTERYVOICE_000_17: I know, my friend. I know. Just...grant me a moment. Please.
...Lyna. Do you remember the time you got lost in the tower when you were little, and I searched for you for hours on end?
And the cake I baked for your tenth nameday. That hideous lump the good people of the Mean covered up with beautiful candles...
And your hapless first encounter with the sin eaters as a guard. Afterwards, you threw yourself into your training, pretending nothing was wrong, though I could see the tears in your eyes...
All these moments that we shared, all the feelings that accompanied them...they are as real as aught that came before, and nothing will ever change that─will ever change what we mean to one another.
If I have made you worry, then I beg your forgiveness. Heavens know you deserve better.

Through the darkest of times, you have kept faith with me, standing tall as a proud daughter of the Crystarium─as an example to us all. I count myself blessed to have had you in my life, and I want you to know that.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_LYNA_000_179: Why do you speak so? As if this were our last meeting? Truly, you have a knack for making people worry.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_LYNA_000_180: Besides, it is you who are an example to us all. You who have led us through countless trials. And you who will lead us through countless trials to come.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_LYNA_000_181:
So go, my lord. Do what you must.
...But take care.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_MYSTERYVOICE_000_20: The ward holds. Excellent. Elidibus will still be within the tower.

Our foe's sole purpose is to destroy you, and to that end he has summoned heroes from other reflections, empowering himself with their hope even as they occupy your comrades. You will not best him as easily as you did in the depths. By any measure, the odds are now stacked firmly in his favor.
To wit, spare no preparation, my friend. I shall lift the ward only when you are ready.
TEXT_LUCKMI107_03777_SYSTEM_000_203: You may now enter the Heroes' Gauntlet with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_LUCKMI108_03778_GUIDEOFTHEPENDANTS_: M-My ! Sincerest apologies, but the way to your room is blocked at the moment. In their rush to see the starshower, a number of residents lost their footing and fell down the stairs, you see... Our chirurgeons are presently attending to them, and we ask for your patience and understanding until such time as they can be moved.
TEXT_LUCKMI108_03778_MYSTERYVOICE_000_00: You are ready, then? Very well. I shall lift the ward.
TEXT_LUCKMI108_03778_A1_000_003: You know, it wasn't so long ago that I watched you seal the place up.
TEXT_LUCKMI108_03778_MYSTERYVOICE_000_00: And finish it we shall. For no hero our foe could summon to his side shall ever compare to you! And...as for me...well, no ally you could summon to your side will ever try harder, that much I swear.
So come, my friend! Let's finish this─once and for all!
Hm? Ah, before I began my slumber, you mean? Ha! It seems rather longer to me. But yes, what strange symmetry.
This time, I break the seal, and I have no intention of locking myself away again.
Nay, together we will enter, and together we will leave─in triumph. So come, my friend. Let us be about it!
TEXT_LUCKMI108_03778_GUIDESOLDIER03643_0: ! Will you be entering the tower?
TEXT_LUCKMI108_03778_Q2_000_0011: Proceed to the Seat of Sacrifice?
TEXT_LUCKMI108_03778_ALPHINAUD_000_020:
At such moments, it is hard to know what to say...
...Are you all right, my friend?
TEXT_LUCKMI108_03778_ALISAIE_000_025: You did well, ─you and the Exarch...
TEXT_LUCKMI108_03778_THANCRED_000_030: Shortly after you left, we observed that our enemy's ranks were no longer being replenished─presumably when your absence was noted. So we polished them off and came as quickly as we could.
TEXT_LUCKMI108_03778_THANCRED_000_031: ...Which is to say, not quickly enough. But then you had the Exarch for company, didn't you, and you could ask for no better than that.
TEXT_LUCKMI108_03778_URIANGER_000_035: Ere we descended from the throne room, I did chance upon an object which, if I have the right of it, did once─
TEXT_LUCKMI108_03778_URIANGER_000_036: ...Hm. M-Mine apologies. Mayhap now is not an appropriate time. Let us speak of it later.
TEXT_LUCKMI108_03778_YSHTOLA_000_040: Sometimes, I wish that I too had been gifted with the Echo. Then I might see what you have seen and glimpse into your heart without the need for words.
TEXT_LUCKMI108_03778_RYNE_000_050: ...Hm? Am I all right? I should be the one asking you...
TEXT_LUCKMI108_03778_RYNE_000_051: But yes, I'm fine, thank you. We all are.
TEXT_LUCKMI108_03778_RYNE_000_052: The people are fine, the city's fine, and the starshowers have stopped.
TEXT_LUCKMI108_03778_RYNE_000_053: It's almost as if we'd gone back to the peaceful days that followed the night's return. Almost.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALPHINAUD_000_000:
At such moments, it is hard to know what to say...
...Are you all right, my friend?
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALISAIE_000_005: You did well, ─you and the Exarch...
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_THANCRED_000_010: Shortly after you left, we observed that our enemy's ranks were no longer being replenished─presumably when your absence was noted. So we polished them off and came as quickly as we could.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_THANCRED_000_011: ...Which is to say, not quickly enough. But then you had the Exarch for company, didn't you, and you could ask for no better than that.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_URIANGER_000_015: Ere we descended from the throne room, I did chance upon an object which, if I have the right of it, did once─
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_URIANGER_000_020: ...Hm. M-Mine apologies. Mayhap now is not an appropriate time. Let us speak of it later.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_RYNE_000_025: The only way is forward. So I have to believe that whatever lies ahead will be better than what came before.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_YSHTOLA_000_030: . If you are ready, would you recount to us how the day unfolded?
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_YSHTOLA_000_031: ...So you reached out to Elidibus at the last...and his heart was moved.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_A1_000_033: I'm not sure I did the right thing.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_A1_000_035: I only did as you asked.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_YSHTOLA_000_036: Perhaps you did. Perhaps you did not. None can say.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_YSHTOLA_000_037: Perhaps not. Ultimately, you had no choice but to strike him down.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_YSHTOLA_000_039: But the important thing is this: though violence proved unavoidable, you did at least come to understand your foe.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_YSHTOLA_000_040: And in knowing his hopes and dreams do we best remember him─him and his legacy.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_YSHTOLA_000_041: So long as they remain unforgotten, the love he and his brethren bore for one another and the star may yet be rewarded.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALPHINAUD_000_042: You said that an ancient came to your aid. But how is that possible?
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_YSHTOLA_000_043: A gift from Emet-Selch. He knew of Elidibus's plight. Foreseeing his own death, he made provisions to bring Elidibus's suffering to an end, lest his friend be left to continue the struggle alone.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_YSHTOLA_000_044: Or so I wildly speculate. It is unlikely we will ever know the truth.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_YSHTOLA_000_045: The best we can do is to remember events as they happened, no more and no less. As the Ronkans so rightly put it, “History is learned, not lived.”
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_URIANGER_000_047: My friend! We were given to understand thou wert injured. Shouldst thou not be abed?
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_BEQLUGG_000_048: Lie down at a time like this!? Don't be absurd! I would have come sooner had the guards not made such a fuss!
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_BEQLUGG_000_049: Now, tell me what's happened. Where is the Exarch?
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_BEQLUGG_000_051: ... Will you show me his spirit vessel?
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_BEQLUGG_000_052: Yes... Both his soul and memories seem intact. Good.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_BEQLUGG_000_053: Unlike the others, his aether was not highly charged, and so it did not seem necessary to employ a familiar for the imbuing. But I needed to be certain all the same. Oh, what a relief...
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_URIANGER_000_054: Then 'tis but a question of restoring his soul unto his flesh.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_URIANGER_000_055: And as thou didst lately tell me, the success of this process resteth on no more than our friend's soul recognizing his flesh as its own.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_THANCRED_000_056: Given his apparent desire to return to the Source with , one would think his soul would be only too happy to be home, no? Surely it wouldn't balk at the relative newness of its accommodation?
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_BEQLUGG_000_057: So one would hope, but none can speak for the Exarch's heart of hearts. And he can no longer speak for himself.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_BEQLUGG_000_058: Furthermore, though I have drawn upon all of my not inconsiderable experience to predict the outcome, the fact remains that there is no direct precedent for what we are attempting.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_BEQLUGG_000_059: Will his body accept his soul? Will his essences blend properly? Will he awaken whole of mind? Any number of things could go awry.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_BEQLUGG_000_060: ...Assuming I have succeeded in tempering your expectations, I should probably add that I did ask the Exarch if he still wished to return to the Source in full knowledge of the risks.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_BEQLUGG_000_061: A simple enough question, one would think, warranting a single-word reply. Yet the answer I received was rather longer than that. Almost comically so, in fact. Regardless, out of respect for the man, I shall attempt to recite it─with a certain amount of poetic license. Ahem!
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_BEQLUGG_000_062: “As I grew older, the burdens I carried became ever more numerous. Burdens which weighed upon my hopes, burying them deep within my breast. So deep that I couldn't be certain they were still there.
