TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_BEQLUGG_000_063: “But when I look around me, I am reminded that, no matter how deeply buried they may be, our hopes never truly disappear. No, they are always with us. Guiding us. Driving us.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_BEQLUGG_000_064: “I see it in Vauthry, who sought to vindicate his existence by creating his paradise.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_BEQLUGG_000_065: “I see it in Ran'jit, who forsook his life's cause in order to protect that which he held most dear.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_BEQLUGG_000_066: “I see it in the people, who chose to struggle rather than surrender to despair.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_BEQLUGG_000_067: “And though our struggles may differ greatly, since the very beginning of time, they have all shared that one common thread: hope.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_BEQLUGG_000_068: “We struggle because we have hope. And when the time comes, I too will embrace mine. I will follow my heart, regardless of the risks.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_BEQLUGG_000_069: “And I will live with all my being, as befits one who has been granted a second chance.”
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_BEQLUGG_000_070: There! I told you it was long. And unspeakably sentimental to boot. One would think them the outpourings of a dewy-eyed boy, not the old man the Exarch seems to believe he is.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_BEQLUGG_000_071: I mean, really─he's scarcely been alive as long as I've been in hiding!
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_YSHTOLA_000_072: I daresay he is blushing in his vessel.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_YSHTOLA_000_073: Speaking of which, we should make ready for our journey. Time remains of the essence, after all.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_YSHTOLA_000_074: Needless to say, once we leave, there is no guarantee that we can return. If anyone has unfinished business, now is the time to see to it.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_YSHTOLA_000_075: I must pay a visit to Slitherbough. Let us reconvene here anon.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_URIANGER_000_076: Hm... There remain some few matters which require mine attention in Il Mheg.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_URIANGER_000_077: May I leave Thancred in thy care, child?
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_RYNE_000_078: Um...I've been meaning to get some flowers. For Minfilia.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_RYNE_000_079: I thought you might help me choose them. And then we could go to Nabaath Areng together...one last time.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALPHINAUD_000_081: Well, it's back to Eulmore for me. Amongst other things, I owe the mayor an apology about his airship.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALPHINAUD_000_082: I assume you have places of your own to be, Alisaie. I shall see you later.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_BEQLUGG_000_090: I shall take this opportunity to conduct a final inspection of the spirit vessels. Given what is at stake, one can never be too thorough.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALISAIE_000_100: As you've probably guessed, I'm going to pay a visit to the Inn at Journey's Head. But I want you to come too.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALISAIE_000_101: I realize you don't need to say any farewells.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALISAIE_000_102: But the Exarch does, if only in spirit. So I thought you might bring him along, so to speak.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALISAIE_000_103: I'm sure he'd love the thought of being lugged about on his hero's back.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALISAIE_000_104: So let's be off, shall we? I can't wait to see how Halric's doing!
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALISAIE_000_110: Halric? Halric! Oh gods, don't tell me he's wandered off again?
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALISAIE_000_111: Quickly, ! We have to find him!
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_WILLFORT_000_112: Oh, Alisaie! I didn't see you there. If you're looking for Halric, he's gone for a walk with one of the others. They were planning to visit the graveyard, if I'm not mistaken.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALISAIE_000_113: Well, that's a relief. Shall we adjourn to the graveyard, then?
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_JOURNEYSHEADNURSE_0: Oh, greetings, ! Looking for Halric, by any chance?
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALISAIE_000_130: There he is. I was afraid he'd wandered off again.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_JOURNEYSHEADNURSE_0: Oh, there's no need to worry─Halric's safe and well. He's been showing good progress, and likes to go for walks of late.
Though his steps usually bring him to this particular spot...
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALISAIE_000_133: Oh? I wasn't aware he had family here.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_JOURNEYSHEADNURSE_0: He doesn't. It's Tesleen. Her sword, that is.
We buried it here in her honor.
What brings you back so soon, out of interest? I didn't think the next round of treatments was due yet.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALISAIE_000_138: Uh...no. It isn't. Look─I realize this is sudden...but I've come to say good-bye. It's time for me to return home.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALISAIE_000_139: But rest assured the treatments will continue. Beq Lugg will come to oversee them in my stead.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_JOURNEYSHEADNURSE_0: I see... You did mention that you and your friends were searching for a way home.
Needless to say, we'll be sorry to see you go─but I know everyone will be happy for you. Truly.
Happy and grateful. You've done so much for us. Achieved what none of us dared hope was possible.
And we'll see to it that your good work continues, and that no more poor souls are buried here before their time.
So rest easy, and take care. We wish you every happiness.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALISAIE_000_145: Thank you. I will miss you all.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALISAIE_000_146: But it isn't time to say our farewells quite yet. So if there are any tasks that need doing─hunting beasts, fetching water, and what have you─just say the word.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALISAIE_000_147: I mean to make use of every last moment here. After all...
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_HALRIC_000_148: The time left to you...is precious...
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALISAIE_000_149: That's right, Halric... That's exactly right.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALISAIE_000_150: Those words will guide you true. So never forget them.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_JOURNEYSHEADNURSE_0: Thank you for coming to see Halric, . And Tesleen as well.
She did always enjoy having visitors. And none were more welcome than you and Alisaie.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALISAIE_000_170: What? I'm not crying! I just have sand in my eye, that's all.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALISAIE_000_171: ...Ahem. As I mentioned, I mean to stay here as long as possible. In the meantime, perhaps you could go and look in on the others?
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALISAIE_000_172: Alphinaud, for instance. If anyone is crying, it will be him!
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALISAIE_000_180: What are you still doing here? Hurry over to Eulmore and look in on Alphinaud. Oh, and send my regards to the Chais.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_CHAINUZZ_000_190: I hear the airship crashed in Amh Araeng. Never mind. The important thing is you're all safe and well.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_CHAINUZZ_000_191: That said, we should probably retrieve the wreck before the locals strip it for trolley parts. Or perhaps we can make a trade of it...
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_DULIACHAI_000_195: Oh, thank goodness you can still return! If I had to bid farewell to you both, my heart would burst here and now!
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_DULIACHAI_000_196: Like Alphinaud, I know that yours is a life of constant employment, but do visit us from time to time. It would mean the world to us.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_WRENDEN_000_200: I understand the Exarch will be leaving with you. Capable though its custodians are, the Crystarium will be poorer for his absence.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_WRENDEN_000_201: It seems the coming years will be a period of transition for both of our cities... But through mutual cooperation, I am confident we will find a way forward.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALPHINAUD_000_210: 'Tis a strange feeling, . To stand in the company of our friends, knowing that I will never see them again... I struggle to reconcile it in my mind.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALPHINAUD_000_211: But this I know: I shall cherish my memories of Norvrandt─of every soul I met here─for the rest of my days.
TEXT_LUCKMI109_03779_ALPHINAUD_000_212: And I shall look forward to your tales of their endeavors.
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_CHAINUZZ_000_001: I hear the airship crashed in Amh Araeng. Never mind. The important thing is you're all safe and well.
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_CHAINUZZ_000_002: That said, we should probably retrieve the wreck before the locals strip it for trolley parts. Or perhaps we can make a trade of it...
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_DULIACHAI_000_005: Oh, thank goodness you can still return! If I had to bid farewell to you both, my heart would burst here and now!
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_DULIACHAI_000_006: Like Alphinaud, I know that yours is a life of constant employment, but do visit us from time to time. It would mean the world to us.
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_WRENDEN_000_010: I understand the Exarch will be leaving with you. Capable though its custodians are, the Crystarium will be poorer for his absence.
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_WRENDEN_000_011: It seems the coming years will be a period of transition for both of our cities... But through mutual cooperation, I am confident we will find a way forward.
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Forgive me. I realize now that I never asked you what business brought you here. Can I be of assistance?
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_ALPHINAUD_000_021: ...Alisaie said that, did she? Well, as you can see, I am quite all right now─unlike her, by the sound of it. Ahem. Perhaps you might consider visiting Urianger next?
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_ALPHINAUD_000_022: Given his conversance with the idiosyncrasies of the fae folk, I doubt it will be an issue, but a small part of me worries that they may not relinquish him willingly. As such, I would feel better if you were to look in on our friend─assuming you have the time, of course.
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_ALPHINAUD_000_023: I still need to say my farewells to a few others here. Pray look in on Urianger, and I shall see you at the Crystarium.
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_URIANGER_000_030: Ha! That I should have the pleasure of welcoming a guest, even as mine own occupation draweth to a close. What bringeth thee hither, my friend?
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_URIANGER_000_031: So thou wouldst grant the Exarch a final tour of the realm which hath been his home these hundred years? A noble gesture.
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_URIANGER_000_032: As for Master Alphinaud's concerns, thou may'st rest assured that all is well here. Far from detaining me, our fae friends have agreed to assist in the transportation of these tomes unto the Cabinet of Curiosity. Naught more remaineth to be done.
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_URIANGER_000_033: Regardless, 'tis well that thou didst come, for I had been meaning to show something to thee.
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_URIANGER_000_034: An object I chanced to find after thy victory over Elidibus.
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_URIANGER_000_035: Though it hath lost its radiance, 'tis unmistakably a Crystal of Light. One that did, in all likelihood, once belong to Ardbert.
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_URIANGER_100_035: Having been interred with his body, it would have remained upon his person after his possession by Elidibus.
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_URIANGER_000_036: And when his mortal form was─forgive mine indelicacy─consumed by thy foe to fuel his transformation, I posit that the crystal did tumble free.
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_URIANGER_000_037: Save that which doth abide in thee, it is all that remaineth of our friend. And if thou art willing, I would have thee deliver it unto Seto. I can think of no worthier recipient than he─and no more fitting a bearer than thee.
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_URIANGER_000_038: As ever, thou wilt find the amaro in Wolekdorf. My thanks, .
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_URIANGER_000_040: The crystal shall grant Seto a measure of comfort, I believe. And to receive of it from thee shall only add to its meaning.
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_SETO_000_051: Ah, full glad am I to see you safe and well. Rumors spoke of strange, spectral foes bent on your destruction...
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_SETO_000_052: But with the sky returned to normal, I assume all is well again. So, to what do I owe the pleasure of this visit?
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_SETO_000_060: Thank you, . For taking care of Ardbert.
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_SETO_000_061: May your adventures together take you beyond the farthest horizons. And may they always lead you safely home.
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_URIANGER_000_070: Ah, thou art returned. Tell me, how did Seto receive thine offering?
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_URIANGER_000_071: ...Remarkable. 'Twas fated that thou shouldst be the one to undertake this task, I think.
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_URIANGER_000_072: As Ardbert liveth on in thee, so too shall he and his comrades live on in the hearts of the people of Norvrandt.
TEXT_LUCKMI110_03780_URIANGER_000_073: And their tale, now rightly told, shall inspire new Warriors of Light for generations to come.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_URIANGER_000_000: Now, assuming thou intendest to continue thy tour, might I suggest Slitherbough as thy next destination?
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_URIANGER_000_001: The task of tidying up one's abode is seldom light work, yet I suspect Y'shtola's is heavier than most. Suffice it to say, a pair of helping hands might not go amiss.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_URIANGER_000_010: Given its specificity to the Source, yon elemental chart is perhaps best removed.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_URIANGER_000_011: Yet I cannot help but imagine what might unfold were a native of the First to chance upon it... What questions it would conjure in the mind of its discoverer...and whither their curiosity might lead them... 'Twould make for the beginnings of a grand adventure, would it not?
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_YSHTOLA_000_020: And what is this? Have you come to spy on me?
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_YSHTOLA_000_021: ...Does Urianger truly think me so slovenly? The nerve.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_YSHTOLA_000_022: Loath as I am to disappoint, I put my affairs in order some time ago. I've even bade my farewells.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_YSHTOLA_000_023: To everyone save Runar, that is. He's nowhere to be seen...
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_RUNAR_000_030: Please take good care of Master Matoya. See that she eats well, and wraps up warm on cold days.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_RUNAR_000_031: Ah, and there is a herbal tea which she enjoys! If I give you the recipe, you could make it for her, perhaps? And, uh...uh...
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_RUNAR_000_032: Above all─please keep her close. I do not deny that she is strong, but even the strongest among us should not be alone.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_YSHTOLA_000_040: Honestly, he's a boy in the body of a man... <sigh>
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_YSHTOLA_000_041: Anyway, it is time we headed back to the Crystarium. Shall we?
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_YSHTOLA_000_042: ...You still have to take the Exarch to Nabaath Areng? I see. Very well, you can look in on Thancred while you're about it.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_YSHTOLA_000_043: His will be a difficult farewell, and I am sure he would appreciate your support.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_YSHTOLA_000_044: The path goes through Twine. If you wait there, you are like to meet him on his way back, if not before.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_YSHTOLA_000_050: As I make my way out of the wood, I shall call to mind all that I learned during my time here. And I shall picture the day of my return.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_YSHTOLA_000_051: I know not when it will be, but mark my words, I will learn to traverse the rift.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_THAFFE_000_055: Ah, it's you! Good to see you looking none the worse for wear!
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_JERYK_000_060: Let me guess: you're here to ride the trolley too. Don't ask me how I know─I can just tell!
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_MAGNUS_000_070: Eh? You too? What is this, my bloody nameday?
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_MAGNUS_000_071: I see, I see. Yes, Thancred was here─and Ryne too. They said they wanted to go to Nabaath Areng, so we gave them the use of the trolley.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_JERYK_000_072: That's right, the old girl's up and running again! But we didn't just put her back together, mind you!
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_JERYK_000_073: No, with a little bit of help from Master Chai...
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_JERYK_000_076: Ohhh yes, the future of trolleys is looking brighter than ever! Whisper it, but I reckon it might be time─time to reach for the stars with a trolley to dwarf all trolleys!
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_THAFFE_000_077: If you ask me, we'd be better off making them smaller. That way, they can fit in narrow shafts.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_JERYK_000_078: But that─ That's genius! Why didn't I think of that!?
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_MAGNUS_000_079: Enough. You can daydream in your own time. In case you've forgotten, our priority is to have more working trolleys.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_MAGNUS_000_080: That's why we turned to Chai-Nuzz, by the way─not to make the one trolley we've got go faster. We needed help getting a few Talos back in working order, see.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_MAGNUS_000_081: We were out testing 'em when your airship came down, as a matter of fact. You seem to have a habit of crashing things...
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_THANCRED_000_082: We're back. Our thanks for the loan of the trolley.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_THANCRED_000_083: ...? What are you doing here? Don't tell me the others are waiting for us?
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_THANCRED_000_084: That's a relief. At any rate, we've done what we came to do─which means I'm ready to leave. Or as ready as I'll ever be.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_MAGNUS_000_085: Not to pry, but what's going on? You off somewhere?
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_MAGNUS_000_087: So you're heading home. I'm just a simple miner and don't know much about this world-traversing business...
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_MAGNUS_000_088: But the young lady here─she'll be looked after, will she?
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_RYNE_000_089: I'll be fine, thank you. I have a place to stay at the Crystarium, and don't want for anything.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_RYNE_000_090: Besides which, I've recently made a new friend. Her name is Gaia, and she'll always be there if I need her. Just like you lot.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_RYNE_000_091: Besides which, I've no shortage of friends I can turn to. Friends like you lot.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_RYNE_000_092: So please don't worry. I'll be fine, really.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_MAGNUS_000_094: It being a matter of life and death, I suppose you have to leave.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_MAGNUS_000_095: But I for one would still be torn. If the choice were mine, I'm not sure I could bear to be parted from my family.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_THANCRED_000_096: No. But it's for the best. Ryne has chosen to walk her own path, and she doesn't need me under her feet.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_THANCRED_000_097: Besides, I have my own responsibilities, and I wouldn't be setting a very good example if I neglected them.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_MAGNUS_000_098: Hmph. Perhaps not. Either way, I envy you your dilemma.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_MAGNUS_000_099: Well then, young lady... If there's anything you need─anything at all─you're to call on us. It may surprise you, but we can do more than simply offer you trolley rides.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_RYNE_000_102: If you've nowhere left to visit, we can go back to the Crystarium together.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_MAGNUS_000_110: Bugger me, I forgot to thank Thancred...
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_MAGNUS_000_111: When you get the chance, tell him I'm glad we had that little talk. And tell him we'll look out for the girl.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_THAFFE_000_115: When it comes to families, you'd think together was best, but it's not always that simple, is it? Never really thought about it, what with my parents being long gone.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_THAFFE_000_116: The people in this town are the closest thing to family I've got. And to be fair, I'd hate to leave them. Which is why I'm not going anywhere!
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_JERYK_000_120: Mark my words, : one day, Twine will thrive again, and I hope that Thancred can come back to see it. Him and that funny-talking, fortune-teller bloke!
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_ALPHINAUD_000_125: I thought that it would be easier after saying farewell, but each step I took out of Eulmore felt heavier than the last...
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_ALISAIE_000_130: I did everything I could in the time I had. No regrets.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_URIANGER_000_140: I took the liberty of informing the Crystarium's leaders of our imminent departure. It seemed only right.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_YSHTOLA_000_145: I trust the Exarch had a pleasant tour of the realm.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_RYNE_000_150: Oh, it's you... You're probably wondering why I'm not with the others.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_RYNE_000_151: <sigh> It's just...I always knew that everyone would leave one day. And I always hoped and prayed that we would find a way to send them home. But now that the time has come, I just feel...lost. Lost and lonely.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_RYNE_000_152: I don't want our last moments together to be sad. I want to hold myself together, just long enough to say the things that I need to say. But I'm not sure I can even do that...
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_RYNE_000_157: Thank you, . I think we all feel braver with you around. Go on ahead and join the others. I'll be along after I've taken a few deep breaths.
TEXT_LUCKMI111_03781_RYNE_000_158: Thank you, . I feel braver already. <sniff> Go on ahead and join the others. I'll be along after I've taken a few deep breaths.
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_CRYSTALGATEKEEPER_1: Oh? Begging your pardon,  , but should you not wait for Mistress Ryne?
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_RYNE_000_000: Well, I suppose it's time. Are you ready, ?
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_RYNE_000_001: All right. Let's not keep the others waiting.
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_CRYSTALGATEKEEPER_0: Ah,  . I have but this moment shown your associates in. Strange to think that I will not have the honor of showing them out again...
But I am informed that you yourself may yet return, and I look forward to welcoming you on that happy day. Now, if you would care to follow me.
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_ALPHINAUD_000_010: I did not expect such a rousing farewell from the people. It was the very thing my spirits needed.
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Now all that remains is to return to the Source. The Twelve know we have made Krile and Tataru worry long enough.
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_ALISAIE_000_015: Angelo stands ready to work his magick on our souls.
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_THANCRED_000_020: Since we cannot take our worldly goods with us, I want you to have my gunblade.
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_THANCRED_000_021: Use it or sell it, it's all the same to me. So long as it serves you in some way, I will be satisfied.
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_URIANGER_000_030: How many times have we few assembled thus in this storied chamber? Many and more, I think.
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_URIANGER_000_031: Were the Exarch standing before us, the scene would be complete. Nay─'twould be complete were he standing before us with Emet-Selch smirking in the wings.
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_YSHTOLA_000_035: In the spirit of solidarity...I bid you carry the vessels as if your life depended on it.
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_BEQLUGG_000_040: Ah, there you are. I take it you are ready for the journey.
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_BEQLUGG_000_041: The spirit vessels are primed, and our company complete. At a word from you, we shall begin.
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_SYSTEM_000_042: Upon beginning the soul-imbuing ritual, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_SYSTEM_000_043: It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_Q2_000_044: Begin the soul-imbuing ritual and return to the Source with your comrades?
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_BEQLUGG_000_045: Very good. I shall distribute the vessels at once.
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_Q3_000_050: Continue with the main scenario quest?
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_GRAHATIA_000_062: Tell me, . Do you think I was...excessively familiar earlier? In my tone and mannerism?
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_GRAHATIA_000_063: I thought it better to be familiar than formal if we are to be comrades. But now I worry that it may have detracted from the gratitude and respect I harbor for everyone.
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_GRAHATIA_000_064: Perhaps we might consider it a nod to my regrettably less-than-humble beginnings...? Yes! Yes, that will do!
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_GRAHATIA_000_065: <sigh> Being free to live as one pleases is not without its challenges... In a way, it was easier when I had a mission that consumed my every waking moment. It provided me with a focus, a constant push in a singular direction.
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_GRAHATIA_000_066: By the way, was casting spells always so draining? I had quite forgotten what it was like to do it without the tower. I've rarely felt so exhausted. Or hungry.
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_GRAHATIA_000_067: Yet if all I did was bend the bow, I would be of limited use to you on your adventures. So I shall persevere.
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_GRAHATIA_000_068: Whoever I might have been before, I am now a Scion─and an inexperienced Scion at that. A green initiate, eager to learn how best to contribute to the cause...
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_GRAHATIA_000_069: ...That he might follow in the footsteps of his inspiration!
TEXT_LUCKMI112_03782_SYSTEM_000_070: G'raha Tia is now available as a Trust companion.
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_KRILE_000_000: Oh, greetings, . Come to look in on our friends?
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_KRILE_000_001: Rest assured, everyone is quite well. I've been keeping a close eye on them, and have satisfied myself that they are all in fine health.
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_KRILE_000_002: As a matter of fact, they're just about to convene in Dawn's Respite to discuss how best to use their pent-up energy. Let's join them, shall we?
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_GRAHATIA_000_010: <sigh> When Y'shtola is about, one cannot afford even the slightest slip...
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_TATARU_000_011: Don't worry, I can say with complete confidence that G'raha is dressed for anything!
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_ALISAIE_000_020: When I set out to save Halric, I think Ga Bu was always at the back of my mind. And having proved that the Light-corrupted are not lost, I am convinced that the same must be true of the tempered.
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_ALISAIE_000_021: Similar to those corrupted by the sin eaters, the aether of Ga Bu's soul has been rendered stagnant.
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_ALISAIE_000_022: And though the root cause is different, perhaps the solution is the same.
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_GRAHATIA_000_023: It is by no means an unreasonable hypothesis, Alisaie. And it warrants full investigation.
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_ALISAIE_000_024: If there's even a chance we can save Ga Bu, we have to try. But however much I'd like to race over to Limsa and set to work, there's no room for recklessness. Not when a child's life is at stake.
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_ALISAIE_000_025: As I'm sure Beq Lugg would remind us, we still know little and less about the soul. Any number of things could go wrong if we don't exercise due caution.
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_ALISAIE_000_026: And so, before attempting anything, we should learn all we possibly can about tempering.
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_ALISAIE_000_027: There's just one problem: research into the condition has long since ground to a halt, and the combined work of the many scholars involved doesn't exactly amount to a wealth of knowledge...
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_GRAHATIA_000_028: Not of the modern scholars, perhaps. But what of their ancient counterparts? I know the Allagans took a more-than-passing interest in the subject.
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_GRAHATIA_000_029: And if what we seek is to be found anywhere, it would surely be at the Aetherochemical Research Facility.
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_ALISAIE_000_030: ...Where they experimented on primals and their worshipers, yes? Good thinking. I've never actually been there myself, but I did read the reports on Azys Lla. Which means we'll be needing an airship.
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_TATARU_000_031: Heh heh heh...! An airship, you say?
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_TATARU_000_032: Meet me at the northern bank of Silvertear Lake─I've got a little surprise for you. Oh, and come prepared to travel!
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_TATARU_000_040: I give you the Bonanza, the Scions' very own airship!
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_TATARU_000_041: I built her as a company project with help from our friends at the Rising Stones, and named her for luck and prosperity!
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_ALISAIE_000_042: Tataru, this is... This is amazing! We'll be able to fly just about anywhere we want!
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_GRAHATIA_100_043: Our garments were impressive enough, but to build an entire airship... I see the annals did not exaggerate the many talents of the Scions' fabled coinkeeper.
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_TATARU_000_044: Hee hee hee! I'd also introduce myself as your pilot, except the training didn't go quite as well as I'd hoped... But that's all right, because we've hired this capable fellow here instead!
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_TATARU_000_045: The Bonanza is equipped with a full complement of manacutters, by the way. Feel free to use them to get around Azys Lla!
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_TATARU_000_046: But enough talk─it's time to fly. All aboard!
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_GRAHATIA_000_048: Did I ever mention that I was fond of flying? Because I am. Be it on an airship, an amaro, or a chocobo, there is nothing so exhilarating as feeling the wind on your face as the horizon unfolds before you...
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_ALISAIE_100_050: Honestly, Cid would be jealous of the way that airship flies. Tataru has outdone herself.
TEXT_LUCKMJ101_04007_ALISAIE_000_050: Anyway, here we are, on Azys Lla─and Alphinaud's report did not do the scale of this place justice...
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_100_000: So this is where you had your reckoning with Thordan. I wish I'd been with you.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_100_000: This appears to be Helix, which means we stand in the Alpha Quadrant. To the east lies the Beta Quadrant, and...
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_000: Yes, I believe I have my bearings. Though this is my first time on Azys Lla, I do have some familiarity with the place thanks to the records in the Crystal Tower.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_001: Unless I am mistaken, this path leads to an aetheryte, beyond which there will be an information terminal. I suggest we begin our search there.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_005: Time for our authority on Allagan artifacts to show what he can do.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_010: And here is the terminal. A moment while I search the archives for references to tempering...
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_012: “Eikonic Corruption ─ An Overview”... That sounds promising!
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_013: Indeed. Let us see what this report has to say.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_014: Hm? ...Confound it. The contents appear to have been deleted.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_015: What? No...! Isn't there something you can do?
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_016: Not from here, I'm afraid. But it may be that another copy of the report exists elsewhere. The question is, where to look...?
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_017: It says here the report was written by someone named Owen. Is it likely that he kept a copy?
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_019: I would say it is a distinct possibility. Assuming he was a researcher here, he will have had quarters on the Habisphere. We can ascertain the details at Habisphere Control.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_021: Let us return to the Bonanza and avail ourselves of the manacutters. We will need them to reach our destination.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_022: I forgot─you already have a suitable means of transport, don't you. No need to waste time accompanying us back to the ship, then. We'll see you at the Habisphere.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_025: The manacutters appear to be Ironworks made, but I daresay Tataru will craft her own soon enough.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_HABISPHERESYSTEM_10: Bzzz... Welcome to Habisphere Control. How may I assist you?
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_100_030: If the late Owen did indeed have a chamber here, this node will be able to tell us its number.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_030:
There. From what I recall of the layout, it should be somewhere in the vicinity of─
...Hm?
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_HABISPHERESYSTEM_10: Warning: an evacuation order is presently in effect. Entry to the Habisphere is not permitted at this time.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_031: Foiled again... In all likelihood, the order would have been imposed during the Fourth Umbral Calamity, and I doubt it will be lifted in the near future.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_HABISPHERESYSTEM_10: Bzzz... Energy level critical. Returning to base for recharging.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_032: Well...surely there must be some other way to gain access. Force, for example?
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_033: Hm. Ere we resort to that, I have an idea. Were we to send a surge of energy through yonder control mechanism, it should prompt the system to restart, releasing the locks.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_034: As for a suitable energy source...a concentrated lightning shard might suffice. Happily, I seem to recall that they are known to form at points of stagnant aether throughout the continent.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_035: You seem to recall? Are you honestly telling me that was in the records too?
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_036: Hah! I am. A report sent to the capital mentioned that lightning-aspected aether was prone to pooling on the continent, resulting in surges that interfered with equipment.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_037: A minor detail, I grant you, but in my role as caretaker of the Crystal Tower, there was no such thing as too much Allagan knowledge.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_100_037: Besides, my studies helped me to feel connected to the Source. To home.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_100_038: I must have explored this facility a thousand times in my mind, but to finally stand here with the two of you... 'Tis more exhilarating than I can well express.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_038: Now then, the lightning shard. If I may, I suggest we split up and search the Beta Quadrant. Oh, but beware of sprites─they are wont to manifest where the aether is stagnant.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_039: Now you're just showing off. Which makes me think we should make a contest of this. The first to return here with a shard wins. What do you say?
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_040: Very well! It would be my honor to come third!
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_050: (-Disembodied Voice-)Bravo! That was quite a show, adventurer! Why, the spectacle proved so enthralling that all thoughts of the prize slipped my mind.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_051: (-Disembodied Voice-)I appear to have forfeited our little race! Congratulations─the lightning shard is yours.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_A2_000_001: Who are you? Show yourself at once!
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_A2_000_002: What, no dramatic entrance? You've changed.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_A2_000_003: Very funny. Now let's get back to work.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_100_052: Forgive me, my friend. The scene so reminded me of our first meeting, I couldn't resist.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_200_052: Ugh, you remember that? In my defense, I was caught up in the moment. It isn't every day you meet an honest-to-gods hero, after all.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_300_052: Forgive me. The scene so reminded me of our first meeting, I couldn't resist.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_053:
Well, the contest continues, so you had better hurry back.
...Ah, but one last thing.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_054: Thank you, . For bringing me here.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_058: You have a shard? Then you win. I searched high and low, but couldn't find so much as a trace of stagnant aether.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_060: It appears Alisaie had no luck, so victory is yours. Congratulations. Now then, may I have the shard?
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_061: <sigh> What is it that makes you so much better at finding things? What do you have that I don't?
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_062: That is a question I too have asked myself on numerous occasions. I suspect we could both learn a great deal from ─and not only about the secrets of adventuring. But come, we should attend to our mission.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_063: Excellent, the system responded exactly as intended. We now have access to the Habisphere.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_064: Only one obstacle remains: the security systems within. Should they be triggered, they could make life rather difficult for us.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_065: In light of which, pray leave the rest to me. If I am right, my royal blood should allow me to venture in unmolested.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_100_066: Assuming this place works like the Crystal Tower, yes. But if it doesn't, you'll be on your own. I want you to promise us that you'll get out at the first sign of trouble.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_100_068: Well, nothing for it but to sit tight...
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_101: I'm sure this Owen fellow was very learned, but “Eikonic Corruption ─ An Overview” sounds like a Studium thesis. We all had to write one.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_102: Lest you wonder, mine was about the combat applications of aether. I'm nothing if not practical...
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_103: Alphinaud's was more philosophical, of course. Political, dare I say it. He chose to write a lengthy discourse on our nation's duty to the world.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_104: A controversial subject, to say the least.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_105: He asserted that Sharlayan's knowledge should rightly be used to protect all life on the star─in direct opposition to the country's cherished policy of nonintervention. Being a leading member of the Forum, our father was...not happy.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_106: At the time, of course, Alphinaud was utterly convinced of his views and would cheerfully argue to the death with anyone who saw things differently. By which I mean, the rows were long. To be fair to him, though, he's since learned to be a little more open-minded─but deep down he still holds fast to that one belief. And I admire him for it.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_107: I should have liked to meet the young Alphinaud! For what it's worth, my thesis concerned the Allagan civilization as depicted in folklore.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_108: Oh, you're back. I didn't know you attended the Studium?
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_109: I didn't─a thesis was required to earn my Archon's mark. My peers at the Students of Baldesion convinced me to write one with the promise of unfettered access to forbidden tomes!
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_110: Though I considered it no more than a means to an end at the time, I will admit it was gratifying to have my efforts acknowledged.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_111: Good gods, an Archon's thesis... I shudder to imagine the work involved. But enough about that─is this the fruit of your foray?
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_112: Yes. Owen's archive node. It was waiting for me in his chamber.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_113: If a copy of his report still survives, it would be stored in this device. Shall we find out?
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_DATASYSTEM_000_115: User not found. To proceed as a guest, please complete biometric authentication.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_DATASYSTEM_000_117: <bloop> Authentication complete. Guest identified as: member of the royal family. I am at your most humble service, Your Highness.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_118: Hm hm hm! It never ceases to amuse me. 'Tis but a pity the effect will not last forever.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_119: Doga and Unei said as much when they granted me this gift. But until such time as it fades, I shall use it gratefully.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_DATASYSTEM_000_121:
<blip> Searching...
<bloop> One item found: Eikonic Corruption ─ An Overview.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_DATASYSTEM_000_122: The report is locked by the author. Please state password.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_123: Well, go on then, Your Highness. Tell the nice node the password.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_129: Come now, passwords are invariably short and simple. For instance...
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_DATASYSTEM_000_131: The notion that the password could be something so inane would be laughable were it not dangerously stupid. Furthermore, your conduct in the presence of His Highness is grossly inappropriate. Know your place, handmaiden.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_132: What did that thing just call me!?
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_DATASYSTEM_100_034: <blip> <bloop> Password incorrect. Again. Be warned that any further inappropriate behavior in the presence of His Highness will not be tolerated.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_ALISAIE_000_135: All right, that's it. I say we dismantle it and manually extract what we need.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_136: Now, now, let's not be too hasty! A single misstep, and we risk losing the report altogether.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_137: I believe this may be a task for Cid and his colleagues. If anyone can coax machina into cooperating, it is them.
TEXT_LUCKMJ102_04008_GRAHATIA_000_138: Come, let us bear the node back to the Rising Stones.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_ALISAIE_100_000: Fine. I'll let Cid try his hand first. But if that doesn't work, we're doing it my way.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_000_000: I should probably mention that I have yet to meet Cid since waking up. Rammbroes did send word to the Ironworks, but it appears our friend has been afield on urgent business.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_000_001: Nevertheless, I assure you my proposal to seek his help is no pretext, however much I might look forward to seeing him again. Him and everyone. But come, let us be on our way.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_ALISAIE_000_002: Hehehe! Look at him, all but running... How sweet.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_ALISAIE_000_003: Still, it wouldn't do to keep him waiting. Shall we?
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_ALISAIE_000_005: Krile's back too. I wonder what was decided at the council...
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_KRILE_000_006: I take it you have news to share. So do I.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_TATARU_000_007: I'm pleased to see your mission was a success─and in no small part due to the Bonanza!
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_000_010: Wonderful news, ! Tataru contacted Cid on our behalf, and he is on his way here even as we speak!
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_000_011: While we wait, I should like very much to hear what transpired at the Alliance council. Would you be so kind, Krile?
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_KRILE_000_012: As you know, the meeting was convened to discuss how best to respond to recent events in Garlemald.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_KRILE_000_013: According to intelligence from our Doman allies, the war of succession rages on, and the Empire remains without a leader.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_KRILE_000_014: Amidst the chaos, the imperial legions in the provinces have begun to move independently of the motherland.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_KRILE_000_015: Of greatest concern to us is the IIIrd, a legion aligned with Lord Nerva. It appears they have received substantial financial backing from House Brutus.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_ALISAIE_000_016: Brutus... Aren't they the ones who took in Yotsuyu and Asahi? This bodes well...
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_KRILE_000_017: Zenos's movements, meanwhile, remain shrouded in mystery. We're hoping that Thancred and Urianger will be able to shed some light on his activities when they return.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_KRILE_000_018: Until such time as they do, the Allied leaders feel it would be unwise to interfere in the conflict. And so, thanks in part to the imperial withdrawal from Ghimlyt, they have decided to turn their attention to the primal problem once more.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_KRILE_000_019: Working with friendly factions among the beast tribes, they hope to reopen dialogue and explore new avenues for peace.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_KRILE_000_020: Given the timing, I suspect they wish to put their respective houses in order ahead of a decisive clash with the Empire.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_KRILE_000_023: Whatever their intent, this is not a problem easily solved. The Lominsans, in particular, struggle in their efforts, and Alphinaud and Y'shtola have been called upon to aid them.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_ALISAIE_000_024: So long as we are dealing with the tempered, I'm afraid no amount of dialogue will avail us.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_ALISAIE_000_025: But if we can develop a treatment for tempering, then anything is possible!
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_000_026: Which is why we must succeed.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_TATARU_000_027: And on that cheery note, why not make yourselves comfortable in Dawn's Respite? I'll show Cid in as soon as he arrives!
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_KRILE_000_030: I understand you took a little trip to Azys Lla. Raha made himself useful, I trust?
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_TATARU_000_031: We've made the Respite cozier than ever. You're going to love it!
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_ALISAIE_000_033: As important as Ga Bu is to me, I know only too well how much more is at stake here. A cure could change the whole world.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_DATASYSTEM_000_034: <blip> <bloop> Warning: His Highness is exhibiting elevated blood pressure.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_CID_100_041: Forgive us for not coming to see you sooner, my friend. As you may have heard, we've had our hands full.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_CID_000_041: In our defense, you are up rather early. I was under the impression you'd be slumbering awhile longer.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_000_042: Oh, I would have been─had you not fulfilled your promise.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_CID_100_043: Hah! I still struggle with that idea. From where I stand, the secrets of traversing time and space seem exactly as unfathomable as they ever did.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_CID_000_043: But if an alternate version of myself has already laid them bare, I daresay that frees me up to concentrate on other endeavors. Speaking of which, you wanted my help with something. What is it?
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_CID_000_044: Well, well...a treatment for tempering. And for the next step, you need to find the password to this Allagan's report...
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_000_045: Just so. With nary a clue to guide us, we could be here forever and still not guess correctly. And thus we turn to you.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_CID_000_047: Well, I'd love to say that we could help you...so I will. Once suitably configured, a magitek terminal should make short work of identifying the password.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_000_048: I knew I could rely on you. Now, anticipating that it might be of use, I took the liberty of borrowing a tomestone from Rammbroes. It contains an Allagan dictionary.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_CID_000_049: Good thinking. I'll transfer the information to a terminal and set it to work right away.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_CID_000_101: Ah, looks like it's finished. Let's see...
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_ALISAIE_000_103: Hah. Short and simple, just as I said. Would you care to do the honors, Your Highness?
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_000_105: Node, open the report entitled “Eikonic Corruption ─ An Overview,” password: freedom!
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_OWEN_000_107: This report seeks to provide an overview of the mechanism by which eikons corrupt and bind men to their will.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_OWEN_000_108: The phenomenon we call “corruption” refers to the alteration of the aether of the soul.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_OWEN_000_109: Said aether ordinarily exists in equilibrium; no one element being more prominent than another.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_OWEN_000_110: But when a subject is exposed to the aether of an eikon, this changes, their soul taking on the properties of the entity in question.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_OWEN_000_111: By way of an example, exposure to the aether of the Fiend, Sephirot, would cause a subject's aether to become aligned with the element of earth.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_OWEN_000_112: As a consequence, the subject would attain heightened affinity with earth-aspected magicks, as well as preternatural levels of endurance. Repeated exposure would further enhance these traits, ultimately altering the subject's very flesh.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_OWEN_000_113: The changes undergone by the subject are not solely attributable to elemental alignment, however. Further testing has determined that the subject's soul becomes umbrally charged, or stagnant during the process.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_OWEN_000_114: This stagnation of the soul has the effect of diluting the sense of self, rendering the subject vulnerable to the will of the eikon, the thoughts of whom come to consume their entire existence.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_OWEN_000_116: In this manner do the corrupted become worshipers of the eikon, their prayers serving to further empower the entity.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_OWEN_000_117: Having discerned the mechanism of eikonic corruption, my colleagues and I set out to develop a material capable of shielding one from its effects. An endeavor in which we were successful, albeit it at great cost...
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_OWEN_000_118: In the course of testing, many of my assistants─good men and women all─fell victim to corruption. And in accordance with protocol, they were summarily put to death.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_OWEN_000_119: I subsequently submitted a proposal to investigate potential cures for corruption, but it was rejected─deemed “nonessential” by Lord Amon.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_OWEN_000_120: Though I knew it would be fruitless, I protested the decision. And for my impertinence, I have been stripped of rank and title, and will shortly be expelled from this facility.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_OWEN_000_121: In all likelihood, this report will be expunged from the archives. Nonetheless, I record it in the hope that one day, someone will undertake to do that which I could not, and find a cure for the victims of eikonic corruption. End recording.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_000_122: So not even the Allagans were able to find a cure. Or rather, were not given the chance to do so. One cannot help but wonder what motivated Lord Amon's decision.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_ALISAIE_000_123: More importantly, this confirms that stagnation of the soul is indeed the problem─and Angelo can remedy that.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_000_124: True. Yet were we simply to reanimate a tempered soul, I fear it would do naught to diminish the individual's fanatical faith. Indeed, it may well intensify it.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_000_125: No, we would somehow need to suppress the primal's hold over the subject at the same time, or risk them ever remaining its thrall.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_A1_000_001: If we could only make them remember who they were...
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_A1_000_002: So there's no point in reviving their souls unless we can also restore their sense of self?
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_000_127: But of course─memory transference! The process has the effect of compartmentalizing memories─separating them into manageable bundles, if you will.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_100_127: By adapting the technique, it may be possible to achieve selective reanimation. That is, limit the effects to only those memories that existed prior to tempering.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_200_127: Through thus restoring the sense of self, we could theoretically drown out the incitements of false faith which had come to dominate the individual's thoughts.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_ALISAIE_100_128: I see... The theory seems sound. And our experience treating the Light-corrupted would help us to identify suitable memories for reanimation.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_ALISAIE_000_128: But are you confident you can adapt memory transference as required? I seem to recall your attempts to do so while trying to bring us home culminated in literal bloodletting.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_000_129: They did, you are right. Despite my best efforts, I could not recreate the mechanism. And I concede that the rather clumsy compromise I reached would not provide the basis for a cure.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_ALISAIE_000_130: Then perhaps it's better that we consider another approach.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_000_131: Your doubts are understandable, but this time I believe we have reason to be confident.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_000_132: You see, nodes such as this were built with the ability to simulate magicks.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_000_133: Which leads me to believe that it may be capable of performing simulations of the transference technique. If so, we would be able to conduct years' worth of tests within the space of a few days.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_CID_000_134: Hm. In theory, it would be no different from how we identified the password.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_CID_000_135: But it'll take more calculating power. A lot more. I honestly couldn't say whether our equipment would be up to the task.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_000_136: Tell me, Cid. Why do you suppose Owen locked his report behind a password?
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_CID_000_137: To keep it from prying eyes, of course. Why else?
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_CID_000_138: ...Wait. A password that could be guessed by anyone with leisure and a dictionary wouldn't keep it from a person minded to look.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_CID_000_139: No, he wanted his report to be seen...by those who strive for freedom.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_000_140: Not unlike the members of a certain distinguished engineering collective. I believe their motto was “Freedom through Technology,” or some such.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_CID_000_141: You two─round up as many magitek terminals as you can find and bring them to the workshop.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_CID_000_143: Things are about to get very busy. Lucky we have you to help, eh?
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_ALISAIE_000_150: We're getting there, . One step at a time.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_000_151: As with our first foray into the Labyrinth of the Ancients, we seek to venture into the unknown. And in order to succeed, we require not only knowledge and preparation, but daring besides. Just like old times.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_KRILE_000_152: Suffice it to say, I shall be of whatever help I can.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_TATARU_000_153: Hmmm, all those magitek terminals won't come cheap... Ack, shut up, Tataru. Some things you shouldn't put a price on.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_CID_000_160: Right, while G'raha Tia and I configure the terminals, I want the rest of you to procure supplies.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_CID_000_161: Namely, ceruleum to fuel the terminals and ice shards to keep them cool. The more we have of both, the better.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_KRILE_000_162: Leave the ice shards to me. I'll round up some adventurers and go on a gathering spree.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_CID_000_163: In that case, I'll trust  and Alisaie with the ceruleum. Here's a promissory note for each of you.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_CID_000_164: Take them to the Skysteel Manufactory in Ishgard and the Ceruleum Processing Plant in Thanalan. The people there will give you what we need.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_ALISAIE_000_165: Yours is a well-known face in the Holy See, I believe? If it's all the same to you, I'll head to Thanalan.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_CID_000_168: If Alisaie's bound for the Ceruleum Processing Plant, you'll want to take yourself to the Skysteel Manufactory. Off you go, now.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_GRAHATIA_000_169: We shall see to it the terminals are ready by the time you return.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_KRILE_100_170: We're about to set out for the ice shards. I suggest we all compare spoils when we return.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_TATARU_100_171: The workshop hasn't been used for a while. I'll have to give it a good clean!
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_FROMELAUT_000_170: You stand in the Skysteel Manufactory. What is it you require?
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_FROMELAUT_000_171: Welcome back,  . How may I serve you this day?
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_FROMELAUT_000_172: So you are after ceruleum. In that case, please present the note to our engineer at the airship landing. He shall be glad to assist you.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_FROMELAUT_000_175: Please present the note to our engineer at the airship landing. He shall be glad to assist you.
TEXT_LUCKMJ103_04009_SKYSTEELENGINEER040: Ceruleum? You've come to the right man. Fair warnin', though: the price has shot up on account of the uncertainty with the Empire, so I hope you've got the coin!
Well now, a promissory note from the Ironworks. Don't see many of these. Not that it's a problem─it's as good as gold to me.
TEXT_LUCKMJ104_04010_GRAHATIA_100_000: Alas, the Ironworks crew couldn't linger long─far too much to do. Yet brief though our time together was, it was bloody good to see them!
TEXT_LUCKMJ104_04010_ALISAIE_000_000: At long last, we have our cure...
TEXT_LUCKMJ104_04010_GRAHATIA_100_001: In theory, at any rate. We cannot be certain until such time as we put it to the proof, but I am quietly confident.
TEXT_LUCKMJ104_04010_ALISAIE_100_002: Well, if we're to test it on someone, then I suggest Ga Bu. His symptoms are relatively mild.
TEXT_LUCKMJ104_04010_A1_000_001: It'll be fine, I'm sure of it.
TEXT_LUCKMJ104_04010_A1_000_002: As long as you exercise due caution...
TEXT_LUCKMJ104_04010_ALISAIE_100_003: Yes. As long as we exercise due caution, it will be fine.
TEXT_LUCKMJ104_04010_ALISAIE_100_004: Without further ado, then, let's make for Limsa. We've kept Ga Bu waiting long enough!
TEXT_LUCKMJ104_04010_KRILE_000_010: I doubt I could contribute much towards what comes next, so I shall cheer you on from afar. Best of luck with the treatment.
TEXT_LUCKMJ104_04010_TATARU_000_011: We'll all be praying for your success!
TEXT_LUCKMJ104_04010_GRAHATIA_000_012: 'Tis plain Alisaie is very fond of Ga Bu. To the extent that I have a hand in it, I shall do all in my power to bring him back.
TEXT_LUCKMJ104_04010_ALISAIE_000_013: Well, this is the moment of truth. I'll have our hosts bring Ga Bu to us at once.
TEXT_LUCKMJ104_04010_YSHTOLA_000_014: Alisaie will succeed, I am certain of it. We need but have faith.
TEXT_LUCKMJ104_04010_ALPHINAUD_000_015: Well, this seems as good a spot as any to have a rest.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_ALPHINAUD_100_000: You may recall that in order to procure the ingredients for Angelo, we had no choice but to surrender ourselves to the whims of the pixies. But I should have done so with far better grace had I known what we would go on to achieve.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_ALISAIE_100_001: We did it. We brought Ga Bu back. And if I have any say in the matter, he'll be the first of many.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_GRAHATIA_100_002: Alisaie will be exhausted from her efforts, but you wouldn't think so to look at her now. If she is ready to press on, then so am I.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_YSHTOLA_000_000: As she will be at pains to remind me, I have not paid Master Matoya a visit since returning from the First. But this seems as good a time as any. Come, let us make for her cave.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_ALPHINAUD_000_010: It has been some time since Master Matoya last saw Y'shtola. What a lot they will have to talk about.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_ALISAIE_000_011: Do you remember? When last we came here, it was to find out why the others had collapsed. If someone had told me then that they'd been whisked away to another world, I would probably have laughed in their face. You live and learn, eh?
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_GRAHATIA_000_012: Master Matoya is something of a legend among Archons. I very much look forward to meeting her...if not the dressing down I am liable to receive for my inept attempts at summoning you.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_YSHTOLA_000_020: I take it you are ready to bear witness to the joyous reunion of master and pupil? Very well...
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_ALPHINAUD_000_030: A porxie that produces porxies... What an inspired idea.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_ALPHINAUD_100_030: ...By the way, . Do you think I misspoke earlier? I assure you it was not my intention to embarrass anyone.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_ALISAIE_000_031: In case you've ever wondered, Alphinaud got his innocent streak from our mother. And it can be rather endearing─even useful in certain situations.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_ALISAIE_100_031: But most of the time, it just makes me want to shake him. Poor Y'shtola...
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_YSHTOLA_000_032: “Moldy old hole”...? She really must miss the place.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_GRAHATIA_000_033: Where does she mean, do you think? Some manner of hidden workshop, perhaps?
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_MATOYA_000_040: All right, off to my old workshop, then. Everything required to make your familiar is there.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_YSHTOLA_000_041: That may be, but no one has set foot in there since the exodus. I dread to imagine what has become of it.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_MATOYA_000_042: Oh, there's sure to be a handful of feral familiars and mayhap a monster or two. But nothing to trouble the likes of you. You can consider cleaning up the place payment for my help.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_MATOYA_000_044: Good girl. Now, if there are no other objections, I suggest you run along to the Makers' Quarter.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_MATOYA_000_045: I'll send one of my poroggos ahead to let you into the workshop. You need only tell him who you are. One can't be too careful, after all. Off you go.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_MATOYA_000_050: What are you still doing here? Off to the Makers' Quarter with you! I'll join you when I'm ready. Go on, now! Shoo!
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_ALPHINAUD_000_051: As I may have mentioned, Alisaie and I were still very young when we departed with the exodus. I envy Y'shtola for remembering the city as it once was.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_ALISAIE_000_052: The grass could certainly do with a trim...
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_YSHTOLA_000_053: The workshop was an unforgiving place even before the exodus, and I doubt the years of neglect have improved it.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_GRAHATIA_000_054: Judging by the unruly state of the flora without, I think it safe to assume there will be no shortage of unruly fauna within. Add to that the undisturbed secrets of the workshop, and we have the makings of an adventure!
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_GUIDEPOROGGO_000_06: Greetings, ribbit, and welcome to my good mistress's relict. Puro Roggo is my name, and I am honored to be your guide.

Within you will find a space dedicated to the making of familiars, along with a cavern wherein the requisite ingredients may be had. I must warn you, however, that the place has not played host to a single soul, much less a broom, in over fifteen years, and will, I regret, be in some disarray.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_GUIDEPOROGGO_100_06: But rest assured, my brothers and I shall see to it you do not lose your way. Now then, ribbit! Only say the word, and I will show you in.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_A1_000_002: Form a party and enter Matoya's Relict.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Though it has been a while since last I joined the fray, I have followed Alisaie's example and practiced whenever possible. My healing magicks are ready as always.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_ALISAIE_000_071: I'm no stranger to porxie-making, as you know. And that must count for something!
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_YSHTOLA_000_072: I was still a child when last I came here, but now I am rather more capable. Not that Master Matoya seems to have noticed. Mayhap she will when I have cleaned up the mess she left.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_GRAHATIA_000_073: So, , shall I lead the van? Or would you rather I followed up the rear?
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_GRAHATIA_100_073: Whatever you prefer, I am happy to adapt. So come, let us go and make our mother porxie!
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_MATOYA_100_075: Why aren't you in the Makers' Quarter? You're to look for my poroggo there. Go on now. I'll join you when I'm good and ready.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_GUIDEPOROGGO_100_07: Are you ready, ribbit? But give me the word, and I will show you in.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_ALISAIE_000_080: Given it was her first time making a porxie, Master Matoya did a fine job. Though she did have Angelo for inspiration.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_GRAHATIA_000_081: Forgive me if this is a silly question, but of all creatures real and imagined...why choose a flying pig? Not that I dislike pigs, mind you...
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_MATOYA_100_085: Ugh, my joints were fairly screaming by the time I got home, and Shtola was more hindrance than help. In future, I'll thank you to keep your favors closer to my cave.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_YSHTOLA_100_086: My apologies, but I will rest here awhile. Go on without me.
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_ALPHINAUD_000_090: Lest you wonder, Master Matoya has returned to her cave with Y'shtola. Hm hm! They are as peas in a pod, are they not?
TEXT_LUCKMJ105_04011_SYSTEM_000_100: You may now enter Matoya's Relict with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALISAIE_100_001: Let's see: brilliant minds, rapier wits, humor drier than Thanalan... Appearances aside, I'd say the two Matoyas are mirror images of each other.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_GRAHATIA_100_002: As I followed your deeds through history, I came across the names of a great many distinguished individuals such as Commander Hext and Master Matoya, and it has been a delight to meet them in the flesh. I heartily look forward to making the acquaintance of the rest, not least the Azure Dragoon!
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_YSHTOLA_100_003: My apologies, but I will rest here awhile. Go on without me.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Well then, my friends, let us return to Limsa Lominsa and deliver the good news to the Admiral. A word to the officer in Bulwark Hall should be sufficient to secure us an audience.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Though the Admiral is not expecting us, I am certain she will want to hear our report. Come, let us request an audience.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALISAIE_000_011: If we offer them the means to cure their tempered, the beast tribes are far more likely to listen.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_GRAHATIA_000_012: Even as we speak, we are weaving a new future. And when it all becomes history, I hope that those who follow may look back with gladness.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ZANTHAEL_100_020: ...Tidings for the Admiral, you say? She is presently receiving guests, but for the Scions, I know she will make an exception. Follow me.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_020: My friends... What brings you here this day?
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_100_021: By the Navigator... A cure for tempering.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_021: As often as I've been in awe of you Scions, I would not have thought it possible...
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALISAIE_000_022: And yet it is, Admiral. We have done it. Here in Limsa. And production of more familiars has already begun.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_023: You have my thanks. Truly. This will do much to advance the cause of peace. Yet I fear it will take more to close the rift 'twixt man and beastman.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_024: Bah, even to speak thus divides us.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_025: <sigh> Welcome as it is, a cure will not guarantee reconciliation between our peoples. For though summoning and the tempered may serve to fuel the conflict, they are but symptoms of it.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_026: If we are to resolve the primal problem once and for all, we must address the cause. We must strive for mutual understanding and find a way to leave our bloody past behind.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_027: ...'Twas I who moved that the Alliance renew its push for peace.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_028: Since our ancestors came to these shores some seven centuries past, we Lominsans have been at odds with those who share our island home.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_029: Save for a brief moment of cooperation with the kobolds, our history has been one of nigh-constant territorial squabbling.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_030: Meanwhile, our struggle with the Sahagin for control over the seas has only grown fiercer. A matter made worse by the thrice-damned Calamity driving them to seek new spawning grounds...
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_031: With survival at stake, each had no choice but to fight. And so I dismissed peace as impossible.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_032: “Impossible is a word coined by the weak,” I proclaimed to all who'd listen─and then gave up. You and yours put me to shame.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_033: Since you led us to victory against the Black Wolf, you have achieved the impossible again and again and again.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_034: And I thought it high time that I followed suit. Hence my proposal to the Alliance council.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_035: But no sooner did I reach out to our neighbors in Vylbrand than my own people sought to thwart me.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALPHINAUD_000_036: You speak of the pirates who failed to attend the meeting.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_037: Aye. Acting through a friendly faction among the kobolds, we had intended to seek an audience with a prominent patriarch.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_038: But the Bloody Executioners would not hear of it, and their absence sent a message to the rest.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_039: Though they are but one of the three pirate powers, they are the greatest, and any attempt at peace would founder without them.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALPHINAUD_000_040: I am given to understand that their leader, Captain Hyllfyr, has been bedridden for some while with an ailment of the lungs.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_041: Correct. In his absence, his right hand leads, a man named Sicard but recently risen to prominence among their ranks.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_042: Save for his disdain for authority, little is known about him. We have invited him to speak with us more than once, but he will not come.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_043: I have tasked the Yellowjackets and the rogues with uncovering his motives, but they have learned naught of any value.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALISAIE_000_044: We have a nose for the truth. Whatever this Sicard wants, we'll find out.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALISAIE_000_045: We have a nose for the truth. Whatever this Sicard wants, I'm sure we could find out.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_046: Truly? I would be much obliged.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_MERLWYB_000_047: I shall look forward to hearing what you learn, then. Good luck.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALISAIE_000_050: The Admiral is right─the cause of the conflict needs to be addressed. We'll do what we can to ease the way, but it ultimately falls to the Lominsans to make peace with their neighbors.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_GRAHATIA_000_051: I know naught of this city save what I've read or heard in passing. So in this matter, I will follow your lead.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ZANTHAEL_000_052: So you will be looking into Sicard for us, will you? I wish you luck...
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALPHINAUD_000_060: By way of a first step, I suggest we split up and make inquiries around town. Someone must know this Sicard.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALPHINAUD_000_061: If you could approach the pirates, , the rest of us will seek out merchants and adventurers.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_CARVALLAIN_000_070: Curious about Sicard, are you? As am I, my friend, as am I.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_CARVALLAIN_000_071: Sadly, I know nothing of the man─save that the Bloody Executioners experienced a marked improvement in their fortunes after his promotion.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_CARVALLAIN_000_072: Quite how he achieved this is a matter of some debate.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_CARVALLAIN_000_073: As you know, the thalassocracy permits us to attack only Garlean vessels, yet these have all but vanished from the seas since the Empire turned in upon itself.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_CARVALLAIN_000_074: In order to adapt, we Krakens have taken to trading with the East, but the Executioners are less...forward looking. I cannot imagine they would willingly abandon the old ways.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_CARVALLAIN_000_075: So how, then, are they lining their coffers? ...Whatever their secret, they are not like to share it with their rivals, but mayhap you will have more luck.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_RHOSWEN_100_080: Eh? Ye want to know about Sicard? 'E's a wily bugger is what 'e is.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_RHOSWEN_000_080: Found some clever way to make coin, they say, an' traded it fer Moenskaet's place at ol' Hyllfyr's side.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_RHOSWEN_000_081: There was a time we raced the Executioners fer our pick of the Empire's fleet, but the Garleans are gone, an' them days with 'em.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_RHOSWEN_000_082: Owin' to which, we've all of us had to look fer other ways to make ends meet─with that jumped-up bilge rat Sicard landin' the juiciest, whatever it may be.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_RHOSWEN_000_083: Not that we Sirens are strugglin', mind... We do well enough guardin' fishin' boats from the fishbacks an' other beasties.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_RHOSWEN_000_084: Get the first pick o' the produce fer our trouble, see. Quality stuff at a bargain price.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_RHOSWEN_000_085: This we pass to our sisters as can't sail on account o' gettin' old or wounded or with child, an' they cook it up an' sell it for a pretty profit. Simple!
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_RHOSWEN_000_086: Oh, I miss the old ways, don't get me wrong. But when I see the girls with their little ones, I think to meself: a life o' peace an' quiet ain't all bad.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_CARVALLAIN_000_090: I have told you all I know of Sicard. Should you learn how the Bloody Executioners are lining their coffers, you will share their secrets with me, I trust?
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_RHOSWEN_000_091: If you 'ear 'ow that scrawny whelp's makin' that much coin, you tell me, all right? I'll make it worth yer while.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALISAIE_000_092: As I went about making my inquiries, I chanced upon a shop that boasted a rather enticing selection of sweetmeats. Perhaps we could take Ga Bu and G'raha there one day?
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_GRAHATIA_000_093: Walking through the city, one would never suspect this was until recently a bastion of piracy. The Admiral is to be commended for overseeing so swift a transformation.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALPHINAUD_000_100: I see everyone has returned. Now, who would like to go first?
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALPHINAUD_000_101: So, just as their imperial prey began to disappear, Sicard turned the Executioners' fortunes around with a mysterious new source of income...
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALISAIE_000_102: Whatever it is, it's nothing to scoff at. According to a tavern keeper I spoke to, the crew have been indulging themselves as never before. But no amount of drink seems to loosen their tongues as to how they are coming by their coin.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_GRAHATIA_000_103: For my part, I spoke with a reporter from the Harbor Herald. The publication has been investigating the secret of the Executioners' good fortune, and making little headway.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALPHINAUD_000_104: Plainly, the Executioners do not wish the nature of their business to be made public.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALPHINAUD_000_105: ...And I think I may know why. In the course of making inquiries on Hawkers' Alley, an interesting fact came to light. Just as the Executioners began to enjoy better fortunes, the price of crystal went into sharp decline─a sudden fall in demand, I was told.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALPHINAUD_000_106: Curious, I contacted Hoary Boulder, who has been watching the movements of the beast tribes. And my suspicions were proven correct.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALPHINAUD_000_107: Despite ever-worsening relations between the beast tribes and the thalassocracy, neither Titan nor Leviathan have made an appearance of late, suggesting that the kobolds and Sahagin lack the means with which to summon them.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_GRAHATIA_100_108: Do you mean to say the Executioners are divesting them of their crystals?
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALPHINAUD_000_109: All indications point to that conclusion, yes─though we have no hard evidence as yet. We must investigate further.
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALISAIE_000_110: Agreed. So how do we proceed?
TEXT_LUCKMJ106_04012_ALPHINAUD_000_111: Oh, I have an idea about that. In fact, I have already taken the liberty of making certain provisions.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_ALISAIE_100_001: Do you remember how Alphinaud pretended to be some manner of merchant to infiltrate Eulmore? Well, I bet you ten gil he's about to reprise the role.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_GRAHATIA_100_002: If Alphinaud's theory proves well founded, it would go some way to explaining the Executioners' vehement opposition to peace.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_ALPHINAUD_000_000: During my inquiries, a disgruntled merchant informed me that a wholesaler of crystals had recently arrived in Limsa Lominsa, offering wares at prices far undercutting the competition.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_ALPHINAUD_000_001: After asking around, I was able to gain an introduction, and will shortly pose as a potential buyer, in a bid to establish the crystals' provenance.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_ALPHINAUD_000_002: The man is due to be at Oschon's Embrace in lower La Noscea shortly. I suggest we make our way there at once.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_ALPHINAUD_000_010: That appears to be our merchant. Wish me luck...
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_GRAHATIA_000_011: Wait. If he truly is in league with the Bloody Executioners, he will surely be wary of those allied to the Admiral─the Scions not least of all.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_GRAHATIA_000_012: Compared to yours and 's, mine is an unfamiliar face. Let me play the role of buyer.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_ALISAIE_100_012: G'raha is right. And even if you aren't recognized on sight, you look too genteel to be mixing with society's underbelly.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_ALPHINAUD_000_013: Genteel...? But very well. I leave it you, G'raha.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_GRAHATIA_000_015: I─ Ahem. You're the crystal wholesaler?
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_SUSPICIOUSMERCHANT_: That I am. But you're no merchant. So what do you want the crystals for?
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_ALISAIE_000_018: (Don't look at us, you idiot! You'll give yourself away!)
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_SUSPICIOUSMERCHANT_: Ohhh, I see. You're a weaponsmith, am I right? And you need crystals to make staffs like that fine specimen you've got there.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_GRAHATIA_000_020: Th-That's right! I am indeed a weaponsmith, and I use naught but the finest materials. I bid you show me your wares.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_SUSPICIOUSMERCHANT_: Well, we don't invite just anybody into our storehouses. Takes time to establish trust, you understand.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_GRAHATIA_000_022: Look, I have a large and urgent commission. If the quality is satisfactory, I will not quibble over the price.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_SUSPICIOUSMERCHANT_: ...All right. It's plain that's no ordinary crystal adornin' your staff. So I'll make an exception. Come with me.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_ALPHINAUD_000_024: It...seems to be working. Let's follow them.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_ALISAIE_000_028: Given how long he spent playing the Crystal Exarch, you'd think G'raha would be a better actor.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_ALISAIE_100_028: Honestly, if it hadn't been for that staff... We must remember to thank Tataru.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_ALPHINAUD_000_030: They went into that tunnel. Quietly, now...
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_SUSPICIOUSMERCHANT_: You won't find any finer. 'Specially not for the price.
