TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_GRAHATIA_000_051: Indeed. I would expect to pay more than double for such quality. How could they possibly be so cheap?
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_SUSPICIOUSMERCHANT_: There's nothin' unlawful about 'em, if that's your worry. They're from O'Ghomoro, if you take my meanin'.
Stuff's as pure as it gets─you won't be disappointed. So...how much d'you want?
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_ALPHINAUD_000_054: O'Ghomoro. Taken from the kobolds, just as we suspected.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_SICARD_000_055: (-???-)That's enough. Shut your gobs and turn around. Slowly.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_SICARD_000_056: I'm Sicard, actin' captain of the Bloody Executioners.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_SICARD_000_057: No need to introduce yourselves. We know who you are...Scions.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_SICARD_000_058: And we also know you've been chattin' to the Admiral. Got eyes and ears everywhere, see. Comes with bein' the only true pirate crew left in Limsa.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_SICARD_000_059: So we've established you ain't here to buy crystals. The question is: what are you here for?
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_ALPHINAUD_000_060: You are bold to reveal yourself to us without knowing our objective. But that would explain your swift rise to power.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_ALPHINAUD_000_061: You have spoken plain, and so I shall return the favor. We came here to learn why the Bloody Executioners oppose the Admiral's will.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_ALPHINAUD_000_062: And we have our answer. Should Limsa Lominsa make peace with the kobolds, you would lose the source of your newfound wealth.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_SICARD_000_063: That's right. Just to remind you, though, we ain't breakin' any rules here.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_SICARD_000_064: The law forbids us from attackin' any vessel not flyin' the imperial flag, but it don't say nothin' about beastmen.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_SICARD_000_065: Only reason we keep our operation nice and quiet's 'cause we don't want no one takin' our business.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_SICARD_000_066: Wait. Just listen to the end, will you? For what it's worth, I have the highest respect for you and yours─ especially.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_SICARD_000_067: While the Maelstrom were worryin' about dirtyin' their fancy red clobber, you lot stormed U'Ghamaro and battered bleedin' Titan himself. Raised a mug to you when I heard the news!
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_SICARD_000_068: And now we're followin' in your footsteps, makin' sure the beastmen never summon their stinkin' gods again. Practically your successors, we are.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_SICARD_000_069: When there were still imperial ships about, we did our bit for Limsa and went after 'em. But with the Garleans gone, there's no one left to ply our trade on 'cept the beastmen. So let us have that, eh? It's only fair.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_GRAHATIA_000_070: ...Contentious though some may find your views, it is true that you have broken no laws.
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_GRAHATIA_000_071: That being so, I see no reason why you should not state your case directly to the Admiral's face. Unless the acting captain of the only true pirate crew left in Limsa Lominsa has some other cause to hide in a cave?
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_SICARD_000_072: Hmph. Well said. Well said indeed...
TEXT_LUCKMJ107_04013_SICARD_000_073: All right. I'll meet with the Admiral. I'll even provide the venue─the Astalicia. I trust she won't turn down the invitation.
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_ALISAIE_100_001: I don't know about you, but it was all I could do to stop myself punching Sicard in the smirking face whenever he opened his mouth.
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_GRAHATIA_100_002: Though I have some passing knowledge of prior events, I am yet ill qualified to meddle in Lominsan affairs. 'Twas not my place to argue with Sicard, much as I would have liked to.
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_GRAHATIA_200_002: Nay, it is for the Admiral to deal with him and the Bloody Executioners both. By bringing them to the negotiating table, we have played our part.
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_ALPHINAUD_000_000: I thought myself the hunter, but it turns out I was the prey... A timely reminder that the pirate powers of Limsa Lominsa are not to be trifled with.
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_ALPHINAUD_000_001: But all's well that ends well. G'raha Tia's timely provocation had the desired effect, and Sicard has agreed to a meeting. Let us hurry back to Limsa Lominsa and pass on his invitation to the Admiral.
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_ALPHINAUD_000_005: Sicard does not want for confidence, that much is plain, but I have faith in the Admiral. She has dealt with far worse.
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_ALISAIE_000_006: The Astalicia is the very last place for such a meeting. The Admiral will be marching right into the coeurl's den. <sigh> I hope we don't end up regretting this...
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_GRAHATIA_000_007: While we have no assurances Sicard will be amenable to reason, there can be no compromise without discussion.
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN_00: There you are. We have eagerly awaited your return.
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_ZANTHAEL_000_020: , your companions have already reported to the command room. Will you be joining them?
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_MERLWYB_000_010: Welcome back, my friends. What news?
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_MERLWYB_100_011: So they have been stealing crystals from the kobolds...
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_MERLWYB_000_011: My thanks for solving the mystery, and securing a meeting besides.
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_MERLWYB_100_012: Suffice to say, I accept Sicard's invitation. And I would have you join me as my guests.
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_MERLWYB_000_012: The future of Limsa hangs upon the outcome of this meeting, and I would have the Scions present to bear witness.
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_ALPHINAUD_000_020: When the discussion gave way to a duel, I feared what might unfold. Yet only a fool would underestimate the Admiral─as Sicard soon discovered.
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_ALISAIE_000_021: While I don't condone what Sicard has been doing, I know how difficult it can be to change course. It took me long enough to join the Scions, didn't it.
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_GRAHATIA_000_022: There are times when one must stand one's ground, even if the cost of failure is beyond reckoning.
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_GRAHATIA_100_022: The Admiral did just that, and I have nothing but respect for her. As she continues to steer her nation through this period of transition, I pray the Navigator will see fit to fill her sails.
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN_00: Like Mistbeard before him, Hyllfyr chose to trust the future of our nation to the Admiral. That was the moment, I believe, that the good ship Limsa Lominsa finally embarked upon her new course.
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_MERLWYB_000_030: ...Though I had anticipated a duel, I did not foresee that Hyllfyr would intervene.
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_MERLWYB_000_031: But full glad am I that he did. 'Twould have been a shame to kill the boy.
TEXT_LUCKMJ108_04014_MERLWYB_000_032: Instead, the whelp has learned a valuable lesson, and we have made peace amongst ourselves. All that remains is to do likewise with our neighbors.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ALPHINAUD_100_000: When the discussion gave way to a duel, I feared what might unfold. Yet only a fool would underestimate the Admiral─as Sicard soon discovered.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ALISAIE_100_001: While I don't condone what Sicard has been doing, I know how difficult it can be to change course. It took me long enough to join the Scions, didn't it.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_GRAHATIA_100_002: There are times when one must stand one's ground, even if the cost of failure is beyond reckoning.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_GRAHATIA_200_002: The Admiral did just that, and I have nothing but respect for her. As she continues to steer her nation through this period of transition, I pray the Navigator will see fit to fill her sails.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN_10: Like Mistbeard before him, Hyllfyr chose to trust the future of our nation to the Admiral. That was the moment, I believe, that the good ship Limsa Lominsa finally embarked upon her new course.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ZANTHAEL_100_004: The Admiral awaits you in the command room, . Shall I announce you?
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_000_000: Now, I need hardly tell you, but any attempt to negotiate with the tribes is doomed to fail unless their minds can first be wrested from the grip of their gods.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_100_000: And so, in the meeting we seek to arrange with the kobolds, I would have you free their leader of Titan's influence.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ALISAIE_000_001: Leave it to us. We will open his ears to reason.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_000_002:
You have my thanks.
Ere we proceed, there is something you should know.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_000_003: Some fifty years past, when the Sahagin swarmed at our hulls in ever greater numbers, Limsa entered into a covenant with the kobolds.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ALPHINAUD_100_004: “To men shall go the bounty of the sea; to kobolds shall go the bounty of the land.” An ostensibly equitable arrangement...conspicuously lacking in detail.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_000_005: Aye. Inadvertently or not, the wording was ambiguous. And we took advantage of it, moving in to claim the northern reaches of La Noscea─which the kobolds believed theirs.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_000_006: Bloodshed followed. Then bloodshed to answer the bloodshed. And on and on it went, till every ilm of Vylbrand bore the stain of our conflict.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_000_007: This is not history, you understand. It is the present, fresh and raw. And with their kindred's blood yet on our hands, we will struggle to regain the kobolds' trust, even should we cure their tempered.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN_00: (-Eynzahr-)Admiral. You speak of obstacles we are like to encounter at the meeting, but as things stand, I see no reason why the kobolds would agree to a meeting in the first place.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_000_013: And so we must provide a reason. I will restore their stolen crystals to them, and personally deliver the cargo along with my apologies.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN_00: (-Eynzahr-)Bait. They would welcome us into their midst not to speak of peace, but to have you at their mercy.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_100_016: Aye. And given the wealth of crystals we will bring, I'll wager they will attempt to summon Titan there and then.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ALISAIE_100_017: Meaning a high priest would need to be present...to whom we could administer the cure!
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_000_017: Precisely. He is the fish I would catch. But he will not be alone. Nay, he will have guards on hand, and they will lay down their lives to protect him.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_100_018: Yet a single death on the kobolds' side would jeopardize our chance at peace. And there my venture founders...
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN_00: (-Eynzahr-)...Yet it need not. What if we were to employ the Conqueror's Chain? Though we would still have to weaken the kobolds, it would allow us to subdue them without inflicting lasting harm.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_100_019: The artifact Mistbeard used to take goods and not life? Aye, that would serve. Well done, Marshal.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_000_020: So, friends, what think you of our strategy?
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_GRAHATIA_000_021: The effects of tempering are cumulative, and we may safely assume that the high priest's exposure to primal influence is extensive. It will therefore take a great deal of aether to reverse its effects, not to mention time.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ALPHINAUD_000_022: Time during which Alisaie would be defenseless. Even should we all look to her protection, I am not convinced we could keep an entire army of kobolds at bay.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ALISAIE_000_023: Well, I'm happy to take that risk. It's not as if we have any other choice.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ALISAIE_000_024: Besides, it's what Tesleen would do. And had I not followed her example, we wouldn't even have a cure for tempering, much less a chance to bring peace to Vylbrand.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ALISAIE_000_025: So I'm going to cure that priest, or die trying.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ALISAIE_000_026: And I believe in you too. You and everyone. I know you'll keep me safe.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ALISAIE_000_027: We don't need one. I trust you. All of you. And I know you'll keep me safe.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_000_028: It is settled, then. See to your preparations, and make for Camp Overlook. We will join you there anon.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ZANTHAEL_100_0040: I shall be praying for your success at the negotiation! Godsspeed!
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ALPHINAUD_000_040: I have no doubt that Alisaie will succeed with the cure, if we can but afford her the time.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_GRAHATIA_000_041: Be under no misapprehension: the extent of the high priest's tempering is like to far exceed that of Ga Bu.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_GRAHATIA_100_041: But then his was a relatively mild case. Milder, indeed, than the majority of those we wish to save. The coming mission will be a truer test of our treatment.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ALISAIE_000_050: Alphinaud wasn't lying when he said I'd be defenseless. So I'm counting on you all to give me the time I need.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ALPHINAUD_000_052: Our sole purpose will be to keep you out of harm's way. So leave that to us, and focus on your own task.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_GRAHATIA_000_051: Indeed. And should you want for aether, you need only say the word.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ALISAIE_000_053: Ga Bu! Did you follow us here!?
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_GABU_000_054: There's something important that I want to say to the high priest. Express, state, say. Please let me come with you. Please!
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ALISAIE_000_055: I'm sorry, but it's too dangerous. I need you to promise me that you'll stay here where it's safe, all right?
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_000_056: My apologies for the wait. It took time, but we have secured our audience.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_000_057: All unfolded as expected. At the mention of my returning their crystals in person, the kobolds suddenly remembered how keen they were to be reconciled.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_100_057: And so, in the glorious spirit of cooperation, we are to be received by Patriarch Za Da of the Second Order, who awaits our pleasure in the Navel. If you are ready, let us proceed to the U'Ghamaro Mines at once.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_GABU_000_060: But I really wanted to go with you... Accompany, join, go with you... <whimper>
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ALPHINAUD_000_061: Patriarch Za Da... If the name sounds familiar, it is because he was the one who presided over the deaths of Ga Bu's parents.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ALPHINAUD_100_061: I tried to reach out to him that day, only for my pleas to fall upon deaf ears.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ALPHINAUD_100_062: But this day will be different. We will reach out together, all of us, and we will take peace in our grasp.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ALISAIE_000_062: There's nothing more to say. I'm going to do this─for Ga Bu, and Tesleen, and anyone who's ever dreamed of a better future.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_GRAHATIA_000_063: Alisaie can be forgiven a certain amount of recklessness, but if she goes so far as to contemplate sacrificing herself, I will remind her how she responded when I thought to do the same.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_GRAHATIA_100_063: Not that we will let it come to that, of course. Ready when you are, my friend.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN_00: The Conqueror's Chain stands ready. But weaken your foes, and it will see them subdued.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_BLOEIDIN_000_065: Thought I saw the little one come scamperin' in here earlier. Better now, is he?
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_000_070: This aetheryte will bear us to our quarry.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_000_071: Should he make to summon Titan, as I anticipate, we will halt the ceremony and restrain him.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_000_072: At this, all hells will break loose, and we will have an army of kobolds to entertain till Alisaie's work is done. Just remember: none must die. We weaken them, and let Eynzahr do the rest.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_000_073: It is time. Stay the course, my friends. I spy calmer waters beyond this squall.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_GABU_000_080: I'm so glad we could sway the patriarch. Convince, persuade, sway. Thank you for making it possible! Thank you!
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ALPHINAUD_000_081: It has taken a long time, but the dream of a lasting peace with the kobolds may soon become a reality. And it is all thanks to Alisaie.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_ALISAIE_000_082: The treatment may have restored the patriarch to his senses, but it was the Admiral and Ga Bu's words that touched his heart. This moment belongs to all of us, . We couldn't have done it without each other.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_GRAHATIA_000_083: In two separate worlds, the seeds were sown, and through the determination of two indomitable women, they have quickened into this historic moment. I feel honored to have been present to see it.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN_00: The Admiral seems hells-bent on worrying me to death, but I suppose the ends justify the means. Well fought, my friend. Well fought.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_000_090: 'Twould seem we have found a way forward with the kobolds. Next, we will help the Second Order to free their tempered brethren from thralldom.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_000_091: Theirs is far from the only order, of course, and it will take no small amount of time and effort to reach the rest. But reach them we will, however long it takes.
TEXT_LUCKMJ109_04015_MERLWYB_000_092: I would say that I was in your debt, but that has long been true. So instead, I will say thank you─for helping us to plot a new course not only for Limsa Lominsa, but all Eorzea.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_MERLWYB_000_000: Savor the moment, . Your next task can wait.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_GABU_100_001: If I could befriend you all, then surely other kobolds can befriend men too. And I'll do everything I can to help them. Facilitate, assist, help.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_ALISAIE_100_002: Ga Bu is wise beyond his years. It's all very well leaders signing peace treaties, but it falls to individuals to bridge the gap.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_GRAHATIA_100_003: I daresay we could all do with a rest, Alisaie not least of all, given the amount of aether she has been expending of late.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_EYNZAHRSLAFYRSYN_10: Judging by the...<grunt>...complaints my back is making, I may have overreached myself. Ah, the ravages of old age...
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_STORMOFFICER_000_00: Don't worry, ─I'll keep watch over the tower. Your place is in Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_ALPHINAUD_000_001: It appears to be business as usual inside the city, but Lyse will be able to tell us if there have been any developments without.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_ALISAIE_000_002: ...Ga Bu? Don't worry. He's with our Maelstrom friends. Meaning we're free to deal with the latest problem to fall uninvited into our laps... <sigh>
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_GRAHATIA_000_003: Though it isn't visible from here, the locals report that a tower-like structure has appeared to the south.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Though our objectives were different, I could understand why Elidibus and his fellows acted as they did. But Fandaniel?
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_ALPHINAUD_100_010: It will take me some time to make sense of it all...if indeed there is any sense to be found.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_ALISAIE_000_011: Are you all right, ? The rest of us are fine if a little singed.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_ALISAIE_100_011: That dragon let us off lightly. Honestly, though─only a madman would choose the name “Lunar Bahamut.” Which just about sums up Fandaniel, I suppose...
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_GRAHATIA_000_012: What part could these towers feasibly play in the Telophoroi's plans, do you think?
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_GRAHATIA_100_012: I for one am at a loss. For now, we should bear word of these developments to the others. I only hope Thancred and Urianger are safe.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_RAUBAHN_000_013: Our scouts report that the Ascian and his dragon have left Gyr Abania. It seems this was purely a social visit.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_LYSE_000_020: Thank goodness everyone's safe... We've managed to put out the fire, though not quickly enough to save the garden.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_LYSE_000_021: Raubahn─can I leave it to you to send word to the Alliance?
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_LYSE_100_021: I'm going to take a unit and investigate the tower. We need to find out what it's for.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_RAUBAHN_000_022: No you won't. You'll rest. From what Merlwyb tells me, you're due some time off duty.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_RAUBAHN_000_023: Should we learn anything about the tower, we'll be sure to share it with you. Until then, I want you to rest.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_ALISAIE_100_023: ...Very well. But if you need our help, don't hesitate. And take care. Both of you.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_RAUBAHN_000_030: If an Ascian is on the prowl, it will not be long before we call on you and yours again. Rest now, while you still can.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_LYSE_000_031: So you really did it─you found a cure for tempering! Oh, it makes me want to do something heroic, right now! Speaking of which, I'd better get ready and set out for the tower!
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_ALPHINAUD_000_032: Ah, how good it feels to come home to the Rising Stones. It's here my heart feels most at peace, and my mind the clearest.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_ALISAIE_000_033: Y'shtola returned just before us. And it seems she knows about the towers too.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_GRAHATIA_000_034: Though my new...or rather old...by which I mean young... Ahem. Though this body has a good deal more stamina than the one I wore out in the First, I confess I've been looking forward to a moment's respite. We've had a busy few days, have we not?
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_YSHTOLA_000_035: It would seem you have had quite an eventful time in my absence. But I am fully rested now and ready for more.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_TATARU_100_036: Welcome back, ! Make yourself comfortable, and let me know if I can get you anything.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_KRILE_000_040: Ah, you're back too. Good. We've received the reports from the Alliance.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_KRILE_000_041: Since we are all here, perhaps those who bore witness to the events in Ala Mhigo could treat the rest of us to a firsthand account?
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_YSHTOLA_000_050: No sooner do we overcome one problem than another appears. It would all seem tediously predictable but for the endless variety of our foes. This Fandaniel sounds even more unhinged than his patron.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_ALPHINAUD_000_051: Unhinged, perhaps, but no fool. For all his pantomime theatrics, he gave away little about his plot. We know only that he intends to recreate the Final Days, and that the towers will somehow facilitate this.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_ALISAIE_000_052: He also called his dragon “Lunar Bahamut.” Let's not forget that little detail.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_ALISAIE_000_053: And the creature did resemble the descriptions I've seen of the elder primal.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_ALISAIE_000_054: And the creature certainly did resemble the elder primal.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_GRAHATIA_000_055: That may be...but the fact that it answered to Fandaniel would suggest they are not one and the same entity. I think it more probable that it is some manner of simulacrum born of Ascian magicks.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_ALPHINAUD_000_056: Whatever it is, for now we can but work closely with the Alliance and remain vigilant.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_ALPHINAUD_000_057: I believe that concludes our news. What of yours, Y'shtola?
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_YSHTOLA_000_058: I have been to see the sultana. Knowing how quick the Immortal Flames are to dispose of their tempered, I judged it best to provide them with the cure first.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_YSHTOLA_000_059: As soon as I had sufficiently recovered, I traveled to Ul'dah and delivered the porxies to Her Grace, along with detailed instructions on their use.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_YSHTOLA_000_060: Yet my visit chanced to coincide with the arrival of some troubling tidings. The Immortal Flames had been on the cusp of agreeing to a truce with the Amalj'aa when negotiations abruptly collapsed.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_YSHTOLA_000_061: The Amalj'aa claim that a number of their kind have been abducted...and that men are responsible.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_YSHTOLA_000_062: Naught is known of the perpetrators as yet. But as the Immortal Flames went about investigating the abductions, they came upon one of Fandaniel's towers.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_KRILE_000_063: On the subject of the towers, you may be interested to learn that they are not an exclusively Eorzean phenomenon. According to the Alliance, they have been sighted as far afield as Yanxia.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_ALPHINAUD_000_064: Then it would seem reasonable to assume that they are everywhere. We simply have not found them.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_KRILE_000_065: Well, as you said yourself, we can do little for now save remain vigilant. And since we are dealing with a dragon─ostensibly, at least─I believe it would behoove us to enlist the aid of an authority on such foes.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_ALPHINAUD_000_068: Estinien? Now just a moment... If he could be persuaded to lend us his lance, I would be the first to welcome it, but the truth is, we will struggle even to find him.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_TATARU_000_069: Hehe! You let me and Krile worry about that. We'll sniff him out, no matter where he's hiding!
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_KRILE_000_070: If indeed he is hiding. We have ways of locating him, regardless. So if there are no objections, we shall depart at once.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_ALISAIE_000_071: Well, rather than sitting around, I think I might go to each of the city-states and educate them in the use of the porxies.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_ALPHINAUD_000_072: They would doubtless appreciate it. But might you consider taking a moment to rest before leaving? You would be fresher for the tasks ahead.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_GRAHATIA_000_073: Well, my friend...our moment of triumph did not last long.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_A1_000_001: 'Twas ever the way. The world often needs saving.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_A1_000_002: Oh dear. Are you not enjoying our adventure?
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_A1_000_003: And I really could have done with a rest...
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_GRAHATIA_000_074: And save it we shall. I for one do not intend to allow a nihilistic madman to take us all to the grave with him. Not when the future holds such promise.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_GRAHATIA_000_075: Nay, I will do all in my power to protect those whom I hold dear. Just as you have always done.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_GRAHATIA_000_076: Come now, I didn't say that. While it may not be the most carefree experience, there is nothing in this world I would rather do than write a new future with you.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_GRAHATIA_000_077: A long future, mind, whatever the Telophoroi might hope. We'll stop them, won't we. Together.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_GRAHATIA_000_078: Then why not have one now? If anything happens, I promise I will come and wake you.
TEXT_LUCKMJ110_04016_GRAHATIA_000_079: As much as I enjoy our adventures together, I am conscious of the toll they take. So let us gather our strength while we can, that we might rise to the challenges of the unwritten future.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ALISAIE_000_000: Good news, ! Thancred and Urianger have finished their tour of Garlemald, and are on their way back here even as we speak.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ALISAIE_000_001: As we still haven't heard anything on the towers from the Alliance, I'm hoping they might be able to shed some light on things.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ALISAIE_000_002: They're due to arrive any moment now, so let's see what they have to say, eh?
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_THANCRED_000_010: Ah, a welcoming party. You needn't have gone to the trouble. From what I hear, you've been more than busy enough as it is.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_THANCRED_100_010: Honestly, you might have waited for me to return before discovering a cure for tempering. As it is, I can't even pretend to have been involved!
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Well, if it's any consolation, I myself was little more than a spectator. The lion's share of the credit must go to Alisaie, G'raha, and . But I believe I speak for the rest of us when I say we are proud to have rendered what little assistance we could.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ALISAIE_100_011: As you will also have heard, though, it hasn't all been tales of triumph. Just as we were taking a step towards finally addressing the primal threat, a pile of fresh problems landed in our lap.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ALISAIE_101_011: Anyway, it's good to have you back. Though I can't help noticing that we're one Urianger short of a scouting party. You haven't lost him, have you?
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_THANCRED_000_012: Oh, I couldn't lose him if I tried. And I did try. Repeatedly. But no, he decided to linger in Ala Mhigo to apprise Raubahn and the others of how the land lies in Garlemald.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_YSHTOLA_000_014: Then mayhap you would do the same for us.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_THANCRED_000_015: Indeed. It was just as Lyse said. Worse, in fact. Devastation as far as the eye could see.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_THANCRED_000_016: Nerva and the IIIrd, however, were notable by their absence.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ALPHINAUD_000_017: Might they have met their end at the hands of Zenos and Fandaniel?
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_THANCRED_000_018: Perhaps. Or perhaps they simply lost the will to fight.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_THANCRED_000_019: You see, the capital has been plunged into a deathly silence, with one exception: the imperial palace.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_THANCRED_100_019: It was a busy place before the war, but it has grown busier still, with throngs of soldiers and civilians working there day and night to rebuild─or rather, transform it.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_THANCRED_000_021: That...is a difficult question to answer. The construction is vast and unsettling to behold, like something from a nightmare. According to Urianger, certain aspects of its design were clearly devised with the manipulation of aether in mind. Magitek, in other words.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_THANCRED_000_022: Yet as unnerving as said edifice was, it was nothing next to the sight of its builders. They swarmed the place like so many insects, working with nary a word exchanged between them. No one overseeing construction, no one barking orders. It was as if they were possessed...or tempered.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_THANCRED_000_023: We wanted to investigate more closely, but given our suspicions, it seemed wiser not to take the risk.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ALPHINAUD_000_024: Hmm... If Fandaniel could bind Bahamut to his will, might he have done the same to the people of Garlemald?
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ALPHINAUD_100_024: Whatever the truth may be, this information is certain to prove valuable. You have our thanks.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_THANCRED_000_025: Well, be sure to save some for Urianger. Which reminds me, I have a message from Ala Mhigo.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_THANCRED_000_026: Raubahn is hosting a meeting to discuss the latest findings on the towers, and he requested our presence.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ALPHINAUD_000_027: Then why not leave that to us? You must be weary from your mission.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_THANCRED_000_028: No, no, I'm fine. Those towers have been on my mind since I first spied one on the way back, and I'm keen to get to the bottom of this.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_YSHTOLA_000_029: In that case, I shall stay and begin looking into another matter, as I promised Krile. We need not all attend.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Very well, I suggest the rest of us make our way to Ala Mhigo forthwith. The sooner we leave, the more time we will have to speak with Urianger before the meeting.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_YSHTOLA_000_040: If you are curious to know what I will be doing in your absence, let us speak of it another time. At present, Krile and I have no more than a hypothesis...
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ALPHINAUD_000_045: While we may safely assume that the Telophoroi are behind the works being carried out on the imperial palace, we can only guess at their purpose.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ALISAIE_000_050: The Royal Menagerie is still closed to civilians. Fandaniel and his pet certainly left their mark...
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_GRAHATIA000_055: I wonder if there have been any developments regarding the Amalj'aa abductions. It can be no mere coincidence that the incidents began occurring just as the towers first appeared.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_THANCRED_000_060: Although I was only in Revenant's Toll a short while, I did manage to squeeze in a brief drink with F'lhaminn. Spring water only, it being a flying visit.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_URIANGER_000_070: My friends. Much and more have I heard of your travails in our absence. Heartened am I to see you all hale and whole.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_GRAHATIA000_071: As are we to see you safely returned from your mission, Urianger. I trust Thancred made you feel welcome?
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ARENVALD_072: (-???-)Well, well! If it isn't Alphinaud and his merry band!
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ALPHINAUD_000_073: Arenvald! Whatever are you doing here? When we spoke via linkpearl, you told me you'd be away on a mission!
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ARENVALD_074: And who's to say this isn't part of it? But enough about that. It's good to see you looking so...similar. I thought you'd have grown a bit taller after a whole year in another world, but apparently not!
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ALPHINAUD_000_075: Well, I am sorry to disappoint you. While my soul may be a year older, my body has hardly aged─as you are well aware.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ALPHINAUD_000_076: And may I remind you that we Elezen are known to be late bloomers, especially in terms of our height. Mark my words, the day will come when even a great aurochs such as yourself will crane your neck to meet my eye!
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_URIANGER_000_077: Aye...'twas not until my twentieth summer that I myself outgrew my boyish proportions...though Moenbryda towered over me nonetheless.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ALISAIE_000_078: Arenvald brings out the best in Alphinaud, doesn't he? They both seem so at ease in each other's company. It's almost endearing.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ARENVALD_080: Oh, Fordola, mostly. We need to go over a few things before we set out.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ALPHINAUD_000_081: Set out? Wait. Does this have something to do with the towers?
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ARENVALD_083: Actually, tell me later. You've got a meeting to go to. I'll see you afterwards, all right?
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ALPHINAUD_000_084: If Fordola is going with him, that must mean...
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ALPHINAUD_000_085: My apologies. As Arenvald rightly pointed out, we have a meeting to attend. Let us be about it.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ALPHINAUD_000_150: I accept that numbers can prove a hindrance when infiltrating enemy territory, but to send only two?
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_FORDOLA_000_155: If it's small talk you're after, look elsewhere.
TEXT_LUCKMK101_04058_ARENVALD_160: Now that it's out in the open, I don't have to keep it under my proverbial hat anymore.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ALISAIE_000_000: I get the impression Arenvald is a lot more apprehensive than he lets on. He will have been grateful Alphinaud was there to see him off.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_GRAHATIA_000_005: Estinien Wyrmblood, the Azure Dragoon...! His was another name that featured prominently in the history books, and it will be fascinating to meet the man in the flesh.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ALPHINAUD_000_020: So Estinien was bound for Ishgard...
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ALPHINAUD_000_021: Whatever it is that brings him home, we must hope it will keep him there long enough for us to find him. Come, there is no time to lose.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ALISAIE_000_030: Assuming we find him, this will be my first encounter with the famous Estinien. And if he's half the man Alphinaud claims, I fully expect to go weak at the knees. Perhaps do a bit of fainting while I'm at it.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_GRAHATIA_000_035: I have only visited Ishgard once before, after the devastation of the Eighth Umbral Calamity. To see the place in all its former─forgive me─in all its original glory is a tantalizing prospect indeed.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ALPHINAUD_000_050: All present? Good. Let us split up and search for Estinien.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ALISAIE_000_051: Since we're relatively new to this place, G'raha and I will look around the open spaces─the squares and markets and whatnot. You and  can delve into the nooks and crannies.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ALPHINAUD_000_052: Very well. Let us reconvene at the airship landing later, with or without Estinien. Good luck.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ALPHINAUD_000_053: I think I shall begin at the Skysteel Manufactory, so perhaps you could try the Congregation? Lucia may well have heard news of our friend's return.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ALPHINAUD_000_070: It seems like only yesterday that the Dragonsong War was an inescapable fact of life here. And now Ishgard is united in healing the wounds left by centuries of conflict. Perhaps later, there will be time for us to see for ourselves how the restoration is proceeding.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ALISAIE_000_075: I spied a few Elezen with spears, but they were all Temple Knights. None of whom had seen Estinien.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_GRAHATIA_000_080: Ishgard in its prime... Would that those I left behind could see it too.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_LUCIA_000_090: Good  to you, Warrior of Light. Lord Aymeric sent word that you would be attending the meeting in Ala Mhigo, so I gather you have not come in search of him. To what then do we owe the pleasure of your visit?
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_LUCIA_000_091: I see. No. We were not aware Ser Estinien had returned to Ishgard, but as I expect you remember, he is wont to come and go as he pleases.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_LUCIA_000_092: Mayhap he came seeking an audience with Lord Aymeric, only to find him absent?
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_LUCIA_000_093: In any event, I am afraid I cannot help you. Perhaps one of your companions has fared better.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_LUCIA_000_100: Many who pass through Ishgard do so via the airship landing. Were I you, I should linger there.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_GRAHATIA_000_105: Ser Estinien is every bit as elusive as Urianger suggested.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ALISAIE_000_200: Not to complain, but I didn't expect to find myself here again quite so soon.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_GRAHATIA_000_205: So this is the Delta Quadrant, where countless dragons yet lie imprisoned...the great Tiamat among them.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ESTINIEN_000_210: Tiamat summoned Bahamut once before. She may have again─willfully or no.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ALPHINAUD_000_250: It has been quite some time since last I set foot in Azys Lla, but I understand the three of you were here rather more recently. I don't suppose you chanced to meet with Tiamat during your visit?
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_GRAHATIA_000_251: Alas not. We had no cause to set foot here in the Delta Quadrant. But I have studied the relevant records─which is not to say I wouldn't appreciate a firsthand account of your dealings with her.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ALISAIE_000_252: Well then,  is the person to ask. As far as I know, 's the only one of us to have met Tiamat face-to-face.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_A1_000_100: Even now, she remains a prisoner of the Allagan Empire.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_A2_000_100: Let's just say, it helped that Midgardsormr was there to introduce me.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ALISAIE_000_260: Ever since the end of the war with Meracydia, yes. <sigh> To have been held captive for so long...
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_GRAHATIA_000_265: Ah, yes! You were a friend of her father!
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ALISAIE_000_270: Some things are hard to put into words. I can only imagine what it must have been like to be the first mortal to speak with her after all that time...
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ESTINIEN_000_275: I too have met with Tiamat.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ESTINIEN_000_276: After the Dragonsong War came to a close, I came here to speak with her─a wyrm who had fought her own war against man in another age.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ESTINIEN_000_277: I wished to know if she yet harbored thoughts of vengeance, and asked as much. She said no.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ESTINIEN_000_278: "My hatred for your kind was extinguished long ago.“
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ESTINIEN_000_279: But the guilt she feels for resurrecting Bahamut burns on undimmed. It torments her, even now.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ALPHINAUD_000_280: ...I see. Then your original reason for coming here was out of concern that Tiamat had been forced to summon Bahamut.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ESTINIEN_000_281: Nidhogg is a part of me. I feel his emotions as my own. And I know that he would not allow his sister to be made a tool of evil.
TEXT_LUCKMK102_04059_ESTINIEN_000_282: In his absence, it falls to me to watch over her.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALPHINAUD_000_000: It was the Ascians who taught Tiamat the secrets of summoning...even as they supplied the Allagans with the means to capture primals. So much suffering, all of it by design.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALISAIE_000_005: Our grandfather sacrificed everything to protect the realm from Bahamut. We must be prepared to do the same.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_GRAHATIA_000_010: The Azure Dragoons of history were the mortal enemies of the dragons. Yet now they would be hard-pressed to find a soul who understood them better.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALPHINAUD_000_040: Resigned to her fate though she may be, I cannot help but feel that we may be able to help Tiamat...would she only let us.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALISAIE_000_045: To think that man is responsible for all this─and so much else that dragonkind has suffered...
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_GRAHATIA_000_050: So this is one of the seven great wyrms... Even thus confined, her presence is...overwhelming.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALPHINAUD_000_100: I confess, my heart was in my throat when Estinien thought to berate her, but it appears to have had the desired effect.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALISAIE_000_105: It won't make up for what she's suffered at the hands of men, but if there's a chance we can free her─truly free her─we owe it to her to try.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ESTINIEN_000_110: It would seem she still has some pride after all. Let's see if she's as good as her word.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_GRAHATIA_000_130: While porxies have been shown to be effective in curing the tempered, Tiamat must be considered a special case.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_GRAHATIA_000_131: She is far, far larger─and immeasurably more powerful─than any subject treated thus far. Were we to remove her restraints only to find that the process had failed, we would be hard-pressed to contain her.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALISAIE_000_132: Then...before going ahead, we should learn as much as we can about the exact nature of her condition. Do you suppose we can find that information here?
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_GRAHATIA_000_133: Why, yes...we can! We can indeed! The Allagans kept detailed records on all of their notable captives, and I know exactly where to look.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALPHINAUD_000_134: We shall leave that to you, then. In the meantime, the rest of us can turn our thoughts to the removal of those shackles.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ESTINIEN_000_135: I know Alphinaud and  here well enough─but not you. Are you certain you're ready to see this through?
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_GRAHATIA_000_136: Rest assured, Ser Estinien, that I am both ready and willing to give my all for the sake of this star─though that is not my only reason for wanting to set Tiamat free.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_GRAHATIA_000_137: While I do not claim to know all of her sorrows, I too once found myself in a prison of despair. And I well understand how hard it can be to dare to dream of escape.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_GRAHATIA_000_138: It took the encouragement of braver souls than I am to make me take the first step towards a brighter future. And now I would help Tiamat do the same.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ESTINIEN_000_140: I gather you are not as young as you look.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_GRAHATIA_000_141: Mayhap when our work here is done, we could trade tales over a pot of Tataru's famous tea?
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ESTINIEN_000_142: And be indebted to her for the leaves and hot water? I think not.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_GRAHATIA_000_143: ...I see. Ahem! Returning swiftly to the task at hand, then...
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_GRAHATIA_000_145: I believe the nodes governing Tiamat's restraints are located in the sector known as the Flagship.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALPHINAUD_000_146: Ah yes. We are familiar with it. The Aetherochemical Research Facility in particular.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_GRAHATIA_000_147: Oh, you may wish to take this. A spirit vessel, containing a small amount of my blood.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALISAIE_000_148: ...Which you just happened to be carrying around with you.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_GRAHATIA_000_149: I suppose that could seem rather odd. To explain, Rammbroes, Urianger, and I are researching the use of spirit vessels in the transference not only of memories, but the traits of certain bloodlines. And so I keep one at the ready should an opportunity to test our theories arise.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_GRAHATIA_000_150: As for its use to you, you may recall that during our previous visit, the nodes here granted access to restricted functions, having identified me as being of royal blood. And armed with that spirit vessel, I posit that they will do the same for you, even in the absence of, well, the rest of me. It seemed worth a try, at least.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALPHINAUD_000_151: Agreed. We will take good care of it.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALISAIE_000_160: It's possible the restraints may have mitigated the effects of her tempering, but Tiamat has been in thrall to Bahamut for thousands of years. To have clung on to her reason through it all says a lot for her strength of will. More than a lot.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_GRAHATIA_000_165: Alisaie and I shall remain here and attend to necessary preparations. In the event that the spirit vessel fails to work as expected, you know where to find me. Good luck.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ESTINIEN_000_170: I would rather leave these Allagan contraptions to you and Alphinaud...
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALPHINAUD_000_180: Let us split up and search the Flagship for the node that controls Tiamat's restraints.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALPHINAUD_000_181: But should you find a likely candidate, do not be tempted to make any adjustments; it would not do to accidentally release some manner of experimental monstrosity, nor less Tiamat herself in her current state. Our objective at this stage is simply to identify the relevant node or nodes. Once we have learned what we can, we should reconvene and compare notes prior to proceeding.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALPHINAUD_000_190: I realize I've said this before─and on more than one occasion─but I never cease to be amazed by Allagan technology. Amazed and disturbed.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ESTINIEN_000_195: These...nodes, or whatever it is you call them─why do they quiver so?
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALLAGANSYSTEMA04060: BZZZT... Friction between metallic components detected... Temperature increasing to critical levels... Please replace damaged parts or retreat to a safe distance... BZZZT...
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_SECURITYSYSTEM_000_: <blip> <bloop> WARNING. Scheduled dragon restraint maintenance due in: -2,020 years. Failure to verify system integrity may result in unscheduled specimen release.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALLAGANSYSTEMB04060: KRRR... Data link with Delta Quadrant broken. Possible cause: intruder interference. Advise deployment of automated combat units. Proceed?
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALLAGANSYSTEMA04060: BZZZT... Friction between metallic components detected... Temperature increasing to critical levels... Please replace damaged parts or retreat to a safe distance... BZZZT...
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_SECURITYSYSTEM_000_: <blip> <bloop> WARNING. Scheduled dragon restraint maintenance due in: -2,020 years. Failure to verify system integrity may result in unscheduled specimen release.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALLAGANSYSTEMB04060: KRRR... Data link with Delta Quadrant broken. Possible cause: intruder interference. Advise deployment of automated combat units. Proceed?
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ESTINIEN_000_235: Infernal things... One of them sent a swarm of mechanical vilekin to plague me. I must have angered it...
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALPHINAUD_000_250: I am afraid Estinien and I have little to show for our efforts. Did you find anything?
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_A1_000_100: I did! A node which smelled like burned hair!
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_A2_000_100: Yes. A chirruping node which spontaneously warned me about neglecting the dragon restraints.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_A3_000_100: I, uh...found a way to activate mechanical sentries if that's any help?
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ESTINIEN_000_260: Hmph. I know the one─though I thought the stench more akin to a fire in a manure shed. But it seemed likelier to explode than grant our wish. Surely there must be another?
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALPHINAUD_000_265: Spontaneously, you say? Well, that does sound promising. Almost suspiciously so, in fact...
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALPHINAUD_000_270: Only if they are willing to lead us to the node we seek...which I somehow doubt. But from what I recall of the Flagship's design, the node you found could facilitate communications throughout Azys Lla, so we may yet find a use for it.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALPHINAUD_000_280: But then you were in possession of the spirit vessel... Hm. I daresay it is indeed the node of which G'raha spoke.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALPHINAUD_000_281: And it was “chirruping,” you say? Very well, let us take a closer look.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALPHINAUD_000_290: As I suspected, the node will not acknowledge my authority to issue it instructions.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ESTINIEN_000_295: How did the Allagans tell these godsforsaken things apart?
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_SECURITYSYSTEM_000_: <blip> Do you wish to operate the dragon restraint mechanisms?
<blip> <bloop> You do not have the requisite access privileges. Operation of the dragon restraint mechanisms may only be undertaken by the chief technologist and members of the royal family.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALPHINAUD_000_312: Or those with a vessel full of royal blood, perhaps.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_SECURITYSYSTEM_000_: (-Restrainment Node-)<blip> New user detected. Commencing biometric authentication...
(-Restrainment Node-)<bloop> Authentication complete. User identified as: member of the royal family. Please state your name.
(-Restrainment Node-)<bloop> Welcome, . You may operate the dragon restraint mechanisms when ready.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALPHINAUD_000_365: But─ But that's just confusing! Amusing as you may find my name, I must ask that you use . Please.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_SECURITYSYSTEM_000_: (-Restrainment Node-)<bloop> User name changed. Welcome, . You may operate the dragon restraint mechanisms when ready.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ESTINIEN_000_370: ...Very funny. But if that thing speaks my name, I shall see that it never speaks again. Use your own. , in case you've forgotten.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_SECURITYSYSTEM_000_: (-Restrainment Node-)<bloop> User name changed. Welcome, . You may operate the dragon restraint mechanisms when ready.
(-Restrainment Node-)<blip> <bloop> Error: Unable to disengage restraints of the specimen “Tiamat.” A system update is required.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALPHINAUD_000_381: ...A “system update”? What do you suppose it is asking of us?
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ESTINIEN_100_381: Well, that's more than I can say. Confounded bloody thing...
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ESTINIEN_105_381: Now that I do understand. You can go first.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_SECURITYSYSTEM_000_:
(-Restrainment Node-)User agitation detected. Initiating guidance program...
<bloop> In order to operate the restraint mechanism, I require access to the central control system. However, I am unable to establish a link to said system due to the obsolescence of my own software.
(-Restrainment Node-)This issue can be resolved by applying a system update using the corresponding terminal located within the Flagship.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ESTINIEN_000_384: So can this thing release the restraints or not?
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALPHINAUD_000_385: It can─but only once it has received the requisite “system update,” as far as I can tell.
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ESTINIEN_000_386: ...Until which time it'll float there spewing nonsense?
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_SECURITYSYSTEM_000_:
(-Restrainment Node-)User dissatisfaction detected. Initiating placation protocols...
<bloop> I am here to help! Rest assured that I will be on hand to guide you through every step of the system update process!
TEXT_LUCKMK103_04060_ALPHINAUD_000_388: How...gratifying. But I daresay we will fare better with guidance than without it.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ALISAIE_000_000: It's possible the restraints may have mitigated the effects of her tempering, but Tiamat has been in thrall to Bahamut for thousands of years. To have clung on to her reason through it all says a lot for her strength of will. More than a lot.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_GRAHATIA_000_005: Alisaie and I shall remain here and attend to necessary preparations. In the event that the spirit vessel fails to work as expected, you know where to find me. Good luck.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ALPHINAUD_000_010: Cid and his colleagues always make operating these Allagan devices seem so easy...
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ESTINIEN_000_015: I don't know what possessed the Allagans to surround themselves with these chattering orbs, but the fact that they remain while their creators do not speaks volumes...
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_SECURITYSYSTEM_000_: <bloop> Guiding user to terminal. This way, please.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ALPHINAUD_000_040: This terminal appears to be similar to the one we encountered when we first set foot here. Let us hope it will be equally helpful.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ESTINIEN_000_045: Don't look at me. This is a task for you and Alphinaud.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_SECURITYSYSTEM_000_: <bloop> Access granted to user , and  adolescent Elezen companion. Master 's other companion is deemed a potential risk to safe operation and has been denied access privileges until further notice.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Let's see... According to the terminal, the central control system is presently employing...“Software Version 56.135.” Dare I ask which version you are employing?
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_SECURITYSYSTEM_000_:
Why, Software Version 42.002, of course.
<blip> <bloop> Warning: Errors detected in the data management system. Estimated time required for update: 5 years, 1 day.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ALPHINAUD_000_072: That is...rather longer than we were hoping. Aren't there any other options? For instance, using this terminal to operate Tiamat's restraints instead?
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_SECURITYSYSTEM_000_: <bloop> The proposed method is indeed an option. Please be warned, however, that the procedure may have changed as a result of the system update, and my instructions may no longer be accurate.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ALPHINAUD_000_074: Well, I can't imagine it will have changed all that much. As long as we pay due attention to any discrepancies, I daresay we shall be able to muddle our way through.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ESTINIEN_000_075: Don't bother trying to explain. Just tell me if we've made any progress.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ALPHINAUD_000_076: I would say so, yes. It does, however, require that I remain here to operate the terminal. I shall inform you via linkpearl once I am ready to release the shackles.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ALPHINAUD_100_076: It might be best if you left the spirit vessel with me. I may yet have use for it. Rest assured, I will be certain to return it to G'raha Tia once this is over.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ESTINIEN_000_077: ...Just a little more work and Tiamat will be free.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ESTINIEN_000_078: But before we go any further, there is something I would know.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ESTINIEN_000_079: When Tiamat and her kin fought against the Allagan Empire, both sides were but dancing to the tune of the Ascians.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ESTINIEN_000_080: And it was the same in Ishgard, where they stoked the fires of conflict between man and dragon from the shadows.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ESTINIEN_000_081: All that the Ascians touch turns to ash, and thus have you made it your mission to fight them.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ESTINIEN_000_082: But there have been times when you tried to reach out to them instead. To find common ground.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ESTINIEN_000_083: And so I must ask: what do you intend to do with Fandaniel? Will you try and reach out to him too?
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_A1_000_100: Enemy or no, I want to understand him.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_A2_000_100: I will try, yes. And if that fails, I'll remember him.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_A3_000_100: Certainly. After I've wiped the smile off his face.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ESTINIEN_000_090: But did he not tell you that he was beyond reason? If he wishes to die, I say we oblige him.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ESTINIEN_000_095: Hmph. I see little point in reasoning with the wretch. Or remembering him for that matter.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ESTINIEN_000_100: Hmph. I'd rather put my lance through his heart and be done with it.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ESTINIEN_000_110: But perhaps that's the difference between you and me. You see the good in people─even if it be but the faintest glimmer. I only hope you do not come to rue your benevolence.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ALPHINAUD_000_111: You think us unwise for viewing the world thus?
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ESTINIEN_000_112: Far from it. That has ever been your way, as I learned when we journeyed together with Iceheart.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ESTINIEN_000_113: Yet the fact remains that there are some who view compassion as a weakness to be exploited. And there may come a time when you extend the hand of friendship only to wish that you had dealt the killing blow.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ESTINIEN_000_114: So...save your mercy for those who deserve it.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ESTINIEN_000_115: ...Well, we should be getting back to our task. If Alphinaud has things in hand here, I suggest we rejoin the others.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ALPHINAUD_000_120: I cannot deny the logic in Estinien's argument. Given all that is at stake, even the slightest lapse in judgment could be the undoing of us all.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_SECURITYSYSTEM_000_: <blip> <bloop> Warning! Releasing dragon restraints may result in specimen loss, damage to facilities, and incineration of staff.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ESTINIEN_000_130: If this Fandaniel truly is without reason or creed, he is no better than a rabid dog. Treat with him if you must, but be ready to do what is necessary.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_GRAHATIA_000_135: So the spirit vessel proved useful after all? Excellent!
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ALISAIE_000_150: Estinien told me all is well, but nothing more. Honestly, it's like getting blood out of a stone with him. I take it from Alphinaud's absence that he's needed elsewhere?
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ALISAIE_000_151: Well, that all sounds rather frustrating, but you got there in the end. While you were off talking to nodes, G'raha and I were learning as much as we could about Tiamat's condition.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_GRAHATIA_000_152: Our readings confirm that her aetherial balance leans strongly towards the umbral, as was the case with the kobolds. Therefore, all other things being equal, the treatment should work.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_GRAHATIA_000_153: The difficulty lies in the sheer quantity of aether with which we must contend. Multiple applications of the treatment will inevitably be required if we are to reverse the effects of the tempering completely.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ALISAIE_000_155: Meaning I'll need all the aether I can get. Thank you in advance.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_GRAHATIA_100_155: Although this endeavor will ask much of us, we do have one reason to be optimistic.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_GRAHATIA_101_155: Namely that Tiamat shows no signs of fanatical devotion, suggesting a milder case of tempering than that suffered by the kobolds.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ESTINIEN_000_156: Hmm... Tiamat saw Bahamut as an equal rather than a god. Might that have made a difference?
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ALISAIE_000_157: Now that you mention it, it very well might. She would not have believed it necessary to defer to his will.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ALISAIE_100_157: But enough talk─it's time to put our theories to the proof. Tell Alphinaud to disengage the restraints' aetherial dampers!
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_TIAMAT_000_159:
(-Tiamat-)Ahhh, such warmth... The frost that shroudeth my soul doth begin to thaw.
But what are these? Visions of days long forgotten...of war with the men of Allag. Wherefore do such baleful memories return to me now?
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_GRAHATIA_000_160: Could it be that the process of restoring her soul to its pre-tempered state is awakening ancient memories? Or might the opposite be true? If so, by helping her to recall the past, we may be able to speed her recovery!
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_GRAHATIA_000_161: ─she trusts you. Speak to her! Ask her to tell you of times past!
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_A1_000_200: Tell me of Bahamut and the Ascians.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_A2_000_200: Tell me of your war with the men of Allag.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_TIAMAT_000_165: (-Tiamat-)Ah, Bahamut...my beloved... Would that the peace we found in Meracydia could have lasted for eternity. But alas, it was not to be... The Ascians saw to that. In all creation, I know of none more wicked. It was at their behest that the men of Allag first came unto Meracydia. Unto our home.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_TIAMAT_000_170: (-Tiamat-)Wicked, bloodthirsty creatures... Not content with their own lands, they brought fire and death to Meracydia. Our home.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_TIAMAT_000_180: (-Tiamat-)The tale began when Bahamut and I left our father's side. We took wing in search of a place to make our aery.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_TIAMAT_000_181: (-Tiamat-)Beyond the southern ocean, we discovered a lush and fertile land. It would come to be known as Meracydia by the children of men, though many years were to pass before they crossed the seas.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_TIAMAT_000_182: (-Tiamat-)Upon our arrival, we were welcomed by the peaceful people of the forest, kin to the trees. Surrounded by nature's bounty, Bahamut and I had found a place to raise our young.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_GRAHATIA_000_183: Fascinating! This correlates with the writings of the Sharlayan scholar Rurusha.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_GRAHATIA_100_183: She posits that man first settled on the southern continent towards the end of the Second Astral Era─correctly, it would appear. If only she were with us to hear the tale from Tiamat herself.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_TIAMAT_000_185: (-Tiamat-)When first the children of man arrived on our shores, no foot did they set in those places over which we held dominion, such was their fear of dragonkind. And as they kept their distance, so did we let them be.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_TIAMAT_000_186: (-Tiamat-)Yet as the days went by, ship after ship appeared upon the horizon, bearing ever more of their brethren, who divided the vast land amongst themselves.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_TIAMAT_000_187: (-Tiamat-)For a time, they knew peace and prosperity. But as their numbers grew, the smaller their share came to seem, and soon they began to covet the territory of their fellows. Ere long, man fought man, blood was answered with blood, and none could see an end to the strife. Until, one day, they came to us.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_TIAMAT_000_188: (-Tiamat-)Recognizing our wisdom, they entreated us to intercede in their conflicts. Bahamut agreed, and with him presiding over the affairs of men, the land knew peace once more.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_TIAMAT_000_189: (-Tiamat-)Alas, those golden days of harmony, too, were fated to end. For the men of Allag slew my beloved, and I, in my rage and sorrow, heeded the envenomed words of the Ascians... The rest, thou knowest only too well.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ALISAIE_000_190: But your tale doesn't have to end there. When you are free, we'll rid the world of the Ascians together. And you and your beloved will have justice.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ESTINIEN_100_190: Fine sentiments─but you're almost spent. I'll keep watch from above. If the treatment fails...run.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ALISAIE_101_190:
Ugh... Thanks for the vote of confidence!
I swear, when this is over...
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_GRAHATIA_000_191: Keep going, Alisaie! The magick is working!
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ESTINIEN_000_200: The girl is as stubborn as her brother. By now, her aether must be all but spent, yet she will not give up.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_GRAHATIA_000_205: Slowly but surely, the magick is working, aided no doubt by the memories you bade her share.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ALISAIE_000_220: <huff> While I knew this wasn't going to be easy...no patient could have prepared me for treating a great wyrm...
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ALISAIE_000_221: But we're close. I can feel it. And while I've only got a few more drops of aether left to give, with yours and G'raha's, this will work.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_GRAHATIA_000_222: Then I believe I speak for both of us when I say that you may take as much as you require!
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ALISAIE_000_223:
Careful, I might hold you to that...
All right, here I go!
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_SECURITYSYSTEM_000_: <bloop> Dragon restraints successfully disengaged. Unable to confirm presence of specimen “Tiamat.” Please seek shelter immediately.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_ALISAIE_000_270: <pant> I'll be fine... Plenty of time to...<pant>...recover on the airship.
TEXT_LUCKMK104_04061_GRAHATIA_000_290: While I'm sure you're desperate to join Estinien and Tiamat in battle, 'twould be wiser to gather the full strength of the Scions first. The foe we face demands no less.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_ALPHINAUD_000_000: ...Yes. We should rally our forces, and make for Paglth'an with all haste.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_SECURITYSYSTEM_000_: <bloop> Dragon restraints successfully disengaged. Unable to confirm presence of specimen “Tiamat.” Please seek shelter immediately.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_ALISAIE_000_010: <pant> I'll be fine... Plenty of time to...<pant>...recover on the airship.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_GRAHATIA_000_030: ...I have already sent word to the others. We are to rendezvous in Ul'dah, at the Hall of Flames.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_GRAHATIA_000_031: Let us collect Alphinaud, and be on our way.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_ALPHINAUD_000_040: As I am sure you recall, Arenvald and Fordola were bound for Paglth'an. I pray they have not come to any harm...
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_ALISAIE_000_045: If you're worried about me, don't be. I got some rest during the flight, and now I feel ready for anything.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_GRAHATIA_000_050: First the spate of abductions, and now an attack on the Amalj'aa homeland... What do the Telophoroi aim to achieve with all of this?
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_URIANGER_000_055: Of the foe we face, we know but little. Though time be of the essence, we must not stint in our preparations, lest our haste to fly to the aid of the Amalj'aa cost us our best chance of victory.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_YSHTOLA_000_060: By happy coincidence, Krile and I were in the process of concluding our inquiries when news reached us of Lunar Bahamut's return. There is much to discuss, but it will have to wait.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_THANCRED_000_070: Now, I know some of you could do with a rest, but I'm sorry to say the Telophoroi have other plans. Paglth'an is already under siege.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_THANCRED_000_071: Happily, the Immortal Flames arrived just in time to join the defensive effort─with Marshal Tarupin at their head.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_ALPHINAUD_000_072: Well, now...! Given the failure of the peace negotiations, I was uncertain how the sultanate would respond. 'Tis good to hear that Ul'dah has not abandoned the Amalj'aa.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_NANAMOULNAMO_000_07: (-???-)Abandon them? Did we not profess to be their friends?

Marshal Tarupin had made provisions for such an exigency and was ready to depart at a moment's notice. All that was required was the agreement of the Syndicate─each of whom voted in favor of intervention.
Nor is Ul'dah alone in its resolve. The other Alliance nations have likewise dispatched their troops to Paglth'an.
Yet even with our combined strength, we shall be sorely tested. For we face not only the might of an imperial legion, but Lunar Bahamut and his draconic horde besides.
Fight as we may, victory is by no means assured. But not all of the omens are grim. Our forces report that despite their proximity to Lunar Bahamut, none of the Amalj'aa show any signs of tempering.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_YSHTOLA_000_080: Strange. What primal would turn down a chance to claim new thralls?
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_YSHTOLA_000_081: ...Unless it is incapable of doing so? Primals are not wont to serve a master, Ascian or otherwise. It may well be that Lunar Bahamut differs in some fundamental manner from those we have previously encountered.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_ALISAIE_000_082: If that were true, anyone could fight him. And  and others like  wouldn't have to shoulder the burden alone.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_NANAMOULNAMO_000_08: Be that as it may, Lunar Bahamut remains an incalculably powerful foe whom our soldiers will struggle to best through mere force of arms. With the aid of the Scions, however, I believe they will fare rather better...assuming, that is, you are ready to take the field.
An airship awaits to bear you to the front. Pray set forth as soon as you are able.
I, meanwhile, shall continue to coordinate our forces. Till next we meet, may the Twelve bless and keep you.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_YSHTOLA_000_087: It was kind of her to speak with us personally. You may be certain she has no shortage of other responsibilities.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_THANCRED_000_088: Well, I for one am inclined to do as Her Grace requests. Lest we forget, Arenvald and Fordola are in Paglth'an on reconnaissance. The sooner we save the day, the better their chances.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_ALPHINAUD_000_090: It is not impossible that the Telophoroi redirected some of the troops stationed at the tower to the front line... If so, this may all turn out to have been to Arenvald and Fordola's benefit.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_ALISAIE_000_095: Given what we know, some─or perhaps even all─of the imperial soldiers may have been tempered. If we can subdue them, we should be able to do something about that, but they would still see us as enemies even then. That said...they wouldn't be deaf to reason, which is better than nothing.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_GRAHATIA_000_100: Do you think Estinien and Tiamat have already reached Paglth'an? ...Ah, but I should know better than to speculate on the whereabouts of the Azure Dragoon. Forgive me.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_URIANGER_000_105: Lest thou wonder, I have attended to Thancred's ammunition, and completed mine own preparations. I trust thou canst say the same of thine.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_YSHTOLA_000_110: So, the Telophoroi have constructed buildings capable of tempering, and primals which are not? What secrets are they hiding...?
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_THANCRED_000_115: Try as I might, I cannot fathom why the Telophoroi would move to attack the Amalj'aa. If Fandaniel's objective is death and destruction, one of the city-states would surely have been a better target.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_THANCRED_000_116: No, they have some other agenda. One encompassing the recent abductions, perhaps...
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_FLAMEPILOT04062_000: But say the word, and we shall depart for Paglth'an at once.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_A1_000_002: Form a party and depart for Paglth'an.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_ALPHINAUD_000_130: By dealing with Lunar Bahamut and his hordes, so too will we render aid to Arenvald and Fordola. Come, let us go!
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_ALISAIE_000_135: Whether he's here or not, we can be sure Fandaniel is behind this attack. And that makes me doubly determined to see that it fails.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_GRAHATIA_000_140: The grasslands of Paglth'an will make for an open battlefield. Many though our enemy are, we will not have to fight against the terrain, at least.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_URIANGER_000_145: At the cost of his own life did Master Louisoix strike down the primal Bahamut. Whatever the true nature of this new incarnation, it cannot be suffered to threaten this star.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_YSHTOLA_000_150: I know not what designs the Telophoroi have on Paglth'an, but I do know they must be stopped, for the good of the Amalj'aa and us all.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_THANCRED_000_155: Like most who have spent time in Ul'dah, I haven't always seen eye to eye with the Amalj'aa. But today I will fight side by side with them in common cause─and hope that none of them remember me.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_ALISAIE_000_200: From what I could tell, there didn't seem to be many imperials in the vicinity of the tower. Hopefully, Arenvald will have used the opportunity to get in and out undetected.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_GRAHATIA_000_205: Tiamat did all she promised and more this day, but I doubt she will be satisfied. Nay, she will fight on in defense of her children, wheresoever they may be.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_URIANGER_000_210: Though the day is won─thanks in no small part to thy valor─the Telophoroi are far from defeated. Yet be that as it may, 'tis only right that we rejoice in Lunar Bahamut's banishment unto the aether.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_YSHTOLA_000_215: To see the Amalj'aa fighting alongside us brought to mind the Zun of the Crystarium. I pray that our peoples can forge bonds as strong as those of our counterparts in the First.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_THANCRED_000_220: It will take more than a single victory to wash away all the bad blood between men and Amalj'aa...but one has to start somewhere.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_ESTINIEN_000_225: I should have known you'd be the one to end it. Mayhap now Tiamat will find some measure of solace.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_FLAMEPILOT04062_000: Is it true? Has Lunar Bahamut been defeated?
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_ALPHINAUD_000_240: While it would be too much to hope that we have seen the last of Fandaniel, we have dealt his schemes a telling blow this day, and that alone is cause to celebrate.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_ALPHINAUD_000_245: And celebrate I will...when we have received word of Arenvald's safe return.
TEXT_LUCKMK105_04062_SYSTEM_000_500: You may now enter Paglth'an with a party of NPC avatars. To make use of this feature, open the Trust interface located under Duty in the main menu.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ALISAIE_000_000: From what I could tell, there didn't seem to be many imperials in the vicinity of the tower. Hopefully, Arenvald and Fordola will have used the opportunity to get in and out undetected.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_GRAHATIA_000_005: Tiamat did all she promised and more this day, but I doubt she will be satisfied. Nay, she will fight on in defense of her children, wheresoever they may be.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_URIANGER_000_010: Though the day is won─thanks in no small part to thy valor─the Telophoroi are far from defeated. Yet be that as it may, 'tis only right that we rejoice in Lunar Bahamut's banishment unto the aether.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_YSHTOLA_000_015: To see the Amalj'aa fighting alongside us brought to mind the Zun we encountered in the Crystarium. I pray that our peoples can forge bonds as strong as those of our counterparts in the First.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_THANCRED_000_020: It will take more than a single victory to wash away all the bad blood between men and Amalj'aa...but one has to start somewhere.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ESTINIEN_000_025: I should have known you'd be the one to end it. Mayhap now Tiamat will find some measure of solace.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_FLAMEPILOT04062_000: Is it true? Has Lunar Bahamut been defeated?
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ALPHINAUD_000_040: <sigh> Standing around here worrying is not going to help matters. Come, we must discuss the day's events with Pipin and Her Grace.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_NANAMOULNAMO_000_04: Would that I could treat you to a hero's welcome─but I bear urgent news from the Phrontistery.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ALPHINAUD_000_043: Your Grace! Whatever is the matter?
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_NANAMOULNAMO_000_04: As our troops withdrew from Paglth'an, they came upon the two scouts sent to the nearby tower. I have yet to hear a full account, but it seems that one of them─your friend, I believe─had been wounded, and was being dragged away by the other.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ALPHINAUD_000_046: I-I must go. Forgive me, Your Grace!
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_THANCRED_000_047: Can you tell us aught of Arenvald's condition, Your Grace? The wounded scout.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_NANAMOULNAMO_000_04: Naught save that it is grave. The chirurgeons tend to him even as we speak.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ALISAIE_000_049: The infirmary must be inundated with the wounded. If all of us go, we'll only get underfoot. , Estinien─would you mind going after Alphinaud? He may need some support─from someone other than me.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ALISAIE_000_051: Thank you. The rest of us will see that the relevant people know what took place in Paglth'an.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ESTINIEN_000_060: ...I take it Alphinaud is fond of Arenvald.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ESTINIEN_000_061: I know how he feels. But hand-wringing isn't going to help anyone. You had better have a word.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_FORDOLA_000_070: Instead of standing there gawping, why don't you tell your friend to stop whining like an underfed dog? People are fighting for their lives in there.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_FRONDALEHEALER04063: Another one come to see the lad in silver armor? Master Damielliot is attending to him as we speak. If you would be so kind as to wait─
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ALPHINAUD_000_081: What did Master Damielliot say? Tell me his exact words!
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_A2_000_100: Let the chirurgeons do their work.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ALPHINAUD_000_085:
But─ ...You're right. Forgive me.
<sigh> ...When we said our farewells to Arenvald, I was afraid that something like this might happen, but now that it has...
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ESTINIEN_000_100: That woman... She plays at scorn, but her eyes are filled with sorrow. Sorrow deep enough to drown in.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ALPHINAUD_000_121: I know... I know. There is nothing more I can do here. Come, let us rejoin the others.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_FLAMEHERALD04063_00: Ahem. Her Grace invites the Scions of the Seventh Dawn to join her in the Fragrant Chamber.
Your comrades have already arrived. Will the three of you be joining them?
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ALPHINAUD_000_150: Though we have won our first battle against the Telophoroi, and made significant discoveries to boot, the war has scarcely begun. We must steel ourselves for what lies ahead.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_GRAHATIA_000_155: Alphinaud knows only too well that sacrifices are an unavoidable part of conflict.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_GRAHATIA_000_156: But knowing something does not change how one feels about it. You yourself have shared adventures with Arenvald, have you not? ...Then I shall say no more.
