TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_URIANGER_000_160: With the secrets of the towers thus laid bare, our duty to prevent further abductions taketh on new import. Fail in this and our enemy shall punish our negligence with a plague of primals.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_YSHTOLA_000_165: Amidst this great push for peace with the beast tribes, we would do well to remember that old prejudices yet remain. It is a delicate political dance, and I do not envy the sultana her task─nor any Alliance leader.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_THANCRED_000_170: Even without the threat of tempering to contend with, the Grand Companies have quite a task on their hands.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_THANCRED_000_171: Regardless of Her Grace's protestations to the contrary, it may be best to dispatch a few of our own to assist in the endeavor. Remind me to mention it to Tataru, would you?
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ESTINIEN_000_175: If there is no reason to linger, I will take my leave.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ALISAIE_000_200: Right, then. Unless anyone has any objections, I think it's about time we returned to the Rising Stones.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ALISAIE_000_201: And that includes you, Alphinaud. Arenvald is in good hands here.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ALPHINAUD_000_202: ...Of course. He would doubtless mock me for pacing about the infirmary.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ALPHINAUD_000_203: Let us retire, then, that we might regain our strength in readiness for the coming challenges.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_THANCRED_000_204: If all are in agreement, then, I shall let Krile know to expect us. A hot bath and a hearty meal shouldn't be beyond arranging with the time available.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ALPHINAUD_000_205: It will be good to be home. I have some thinking to do...
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_THANCRED_000_206:
Yes, I'll try asking him.
...And thank you, I shall look forward to it.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_THANCRED_000_207: Our comrades eagerly await our return. And Krile, in particular, has a few matters she is keen to discuss─one of which concerns you, Estinien, believe it or not. You will join us, won't you?
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ALPHINAUD_000_209: ...Really? I thought you said you were avoiding “that Baldesion woman.”
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ESTINIEN_000_210: If I refused, she would only pursue me.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ESTINIEN_000_211: Let's get this over with, shall we?
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_ALISAIE_000_240:
Amidst all the fighting, it's easy to forget what we've achieved, isn't it? I mean...we cured Tiamat. Tiamat, for heavens' sake!
...You will tell me if I become insufferably smug, won't you? Because the way things are going, it feels like a definite possibility.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_TATARU_000_250: Well, it looks like I'm going to have a busy few moons─not that they ever seem to be anything but.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_TATARU_000_251: Thancred's got me dispatching troops to every corner of the realm. Which is not to say I don't trust the Alliance, because I do. But when it comes to putting down primals, nobody does it better than us.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_TATARU_000_252: Well, than you lot, more accurately. You won't catch me trading blows with a primal in the near future. But for every fell fiend you vanquish, there's countless meals to arrange, baths to fill, sheets to wash, stores to replenish, and the list goes on.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_TATARU_000_253: Which is where I come in. And gladly, mind you. It's the least I can do to support the Scions who risk life and limb─like poor Arenvald...
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_TATARU_000_254: <sigh> I wish there was something we could do for him. But we'll just have to settle for saying the odd prayer and keeping a roof over our heads.
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_TATARU_000_255: It wouldn't do to have him come back to a complete shambles, now would it?
TEXT_LUCKMK106_04063_TATARU_000_256: ...But that's enough of my rambling. Off you go and get some rest. If there are any developments, I promise you'll be the first to know!
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALISAIE_000_000: Ah, ! You're looking well. I take it you managed to squeeze in some rest. If you came hoping for tidings from Krile, I'm afraid we're still waiting, but we do have some odd scraps of news to share.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_TATARU_000_001: Scraps, she says! Lunar primals have been popping up all over the place, but the Alliance has the situation well in hand─thanks in no small part to Hoary Boulder and the others.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_TATARU_000_002: Meanwhile, talks with the beast tribes are going even better than expected. Encouraged by Ul'dah's progress with the Amalj'aa, Gridania has opened negotiations with the Ixal, believe it or not.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALISAIE_000_003: All of which is obviously very encouraging. But with the Telophoroi still out there, it's not as if we can afford to lower our guard.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_RESISTANCEHERALD040: Begging your pardon, but I come bearing an invitation from the Alliance.
A council meeting is due to be held in Ala Mhigo, and your attendance is humbly requested.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALISAIE_000_005: Ah, we were just talking about the Alliance. May I ask what's on the agenda?
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_RESISTANCEHERALD040: I believe the intention is to share news of recent developments, and discuss what measures might be taken to combat the Telophoroi...in concert with our new allies. The beast tribes have also been invited.
It is hoped that they will join us in the fight against our common foe.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_YSHTOLA_000_008: So the Alliance would bring all of the beast tribes into the fold at a single stroke. An ambitious plan, given the delicacy of the negotiations, but mayhap an expedient one, considering the threat we face.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_RESISTANCEHERALD040: Indeed, my lady. And for their part, I am told the beast tribes have agreed to attend. If the Scions, too, are present, all of Eorzea will be represented.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_010: To arrange such a meeting must have been quite an undertaking, not only diplomatically but practically...
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_011: Pray inform the Alliance that we would be honored to participate. We shall make for Ala Mhigo without delay.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_RESISTANCEHERALD040: Then I will bear your answer thither with all haste. We look forward to receiving you at the Royal Palace.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_THANCRED_000_013: Well, now that we've accepted the invitation, who exactly is going to attend?
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_014: I move that you and Y'shtola lead our contingent. Given how long you have worked to end summoning, it is only right that you be present for what promises to be a historic moment.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_THANCRED_000_015: I think we've all played our part in that little endeavor, don't you, ?
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_URIANGER_000_016: All present may rightly claim a seat, I do quite agree. But by your leave, I believe I shall remain here and lend what assistance I can to the coordination of our defensive efforts.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ESTINIEN_100_016: I'm not coming either. Aymeric will be there, and I'd rather not be interrogated.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_THANCRED_000_017: Very well, then. While those with a mind to hold the fort get on with holding it, I suggest the rest of us make for Ala Mhigo. Shall we?
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_TATARU_000_019: Don't forget to bring me something nice from Ala Mhigo!
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_URIANGER_000_020: I shall take this opportunity to gain a better understanding of Ser Estinien. Being Elezen of like age, 'tis possible we have interests in common.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_URIANGER_000_021: Mayhap I shall begin by lending him a favorite treatise or two from my collection...
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ESTINIEN_000_025: Don't worry, I have no plans to return to roaming in your absence. I know you'd only chase me if I did.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_030: Even with the swift intervention of the Immortal Flames, all too many lost their lives at Paglth'an. Still closer cooperation between our peoples will be required if we are to thwart the plans of the Telophoroi.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALISAIE_000_035: Honestly, the look on your face... Eager to bear witness to another historic moment, by any chance?
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_GRAHATIA_000_040: Hah! I suppose I am. And the fact that our cure for tempering made it possible only heightens my anticipation.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_THANCRED_000_045: The Amalj'aa cannot be the only tribe to have been targeted by the Telophoroi. And none of them will have taken kindly to having their people enslaved, nor their gods turned against them.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_YSHTOLA_000_050: Like the city-states, every beast tribe has its factions, each with their own agenda, making peace a complex proposition. But if the Alliance can come to an understanding with their leaders, it will be for them to resolve internal politics.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_RESISTANCEGATEGUARD: While some few guests have yet to arrive, the Alliance leaders are all present. Shall I show you in?
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALISAIE_000_150: It's a pity it took the threat of annihilation for everyone to cast their grievances aside. But better late than never, I suppose.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_GRAHATIA_000_155: Forgive me for observing, but Alphinaud seems less than jubilant. Might his thoughts still be occupied by the fate of poor Arenvald?
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_THANCRED_000_160: The Grand Company of Eorzea... I wonder what Riol and the other former Crystal Braves will make of it.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_YSHTOLA_000_165: We have won over the leaders. Now the leaders must win over their own people. No small task, I grant you...but we have come a long way since first we joined with Minfilia to bring an end to summoning. A long, long way...
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_180: Well...now that we are out of earshot of the other delegates, I hope you will forgive me if I speak my mind.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_181: Let me begin by saying that I have dreamed of this day since the moment I first set foot upon these shores, and that I was as heartened as anyone to see the peoples of Eorzea pledge their solidarity... Yet even as they uttered their declarations, all I could think about was the conflict to come─of the sacrifices that would be made, and the lives lost. Inevitabilities that I still struggle to accept.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_182: But at least now there is hope. The formation of the Grand Company of Eorzea is the first step. The first of many.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_THANCRED_000_184: Elder Seedseer... How might we be of service?
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_KANESENNA_000_185: I seek Master Alphinaud's assistance in a matter involving Gridania's neighbors, the sylphs.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_KANESENNA_000_186: I know that you and yours have long kept a weather eye upon the crystal trade, the better to predict the coming of primals, and so you will be familiar with the sylphs of the Ashcrown Consortium.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_KANESENNA_100_186: Through their dealings, they have cultivated relations not only with the city-states, but many other communities besides.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_187: Communities such as the beast tribes.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_KANESENNA_000_188: Just so. It is our hope that we may make use of the sylphs' established lines of communication to coordinate the efforts of our new fellowship.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_KANESENNA_000_189: Yet there remain certain practical differences between a trade consortium and a Grand Company. If the sylphs are to perform their task effectively, they will require the counsel of one versed in the operational aspects of an armed force.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_THANCRED_000_190: An armed force founded with the selfsame goal in mind, no less.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_KANESENNA_000_191: The Crystal Braves, yes. Forgive me, Master Alphinaud. I know that it was a painful chapter in your life, but the experience may yet be made to serve the realm.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_192: <sigh> In my hubris, I plotted a course for the Crystal Braves which stretched far beyond the order's initial conception; one intended to pave the way for the founding of what I intended to call “the Grand Company of Eorzea.”
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_193: But my plans all came to naught. Built upon a frail foundation of lofty ideals, the order was doomed from the first to collapse under the weight of more worldly interests. And I have no wish to see this new endeavor suffer the same fate.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_KANESENNA_000_194: Mayhap I ask too much of you...
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_195: Not at all. You may count upon my assistance, for what little it is worth. By your leave, I shall prepare a report, including a list of recommendations drawing on the lessons I learned from the failures of the Crystal Braves.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_KANESENNA_000_196: You have my gratitude, Master Alphinaud...and my trust. When your report is ready, pray share it directly with the sylphs.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_KANESENNA_100_196: With your guidance, and the earnest efforts of every goodly soul gathered here this day, I have no doubt but that our fellowship shall emerge from the shadow of the Telophoroi and flourish. Until next we meet, my friends.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_197: Before committing anything to writing, there are a number of people whose thoughts I should like to hear. Former Braves, you understand. Might you join me in seeking them out?
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_A1_000_100: As if you have to ask.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_A2_000_100: I can't think of an excuse not to, so...yes?
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_200: Thank you. As someone who witnessed the order's rise and fall, yours would be a reassuring presence.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_205: Well, I shall be grateful of your help, grudging or not!
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALISAIE_000_210: I'll join you. If you're planning to canvass the opinions of your former comrades, it will be a lot quicker if we share the task of questioning them.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_YSHTOLA_000_211: Then mayhap G'raha can lend a hand as well. I shall accompany Thancred back to the Rising Stones. Between us, I daresay we should be able to provide an accurate enough account of the day's events.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_212: We should be glad of your company, G'raha. I shall explain the details on the way.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_GRAHATIA_000_220: I take it we will soon be paying the sylphs a visit? How fascinating it will be to speak with them in person...though I gather conversation can prove rather...challenging?
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_225: It will not be easy to revisit the past, but sometimes one must look back to see the way forward.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALISAIE_000_240: So, what's the plan, brother mine?
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_241: Before discussing the task at hand, I should probably admit that the report I proposed is largely written.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_242: Not long after that fateful day in Ul'dah, I penned a detailed account of the organization's history, from the events that led to its inception to the failings that brought about its demise. This I did primarily as a means of taking some semblance of responsibility; never did I imagine that it might later be referred to by those seeking to form a similar organization.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_243: And while I made every attempt to be objective, the account was mine alone; its events viewed from my singular perspective. For it to be of use, however, it must be broadened to encompass the viewpoints of all involved. Only then can it answer what seems to me to be the crucial question...namely: why, after the Crystal Braves disbanded, did some members choose to remain with us while others did not?
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALISAIE_000_244: I see. You think the answer will tell us something about the nature of the ties that bind our new Grand Company together.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALISAIE_000_245: And that this knowledge might help us to prevent it from falling apart when those bonds are inevitably tested.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_246: That is my hope, yes. But the questions I would ask are uncomfortable to some. As the former commander of the Crystal Braves, I doubt that those who abandoned the cause would welcome my inquiries.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALISAIE_000_247: Then G'raha and I will just have to try.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALISAIE_000_248: Meanwhile, the two of you can talk to the ones who kept the faith.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_249: A fine suggestion. Have care, however─certain of my former comrades are...of questionable character. So keep your wits about you, and let us reconvene in Gridania later on.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_250: If you have no objections, I've a mind to begin by speaking with Riol and Alianne. If memory serves, the two of them will be attending an intelligence briefing at Castrum Oriens. Let us seek them out there.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_260: While such briefings are seldom exciting affairs, their importance in coordinating our efforts with our allies cannot be overstated. In that regard, Alianne and Riol have been most dependable.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALIANNE_000_265: Oh? I didn't expect to see you here, . But if you enjoy intelligence briefings, you've come to the right place.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_RIOL_000_280: Well, look who it is! An' what brings you two here? Wouldn't have anythin' to do with the big meetin', would it?
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_281: In a manner of speaking. I have been assigned a task, you see, for which I require the assistance of former members of the Crystal Braves...
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_RIOL_000_282: So ye want to know why we decided to stick with the Scions, eh? Hmmm... Ain't an easy thing to put into words, that...
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALIANNE_000_285: As I once explained to , I spent a long time agonizing over my failure to alert you to the traitors in our midst. For my negligence, I was captured along with many others, and we were powerless to prevent the tragedies that ensued.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALIANNE_000_290: As Riol will attest, I spent a long time agonizing over my failure to alert you to the traitors in our midst. For my negligence, I was captured along with many others, and we were powerless to prevent the tragedies that ensued.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALIANNE_000_295: Not a day goes by that I do not think back to those fateful events. By joining the Scions, I hoped to redeem myself, and I will continue to serve the cause for as long as I am able.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALIANNE_000_296: But that wasn't my only reason.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALIANNE_000_297: When we were finally reunited at the Rising Stones, you refused to blame anyone but yourself for the fall of the Crystal Braves.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALIANNE_000_298: And in spite of everything that had happened─everything you had suffered─you took us back without a moment's hesitation.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALIANNE_000_299: We would not have blamed you had you turned us away. But when you gave us your trust instead, what else could we do but try to repay it?
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_RIOL_000_300: Nothin', that's what! ...As for me own tale, well, I've always felt the Scions have somethin' in common with me old crew. “The duty of the strong is to protect the weak”─that was our creed, an' I still strive to live by it to this day.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_RIOL_000_301: But as time's gone on, I've learned that strength comes in many shapes an' sizes. From Hoary Boulder to Mistress Tataru, we've all of us got somethin' to offer.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_RIOL_000_302: An' not one of us is doin' it for personal gain. 'Cause we believe there's more important things than that─things worth protectin'─which is what bein' a Scion's all about.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_303: I... I am at a loss for words. Thank you, my friends. To hear this from you means more than you know.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_A1_000_200: Give us your thoughts on the Crystal Braves.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_A2_000_200: Why do you think the Crystal Braves ended in failure?
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_RIOL_000_305: Well, its foundin' ideals were somethin' to be proud of. But ideals alone don't make a crew.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_RIOL_100_305: For every swab who signed up with good intentions, there was another who was only in it for the coin, the glory, or both.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALIANNE_000_306: Ours was quite a disparate band. And while I will never forgive Ilberd, the fact that we managed to function at all was thanks in large part to his efforts.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_RIOL_000_307: Just a pity he was doin' it for all the wrong reasons, eh? Only takes one bad apple, they say, an' the Braves had a barrelful of 'em. Not like the Scions. We might look like a ragtag band o' misfits, but deep down, we've all got that shared sense o' purpose. An' why? 'Cause Tataru sifted out all the glory-hunters 'fore they made it through the door!
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_308: I see. So while our ranks comprise a diverse range of people, each with their own individual strengths, we are all united in purpose.
TEXT_LUCKML101_04064_ALPHINAUD_000_309: ...Thank you, my friends. With your permission, I shall make a record of our discussion and refer to it when drafting my recommendations. Until we meet again.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_RIOL_000_000: After the Company of Heroes went their separate ways, I did try workin' on me own for a bit. An' I'll admit, it was nice bein' able to pick me own battles. But if ye want to make a real difference, ye need to find a good crew an' stick with 'em.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALIANNE_000_005: Speaking of former Crystal Braves, I have not seen Aergmhus of late, constantly away on missions as he is. I wonder how he fares.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALPHINAUD_000_020: Well, I think we have taken up enough of our colleagues' time...and I am conscious that less life-affirming testimonies await. Let us make our way to Gridania and hear what the others have learned.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALPHINAUD_000_040: On the way here, I took the opportunity to write up my notes from our conversation with Alianne and Riol. All that remains is to add Alisaie and G'raha's findings, whatever they may be...
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_GRAHATIA_000_045: When Alisaie sets her mind on something, there is no stopping her. And her mind was truly set on finding former Braves. For a while, I even feared what she might do to them. But in the event, she was admirably civil. For the most part.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALISAIE_000_060: Thanks to Tataru's ever-dependable intelligence, we managed to track down a handful of former Braves without any great difficulty.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALISAIE_000_061: Some were forthright, others less so, but we heard enough to form a picture. I must warn you, Alphinaud─some of their comments were...harsh.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALPHINAUD_000_062: I can well imagine. But their opinions are no less vital to my report. I seek the unvarnished truth.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALPHINAUD_000_063: Thank you. I will set about adding your findings to my own at once. In the meantime, pray go on ahead to Little Solace and seek out Elder Frixio. I will join you anon.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALPHINAUD_000_070: Leave me to attend to my report and join the others in Little Solace. I shan't keep you waiting long. I know how playful the sylphs can be...
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_GRAHATIA_000_075: Though I had the honor of sharing a table with Elder Frixio in Ala Mhigo, I did not have an opportunity to speak with him. I do hope my studies have granted me a sufficient grasp of his people's customs.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALISAIE_000_080: Now that I think about it, of the four of us, only you and Alphinaud have any real experience in conversing with sylphs. Still, it can't be that hard, can it?
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_FRIXIO_000_100: Ah, welcome, brave one and friends of brave one! How good it is to see walking ones again so soon after the meeting.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_A1_000_100: It's been a while since we last spoke.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_A2_000_100: ...Should this one perform the customary dance of greeting?
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_FRIXIO_000_105: Indeed it has! Though the palace was very pretty, the meeting was far too noisy for this one. So many shouting ones and squawking ones and cheering ones, with no chance for carefree conversation. Still, this one is pleased all ones can be friends.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_FRIXIO_000_110: No, no! Be at ease. It is true that these ones once delighted in making walking ones dance, but no more.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_FRIXIO_000_115: Oh dear, did brave one take a knock to the head? This one is Frixio! Or perhaps brave one is joking one, yes?
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_FRIXIO_000_120: Horned one Kan-E-Senna said that walking ones would be coming to Little Solace. Imperial ones also invaded Sylphlands and abducted many of these ones, so these ones will be glad to bear messages between fighting friendly ones!
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_GRAHATIA_000_121: That is heartening to hear, Elder. It will require all ones to work in unison to stop the Telophoroi.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_FRIXIO_000_122: These ones will try very hard, of course, but in matters of war, these ones have little experience. Any advice walking ones can provide would be most welcome.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_FRIXIO_000_123: ...Oh? Another pretty silver-haired one? And in quite a hurry, it seems.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALISAIE_000_125: Whatever's the matter, Alphinaud? Don't tell me─you couldn't read my handwriting.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALPHINAUD_000_126: What? No! A Twin Adder officer accosted me as I was about to set out.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALPHINAUD_000_127: Sharlayan has sent an envoy, who is due to arrive in Gridania at any moment!
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_GRAHATIA_000_128: An envoy? Could it be that Krile has managed to sway the Forum?
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALPHINAUD_000_129: We shall know soon enough. But there is more. The envoy has requested that the two of us attend the audience with the Elder Seedseer.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALISAIE_000_130: ...Really? I can see why they might want Scions to be present, but us specifically? ...Wait. It isn't who I think it is?
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALPHINAUD_000_131: ...It is. I could scarce believe it myself, but when I inquired as to the envoy's identity, I was told that it was one “Fourchenault Leveilleur.”
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_GRAHATIA_100_131: Your father? Well, now... The fact that a serving member of the Forum had journeyed here would be surprise enough─but him?
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALPHINAUD_101_131: Quite. I glean from this that they are taking the matter seriously.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALISAIE_000_132: That may be, but why him and not one of the other ninety-eight Forum members? Unless he volunteered for it...
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_GRAHATIA_100_132: It has been some time since you last saw your father, has it not? Could it be that he is concerned for your well-being?
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALISAIE_101_132: ...Perhaps. But he has always been reluctant to discuss his work with us.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALPHINAUD_102_132: Indeed. And whenever we write to our parents, it is invariably our mother who replies.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALPHINAUD_000_133: Nevertheless, I welcome the opportunity to meet with him after so long, even if it is secondary to his true purpose here.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALPHINAUD_000_134: Elder Frixio─loath though I am to cut our visit short, we must return to Gridania. Pray accept my apologies, along with my report.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_FRIXIO_000_135: Never mind. There will be time to talk later. This one won't keep walking ones from more urgent matters. Go!
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALPHINAUD_000_136: The audience will be held at the Lotus Stand, where the Elder Seedseer awaits even now. Let us be on our way.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_FRIXIO_000_145: Don't mind this one. Walking one should head back to Gridania with the others. If this one has any questions about the report, this one will be sure to send word.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_SILENTCONJURER_000_: Welcome, Warrior of Light. The Elder Seedseer and your friends are waiting within.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALPHINAUD_000_180: Ninety-nine may seem like rather a lot of members, but before the Forum was founded, every person of age in Sharlayan was given equal say in its governance.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALPHINAUD_000_181: Many of the institutions that are still active today were established by the people's vote, not least the Studium. As Alisaie and I were constantly reminded during our time there, it is an example of what can be achieved through absolute democracy.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_GRAHATIA_000_185: During my time in Sharlayan, I heard much of Fourchenault Leveilleur. He is a gifted speaker, known amongst other things for the uncompromising application of Forum policy.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALISAIE_000_190: After all this time away, it will be good to see my father. Even if it is at an official meeting.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_SILENTCONJURER_000_: Come, the Elder Seedseer awaits you in the Lotus Stand.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_KANESENNA_000_210: My friends, I thank you all for coming so swiftly.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_KANESENNA_000_211: Word of Master Fourchenault's visit took us quite by surprise. When the Alliance granted Mistress Krile permission to request Sharlayan's aid, we did not anticipate so prompt a reply, much less that it would be delivered by a member of the Forum.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_KANESENNA_000_212: What the nature of that reply may be, we shall soon discover...
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALPHINAUD_000_230: Is it we who walk the path of ruin? Time will tell.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_GRAHATIA_000_235: In order to avoid conflict with Garlemald, the Forum went so far as to order the abandonment of an entire city-state. Their refusal to aid us now is, I am sorry to say, entirely consistent with their historic position.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_KANESENNA_000_240: It was not so very long ago that we had a friend and neighbor in Sharlayan, and so I clung to the hope that she might yet lend us her strength. But when she forsook Dravania, it would seem she forsook us all.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALISAIE_000_260: So that's what he came here to say!?
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALISAIE_000_261: That we're all fools for having the temerity to defend ourselves against the Telophoroi!? And as for the rest─
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALPHINAUD_000_262: Like it or not, this was the Forum's decision. To watch from afar while Eorzea burns.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALPHINAUD_000_263: Father was but the messenger. And as he handed down their judgment, I could think of nothing to say that could possibly sway him. I...still can't.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_KANESENNA_000_264: To have prolonged the discussion would have changed little, for it is not only Master Fourchenault who must be persuaded, but the Forum as a whole. Their decision was made ere your father crossed the sea.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_KANESENNA_000_265: Nor is it like to be changed. And so we shall face the Telophoroi without their aid.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_GRAHATIA_000_266: Forgive me, but if they had no intention of helping us, then why would they go to the trouble of sending an envoy in the first place? Why did they not simply keep their counsel, as they are wont to do?
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_KRILE_000_268: (-Krile-)Then it is as I feared. My efforts were in vain.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_KRILE_000_269: (-Krile-)I pleaded our case to as many Forum members as I could, but they flatly refused to discuss the matter. No─that's not exactly true. I should rather say that they ignored every word I said on the subject, without exception. It was almost unnerving.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_GRAHATIA_000_270: Could it be that they are hiding something from us? That might go some way to explain Master Fourchenault's...performance.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_GRAHATIA_100_270: When he said that they would know if the Final Days were truly upon us, I dismissed it as pride. But what if they genuinely believe that they know how the world will end, and simply disagree with us about the circumstances?
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_KRILE_000_271: (-Krile-)That I don't know...but something tells me they are not as unconcerned about the Telophoroi as they claim.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_KRILE_000_272: (-Krile-)If the threat weren't real, why else would they be so standoffish and secretive?
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_KRILE_000_273: (-Krile-)I would very much like to delve deeper into this, but I'm afraid I've exhausted every avenue of inquiry.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_KRILE_000_274: (-Krile-)Nor have I fared any better with my other mission, researching Hydaelyn and the aetherial sea. I tried enlisting the help of experts in the field, but it appears the Forum has forbidden anyone from cooperating with us.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_KRILE_101_274: (-Krile-)So it would seem, but don't lose heart just yet. With all the knowledge and acquaintances we have between us, we can still find a way forward.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_KRILE_102_274: (-Krile-)To that end, I would like you all to join me here─when the time is right, of course. I am aware that matters in Eorzea stand on a knife-edge, but with your permission, I can at least start making the necessary arrangements.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_A1_000_200: I've always wanted to visit Sharlayan!
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_A3_000_200: Well, there are one or two things to take care of here first...
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_KRILE_000_280: (-Krile-)And so you shall! Albeit under less-than-happy circumstances.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_KRILE_000_281: (-Krile-)It may take a while to secure entry for you all, but I'll let you know when everything is in order. Look after yourselves in the meantime, won't you?
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_KRILE_000_285: (-Krile-)Excellent. Obviously, keeping the Telophoroi at bay must take precedence, but with luck, you'll be able to make the journey to Sharlayan ere long.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_KRILE_000_286: (-Krile-)It may take a while to secure entry for you all, but I'll let you know when everything is in order. Look after yourselves in the meantime, won't you?
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_KRILE_000_287: (-Krile-)After which, assisting me will seem a sweet relief, I'm sure.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_KRILE_000_288: (-Krile-)While you attend to matters heroical, I shall see about securing entry for you all, and will let you know when everything is in order. Take care in the meantime, won't you?
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_KANESENNA_000_290: Your speculations give me cause to hope. Yet if these seeds will bear fruit, I cannot say. While it is possible the Sharlayans hide some secret truth from us, there can be no certainty that its exposure will prompt in them a change of heart. And so, for the present, we must needs confront the plight in which we find ourselves.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_KANESENNA_000_292: The Forum has refused our request for aid, and it falls to us alone to contend with the Telophoroi.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALPHINAUD_000_293: Even with all of Eorzea standing united, there is no guarantee that we will prevail.
TEXT_LUCKML102_04065_ALPHINAUD_000_294: What does Sharlayan intend to do if we fail?
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALPHINAUD_000_000: Throughout my childhood, I remember Grandfather arguing with my father over Sharlayan's policy of nonintervention. And this time, it was my turn to play the role.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALPHINAUD_000_001: But if even my grandfather could not win him over, what chance had I? If words exist that may sway him, I know not what they are...
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALISAIE_000_005: With their knowledge, Sharlayan could have done so much for the cause! They could have helped us to uncover the secrets of the towers and save the tempered captives within, and yet─ Gods!
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_GRAHATIA_000_010: The Forum includes representatives from all of Sharlayan's central institutions. With them hindering Krile's investigation, she will struggle to make any headway on her own.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_SILENTCONJURER_000_: Have you more to discuss with the Elder Seedseer?
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_KANESENNA_000_030: While Sharlayan's stance is indeed disappointing, we cannot allow ourselves to be distracted from the challenge before us. There is much and more to be done.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_KANESENNA_000_031: I shall begin by sharing the Forum's response with my counterparts in the Alliance. Meanwhile, I would ask that the Scions─
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_SYLPHICSERVANT04066: (-???-)Grave tidings, walking ones! Grave, grave tidings!
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_KANESENNA_000_033: Calm yourself, my gentle friend. What has occurred?
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_SYLPHICSERVANT04066: These ones who went to see feathered ones send terrible news! Destroying ones have appeared in Xelphatol!
Destroying ones and captured ones and even frightful godly ones! Feathered ones didn't stand a chance and were sent flapping and squawking!
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALISAIE_000_036: When did this happen!? Is it too late to help them?
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_SYLPHICSERVANT04066: Too late, yes, much too late! But luckily, destroying ones were only passing through, and continued on west. Feathered ones who did not fight were left unharmed.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_BODYGUARD04066_000_: My lady, the Ishgardians report that the Telophoroi have emerged from the eastern highlands of Coerthas and are marching at speed.
Though their purpose has yet to be determined, the Carteneau Flats would seem their most likely destination. Lord Aymeric has already dispatched his forces, and requests our immediate support.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_KANESENNA_000_041: Tell him he shall have it. The time is come for the Grand Company of Eorzea to prove its worth.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALPHINAUD_000_042: Well...mayhap it is a mercy that we do not have time to stew upon our misfortunes. Come, my friends, let us make haste to Carteneau!
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_SYLPHICSERVANT04066: W-Wait! This one almost forgot! Destroying ones were said to be led by cackling robed one! This one must see that all walking ones know! Farewell!
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALISAIE_000_045: Who else. It was only a matter of time before that grinning maniac showed himself again.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_KANESENNA_000_046: I shall have an airship readied to bear you to Carteneau. Pray see to your preparations and report to the landing with all haste.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALPHINAUD_000_048: At once, my lady. Let us away.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_KANESENNA_000_055: The airship will be ready to depart ere long. I bid you make for the landing as soon as you are able. And may the Twelve keep you.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_GRAHATIA_000_060: I have apprised our comrades at the Rising Stones of the situation. They will head directly to Carteneau.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALISAIE_000_065: Alphinaud has been unexpectedly delayed... But you should probably go and see for yourself. He's by the entrance.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_FORDOLA_000_070: Come on. This'll only take a moment, all right?
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALPHINAUD_000_090: . It would seem Fordola here has come all the way to Gridania to find us.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALPHINAUD_000_091: I have explained the situation, but she insists her business is urgent.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_FORDOLA_000_092: Aye, and it'll be over sooner if you shut up and come with me.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_GRAHATIA_000_110: After Paglth'an, I had assumed the Telophoroi would continue to target settlements, but it is plain they considered Xelphatol a mere obstacle on the road to Carteneau. What, then, draws them to the Flats? ...We must keep a close eye on their movements.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALPHINAUD_000_115: I rather doubt that Fordola obtained the chirurgeons' permission before bringing Arenvald halfway across the realm.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALPHINAUD_000_116: ...And solely to deliver a message at that. They should both have known better! But what's done is done...and I will not soon forget his words.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALISAIE_000_130: You can tell me later what that was all about, but judging by the set of Alphinaud's jaw, it appears to have done him some good.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALISAIE_000_131: Thancred and the others have already left the Rising Stones. And according to the communications officer, Amalj'aa and kobold forces are also bound for Carteneau as we speak.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALISAIE_000_132: They mean to keep the promise they made in Ala Mhigo, and we must do the same, by saving as many of their tempered kin as possible.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALISAIE_000_134: Anyway, the airship is ready to depart. We should get going.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_SYSTEM_000_150:
Upon joining the battle at Carteneau, several cutscenes will play in sequence.
It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to participate in the battle and view these scenes in their entirety.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_SYSTEM_000_151: Your progress through the battle will be saved at certain points. In the event that you are defeated, you will be able to try again from the most recent of these.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_SYSTEM_000_152: Please note that if you enter battles associated with other quests or log out from the game, this progress will be lost.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_SYSTEM_000_153: You must be a Disciple of War or Magic of level 80 or above to proceed.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_SYSTEM_000_200: As the Scions spread out across the field, Alisaie and G'raha take the fight to the Telophoroi...
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALISAIE_000_601: The glyph? Yes. How worried should we be?
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_YSHTOLA_000_602: Listen well, and judge for yourself. Though I can see aetherial currents, I had not thoroughly examined those that flow through the heart of Carteneau. But now that I am here, things have become clear.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_YSHTOLA_000_603: The Flats conceal an aetheric confluence, like to the pillars of the Azim Steppe, but greater in scale. Far greater.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_YSHTOLA_000_604: The glyphs that Fandaniel has conjured reach into its very midst...
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_YSHTOLA_000_605: ...And I believe I know their purpose. Should the lunar primals destroy them, it would spark a chain reaction with the potential to obliterate the confluence entirely.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_YSHTOLA_100_605: The resultant disruption to the flow of aether would sow chaos among the elements, prompting earthquakes, floods, and tempests large enough to lay waste to the realm.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_URIANGER_000_606: That he would go so far cometh as little surprise. We must needs protect the confluence at all costs.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_SYSTEM_000_300: Meanwhile, G'raha Tia and Alisaie prepare to lock swords with Lunar Ravana...
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_SYSTEM_000_400: At the selfsame moment, you stand shoulder to shoulder with Alphinaud and Estinien, resolved to lay Lunar Ifrit low...
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALISAIE_000_700: The tempered that we were able to treat will be taken to the city-states for observation. As soon as the Alliance is satisfied that they're fully recovered, they will be free to return home.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALPHINAUD_000_705: At the close of the battle, when the clouds parted and the moon shone down on us all...I cannot well express how I felt. Somehow, it seemed more a beginning than an ending.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_GRAHATIA_000_710: Throughout the battle, I could not shake the feeling that all present were performing for the amusement of Fandaniel.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_GRAHATIA_000_711: Nor did his blithe reaction to this latest defeat give me cause to think otherwise. I can only conclude that such failures are of little consequence to his broader scheme...whatever it may be.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_THANCRED_000_715: It was decent of Lord Aymeric to bear us home aboard his airship. The gods only know how we would have squeezed this many people onto the Bonanza...
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_YSHTOLA_000_720: I will recommend that the Alliance keep a closer watch over Carteneau. The Telophoroi may have failed in their attempt to destroy the confluence this time, but there is naught to stop them trying again.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_URIANGER_000_725: The Carteneau Flats seem fated to play a prominent role in the history of the realm, do they not? I wonder...might the abundance of aether that floweth through the region have led the Allagans to entomb Omega there?
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ESTINIEN_000_730: Many though the enemy were, their numbers consisted largely of tempered beastmen, with a few lunar primals to keep things interesting. The Garleans themselves ventured little, and lost less.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ESTINIEN_000_731: It has ever been the Empire's way to have others fight their battles, but even they would blush at the Telophoroi's use of tempered slaves.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_TATARU_000_735: You should've seen my face when Lord Aymeric turned up on our doorstep. Did none of you think to send word he was bringing you home?
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_AYMERIC_000_750: I trust you all enjoyed a comfortable flight aboard the pride of the Ishgardian fleet? Lest you worry, the Bonanza has been towed to a nearby location to be retrieved at your convenience.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_THANCRED_000_751: You have thought of everything, Lord Aymeric. And may I say how much I appreciated the hospitality you afforded us on the way home.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_AYMERIC_000_752: Think nothing of it. Our destination lay in the same direction─and it afforded me the perfect opportunity to learn how my errant friend has been since last he took his leave.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_AYMERIC_000_753: It would seem you have finally found a place to settle down.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ESTINIEN_000_754: Hmph. I merely grew weary of wandering the Far East.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_AYMERIC_000_755: Returning to more serious matters─while the Telophoroi have been driven from Carteneau, 'tis like that the bulk of their forces yet remain.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_AYMERIC_000_756: On the evidence of the Grand Company of Eorzea's first joint military operation, however, I am confident that we have the potential to meet such threats head-on─even without the aid of you and yours.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_AYMERIC_000_757: As such, while our forces keep the Telophoroi at bay, I would ask that you apply your talents to the task of neutralizing the towers.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_YSHTOLA_000_758: A sensible division of labor. While the towers remain, so too will the threat of the lunar primals.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_YSHTOLA_100_758: And given our expertise in the field of aetherology, we are better qualified to find the solution.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_THANCRED_101_758: That we are. Especially should it happen to lie beyond the Alliance's dominion.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_THANCRED_102_758: There is a time and a place for formal investigations, of course, but certain secrets are wont to hide where only enterprising individuals may venture.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_AYMERIC_000_759: I could not agree more. There are none better suited to this task, nor any upon whom I would rather rely.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_AYMERIC_100_759: On behalf of the Alliance, I thank you. We look forward to receiving any information you are able to uncover.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_AYMERIC_101_759: And with that, I must take my leave. Should you have need of assistance, pray do not hesitate to ask. Fare you well, my friends.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALPHINAUD_000_760: I confess, I had hoped to be able to study the towers more closely, vital as they plainly are to the Telophoroi's plans. If we can discern their ultimate function, we will be one step closer to understanding our enemy's grand scheme.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALPHINAUD_000_761: Should we succeed in neutralizing them, of course, it is all but certain that the Telophoroi will mount an all-out invasion.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALPHINAUD_000_762: And then it will begin. The one who awaits at the heart of the chaos will come for us. For you.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALPHINAUD_100_762: ...Yet in the end, our true nemesis may be the calamity to end all calamities. The Final Days themselves.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALISAIE_000_765: Yes, all right, Alphinaud. We need a plan, not portents. As Thancred so eloquently pointed out, we are in a position to seek information from all manner of places, not least...
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_GRAHATIA_101_765: According to Krile, the Forum have been more secretive than ever of late. While this may be related to the appearance of the Telophoroi, that remains a matter of speculation.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_GRAHATIA_102_765: But one thing is clear: the Forum is determined to keep us from discovering the truth. Master Fourchenault's performance at the Lotus Stand was enough to convince me of that.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_URIANGER_103_765: The matter beareth further investigation, I do heartily concur.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_URIANGER_104_765: Nor can I think of a more promising place to look for the answers we seek on the matter of the towers. Sharlayan hath ever been the wellspring of aetherological knowledge.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ESTINIEN_105_765: I care not where we go. Here or there, my lance will be ready.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_THANCRED_106_765: And what of you, ? Might you be persuaded to join us?
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_A2_000_100: If it means I can have words with Fourchenault...
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_A3_000_100: An island of bookworms and bureaucrats? Have we no other choice?
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALPHINAUD_110_765: Hear, hear! It is time we laid bare the Telophoroi's dark designs!
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_ALISAIE_116_770: If he and his friends in the Forum think we'll leave them alone if they ignore us, they're in for a shock!
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_THANCRED_120_765: To be frank, I myself would sooner plump for a tropical paradise. But Krile does need our help, and who knows where the trail might lead us?
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_YSHTOLA_000_766: It appears we are in agreement. We have but to wait for Krile to secure the necessary permissions. In the meantime, there is a matter I would investigate.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_YSHTOLA_000_768: By strange coincidence, it does. At present, I have only a creeping suspicion, but with your help, I will soon find out whether my fears are warranted.
TEXT_LUCKML103_04066_SYSTEM_000_770: You have learned the emote Shush!
